All six models lose their initial height during a $180^\circ$ turn-and-walk rollout: initialized at 0.15 m, only 0-20% of clips end within $1.3\times$ of the starting height as inferred viewpoints converge to human heights of 1.1 m to 1.5 m, whereas ground-truth renders remain within a few percent. In Matrix-Game models, homography-tracked floor motion stays consistent with constant elevation during rotation even as newly outpainted room geometry yields a higher reconstructed viewpoint. Regression grows with rotation angle, begins while the start frame remains in context, and largely reverses in SANA-WM when a $360^\circ$ turn restores the initial view. We trace this pull to human-centric video priors in which floor-level views are nearly absent: in SANA-WM, textual height cues and dense floor-disparity maps do not prevent it, whereas classifier-free text guidance during the first half of denoising strengthens it. Combining unguided sampling with height-balanced fine-tuning recovers more retention but costs 5 MUSIQ points, a loss fixed during those same early steps. Viewpoint drift alone shifts the paths predicted by visual navigation policies.

AI.tldr: 论文发现交互式视频世界模型存在"相机高度回归"问题：相机运动后生成内容会把视角拉向人类眼高，偏离起始高度。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型被用作具身智能体的模拟器，起始图像固定了相机高度（如地面机器人0.15m、顶视相机2.2m），忠实模拟器必须在相机移动时保持该高度。作者要检验现有模型是否满足这一基本要求。
AI.method: 构建EyeHeight基准：6种渲染高度（0.15–2.2m）与4种标定真实装置高度配对，采用无尺度多视角高度估计评估。对6个开源权重模型做180°转身行走测试，并结合单应性追踪地板运动、消融文本高度提示、稠密地板视差图、无分类器文本引导、高度均衡微调等手段定位原因。
AI.result: 6个模型全部失败：从0.15m初始化，仅0–20%片段的推断视角落在起始高度1.3倍以内，视角收敛到1.1–1.5m的人类眼高，而真值渲染误差仅几个百分点。回归随旋转角度增大，起始帧仍在上下文中时即已出现；360°转回初始视角时SANA-WM中可大部分逆转。文本高度提示与稠密地板视差图均无效，前半个去噪阶段的CFG会加剧回归。无引导采样加高度均衡微调可提升保持度，但损失5个MUSIQ点。仅视角漂移就会改变视觉导航策略的预测路径。
AI.conclusion: 相机高度回归源于以人类为中心的视频先验（地面视角数据近乎缺失），是现有视频世界模型作为具身模拟器的系统性缺陷；单纯提示或几何线索难以修复，需在采样与训练层面干预，且需权衡画质与导航策略可靠性。

title: Exploiting Aggregate Feedback for Decentralized Equilibrium Learning in Markov Games: A Smart Grid Application
summary: In many multi-agent systems, an agent's payoff depends on its own action and an aggregate of other agents' actions, rather than their individual decisions. This paper investigates decentralized equilibrium learning in Markov games (MGs) with such aggregative reward structures. However, existing decentralized learning algorithms for general MGs typically rely on bandit feedback, without exploiting the additional information available from aggregate observations. To exploit this information, we develop an aggregation-predictive stage-based V-learning algorithm with hybrid-feedback Exp3-IX. Using known local reward functions and observed aggregate quantities, each agent evaluates the immediate rewards of all candidate actions and predicts their immediate losses from historical aggregate feedback, while continuation values are learned from selected-action state transitions. The algorithm requires neither opponents' individual information nor knowledge of the transition kernel. We establish a high-probability regret bound that explicitly depends on aggregate prediction errors and retains the standard worst-case order. Under a regularity condition on adaptive stage lengths, the algorithm learns an $ε$-approximate coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE) within $\widetilde O(SA_{\max}T^5/ε^2)$ episodes and extends to correlated equilibrium (CE) learning. We further apply the algorithm to a renewable-rich microgrid with strategic prosumers and shared energy storage. Numerical results show smaller deviation gaps and lower gap-AUC than three learning baselines. Compared with representative demand-response rules, the learned policies exhibit weaker incentives for unilateral deviations while maintaining favorable user rewards, high renewable utilization, and relatively stable electricity prices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有聚合型奖励结构的马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化均衡学习，提出一种利用聚合观测的"聚合预测式分阶段V-learning + 混合反馈Exp3-IX"算法，在无对手个体信息、未知转移核条件下给出高概率遗憾界，并学习到CCE/CE，最后应用于含策略型产消者的微电网。
AI.motivation: 现有一般马尔可夫博弈的去中心化学习算法多依赖bandit反馈，未能利用"聚合观测"这一额外信息（智能体收益只依赖他人动作的聚合而非个体决策），因此存在改进空间。
AI.method: 提出聚合预测式分阶段V-learning算法，结合混合反馈Exp3-IX：利用已知局部奖励函数与观测到的聚合量评估所有候选动作的即时奖励，并由历史聚合反馈预测即时损失；延续价值则从所选动作的状态转移中学习。算法无需对手个体信息与转移核知识。
AI.result: 给出显式依赖聚合预测误差且保持标准最坏情况阶的高概率遗憾界；在自适应阶段长度的正则条件下，可在 Õ(SA_max T^5/ε²) 回合内学到 ε-近似粗相关均衡（CCE），并可扩展到相关均衡（CE）。微电网数值实验中，偏差间隙与gap-AUC均小于三个基线；相较代表性需求响应规则，所学策略单边偏离激励更弱，同时保持较好用户收益、高可再生能源利用率和较稳定电价。
AI.conclusion: 利用聚合反馈信息可在去中心化马尔可夫博弈中有效提升均衡学习性能，理论上保证CCE/CE收敛，实践中在策略型产消者微电网场景展现出更稳定、更具抗偏离性的电价与调度策略。

title: Revision-Consistent Code Context for Agents That Edit Their Environment
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Source code and reproducibility artifacts are available at https://github.com/mengshi02/codetrip
summary:
Editing agents query repositories while simultaneously changing them. Source content, symbols, graph relations, and retrieval state may be maintained by different stores and refreshed at different times. During an update, a successful query can therefore combine facts that never belonged to the same repository state. We call this condition mixed-revision code context.
  This paper proposes an Agent-visible complete-revision publication contract for composite code-intelligence queries. Before a query-visible publication point, a service must wait, report unavailability, or serve a complete old revision; after that point, it serves the complete new revision. The contract requires a shared version identity and publication boundary across every view returned in one response.
  We instantiate the method in Codetrip, whose brief operation joins source, symbol, and graph facts. In a controlled comparison on frozen Gin v1.12.0, live-source composition produced two unsafe responses in 150 update trials, whereas complete-revision publication produced none under the same five edit scenarios. We further implement journaled, idempotent publication and terminate the real MCP process at five durable boundaries. All 300 evaluable recovery trials on frozen Gin and Cobra returned complete-new context equivalent to a clean full rebuild, with median restart-to-context latency of 77--131 ms. In a separate rename probe, mixed context occurred in 0/30 Codetrip trials and 30/30 trials for both CodeGraph and codebase-memory-mcp before clean-full-equivalent convergence.
  The contribution is an Agent-facing safety contract, implementation pattern, and measurement protocol for joining live repository bytes with asynchronously derived facts. Every successful composite response consequently has a testable repository-state meaning, including after interruption.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"完整修订发布契约"，解决编辑型Agent在查询代码仓库时可能拿到跨版本混合事实（mixed-revision code context）的不安全问题，并在Codetrip系统中实现与验证。
AI.motivation: 编辑型Agent同时查询与修改仓库，源码、符号、图关系和检索状态分散在不同存储、刷新时机不同。一次成功查询可能把从未共存于同一仓库状态的事实混在一起，导致上下文不一致与不安全响应。
AI.method: 提出Agent可见的完整修订发布契约：在查询可见的发布点之前，服务必须等待、报告不可用或返回完整的旧修订；发布点之后只能返回完整的新修订。任一响应中的所有视图需共享同一版本标识与发布边界。方法在Codetrip中实例化（其brief操作联合源、符号、图事实），并实现带日志的幂等发布。
AI.result: 冻结Gin v1.12.0上150次更新试验中，实时源组合产生2次不安全响应，完整修订发布为0；在5个持久化边界终止真实MCP进程，Gin与Cobra共300次可评估恢复试验均返回与干净重建等价的完整新上下文，中位重启到上下文延迟77–131 ms；重命名探针中混合上下文Codetrip为0/30，CodeGraph和codebase-memory-mcp均为30/30。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是面向Agent的安全性契约、实现模式与测量协议，将实时仓库字节与异步派生事实结合；使得每个成功的复合响应都具有可测试的仓库状态含义，且在中断后依然成立。

title: FACE: Flow-Guided Angular Channel Estimation Framework for mmWave MIMO Systems
summary: Acquiring accurate channel state information (CSI) is essential for millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. However, it remains challenging due to high-dimensional channels, limited pilot observations, and measurement noise. To address these challenges, we propose flow-guided angular channel estimation (FACE), a novel channel estimation framework based on flow matching, an emerging generative modeling paradigm that learns continuous transport dynamics between probability distributions. FACE exploits the inherent angular-domain sparsity of mmWave channels and incorporates the learned flow matching model as a generative channel prior. Numerical results show that FACE consistently achieves higher channel estimation accuracy than both conventional estimators and diffusion-based generative estimator across diverse channel and system configurations. Moreover, FACE maintains high estimation accuracy with fewer pilot observations and achieves an average achievable rate close to the perfect-CSI benchmark. Compared with diffusion-based estimation, FACE requires substantially fewer sampling steps while achieving superior or comparable estimation accuracy, reducing inference time and computational cost. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates the potential of flow matching for accurate, pilot-efficient, and computationally efficient mmWave MIMO channel estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于flow matching的流引导角度域信道估计框架FACE，利用毫米波角度域稀疏性作为生成先验，实现高精度、导频高效且计算高效的MIMO信道估计。
AI.motivation: 毫米波MIMO信道维度高、导频观测有限且存在测量噪声，精确获取CSI困难；现有估计器及扩散模型方法在精度、导频效率和推理开销上仍有不足。
AI.method: 基于flow matching生成建模范式，学习概率分布间的连续传输动力学；显式利用毫米波信道角度域稀疏性，并将训练好的flow matching模型作为生成式信道先验用于角度域信道估计。
AI.result: 在多种信道与系统配置下，估计精度持续优于传统估计器和基于扩散模型的生成式估计器；在更少导频下保持高精度，可达速率接近完美CSI基准；相比扩散方法采样步数显著减少，推理时间和计算成本更低。
AI.conclusion: flow matching在毫米波MIMO信道估计中具备实现高精度、导频高效与计算高效估计的潜力。

title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
summary: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting. Given its weights, graded answers and the ability to run itself, a 27B model diagnoses its failure and edits the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better. It keeps getting better: it submits an edit only when its own tests support it, each edit replacing the last, and over its first eight such sessions its accuracy only rises. Unlike test-time scaling, the gain persists in its weights and adds no cost per answer; unlike training, it needs no pre- or post-training infrastructure, only an open model and hours on one GPU. It repairs a damaged copy of itself: it locates the corrupted matrix and rewrites it with values of its own, never reading the undamaged weights; found on text math problems alone, the repair lifts the copy on six image benchmarks it never saw from 7% to 70% accuracy, 83% of the undamaged model's. And the ability emerges with scale: across four sizes of one family, the 2B model makes no edit and the 4B and 9B models break themselves; only the 27B model works on itself as a human would, comparing its hidden states on answers that finish and on answers that run out of tokens, weakening the direction that separates them. Like a human, a model need not separate training from inference; improving a language model may come to take a conversation rather than a training run.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"self-rewriting"：27B模型通过自身推理、无梯度无训练地诊断失败并改写自身权重，在未见问题上提升6.6分，且增益持久、零推理开销；还能修复受损自身的权重矩阵，该能力随规模涌现。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型训练后即冻结部署，改进需再训练；提示、脚手架或推理时额外计算在任务结束后即丢弃，无法持久。作者探究模型能否通过自身推理改写自身权重来变得更好。
AI.method: 给定模型权重、评分答案和运行自身的能力，27B模型诊断自身失败并对相关权重进行无梯度的直接编辑；仅在自身测试通过时提交编辑，逐次替换上一次编辑。修复实验中对损坏副本，模型定位被破坏的矩阵并写入自创数值，不读取未损坏权重。机制上比较"答案完成"与"token耗尽"两类样本的隐藏状态，削弱区分二者的方向。
AI.result: 在预先固定、从未见过的490题上准确率提升6.6分，另一次会话的编辑也显著有效；前八次会话准确率单调上升。文本数学题上发现的修复使损坏副本在六个未见图像基准上从7%升至70%（达未损坏模型的83%）。跨四个规模：2B无法编辑，4B与9B把自身弄坏，仅27B成功自改。
AI.conclusion: 模型可像人类一样不区分训练与推理，通过对话而非训练运行来改进自身；self-rewriting增益持久写入权重、无每题开销、无需训练基础设施，仅需开放模型和单卡数小时。

title: Limite 1B - Violetto: Technical Report
comment: 36 pages. Model, checkpoints and serving code: https://github.com/paradigma-inc/limite-violetto
summary: We present Limite 1B - Violetto, a one-billion-parameter model designed for high-throughput mathematical reasoning. Limite is trained from scratch on 237 billion tokens from a carefully curated, mathematics-centric corpus and supports context lengths of up to 131k tokens. Its architecture and training recipe were developed together to maximize reasoning capability while keeping training and inference costs low. Post-training combines knowledge distillation, targeted supervised fine-tuning, and RLVR on a curated curriculum. Limite achieves 94.01% on AIME 2026 and 74.25% on BeyondAIME, placing it among models many times its size on our evaluation suite. The model is deliberately only lightly instruction-tuned: it is intended primarily as a single-turn mathematical solver and as a fast, parallel component of larger systems, rather than as a general-purpose assistant. We release the model, its base and value checkpoints, and an optimized serving implementation under the Apache 2.0 license.

AI.tldr: Limite 1B (Violetto) is a 10亿参数、面向高吞吐数学推理的模型，从零训练于2370亿token数学语料，支持131k上下文，在AIME 2026达94.01%、BeyondAIME达74.25%，并开源模型与推理实现。
AI.motivation: 作者希望以低成本训练与推理获得强数学推理能力，同时让模型可作为大系统中的快速并行组件，而非通用助手，因此专门设计一个高吞吐、小体积的数学求解器。
AI.method: 架构与训练配方协同设计；从零在237B词元的精选数学中心语料上预训练，支持最长131k上下文；后训练结合知识蒸馏、定向监督微调以及在精心设计课程上的RLVR；仅做轻量指令微调。
AI.result: AIME 2026 得分94.01%，BeyondAIME 得分74.25%，在同规模评测中可与数倍于其参数量的模型相比。
AI.conclusion: Limite 1B 是一个高效的小型专用数学推理模型，定位于单轮数学求解与大系统的并行子组件；作者以Apache 2.0许可开源模型、base与value检查点及优化推理实现。

title: NONSENSE: Non-Semantic Strings Expose Semanticity Gaps in Dense Retrieval
summary: Dense retrieval is central to modern search, question answering, and retrieval-augmented generation, where high similarity is often treated as evidence of semantic relevance. We examine how far this assumption can be stressed. NONSENSE is a black-box sparse-edit probe that constructs visibly non-semantic strings while forbidding query-term copying, optimizing only the dense similarity between a query and the string. Across five BEIR-style datasets and three popular single-vector retrievers, these strings frequently outscore the retriever's own best judged query-relevant passage (QRP), and often rank first in the full corpus. The result indicates a semanticity gap in the evaluated dense retrievers: nearest-neighbor status can be separated from passage-like meaning. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating dense retrievers not only by whether they retrieve relevant documents, but also by how reliably their similarity scores reflect semantic evidence.

AI.tldr: NONSENSE 是一个黑盒稀疏编辑探针，能构造出明显无语义、且禁止复制查询词的字符串，却能在 5 个 BEIR 风格数据集和 3 种单向量检索器上频繁超过真实相关段落的相似度得分、甚至排名 corpus 第一，揭示稠密检索器的"语义性鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索广泛用于搜索、问答和 RAG，其核心假设是"高相似度≈语义相关"。作者要检验这一假设能被推到多远，即最近邻地位能否与"类似段落的语义"脱钩。
AI.method: 提出 NONSENSE：黑盒、稀疏编辑的对抗探针，仅优化查询与构造字符串之间的稠密相似度；约束是生成可见地无语义的字符串，并禁止复制查询词，从而排除词汇重叠带来的相似度。
AI.result: 在五个 BEIR 风格数据集、三种流行单向量检索器上，这些无语义字符串经常超过检索器自身最佳判定的相关段落（QRP）得分，并常在完整语料中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 被评测的稠密检索器存在语义性鸿沟：最近邻地位可与段落式语义分离。因此评估检索器不仅应看是否检索到相关文档，还应看其相似度分数是否可靠反映语义证据。

title: Data-Driven Variable-Length Compression of 3D Representations
summary: Compressing 3D shapes is important for the efficiency of many applications, yet existing methods either cannot leverage dataset-level statistics or use a fixed compression ratio for all shapes. We propose a learned variable-length compression method that exploits structure across a training dataset while adapting compressed representation size to individual shape complexity using only fast feed-forward inference. Our method operates on general latent representations and improves rate-distortion for both meshes and signed distance fields. Code is available at https://github.com/voilalab/varlen-3D.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习式变长3D形状压缩方法，利用训练集统计数据并通过快速前馈推理按形状复杂度自适应调整压缩表示长度，在网格与SDF上提升率-失真性能。
AI.motivation: 3D形状压缩对许多应用效率重要，但现有方法要么无法利用数据集级统计信息，要么对所有形状使用固定压缩率，忽略了单个形状复杂度差异。
AI.method: 学习式变长压缩：在训练集上挖掘跨样本结构，同时仅用快速前馈推理即可为每个形状自适应决定压缩表示大小；方法作用于通用隐表示，可扩展到网格与符号距离场（SDF）。
AI.result: 在网格和符号距离场两类表示上均改善了率-失真（rate-distortion）性能，且保持快速前馈推断效率，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将数据集级统计与逐形状自适应码长结合，是一种通用有效的3D形状压缩思路，可推广到多种隐表示。

title: A Common Exponential Lower Bound for Dantzig and Modified Simplex in Deterministic Discounted Games
summary: On a family of $N$-state deterministic two-player discounted games, every run that chooses adaptively between Dantzig's rule and modified simplex requires $2^{Ω(N)}$ switches from a specified initial strategy, regardless of tie breaking. More generally, a return-gate construction lets Dantzig reproduce any finite Bland prefix in an undiscounted deterministic Markov decision process with rational rewards whenever every visited policy reaches a common sink from all states. Applied to an acyclic binary counter, deleting the minimizer's return actions preserves every fixed maximizing strategy's value at each original state while reducing Dantzig's switch count from exponential to linear. With returns, halving the total optimality gap can take $Ω(h/\log h)$ switches at discount horizon $h=(1-γ)^{-1}$, even on games solvable in linear arithmetic time. Conversely, Dantzig is strongly polynomial when strongly connected components have bounded size, each state has a bounded number of actions, and the condensation graph has height $O(\log N)$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究确定性双方折扣博弈中Dantzig规则与改进单纯形法的切换复杂度，构造出需要指数级切换的博弈族，并给出切换次数线性化与强多项式的条件。
AI.motivation: Dantzig规则与Bland规则等单纯形型策略迭代在博弈/MDP中的复杂度尚不清楚，尤其缺乏对其切换次数（pivots/switches）的紧界，作者希望刻画其最坏情况并找出可高效求解的结构条件。
AI.method: 构造一族N状态的确定性双人折扣博弈，证明任何在Dantzig与改进单纯形间自适应选择的运行都需要2^Ω(N)次切换；提出"return-gate"构造，使Dantzig能复现任意有限Bland前缀；应用于无环二进制计数器，通过删除最小化者的return动作将切换次数从指数降到线性；并分析折扣horizon h下最优性间隙与切换数的关系。
AI.result: 存在需2^Ω(N)次切换的博弈族（与打破平局方式无关）；return-gate可复现Bland前缀；无环二进制计数器中去除return动作后切换数由指数降为线性且保持最大化策略价值；有return时，将总最优性间隙减半需Ω(h/log h)次切换（即使博弈可线性算术时间求解）；当SCC规模有界、每状态动作数有界且凝聚图高度为O(log N)时Dantzig为强多项式。
AI.conclusion: Dantzig规则在最坏情况下可呈指数切换，且即使在可线性求解的博弈中收敛也可能极慢；但通过特定结构条件（有界SCC、有界动作数、凝聚高度O(log N)）可保证强多项式时间，揭示了策略迭代复杂度的结构性边界。

title: A Chain-of-Thought Prompt Engineering Framework for Automated Technical Specification Generation in Enterprise Integration: A Real-World Case Study
summary: Technical Specification Documents (TSDs) translate functional requirements into implementable designs and are mandatory artifacts in governed Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) programs, yet their production remains a manual, expertise-intensive bottleneck. Large Language Models (LLMs) have been studied extensively for code generation, but long-form, template-governed engineering documents remain comparatively unexplored. This paper reports an industrial case study, conducted during a migration of more than 250 enterprise integrations to Microsoft Azure Integration Services at a large Australian wholesale distributor, that introduces a chain-of-thought prompt-engineering framework for automated TSD generation using GitHub Copilot. The framework combines a two-phase generation architecture that grounds the model in the functional specification, organizational standards, and the approved template; a six-stage prompting pipeline with human validation checkpoints; and Prompt-as-a-Code, under which prompts are version-controlled and reviewed as engineering artifacts. Applied to a stratified sample of fifteen production interfaces, the framework reduced TSD authoring effort from 793 to 300 person-hours, a 62.2% pooled reduction and a 64.0% mean per-document reduction (Wilcoxon signed-rank, n = 15, p < 0.001), at 74.3% reviewer-assessed accuracy and 3.7/5 developer satisfaction. Benefits degrade monotonically with interface complexity: between the simplest and most complex bands, effort reduction falls from 70.6% to 58.9% and accuracy from 91% to 62.5%, and the residual human effort concentrates in diagrams, sequence flows, and cross-system integration content. We additionally report comparative observations of GPT-4.1/5 and Claude Sonnet 4, as well as Copilot's Ask and Agent interaction modes, offering reusable, practice-grounded guidance for enterprise settings.

AI.tldr: 本工业案例研究报告了在澳大利亚大型批发分销商将250+企业集成迁移至Azure Integration Services期间，提出基于GitHub Copilot的思维链提示工程框架，用于自动生成技术规范文档（TSD）；在15个生产接口样本上，TSD撰写工作量从793降至300人时（62.2%），精度74.3%，满意度3.7/5，且收益随接口复杂度上升而单调下降。
AI.motivation: TSD是受治理的企业应用集成（EAI）项目中的强制交付物，但撰写仍依赖人工且高度依赖专家经验，形成瓶颈；而LLM研究集中于代码生成，对长篇幅、受模板约束的工程文档生成探索不足。
AI.method: 单一大规模企业迁移场景下的工业案例研究，框架包含三部分：(1) 两阶段生成架构，将模型锚定于功能规格书、组织标准与获批模板；(2) 六阶段提示流水线，设有人工验证检查点；(3) Prompt-as-a-Code，即提示词像工程制品一样版本控制与评审。在15个分层抽样的生产接口上评估，并报告GPT-4.1/5与Claude Sonnet 4、Copilot Ask与Agent模式的对比观察。
AI.result: 工作量由793降至300人时（汇总降低62.2%，单文档平均降低64.0%，Wilcoxon符号秩检验 n=15，p<0.001）；评审者评估精度74.3%，开发者满意度3.7/5。收益随复杂度单调衰减：从最简单到最复杂区间，工作量降低由70.6%降至58.9%，精度由91%降至62.5%；剩余人工工作集中于图表、时序流与跨系统集成内容。
AI.conclusion: LLM可在受模板约束的工程文档生成中带来显著效率收益，但需以规格/标准/模板接地、人工检查点与提示词工程化治理为保障；其效果受接口复杂度限制，复杂集成仍需较多人工投入。所提出的框架与实践观察可为企业场景提供可复用的指导。

title: Hybrid Quantum Selection of Learning Rates in Language-Model Training: Termination Criteria and an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle
summary: Learning-rate choices strongly affect language-model fine-tuning, but the best joint profile across layer groups is generally unknown. This paper studies quantum minimum finding for layer-group learning-rate selection within a hybrid classical-quantum training framework. It combines Durr-Hoyer minimum finding with BBHT search and compares fixed-budget and confidence-based stopping policies using a lookup oracle built from measured profile scores at fixed training checkpoints. The paper then introduces an Interaction-Guided Schedule Oracle that scores and marks joint schedules in superposition without a precomputed score table. Classical one-step loss measurements supply the main, pairwise and three-way interaction effects between layer groups. The circuit adds the effects for each schedule, compares the resulting score with the current baseline score, and marks improving schedules for amplitude amplification. Measured candidates are checked classically before acceptance. Uniform-rate training supplies the initial baseline; using schedules from classical adaptive methods as baselines for joint refinement is left for future work. In closed-loop fine-tuning of a 1.5-billion-parameter language model, each selected schedule drives the next 200 classical training steps. Benchmark accuracies lie within the range observed across five uniform-rate seeds. The results give a working example of how quantum superposition can support adaptive learning-rate selection during training; the remaining quantum limitations are discussed in the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文将Durr-Hoyer量子最小查找（结合BBHT搜索）用于混合经典-量子训练框架下的层组学习率联合选择，并提出交互引导调度预言机（IGSO），在1.5B参数语言模型闭环微调中验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 学习率选择对语言模型微调影响显著，但不同层组间最优的联合学习率配置一般未知；作者希望探索量子叠加/量子最小查找能否在训练过程中支持自适应学习率选择。
AI.method: 在混合经典-量子框架中，用Durr-Hoyer最小查找与BBHT搜索比较固定预算和基于置信度的停止策略，基于固定训练检查点测得的分值构建查找预言机；进而提出交互引导调度预言机：无预计算分值表，直接在叠加态中对联合调度打分，利用经典单步损失测量得到层组间的主效应、两两及三阶交互效应，电路对每个调度累加效应并与当前基线分比较，标记改进调度用于振幅放大；被测候选在接受前经经典核验。以均匀学习率训练的初始基线为准，每次选中调度驱动后续200步经典训练。使用1.5B参数语言模型闭环微调。
AI.result: 在1.5B参数语言模型的闭环微调中，所选调度下的基准准确率落在五个均匀学习率随机种子观测到的范围内，说明量子叠加支持的自适应学习率选择可以实际运行。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了一个量子叠加用于训练中自适应学习率选择的可行示例；论文同时讨论了残余的量子限制，将经典自适应方法调度作为联合优化基线留待未来工作。

title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
summary: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model. Faster inference can be achieved when multiple draft tokens pass verification simultaneously. Recent parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark) improve draft quality by conditioning on rich features computed by the target, through a mechanism known as feature encoding. However, standard feature encoding mechanisms have three limitations: (1) they are lossy, applying encoding projections that are destructive to the underlying target feature-space via a discovered effect known as residual mixing, (2) they are memory-less, with no record of previously processed proposals, and (3) they utilize features sampled uniformly from across the target layers, omitting important hidden states. To address these issues, we propose Mixture-of-Features Attention (MoFA), a lightweight feature-encoding approach equipped with a working memory that encodes previously rejected proposals. Leveraging MoFA, rejection memory, and a set of further enhancements, including 2-tap causal convolutions, prefix-only cross-attention, and non-uniform target layer selection, the final architecture, DNeo, achieves 1.3x faster generation speed than SoTA (DFlash-2) without impacting drafter footprint or generation quality. DNeo marks a new state of the art in high quality, fast LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出MoFA特征编码与DNeo架构，解决推测扩散解码中特征编码有损、无记忆、层采样均匀等问题，生成速度比DFlash-2快1.3倍且不损质量。
AI.motivation: 推测扩散解码（speculative-diffusion decoding）靠小drafter并行生成b个token再由大模型并行验证，多token同时通过验证才能加速。DFlash、DSpark等并行draft架构通过feature encoding利用target特征提升draft质量，但现有特征编码有三缺陷：(1)有损——编码投影破坏target特征空间（residual mixing）；(2)无记忆——不记录已处理提案；(3)均匀采样target各层特征，遗漏重要隐状态。
AI.method: 提出Mixture-of-Features Attention（MoFA）：轻量特征编码方法，配备工作记忆（working memory）编码此前被拒绝的提案（rejection memory）。在此基础上加入2-tap因果卷积、仅前缀的cross-attention（prefix-only cross-attention）、非均匀target层选择等增强，构成最终架构DNeo。
AI.result: DNeo生成速度比SoTA（DFlash-2）快1.3倍，且不增加drafter占用、不损害生成质量。
AI.conclusion: DNeo在高质快速LLM推理上达到新的state of the art。

title: FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agentic Document Exploration
summary: Generative AI agents can help journalists explore large document collections. But exploratory workflows can require substantial token use and time, especially when the task is broad and the relevant subquestions are not yet known. This paper introduces FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes a document collection into a topic hierarchy and exposes tools for corpus orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading. I evaluate FieldGuide on five journalistic document-exploration tasks using 38 Chicago Police Department public-records documents, comparing it with raw-file access and retrieval-augmented generation. Across the five tasks, FieldGuide used 27% fewer tokens and 41% less elapsed time than raw-file access; relative to RAG, it used 38% fewer tokens and 21% less elapsed time. An accuracy audit identified four minor issues in FieldGuide's responses, comparable to the other conditions. In blind ratings of generated reporting leads, FieldGuide's mean ratings were higher than RAG's and lower than the raw-file condition's. These descriptive results suggest that corpus orientation may reduce runtime token use and elapsed time without severe accuracy failures. They also motivate further study of whether selective access limits broad, cross-document discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FieldGuide——一种面向AI智能体的"语料地图"，将文档集合组织为话题层级结构，并提供语料定向、范围搜索和有界阅读工具。在五项新闻调查任务上，其token用量和时间开销均优于原始文件访问与RAG，准确率相当。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI智能体可辅助记者探索大型文档集合，但在任务宽泛、子问题未明的情况下，探索性工作流往往消耗大量token和时间。作者希望提供一种结构化导航手段来降低开销。
AI.method: 构建 FieldGuide：把文档语料组织成话题层级（corpus map），并暴露三类工具——语料定向（orientation）、限定范围搜索（scoped search）、有界阅读（bounded reading）。在38份芝加哥警局公开记录文档上，用五个新闻文档探索任务，与"原始文件直接访问"和RAG两种基线对比，并做准确率审计与盲评。
AI.result: 相比原始文件访问，FieldGuide 减少27%的token、缩短41%耗时；相比RAG，减少38%的token、缩短21%耗时。准确性审计仅发现4处小问题，与其他条件相当。在生成报道线索的盲评中，FieldGuide平均评分高于RAG、低于原始文件条件。
AI.conclusion: 描述性结果表明，"语料定向"能在不出现严重准确性失败的前提下降低运行时的token消耗与耗时；同时也提示需进一步研究选择性访问是否会限制跨文档的广泛发现。

title: Deal With It: On Better Schedules for Listwise Reranking
summary: Listwise LLM rerankers cannot reliably rank hundreds of documents in a single call, and rely on schedules to orchestrate their calls. Parallel schedules split candidates into groups and advance a fixed quota from each. When a group holds more of the top passages than its quota, some are cut, and expensive repair calls become required. We show that the way candidates are split matters where such a quota can bind, and that, in expected cuts, the best split there deals them round-robin by retriever rank, like cards. Although not conceptually new, dealing has remained unanalyzed. We prove that, under a simple retriever model, no split with equal quotas cuts fewer of the true top ten on average, and that contiguous chunks cut more as the retriever improves. DealRank, the simplest schedule our analysis allows, is on average within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules over six LLMs, in two rounds. It is consistently 1.1 to 1.4 times faster than BlitzRank with concurrent first calls up to a thousand candidates. There, it needs three rounds and is eleven times faster than the sliding window. In existing schedules such as BlitzRank, dealing reduces repair calls from 59% of queries to 14%, improving latency with no significant change in quality. Random partitioning appears equivalent at a quota of four, as predicted, but ties results to the seed and trails by 1.3 nDCG@10 points at a quota of one over a dense retriever.

AI.tldr: 分析并行列表式重排调度中候选分组方式对"配额截断"的影响，证明按检索排名轮转发牌(round-robin)的切分在期望截断上最优，并提出最简调度DealRank，在保持质量的同时显著降低延迟与修复调用。
AI.motivation: 列表式LLM重排器无法单次可靠地对数百文档排序，需依赖调度多次调用；并行调度将候选分组并各组推进固定配额，当某组包含超过配额的真实top段落时会被误截，需要昂贵的修复调用。作者指出切分方式在配额可绑定处很关键，但发牌式切分此前未被分析。
AI.method: 建立简单检索器模型下的理论分析：证明在等配额下没有切分能在平均意义上比按检索排名轮转发牌更少截断真实top10；证明连续分块随检索器变强截断更多。基于该分析提出最简调度DealRank，并实证对比BlitzRank、滑动窗口、随机划分等（六个LLM、两轮设置、并发首调至千候选等）。
AI.result: DealRank在六个LLM、两轮内平均与最佳调度相差0.1 nDCG@10内；持续比BlitzRank快1.1–1.4倍；在千候选并发下三轮且比滑动窗口快11倍；在BlitzRank类调度中发牌将修复调用从59%查询降至14%，延迟改善而质量无显著变化；随机划分在配额4时如预测等价，但结果受seed影响，在配额1经稠密检索器时落后1.3 nDCG@10。
AI.conclusion: 候选切分方式在配额可绑定时显著影响截断与效率；按检索排名发牌切分在期望截断上最优，DealRank以最简配置实现高质量、低延迟和少修复调用，验证了理论预测。

title: Sketch, Don't Paint: Allocating Test-Time Compute in Generative Visual Reasoning
summary: Multimodal models increasingly reason by synthesizing pixels, sketching maze paths within interleaved chains of thought or rolling out video solutions frame by frame. Each visual thought runs the full diffusion schedule inherited from photorealistic synthesis, so iterative denoising dominates inference cost. We study how to allocate test-time compute along two axes: when to render visual thoughts rather than thinking in text or answering directly, and how many denoising steps each thought requires. Controlled interventions that vary only how the thought is rendered uncover three regimes. Causal thoughts carry the plan and become legible early: an 8-step sketch nearly matches a 50-step render in accuracy, commits to the same plan as often as two independent full renders agree, and in video models mostly fails by stalling short of the goal, so the rollout abstains. Decorative thoughts can be omitted without loss, whereas harmful thoughts lower accuracy. Because the regime depends on both model and task, always drawing is suboptimal. Across 14 model-benchmark pairs of three interleaved reasoners, answering directly, without any thinking, wins 9 pairs, and choosing among direct, text-only, and visual tiers from ten labeled examples per pair raises mean accuracy from 60.7% (always drawing) to 65.1%. Where drawing pays, we propose sketch-and-vote, which samples 8-step sketches (a step count chosen without labels) from independent noises until one answer reaches three votes. With this one setting, sketch-and-vote beats full rendering with fewer denoising steps on an image reasoner and two video reasoners, by 8.6 points on VSP spatial planning and by 9.6 and 22.1 points on mazes.

AI.tldr: 多模态推理模型把视觉"思考"当作像素渲染，成本高昂。作者研究何时该画、画多少步：因果性视觉思考早早就可读懂，8步草图≈50步全渲染；装饰性思考可省略，有害思考反而降低准确率。据此提出分层选择策略（直接答/纯文本/视觉）与 sketch-and-vote，在多数基准上优于始终绘图。
AI.motivation: 视觉思维链中每次"画图"都要跑完整扩散去噪流程，导致推理成本居高不下。作者希望弄清测试时算力应如何分配：何时需要渲染视觉思考而非纯文本或直接作答，以及每个视觉思考需要多少去噪步数。
AI.method: 通过只改变"思考如何被渲染"的受控干预，归纳出三种机制。提出草图-投票（sketch-and-vote）：从独立噪声中采样8步草图（步数无标签选定），直到某答案获得三票。另用每对10个标注样例在直接答、纯文本、视觉三档之间做选择。
AI.result: 在3个交织推理器的14个模型-基准对上，完全不作视觉思考的直接作答在9对中胜出；分层选择使平均准确率从60.7%（始终绘图）升至65.1%。需要绘图时，sketch-and-vote以更少去噪步数胜过全渲染，在图像推理器上提升8.6点（VSP空间规划），在两个视频推理器迷宫任务上提升9.6和22.1点。
AI.conclusion: 视觉思考的价值取决于模型与任务，取决于其属于因果、装饰还是有害类别，因此"总是画"是次优的；应自适应分配测试时算力，并在需要绘图时以少步草图加投票替代完整渲染。

title: Equilibrium Statistics and Stability in Random Two-Population and Three-Population Evolutionary Games
summary: Multi-population matrix evolutionary games provide a framework for studying adaptation and strategic interactions among heterogeneous agents. When payoffs are uncertain, however, analysing a specified game does not reveal how frequently different evolutionary outcomes occur or how their probabilities depend on modelling assumptions. We study two- and three-population games with two strategies per population and both within- and between-population pairwise interactions, with payoffs fixed during each evolutionary trajectory. For two populations, we derive equilibrium-existence probabilities and analytical stability results for generic games and three structured classes: diversity, exclusive, and avoidance games. For generic two-population games, independent Gaussian sampling of payoff entries and of replicator coefficients produces different equilibrium statistics. Interaction structure further distinguishes coexistence from attraction: diversity and exclusive games share the same interior-existence probability, but only exclusive games admit asymptotically stable interior equilibria. Avoidance games admit transversely attracting equilibrium families without locally asymptotically stable individual points. For generic three-population games under independent payoff sampling, we obtain existence probabilities for all equilibrium types and joint existence-and-stability probabilities for boundary equilibria. Monte Carlo simulations support the analytical predictions and quantify multistability, while phase portraits illustrate initial-condition dependence. Under the same Gaussian payoff-sampling protocol, simulations show a lower frequency of fully mixed equilibria but a higher frequency of multistability for three populations than for two.

AI.tldr: 研究多群体矩阵进化博弈中收益不确定时各类进化结果的出现概率，推导两群体与三群体的均衡存在性与稳定性概率，并用蒙特卡洛模拟验证。
AI.motivation: 当收益不确定时，仅分析一个特定博弈无法揭示不同进化结果出现的频率，也无法说明这些概率如何依赖建模假设。
AI.method: 研究每群体两策略、含群体内与群体间成对交互的两群体和三群体博弈（收益在每条轨迹中固定）。对两群体：推导一般博弈及多样性、排他性、回避型三类结构博弈的均衡存在概率与解析稳定性结果，比较独立高斯采样收益元素与复制系数两种假设。对三群体：在独立收益采样下给出各类均衡的存在概率及边界均衡的联合存在-稳定性概率，用蒙特卡洛与相图辅助分析。
AI.result: 两群体一般博弈中，对收益元素与复制系数分别独立高斯采样会产生不同的均衡统计。多样性与排他性博弈的内部存在概率相同，但仅排他性博弈存在渐近稳定的内部均衡；回避型博弈存在横截吸引的均衡族而无局部渐近稳定的单点。三群体下得到全部均衡类型的存在概率与边界均衡的联合存在-稳定性概率。模拟显示三群体比两群体全混合均衡频率更低，但多稳态频率更高。
AI.conclusion: 收益采样协议与交互结构显著影响进化结果的概率分布；群体数量增减会系统性改变混合均衡与多稳态的出现频率。

title: The Defense Rests: A Courtroom-Inspired Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Safety Case Generation
summary: Safety cases are widely used to demonstrate that mission-critical systems, such as autonomous vehicles and unmanned aerial systems, can operate safely after deployment. However, manually constructing safety cases is complex, time-consuming, and labor-intensive, which calls for the proposal of automated approaches to support their creation. Inspired by the legal nature of safety case construction, we formalize the safety case creation problem through a courtroom analogy, where stakeholders collaboratively propose, examine, criticize, review, improve and validate safety claims and their supporting evidence. In this analogy, the safety analyst acts as a prosecutor by identifying hazards and safety concerns, while the assurance case developer serves as a defense attorney by constructing and substantiating safety arguments. An orchestrator acts as a judge by coordinating stakeholder interactions, and a review board serves as a jury by assessing argument completeness and persuasiveness. Based on this formalization, we propose eTrustWare, a Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for automated safety case generation and review. Our experiments on several safety cases of ML-enabled autonomous driving systems demonstrate the feasibility of coordinated LLM-based agents for generating safety cases.

AI.tldr: 提出受法庭类比启发的LLM多智能体框架eTrustWare，自动化生成与评审安全案例。
AI.motivation: 安全案例（如自动驾驶、无人机等关键系统的安全论证）人工构建复杂、耗时且劳动密集，亟需自动化方法支持其创建。
AI.method: 借鉴安全案例构建的法律性质，用"法庭类比"形式化安全案例创建问题：安全分析师充当检察官识别危害，论证开发者充当辩护律师构建安全论证，协调者充当法官组织交互，评审委员会充当陪审团评估论证完整性与说服力；据此提出基于LLM的多智能体框架eTrustWare，实现安全案例的自动生成与评审。
AI.result: 在多个机器学习赋能的自动驾驶系统安全案例上实验，验证了基于LLM的协作智能体生成安全案例的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 法庭式多智能体协作可有效支撑安全案例的自动化构建与评审，为关键系统安全保障提供新途径。

title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
summary: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2τ)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. We confirm all three predictions across five model families spanning four benchmarks. The closed-form solutions also enable principled method design: we prove that adding any label smoothing $\varepsilon > 0$ to SimPO creates a finite margin attractor at $Δ^* = β^{-1}\log((1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon)$, while $\varepsilon = 0$ (standard SimPO) has no attractor. We test this across three models (8B-9B) and confirm the prediction: the theory-derived configuration (TPO-S, $\varepsilon = 0.05$) is competitive with the strongest baselines, attaining the highest mean IFEval score among the compared methods on all three, validating that the predicted finite attractor is a usable operating point rather than proposing a new state-of-the-art loss.

AI.tldr: 该论文为LLM对齐方法建立统一理论:每个成对偏好方法在概率单纯形上定义向量场,投影到单对偏好/非偏好样本后化简为一维margin常微分方程并给出闭式解,据此区分DPO/IPO/SimPO等方法的margin行为并预测实验现象。
AI.motivation: 实践者选择LLM对齐方法(DPO、IPO、SimPO等)基本靠试错,缺乏理论指导。作者希望给出理论依据,解释各方法在优化动态上的本质差异,从而指导方法选择与设计。
AI.method: 将每个成对对齐方法建模为概率单纯形上的向量场;投影到单一preferred/dispreferred对上得到一维margin ODE,求得闭式解。用闭式解分析DPO与IPO的margin增长、标签噪声的影响(DPO相变、IPO仅定量变化)、以及非对称加权下梯度集中性与可训练性;并在5个模型家族、4个基准上验证,同时推导带label smoothing的SimPO(TPO-S)的有限margin吸引点。
AI.result: 闭式解揭示:DPO margin无界增长(梯度流极限下O(log t)),IPO收敛到有限值1/(2τ);标签噪声使DPO由无界变为有界(定性相变),而IPO仅定量受影;梯度集中决定大尺度下的可训练性。三项预测在5个模型家族、4个基准上均得到证实。理论还预测:SimPO加入ε>0的label smoothing后存在有限吸引点Δ*=β⁻¹log((1-ε)/ε),ε=0则无。在3个8B-9B模型上验证,TPO-S(ε=0.05)与最强基线相当,并在三个模型上取得最高平均IFEval分数。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了成对对齐方法的统一理论框架,闭式解既解释并预测了现有方法的训练动态,又能用于有原则的方法设计;验证表明预测的有限吸引点是可用工作点,而非单纯追求新SOTA损失。

title: SLED: Sensor SLicing from Edge to Datacenter
comment: Accepted in IEEE Annual Congress on Artificial Intelligence of Things (IEEE AIoT) 2026. The SLED software and evaluation datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/UNL-CPN-Lab/SLED-Sensor-SLicing-from-Edge-to-Datacenter
summary: Modern sensing systems generate large volumes of heterogeneous data streams from multiple sensor modalities, increasing reliance on datacenters for computation, artificial intelligence/superintelligence (AI/SI) inference, and AI/SI training. Each sensor stream may have different network and compute requirements depending on its type and data volume. However, current wireless systems typically allocate resources at the device level, leading to contention among co-located sensor streams, where bulk data transfers may starve latency-critical telemetry. To this end, this paper introduces Sensor Slicing (SL). SL provides deterministic, medium access control (MAC)-level isolation for individual sensors within a single user equipment (UE) in open radio access networks (O-RAN). Using agentic coding techniques, SL is implemented in two O-RAN-compliant packages, reducing development time by 400 times (2 h 40 min [OCUDU] vs. 6.5 weeks [OAI]), 228-fold fewer human prompts (4 vs. 913), and less than half the tokens (0.64B vs. 1.43B). An associated end-to-end framework, SLED, is implemented to establish per-sensor radio and network isolation across edge, campus, and remote high-performance computing (HPC) tiers. Over-the-air wireless experiments demonstrate that while conventional network slicing causes critical delays to increase more than 2,300-fold under high traffic load, SLED maintains stable latency. Scaling evaluations on the two RAN stacks show that throughput remains within 0.9% and 1.4% of expected allocations even as the number of sensor slices increases. The results demonstrate that SLED preserves latency-critical telemetry while effectively utilizing resources across the sensor-to-HPC pipeline. The SLED software and evaluation datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/UNL-CPN-Lab/SLED-Sensor-SLicing-from-Edge-to-Datacenter.

AI.tldr: 提出传感器切片(SL)与SLED框架，在O-RAN中为单UE内各传感器提供MAC层确定性隔离，借助智能体编码快速实现，实验表明可在高负载下稳定时延并保持吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现代感知系统产生多模态异构数据流，对网络与算力需求各异；但现有无线系统在设备级分配资源，导致同一设备内传感器流相互争用，大流量传输可能饿死时延敏感遥测。
AI.method: 提出Sensor Slicing(SL)，在O-RAN中为单UE内单个传感器提供MAC层确定性隔离；用智能体编码技术在两个O-RAN兼容栈(OCUDU与OAI)实现；并构建端到端框架SLED，实现边缘、校园与远程HPC各层级的逐传感器无线与网络隔离。
AI.result: 开发效率显著提升：OCUDU耗时2h40min对比OAI的6.5周(约400倍)，人工提示4 vs 913(228倍更少)，token量0.64B vs 1.43B。空口实验显示传统网络切片在高负载下关键时延增大超2300倍，而SLED保持稳定时延；两栈扩展测试中吞吐保持在预期分配的0.9%与1.4%以内。
AI.conclusion: SLED能在传感器到HPC全链路上保护时延敏感遥测并高效利用资源，软件与数据集已公开。

title: Can an LLM dream? Testing the overfitted brain hypothesis on an agent with text memory
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/EricJujianZou/llm-dream
summary: Hoel (2021) proposed that dreams distort replayed experience so that the brain does not overfit to recent events. We test this hypothesis on an LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5) that stores what it learns in a text memory and rewrites that memory each night from the day's conversation transcript. The agent goes through ten simulated days of conversation built from LongMemEval. We corrupt 5, 10, 20 or 40 percent of the transcript's turns before each nightly rewrite in one of two ways. Detail corruption changes one or two details in a turn to plausible wrong ones, or replaces the turn with one by the same speaker from an earlier day. Random-text corruption replaces half of the selected turns with a passage of Moby-Dick and inserts Moby-Dick words into the other half. A size limit on the memory, rising from 19,500 to 117,000 tokens over ten nights, set from human free-recall data, forces it to forget. We learned that corruption did not help the agent apply what it learned in earlier conversations to new tasks in any of 30 runs (ten conditions, three different conversation histories). Replacing details in 40 percent of turns lowered recall from 76 to 60 percent. Random text had no consistent effect on recall, with a paired difference of 0 $\pm$ 2 points at 40 percent, because the model recognized it as corrupted and left it out of memory. Replaced details were stored as fact even when another turn held the correct value, and the agent answered 40 percent of those questions correctly, compared with 75 percent without corruption. These results suggest that a pretrained model can separate corrupted text from real events, so a fair test needs a learner that cannot make this separation as easily, such as a model fine-tuned on the corrupted days or an agent whose days take place in an invented world.

AI.tldr: 在LLM智能体上检验Hoel(2021)的"梦境扭曲经验以防过拟合"假说，30次运行中未发现扭曲带来任何增益。
AI.motivation: Hoel(2021)提出梦之所以扭曲重放经验，是为了让大脑不过拟合近期事件。本文试图在一个可控、可测量的LLM智能体上直接检验这一假说。
AI.method: 让Claude Opus 5.5智能体以文本记忆存储所学，每晚依据当日对话记录重写记忆（基于LongMemEval构造10天模拟对话）。每晚重写前对5%/10%/20%/40%的对话轮次进行两种污染：细节污染（替换1-2个细节为貌似合理的错误值，或换成同一说话者早先某天的话轮）和随机文本污染（半数掺入《白鲸》段落、半数插入《白鲸》词汇）。同时依据人类自由回忆数据设定记忆容量上限（10晚内从19,500增至117,000 token），强制遗忘。
AI.result: 十种条件×三种对话历史的30次运行中，污染均未帮助智能体将早期对话所学迁移到新任务。40%轮次替换细节使回忆率从76%降至60%；随机文本无一致影响（40%时配对差异0±2分），因模型能识别其为污染并排除在记忆外。被替换的细节即使另有话轮含正确值仍被捕入记忆为事实，相应问题正确率40%，无污染时为75%。
AI.conclusion: 预训练模型能较容易地区分污染文本与真实事件，因此这并非公平检验；未来需用难以做出该区分的"学习者"，如经污染日微调的模型，或处于虚构世界中的智能体。

title: More Than a Score: Reinforcement Learning with Verbalized Feedback for Generative Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for generative recommendation, where recommended items are generated directly from users' interaction histories. To further improve recommendation quality, reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to align these models with recommendation objectives. However, existing RL methods rely on scalar rewards to implicitly guide exploration. These rewards do not specify which aspects of a candidate conflict with the user's preferences or how the next candidate should differ. To address this gap, we propose VerRec, a verbalized feedback-guided RL framework for generative recommendation. Specifically, a user simulator generates personalized verbalized feedback based on the user's historical preferences and the candidate item profile. The policy uses this feedback to produce refined recommendations. Original and refined candidates form an expanded group and are jointly optimized with group relative policy optimization. The user simulator is only required during training and is removed at inference time. Experiments on three Amazon review datasets with two generative recommendation backbones demonstrate that VerRec improves recommendation accuracy and ranking quality. Further analyses show that verbalized guidance encourages exploration of more diverse candidates and helps the policy discover more rewarding recommendations during training.

AI.tldr: VerRec：用"用户模拟器"生成的语言化反馈替代标量奖励，指导生成式推荐的RL对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有RL方法用标量奖励隐式引导探索，无法说明候选物品哪一方面与用户偏好冲突、下一个候选应如何调整，探索效率低。
AI.method: 训练时由用户模拟器基于用户历史偏好与候选物品画像生成个性化语言化反馈；策略据此精炼推荐；原始与精炼候选构成扩展组，用GRPO联合优化；推理时移除模拟器。
AI.result: 在三个Amazon评论数据集、两种生成式推荐骨干上，推荐准确率与排序质量均提升；分析显示语言化引导促进候选多样性探索，帮助策略在训练中发现更高奖励的推荐。
AI.conclusion: 语言化反馈是标量奖励的有效补充，可在不增加推理开销的前提下提升生成式推荐效果。

title: Rethinking Perceptual Similarity for Remote Sensing: Multi-Layer Attention Scoring and Human Preference Benchmarking
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027). 9 pages
summary: Perceptual similarity metrics for natural images transfer poorly to remote sensing (RS), where severe geospatial and semantic failures can remain visually plausible while still being decisively wrong for downstream use. To address this, we develop a novel human-aligned perceptual quality metric for generated RS imagery and evaluate it across several generation tasks. We first conduct a controlled perturbation study where we progressively increase the severity of common synthetic perturbations. Using the layer-wise Aligned Attention Score (AAS) responses in RemoteCLIP, we find that different RS artifacts are best captured at different depths. Based on these findings, we introduce Remote Sensing Perceptual Distance (RSPD), a pairwise metric that averages seven independently calibrated layer distances without tuning on human-preference labels. To evaluate our metric on realistic RS generation tasks, we construct a blind, reference-conditioned two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) benchmark with five 300-triplet subsets spanning synthetic artifacts, airborne and spaceborne super-resolution, SAR-to-optical translation, and timeseries controls. We also construct a 300-triplet ordered misregistration benchmark with deterministic labels. Using the same RemoteCLIP checkpoint, RSPD substantially outperforms simple cosine distance with the final global embedding and is competitive with the strongest generic baselines across the realistic RS generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出RSPD——一种面向遥感生成图像的人类对齐感知质量度量，基于RemoteCLIP分层特征校准七层距离取平均，无需人类偏好标签调参，并在多类遥感生成任务的2AFC基准上验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 通用自然图像的感知相似度度量在遥感领域迁移效果差，遥感中存在严重的地理与语义错误，这些错误在视觉上可能仍然"看起来合理"，但对下游任务却决定性错误，因此需要专门针对生成式遥感图像的人类对齐感知质量度量。
AI.method: 1）开展受控扰动研究，逐步增大常见合成扰动的严重程度；2）利用RemoteCLIP的分层对齐注意力分数（AAS）响应，发现不同遥感伪影在不同网络深度处最易被捕捉；3）据此提出RSPD——一种成对度量，将七个独立校准的层级距离取平均，且不使用人类偏好标签调参；4）构建盲测、参考条件的两选一强制选择（2AFC）基准，含五个300三元组子集（合成伪影、机载/星载超分、SAR到光学转换、时序对照），并构建300三元组带确定性标签的有序配准误差基准。
AI.result: 在同一RemoteCLIP检查点下，RSPD显著优于使用最终全局嵌入的简单余弦距离，并在各真实遥感生成任务上与最强的通用基线方法相当或接近。
AI.conclusion: 遥感伪影的感知质量需分层捕获，RSPD作为一种无需人类偏好标签、基于分层特征校准的度量，能有效评估生成式遥感图像质量，是通用度量在遥感场景中的有力替代方案。

title: Virtual Double Oracle: Faster Convergence by Leveraging Strategies That Were Watching All Along
summary: Double Oracle (DO) and PSRO approximate Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum games by iteratively expanding a strategy population with best responses supplied by an oracle. Online Double Oracle (ODO) interleaves multiplicative weights updates (MWU) with population discovery and obtains an $O(\sqrt{k\ln k/T})$ rate, where $T$ is the number of learning rounds and $k$ is the larger of the two players' final population sizes. We identify the reinitialisation step as an underexplored design choice: at each expansion, MWU-based methods reset newly discovered strategies to a uniform prior. We introduce Virtual Double Oracle (VDO), which exploits a bilinear identity (a strategy's full hindsight loss history collapses to its utility against the time-averaged opponent) to initialise each new strategy with the MWU weight it would have had from the start. We prove that VDO achieves $O(\sqrt{k/T})$ exploitability over the discovered population as it grows, provided the cumulative cost of adding strategies is at most linear in $k$, a condition supported by our empirical measurements. Discounted VDO (dVDO) moderates historical preferences to reduce over-concentration at reinitialisation. Experiments across matrix games, poker, and Goofspiel show that, with a suitable discount, dVDO can substantially reduce finite-horizon exploitability relative to both VDO and uniform-reset ODO, and can improve the discovered strategy populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出Double Oracle及其在线变体ODO中"新策略被重置为均匀先验"这一设计缺陷，提出Virtual Double Oracle (VDO)：利用双线性恒等式，将新策略的完整事后损失历史压缩为其对时间平均对手的期望效用，从而以"从头就应有的MWU权重"初始化新策略；并给出VDO的O(√(k/T))可利用度界，以及带折扣的dVDO以缓解重初始化时的过度集中。
AI.motivation: 现有DO/PSRO类方法（尤其是MWU-based ODO）在每次扩张策略种群时，会把新增的最佳响应策略的权重重置为均匀先验，丢弃该策略若在早期就被发现本应积累的历史信息，导致收敛与有限时域可利用度受限。这一重初始化步骤此前未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出VDO：基于双线性恒等式（某策略的完整事后损失历史可坍缩为其对时间平均对手的效用），为每个新策略直接赋予其"若自始存在"所应得的MWU权重，而非均匀先验；进一步提出dVDO，通过对历史偏好施加折扣来抑制重初始化时的过度集中。理论上给出VDO的收敛率分析，要求累积加策略成本至多与k呈线性（并由实证测量支持）。
AI.result: 理论上证明VDO在所发现策略种群上随其增长达到O(√(k/T))的可利用度（在加策略累计成本关于k线性的条件下），优于ODO的O(√(k ln k/T))。实验覆盖矩阵博弈、扑克与Goofspiel，表明在合适折扣下，dVDO相比VDO与均匀重置的ODO能显著降低有限时域可利用度，并改善所发现的策略种群质量。
AI.conclusion: 重初始化策略的选择是被忽视却关键的设计维度；以虚拟权重初始化的VDO在理论上改进收敛率，折扣版本dVDO在实践中显著降低有限时域可利用度并提升策略种群质量，为DO/PSRO类算法提供了简单有效的改进方案。

title: Stochastic Modeling of the Mean Time Between Software Failures: A review
summary: A review of several models for the software failure detection stochastic process is per- formed. We focus on how the Mean Time Between Failures is obtained from those models and present a comparative study. The models considered involve some of the well known based on non- homogeneous Poisson processes and a recently proposed model based on contagion. Our main target is to evaluate the models performance when they are applied to modern software projects developed under Agile methodologies. Recently developed Software Engineering practices (TDD, Scrum, etc.), propose an iterative procedure be- tween development, testing and debugging, introducing this way, particular challenges to Software Reliability modeling. As opposed to the non-homogeneous Poisson processes, the failure rate of the contagion model depends not just on time but also on the number of previously detected failures. All the considered models are particular cases of non- homogeneous Birth Processes, a general fundamental theory on how to obtain time to failure and time between failures expectations is also shown.

AI.tldr: 本文综述并比较多种软件失效检测随机过程模型（非齐次泊松过程模型与基于传染的新模型），推导其MTBF，并在敏捷开发项目背景下评估模型性能。
AI.motivation: 敏捷方法论（TDD、Scrum等）带来开发、测试、调试的迭代过程，给软件可靠性建模带来新挑战；需要评估现有模型在现代软件项目中的适用性。
AI.method: 对若干非齐次泊松过程模型与一个基于传染的模型进行综述，说明如何从各模型得到平均失效间隔时间（MTBF）并进行比较研究；指出这些模型均为非齐次生灭/出生过程的特例，并给出求失效时间与失效间隔期望的一般理论。
AI.result: 给出各模型的MTBF推导与对比；指出与非齐次泊松过程不同，传染模型的失效率不仅依赖时间，还依赖已检测到的失效次数。
AI.conclusion: 以非齐次出生过程为统一理论框架可比较各类模型；传染模型因依赖累积失效数，更适合刻画敏捷开发中迭代测试的可靠性过程。

title: Learning Calibrated and Samplable Predictive Distributions of Surface-Ocean $Δp$CO$_2$ Using Tabular Diffusion Models
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Representations for the Physical Sciences
summary: The ocean absorbs almost 30% of anthropogenic CO$_2$ emissions, but quantifying this sink requires estimating surface-ocean CO$_2$ from observations that are sparse in space and time. Most existing machine-learning estimates of this field are deterministic, giving a single value per grid point, with uncertainty approximated post hoc via residuals, ensembles, or prescribed distributions. We instead learn a conditional predictive distribution for each observation: using Treeffuser, a conditional diffusion model with gradient-boosted-tree score functions, we estimate the full predictive distribution of $Δp$CO$_2$ (the sea-air $p$CO$_2$ difference) from 13 environmental, spatial, and temporal predictors. On a held-out SOCAT test set, Treeffuser attains the lowest continuous ranked probability score among the uncertainty-quantification methods evaluated (8.229 $μ$atm) and the coverage closest to the nominal 68% / 95% levels (0.686 / 0.930), while retaining point-prediction skill comparable to a deterministic XGBoost baseline (RMSE 18.4 vs. 17.7 $μ$atm; $R^2$ 0.77 vs. 0.79). These results show that conditional diffusion can provide well-calibrated, observation-level uncertainties while largely preserving point-prediction skill. Because Treeffuser is generative, its samples can support probabilistic analyses of $Δp$CO$_2$; extending this to spatially coherent field reconstruction will require modeling dependence across grid cells and evaluation on spatially held-out data.

AI.tldr: 用条件扩散模型（Treeffuser，以梯度提升树为得分函数）为每个观测点学习ΔpCO2的完整预测分布，在海气CO2通量估算中给出校准良好的观测级不确定性，同时保持接近XGBoost的点预测精度。
AI.motivation: 海洋吸收了近30%的人为CO2排放，但量化这一碳汇需要从时空稀疏的观测中估计表层海洋CO2。现有机器学习估计多为确定性方法，每个格点只给单一值，不确定性只能事后用残差、集成或预设分布近似，缺乏校准良好的观测级不确定性。
AI.method: 提出用Treeffuser——一种以梯度提升树作为得分函数的条件扩散模型——学习每个观测的条件预测分布；以13个环境、空间和时间预测变量为条件，估计海气pCO2差（ΔpCO2）的完整预测分布，并在SOCAT留出测试集上评估。
AI.result: 在SOCAT留出测试集上，Treeffuser的CRPS最低（8.229 μatm），覆盖率最接近名义水平（68%/95%对0.686/0.930），点预测精度与确定性XGBoost基线相当（RMSE 18.4 vs 17.7 μatm；R² 0.77 vs 0.79）。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散可在基本保持点预测精度的同时提供校准良好的观测级不确定性，其生成样本支持ΔpCO2的概率分析。但实现对空间连贯的场重建仍需建模格点间的依赖关系并在空间留出数据上评估。

title: Conserved Verdicts, Drifting Commitments: Identifying Harmful Overthinking
summary: A reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. Deciding whether to stop means comparing two probabilities at the same point of a chain: that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct (its commitment), and that the answer it will finish with is correct (its verdict). We show that the verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot make this comparison. As a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift, whether continuing helps or hurts. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. We measure both on MATH-500. At all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. In six reasoning models from three families, on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench and with budgets up to 16,384 tokens, declining accuracy curves come from which chains remain, while the chains still reasoning keep or improve their answers. An oracle stopping rule gains at most +1.8 and +2.5 points at 1.5B and 7B. The framework says what to measure before building a stopping rule.

AI.tldr: 论文区分"承诺"（当前答案正确概率）与"裁决"（最终答案正确概率），证明只依据裁决无法判断是否应停止思考，并给出两个恒等式，将准确率-预算曲线分解为链内答案变化与仍在运行的链的变化。
AI.motivation: 推理模型即使已达正确答案，继续思考反而可能丢失答案。判断是否停止需比较同一思考链上的两个概率：若现在停止所得答案的正确性（承诺）与最终答案的正确性（裁决）。已有基于最终正确性探针的方法只能估计裁决，无法完成这一比较，因此需要理论框架明确该测什么。
AI.method: 提出承诺-裁决框架：证明裁决作为固定结果的预测无系统性漂移；承诺-裁决差等于答案质量的期望剩余变化，也等于停止所获准确率。第二个恒等式把准确率-预算曲线拆分为链内答案变化与仍在运行链集的变化。在 MATH-500 上测量 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 的 379 个持正确答案点，并在 3 个家族 6 个推理模型、MATH-500 与 OlympiadBench、预算至 16384 token 上验证，另评估 oracle 停止规则。
AI.result: 在 379 个持正确答案点上，继续思考平均损失 3.6 分（95% CI [2.2, 5.2]），损失集中于少数问题。六个模型中下降的准确率曲线源于哪些链仍在运行，而仍在推理的链保持或改进答案。Oracle 停止规则在 1.5B 与 7B 上最多仅增益 +1.8 与 +2.5 分。
AI.conclusion: 仅用最终正确性探针不足以决定是否停止，必须测量承诺——裁决差距。下降的准确率-预算曲线主要来自链的选择效应而非单链退化；oracle 停止收益有限，说明在构建停止规则前应先按该框架确定测量对象。

title: Literary Language Mashup: Curating Fictions with Large Language Models
summary: In this paper, we propose an alternative approach to human evaluation of literary fictions by employing LLMs themselves as evaluators within the GrAImes framework. We apply this methodology to assess human-written and AI-generated microfictions in Spanish, to five PhD professors in literature and sixteen literary enthusiasts, and to short stories in both Spanish and English. By comparing the evaluations performed by LLMs with those of human judges, we examine the degree of alignment and divergence between both perspectives, thereby assessing the feasibility of LLMs as auxiliary literary evaluators. Our analysis focuses on the alignment of responses from LLMs with those of human evaluators, providing insights into the potential of LLMs in literary assessment. The conducted experiments reveal that while LLMs cannot be regarded as substitutes for human judges in the evaluation of literary microfictions and short stories, with a Krippendorff's alpha reliability coefficient less than 0.66, they can serve as a valuable tool that offers an initial perspective on the editorial quality of the texts in question. Overall, this study contributes to the ongoing discourse on the role of artificial intelligence in literature, underlining both its methodological constraints and its potential as a complementary resource for literary evaluation.

AI.tldr: 将LLM自身作为评估者纳入GrAImes框架评估文学虚构作品，与人类评判对比显示二者一致性中等偏低（Krippendorff's α<0.66），LLM不能替代人类但可辅助初评。
AI.motivation: 人类对文学虚构作品的评估成本高、主观性强，作者希望探索LLM能否作为辅助或替代性文学评估者，并量化其与人类评判的一致程度。
AI.method: 在GrAImes框架下用LLM作为评估者，对西班牙语人类写作与AI生成的微小说、以及西班牙语和英语短篇小说进行评估，并与5位文学博士教授和16位文学爱好者的评判进行对比，用一致性统计（如Krippendorff's alpha）衡量对齐与分歧。
AI.result: LLM与人类评判的Krippendorff's alpha低于0.66，一致性不足，说明LLM不能作为人类评判的替代者；但LLM能提供关于文本编辑质量的初步视角，具有辅助价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示LLM在文学评估上的方法学局限，同时肯定其作为补充性文学评估资源的潜力，为AI在文学中的角色讨论提供实证证据。

title: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, accepted at KDD 2027
summary: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"评分标准对齐检索"(Rubric Aligned Search)，用统一的评分标准(rubric)为整个搜索流水线提供监督信号，从检索到集合级选择全面对齐LLM推理效用，并在元宝搜索上线取得8.52%端到端答案质量提升。
AI.motivation: Agentic搜索要求搜索引擎不止做单文档相关性排序，而要组装出适合下游LLM推理的文档集合。现有工作要么孤立地优化单个流水线阶段，要么在相关性训练的上游模块之上再加RL选择，导致整个技术栈未与推理效用对齐。
AI.method: 提出统一的监督面(rubric)：对每个查询由粗到细生成加权正向准则与负向准则。由此派生两种训练信号：(1)轻量标注器将rubric判断蒸馏为单文档效用标签，监督对比双编码器检索器和带四个对齐评分头的多任务排序器；(2)rubric条件评估器产生集合级奖励，驱动双分支RL选择器，结合GRPO与最优rollout蒸馏，解决子集优化中的信用分配问题。
AI.result: 在元宝搜索(Yuanbao Search)线上部署，端到端答案质量相比生产基线提升8.52%。
AI.conclusion: 用单一rubric贯穿检索、排序与集合选择，可实现对推理效用的全栈对齐，验证了统一监督框架在真实产品中的有效性。

title: Can a World Model Predict a Deepfake Video? A Consistency Margin Prior for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfake detectors often perform well on the dataset they are trained on, but their performance drops when tested on videos from different datasets. In this paper, we study whether a predictive video model can provide a signal that generalizes better across datasets. Instead of relying only on generator-specific artifacts, as many existing detectors do, we use a model trained to predict natural video and measure the difference between what it predicts and what it observes in a video. Using V-JEPA 2.1, we keep the encoder frozen and adapt the predictor using rank-16 LoRA. We define the difference between the predictor output and the frozen encoder target as the prediction residual. We hypothesize that manipulated clips produce, on average, larger prediction residuals than authentic clips, and use this as our consistency-margin prior. We process these residuals using a lightweight Latent Consistency Head (LCH), which separates residual magnitude from direction for training and classification. To test whether the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset generalization, we compare standard and reversed margin objectives while keeping the remaining training setup fixed. We match the two settings on FF++ validation performance before evaluating them on unseen data. The reversed-margin setting exhibits a larger cross dataset generalization gap on average, providing evidence that the direction of the consistency margin affects cross-dataset transfer. Our complete model adds only 8.25M trainable parameters, which is 2.47% of the total 334M parameters. Trained only on FF++, it achieves an AUC of 90.5 on Celeb-DFv2 and performs well across several other cross-dataset benchmarks. Our ablations show that separating residual magnitude from direction, reducing dataset-specific variation, and using a low-rank projection improve cross-dataset generalization in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用预测式视频模型V-JEPA 2.1的"预测残差"作为深度伪造检测信号，并提出"一致性边界先验"，以提升跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器在训练集上表现良好，但跨数据集测试时性能显著下降，原因是过度依赖特定生成器的伪影。作者希望找到一个不依赖生成器伪影、能更好跨数据集泛化的信号。
AI.method: 冻结V-JEPA 2.1编码器，用rank-16 LoRA适配预测器；将预测器输出与冻结编码器目标之差定义为"预测残差"，假设被篡改片段平均产生更大残差（一致性边界先验）；用轻量Latent Consistency Head（LCH）分离残差的幅度与方向用于训练和分类；并对比标准与反向边界目标以检验方向对跨数据集泛化的影响（两者在FF++验证集上性能对齐后再评估）。
AI.result: 反向边界设置在跨数据集上平均泛化差距更大，说明一致性边界方向影响跨数据集迁移。仅训练于FF++时，模型在Celeb-DFv2上达到AUC 90.5，并在其他多个跨数据集基准上表现良好。可训练参数仅8.25M，占总334M参数的2.47%。
AI.conclusion: 预测式视频模型的一致性边界信号可有效提升跨数据集泛化；消融表明分离残差幅度与方向、减少数据集特异变化、使用低秩投影均有助于跨数据集泛化。

title: From AIOps Pipelines to Agentic Service Operations: A Survey of Capability, Authority, and Evidence
summary: Modern service systems combine rapidly changing dependencies, heterogeneous telemetry, and operational actions whose side effects may amplify an incident. Conventional AIOps research has produced effective detectors, localizers, and diagnostic models, yet surveys typically organize them by task, telemetry modality, or learning technique. Such taxonomies describe what a method predicts, but not which decisions it may make or which evidence justifies that authority. We survey the transition from AIOps pipelines to agentic service operations through three coupled lenses: capability, operational authority, and evaluation evidence. We first relate SOA, microservices, Kubernetes, service meshes, and serverless platforms to the incident lifecycle. We then review conventional AIOps methods and audit 22 language-model-enabled systems according to their evaluated behavior rather than their intended autonomy. The audit shows that most systems remain copilots or read-only investigators. Only two exercise write authority; both use constrained action envelopes, and neither carries controlled production-outcome evidence. Building on these findings, we synthesize a four-plane reference architecture, evidence grades, an evaluation ladder, and a controlled adoption path. Together, these artifacts clarify which claims current evaluations support and what evidence is still required for dependable agentic service operations.

AI.tldr: 本文综述AIOps从传统流水线向"智能体化服务运维"的演进，以能力、操作权限、评估证据三个耦合视角组织文献，审计22个语言模型驱动的系统，指出多数系统仍停留在副驾驶或只读调查阶段，并提出四平面参考架构、证据分级、评估阶梯与受控采纳路径。
AI.motivation: 现代服务系统依赖变化快、遥测异构，且运维操作的副作用可能放大故障。传统AIOps综述按任务、遥测模态或学习技术分类，只描述"方法预测什么"，未说明"它能做哪些决策"以及"何种证据赋予其这种权限"，因此需要新的组织视角。
AI.method: 1) 梳理SOA、微服务、Kubernetes、服务网格、无服务器平台与故障生命周期的关系；2) 回顾传统AIOps方法；3) 按"被评估的实际行为"而非"宣称的自主性"审计22个LLM驱动系统，聚焦其操作权限与证据；4) 据此归纳四平面参考架构、证据等级、评估阶梯与受控采纳路径。
AI.result: 审计显示多数系统仍是副驾驶或只读调查者；仅两个系统具备写操作权限，且均采用受限动作包络，二者均缺乏受控的生产结果证据。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估只能支持有限的主张。本文的参考架构、证据分级与评估阶梯明确了当前证据能支撑什么、仍缺什么，为可信的智能体化服务运维指明所需证据与受控落地路径。

title: Regularized Score Centering
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正则化分数中心化（RSC），在分数中心化基础上加入反向KL惩罚，约束学习器下一 token 分布靠近行为策略，从而稳定异步强化学习中的离策略训练。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习虽提升训练吞吐，但过期策略数据与训练/推理的数值不匹配会导致训练不稳定。分数中心化（SC）能通过去除奖励基线影响来稳定离策略更新，但当学习器远离产生数据的行为策略时仍会失效。
AI.method: 1) 梯度诊断表明 SC 的梯度比重要性采样（IS）更不极端；2) 提出 RSC，在 SC 上加入反向 KL 惩罚，使学习器的下一 token 分布贴近行为策略；3) RSC 可配合截断重要性采样（TIS）使用，限制 token 级重要性权重；4) 理论分析证明 KL 正则可改进收敛保证。
AI.result: 在稠密模型与混合专家模型上评测数学推理及多种智能体任务（在线购物、工具使用、游戏、全异步软件工程）。RSC+TIS 在所有智能体基准上显著提升样本效率，相同采样响应数下训练奖励更高；最终评测在全部六个智能体任务上取得最佳表现，AppWorld 提升 14.3%，BabyAI 达最强基线的 9.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过反向KL约束限制策略漂移，可有效补救分数中心化在强离策略情形下的失效问题，并在理论与多类智能体任务上验证其对异步 RL 稳定性和性能的有效性。

title: Honest Brokers in AI Regulation: How Public Comments Introduce Evidence to Regulators
summary: The regulation of Artificial Intelligence is susceptible to various forms of capture by industry actors that hold undue influence over the policymaking process, due in part to their information advantage in developing these technologies. In the following paper, we investigate the roles of public commenters in providing evidence to potential regulation in the USA. We build a corpus of 40 potential regulations, and 2,664 public comments submitted by a variety of stakeholders. We computationally process these texts to extract evidence meant to inform regulators, in the form of formal citations and informal references. We find significant differences in the type and amount of evidence supplied: Holding comment length constant, business commenters introduce altogether less evidence, and government, university, and civil society commenters provide significantly more research and legal sources. The publication status of cited research is nearly evenly split, with preprints and peer-reviewed articles being introduced by commenters of all types. We further explore patterns of self-citation and find that while it is prevalent amongst all groups, a small cluster of organizations account for over half of all self-citations in our corpus. Our findings complicate a narrative that public comments alone are means to information capture. We interpret these results in terms of the role that commenters attempt to play in the policymaking process-being either an Issue Advocate or an Honest Broker. These findings on the supply of evidence in public comments shed light on an often overlooked form of policymaking that has implications for how and through what sources information is made accessible to regulators of AI.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国AI监管公众意见中的证据供给模式，发现商业评论者提供的证据更少，而政府、高校与公民社会评论者提供更多研究与法律来源，说明公众意见并非单纯的信息俘获手段。
AI.motivation: AI监管易被产业行为者俘获，部分原因在于其技术信息优势。作者希望考察公众意见征询这一常被忽视的环节中，不同利益相关者如何提供证据，从而判断其究竟扮演"议题倡导者"还是"诚实中间人"的角色。
AI.method: 构建包含40项潜在法规、2,664条公众意见的语料库，通过计算文本处理提取正式引文与非正式引用形式的证据，并比较不同类型评论者（商业、政府、高校、公民社会）提供证据的类型、数量、出版状态及自引模式。
AI.result: 在控制评论长度后，商业评论者引入的证据总量显著更少；政府、高校和公民社会评论者提供显著更多的研究与法律来源。引用研究的出版状态大致均分，预印本与同行评议文章由各类评论者共同引入。自引普遍存在，但少数组织贡献了全语料库一半以上的自引。
AI.conclusion: 上述发现复杂化了"公众意见仅是信息俘获途径"的叙事，揭示了公众意见中证据供给对AI监管者获取信息来源与渠道的影响。

title: From Preference Data to Personalization: Tracing Sycophancy in Large Language Models
summary: Sycophancy in large language models is often measured as agreement with the user, yet agreement can be appropriate when the user's claim is valid, their preference is genuine, or their experience warrants acknowledgment. We study sycophancy as inappropriate agreement: validating a claim, preference, or self-assessment when the context calls for correction, qualification, or resistance. We introduce a validity-aware sycophancy grader and SycoDrift, a persona-targeted evaluation set of 3,298 validity-annotated probes with controlled annotations for user openness and stakes. We use this framework to analyze three sources of agreement pressure: human preference data, automated judge specification, and in-context personalization. First, preference for validating responses in human datasets (Chatbot Arena, HH-RLHF, Community Alignment) is weak and concentrated where agreement is often appropriate. Second, in a selected-value, single-model experiment, emphasized judge rubrics produce consistent but modest increases relative to paired suppressed rubrics, demonstrating a plausible mechanism for training-time amplification. Third, in off-policy evaluations across 14 models, inference-time personalization increases inappropriate agreement, with the largest effect from matched user profiles placed directly before the query.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不适当迎合"的严格定义与有效性感知评分器,构建SycoDrift(3298条带有效性标注与用户开放性/利害标注的探针集),并分析人类偏好数据、自动评判规范、上下文个性化三大"赞同压力"来源。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常以"是否赞同用户"简单度量谄媚(sycophancy),但当用户主张正确、偏好真实或经历值得认可时,赞同是恰当的;需要区分"恰当赞同"与"不适当迎合",并厘清其产生来源。
AI.method: (1) 将谄媚定义为"不适当认同":在需要纠正、限定或抵制的语境下仍验证用户主张/偏好/自我评价;(2) 提出有效性感知的谄媚评分器(validity-aware sycophancy grader);(3) 构建SycoDrift:3298条带有效性标注的探针,并控制标注用户开放性与利害程度;(4) 从人类偏好数据、自动评判规范、上下文个性化三方面开展实验,含14个模型的离策略评测。
AI.result: 人类数据集(Chatbot Arena、HH-RLHF、Community Alignment)中对验证性回答的偏好较弱,且集中于赞同本应恰当的样本;在选定取值的单模型实验中,强调式评判标准相较配对抑制式标准带来一致但温和的提升,提示训练期放大机制;14模型离策略评测中,推理时个性化提升不适当赞同,其中"匹配用户画像置于查询之前"效应最大。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚应作为条件性失效而非无条件赞同来度量;人类偏好数据并非主要驱动,评判规范可温和放大,而推理时个性化是当前更强的风险来源,尤其当用户画像贴近查询时。

title: MIPR: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval with Multi-Category Solutions
summary: Real-world e-commerce queries often express user intent without naming a target product, and a single intent may be fulfilled by products from multiple categories. However, existing multimodal retrieval benchmarks typically assume a relatively well-defined target, leaving retrieval for intents with multi-category solutions less explored. To fill this gap, we introduce MIPR, a benchmark for Multimodal Intent-to-Product Retrieval comprising 3,522 multimodal queries and a shared corpus of 30,731 products. MIPR features reasoning-intensive retrieval, multi-category solutions, and fine-grained relevance labels. Experiments show that the best embedding-based retriever achieves 49.23% nDCG@10 on the full query set, and 55.86% solution-category recall@10 on queries with multiple solution categories. Reranking improves these scores to 60.11% and 67.00%, respectively, yet substantial gaps to the candidate-pool oracle remain. These results establish MIPR as a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for evaluating multimodal intent-to-product retrieval. The data and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/leequeue/MIPR.

AI.tldr: 提出MIPR基准，用于多模态"意图到产品"检索，涵盖3522个多模态查询与30731个共享产品，突出多类别解与细粒度相关性标签，实验显示检索与重排仍有明显提升空间。
AI.motivation: 真实电商查询常不指名目标产品，同一意图可由多类别产品满足，而现有多模态检索基准多假设目标较明确，缺乏对多类别解意图检索的探索。
AI.method: 构建MIPR基准：3522个多模态查询与30731个产品的共享语料库，设计推理密集型检索任务，提供多类别解与细粒度相关性标注。
AI.result: 最佳嵌入检索器在全查询集上nDCG@10为49.23%，多解类别查询的solution-category recall@10为55.86%；重排后分别提升至60.11%和67.00%，但与候选池oracle仍有明显差距。
AI.conclusion: MIPR是一个具挑战性与诊断价值的基准，可用于评估多模态意图到产品检索，推动该方向研究。

title: AR-WAM: efficient streaming world-action modeling for autonomous driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires anticipating how traffic will evolve while responding quickly to new observations. Video foundation models offer the first ability, but repeated history encoding and iterative video generation make them costly to use for driving. We present AR-WAM, an efficient streaming world-action model that combines autoregressive temporal modeling with single-pass future conditioning. Because its video backbone is causal, AR-WAM updates its visual context incrementally, reusing past computation and conditioning future prediction on observed motion. We further hypothesize that future features computed from recent observations can improve generalization in dynamic traffic without iterative video generation. AR-WAM therefore obtains these features in one forward pass and uses them to condition trajectory generation, and reinforcement learning then improves the policy through direct optimization of driving rewards. With a single front camera, AR-WAM achieves 91.5 PDMS after supervised training and 94.0 after reinforcement learning on NAVSIM-v1, outperforming the compared strong end-to-end world-action models. In a dynamic setting of continuous driving, supervised AR-WAM keeps its visual history across decisions and outperforms strong world-action baselines.

AI.tldr: AR-WAM 是一个高效流式"世界-动作"模型，用因果视频骨干做增量视觉上下文更新，并单次前向生成未来特征来条件化轨迹，实现低成本预测性自动驾驶。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶既要预判交通演化，又要快速响应观测。视频基础模型虽能预测未来，但重复编码历史与迭代式视频生成代价高昂，难以用于实时驾驶。
AI.method: 结合自回归时序建模与单次未来条件化：因果视频骨干使视觉上下文增量更新、复用历史计算，并让未来预测以已观测运动为条件；同时假设近期观测推导的未来特征可提升动态交通泛化性，故在单次前向中获取该特征以条件化轨迹生成；再用强化学习直接优化驾驶奖励改进策略。
AI.result: 单前视相机下，NAVSIM-v1 上监督训练达 91.5 PDMS，强化学习后达 94.0，优于对比的强端到端世界-动作模型；在连续驾驶的动态设定中，监督版 AR-WAM 跨决策保持视觉历史，优于强世界-动作基线。
AI.conclusion: 无需迭代视频生成即可获得未来条件化能力，使流式世界-动作模型在效率与性能上同时占优，适用于连续动态驾驶场景。

title: On Improving the Adoption, Usability, and Retention of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Tools
comment: 56 pages, 8 figures. M.S. thesis in Cybersecurity, Montana State University
summary: As the Internet connects more of the world, software vulnerabilities create growing security risks. Because software developers are responsible for building and maintaining secure applications, they rely on tools and techniques that help identify vulnerabilities early in development. Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools analyze source code to identify potential security weaknesses before software is deployed. Although SAST can help developers address vulnerabilities proactively, these tools also present usability and adoption challenges. This thesis examines those challenges and explores ways to improve the adoption, usability, and continued use of SAST. First, a literature review of 89 research works related to SAST implementation and continued usage identifies recurring developer concerns, including false positives and other usability barriers that can reduce trust in SAST results. Second, the thesis presents a process for automating the execution of SAST tools and formatting their output so that findings are more meaningful and actionable to developers. A real-world use case evaluates an implementation of this process and gathers developer feedback. Participants reported satisfaction with several aspects of the process and indicated that it increased their willingness to use the SAST tool.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究SAST工具的采用与可用性挑战，通过文献综述和自动化执行流程设计，提升开发者使用意愿。
AI.motivation: 互联网连接扩大带来日益增长的安全风险，开发者需在开发早期发现漏洞；SAST工具虽可主动识别弱点，但存在误报等可用性与采用障碍。
AI.method: 首先对89篇SAST实施与持续使用相关研究进行文献综述，归纳开发者反复关注的问题；随后提出一套自动化执行SAST工具并格式化其输出的流程，使发现更可理解、可操作，并通过真实用例评估实现效果并收集开发者反馈。
AI.result: 文献综述识别出误报等降低对SAST结果信任的可用性障碍；真实用例中参与者对流程多个方面表示满意，并称其提升了使用SAST工具的意愿。
AI.conclusion: 改善SAST的输出呈现与自动化流程可增强可用性和开发者采用意愿，有助于SAST的持续使用。

title: Urban Representation Learning for Identifying Potential Disparities in Crime Reporting
comment: Accepted for publication in International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computer, Data Sciences, and Applications (ACDSA 2027)
summary: Open crime data support urban safety analysis but reflect reported incidents rather than the complete distribution of criminal activity, potentially introducing spatial distortions in downstream analysis. We propose a self-supervised urban representation learning framework for identifying unusual reporting patterns relative to representation-similar peers using only georeferenced crime records. The method constructs complementary hourly, weekly, and static reporting profiles, learns scale-specific representations under geographic self-supervision, and integrates them into a unified latent space. Neighbor Profile Divergence (NPD) is then used to quantify disagreement between each region's reporting profile and those of its retrieved peers. Experiments on more than 1.8 million crime records from Mexico City, aggregated into 1,058 H3 regions, show that the proposed representation achieves a mean Silhouette score of 0.4052, compared with 0.2863 for Hex2Vec. NPD rankings remain highly stable across neighborhood sizes, with Spearman correlations from 0.9720 to 0.9951, while most high-divergence candidates persist across configurations. The retrieved peers also extend substantially beyond immediate geographic neighborhoods, indicating that the learned representation captures structure beyond local spatial proximity. High-divergence regions exhibit spatially organized patterns and, in several cases, differences in incident volume relative to peer expectations. These results support NPD as an internal auditing and prioritization mechanism for identifying regions that warrant further investigation, rather than as direct evidence of underreporting.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督城市表征学习框架，用NPD指标识别犯罪上报模式的异常区域。
AI.motivation: 开放犯罪数据只反映"已上报"事件而非真实犯罪分布，会造成下游分析的空间失真，因此需要识别上报模式异常的区域。
AI.method: 仅用地理编码犯罪记录：构建小时、周、静态三类互补上报画像，在地理自监督下学习多尺度表征并融合到统一潜在空间；再用邻域画像散度(NPD)衡量各区域与其检索同伴画像的不一致程度。
AI.result: 墨西哥城180万+记录、1058个H3区域：平均Silhouette 0.4052（Hex2Vec为0.2863）；不同邻域规模下NPD排序Spearman相关0.9720–0.9951，高散度候选稳定；检索同伴超出邻近地理范围，说明表征捕捉了超越局部的结构；高散度区域呈空间组织性并伴随案件量差异。
AI.conclusion: NPD可作为内部审计与优先级筛选机制，用于定位值得进一步调查的区域，而非低报的直接证据。

title: DiscoveryAgent: A Framework for Scientist-centric Agentic AI
