comment: Supplementary information is available as an ancillary file (supplementary_information.pdf)
summary: AI agents can assist scientific research, but balancing autonomous investigation with scientists' ability to inspect and redirect ongoing work remains a central design challenge. We present DiscoveryAgent, a domain-agnostic, scientist-centric system that combines autonomous investigation with scientist-directed hypothesis steering. Scientists select, refine, or replace hypotheses between research rounds, while audit agents interrogate checkpointed records to trace claims, reproduce analyses, and inform subsequent decisions. Across two predictive modeling tasks, DiscoveryAgent produced the best variable-star classifier among evaluated baselines and, with scientist steering, a protein variant-effect predictor surpassed by only one of 106 ProteinGym baselines. We develop a rigorous checkpointing system that enables highly capable audit agents, a scalable form of oversight for agentic research. Audit agents autonomously identify errors at higher rates than previous AI scientist agents, and scientists collaborating with audit agents identify 14x more valid errors versus scientists performing manual review. In three case studies led by domain experts across physical science, social science, and life science, we developed a multimodal photometric-redshift estimator that resolves complementary failures of images and photometry, achieving 0.971 AUROC for low-redshift classification; documented an 83% rise in Florida homeowners-insurance premiums from 2013 to 2023, with a growing, regressive burden; and identified CD4+ T-cell relay genes, which both receive and exert broad transcriptional regulation, enriched for autoimmune disease associations. Together, these results show how autonomous research can expand scientists' empirical reach while centering their authority over research direction and their ability to understand and challenge the evidence.

AI.tldr: DiscoveryAgent：以科学家为中心的领域无关 agent 科研系统，通过"可审计检查点 + 审计 agent"在自主研究与科学家主导假设之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: AI agent 可用于科研，但自主探索与科学家检查、改向能力之间的平衡是核心设计难题。
AI.method: 提出领域无关的 DiscoveryAgent：各研究轮次间由科学家选择/精化/替换假设；审计 agent 质询检查点记录以追溯主张、复现分析；配套严格 checkpointing 系统支撑可扩展监督。
AI.result: 两项预测建模任务中产出最佳变星分类器；经科学家的引导，蛋白变体效应预测器在 106 个 ProteinGym 基线中仅次于 1 个。审计 agent 自主发现错误率高于以往 AI 科学家 agent；人机协作发现的有效错误为人工审查的 14 倍。三个专家案例：多模态测光红移估计器低红移分类 AUROC 0.971；记录佛罗里达房主保险保费 2013–2023 上升 83% 且负担累退；识别 CD4+ T 细胞"中继"基因并富集自身免疫关联。
AI.conclusion: 自主研究可扩展科学家的实证触达范围，同时保持其对研究方向的权威及理解、质疑证据的能力。

title: Consistency Is Not Correction: Separating Confidence, Abstention, and Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: A controller that resamples an answer, escalates to a larger model, or abstains is usually justified by a confidence signal. Three claims about such a signal do not follow from one another: it ranks answers (discrimination), it supports withholding some of them (selective prediction), and it changes an answer for the better (correction utility). We give an exact decomposition of the third into gated recoveries minus gated harms, which bounds whether a comparison can succeed before it is run: a gate that only replaces a proposal can act only where the base policy was already wrong, so the initial error count caps the discordant pairs any correct gate can produce. When that cap falls below the count a paired test needs, the experiment cannot return a positive result for a working mechanism, nor distinguish one from a gate that never fired. We measure all three targets on two model scales and find the bound binds. In a small-model suite a perturbation-agreement verifier reaches within-policy AUROC 0.990 (95% interval [0.95, 1.00]) while every episode outcome matches single-sample decoding at 4.32 times the call count. In a controlled 840-episode study no verifier replaced the proposal on any of the 60 GSM8K decisions, so that comparison tested nothing; the entire GSM8K gain across six controllers is one task, and it is the task whose identical temperature-zero repeats disagreed, making it the one answer the service does not reproduce. On the diagnostic set the gate could reach four errors while the test needed six, so even a perfect gate had no significant result available. We report two checks that would have caught this before any budget was spent, and show that tie handling in rankings, tied selection cutoffs, and unequal output limits each move a headline number in the same dataset. The binding constraint on this literature is measurement resolution, not the choice of signal.

AI.tldr: 置信度信号的判别力、选择性预测、纠错效用互不蕴含；作者给出纠错效用的精确分解与上界预检，并在两档模型上验证该界确实约束了实验结论。
AI.motivation: 控制器（重采样/升级到大模型/弃答）通常由置信度信号驱动，但"排序好、能弃答、能改对答案"三者常被混为一谈；更关键的是，很多对比实验在开跑之前就已经不可能得到正结果，而文献缺少事先可判定的检验。
AI.method: 提出纠错效用的精确分解：净收益 = 门控恢复 − 门控伤害；由此得界——只替换提案的门控只能在基策略已错处生效，故初始错误数上限约束了正确门控能产生的判别对数量。若该上限低于配对检验所需数量，实验对有效机制也无法呈阳性，且无法与"从不触发的门控"区分。用两个模型规模测量三个目标，并做840回合受控研究与诊断集检验；另报告两项预算前检查，以及排序并列、选择阈值并列、输出长度不等对主结论的影响。
AI.result: 界确实生效。小模型套件中扰动一致性验证器达到样本内AUROC 0.990（95% CI [0.95, 1.00]），但所有回合结果与单样本解码相同，调用量增至4.32倍。840回合研究中，60个GSM8K判定无一被验证器替换，比较实际未检验任何东西；六个控制器的全部GSM8K增益来自单个任务，且该任务在温度0重复解码下自相矛盾，恰是服务不复现的答案。诊断集上门控最多可及4个错误而检验需6个，即使完美门控也无显著结果。
AI.conclusion: 该领域真正的瓶颈是测量分辨率而非信号选择。作者给出两项可在消耗预算前发现上述问题的检查，并说明并列处理、并列截断与输出长度不等都足以在同一数据集上改变头条数字。

title: Learning Cross-Domain Media Similarity from Amazon Reviews
summary: Collaborative filtering is a basic foundation of many recommendation algorithms. It works by analyzing a user's history and then suggesting items similar to those in that history. This method typically relies on user data to compute item similarity, data that is widely available to commercial systems but is usually sparse or inaccessible for independent systems and research, especially across multiple media domains. In this work, we propose a method to generalize similarity information between items using supervised learning. As input to our model, we use semantic and temporal features extracted from Amazon product reviews, which are publicly available. As the training target, we use item (product) co-occurrence in the reviewing history of Amazon customers. We evaluate the quality of the predicted similarities across two media domains: books and movies. Experimental results demonstrate the robustness of our methodology, yielding positive outcomes in zero-shot cross-domain transfer tasks. Furthermore, feature attribution analysis reveals a structural shift in how feature groups are utilized across setups: intra-domain models rely heavily on linguistic semantics, whereas cross-domain environments pivot toward behavioral popularity cues. Incorporating even limited target-domain context during training bridges this domain sparsity gap, significantly enhancing framework generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出用监督学习从公开的Amazon评论中预测物品相似度，缓解独立系统与跨域场景下协同过滤数据稀疏/不可得的问题。
AI.motivation: 协同过滤依赖用户-物品交互数据计算物品相似度，但这类数据对商业系统充足，对独立系统与学术研究往往稀疏或不可获取，跨媒体领域时尤为严重。
AI.method: 以Amazon产品评论中提取的语义特征与时间特征为输入，以Amazon用户评论历史中的物品（产品）共现作为监督目标，训练模型泛化物品间相似度信息。
AI.result: 在图书与电影两个媒体领域评估预测相似度质量，方法表现稳健，在零样本跨域迁移任务上取得正向效果；特征归因分析显示域内模型主要依赖语言语义，跨域环境转向行为性流行度线索；训练中即使引入少量目标域上下文也能显著弥合域稀疏差距、提升泛化。
AI.conclusion: 公开评论数据可在缺乏交互数据的条件下近似物品相似度，且对跨域推荐具有实用价值；特征使用模式随场景结构性变化，少量目标域上下文是提升跨域泛化的关键。

title: FaceRiff: Data-Efficient Unified Text-to-3D Face Asset Synthesis via Geometric Conditioning
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 11 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables
summary: High-resolution facial datasets with consistent UV-mapped geometry, albedo, and physically based displacement are scarce, yet such assets are essential for photorealistic digital-human rendering. Existing 3D face generation methods are often slow, single-modality, or require large specialized datasets. Meanwhile, large image diffusion models encode strong facial priors but do not natively produce lighting-independent textures, pore-scale displacement, or UV-aligned geometry. We present FaceRiff, a unified, data- and parameter-efficient framework for generating complete 3D face assets (mesh, albedo, and displacement) directly from text in a shared UV space. FaceRiff adapts a pretrained SDXL backbone with task-specific LoRA adapters and uses UV normal maps as geometric conditioning: per-instance normals guide albedo and displacement synthesis, while a dataset-mean normal provides a canonical spatial anchor for mesh generation. Using only 2,049 scans from approximately 350 identities and training on a single GPU, FaceRiff updates less than 3% of the backbone parameters per task and produces render-ready 3D face assets without per-instance optimization. Compared with FaceG2E and DreamFace, FaceRiff produces greater per-prompt diversity while preserving prompt alignment and fixed-topology UV consistency, and additionally generates lighting-independent albedo suitable for PBR relighting and pore-scale displacement absent from prior text-driven baselines. A blind study with 45 industry professionals shows that FaceRiff achieves substantially higher perceived realism than DreamFace, approaching that of real captures. Overall, FaceRiff demonstrates that pretrained diffusion priors can be adapted to unified 3D face asset synthesis under limited data.

AI.tldr: FaceRiff 通过适配 SDXL 骨干（任务特定 LoRA + UV 法线图几何条件），从文本直接生成完整 3D 人脸资产（网格、反照率、置换），共享 UV 空间，数据与参数高效。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率、UV 一致且含 albedo 与物理置换的人脸资产稀缺但对逼真数字人渲染至关重要；现有 3D 人脸生成方法慢、单模态或依赖大型专用数据集；图像扩散模型虽有强人脸先验，但原生不产生光照无关纹理、毛孔级置换和 UV 对齐几何。
AI.method: 以预训练 SDXL 为骨干，加入任务特定 LoRA 适配器；用 UV 法线图作为几何条件——逐实例法线引导 albedo 与置换合成，数据集平均法线为网格生成提供规范空间锚点；仅用约 350 身份、2,049 次扫描，单 GPU 训练，每任务更新不足 3% 参数，无需逐实例优化。
AI.result: 相比 FaceG2E 和 DreamFace，逐提示多样性更高，同时保持提示对齐与固定拓扑 UV 一致性；额外生成可用于 PBR 重打光的光照无关 albedo 与毛孔级置换；45 名行业专家盲测显示感知真实感显著高于 DreamFace，接近真实扫描。
AI.conclusion: 预训练扩散先验可在有限数据下被适配为统一的 3D 人脸资产合成框架。

title: The Software Engineering Factory: Engineering Accountability and Control in the Age of Abundant Code
comment: Manuscript submitted to the "New Frontiers in Software Engineering" track of ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM)
summary:
AI agents can now plan, write, test, review, and revise code at a volume no human organization can inspect line by line. Final code review therefore cannot remain the primary organizational control for owning code changes.
  The Software Engineering (SE) Factory moves control into the process that produces the code. The Factory protocols define how work moves, what evidence must exist before it can proceed, and who owns the result. A deterministic protocol engine, implemented in conventional code rather than prompts, enforces those protocols by controlling stage transitions, requiring evidence, and invoking gates and human escalation, where needed, before work can advance. The SE Factory preserves human authority over consequential decisions and makes accountable acceptance possible without requiring humans to supervise every agent action.
  The SE Factory is not a dark factory. Humans remain in control by defining the scope and granularity of delegation, the boundaries and escalation conditions, and the consequential decisions that require accountable human judgment.
  We draw on our experience building three distinct SE Factory implementations, all of which have undergone multiple iterations and two of which are publicly available as open-source systems, into ten principles for conceiving, building, and operating SE Factories at scale, grounded in the organizational and technical realities of our implementations. We do not claim that these principles are exhaustive or constitute the only viable foundation for an SE Factory. Rather, we offer them as a conceptual scaffold and shared vocabulary for reasoning about SE Factories, evaluating their designs, and guiding their evolution. Our goal is to catalyze a community-wide dialogue that moves software engineering beyond controls designed for human-scale code production toward a disciplined, scalable, and trustworthy agentic future.

AI.tldr: 提出"软件工程工厂(SE Factory)"范式，将代码变更的控制权从最终代码评审转移到确定性的协议引擎所执行的流程中，并总结出十条原则。
AI.motivation: AI智能体已能以远超人类组织的规模规划、编写、测试、审查和修改代码，逐行人工评审无法再作为主要的组织性控制手段，需要新的可信控制机制。
AI.method: 将控制嵌入生产过程：工厂协议定义工作流转方式、推进前必须具备的证据以及结果归属；用常规代码（而非提示词）实现的确定性协议引擎来强制执行协议，控制阶段转换、要求证据、调用门禁与人工升级；人类保留对范围、粒度、边界、升级条件和重大决策的权威。基于三个SE Factory实现（均多轮迭代，两个开源）的经验提炼十条原则。
AI.result: 提出十条用于构思、构建和规模化运营SE Factory的原则，强调其不同于"黑暗工厂"——人类仍在控制中；并指出这些原则非穷尽性，而是概念支架与共享词汇。
AI.conclusion: 目标是推动社区对话，使软件工程超越为人类规模代码生产设计的控制方式，走向有纪律、可扩展且可信的智能体未来。

title: VisHead-Spec: Head-Routed Visual Attention for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models(VLMs) while preserving the target model's outputs, but its speedup diminishes under high concurrency serving as the system becomes more compute bounded as the batch size increases. This problem is pronounced for multimodal speculative decoding as the long range of the image tokens in the prompt can significantly increase the computational cost during draft token prediction. The block-diffusion drafters (e.g. DFlash, DSpark) can effectively speed up the draft model efficiency by predicting multiple draft tokens in one forward pass, but their speedup for VLMs under high concurrency is still modest (<9%). In order to understand this gap, we examine the information flow between different modalities from target model to draft model and identify the sparsity pattern of visual attention between the target and draft models: only small set of key-value heads in the draft model need direct visual feature attention in the context and only visual features from top level layers in the target model need to be attended in the context. We therefore propose VisHead-Spec, which selects a small, fixed set of key-value (KV) heads to attend to all image features from top level layers in the target model and restricts the remaining heads to text features. On Qwen3-VL-8B and MMSpec, VisHead-Spec-8 lets 8 of the drafter's 40 KV heads read the image while keeping accepted length within 0.3% of the block-diffusion draft model baseline (i.e. DSpark). At batch size 64, its throughput gain over autoregressive decoding increases to 16.0%, compared with 9.5% for DSpark; at batch size 1, its speedup remains comparable to DSpark.

AI.tldr: VisHead-Spec 通过让草稿模型中少量固定 KV 头直接关注目标模型顶层视觉特征、其余头仅处理文本，缓解高并发下多模态投机解码的算力瓶颈，在批大小 64 时吞吐增益提升到 16.0%（DSpark 为 9.5%），接受长度几乎无损（<0.3%）。
AI.motivation: 投机解码能保持目标模型输出不变地加速 VLM，但在高并发（大 batch）下系统转为算力受限，加速比显著衰减。多模态场景更严重：图像 token 序列很长，会大幅增加草稿 token 预测阶段的计算开销。块扩散类 drafter（DFlash、DSpark）单次前向预测多个草稿 token，但在高并发下对 VLM 的加速仍很有限（<9%）。作者希望弄清这一差距的成因。
AI.method: 分析目标模型到草稿模型之间的跨模态信息流，发现视觉注意力的稀疏模式：(1) 草稿模型中只有一小部分 KV 头需要在上下文中直接关注视觉特征；(2) 只需关注目标模型顶层（top-level layers）输出的视觉特征。据此提出 VisHead-Spec：选取一小组固定 KV 头去关注目标模型顶层的全部图像特征，其余头则限制为只处理文本特征。实验在 Qwen3-VL-8B 与 MMSpec 上进行。
AI.result: VisHead-Spec-8 让草稿模型 40 个 KV 头中的 8 个读取图像，接受长度相对块扩散基线 DSpark 保持在 0.3% 以内；batch size 64 时相对自回归解码的吞吐增益达 16.0%，而 DSpark 为 9.5%；batch size 1 时加速与 DSpark 相当。
AI.conclusion: 多模态投机解码中的视觉注意力高度稀疏，因此可以有原则地裁剪草稿模型的视觉通路而几乎不损失接受长度。VisHead-Spec 以极小改动显著改善高并发场景下的吞吐，同时保持低并发下的性能，说明面向模态的信息流分析是优化 VLM 服务系统中 drafter 设计的有效切入点。

title: WebAgents: Unbundling Agent Creation, Hosting, and Execution for an Agent-Native Web
summary: Large language models are moving from isolated assistants toward autonomous agents that can plan, use tools, and coordinate with others, motivating an emerging Agentic Web of independently developed agents and services. Realizing this vision requires agent behavior to move across creators, hosts, and runtimes without coupling publication to a particular execution environment or transferring authority over user resources. We introduce WebAgents, which unbundles these roles through a signed agent.pkg that carries portable workflows, skills, schemas, and resource requirements. An OpenClaw-based agent-native browser/runtime verifies the package, obtains authorization, and binds it at run time to user-controlled models, tools, permissions, and budgets, while hosts distribute the public program and may retain private services server-side. We demonstrate this contract with three unrelated workflows executed unchanged under local and API-backed models, including literature review with live services and a website-published travel agent using semantic tools and user-selected personal resources. In a controlled suite, WebAgents explicitly blocks all 716 injected contract violations while accepting all 295 matched benign controls, with median automated pre-execution processing below 0.5 s for all three packages. We conclude by outlining a path toward NANDA-based discovery and interoperable package ecosystems while retaining execution authority in the user's runtime.

AI.tldr: 提出 WebAgents：用签名的 agent.pkg 解耦"发布/托管/执行"三种角色，执行权威始终留在用户运行时。
AI.motivation: 大模型正从孤立助手走向可规划、调用工具、协同的自主智能体，催生由独立开发的智能体与服务组成的"智能体网络（Agentic Web）"。但要让智能体行为跨创作者、托管方与运行时流通，现有做法把发布与特定执行环境绑定，或需转移用户资源权限，阻碍互操作与安全。
AI.method: 提出 WebAgents：以签名的 agent.pkg 承载可移植工作流、技能、模式（schema）与资源需求。基于 OpenClaw 构建智能体原生浏览器/运行时，负责校验包、获取授权，并在运行时将其绑定到用户自控的模型、工具、权限与预算；托管方只分发公开程序，私有服务可保留在服务端。
AI.result: 三个互不相关的工作流在本地与 API 模型下未经修改即可运行（含带实时服务的文献综述、使用语义工具与用户自选个人资源的网站发布旅行智能体）。受控测试中，716 例注入的契约违规全部被拦截，295 例匹配的正常对照全部被接受；三个包的自动预执行处理中位耗时均低于 0.5 s。
AI.conclusion: 验证了"发布与执行解耦、执行权威归用户"的契约可行，并给出面向 NANDA 发现机制与可互操作包生态的路线图。

title: Evaluating Semantic Insensitivity in Financial Sentiment Analysis: Implications for Sustainable Financial Decision-Making
comment: 17 pages, 1 figure, Presented and accepted for publication at the Symposium "Rethinking Economic Models: Sustainability, Finance, and Accounting in Times of Transformation" (Bucharest, 2026)
summary: Financial sentiment analysis is critical for automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment, heavily relying on models like FinBERT. Despite high benchmark accuracy, these models remain vulnerable to subtle adversarial text modifications, threatening the integrity of algorithmic decision-making. In this paper, we propose Agent-driven Semantic Inversion (ASI), a novel adversarial attack framework targeting financial sentiment models through domain-specific semantic manipulation. Utilizing an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline, our approach identifies eligible financial news sentences and applies targeted lexical substitutions. We empirically evaluate ASI against FinBERT, one of the most widely deployed financial sentiment models. Our results reveal a striking vulnerability: the attack successfully deceived FinBERT in 90.85% of eligible cases, with the model frequently maintaining its original sentiment prediction despite the fundamental inversion of financial performance indicators. Through qualitative analysis and token-level investigation, we demonstrate that FinBERT critically over-relies on contextual keywords and syntactic patterns rather than true logical comprehension of financial semantics. Our findings highlight the urgent need for logic-aware, robust financial NLP models to ensure the reliability of automated decision-making systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent驱动的语义反转攻击(ASI)，用多智能体LLM流水线对金融新闻做定向词汇替换，成功欺骗FinBERT达90.85%，揭示其依赖关键词而非真正语义理解。
AI.motivation: 金融情感分析模型（如FinBERT）虽基准准确率高，但对细微对抗性文本改动脆弱，威胁自动交易与风控决策的可靠性，需揭示其安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出ASI框架：基于LLM的多智能体流水线，先识别可攻击的金融新闻句子，再施加领域特定的定向词汇替换，实现语义反转；对FinBERT开展实证评估，并进行定性分析与token级调查。
AI.result: 在90.85%的合格样本中成功欺骗FinBERT，即使财务业绩指标被根本性反转，模型仍常保持原情感预测；token级分析显示其过度依赖上下文关键词和句法模式。
AI.conclusion: FinBERT缺乏真正的金融语义逻辑理解，凸显构建逻辑感知、鲁棒的金融NLP模型的紧迫性，以保障自动决策系统可靠性。

title: IntentGR: Enhancing Intent for End-to-End Personalized Generative Retrieval in Search
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures; Accepted by WSDM 2027 Findings
summary: Personalized generative retrieval in search should jointly satisfy the user's immediate search intent and long-term preference. Recent end-to-end approaches, primarily explored in recommendation, unify item tokenization and sequence generation within a single model, allowing semantic identifiers (SIDs) to be optimized toward the downstream generation objective. However, these methods often treat the query merely as an input feature, without explicitly leveraging it to guide either identifier learning or sequence generation. This leaves intent guidance weak in both the tokenization and the generation stage, causing generated semantic identifiers to drift toward high-frequency token patterns rather than the current search intent. In this work, we find that incorporating additional query-related evidence into the framework of end-to-end generative retrieval is important. Based on this finding, we propose IntentGR, an intent-enhanced end-to-end framework that strengthens query semantics at four complementary stages of the retrieval pipeline. Query-Aware Semantic Behavior Representation (QBR) introduces query-level behavioral evidence as a new input signal; Query-Semantic Alignment (QSA), Long-Tail Query Enrichment (LQE), and Query-conditioned Attention Modulation (QAM) then serve as integration mechanisms at the optimization, training-distribution, and decoding stages to fully exploit this evidence. Experiments on the public AOL4PS benchmark and AE, a large-scale industrial e-commerce dataset, show that IntentGR improves Recall@10 by 8.11% and 11.96% over the strongest baseline, with strong gains on long-tail queries. These results suggest that enriched query-related input evidence, together with effective integration mechanisms, is beneficial for building intent-aware end-to-end generative search systems.

AI.tldr: IntentGR：通过引入查询相关行为证据并在优化、训练分布、解码四个阶段增强查询语义，构建意图感知的端到端生成式个性化检索框架。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端生成式检索（多来自推荐）仅把查询当输入特征，未用其指导标识符学习与序列生成，导致意图引导在tokenization和生成阶段均较弱，生成的SID偏向高频token模式而非当前搜索意图。
AI.method: 提出IntentGR框架，在检索管线四个互补阶段强化查询语义：QBR引入查询级行为证据作为新输入信号；QSA（优化阶段）、LQE（训练分布阶段）、QAM（解码阶段）作为集成机制充分利用该证据。
AI.result: 在公开AOL4PS基准和工业电商数据集AE上，Recall@10较最强基线分别提升8.11%和11.96%，长尾查询上增益显著。
AI.conclusion: 丰富的查询相关输入证据配合有效集成机制，有助于构建意图感知的端到端生成式搜索系统。

title: Domain-Tuned Diffusion Super-Resolution for 4K Facial Asset Maps
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications. 4 pages
summary: Physically based facial assets require 4K albedo and displacement maps for cinematic close-ups, yet generative pipelines commonly produce them at only 1K. Naively applying photographic super-resolution is a poor fit: facial UV maps have domain-specific statistics, and displacement is a scalar height field whose errors directly distort geometry. We present a domain-tuned diffusion upscaler for 4x (1024 to 4096) facial asset super-resolution. Starting from a bilinearly upsampled map, we adapt a frozen SDXL backbone per modality with lightweight LoRA modules, while a Tile ControlNet preserves input structure as the diffusion prior restores pore- and wrinkle-scale detail. On held-out maps, our method produces sharper, more faithful detail than bilinear and off-the-shelf GAN and diffusion super-resolvers, reducing albedo LPIPS from 0.21 to 0.08 while avoiding misplaced or excessive displacement relief. These results show that lightweight domain adaptation can produce render-ready 4K facial asset maps without a custom super-resolution architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出面向面部资产UV贴图的领域微调扩散超分方法，用LoRA适配冻结的SDXL并加Tile ControlNet，将albedo与位移图从1K提升到4K，效果优于通用GAN/扩散超分模型。
AI.motivation: 影视级面部资产需要4K albedo与位移贴图，但生成管线通常只输出1K；直接套用摄影超分不合适，因为面部UV图有特定统计特性，且位移是标量高度场，其误差会直接扭曲几何。
AI.method: 以双线性上采样图为起点，针对albedo与位移两种模态分别用轻量LoRA模块适配冻结的SDXL主干；同时引入Tile ControlNet以保留输入结构，让扩散先验恢复毛孔与皱纹级细节，无需定制超分架构。
AI.result: 在留出贴图上，细节比双线性、现成GAN与扩散超分器更锐利、更忠实；albedo的LPIPS从0.21降至0.08，同时避免位移浮雕错位或过强。
AI.conclusion: 轻量领域适配即可生成可直接用于渲染的4K面部资产贴图，说明无需专门设计超分架构，通用扩散骨干加LoRA与Tile控制已足够。

title: Trustworthy AI Teammates for Software Engineering: A Research Agenda for Lifecycle Context, Explainability, and Agentic Collaboration
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Pan-African Artificial Intelligence and Smart Systems Conference (PA-AI&SS 2026)
summary: Large Language Models are rapidly changing software engineering (SE) practice by supporting code generation, testing, debugging, documentation, and program comprehension. Yet most current AI coding assistants remain reactive tools: they respond to local prompts, rely on limited context, and provide suggestions whose rationale is often difficult for developers to inspect. This paper argues that the next phase of AI-assisted SE requires a shift from coding assistants to trustworthy AI teammates. We present a research agenda for human-AI co-evolution in SE, organized around three requirements. First, AI systems must become lifecycle-aware, reasoning across requirements and other deployment artifacts rather than isolated files or prompts. Second, they must provide principled explanations that expose assumptions, evidence, trade-offs, and risks in ways that support developer judgment. Third, they must enable agentic collaboration, in which specialized AI agents participate in software workflows while preserving human oversight and accountability. We propose an evaluation framework that moves beyond isolated functional correctness toward collaborative quality, including contextual alignment, trust calibration, maintenance recovery cost, and traceability. We conclude by outlining open challenges for designing AI systems that improve software quality without weakening human understanding, agency, or responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"从编码助手走向可信AI队友"的研究议程，围绕生命周期感知、可解释性、智能体协作三项要求，并提出超越功能正确性的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 当前AI编码助手多为被动响应式工具：仅响应局部提示、上下文有限、建议依据难以让开发者审查，难以支撑软件工程对人的理解力与责任的要求。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/议程型论文。提出三大要求：(1)生命周期感知，跨需求与部署制品推理；(2)有原则的解释，暴露假设、证据、权衡与风险；(3)智能体协作，专用AI智能体参与工作流并保留人类监督与问责。并设计评估框架：上下文对齐、信任校准、维护恢复成本、可追溯性。
AI.result: 提出以"协作质量"为核心的评估框架，替代孤立的函数级正确性评测，并梳理了相关开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助软件工程的下一阶段需实现人机共同演化，在提升软件质量的同时不削弱人类的理解、能动性与责任。

title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary:
Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements.
  We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.

AI.tldr: Inventa is a framework for automated scientific discovery that uses isolated autonomous research units plus a verified shared knowledge channel to avoid idea convergence and unsupported claim propagation, outperforming baselines on five benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Scaling up LLM agents or iterations does not necessarily yield more diverse or feasible research ideas: agents converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims via shared memory, and keep reusing exhausted search strategies.
AI.method: Inventa employs autonomous research units, each evolving a lineage of candidate ideas via a mutator agent. A local orchestrator periodically adapts the mutator's harness and, upon stagnation, swaps the model or restarts idea evolution. Verifiers assess each candidate and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations into a shared knowledge base—the only inter-unit channel.
AI.result: Evaluated on five benchmarks across the research cycle (ScholarCatalyst, IdeaBench, IdeaScientist, EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench), Inventa leads all five: 73.6% on EurekaBench vs. 56.2% for CORAL; on IdeaBench, 26.0 novel ideas per paper vs. 18.6 for ResearchAgent with 82% fewer model calls.
AI.conclusion: Isolating research units while restricting inter-unit communication to verified knowledge improves idea diversity, feasibility and efficiency in automated scientific discovery.

title: KV-LTM: Persistent Per-Session KV Caches as Long-Term Memory for Personal Assistants
summary: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. In a system-level comparison on LongMemEval, two commercial assistants scored well below the same model reading the history offline [1], consistent with, but not isolating, content loss between write and read. We propose KV-LTM: a memory tier storing each session's raw text plus its KV cache under a fixed reader model, answering by restoring cached sessions and appending the question. KV-LTM is complementary to, not a replacement for, retrieval and indexing. Text is the memory of record; the cache is a recompute-free prefill accelerator, degrading gracefully to text. We specify the design: storage record, budget-derived retention, append-only read path, and bounded aggregation. We size it analytically: across pinned BF16 full-attention (GQA) and latent-cached MLA configurations, per-token state spans approximately 31K-328K bytes (the pinned KDA+MLA hybrid differs: approximately 8.1K bytes/token plus a fixed per-session recurrent term), giving approximately 0.34-3.6 TB per user-year at a declared 30K-token/day scenario, against approximately 49 MB of raw text; per-query cost is modelled as regime-conditional transfer, attention, decode, aggregation, and compute. We define an evaluation protocol needing no persistent-cache implementation for logical QA evaluation: per-session prefill emulates valid cache reuse under the same model/input-state contract and ideal arithmetic, with named arms, controlled baselines, and a preregistered reader-model gate; a separate minimal real-cache replay tests numerical equivalence and measures the cost axis, with outcomes not assumed. KV-LTM trades storage for avoided re-prefill compute and write-time fidelity, within a declared retention budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 KV-LTM：一种长期记忆层，同时保存每次会话的原始文本与其在固定阅读模型下的 KV cache，回答时恢复缓存会话并追加问题，以“免重算 prefill”换取写入-读取间的保真度，并给出存储/成本分析与评估协议。
AI.motivation: 当前长期记忆系统在“问题—证据”之间引入了推导或选择环节，存在写入到读取之间的内容损失。LongMemEval 上两个商用助手明显低于同一模型离线读全history的表现，暗示（但未隔离证明）存在信息损失。
AI.method: 设计级论文：每会话存储原始文本+KV cache；预算驱动的保留策略、append-only 读路径、有界聚合；与检索/索引互补而非替代，文本为记录载体、缓存为可降级加速器。用解析法估算不同注意力配置（BF16 GQA、latent-cached MLA、KDA+MLA 混合）的每 token 状态与每用户年存储；构建无需持久缓存实现的按会话 prefill 逻辑 QA 评估协议（命名臂、受控基线、预注册 reader 门控），并用最小真实缓存回放检验数值等价与成本。
AI.result: 每 token 状态约 31K–328K 字节（KDA+MLA 混合约 8.1K 字节/token 加固定每会话递归项）；按 30K token/日场景约 0.34–3.6 TB/用户年，对比原始文本仅约 49 MB。每查询成本建模为分情形传输、注意力、解码、聚合与计算。
AI.conclusion: KV-LTM 在声明的保留预算内，用存储换取免重 prefill 计算与写入期保真；其可行性依赖真实缓存回放的数值等价与成本测量，结果未被预设。

title: Token Commitment as a Control Surface for Steering Masked Diffusion Generation
summary: Masked diffusion models repeatedly predict provisional tokens before a sampler decides which predictions become permanent. Existing inference-time steering methods primarily modify activations, logits, or denoising trajectories, while treating this commitment policy as a fixed decoding detail. We instead study token commitment as a diffusion-specific control surface and separate it into two decisions: which tokens to commit and how many tokens to commit at each step. For the first, we introduce counterfactual target-aware commitment, which ranks unresolved positions by a mixture of model confidence and leave-one-token-out target contribution. For the second, we introduce calibrated adaptive budgets driven by target progress and confidence. Across language and vision-language settings in the LLaDA family, multiple targets, two activation-steering methods, and an unsteered control, both mechanisms yield empirically monotonic target-quality trade-offs in every configuration we evaluate. Adaptive schedules also recover competitive operating points relative to scorer-free stochastic schedules matched in average denoising cost. Because both mechanisms require only a scalar score evaluated on a provisional completion, they apply unchanged when the target is an automatic proxy for task success rather than an output attribute: NLI entailment for dialogue summarization and CLIPScore for captioning, neither of which corresponds to a single reusable steering direction. We reproduce the behavior of both mechanisms on a second masked-diffusion family, Dream-7B, for one control target and one task-success target. These results characterize commitment--which provisional predictions become irreversible, and how rapidly--as an interpretable control surface for steering masked diffusion generation under the conditions we test.

AI.tldr: 论文将掩码扩散模型的"token承诺策略"（提交哪些token、每步提交多少）作为独立的可控面，提出反事实目标感知承诺与校准自适应预算两种机制，实现可解释的目标导向生成控制。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码扩散模型的推理时引导方法主要改动激活值、logits或去噪轨迹，而把"哪些预测被固定为永久输出、以及多快固定"的承诺策略视为固定的解码细节，未加研究。作者认为这一承诺政策本身是一个扩散特有的、有价值的控制面。
AI.method: 将承诺拆为两个决策：1）提交哪些token——提出反事实目标感知承诺，按模型置信度与"留一token"目标贡献的混合得分对未解决位置排序；2）每步提交多少token——提出校准的自适应预算，由目标进度与置信度驱动。两种机制仅依赖对临时补全评估的标量分数，因此也可直接用于自动代理指标（如对话摘要的NLI蕴含、图像描述的CLIPScore）。
AI.result: 在LLaDA家族的语言与视觉语言设置、多个目标、两种激活引导方法及无引导对照中，两种机制在所有配置下均呈现经验单调的目标质量权衡；自适应调度在平均去噪成本匹配下可达到与无评分器随机调度相当的工作点；并在Dream-7B上复现了一个控制目标与一个任务成功目标的行为。
AI.conclusion: 承诺机制（哪些临时预测变得不可逆、以及多快变不可逆）可作为掩码扩散生成引导的可解释控制面，且不依赖单一可复用的引导方向，适用于属性目标与任务成功代理目标。

title: Better Rankers, Worse Retrievers: The Hidden Cost of RL Post-Training in Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommenders decode the semantic ID of a user's next item with a language model, and post-training them with reinforcement learning (RL) after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) has become standard practice. The gains are mostly reported on the first ten results, yet in deployment such models hand hundreds of candidates to a downstream ranker or reward model. We show that RL post-training has a hidden cost: it improves accuracy at the top of the list (hit@K for small K) but, on all five datasets we study, lowers the recall of the candidate list (hit@K for K in the hundreds). The model becomes a better ranker and a worse retriever. Controlled experiments trace the loss to the negative advantages that RL assigns to the candidates it samples, the rollout. The root cause is that only one next item is logged per user, so RL treats every other candidate as wrong. Yet these candidates are the model's most plausible alternatives, and often the next items of other users with similar histories. Penalising them pushes down exactly what similar users choose next, and these items drop out of those users' candidate lists. This diagnosis points directly to a remedy: out-of-rollout anchoring, a single additional loss term that preserves the SFT model's ordering of the items outside the rollout. It keeps the gain at the top and restores recall to the SFT level on all five datasets, and it is effective under other RL configurations as well. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of this recall loss: we measure it, identify its cause, and show that, once the cause is known, a simple remedy suffices.

AI.tldr: 强化学习后训练会让生成式推荐模型"排序更好但召回更差"：hit@小K提升而hit@数百K下降。根源是RL将rollout外的候选当作负样本惩罚，提出out-of-rollout anchoring损失项，在五个数据集上兼顾头部精度与候选集召回。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐器经SFT后用RL后训练已成为标准做法，但现有报告多只看前10个结果。实际部署中模型需向下游排序器/奖励模型提供数百个候选，因此需要考察RL对候选列表整体召回的影响。
AI.method: 系统测量RL后训练的hit@K曲线（K从个位到数百）；通过控制实验定位到RL对采样rollout中候选赋予的负优势值；提出out-of-rollout anchoring——一个额外损失项，保留SFT模型对rollout之外物品的相对排序。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上，RL后训练一致提升小K的hit@K，却降低数百K的hit@K；out-of-rollout anchoring在五个数据集上保持头部收益并将召回恢复到SFT水平，且在其他RL配置下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个对该召回损失的系统性研究：度量现象、诊断原因（单正标签导致的错误负样本惩罚），并证明一旦明确病因，一个简单的附加损失项即可同时保住排序增益与召回。

title: Temporal Pseudo-RGB Encoding for Label-Free Detection of VEEV Infection in Human Brain Endothelial Cells
comment: 20 pages. Supplementary material is included as an ancillary file
summary: Label-free detection of viral infection is central to antiviral screening and pathogen surveillance. Most deep-learning methods analyze individual frames and do not model temporal progression. We evaluate temporal pseudo-RGB encoding, which stacks three time-offset brightfield frames ($t{-}6$ h, $t{-}3$ h, $t$) as the red, green, and blue channels of a single image so that morphological change becomes color and an ImageNet-pretrained convolutional neural network (CNN) can be trained on infection trajectories without architectural modification. In human brain microvascular endothelial cells (HBMVEC) infected with Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) TC-83, a multi-task network predicts infected-versus-mock status and time post-infection in one forward pass. Across three experimental runs under leave-one-row-out cross-validation, with all 36 wells scored out of fold, the encoding reaches 91.6% accuracy against 87.4% for the single-frame model (paired difference $+4.2$ percentage points, 95% CI $[+2.5, +6.1]$; sign-flip $p = 3\times10^{-5}$; well-level inference, conditional on three runs). At the late-phase endpoint (40-48 h), where floating cells and debris can make conventional brightfield images difficult to interpret, the advantage widens to $+23.9$ points (95% CI $[+19.2, +28.9]$). Time post-infection is recovered on the fixed row split with MAE = 1.31 h ($R^2 = 0.975$). Among the temporal models tested the encoding has the highest mean accuracy, at a fraction of the cost of the recurrent and 3D convolutional alternatives, though only its margin over the single-frame model is resolved; the tested ViT-B/16 backbone showed no corresponding gain, so the finding is limited to convolutional backbones and this virus-cell system.

AI.tldr: 提出"时间伪RGB编码"——将3个时间偏移的明场帧堆叠为RGB通道，使形态变化转为颜色，从而无需修改架构即可用ImageNet预训练CNN做病毒感染的无标记时序检测，在VEEV感染HBMVEC上达91.6%准确率。
AI.motivation: 多数深度学习病毒检测方法只分析单帧、不建模时间进程；而时序建模（RNN/3D CNN）代价高。作者希望用极低成本让现成的2D预训练CNN获得时序信息。
AI.method: 把 t-6h、t-3h、t 三帧明场图像分别作为R/G/B通道合成单张图像；在HBMVEC感染VEEV TC-83数据上训练多任务网络，同时预测感染/对照状态与感染后时间；采用留一孔行交叉验证（3次实验、36孔全部折外评分），并与单帧模型、RNN、3D CNN、ViT-B/16比较。
AI.result: 整体准确率91.6% vs 单帧87.4%（+4.2pp，95%CI [+2.5,+6.1]，符号翻转p=3e-5）；晚期（40-48h）优势扩大至+23.9pp；感染后时间MAE=1.31h（R²=0.975）；在时序模型中平均准确率最高且成本远低于RNN/3D CNN；ViT-B/16未见相应增益。
AI.conclusion: 时间伪RGB编码是一种简单、高效的时序建模替代方案，但结论仅限卷积骨干与该病毒-细胞体系；且除对单帧模型的优势外，各时序模型间差异未被统计分辨。

title: Evaluating AST-Derived Knowledge Graph Retrieval for AIOps Incident Diagnosis in Apache Kafka
summary: Incident diagnosis requires retrieving source-linked operational evidence from large codebases. We evaluate graph-augmented retrieval for Apache Kafka using an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-derived ownership graph over 1,600 source-linked log records and an audited benchmark of 315 incident-style queries covering 103 unique targets. Vector-only retrieval is a strong baseline at Recall@20 of 0.956, and neither static nor confidence-guided staged AST expansion significantly improves Recall@20 over it. As an external control we evaluate HippoRAG, a published text-derived graph-retrieval system, against its own ColBERTv2 retrieval backbone. Against ColBERTv2-only (Recall@20 0.803), HippoRAG attained 0.308; a post-hoc document-ensemble sensitivity raised Recall@20 to 0.648 but did not eliminate the deficit. Relative to static expansion, staging reduces cross-encoder pair workload and measured reranking time by about 52%. A manually evaluated 100-query downstream study finds no significant root-cause-correctness advantage for AST-derived structural evidence.

AI.tldr: 在Apache Kafka上评估AST派生所有权图增强检索：向量检索已达Recall@20=0.956，分阶段AST扩展无明显提升；外部对照HippoRAG远逊于ColBERTv2。
AI.motivation: 事故诊断需要从大型代码库中检索与源码关联的运维证据，作者想验证图增强检索（AST结构图、文本派生图）是否能优于纯向量检索。
AI.method: 构建AST派生的所有权图，覆盖1,600条源码关联日志记录，并建立315条事故式查询（103个唯一目标）的审计基准；对比向量检索、静态与置信度引导的分阶段AST扩展；以HippoRAG对ColBERTv2作外部对照；再做100条查询的人工下游评测。
AI.result: 向量检索基线Recall@20=0.956，两种AST扩展均无显著提升；HippoRAG仅0.308对ColBERTv2的0.803，事后文档集成仅升至0.648；分阶段扩展使交叉编码器配对量与重排时间降低约52%；下游评测未发现AST结构证据在根因正确性上的显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 图增强检索在本设定下未带来召回或根因诊断收益；其价值主要体现在降低重排计算成本，纯向量检索仍是强基线，对图增强的收益应保持谨慎。

title: When Does Discrete Ricci Curvature Help? An Edge-Level Analysis of Curvature-Enhanced GCNs for PPI Prediction
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning
summary: Curvature-enhanced graph convolutional networks (CGCN) incorporate Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), grounded in optimal transport theory, into message passing, motivated by the claim that curvature-weighted edges alleviate "over-squashing" at structural bottlenecks. But does CGCN's improvement actually come from mitigating over-squashing? We investigate this on four real-world protein-protein interaction (PPI) datasets, comparing CGCN against a standard GCN at the level of individual edges rather than aggregate metrics alone. While CGCN improves aggregate AUC, AUPR, and F1 across all four datasets, this gain is concentrated almost entirely on low-degree edges, while performance on low-curvature (bottleneck) edges systematically degrades in three of four datasets, the opposite of what the over-squashing motivation predicts. Examining the learned edge-weight function directly, together with clustering-validity metrics, edge-distance ratios, and a layer-depth ablation across four depths, we find evidence for an alternative account: curvature-weighting sharpens the separation between clusters, which improves intra-cluster predictions at the cost of inter-cluster (bottleneck) ones. We test this account against topologically defined communities rather than the classification labels used elsewhere. Additionally, we offer practical guidance on when to prefer CGCN over standard GCN, depending on whether intra- or inter-cluster predictions matter most.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文检验了曲率增强图卷积网络(CGCN)是否真的通过缓解"过度压缩"来取得提升，发现证据并不支持这一动机，反而支持"曲率加权通过锐化簇间分离、以牺牲簇间(瓶颈)边为代价换取簇内预测提升"的替代解释。
AI.motivation: CGCN将基于最优传输理论的Ollivier-Ricci曲率(ORC)加入消息传递，理由是曲率加权边能缓解结构瓶颈处的"过度压缩"。但作者质疑：CGCN的提升是否真的来自缓解过度压缩？现有评估多停留在聚合指标层面，未在单条边层面检验这一因果解释。
AI.method: 作者在四个真实蛋白质相互作用(PPI)数据集上，将CGCN与标准GCN在单条边层面进行对比（而非仅看聚合指标）。分析手段包括：直接考察学习到的边权函数、聚类有效性指标、边距离比值，以及在四个不同层深上的层深消融实验；此外还使用拓扑定义的社区（而非分类标签）来验证替代解释。
AI.result: CGCN在四个数据集上均提升了聚合AUC、AUPR和F1，但增益几乎全部集中在低度边上；而低曲率(瓶颈)边上的表现反而在四分之三的数据集中系统性下降——这与过度压缩动机的预测正好相反。上述多项分析一致支持替代解释：曲率加权锐化了簇间分离，改善了簇内预测但牺牲了簇间(瓶颈)预测。
AI.conclusion: CGCN的提升并非源于缓解过度压缩，而是源于曲率加权带来的簇分离锐化效应。作者据此给出了实用建议：应根据任务更重视簇内还是簇间预测，来决定是否选择CGCN而非标准GCN。

title: On Formal Counterfactual Explanations
summary: Counterfactual explanations are often seen as counterfactual conditionals under closest-world semantics, requiring one to reason over all minimally distant counterexamples. In contrast, formal XAI typically relies on feature-based abductive explanations (AXps) and contrastive explanations (CXps), which admit efficient computation and a minimal hitting-set duality. This paper bridges these perspectives by (i) characterizing closest-world counterfactual explanations explicitly as a disjunctive normal form over all minimally distant counterexample instances, and (ii) introducing conjunctive counterfactual explanations (CFXps), a subclass of counterfactual antecedents restricted to conjunctions of feature literals that guarantee prediction change. The paper establishes structural results connecting CXps, AXps and CFXps: every CXp induces an AXp for its witness instance, and every CXp together with a witness AXp induces a CFXp whose support is precisely determined by that AXp. These theoretical results yield a modular approach for computing CFXps using existing AXp/CXp machinery. Experiments on a representative set of benchmarks using tree ensembles and neural networks show that CFXp extraction is practically efficient. Compared with popular point-based counterfactual explainers, CFXps generally require no more feature changes and can guarantee the counterfactual prediction beyond a single instance.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"最接近世界"语义下的反事实解释刻画为对所有最小距离反例实例的析取范式，并提出了合取反事实解释（CFXp），建立了CXp、AXp与CFXp之间的结构性联系，给出模块化计算方法。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释（最近世界语义）与形式化XAI中基于特征的可解释方法（AXp/CXp）之间存在概念鸿沟：前者需对所有最小距离反例推理，后者计算高效且有极小碰集对偶性，但两者缺乏统一联系。
AI.method: (i) 将最近世界反事实解释显式刻画为所有最小距离反例实例的析取范式；(ii) 定义合取反事实解释CFXp，即仅由保证预测改变的特征文字合取构成的反事实前件子类；(iii) 证明结构性结果：每个CXp诱导其见证实例的一个AXp，且CXp与见证AXp共同诱导一个CFXp，其支撑由该AXp精确确定；(iv) 据此借助现有AXp/CXp机制进行模块化计算。
AI.result: 在代表性基准上用树集成和神经网络实验表明，CFXp提取在实践上高效；与流行的点式反事实解释器相比，CFXp通常不需要更多特征改动，且能保证超出单一实例的反事实预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立反事实解释的形式语义与AXp/CXp框架之间的桥梁，论文提出了可高效计算且具有更强保证（不止于单点）的CFXp，为反事实解释提供了兼具理论基础与实用性的新方案。

title: Disambiguating Moral Circuits and Moral Features in Language Models: Moral content, normative judgment or cue words? Evidence from 14 models
summary: Interpretability methods can locate the attention heads and sparse autoencoder (SAE) features that change the answer a language model gives to a moral prompt, e.g., whether "Stealing medicine for a dying child is morally" continues with "justified" or "wrong". Such a component could respond to moral content, to the judgment of conduct by any norm, or to the word "morally" in the prompt. We built 227 minimal pairs of short phrases, validated by five annotators, whose two versions differ in a moral standard, in another kind of norm (prudence, etiquette, aesthetics or evidence) or in a descriptive quality, and showed them to 14 open-weight models (Llama, Gemma and Qwen, 1B to 14B, base and instruction-tuned), with and without the word "morally". In every model, the heads that change the moral answer belong to an evaluation circuit the models use for every kind of normative judgment we tested: these heads carry the same share of the effect for moral as for other normative pairs (pooled ratio 1.00, 97.5% confidence interval [0.92, 1.07], with the word; 0.90, [0.84, 0.96], without it), and the models need them as much for both. The models need these heads also when nothing in the prompt asks for a judgment, and on 400 scenarios of the ETHICS benchmark, where removing them takes away 37 to 39% of the difference between acceptable and unacceptable scenarios, against 1 to 3% for ten random heads. The SAE features we located respond mostly to the word "morally" rather than to what the phrase is about. The models represent the category of a pair (the standard the annotators assigned to it): it can be read from their hidden states, and, in the eight models we tested, removing the direction that carries it weakens the moral verdict by a few percent, and more than the other verdicts in seven of them. We release the pairs, the ratings, the code, the trained SAE dictionaries and the result files.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过227个最小对照短语对与14个开源模型，检验"道德判断"相关注意力头是否专属于道德内容。结论是其属于通用规范性评价回路，而SAE特征主要响应"morally"一词本身。
AI.motivation: 可解释性方法能定位改变模型道德回答的注意力头和SAE特征，但这些组件可能只响应道德内容，也可能只响应任何规范判断，甚至只是响应提示中的"morally"一词。作者希望厘清这一混淆。
AI.method: 构建227个经五位标注者验证的最小型短语对，配对版本分别只在一处不同：道德标准、其他规范（审慎、礼仪、审美、证据）或描述性属性；在14个开放权重模型（Llama、Gemma、Qwen，1B–14B，base与指令微调）上测试，含/不含"morally"两种条件；进行注意力头消融、随机头对照、隐藏状态探针与方向消融，并在ETHICS基准400个场景上验证。
AI.result: 改变道德回答的注意力头同样携带其他规范判断的效应（含"morally"时汇总比值1.00，CI[0.92,1.07]；不含时为0.90，[0.84,0.96]），模型对二者的依赖程度相当。即使提示未要求判断、以及在ETHICS场景上，移除这些头也造成影响（消除可接受/不可接受差异的37–39%，随机头仅1–3%）。SAE特征主要响应"morally"一词而非短语主题。模型隐藏状态可读出配对类别；移除该方向在8个模型中削弱道德判断数个百分点，其中7个削弱幅度大于其他判断。
AI.conclusion: 模型并不存在专用的"道德"电路，而是使用一套通用的规范性评价回路；此前定位到的SAE特征多半只是捕捉字面词汇。作者公开短语对、评分、代码、SAE字典与结果文件。

title: Music Similarity Learning in Sparse Latin Scenarios
summary: In this work we propose a lightweight, interpretable approach that estimates item-item music similarity from publicly available metadata. Our hybrid regression model combines content-based filtering with the classic item-based collaborative filtering. We test generalization via a zero-shot evaluation on Latin American music, a genre for which co-occurrence data is scarce. Accurately predicting similarity for these unseen, sparse pairs shows that our approach is robust to the regional gap affecting many existing systems, without the audio signal processing or the computational budget that deep multimodal approaches would require.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种仅用公开元数据的轻量可解释方法，将内容过滤与经典item-based协同过滤相结合，以混合回归模型估计音乐曲目间相似度，并在数据稀缺的拉美音乐上通过零样本评估验证泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐相似度系统多依赖音频信号处理或深度多模态模型，计算成本高且缺少可解释性；同时共现数据匮乏的地区性音乐（如拉美音乐）存在泛化缺口，需要一种轻量、稳健的方案。
AI.method: 构建混合回归模型，融合基于内容（content-based）的过滤与经典item-based协同过滤，输入为公开可获取的元数据而非音频；在拉美音乐上进行零样本（zero-shot）评估，检验模型对未见、稀疏曲目对的相似度预测能力。
AI.result: 模型能准确预测未见、稀疏曲目对的相似度，在共现数据稀缺的拉美音乐上表现稳健，说明其对影响许多现有系统的区域差距具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 无需音频信号处理与深度多模态方法所需的高计算预算，也能实现可解释且跨地区泛化的音乐相似度估计。

title: REEL: Brain-Guided Video Generation and Selection by Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear Decoding from fMRI data
summary: Visual brain decoding from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data has made remarkable progress in recent years, driven by increasingly powerful artificial intelligence (AI) models and the growing availability of large-scale public datasets. However, despite the impressive advances achieved in static image decoding, the reconstruction of videos from fMRI signals remains challenging due to the temporal mismatch between rapidly changing video stimuli and the slow dynamics of the blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) response. We evaluate a Bayesian-inspired proposal-and-rerank strategy on CC2017 and the BOLD Moments Dataset (BMD), using a linear semantic decoder, a pretrained video generator, and three neural encoding streams with ridge readouts and learned pooling in two streams. We refer to this framework as REEL (Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear decoding). Compared with a single generated candidate, reranking increases mean Video 50-way accuracy from 0.2359 to 0.2434 across three CC2017 participants and from 0.3653 to 0.3920 across ten BMD participants. These findings suggest an alternative and conceptually simpler strategy for improving video brain decoding, highlighting the potential of our approach as a complementary direction to increasingly complex pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REEL框架，用"候选生成+重排序"策略改进fMRI视频大脑解码，在线性解码、预训练视频生成器和三条神经编码流的基础上，通过重排序提升视频识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 静态图像fMRI解码已有显著进展，但视频重建仍具挑战：快速变化的视频刺激与缓慢的BOLD响应之间存在时间失配。现有方法倾向于构建日益复杂的流水线，本文希望探索更简单、互补的策略。
AI.method: 提出REEL（Reranking Encoder Embeddings with Linear decoding）框架，受贝叶斯思想启发：结合线性语义解码器、预训练视频生成器，以及三条神经编码流（岭回归读出，其中两条流使用可学习池化）。对生成多个候选视频，再用神经编码模型对其进行重排序。在CC2017和BMD数据集上评估。
AI.result: 重排序相比单一生成候选显著提升视频50-way准确率：CC2017三位被试由0.2359提升至0.2434；BMD十位被试由0.3653提升至0.3920。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，"候选生成+重排序"是一种概念更简单、可为复杂流程提供补充方向的视频大脑解码策略，具有提升解码性能的潜力。

title: X-LocVul: An Evidence-Propagation Audit of Cascaded C/C++ Vulnerability Detection, Localization, and Explanation
comment: Full-length preprint: 21 pages, 13 tables, and 1 figure. Reproducibility artifact and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22723493
summary:
Developer-facing vulnerability analysis should link a function-level warning to a source location and a supported explanation. Cascaded systems can propagate weak evidence despite plausible components. We present X-LocVul, a measurement-first audit of a modular C/C++ detector-localizer-explainer pipeline combining UniXCoder, CodeT5, and Qwen2.5-Coder. We test whether evidence passed across stages is useful, merely source-resident, or misleading.
  Under duplication and temporal-leakage controls, UniXCoder has higher point estimates than CodeBERT, but true-CWE supervision is statistically indistinguishable from a shuffled-CWE control on PR-AUC, MCC, and vulnerable-class F1. Raw generated statements fail exact source matching in 90.83% of cases. Fuzzy projection reaches 83.79% Top-1 accuracy and exceeds semantic projection by 1.59 percentage points, although its advantage over raw ranking is not established. In a randomized, condition-label-masked two-rater evaluation of 50 paired cases, a predicted line improves evidence support, whereas a predicted CWE improves no endpoint. Oracle evidence improves evidence support (Holm-adjusted p=0.00453) and CWE consistency (p=3.49 x 10^-7), but not root-cause quality after correction (p=0.250); unsupported claims remain common. A chronological stress test retains ranking signal (ROC-AUC 0.782; PR-AUC 0.110), while the transferred threshold yields zero recall and F1.
  The contribution is not a state-of-the-art claim, but an auditable account of evidence construction, transfer, and consumption. It separates source residency from localization correctness, auxiliary labels from semantic supervision, and predicted evidence from useful evidence. Public E4 scores regenerate all 15 tests; missing manifests, final prompts, and profiler logs bound stronger reproducibility claims.

AI.tldr: X-LocVul 是一个"测量优先"的审计研究，将 UniXCoder（检测）+ CodeT5（定位）+ Qwen2.5-Coder（解释）组合成级联流水线，检验各阶段证据是真正有用、仅存于源码中、还是具有误导性。核心发现：真实 CWE 监督与打乱 CWE 对照在统计上无法区分；90.83% 生成语句无法精确匹配源码；预测行能提升证据支持而预测 CWE 不能；时序压力测试下迁移阈值导致召回与 F1 归零。
AI.motivation: 面向开发者的漏洞分析应将函数级告警链接到源码位置并给出可支持的解释，而级联系统即使组件各自看似合理，也可能逐级传播弱证据甚至虚假证据。现有工作缺少对该证据构造—转移—消费链条的可审计测量，作者因此提出对模块化 C/C++ 检测—定位—解释流水线进行系统审计，而非追求 SOTA。
AI.method: 构建 UniXCoder（检测）、CodeT5（定位）、Qwen2.5-Coder（解释）三模块级联流水线并进行测量实验：(1) 在复制与时间泄漏控制下比较 UniXCoder 与 CodeBERT，并用"打乱 CWE"对照检验真实 CWE 监督的有效性；(2) 对生成解释做精确源码匹配，对比模糊投影与语义投影的 Top-1 准确率；(3) 对 50 组配对样本做随机化、条件标签遮蔽的双评分员人工评估，分别考察预测行、预测 CWE 与 oracle 证据对证据支持、CWE 一致性和根因质量的影响；(4) 时序压力测试考察排序信号与阈值迁移。
AI.result: UniXCoder 点估计高于 CodeBERT，但真实 CWE 监督在 PR-AUC、MCC、易受攻击类 F1 上与打乱 CWE 对照统计不可区分。原始生成语句 90.83% 无法精确匹配源码；模糊投影 Top-1 达 83.79%，比语义投影高 1.59 个百分点，但相对原始排序的优势未确立。人工评估中预测行可提升证据支持，预测 CWE 对任何指标都无提升；oracle 证据提升证据支持（Holm 校正 p=0.00453）与 CWE 一致性（p=3.49×10^-7），但校正后不改善根因质量（p=0.250），无支持论断仍普遍存在。时序压力测试保留排序信号（ROC-AUC 0.782，PR-AUC 0.110），但迁移阈值下召回与 F1 为零。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献不是 SOTA 声明，而是对证据构造、转移与消费的可审计刻画，明确区分了"源码驻留"与"定位正确性"、"辅助标签"与"语义监督"、"预测证据"与"有用证据"。公开 E4 分数可复现全部 15 项测试，但缺失的 manifest、最终提示与 profiler 日志限制了更强的可复现性主张。

title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.

AI.tldr: 在带宽受限的边缘加速器（NVIDIA GB10）上对 26B 扩散 MoE 语言模型进行单用户解码剖析发现：权重量化后，真正主导解码时间的不是专家 GEMM，而是对整个画布×词表的 logits 采样/停止流水线（因需 S 倍处理），通过两级无损优化（逐位一致层 + 精度对齐的融合单遍熵核与 Gumbel-max 采样）配合 W4A16 专家核，实现 2.4–2.7 倍端到端加速且精度不变。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型每步都要对全画布 token 做逐 token 采样与停止判断，每次前向都要遍历整个 logits 张量；相比自回归解码每输出 token 只采样一个位置，扩散解码需要 S 倍（S 为去噪步数）的 logit 条目处理。作者指出这一开销在权重量化使骨干变便宜后成为 MoE 扩散模型最大的解码瓶颈，而这一现象容易被忽视。
AI.method: 在 GB10 上剖析 26B 扩散 MoE 单用户解码；论证 logits 流水线存在大量冗余且可融合；提出两级无损优化：(1) 逐位一致（bit-exact）层，输出与参考解码器字节完全相同；(2) 精度对齐层，使用融合单遍熵核和 Gumbel-max 采样；并与 W4A16 专家量化核组合成完整栈。
AI.result: 完整栈在 273 GB/s 单设备上相对 bf16 达到 2.4–2.7 倍端到端加速，GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH 基准精度不变；在独立构建的 LLaDA2.0-mini 上复现该发现（流水线占解码 28.8%，融合 W4A16 精度对齐下 3.3 倍加速）；在稠密扩散模型上该现象消失（仅占 3.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 该瓶颈是 MoE 扩散模型特有的：量化使骨干计算变便宜后，logits 采样/停止流水线成为主导成本。两级无损优化可有效消除该冗余，且不损精度；作者已开源代码与量化权重。

title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Work in progress: benchmark design and protocol; results to be added in a later version
summary: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillBuffBench，一个把 Agent Skills 访问方式（无 Skill / 精选 Skill / 从已安装库自动调用）与记忆（关/开）、四种 harness、多家模型交叉配对评测的基准与协议，任务来自材料科学与生物学专家的真实研究工作流，当前仅描述设计与协议，评测结果待补。
AI.motivation: 现有关于 Agent Skills 有效性的证据多来自"人工为任务挑好正确 Skill"且"agent 从空白状态起步"的理想化设置；而真实部署中 agent 需从已安装的任意 Skill 库中自行选择，且往往带有先前工作留下的记忆，两者都未被现有评测覆盖。
AI.method: 构建基准与配对评测协议：将 Skill 访问设为三水平因子（无 Skill、精选 Skill、从已安装库自动调用），与记忆（关/开）交叉，再与四种 agent harness 和多个模型（Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 的 SOTA 专有模型，以及中国厂商的 SOTA 开源权重模型）构成全交叉设计，每个模型在每种 harness 下均运行；任务由领域专家提供并附带其实际使用的 Skill，目前覆盖材料科学与生物学，并滚动扩充。每个 run 用确定性 verifier 判定，不确定性用配对的任务级 bootstrap 报告，同时单列成本、agent 轮数与实际耗时而非折算进分数。
AI.result: 本版本仅为基准设计、评测协议与当前任务/Skill 集合的说明，评测仍在进行中，尚无结果；任务集、结果与分析将滚动更新。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把 Skills 评测从"精选 Skill + 空白起点"推向更接近部署现实的"自动调用 + 带记忆"场景，并通过全交叉配对设计和确定性验证提供可比较、可成本核算的评测框架；但当前阶段属于基准提案，其实际结论有待完整运行结果验证。

title: Corrupting Ties: Investigating Robustness to Bias Injection Across Multi-Agent Network Topologies
summary: AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts, where interactions among components can introduce fairness risks that remain undetected when auditing components or collective outcomes in isolation. As LLM-based multi-agent systems become more prevalent, understanding how biased information propagates through agent interactions is essential for assessing their fairness. We introduce a controlled bias injection framework that replaces selected agent responses with predefined biased ones, enabling an intervention-based analysis of how network topology and injection configurations shape system behavior. We propose decision divergence metrics that quantify the effects of these interventions at the agent, network, and system levels, and evaluate five topologies on three binary classification tasks using LLMs from the Qwen and Gemma families. Sequential networks show the greatest divergence, whereas fully connected and mesh networks show less. Injection position also matters: in star networks, injecting the central agent has larger effects than injecting peripheral agents. Models further differ in whether divergence follows the injected bias. These findings highlight the role of network structure in the propagation of biased information and motivate topology-aware auditing of fairness risks in multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 提出受控偏见注入框架，用决策分歧指标分析LLM多智能体系统中网络拓扑与注入配置对偏见传播和公平性的影响。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在高风险决策中日益普及，组件间交互可能引发单组件审计或整体结果审计都无法发现的公平性风险；需理解偏见信息如何在智能体交互中传播。
AI.method: 将选定智能体回复替换为预设偏见回复的受控注入框架；提出智能体、网络、系统三级决策分歧指标；在Qwen与Gemma系列LLM上，对5种拓扑、3个二分类任务进行干预式评估。
AI.result: 顺序网络分歧最大，全连接与网状网络较小；星形网络中注入中心智能体影响大于外围；不同模型在分歧是否随注入偏见方向变化上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 网络结构显著影响偏见信息传播，应开展拓扑感知的多智能体系统公平性审计。

title: CARE: Conversational Affective Response Retrieval for Internet Memes
summary: Conversational meme retrieval supports response selection in online communication, where relevance depends on both contextual meaning and affective expression. We study this task using two language-specific collections from Douban and Imgflip, containing 98,506 meme records across 5,583 discussion topics. Thread membership supplies weak relevance labels, while likes provide implicit ranking feedback. Automatically extracted sentiment, facial-expression indicators, and cross-modal consistency features support an exploratory analysis of engagement. We propose CARE, a Conversational Affective Response Retrieval framework that combines an emotion-enhanced CLIP retriever with a Jina-based reranker. The retriever incorporates free-form emotion descriptors through gated fusion and learns from multiple positive examples per query. The reranker combines query--image interactions with emotion representations and is trained using engagement-based ranking supervision. Under the reported topic-held-out protocol, CARE achieves Hit@10 of 24.03\% on Douban and 49.33\% on Imgflip, compared with 23.16\% and 41.07\%, respectively, for fine-tuned CLIP. These results support the utility of the complete two-stage system for recovering thread-associated memes. They do not independently establish perceived social resonance or isolate the contribution of affect from reranker training. The study provides a basis for further evaluation of affect-aware retrieval with human relevance judgments and controlled comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段"对话情感响应检索"框架CARE，在豆瓣和Imgflip表情包数据集上提升对话式表情包检索效果。
AI.motivation: 在线交流中，表情包检索的相关性同时取决于上下文语义与情感表达；现有检索方法缺乏对情感的建模与对多正例、隐式互动信号的利用。
AI.method: 构建两个语言特定数据集（豆瓣、Imgflip，共98,506条记录、5,583个话题），以话题归属为弱相关性标签、点赞为隐式排序反馈；提取情感、面部表情与跨模态一致性特征用于探索性分析；提出CARE：情感增强CLIP检索器（自由形式情感描述经门控融合，支持多正例学习）+ Jina重排器（查询-图像交互+情感表示，用互动信号做排序监督）。
AI.result: 话题留出协议下，CARE在豆瓣Hit@10为24.03%、Imgflip为49.33%，优于微调CLIP的23.16%和41.07%。
AI.conclusion: 完整两阶段系统有助于找回与话题相关的表情包，但尚不能独立证明社会共鸣感知或分离情感与重排训练的贡献；后续需引入人工相关性标注与受控对比评估。

title: Wrong Input, Wrong Threshold: Re-evaluating Adversarial Facial Privacy
comment: 10 pages main text and 15 pages supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Published face-privacy methods report protection above 90% against black-box recognition models. That number comes from an evaluation protocol with two independent defects, reported in a measure that cannot size either one. The input is wrong: methods published since 2022 feed the network the whole photograph, or a detector's box, where deployed systems detect, align to a landmark template and crop. Re-scoring the same files through a realistic front end costs a standard transfer attack 56% of its dodging protection and a budget-allocating attack 7%, with no image regenerated. The measure is wrong: that loss is a difference of success rates, so it saturates, moving by 8.2x over a budget sweep while the effect beneath it moves by 1.34x. We therefore report the paired cosine shift, in which both thresholds cancel algebraically, so the input defect holds without committing to a calibration. Measured that way it is 2.2x and 10.7x larger on three unseen recognizers, and at matched budget it reverses the L-infinity transfer ranking: the one surveyed method that aligns at evaluation gains 0.18 where MI-FGSM loses 0.05. The cause is a resampling mismatch, not perturbation lost outside the crop; optimising through a differentiable alignment operator largely removes it, adding +24 to +58 points on unseen recognizers and a commercial system, with a residual on one of them. The thresholds are wrong: the four constants inherited since 2021 hold the false-accept rate near its nominal 1% on aligned crops but admit 2.3-5.4% on whole images, with an opposite-signed bias across dodging and impersonation, the two tasks reported side by side. Differentiable alignment and gallery scoring are not new: the first generation of this literature used both, and we show what dropping them cost.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有面部隐私（对抗扰动）方法声称的90%以上保护率源于有双重缺陷的评测协议：输入未经真实的人脸检测-对齐-裁剪前端，且所用"成功率差"指标饱和失真；改用配对余弦位移作为度量后，误差分别为2.2倍与10.7倍，并揭示阈值偏离名义FAR、可微对齐能大幅恢复攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 已发表的人脸隐私保护方法普遍报告90%以上的黑盒识别防护率，但该数字建立在有缺陷的评测协议上：输入未经部署系统实际使用的检测、关键点对齐与裁剪流程，指标本身又无法度量这一问题的大小。作者希望厘清这一虚高保护率究竟由什么造成，并给出不会被校准假设掩盖的度量方式。
AI.method: （1）用真实前端（检测、对齐到关键点模板、裁剪）重打分既有攻击文件而不重生成图像；（2）指出成功率差会饱和，改报配对余弦位移（两个阈值代数相消），使输入缺陷的结论不依赖具体校准；（3）审查自2021年沿用的四个阈值常数在整图与对齐裁剪下的假接受率；（4）用可微对齐算子做端到端优化，并恢复可微对齐与图库打分。
AI.result: 重打分使标准迁移攻击损失56%的规避保护、预算分配攻击损失7%；成功率差在预算扫描中变化8.2倍而底层效应仅1.34倍。配对余弦位移下误差为2.2倍与10.7倍，并在等预算下反转L∞迁移排序（评估时对齐的方法+0.18，MI-FGSM为−0.05）。问题源于重采样失配而非裁剪外扰动丢失；可微对齐优化在未见识别器与商用系统上带来+24至+58点提升，但有一个系统仍有残差。阈值方面，四个常数在对齐裁剪上使FAR接近1%，在整图上却放宽到2.3–5.4%，且规避与冒仿两任务偏差方向相反。
AI.conclusion: 高保护率部分是评测伪影而非真实防护：输入前端、度量与阈值三处均有系统性错误，且可微对齐与图库打分本是第一代文献的标准做法，放弃它们付出了明显代价。人脸隐私评测应改用配对余弦位移等不饱和度量，并在真实前端的对齐裁剪上重设阈值、端到端优化对齐过程。

title: Usage Patterns of Programming Languages and Tools: A Systematic Literature Review
summary: Technology and the popularity of languages and tools are rapidly evolving. Thus, it is important to constantly assess the most popular languages and tools used in industry, furthering the collaboration between research and the software industry. In this study, we use a systematic literature review and investigate 37 studies published between 2015 -- 2024, which explored the programming languages, IDEs and CI tools used in industry. We observed that Java is most often listed among the most popular languages, and there are limited studies that investigate specific IDE usage. Also, Travis CI and GitHub Actions are the most common CI tools identified as being top CI tools used in industry. Overall, evidence shows that there is a lack of research focused on popular languages and tools used in industry, largely as there are many limitations with the possible methodology approaches. For example, lack of access to closed-source projects and sampling biases are potential issues that limit our understanding of popular languages and tools used in industry. In this regard, there is a need for more recent studies into development tools used in industry, involving multiple research approaches, to balance the limitations of each approach.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述分析了2015–2024年间37项研究，考察工业界使用的编程语言、IDE与CI工具，发现Java最常被视为最流行语言，Travis CI与GitHub Actions为最常见的CI工具，但相关研究仍显不足。
AI.motivation: 技术与语言工具的流行度快速演变，因此需要持续评估工业界实际使用的语言和工具，以促进学术界与软件产业的协作。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述（SLR），检索并分析2015至2024年间发表的37项考察工业界编程语言、IDE及CI工具使用情况的研究。
AI.result: Java最常出现在最流行语言榜单中；针对具体IDE使用情况的研究较少；Travis CI和GitHub Actions是最常被列为工业界顶级CI工具的两者。整体证据显示相关研究匮乏，主要受方法论限制影响，如无法访问闭源项目及抽样偏差等问题。
AI.conclusion: 需开展更多更新的、针对工业界开发工具的研究，并结合多种研究方法以相互弥补各自局限，从而更准确地理解工业界的语言与工具使用现状。

title: tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning
summary: Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.

AI.tldr: tmol: a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing RosettaGenFF forcefield, enabling fast batched differentiable scoring for protein design.
AI.motivation: Physics-inspired forcefields generalize better than pure ML models but are slow to evaluate and hard to integrate into ML frameworks.
AI.method: Represents everything in PyTorch-friendly form, doesn't it? The abstract states they built tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch implementation of the RosettaGenFF forcefield, supporting batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement.
AI.result: Up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). When used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.
AI.conclusion: tmol bridges physics forcefields and ML by making RosettaGenFF fast, differentiable, and directly usable as a reward signal in generative protein design.

title: What Does an Agent Need? Bundle-Aware Agent Resource Composition
summary: An agent resource's value depends on its backbone and companion resources and is known only after execution. Token-based generators remain tied to their training catalog, while independent resource scoring misses complementarities and reused bundles target other tasks. We formulate Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition (AgentComposition): jointly selecting a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility. Our Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation retrieves candidate resources and past configurations of similar tasks. A fine-tuned generator reads resource descriptions and recombines candidates through constrained beam search, allowing new resources without retraining. A bundle-aware critic ranks complete configurations using a large language model (LLM) teacher and historically successful configurations as execution proxies, and adapts to execution feedback when available. We evaluate reference recovery, offline execution with judged and native rewards, and online recommendation with real execution, building AgentSelect-Exec with 5,060 executed configurations. Our method recovers the complete reference configuration within ten candidates for 67.73% of AgentSelect queries, nearly twice the strongest baseline, and leads all baselines on SkillsBench. The proxy-trained critic raises the top-ranked agent's execution score from 7.58 to 8.37 out of 10; execution feedback increases it to 8.78, above the strongest baselines. Four target-domain queries suffice to adapt the generator to SkillsBench. Agents recommended online outperform the strongest baselines under both an LLM judge and native verifiers. These results support learning and transferring joint resource composition from task experience.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentComposition任务，用检索增强+束搜索生成+感知组合的评审器，联合选择主干模型与工具技能包以最大化端到端执行效用。
AI.motivation: 单靠主干模型或独立资源评分的现有方法存在不足：基于token的生成器受限于训练目录；独立资源评分忽略互补性；复用已有资源包又往往面向其他任务。因此需要联合选择骨干模型与配套工具-技能包以最大化端到端执行效用。
AI.method: 提出Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation：检索候选资源与相似任务的历史配置；微调生成器读取资源描述，通过约束束搜索重组候选（可引入新资源而无需重训）；bundled-aware评审器用LLM教师与历史成功配置作为执行代理对完整配置排序，并可根据执行反馈自适应。构建AgentSelect-Exec（5,060条已执行配置）评估参考恢复、离线执行与在线推荐。
AI.result: 67.73%的AgentSelect查询在前十个候选中恢复完整参考配置，约为最强基线两倍，并在SkillsBench上领先所有基线；代理训练的评审器将首位agent执行分从7.58提至8.37（满分10），加入执行反馈后达8.78；仅需4个目标域查询即可将生成器适配到SkillsBench；在线推荐在LLM评判与原生验证器下均优于最强基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可从任务经验中学习并迁移联合资源组合能力，验证了AgentComposition建模与代理反馈训练的有效性。

title: SimAI: Mechanistic User Simulation through Psychological Network Models
summary: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. However, existing simulators largely overlook the psychological mechanisms that drive user behavior. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. To support this approach, we construct PSYCHE, a dataset of 18,576 profile-network pairs derived from 516 psychotherapy cases. Automatic evaluations show that SimAI achieves greater simulation and behavioral diversity than existing patient simulators while maintaining strong profile alignment. In an interactive study with 30 mental-health professionals and trainees, SimAI receives the highest average ratings for conversational authenticity, realistic help-seeking behavior, and clinical training utility. Beyond simulation quality, SimAI enables realistic clinical training and uncovers safety failures in prolonged AI interactions with vulnerable users. Code is available at https://github.com/behavioral-data/ANGEL-UserSim.

AI.tldr: SimAI：基于心理机制的图重构目标实现逼真用户模拟框架，并构建PSYCHE数据集。
AI.motivation: 真实用户模拟可在直接实验代价高或有害时研究人类交互，但现有模拟器忽视驱动用户行为的心理机制。
AI.method: 提出SimAI框架，建模心理因素相互作用塑造用户响应；用图重构目标（基于模拟对话反映潜在心理关系的图级奖励）解决开放行为监督难题；构建PSYCHE数据集（516个心理治疗案例的18,576个档案-网络对）。
AI.result: 自动评估显示SimAI的模拟与行为多样性优于现有患者模拟器且保持良好档案对齐；30名心理健康专业人员与学员的交互研究中对会话真实性、现实求助行为、临床训练效用给出最高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: SimAI实现逼真临床训练，并揭示长时间AI交互中针对脆弱用户的安全失效问题。

title: GridDriver: On-Board BEV-Based Language Planning and Reasoning
summary: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV)-conditioned large language models (LLMs) enable language-interactive driving, but onboard deployment requires efficient perception and continuous planning alongside autoregressive language generation. We present GridDriver, an efficient BEV-conditioned LLM framework combining trajectory prediction, structured driving indicators, natural-language navigation, driving explanations, and scene question answering. Lightweight spatio-temporal BEV perception and spatially structured tokens provide scene context to a shared LLM, while frame-wise scheduling interleaves trajectory prediction with asynchronous language generation. GridDriver achieves competitive performance on public benchmarks, reaching 87.9% PDMS on NAVSIM and 57.6% accuracy on nuScenes-QA with a shared planning and QA checkpoint. Spatial representation analyses demonstrate improved geometric information retention and trajectory prediction compared with Q-Former compression. The system achieves 32.7 ms standalone planning latency and 9.4 plans/s in an onboard ROS 2 pipeline. We further evaluate planning on our own data recordings and demonstrate open-loop onboard operation on a research vehicle. Across public benchmarks and real-world evaluations, we identify strengths and limitations of the BEV-based approach.

AI.tldr: GridDriver：一个高效的BEV条件化LLM驾驶框架，统一轨迹预测、驾驶指标、自然语言导航、驾驶解释与场景问答，并实现车载ROS 2实时运行。
AI.motivation: BEV条件化LLM可实现语言交互式驾驶，但车载部署需在自回归语言生成的同时兼顾高效感知与持续规划，现有方案难以满足实时性与多任务协同需求。
AI.method: 采用轻量级时空BEV感知与空间结构化token为共享LLM提供场景上下文；通过帧级调度将轨迹预测与异步语言生成交错执行，替代Q-Former式压缩以更好保留几何信息。
AI.result: NAVSIM达87.9% PDMS，nuScenes-QA达57.6%准确率（规划与QA共享同一checkpoint）；空间表征分析显示几何信息保留与轨迹预测优于Q-Former压缩；独立规划延迟32.7 ms，车载ROS 2流水线9.4 plans/s。
AI.conclusion: 在公开基准与自采数据上验证了系统有效性，并在研究车辆上实现开环车载运行，同时总结了BEV方法在真实场景中的优势与局限。

title: Reusing Battle-tested Code: A Systematic Literature Review of Automated Software Transplantation
summary: Software reuse remains a fundamental challenge in software engineering, often caught between the security risks of external libraries and the reliability concerns of generative AI. Automated software transplantation offers a compelling alternative by enabling the direct extraction and integration, into new host systems, of battle-tested logic (code that has already survived the rigors of production, possibly over many years of extensive in-production use). This paper presents a systematic literature review to evaluate the current state-of-the-art and identify the remaining barriers preventing this technology from becoming a mainstream engineering practice. We identified 27 distinct automated software transplantation approaches. Our analysis reveals that while the adaptation of code is highly automated, significant bottlenecks remain in the manual prerequisite steps of organ location and test suite augmentation. We conclude with a research roadmap that suggests how these manual obstacles might be overcome, including the strategic use of Large Language Models to assist in identifying and verifying high-value, production-hardened logic for transplantation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述梳理了27种自动化软件移植（software transplantation）方法，发现代码适配高度自动化，但器官定位与测试套件增强等前置步骤仍依赖人工，并提出以大型语言模型辅助的研究路线图。
AI.motivation: 软件复用面临两难：外部库带来安全风险，生成式AI带来可靠性顾虑。自动化软件移植可将经过生产验证的成熟逻辑直接提取并集成到新宿主系统，是有吸引力的替代方案，但该技术尚未成为主流工程实践，需评估现状与障碍。
AI.method: 系统的文献综述（SLR）：识别并分析了27种不同的自动化软件移植方法，考察各流程环节（器官定位、代码适配、测试套件增强等）的自动化程度与瓶颈。
AI.result: 代码适配环节已高度自动化；但器官定位（organ location）和测试套件增强（test suite augmentation）等前置步骤仍需大量人工，是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 提出研究路线图，指出可通过战略性地使用大型语言模型来辅助识别并验证高价值、经生产检验的逻辑，从而克服这些人工障碍，推动自动化软件移植走向主流实践。

title: PromptPack: Training-Free Augmentation of Diffusion Editors for Intent-Aligned Spatial and Semantic Control
summary: Many image-editing tasks require confining changes to intended spatial regions while exactly preserving user-designated source content. Instruction-driven editing pipelines often leave such user-intent underspecified, while inpainting editors condition generation on explicitly defined edit support but not on the spatial assignment of individual edit concepts. PromptPack addresses both limitations by equipping diffusion editors with two explicit 'Edit Guides': an edit-role partition that labels each pixel as 'Keep,' 'Permit,' or 'Modify' to specify where edits may occur, and a regional-prompt assignment that maps spatial regions to text prompts to specify which concepts apply where. These guides may be manually specified or, for source-object edits, automatically derived from a text-grounded SAM 3 mask. Without retraining, PromptPack injects independently embedded regional prompts into the editor's fixed-length text sequence and uses the Edit Guides to spatially mask attention, gate flow updates, and restore protected source pixels. We integrate PromptPack into FlowEdit FLUX, FlowEdit SD3, and FLUX Kontext and demonstrate improved requested-concept placement and protected-content preservation across all three integrations on PIE-Bench++. In a pairwise user study, PromptPack achieves an 87% preference rate over FlowEdit FLUX, establishing PromptPack as a practical, training-free interface for intent-aligned diffusion editing.

AI.tldr: PromptPack 提出一种免训练的扩散图像编辑接口，通过"编辑角色分区"和"区域提示分配"两类显式编辑引导，实现对编辑位置与内容的精确控制。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑任务需将修改限制在指定空间区域并严格保留用户指定的源内容，但指令驱动编辑对用户意图表达不足，而 inpainting 编辑器虽定义了编辑支撑区域，却未指定各编辑概念的空间归属。
AI.method: 提出两类 Edit Guides：(1) 编辑角色分区，将每像素标为 Keep/Permit/Modify 以指定可编辑区域；(2) 区域提示分配，将空间区域映射到文本提示以指定概念作用范围。引导可手动指定，或针对源物体编辑由 text-grounded SAM 3 掩码自动导出。无需重训练，将独立嵌入的区域提示注入编辑器固定长度文本序列，并利用 Edit Guides 对注意力进行空间掩蔽、门控流更新、恢复受保护源像素。
AI.result: 集成到 FlowEdit FLUX、FlowEdit SD3 和 FLUX Kontext 三种架构，在 PIE-Bench++ 上均提升所请求概念的位置放置与受保护内容保留效果；成对用户研究中相对 FlowEdit FLUX 获得 87% 偏好率。
AI.conclusion: PromptPack 是一种实用、免训练且意图对齐的扩散编辑接口，可跨多种编辑器即插即用。
