title: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.

AI.tldr: 在三个购物基准上评测十个前沿大模型，发现增加"思考力度"并不能显著提升选品质量，却能显著提高模型自报的置信度——额外思考买到的是信心而非正确率；且模型普遍校准不良，错误高度共享。
AI.motivation: LLM 正被当作自主购物代理使用，直觉上"思考能力越强=购买决策越好"，但这种信念缺乏实证检验。作者想检验两个问题：让模型"多想"是否真能选到更好的商品？模型自报的置信度是否能反映其出错概率？
AI.method: 在 WebShop、Amazon SQID、Wayfair WANDS 三个平台上构建商品选择基准，对十个前沿模型进行评测；控制/变化思维努力（thinking effort）水平，比较决策质量、自报置信度、校准度（置信百分比与真实正确率的匹配），并分析跨模型错误的共享性。
AI.result: 三个基准上，提高思考努力均未在统计上显著提升决策质量；但同等努力变化却显著提高了自报置信度。多数模型在各努力水平下校准不良。错误呈强共享性：一个模型在某任务出错时，其他多个模型也倾向在同任务出错；在多模型共同出错的任务上，大量模型选了同一个错误商品。
AI.conclusion: "更强思考=更好购物决策"的假设不成立，额外计算带来的是信心膨胀而非正确性。模型置信度不可靠、易过度自信，且错误高度相关，意味着多模型投票/集成难以纠错；部署自主购物代理时需谨慎看待其置信度信号并重视共享偏差风险。

title: TUSI: A Citation-Grounded Graph-Based Benchmark
summary: Evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in Persian law remains challenging because benchmarks lack realism, grounding, and coverage of legal reasoning. Existing resources are either synthetically generated from statutory texts, lacking natural information needs, or derived from informal legal question--answer sources without explicit linkage to authoritative legal documents, making them unsuitable for rigorous evaluation of grounded legal reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce TUSI-Bench, a structured Persian legal benchmark designed for the evaluation of RAG-based systems. TUSI-Bench is built upon a multi-layered legal knowledge framework containing 7,261 legal articles and integrating codified statutes, legal commentaries, doctrinal writings, and Supreme Court unification rulings. We also construct a legal knowledge graph linking articles and concepts for structure-aware retrieval. Based on this foundation, TUSI-Bench provides two complementary evaluation tasks: (i) TUSI-QA, an open-ended question answering benchmark containing 1,999 questions that requires grounded responses with explicit legal citations, and (ii) TUSI-Bar, a multiple-choice benchmark containing approximately 500 four-option questions derived from Iranian Bar examination questions. Furthermore, we propose a graph-based retrieval baseline that leverages relational structure within the legal knowledge graph. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating graph-based relations improves retrieval recall by up to 8 percentage points compared to standard baselines, highlighting the importance of structured legal representations for RAG systems. The proposed benchmark provides a standardized resource for evaluating grounded legal reasoning in Persian and enables future research on structured legal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TUSI-Bench，一个面向波斯语法律 RAG 评测的结构化基准，包含 7,261 条法律条文的多层法律知识框架、法律知识图谱，以及两个互补评测任务（TUSI-QA 开放式问答 1,999 题、TUSI-Bar 选择题约 500 题），并提出基于图的检索基线。
AI.motivation: 波斯语法律 RAG 系统缺乏高质量评测基准：现有资源要么由法条合成、缺乏自然信息需求，要么来自非正式法律问答且未与权威法律文件显式关联，无法严谨评测需要事实依据与引用的法律推理。
AI.method: 构建多层法律知识框架（7,261 条条文，整合成文法典、法律评注、学说著作与最高法院统一裁判）；构建连接条文与概念的法律知识图谱以支持结构感知检索；据此设计 TUSI-QA（开放式问答，要求带明确法律引用的有据回答）与 TUSI-Bar（约 500 道四选一选择题，源自伊朗律师资格考试）；并提出利用图谱关系结构的图检索基线。
AI.result: 实验表明，引入图谱关系相较标准基线可将检索召回率提升最多 8 个百分点，说明结构化法律表示对 RAG 系统具有重要价值。
AI.conclusion: TUSI-Bench 为波斯语有据法律推理评测提供了标准化资源，并推动结构化法律智能方向的后续研究。

title: Does the Model Use What It Cites? Counterfactual Tests of Grounded Reasoning Chains in Small Video-Language Models
summary: A grounded reasoning chain cites a frame span and a box for every step, so a reader can check where the model looked. Whether the answer depends on the cited region is a different question. We test it by intervention: the regions a model cited in its own chain are blacked out, and the share of correct answers that flip is compared with blacking out boxes of the same size elsewhere on the same frames. The paired difference, the cite gap, needs no annotation. We apply it to 2-3B video-language models trained on exact CLEVRER chains and on pseudo-labelled NExT-QA chains. With the same weights, the cite gap is 0.089 on CLEVRER and 0.003 on NExT-QA. Pooled over models, masking the cited boxes flips 2.2 times as many correct answers as the control on CLEVRER and 1.1 times as many on NExT-QA, also among the answers that depend on the video at all, while the boxes pass a grounding check on both. Masking the cited entity on every frame, instead of the cited box, flips 1.9 times as many answers as its control. The NExT-QA chains were supervised to cite two frames of entities that stay visible on most frames, so this outcome is what the supervision predicts; the point is that the usual check on grounded chains cannot see it. A citation can be verifiable and relevant without the answer depending on it, and a test of grounded reasoning should remove what a chain names, not only where it points.

AI.tldr: 提出"引用差距(cite gap)"干预测试:遮挡模型自引区域 vs 遮挡同尺寸对照框,衡量答案是否真正依赖引用的视觉区域;发现可验证且相关的引用并不必然被答案依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有 grounded reasoning chain 只要求每步引用 frame span 和 box,读者可检查"模型看了哪里",但无法回答"答案是否依赖该区域"。常规 grounding 检查(框是否对准物体)无法揭示引用是否被真正使用。
AI.method: 干预实验:把模型自己链条中引用的区域涂黑,统计正确答案翻转比例,与同一帧上同尺寸随机对照框的翻转比例比较,取配对差值即 cite gap,无需人工标注。应用于 2-3B 视频语言模型,分别在精确 CLEVRER 链和伪标注 NExT-QA 链上训练;另做"遮挡整帧中被引用实体"的变体。
AI.result: 同权重下 cite gap 在 CLEVRER 为 0.089、NExT-QA 仅 0.003;合并模型后,遮挡引用框翻转的正确答案是控制的 2.2 倍(CLEVRER)与 1.1 倍(NExT-QA),在依赖视频的答案子集中同样成立,而框在两数据集上均通过 grounding 检查。遮挡每帧被引用实体则为对照的 1.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: NExT-QA 的结果正是其监督方式(引用的两个帧中实体在多数帧可见)所预测的:引用可验证、相关,却与答案无因果依赖,而常规 grounded chain 检查看不出来。评估 grounded reasoning 应移除链条"所指内容",而非仅检验"指向位置"。

title: A Model-Driven Automation Pipeline for Building Operation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 27th International Conference on Product-Focused Software Process Improvement (PROFES 2026)
summary: Building Control Systems (BCS) engineering in the Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations (AECO) domain remains a complex, manual, and error-prone process, with fractured tools and manual commissioning causing design and built reality to diverge into a performance gap. We argue that a fully integrated and automated, tool-supported workflow spanning design, programming, and operation is feasible and can improve efficiency while reducing manual effort and configuration errors. Building on model-driven engineering, we present an automated process pipeline for modeling, programming, and auto-commissioning BCS. It uses two domain-specific modeling languages with tooling support to synthesize and deploy executable artifacts from platform-independent models, replacing a fractured, multi-stakeholder handoff process with a defined four-step workflow and improving consistency across the engineering lifecycle. Our evaluation reports notable efficiency gains, improved adaptability, moderate-to-high user acceptance, and good performance with solid scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于模型驱动工程的自动化流水线，用两种领域特定建模语言实现楼控系统建模、编程与自动调试，替代碎片化手工流程，在效率、适应性与用户接受度上取得明显提升。
AI.motivation: AECO领域楼控系统工程复杂、依赖手工、工具碎片化，手动调试导致设计与实际建成之间出现性能差距，需要全流程集成自动化的工作流来减少人工投入与配置错误。
AI.method: 基于模型驱动工程，构建覆盖建模、编程与自动调试的自动化流程流水线；采用两种带工具支持的领域特定建模语言（DSML），从平台无关模型综合并部署可执行工件，并定义四步工作流取代多利益相关方之间的碎片化交接。
AI.result: 评估显示效率显著提升、适应性增强、用户接受度中到高，性能良好且可扩展性稳健。
AI.conclusion: 全集成、自动化且工具支持的工作流在楼控系统设计中可行，可提升效率、减少手工与配置错误，并改善整个工程生命周期的一致性。

title: Adaptive Memory for Online Reinforcement Learning under Sparse Model Changes
summary: We study the discounted reinforcement learning (RL) problem in a setting where the underlying environment changes between deployments. Each deployment provides $H$ observations from a fixed MDP. The reward function and transition kernel are fixed within each deployment. Across deployments, at most an $ε>0$ fraction of the reward and transition kernel entries may change. In this setting, learning each model to deploy from scratch may discard useful observations from past deployments, whereas pooling all past observations can bias the estimates of entries that have already changed. We then propose an algorithm that for each state and action pair, selects how much history to reuse to estimate the reward and probabilities of the next state. We start with observations from the current deployment and add earlier deployment observations one at a time, the most recent first. After each addition, we check whether a single average reward agrees with the estimates from all histories considered until that point. We apply the same check to the distribution of next states. For each estimate, we leverage the last history that passes these aforementioned checks. The optimal control policy is then computed on top of the fitted MDP. We characterize the average gap between the optimal return and the return of the learner's policies over a finite number of deployments. We demonstrate that when $0< |S|ε\leq 2$, with $|S|$ being the cardinality of the state space, our algorithm needs only the observations from the most recent $O(1/ε)$ deployments, and achieves a long-run average gap of at most $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{ε/H})$.

AI.tldr: 研究部署间环境变化（至多ε比例的奖励和转移条目变化）下的折扣强化学习，提出按需回溯历史的估计算法，仅用最近O(1/ε)次部署的数据即可达到Õ(√(ε/H))的长期平均次优差距。
AI.motivation: 实际部署中环境会在多次部署之间发生漂移：每次部署内MDP固定，但跨部署至多ε比例的奖励与转移条目会改变。此时从零学习会浪费历史观测，而全部池化又会因已变化条目的污染产生偏差，需要一个能权衡历史复用量的方法。
AI.method: 对每个状态-动作对，从当前部署的观测出发，按时间由近及远逐次加入更早部署的数据；每加入一次就检验"单一平均奖励"是否与迄今所有历史的一致（对下一状态分布做同样检验），为每个估计采用最后通过检验的那段历史；随后在拟合的MDP上求解最优控制策略。
AI.result: 刻画了有限次部署上最优回报与学习策略回报之间的平均差距。当0<|S|ε≤2时，算法只需最近O(1/ε)次部署的观测，长期平均差距至多为Õ(√(ε/H))。
AI.conclusion: 通过按条目自适应选择历史复用长度并做一致性检验，可在环境缓慢漂移时兼顾数据效率与估计无偏性，以极少的历史数据获得随H增长而收敛的次优差距界。

title: A Hybrid Exact-Heuristic Solver for the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation Problem
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Technical Report for the SOICT 2026 Student Contest
summary: We describe the solver we submitted to the second round of the SOICT 2026 contest on the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation problem, a selective pickup-and-delivery routing problem with time windows, open routes and heterogeneous taxis. The solver is a single-file, standard-library Python program that combines (i) a constant-time insertion test based on latest-arrival slack, (ii) greedy insertion, local search and an Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS) with simulated-annealing acceptance, and (iii) an exact route-selection engine that enumerates, for every taxi, the best feasible route for each request set and then solves the resulting set-packing problem by branch-and-bound strengthened with route-based large neighborhood search, Lagrangian bounds and reduced-cost fixing. The engine is chosen automatically from the instance size, and an independent verifier and a watchdog guarantee that a valid answer is always printed. On the official evaluation (38 scored instances, 5-minute limit) the solver obtained a total benefit of 487,237, finished every run within 277 s and used at most 279 MB; 28 of the 38 instances terminated well before the limit.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了提交至SOICT 2026第二届"一体化乘客与包裹运输"竞赛的求解器，它用标准库Python单文件实现，结合插入启发式、ALNS与精确路线选择分支定界，自动按规模选引擎，并在38个测试实例上取得总收益487,237、均在277秒内完成、内存≤279MB。
AI.motivation: 问题为带时间窗、开放路线和异构出租车的选择性取送货路由问题（IPPT），规模与约束复杂，需要同时兼顾求解质量与5分钟时间限制和内存限制，且必须保证总能输出可行解。
AI.method: 求解器为单文件标准库Python程序，包含三部分：(i) 基于最晚到达松弛的常数时间插入检验；(ii) 贪心插入、局部搜索以及带模拟退火接受准则的自适应大邻域搜索（ALNS）；(iii) 精确路线选择引擎——对每辆出租车枚举每个请求集的最优可行路线，再用带路线大邻域搜索、拉格朗日界与降成本固定的分支定界求解集合划分问题。引擎依据实例规模自动选择，并配独立校验器与看门狗确保始终输出有效答案。
AI.result: 在官方评测（38个计分实例、5分钟时限）上，总收益达487,237，所有运行均在277秒内结束，内存峰值不超过279MB；38个实例中有28个远早于时限终止。
AI.conclusion: 该求解器以轻量实现（纯标准库、单文件）在严格时限内取得高收益且稳健完成全部实例，多数实例提前收敛，验证了启发式与精确方法混合、按规模自动切换引擎的设计有效性。

title: Knowing Which, Not How Much: Language Models Order Party Positions They Cannot Place
comment: Accepted at the 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation (PACLIC 40)
summary: Language models are increasingly asked where real actors stand: what a party's platform prioritises, what an institution has committed to. Such judgments are gradable, carrying both an order and a magnitude. Nearly every benchmark that tests them asks about one entity at a time, then reads that score as the model's knowledge of the domain. Order and magnitude, however, need not be acquired together. Text about social entities carries far more comparison than measurement, so a model may hold a dependable ordering with no anchored scale beneath it. We ask whether a model can place a documented social position on a scale or only order the actors it compares, and what that means for how such knowledge is measured. We test this on party positions in Japan and South Korea, where the Comparative Manifesto Project's coded data supplies a rare external answer key. Asked to order four parties, models beat the strongest fixed-answer baseline by more than a factor of two; asked to place one party on the same scale, they fall below it. The ordering survives inside those failed placements, and supplying the coded values lifts placement to near ceiling. Comparative and absolute questions about the same fact therefore measure different things here, and for party issue salience a benchmark built from one cannot speak for the other.

AI.tldr: 模型对政党议题显著性的"排序"能力可靠，但"绝对定位"能力失效；两者是分离的知识，比较型与绝对型基准不能互相替代。
AI.motivation: 现有基准几乎都逐实体打分，并把该分数当作模型对该领域知识的度量。但社会实体的文本中比较远多于测量，模型可能拥有可靠的相对排序却没有锚定的绝对尺度，因此需要区分"排序"与"定位"两种能力。
AI.method: 以日本、韩国政党位置为测试对象，用Comparative Manifesto Project的人工编码数据作为外部答案键。设置两类任务：对四个政党排序；将单个政党在同一尺度上定位。并与最强的固定答案基线比较，另测试提供编码数值后的定位表现。
AI.result: 四党排序任务中模型表现超过最强固定基线两倍以上；单党定位任务中却低于该基线。失败的单点定位内部仍保留正确的排序，且给定编码数值后定位接近上限。
AI.conclusion: 关于同一事实的比较性问题与绝对性问题在此测的是不同东西。对政党议题显著性而言，仅基于一类问题构造的基准无法代表另一类能力。

title: RICoT: Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought for Page Stream Segmentation
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 19 tables. Dataset and code to be released
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have renewed interest in Page Stream Segmentation (PSS), splitting a multi-page file into its constituent documents. Yet published LLM methods still frame the task as boundary classification over one or a few neighboring pages, and commercial document-splitting APIs do not disclose their methods. We reimagine PSS for LLMs as a sequential process over the whole stream and propose RICoT (Recurrent Interleaved Chain-of-Thought), a prompting framework that works through the pages as a reader would: within a sliding window it reasons about each page and commits its boundary decision before moving on, and across windows it carries forward a compact record of what it has read, keeping per-call cost bounded. We also introduce FinancePSS-205, a benchmark of 205 real-world, de-identified financial page streams, to be released publicly. On FinancePSS-205, RICoT matches or outperforms pairwise and windowed prompting with the same backbone for each of three open-weight LLMs; on a TABME test subset, RICoT with GLM-5 reaches document F1 0.847 and boundary F1 0.915, above published zero-shot results. A 2B-parameter student, trained on a larger teacher's decisions with and without the page-level reasoning, performs comparably in both modes and comes within 0.05 document F1 of the strongest prompted model on FinancePSS-205.

AI.tldr: 论文将页面流分割(PSS)重构为对整条文档流的顺序阅读过程，提出RICoT提示框架，并发布FinancePSS-205基准，在多模型上匹配或超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM方法仍将PSS视为对单页或相邻少数页的边界分类，商业API又不公开方法，缺乏对整条流的建模与公开基准。
AI.method: RICoT：在滑动窗口内逐页推理并先做边界决策再前进，跨窗口携带紧凑的已读记录以限制单次调用成本；同时构建205条真实脱敏财务页面流基准FinancePSS-205，并训练2B学生模型蒸馏更大教师模型的决策（含/不含页面级推理）。
AI.result: FinancePSS-205上，RICoT对三种开源骨干模型均匹配或超越pairwise与窗口化提示；TABME子集上GLM-5达文档F1 0.847、边界F1 0.915，超过已发表零样本结果；2B学生在两种模式下表现相当，与最强提示模型文档F1相差0.05以内。
AI.conclusion: 将PSS作为顺序流式过程处理对LLM更有效，且可被蒸馏至小模型，配套公开基准推动该任务研究。

title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Wheelchair Configuration Classification in Accessible Automated Vehicle Applications
summary: Making automated vehicles accessible requires consideration of vulnerable road users, including wheelchair users. To offer a more tailored experience that supports independence for this group, vehicle design needs to accommodate the wide range of wheelchair configurations. However, wheelchairs are individualized, varying in frame geometry, propulsion, and visual appearance. Moreover, occupants or accessories may obscure visual cues. Existing mobility-aid datasets only label the presence of a wheelchair, rather than describing its specific configuration. To fill this gap, this paper introduces the Wheelchair Configuration Image Dataset (WCID), comprising 467 face-blurred images across 192 capture groups solely for evaluation. Each image is annotated with (i) a two-class label of manual or powered, (ii) a chair subtype, (iii) occupancy, viewpoint, setting, lighting, occlusion, propulsion, and control, with a 273-image validation split and 194-image test split. Three convolutional neural network backbones and a frozen vision-language probe are trained on an external image dataset and evaluated on WCID to measure cross-dataset generalization, while also testing robustness using Gaussian blur. Convolutional models do well on clean images, but performance drops under strong blur, leaving a gap before deployment. Code, split assignments, labels, trained weights, and the face-blurred images is available at: https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/MAID

AI.tldr: 本文提出轮椅配置图像数据集WCID（467张人脸模糊图像，192个采集组），并标注手动/电动、子类型、乘员、视角等多维属性，用于评测模型对轮椅配置的跨数据集泛化与模糊鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需服务包括轮椅使用者在内的弱势道路使用者；但轮椅高度个性化（框架几何、驱动方式、外观各异），且常被乘员或配件遮挡。现有出行辅助数据集只标注"是否存在轮椅"，不描述具体配置，无法支持车辆定制化设计。
AI.method: 构建WCID数据集：467张人脸模糊图像、192个采集组，仅用于评测；每张图标注二元类别（手动/电动）、椅子子类型、乘员、视角、场景、光照、遮挡、驱动与控制方式；划分为273张验证集和194张测试集。用三个CNN骨干网络和一个冻结的视觉-语言探针在外部图像数据集上训练，在WCID上评测跨数据集泛化，并用高斯模糊测试鲁棒性。
AI.result: 卷积模型在清晰图像上表现良好，但在强模糊下性能明显下降，距离实际部署仍有差距。
AI.conclusion: WCID填补了轮椅配置级标注数据集的空白，为跨数据集泛化和鲁棒性评估提供基准；代码、划分、标签、权重及人脸模糊图像已公开，但模糊条件下的性能仍需改进。

title: Fragmented Markers, Mixed Results: A Systematic Review of AI Coding Assistants and Developer Productivity
comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26)
summary:
AI coding assistants are increasingly embedded in software engineering practice, yet the literature still offers no cumulative, easily interpretable picture of their effects on software developer productivity. The central problem is not a lack of studies, but a lack of comparability: prior work operationalizes productivity through heterogeneous markers, settings, and reporting styles, making cross-study conclusions difficult. To address this, we conduct a staged systematic literature review. In the first stage, we synthesize studies that explicitly examine developer productivity. In the second, we extend the scope to productivity-related developer outcomes using SPACE as a theory-informed lens, capturing human-centered evidence that explicit productivity studies often omit. Across both stages, we analyze how productivity is operationalized, which confounding factors are discussed, and how reported effects are distributed.
  We identify 187 unique productivity and productivity-related markers, while individual studies typically only use five, revealing a broad but highly fragmented evidence base. Explicit productivity research is dominated by time-, output-, and artifact-oriented proxies, whereas the broader SPACE-aligned corpus makes satisfaction, psychological aspects, and well-being substantially more visible. Reported effects are often positive, but this pattern is stronger in perceived and tendency-based findings than in objective or statistically evaluated ones. Overall, the literature suggests that AI coding assistants can support productivity, but current evidence does not yet support simple, context-independent conclusions. The key contribution of this review is therefore a structured basis for making productivity evidence more interpretable, multidimensional, and comparable across studies.

AI.tldr: 该文通过分阶段系统文献综述，梳理AI编程助手对开发者生产力影响的证据。共识别187种生产力及相关标记，但单项研究平均仅用5种，证据高度碎片化；显式生产力研究偏重时间、产出等客观代理，SPACE扩展视角则更多呈现满意度与幸福感。报告效应多为正面，但在主观/倾向性发现中更明显，客观或经统计评估的结论则较弱。作者认为现有证据尚不足以支持简单、脱离上下文的结论。
AI.motivation: AI编程助手已广泛嵌入软件工程实践，但文献中缺乏可累积、易解释的关于其对开发者生产力影响的整体图景。核心问题不在于研究数量不足，而在于可比性缺失：既有研究在生产力操作化方式、实验情境和报告风格上高度异质，导致难以形成跨研究结论。
AI.method: 采用分阶段系统文献综述。第一阶段综合明确考察开发者生产力的研究；第二阶段以SPACE框架为理论视角，扩展到与生产力相关的开发者结果，以捕捉显式生产力研究常遗漏的以人为本证据。两阶段均分析生产力如何被操作化、讨论了哪些混杂因素、以及报告效应的分布情况。
AI.result: 识别出187种独立的生产力及生产力相关标记，而单项研究通常仅使用5种，说明证据基础广泛但高度碎片化。显式生产力研究以时间、产出和制品类代理指标为主；而在更广的SPACE对齐语料中，满意度、心理层面和幸福感显著更突出。报告效应多为正向，但这一模式在感知类和倾向性发现中更强，在客观或经过统计评估的发现中较弱。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，文献表明AI编程助手能够支持生产力，但当前证据尚不足以支撑简单、与情境无关的结论。本综述的关键贡献在于为生产力证据提供结构化基础，使其更具可解释性、多维性和跨研究可比性。

title: Cancellation-Free Constrained SquareCB for Safe Controller Selection
summary: We study constrained contextual bandits, in which a learner chooses one of $K$ actions in each round to minimize loss while keeping the expected cost of its play below a budget. Existing reductions to online regression weight the cost by a Lagrange multiplier learned from past constraint residuals, so slack in some rounds can offset violations in others. We instead run SquareCB proposed in \citep{foster2020beyond} with a rectified weight on the cost: it is zero when the estimated cost is within the budget, and otherwise just large enough to bring it back to the budget. Under realizability and Slater's condition with margin $δ$, the algorithm attains regret $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/δ)$ and cancellation-free violation $\sum_t(V_c^{p_t}-b)^+=O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$, where $\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}$ is the error of the regression oracle. The same bounds hold when the budget must be met in every context, potentially adversarially chosen contexts. In controller selection for a safe-control-gym quadrotor and a BOPTEST building, the violation is 6 to 9 times lower than that of primal-dual and virtual-queue baselines, with a lower or comparable regret.

AI.tldr: 提出用带整流权重(rectified weight)的SquareCB求解约束情境bandit，在Slater条件下同时实现低 regret 与无抵消(cancellation-free)的逐轮违反量界，并在四旋翼与建筑控制任务中显著优于原对偶/虚拟队列基线。
AI.motivation: 现有将约束bandit归约为在线回归的方法用拉格朗日乘子对cost加权，乘子由历史约束残差学习，导致某些轮的松弛(slack)会抵消其他轮的违反(violation)，从而只保证平均约束，无法控制逐轮或逐情境的违反量。
AI.method: 以SquareCB(基于在线回归oracle的上下置信界式算法)为基础，对cost使用整流权重：当估计cost未超预算时权重为0，超预算时取恰好足以把它拉回预算的大小(而非全局学习的乘子)。分析基于可实现性(realizability)与Slater条件(margin δ)。
AI.result: regret 为 O(√(KT·Reg_Sq(T))/δ)，无抵消违反满足 Σ_t(V_c^{p_t}−b)^+ = O(√(KT·Reg_Sq(T)))。同样的界在"每个情境都必须满足预算"且情境可对抗选择时仍成立。在safe-control-gym四旋翼控制器选择与BOPTEST建筑控制中，违反量比原对偶与虚拟队列基线低6–9倍，regret 更低或相当。
AI.conclusion: 整流权重的具体实例化(SquareCB + 逐轮重新归一化权重)可避免slack与violation的相互抵消，在保留最优量级regret的同时给出更强的逐轮约束保证，并在真实控制任务上取得显著更低的违反量。

title: MedGuardBench: A Patient-Oriented Benchmark for Personalized Guardrail Development
summary: Safety is personal: the same action can be safe for one person but unsafe for another. Yet current guardrails judge content without considering who is affected. Using medication safety, we introduce \textit{patient-conditioned medication guarding}, which predicts a safety verdict and 17 risk categories from a patient profile and prescription. We release \textbf{MedGuardBench}, a drug-disjoint benchmark of 5{,}001 scenarios across 87 medications. We find that standard guardrails rely on surface cues, such as wording and profile presence, rather than patient facts. To address this, we develop \textit{personalized reasoning guardrails} with three components. \textbf{Personalized Reasoning Distillation} links risks to relevant patient fields. \textbf{Context Unrolling (CU)} makes models check each field themselves, reducing false alarms on most backbones; controls show that providing the check does not yield the same benefit. A \textbf{rule-based reward (guided GRPO)} improves unsafe recall and complex-risk detection, including allergies and adverse reactions, on some backbones, but increases false alarms on others. Our models outperform base models and matched no-profile controls in accuracy, while reducing false alarms relative to no-profile controls. Profile removal and swapping confirm that gains come from patient information, not fine-tuning alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"患者条件化的用药安全护栏"任务并发布MedGuardBench基准（5001个场景、87种药物、药物不重叠），揭示现有护栏依赖表面线索而非患者事实，并开发个性化推理护栏（个性化推理蒸馏+上下文展开+规则奖励引导GRPO）以提升准确率并减少误报。
AI.motivation: 安全性是因人而异的：同一行为对一人安全对另一人可能不安全，但现有护栏在不考虑受影响者的情况下判断内容。论文以用药安全为切入，指出标准护栏依赖措辞、是否提供档案等表面线索，而非患者事实。
AI.method: 构建MedGuardBench药物不重叠基准（5001场景/87种药物，从患者档案+处方预测安全结论及17类风险）；提出个性化推理护栏三组件：个性化推理蒸馏（将风险链接到相关患者字段）、上下文展开CU（让模型自行逐字段核查）、规则奖励引导GRPO（提升不安全召回与复杂风险检测）。并设置无档案对照、档案移除与交换实验。
AI.result: 标准护栏依赖表面线索；CU在多数骨干模型上降低误报，且对照实验表明仅"提供核查"并不能带来同等收益；规则奖励在部分骨干上提升不安全召回与复杂风险（过敏、不良反应）检测，但在另一些骨干上增加误报。整体模型在准确率上优于基础模型与匹配的无档案对照，并相对无档案对照降低误报。
AI.conclusion: 档案移除与交换实验证实性能提升来自患者信息而非单纯微调。个性化推理护栏能有效利用患者事实，但规则奖励的效果依赖骨干模型，存在误报权衡。

title: Call-Efficient ICD-10 Code Prediction via Supervised Candidate Generation and Selective LLM Invocation
summary: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. The task is difficult because diagnosis phrases are short and noisy, the ICD-10 label space is hierarchical, and the class distribution is strongly imbalanced. This paper presents a call-efficient ICD-10 code prediction pipeline that combines transformer embeddings, tree-based supervised candidate generation, candidate-level reranking, and a gated LLM assistance. The evaluation uses a leakage-safe validation protocol: model and threshold selection are based on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions, while final reporting is performed on a locked test set with no shared source-file groups. The supervised conditional parent-code candidate generator reaches 74.32% Top-1 accuracy on the locked test set and 93.05% Top-10 candidate coverage. A direct zero-shot GPT-5.6-Sol baseline reaches 81.01% Top-1 accuracy, but requires an invocation of this large model for every diagnosis. The final deployable system, Pre-LLM fusion, reaches 81.24% OOF-CV accuracy and 83.19% locked-test accuracy while calling the LLM for only 31.97% of cases. This improves the locked-test error rate from 25.68% for the supervised parent-code baseline to 16.81%, corresponding to a 34.5% relative error reduction. The results show that the most effective role of the LLM is controlled reranking on uncertain examples rather than unrestricted coding or full-dataset invocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种调用高效的ICD-10编码预测流水线，结合Transformer嵌入、树模型候选生成、候选级重排与门控LLM辅助；仅在31.97%病例上调用LLM即达到83.19%锁定测试Top-1准确率，相比监督基线错误率降低34.5%。
AI.motivation: 从简短临床诊断文本自动分配ICD-10码是实用的医学文本分类归一化任务，但诊断短语短且噪声大、标签空间具层级结构、类别分布严重不平衡，导致任务困难；同时直接对每条诊断调用大模型成本过高，需要兼顾效果与调用效率。
AI.method: 构建流水线：Transformer嵌入 + 基于树模型的监督式候选生成（父码条件候选生成器）+ 候选级重排 + 门控式LLM辅助（仅对不确定样本调用LLM）。评估采用防泄漏协议：基于折外交叉验证（OOF-CV）预测做模型与阈值选择，最终在无共享源文件分组的锁定测试集上报告结果。
AI.result: 监督父码候选生成器在锁定测试集上Top-1为74.32%、Top-10候选覆盖93.05%；零样本GPT-5.6-Sol直接基线Top-1为81.01%但需对每条诊断调用大模型；最终系统"Pre-LLM融合"达OOF-CV 81.24%、锁定测试83.19%，仅31.97%病例调用LLM，锁定测试错误率由25.68%降至16.81%，相对降低34.5%。
AI.conclusion: LLM最有效的角色是对不确定样本进行受控重排，而非无限制编码或全量调用；在保证效果领先直接大模型基线的同时显著降低调用成本。

title: When the tail is earned by its companions: measuring label dependence in long-tailed multi-label classification
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Information Sciences
summary: A rare label seldom occurs alone, and a classifier can recover it from the frequent labels it co-occurs with, its companions, without having learned the label itself. Existing diagnostics of this need a trained model: none says before training whether a corpus admits the failure, or what the standard aggregate hides. Macro-F1, like any measure built from per-label confusion counts, is unchanged by how a label's recall divides between occurrences with and without a companion. We introduce a within-label estimand of that division, a reading rule under which a fall in dependence counts only if companion-free recall rises, and a statistic of training labels that bounds, before training, how far reported recall can exceed companion-free recall. Across 23 corpora, 7 training objectives and five families of label-correlation mechanisms, companion-free recall falls short on all six corpora where the estimand is defined. Up to 18.4% of the tail true positives macro-F1 credits would vanish at the companion-free rate, within the training-label bound on every corpus. No long-tail objective reduces the dependence, but architecture moves it. Models whose tail score is computed from other labels' predictions are strongly dependent.

AI.tldr: 论文指出稀有标签常与伴生标签共现，模型可靠共现而"搭便车"恢复稀有标签，而现有诊断需先训练模型。作者提出训练前即可计算的估计量、判读规则与统计量上界，并在23个语料上证明该依赖普遍存在且不受长尾目标函数影响。
AI.motivation: 现有对"标签共现依赖"的诊断都依赖已训练模型，无法在训练前判断语料是否存在该失效，也无法说明Macro-F1等聚合指标掩盖了什么——因为Macro-F1对某标签召回在"有伴生/无伴生"间的分配方式不敏感。
AI.method: 提出：(1) 标签内估计量，刻画召回在有伴生与无伴生样本间的划分；(2) 判读规则：仅当无伴生召回上升时，依赖下降才算数；(3) 仅用训练标签计算的统计量，在训练前给出报告召回可超出无伴生召回的界限。
AI.result: 在23个语料、7种训练目标、5类标签相关机制上，6个定义该估计量的语料中无伴生召回全部偏低；最多18.4%的尾部真阳性在无伴生率下会消失，且均落在训练标签界内。长尾目标不改依赖，架构会改变依赖；尾部评分由其他标签预测计算的模型依赖最强。
AI.conclusion: 标签共现依赖会抬高Macro-F1并掩盖无伴生场景下的真实能力；该问题可训练前量化且普遍存在，优化目标难以缓解，而模型架构是关键影响因素。

title: SCAN: Site-Aware Collaborative Privacy-Preserving Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Neurological Disease Classification
summary: Worldwide neuroimaging data could strengthen diagnostic foundation models, but privacy rules often prevent centralizing brain MRI scans. We present SCAN, a site-aware collaborative adaptation framework for Neurological Disease Classification that lets new sites adapt a 3D medical vision-language model (VLM) without retraining or sharing patient scans. Each site keeps exact class prototypes for local prediction and can share privacy-protected class summaries: norm-bounded sums and counts perturbed once with calibrated noise. Using 7,641 scans from 67 sites across 12 countries, covering Alzheimer's disease (AD), stroke, epilepsy and controls, we assess local adaptation, cross-site benefits, and effects on existing sites. At seven unseen sites, the frozen VLM's zero-shot AUCs were 0.833-0.945 for AD and stroke. Training-free local prototypes improved epilepsy AUC at three sites from 0.598/0.625/0.508 to 0.684/0.729/0.762 and AD AUC at one site from 0.833 to 0.863, nearly matching a classifier trained at each site (mean AUC 0.757 vs. 0.759). With differential privacy ($ε$ = 4), new sites contributed without materially reducing accuracy at existing sites (AUC change $\leq$0.2%), although gains from sharing were limited, and membership attacks performed near chance. SCAN offers hospitals a worldwide framework to adapt and share brain MRI VLMs without exchanging scans or retraining.

AI.tldr: SCAN：一种站点点感知的协作自适应框架，让新站点无需重训或共享脑部MRI即可适配3D医学视觉-语言模型，通过差分隐私类摘要实现跨站点协作。
AI.motivation: 全球神经影像数据可强化诊断基础模型，但隐私法规阻碍脑MRI扫描的中心化汇聚。
AI.method: 各站点保留精确类别原型做本地预测，并共享经校准噪声一次扰动的隐私保护类别摘要（范数有界的和与计数）；新站点可据此适配冻结的3D医学VLM，无需重训或交换扫描。
AI.result: 基于12国67站点7,641例扫描（AD、卒中、癫痫与对照）：冻结VLM在7个未见站点零样本AD/卒中AUC达0.833-0.945；无训练本地原型将3站点癫痫AUC从0.598/0.625/0.508提升至0.684/0.729/0.762，一处AD从0.833升至0.863，接近站点本地训练分类器（平均AUC 0.757 vs 0.759）；ε=4差分隐私下，新站点贡献不显著降低既有站点精度（AUC变化≤0.2%），但共享增益有限，成员推断攻击接近随机。
AI.conclusion: SCAN为医院提供无需交换扫描或重训即可适配与共享脑MRI VLM的全球框架，隐私保护有效但跨站点共享收益仍有限。

title: Measuring Human-AI Alignment as an Early Indicator for Effective Collaboration in Hybrid SE Teams
comment: Accepted at 1st International Workshop on LiveWriting @ ASE 2026
summary: As AI agents increasingly integrate into software engineering (SE) processes, ensuring effective collaboration in these hybrid teams becomes a critical challenge. While existing metrics focus on observing dynamic run-time performance, there is a lack of systematic, static measurements for early human-AI alignment -- the degree to which an AI's actions and granularity map to human expectations. This position paper proposes a research agenda to develop an SE-specific alignment metric suite drawing principles from software architecture, organizational psychology, and human-computer interaction. Furthermore, it outlines a validation methodology using concepts and techniques from business process monitoring (BPM) and introduces static assessment tools leveraging declarative BPM languages to ensure agents adhere to specific project constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张为软件工程（SE）混合团队中的AI智能体建立一套静态的、SE专属的人机对齐度量体系，以弥补现有仅关注运行时动态性能指标的不足，并提出基于业务流程监控（BPM）与声明式BPM语言的验证方法与静态评估工具。
AI.motivation: AI智能体正日益融入软件工程流程，人机混合团队的协作有效性成为关键挑战。现有度量主要观察动态运行时表现，缺乏系统化的静态度量手段来在早期评估"人对齐"——即AI动作及其粒度与人类期望的匹配程度。
AI.method: 提出研究议程：借鉴软件架构、组织心理学与人机交互的原理，构建SE专用对齐度量套件；并给出使用业务流程监控（BPM）概念与技术的验证方法论，同时引入基于声明式BPM语言的静态评估工具，以确保智能体遵守特定项目约束。
AI.result: 属于立场论文，未提供实证结果；成果为研究议程、度量套件设计原则、验证方法论框架以及静态评估工具的思路。
AI.conclusion: 应在SE语境下建立系统化的静态人机对齐度量与验证机制，借助跨学科原理与BPM技术，在早期保障AI智能体行为与人类期望的一致性并满足项目约束。

title: WM-Quant: Rollout-Aware Post-Training Quantization for JEPA-Style World Models
summary: We present WM-Quant, to our knowledge, the first post-training quantization (PTQ) framework designed specifically for JEPA-style world models. Although world models typically feature relatively few parameters, action planning algorithms often require thousands of inferences, which can quickly become computationally expensive. PTQ is a natural way to reduce this cost. However, we show that in world models using autoregressive model predictive control (MPC) rollouts, quantization error can compound with each predictor step, resulting in action rankings from the quantized model becoming near-random. WM-Quant addresses this with three components that build on existing PTQ methods: early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling. Early-encoder precision protects accurate latent state and goal information to mitigate long-term error propagation. Control-path preservation allows the world model predictor to distinguish between fine-grained actions, significantly improving action rankings and execution. Rollout-aware scaling jointly calibrates encoder and per-step predictor activation ranges with respect to an entire rollout rather than a single prediction, reducing the cumulative rollout error. Across multiple world models, environments, and PTQ methods, WM-Quant substantially improves planning success at low bit-widths, approaching full-precision performance at W4A4.

AI.tldr: WM-Quant 是首个专为 JEPA 风格世界模型设计的训练后量化（PTQ）框架，通过早编码器精度、控制路径保留和 rollout 感知缩放三项技术，抑制自回归 MPC 中的量化误差累积，在 W4A4 下接近全精度规划性能。
AI.motivation: 世界模型参数量虽少，但动作规划需上千次推理，计算开销大；PTQ 是自然的降本手段。然而在自回归模型预测控制（MPC）rollout 中，量化误差会随预测步逐步累积，使量化模型给出的动作排序近乎随机，现有 PTQ 方法无法直接适用。
AI.method: 在现有 PTQ 基础上提出三个组件：(1) 早编码器精度——保护精确的潜状态与目标信息，缓解长期误差传播；(2) 控制路径保留——使预测器能区分细粒度动作，改善动作排序与执行；(3) rollout 感知缩放——以整段 rollout 而非单步预测联合校准编码器与逐步预测器的激活范围，降低累积误差。
AI.result: 在多个世界模型、环境与 PTQ 方法上，WM-Quant 在低比特下显著提升规划成功率，W4A4 时接近全精度性能。
AI.conclusion: 针对世界模型 rollout 中量化误差累积问题，面向 rollout 的 PTQ 设计能有效保持动作排序质量，实现低比特下的高效规划。

title: Can You Undo It? Reversibility Classes for AI Agent Actions
summary: Tool-using AI agents change files, databases, access rights and public information, yet permission to call a tool does not establish whether a mistake can be undone. We present Reversibility Classes, a declared five-level vocabulary with argument-sensitive rules, conservative defaults and an explicit prior-state capture contract. The pinned implementation and evidence-linked registry cover 536 tools across 20 MCP servers. All 738 rule-case checks conform to declared expectations, while native annotation mapping differs from draft registry labels for 118 of 481 comparable tools. One AI-assisted reviewer approves 148 ratings, 75 matching the registry; this is not independent agreement. On 2,158 recorded runs, the implemented session guard gates the associated action in all 29 attributable attack-positive runs, compared with 18 for a read/write proxy, while adding nine approval points across 1,209 benign runs. Controlled file, Git, SQLite and three-browser experiments show that recovery depends on captured state, later changes, editor storage and recovery route, and expose a Git merge-state exception. The evidence supports making recovery assumptions explicit and testable. It does not establish registry-wide accuracy, reduced production harm or general recovery reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出"可逆性等级"（Reversibility Classes）五级声明式词汇，用于刻画 AI 工具调用的可撤销性。
AI.motivation: 能调用工具不等于出错后能撤销；现有权限/读写分类无法表达"错误是否可以回滚"。
AI.method: 定义五级词汇、参数敏感规则、保守默认与显式前状态捕获契约；构建覆盖 20 个 MCP 服务器、536 个工具的注册表与实现；进行 738 条规则用例校验、481 个可比工具的标注对照、单名 AI 辅助评审，以及 2,158 次运行中的会话守卫评估和文件/Git/SQLite/三浏览器受控实验。
AI.result: 738 条规则用例全部符合预期；原生标注与注册表标签在 118/481 个工具上不一致；AI 辅助评审员批准 148 个评级，其中 75 个与注册表一致（非独立一致性）；29 个可归因攻击阳性运行中会话守卫全部拦截（读写代理为 18 个），同时在 1,209 个良性运行中额外引入 9 个审批点；实验显示恢复效果依赖状态捕获、后续变更、编辑器存储与恢复路径，并暴露 Git 合并态例外。
AI.conclusion: 支持把恢复假设显式化、可测试化；但未证明注册表整体准确性、生产环境伤害降低或通用恢复可靠性。

title: Latent Fact Composition under Next-Token Training
summary: Controlled studies of latent two-hop reasoning train transformers to predict only the answer, whereas language models are trained to predict every token. We ask whether a model trained on every token learns to answer two-hop questions whose intermediate entity appears in no two-hop training example. We build a synthetic corpus with such questions. On this corpus every term of the loss can be computed exactly. A looped transformer, a standard transformer and DiscoLoop answer almost none of these questions. We therefore introduce the Baton family of looped transformers. They pass the intermediate entity to the second loop as a token embedding. When trained to predict only the answer, two of its three variants answer these questions almost perfectly. We then relate the success and failure of each model to three design conditions. Experiments that change one condition at a time agree with this hypothesis. When Baton is trained on every token, however, its accuracy on these questions rises and then declines. We further split the gradient of the next-token loss into three terms. Removing the two terms that depend on the particular training set raises the peak accuracy but does not remove the decline. The decline arises in the second hop while the model still recalls both facts.

AI.tldr: 通过构建可精确计算损失项的合成语料，研究语言模型能否在两跳问题中泛化到训练时未出现的中间实体；提出以token embedding传递中间实体的Baton循环Transformer，并发现预测全token训练会导致第二跳性能先升后降。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在两跳推理的受控研究只训练模型预测答案，而真实语言模型预测每个token。作者想知道：按全token训练的模型，能否回答中间实体从未在两跳训练样本中出现的两跳问题。
AI.method: 构建合成语料，使loss每一项可精确计算；对比looped transformer、标准transformer和DiscoLoop；提出Baton系列循环Transformer，把中间实体作为token embedding传入第二次循环；仅预测答案时三个变体中两个几乎完美；并将各模型成败归因于三个设计条件，进行单变量控制实验；进一步把下一token损失的梯度拆成三项并消融其中两项。
AI.result: loop、标准transformer和DiscoLoop几乎完全无法回答该类问题；Baton两变体在仅预测答案时近乎完美，单条件改动实验与三条件假设一致。全token训练时Baton准确率上升后下降；去除依赖具体训练集的两项梯度后峰值提高但下降仍在；下降发生在第二跳，且模型仍记得两个事实。
AI.conclusion: 中间实体的显式传递机制（Baton）对两跳组合泛化至关重要；但全token的下一token训练会带来第二跳的退化，这种退化不能仅由训练集依赖的梯度项解释，说明逐token预测目标本身对潜在多跳推理有结构性副作用。

title: How Many Persistent Features Does a Biometric Need? A Law Linking Equal Error Rate to Feature Count and Persistence
summary: A biometric designer controls the number of features and their temporal persistence. Earlier empirical work linked the equal error rate (EER) to persistence and to the required number of features by straight lines. We derive the law behind these regularities. For $N$ independent standardized Gaussian features with test-retest correlation $ρ$, scored by cosine similarity, Fisher's $z$-transform turns the genuine and impostor scores into two normals, giving $\mathrm{EER}=Φ(-\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{N}\,\operatorname{atanh}ρ)$ and, inversely, $N=(2q/\operatorname{atanh}ρ)^2$ with $q=Φ^{-1}(1-\mathrm{EER})$; intercorrelated features enter through an effective count $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$. The central extension lets persistence vary across comparisons with spread $τ$ on Fisher's scale: $\mathrm{EER}=Φ(-m/(\sqrt{τ^2+v}+\sqrt{v}))$ with $v=1/(N_{\mathrm{eff}}-2)$, which for a normal spread has a floor $Φ(-m/τ)$ that no number of features can lower. With no fitted parameter the simple law reproduces published simulations and the EER-ICC line, and predicts the KCC-EER relation of eye-movement embeddings on GazeBase ($R^2=0.88$), though less well on GazeBaseVR ($0.63$). Read from the genuine and impostor scores, the general form matches the EER of eye movements, keystroke dynamics, the ECG and face embeddings over 101 conditions with $R^2=0.98$ and a median error of $0.6$ points, against $0.87$ and $1.9$ points for the simple law. The 61 eye-movement, keystroke and ECG conditions check consistency on the same scores; the 40 face conditions use held-out subjects, with the same accuracy. The product $τ\sqrt{N_{\mathrm{eff}}-2}$ gives a design rule: adding or decorrelating features pays fully while it is well below one and little once it exceeds about three, where only higher or more uniform persistence helps.

AI.tldr: 本文推导出生物特征EER与特征数、时间持续性之间的解析定律，并给出无参数可预测EER的通用公式及设计规则。
AI.motivation: 以往经验研究发现EER与持续性、所需特征数呈线性关系，但缺乏理论解释，本文旨在推导其背后的规律。
AI.method: 对N个独立标准化高斯特征（测试-重测相关ρ），用余弦相似度打分，借助Fisher z变换将真伪分数转为正态分布；用有效特征数Neff处理互相关特征；扩展到持续性随比较变化（Fisher尺度扩散τ），得到EER=Φ(-m/(√(τ²+v)+√v))并给出下限。
AI.result: 无拟合参数下复现已发表模拟和EER-ICC线，预测GazeBase的KCC-EER关系R²=0.88（GazeBaseVR 0.63）；通用式在101个条件下R²=0.98、中位误差0.6点，优于简单律的0.87和1.9点；面部条件用留出受试者同样准确。
AI.conclusion: 乘积τ√(Neff-2)构成设计规则：当其远低于1时增加或去相关特征收益充分，超过约3后收益很小，此时仅能靠更高或更均匀的持续性改善。

title: Trusting Trust in AI Software Engineering Agents: The Why, What, and How?
summary: AI software engineering agents are increasingly integrated into development workflows, from autocomplete assistants to autonomous repair agents and multi-agent software development pipelines. Trust matters because these agents can produce, revise, and pass on artifacts that developers, other agents, or organisations may later rely on under uncertainty and risk. Yet trust in such systems is often treated as a single measurable property of an AI system. This is insufficient for software engineering, where trust depends on who relies on the agent, how that reliance is structured, and which properties must hold in that deployment. We propose a structural framework for reasoning about trust in AI software engineering agents. Inspired by the recursive nature of trust in software systems, we decompose trust into three analytical questions: Why trust?, identifying the trust scenario; What trust?, identifying the trust configuration; and How much trust?, identifying the trust properties. From these questions, we derive three scenarios, four configurations, and five trust-relevant properties, state which of these are closed by construction and which remain open to revision, and instantiate the resulting profile on a ChatDev-style multi-agent workflow. The framework is conceptual, and is offered as a foundation for the empirical work that would validate it, rather than as a numerical trust metric.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个分析AI软件工程代理信任的结构化框架，将信任分解为"为何信任、信任什么、信任多少"三个问题，并据此导出三种场景、四种配置与五项信任属性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作把对AI代理的信任当作系统单一可度量属性，但软件工程中的信任取决于谁依赖代理、依赖结构如何、部署中哪些属性必须成立，单一指标不足以刻画。
AI.method: 受软件系统信任的递归性启发，提出概念框架：Why trust?（信任场景）、What trust?（信任配置）、How much trust?（信任属性）；据此推导3种场景、4种配置、5项信任相关属性，并区分哪些由构造封闭、哪些仍可修订；在ChatDev式多智能体工作流上实例化该画像。
AI.result: 得到由三个问题、三种场景、四种配置与五项属性组成的信任画像，并明确各要素的"封闭/开放"状态；在ChatDev风格多智能体流程上完成实例化演示。框架为概念性，未提供数值化信任度量。
AI.conclusion: 统一的单一信任度量不适配软件工程场景；结构化框架可作为后续实证验证的基础，而非可直接使用的数值指标。

title: World-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Pollution-Aware Bird Movement Modeling Using a Multi-Instance DQN Framework
comment: This work has been accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Affinity Event at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Birds are modeled as environmentally sensitive agents whose movement reflects real-world air quality conditions, where AQI serves as a measurable world feedback signal representing pollution-driven consequences. Instead of relying on human preference or synthetic rewards, the system uses environmental outcomes as the primary training signal, enabling policy learning grounded in ecological impact. We propose a multi-instance reinforcement learning simulation in which agents navigate a 2D grid representation of India integrated with a precomputed AQI matrix and geographic state boundaries. The framework combines bird call metadata from the Xeno-canto dataset, spatial discretization, and real environmental data to learn adaptive navigation strategies under pollution constraints. To ensure scalability and efficiency, repeated real-time API queries are replaced by a structured AQI mapping that enables fast lookup during training and execution. Multiple baselines, including Monte Carlo, Q-Learning, and Value Iteration, are evaluated for comparison. Deep Q-Network demonstrates stronger stability, adaptability, and cumulative performance across varying environmental conditions, establishing a scalable foundation for world-feedback driven ecological decision modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种多实例强化学习仿真，将鸟类建模为对环境敏感的智能体，以印度2D网格上的真实AQI数据作为"世界反馈"信号（替代人工奖励），结合Xeno-canto鸟鸣元数据与地理边界训练导航策略；实验中DQN相比蒙特卡洛、Q-Learning和值迭代表现更稳定、自适应且累积性能更好。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习多依赖人类偏好或合成奖励，缺乏与真实生态后果的耦合。作者希望用环境结果（空气质量污染后果）作为主要训练信号，使策略学习扎根于真实生态影响，从而探索"世界反馈驱动"的生态决策建模。
AI.method: 构建多实例强化学习仿真：以印度2D网格为环境，整合地理州界与预计算的AQI矩阵；利用Xeno-canto鸟鸣元数据与空间离散化生成多实例任务。为避免实时API调用开销，用结构化AQI映射实现快速查表。将AQI作为世界反馈奖励信号，训练并对比Monte Carlo、Q-Learning、Value Iteration与Deep Q-Network等基线。
AI.result: Deep Q-Network在多种环境条件下展现出更强的稳定性、适应性与累积回报，优于Monte Carlo、Q-Learning和Value Iteration等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以真实环境结果（AQI）作为反馈信号的强化学习框架能够有效学习污染约束下的自适应导航策略，为可扩展的世界反馈驱动生态决策建模奠定基础。

title: When Lower Harm Misleads: Auditing Concept Corrections
summary: An expert who corrects a concept prediction, such as a BI-RADS descriptor in breast ultrasound, expects the diagnosis to improve. Objectives that reduce the harm of such corrections are judged by harm and accuracy, yet harm also falls when a model responds less to every correction or starts from a worse uncorrected prediction, the reference for harm. We propose a correction audit, a reproducible evaluation protocol that separates these explanations: it splits each correction into harm and useful gain on identical events, separates the starting prediction from the correction response, and compares objectives with amplitude baselines matched in source harm. On three breast-ultrasound sources, worst-case correction training, evaluated from the mean-case model's start, lowers harm but gives up more useful gain in all 21 source comparisons pooled over six seeds, raising the corrected negative log-likelihood (NLL); from the same start, selecting between the objectives by harm picks the less helpful model on all three sources. On CUB, a monotonic harm penalty at its reported weight lowers path-level harm in all 80 concept sets while raising the NLL in all 80, almost entirely before any correction. At a fixed start, rescaling both responses to the same source harm reproduces the penalty's mean harm, useful gain and NLL on single-concept corrections within a prespecified margin of 0.0005 nat, although the two responses point in different directions. Lower harm therefore signals better corrections only when it is read together with useful gain, absolute risk and the start it is measured from.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"correction audit"评估协议，把纠错带来的harm与useful gain分开、把初始预测与纠错响应分开，并用幅度匹配基线比较目标函数；实验表明单看harm会误选模型，降低harm不等于纠错更好。
AI.motivation: 专家纠正BI-RADS等概念预测时期望诊断改善，现有以harm和accuracy评价的纠错目标存在混淆：模型对任何纠正响应变弱、或初始预测本就更差（harm的参照点）都会让harm下降，因此需要可分离这些解释的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出correction audit这一可复现评测协议：(1)在同一事件上把每次纠正拆分为harm与useful gain；(2)把初始预测与纠正响应分离开；(3)与源harm匹配的幅度基线比较各目标。在三组乳腺超声源（6个种子、21组源比较）和CUB（80个概念集）上验证，含预设0.0005 nat边距。
AI.result: worst-case correction训练从mean-case模型起点评估时，21组比较中harm全部下降但useful gain牺牲更多、校正后NLL上升；从同一起点按harm选目标，三个源上均选中帮助更小的模型。CUB上单调harm惩罚在报告权重下80个概念集路径级harm全降但NLL全升，且几乎全部发生在任何纠正之前；固定起点下把两种响应缩放至相同源harm，在0.0005 nat边距内复现了惩罚的mean harm、useful gain和NLL，尽管两者方向不同。
AI.conclusion: 低harm只有在同时结合useful gain、绝对风险和测量起点来解读时才意味着更好的纠错；单独以harm作为纠错目标或选择标准会产生误导。

title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. However, existing evaluations typically provide all patient information upfront and assess only the final diagnosis or rationale. This setup ignores the need to acquire diagnostic evidence incrementally from incomplete information in real-world diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiagTrace, a source-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can reconstruct the documented diagnostic trajectory through interactive information seeking. Each benchmark instance is built from a PubMed Central case report and includes an initial presentation, an event bank, a clinical course, and diagnostic references. DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties, with 225 used to evaluate four LLMs on clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency. Results reveal trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiagTrace，一个基于来源的基准，通过交互式信息检索评估大语言模型能否重建真实诊断轨迹，涵盖8个专科共510例来自PubMed Central的病例报告，并在225例上评测4个模型在临床病程对齐、交互质量和效率上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有医学评测通常一次性提供全部患者信息，仅评估最终诊断或推理依据，忽视了真实诊断中从不完整信息逐步获取证据的需求，因此需要能评估增量式信息寻求与诊断轨迹重建能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建DiagTrace基准：每个实例由一个PubMed Central病例报告生成，包含初始表现、事件库（event bank）、临床病程和诊断参考；通过交互式信息寻求让模型逐步获取证据，并从临床病程对齐、交互质量和效率三个维度评测4个LLM。
AI.result: DiagTrace包含8个专科的510个病例，其中225个用于评测4个LLM；结果显示模型在信息覆盖度、来源一致的事件排序和对话轮次使用之间存在权衡（trade-offs）。
AI.conclusion: DiagTrace填补了增量证据获取式诊断评估的空白，揭示了LLM在交互式诊断轨迹重建中的能力权衡，为更贴近真实临床的模型评估提供了新方向。

title: Pathology Randomization for Synthetic Priors and Zero-Shot Detection
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables (8-page main text with appendices). Code: https://github.com/agr78/Pathology-Randomizer
summary: Hospital brain imaging archives hold a diverse array of pathology at sample sizes beyond prospective studies, particularly for underrepresented populations and diseases. To unlock uncurated clinical data and scale analysis, methods are needed to detect abnormalities across contrasts and resolutions. Synthetic data has provided robust, contrast-agnostic models for a variety of human neuroimaging tasks in healthy anatomy, but pathology detection and other tasks in clinical settings still require real patient data, contrast-specific models, or disease-specific generators. We propose PathoDraw, a generative model of brain MRI with pathology. A conditional distribution of lesions given the healthy anatomy is drawn into the label map before contrast-agnostic rendering, and a single network estimates healthy anatomy with exact signed intensity deviation of any input scan. The contrast-agnostic 3D UNet learns the healthy labels under the lesion and the signed deviation directly and identifies pathology via robust tissue statistics and learned features, despite no training on real pathology. We show zero-shot detection on public stroke, tumor, and white matter hyperintensity datasets as well as archived clinical data, spanning $T_1$w, FLAIR and $T_2$w at various resolutions under a recent unsupervised anomaly detection benchmark protocol. Our single model exceeds or performs comparably to contrast-specific anomaly detectors trained on real scans and keeps healthy anatomy intact. The same generator trains networks for super-resolution and for registration in the presence of pathology. Our model, robust across acquisition and disease, enables the use of uncurated, archived data for clinical analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/agr78/Pathology-Randomizer.

AI.tldr: 提出 PathoDraw——一种带病理的脑MRI生成模型，用合成病理训练单一对比度无关3D UNet，实现零样本病理检测并兼容超分与配准。
AI.motivation: 医院脑影像档案数据量大、病种多样但未标注，现有合成数据方法在健康解剖上有效，而临床病理任务仍依赖真实患者数据、对比度专属模型或疾病专属生成器。
AI.method: 将病灶条件分布（给定健康解剖）绘制进标签图，再做对比度无关渲染；单一网络同时估计健康解剖与任意输入扫描的精确带符号强度偏差；对比度无关3D UNet直接学习病灶下的健康标签与偏差，并借助稳健组织统计与学习特征识别病理，全程不接触真实病理。
AI.result: 在公开卒中、肿瘤、白质高信号数据集及档案临床数据上零样本检测，覆盖T1w/FLAIR/T2w多分辨率，遵循近期无监督异常检测基准协议；单模型性能超过或媲美用真实扫描训练的对比度专属检测器，且保持健康解剖完整；同一生成器还可训练超分与含病理配准网络。
AI.conclusion: 模型跨采集与疾病稳健，可直接利用未整理的档案数据开展临床分析，代码已开源。

title: We Fixed the Scorer First, and Cluster Correction Killed Our Own Planted-Defect Result in AI Code Review
summary: Judging an AI code-review pipeline only by how much it catches hides an axis: what it dropped. Stronger selection raises precision for free; the cost never reaches the report. We ran four arms on the same eight cases, one scorer, asking whether planted-defect detection can rise without raising the claim error rate. Three repetitions are nested in eight cases, so p is reported per contrast and twice: under an exact permutation test over cases (2^8 arrangements) the two contrasts publishable under independence (Fisher p=0.017, 0.019) move to 0.0625 and 0.109, and after Holm correction no contrast separates. This is "not observable with this design," not "no effect": the sign test needs six discordant cases in one direction, its realized type-I rate under the null is 0.0078, and 80% power needs a per-case win probability near 0.80; closing it takes 12-25 cases, not repetitions. Within a run, a second pass never removes what the first found (0/24, 0/24 paired losses) while its gains (+3, +2) fall in one case; baselines on byte-identical prompts differed 15/24 vs 20/24, so run-to-run variance exceeds the effect. The claim error rate is 0.0% (0/178), with no upper bound on the rate claimed; scorer discrimination was measured with pre-registered positive controls (12/12 fabricated claims rejected, 0 false rejections). We retract our original causal explanation and report the instrument defects we hit. The contributions are not the numbers: (1) fixing the instrument before seeing results, then killing our own main effect with it; (2) the identity eps-hat = eps-hat(pi): a reported error rate is computed only on the subset a retention policy kept, silent about what was dropped, so it does not identify the quantity an irreversible gate needs; no improvement in the number promotes an automated verdict to publish, delete, or history-rewrite surfaces; a mechanized refusal enforces this.

AI.tldr: 一项AI代码审查流水线的对照实验：修正测量工具后发现原本显著的效果消失，作者撤回了自己的因果解释，并指出"保留策略下计算出的错误率"无法识别自动化门禁真正需要的量。
AI.motivation: 仅用"抓到了多少缺陷"来评判代码审查流水线，会掩盖被丢弃的内容。更强的筛选能免费提升精确率，而代价永远不会出现在报告里；因此需要检验：在声称错误率不升高的前提下，植入缺陷的检出率能否提高。
AI.method: 同一组8个案例上跑四个实验臂、单一评分器，3次重复嵌套于8个案例。用精确置换检验（2^8种排列）、符号检验、Holm校正及功效分析重新评估；另做二次扫描配对比对、同一提示的基线方差测量，以及预注册的正向对照检验评分器判别力。
AI.result: 在独立性假设下可发表的2组对比（Fisher p=0.017、0.019），置换检验后变为0.0625和0.109，Holm校正后无对比可分离。符号检验需6个同向不一致案例，实现的一类错误率仅0.0078，80%功效需每案例胜率约0.80，需12–25个案例而非重复次数。二次扫描从不移除第一次的发现（0/24、0/24），增益（+3、+2）集中于一个案例；字节相同提示的基线差异为15/24 vs 20/24。声称错误率0.0%（0/178）但未给出上界；评分器正向对照12/12伪造声明被拒、0误拒。
AI.conclusion: 贡献不在数字：(1)先修好测量工具再看结果，并用它推翻自己的主效应；(2)恒等式 ε̂=ε̂(π)——报告的错误率只在保留策略留下子集上计算，对被丢弃部分沉默，无法识别不可逆门禁所需的量。任何数值改进都不足以把自动结论推上发布、删除或改写历史等不可逆操作面；并用机械化拒绝机制强制执行这一原则。

title: A Temporal Algebraic Framework for Data Stream Evaluation Under Delayed Labels and Distribution Shifts
comment: 53 pages, 25 tables, 2 figures. Code: https://github.com/rcprati/data-stream-evaluation (experiments), https://github.com/rcprati/aggmetrics-datastream-lean (Lean 4 formalization), https://github.com/rcprati/aggmetrics (aggmetrics >= 0.4.0, subpackage aggmetrics.stream)
summary: In data streams, labels often arrive late or only for some instances, class prevalence drifts, and rare classes vanish from short windows. Standard evaluation then confuses a degraded decision boundary with a change in prevalence, and is biased when labels are delayed or selected by the model. We extend an algebraic framework that obtains pooled (micro) and per-class (macro) measures from one confusion matrix to streams, weighting the counts in time by exponential fading or a sliding window; the update costs O(m^2) per step, whatever the stream length, and each pooled measure stays a weighted combination of the per-class ones. Delayed and selective feedback enter as an observation mask: until its label arrives, an instance is counted with the model's calibrated class probabilities, and the bias of this interim estimate is driven by their calibration error. Audited conventions report no value for a class without verified instances. We separate prior shift from concept drift by monitoring prior-free coordinates (recall and specificity) and attribute a change in a measure to the two sources with a first-order Jacobian decomposition. On synthetic streams and four real datasets, a detector on these coordinates with a memory per class raises no excess false alarms under label shift, unlike the Jacobian alarm and error-rate detectors. The correction for delayed labels recovers recall in some real settings and is only partial for precision, specificity and F1. Twenty-five statements are checked in Lean 4, and the code is in the aggmetrics package.

AI.tldr: 论文将代数化混淆矩阵评估框架扩展到数据流，用指数衰减/滑动窗加权计数，延迟或选择性标签以校准概率掩码处理，并用无先验坐标（召回率、特异度）分离先验漂移与概念漂移，结论经Lean 4形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 数据流中标签延迟、仅部分标注、类先验漂移及稀有类在短窗口消失，使标准评估把退化的决策边界与先验变化混为一谈，并在标签延迟或被模型选择性标注时产生偏差，缺乏能同时处理这些问题的统一评估框架。
AI.method: 把从单一混淆矩阵导出micro/macro指标的代数框架推广到流式场景：按指数衰减或滑动窗对时间上的计数加权，每步更新代价O(m^2)且与流长无关，汇总指标仍是各类指标的加权组合；延迟与选择性反馈以观测掩码建模，标签到达前用模型校准概率计数，其偏差由校准误差界定量化；无验证样本的类不报告数值；以无先验坐标（召回率、特异度）监控并用一阶Jacobian分解把指标变化归因于先验漂移和概念漂移。
AI.result: 在合成流和四个真实数据集上，基于这些坐标、每类记忆的检测器在标签偏移下不产生额外误报，而Jacobian告警与错误率检测器则不然；延迟标签校正能在部分真实场景中恢复召回率，但对精确率、特异度和F1仅部分有效；25条陈述在Lean 4中完成验证，代码发布于aggmetrics包。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一个可流式、低成本且形式化验证的评估框架，能区分先验漂移与真实概念漂移，并显式处理延迟和选择性标签；但基于概率的临时估计对精确率类指标的纠偏能力有限，是后续改进方向。

title: ATLAS-Finance: Benchmarking AI Agents in Realistic Banking Environments
summary: Professional work involves under-specified assignments, where relevant information is spread across workplace applications and may conflict or change over time. To evaluate how well frontier agents can perform economically valuable work in such settings, we introduce ATLAS-Finance, a benchmark of 100 end-to-end investment-banking tasks across 13 simulated firms. As in real banking workflows, agents must search email, chat, calendars, notes, and files to identify requirements, gather information, reconcile conflicts/updates, and then build complex financial models. Tasks were developed by experienced bankers based on their real deal work and take them 15-30 hours to complete. Agent deliverables are evaluated with expert-authored rubrics (median: 124.5 criteria) covering financial rationale and results, spreadsheet construction, completeness, and formatting. Despite completing substantial portions of the requested work, current agents rarely produce correct deliverables. Across today's frontier models, the best ones (Claude Opus and Fable) pass fewer than 11% of tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 ATLAS-Finance 基准：13 家模拟投行中的 100 个端到端投资银行任务，考察智能体在信息分散、冲突与更新情境下的经济价值工作能力；现有最强模型（Claude Opus、Fable）通过率不足 11%。
AI.motivation: 专业工作常是"任务说明不充分"的：关键信息散落在邮件、聊天、日历、笔记、文件等多个应用中，且可能互相冲突或随时间变化。现有基准难以衡量前沿智能体在此类真实场景中完成有经济价值工作的能力。
AI.method: 构建 ATLAS-Finance 基准：100 个端到端投资银行任务，分布于 13 家模拟公司；任务由资深银行家基于真实交易工作设计，单任务人工需 15–30 小时。智能体须跨应用检索需求、汇集信息、消解冲突与更新，再搭建复杂财务模型。交付物由专家撰写的评分量表评估（中位数 124.5 条标准），覆盖财务逻辑与结果、表格构建、完整性与格式。
AI.result: 智能体能完成相当比例的请求工作，但极少产出正确的交付物；当今前沿模型中表现最好的（Claude Opus 与 Fable）通过任务比例低于 11%。
AI.conclusion: 在信息不充分、跨应用、需处理冲突与更新的真实专业工作场景中，前沿智能体能力仍严重不足，ATLAS-Finance 为衡量此类经济价值工作提供了高难度、专家级评测标准。

title: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Per-claim predictions and scoring script: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Gauntletscore/llm-aggrefact-predictions
summary: Checking whether a generated sentence is supported by its source document is a standard safeguard for AI-written text, and the strongest published checkers are single models. We describe GauntletScore, an evidence engine whose few rules and thresholds were set on the benchmark's development split. It puts typed questions to independent readers from different providers and records each answer as a measurement in an evidence ledger. It combines the measurements with a fixed Bayesian rule that counts a contradiction only when two readers agree. On the full LLM-AggreFact test split (29,320 claims across 11 datasets), following the leaderboard's approach, GauntletScore achieves 79.51 balanced accuracy, above every average published on the leaderboard as of 15 November 2026. That places it level with the best of them, nimble-v4-max (79.45 from its published dataset scores; the engine's 95% interval, 78.47 to 80.53, contains it). On the same claims it beats two of its three readers used alone (Readers A and B) by 1.66 and 2.17 points (95% intervals 0.80 to 2.53 and 1.29 to 3.06). Without AggreFact-CNN, described below, the leads are 0.90 and 1.32 and both intervals stay above zero. The engine also records the evidence behind every verdict, which a single model does not. Its largest margin is on full-length news articles checked against multi-sentence summaries (AggreFact-CNN), a format that resembles much regulated writing. There it scores 76.45, the best on the leaderboard, against 70.1 for the next best and 63.9 to 67.8 for the six systems with the highest averages. The test split was run once, on an engine frozen before the first test claim, under a stopping plan committed in advance. We release per-claim predictions and the scoring script.

AI.tldr: GauntletScore 是一个"证据引擎"：用固定规则向多个独立模型（不同提供商）提问，将回答记录为证据台账，再用贝叶斯规则融合（仅当两个读者一致时才计为矛盾），从而判断生成句子是否被源文档支持，性能与排行榜最佳单模型持平且可解释。
AI.motivation: 现有最强的支持性核查（safeguard）都是单一模型，缺乏证据可追溯性，且单模型存在盲点与不可解释问题。作者希望用多读者集成方式在保持或超越单模型性能的同时，提供每个判定的证据记录。
AI.method: 以开发集设定少量规则与阈值；向来自不同提供商的独立"读者"提出类型化问题；将答案作为测量记入证据台账；用固定贝叶斯规则融合，仅当两个读者一致时才计为矛盾。测试集只运行一次，引擎在任何测试声明之前冻结，停止计划预先承诺。
AI.result: 在 LLM-AggreFact 全测试集（11 个数据集、29,320 条声明）上取得 79.51 平衡准确率，高于排行榜已公布的所有平均值，与最佳 nimble-v4-max（79.45）持平（其 95% 区间 78.47–80.53 包含该值）；比单独使用读者 A、B 分别高 1.66 和 2.17 点，区间均不含 0；去掉 AggreFact-CNN 后仍领先 0.90 和 1.32 点。最大优势在 AggreFact-CNN（长新闻对照摘要）：76.45，为排行榜第一，第二名 70.1，另六个高均分系统为 63.9–67.8。
AI.conclusion: 多读者证据引擎可在与最强单模型相当甚至更优的同时，记录每个判定背后的证据，在长文档对多句摘要这类接近受监管写作的格式上提升最显著；并公开逐条预测与评分脚本。

title: DEFTS: Data-Efficient, Training-Free Few-Shot Learning for CLIP in the Text Subspace
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) achieves impressive zero-shot image classification performance by comparing image embeddings against class-specific text embeddings. While recent few-shot methods leverage labeled training samples to improve upon this zero-shot baseline, they often predominantly rely on image embeddings and underutilize the semantic structure of the text embeddings. In this paper, we introduce DEFTS, a data-efficient, training-free few-shot classification method strictly in the text subspace. We first demonstrate empirically that while raw text embeddings can be suboptimal as direct classifiers, the linear subspace they span remains highly discriminative. DEFTS therefore proposes to reduce the image-text modality gap by projecting estimated image prototypes directly into this subspace. Importantly, by expressing these prototypes as linear combinations of text embeddings, DEFTS reduces a high-dimensional estimation problem to the derivation of just a few coefficients. These coefficients are then computed via a Bayesian posterior mean, using a prior naturally centered on the original text embedding coordinates. Extensive experiments across 12 image classification benchmarks demonstrate that DEFTS significantly improves upon existing training-free methods.

AI.tldr: DEFTS是一种数据高效、无需训练的few-shot图像分类方法，仅利用文本子空间：将估计的图像原型投影到文本嵌入张成的线性子空间中，用贝叶斯后验均值求解少量线性组合系数，从而缓解模态鸿沟并显著超越现有免训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP few-shot方法多依赖图像嵌入，未能充分利用文本嵌入的语义结构；且原始文本嵌入直接作为分类器往往次优。
AI.method: 严格在文本子空间中进行few-shot分类：先将图像原型投影到文本嵌入张成的线性子空间以缩小图文模态鸿沟；用文本嵌入的线性组合表示原型，将高维估计问题降为少量系数的求解，再以贝叶斯后验均值计算，先验自然以原始文本嵌入坐标为中心。
AI.result: 在12个图像分类基准上显著优于现有免训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 文本子空间本身具有强判别性，通过适当投影与贝叶斯系数估计可在无训练条件下高效提升CLIP few-shot分类性能。

title: A Survey of Modeling Languages for Automotive Digital Twins
summary: The demand for digital twins and suitable modeling techniques in the automotive industry is increasing rapidly. Yet, there is no common understanding of digital twins in automotive, nor are there modeling techniques established to create automotive digital twins. Recent studies on digital twins focus on the analysis of the literature on digital twins for automotive or in general and, thus, neglect the industrial perspective of automotive practitioners. To mitigate this gap between scientific literature and the industrial perspective, we conducted a questionnaire survey among experts in the German automotive industry to identify (i) the desired purposes for and capabilities of digital twins, (ii) the modeling techniques related to engineering and operating digital twins across the phases of automotive development, and (iii) the role informal models play during automotive development. To this end, we contacted 189 members of the Software-Defined Car research project and received 96 responses. The results show that digital twins are considered most useful in the usage and support phase of automotive development, representing vehicles as-operated. Moreover, simulation models, source code, and business process models are currently considered the most important models to be integrated into a digital twin alongside the associated, established tools. Furthermore, informal models are frequently created digitally, e.g., using PowerPoint, mainly employed for communication and documentation during the conception and development phase.

AI.tldr: 通过对德国汽车行业189名"软件定义汽车"项目成员问卷调查(96份回复)，揭示了从业者对数字孪生的期望用途与能力、各开发阶段所用建模技术，以及非正式模型在开发中的作用。
AI.motivation: 汽车行业对数字孪生及建模技术需求快速增长，但缺乏对汽车数字孪生的共识，也未建立成熟建模方法；现有研究多基于文献分析，忽视了汽车从业者的工业视角，形成学术与产业之间的差距。
AI.method: 面向德国汽车行业专家开展问卷调查，联系"软件定义汽车"研究项目189名成员，回收96份有效回复，围绕三方面展开：(i)数字孪生的期望目的与能力；(ii)跨汽车开发各阶段的工程与运维数字孪生相关建模技术；(iii)非正式模型在开发过程中的作用。
AI.result: 数字孪生被认为在汽车开发的使用与支持阶段最有用，即表示"运行状态下的车辆"；仿真模型、源代码和业务流程模型被视为当前最应集成到数字孪生中的模型，并配合已有的成熟工具；非正式模型常以数字化方式(如PowerPoint)创建，主要用于概念与开发阶段的沟通和文档化。
AI.conclusion: 研究从工业实践视角补充了汽车数字孪生的认知，明确了其高价值应用阶段、关键集成模型类型及非正式模型的实际地位，为建立面向汽车行业的数字孪生建模方法提供了实践依据。

title: Lost in a Few Heads: Diagnosing and Repairing Block Selection in Sparse Attention
summary: Sparse attention models read a few blocks of keys for every query at a fixed budget and can lose much of their long-context retrieval accuracy at that budget. We ask where this loss is made. Using exact attention mass selection at the shipped budget as an oracle, we show that the selector under-ranks the needle rather than running out of budget. We find attention heads that miss the needle by running a calibration probe that teacher-forces the answer and reads two quantities in every head. The first is the needle attention that the selector forfeits, and the second is the share of the answer's log-probability that fixing the head's selection restores, integrated along the path from the shipped selector to full attention. Four checkpoints of the InfLLM-V2 family and NOSA-8B lose multi-key retrieval in the same three blind heads, which attend to the needle while a mean-pooled key summary dilutes its single decisive token. Full attention in those heads or a 4-bit scorer that keeps the shipped budget recovers most of the loss without training. On MiniCPM4.1-8B at 64K, either fix lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 54.1 to 97.5%, level with full attention in every head. In production serving engines, full attention in those heads keeps 84 to 89% of the time to first token (TTFT) that sparse attention saves at 32K to 128K context length. Beyond the InfLLM-V2 selector lineage, one unified rule flags attention heads above a threshold swept on each checkpoint until they close most of the gap to full attention on calibration prompts. A similar small set of blind attention heads carry the loss for the SeerAttention-R gates, NSA, and DashAttention, whereas many such heads exist in MoBA. On Qwen3-8B with the SeerAttention-R gates, full attention in 18 of 288 key-value heads lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 29.8 to 97.7%.

AI.tldr: 稀疏注意力在固定预算下丢失长上下文检索能力，作者定位到“注意力头”层面：问题不在预算不足，而在少数"盲头"（选择器低估needle）上。对这些头用全注意力或4-bit打分器可在不训练、不增预算的条件下恢复大部分精度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力模型每query只读少量key块，固定预算下长上下文检索精度大幅下降。作者想弄清这种损失究竟发生在哪里——是预算不够，还是选择器选错了块。
AI.method: 以shipped预算下的精确注意力质量选择作oracle，发现是选择器对needle排名过低而非预算耗尽。提出校准探针：teacher-forcing答案，在每个头读取两量——(1)选择器放弃的needle注意力；(2)修正该头选择所恢复的答案对数概率份额（沿shipped选择器到全注意力的路径积分），以识别"盲头"。
AI.result: InfLLM-V2四个checkpoint与NOSA-8B在同一三个盲头上丢失多键检索，原因是均值池化的key摘要稀释了单个决定性token。MiniCPM4.1-8B@64K：任一修正将多键检索从54.1%提升到97.5%。生产引擎中这些头用全注意力仍保留稀疏节省TTFT的84–89%（32K–128K）。统一阈值规则可推广到SeerAttention-R、NSA、DashAttention（MoBA盲头较多）；Qwen3-8B+SeerAttention-R：288个KV头中18个头全注意力使多键检索从29.8%升至97.7%。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏注意力的检索损失集中在少量盲注意力头上，而非预算问题；针对这些头做全注意力或轻量打分器修正即可无训练恢复精度，且保留大部分效率收益，且该诊断规则可跨选择器家族推广。

title: EvoDisco: Strategy Discovery for Evolving Agent Memory
summary: Large language model agents accumulate experience in memory, and how that memory evolves during interaction is as important as what it stores. Recent methods update memory online, yet both the operators that transform memory and the rules that select them remain fixed by design. We propose EvoDisco, which formulates agent memory evolution as evolutionary strategy discovery: the agent must discover which operator to apply, when to apply it, and how to instantiate it, rather than rewriting memory under a static operator schedule. A learnable policy conditions on the current memory state and recent task history, then selects and instantiates one of four semantic operators---Abstract, Refine, Bridge, and Reframe---which respectively compress related memories, decompose overloaded entries, connect weakly linked experiences, and reorganize retrieved reasoning chains. The policy is updated with a bi-level fitness. An inner signal scores each transformation using a retrieval-quality improvement regularized by memory complexity. An outer signal scores strategic efficacy over a window of past decisions, combining historical operator-utility regret, utility-prediction error, and selection diversity. Under a one-pass online plus frozen-transfer protocol on ALFWorld, WebShop, and LifelongAgentBench (OS and DB), EvoDisco improves over strong memory baselines including MemP and MemRL. The largest gains are on ALFWorld ($+8.8$ online / $+12.9$ frozen-transfer points over MemP; $+16.4$ / $+17.9$ over MemRL). Ablations attribute these gains to both fitness levels and the operator library.

AI.tldr: EvoDisco 将智能体记忆演化表述为"演化策略发现"问题，用可学习策略动态选择并实例化四种语义算子（Abstract/Refine/Bridge/Reframe），以双层适应度训练，在 ALFWorld 等基准上优于 MemP、MemRL。
AI.motivation: 现有在线记忆更新方法中，变换记忆的算子和选择算子的规则都是静态固定的，无法适应交互动态；作者认为记忆"如何演化"与"存了什么"同等重要。
AI.method: 提出 EvoDisco：学习型策略以当前记忆状态与近期任务历史为条件，动态选择并实例化四种语义算子（Abstract 压缩、Refine 分解过载条目、Bridge 连接弱关联经验、Reframe 重组推理链）。策略用双层适应度更新：内层以检索质量提升并用记忆复杂度正则化评分单次变换；外层基于历史算子效用遗憾、效用预测误差和选择多样性评分一段决策窗口的战略有效性。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、LifelongAgentBench（OS 与 DB）上采用单遍在线+冻结迁移协议，全面优于 MemP、MemRL 等强基线。ALFWorld 增益最大：相对 MemP 在线 +8.8、冻结迁移 +12.9；相对 MemRL 为 +16.4 / +17.9。消融显示两层适应度与算子库均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 记忆演化可以且应当被"学习"而非固定调度；算子选择策略的元学习与双层反馈是关键收益来源。

title: RLDE: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Iterative Document Editing
summary: Improving the quality, clarity, and flow of long documents remains a challenging problem in NLP, as human editing typically occurs through iterative refinement rather than a single-pass rewrite. Most existing automated systems act as black-box generators or rely on supervised learning, limiting interpretability and failing to capture the sequential nature of revisions. In this paper, we propose RLDE, an automated end-to-end metric-driven RL framework that formulates document revision as a reference-free MDP problem (unsupervised with respect to paired document-revision targets). Working with a limited action space (NOOP, INSERT, DELETE, REPLACE), RLDE leverages Pointer Networks for dynamic span selection at the token level and sends generative actions to the frozen BART-base model to obtain context-aware suggestions. PPO agents learn to optimize a multi-objective reward function based on readability, perplexity, and grammar metrics with the help of a novel SBERT-based Semantic Preservation Penalty constraint to avoid deletion degeneracy. Evaluations on the BEA-2019 dataset showed statistically significant results (p < 0.01) across all metrics, where Flesch Reading Ease increased from 49.8 to 59.4, perplexity decreased from 63.7 to 39.8, while preserving 93% of semantic information. When compared to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompt-engineered models like GPT-4 and LLaMA-2, RLDE shows high performance at a very low computational inference cost. Moreover, the quality of edits generated by RLDE has been verified via human evaluations, scoring 4.9/5 for meaning preservation and 4.4/5 for edit quality.

AI.tldr: RLDE：将长文档修订建模为无参考MDP，用强化学习（PPO）+指针网络+BART实现INSERT/DELETE/REPLACE/NOOP动作的迭代式文档改进，多目标奖励含可读性、困惑度、语法及SBERT语义保持惩罚。
AI.motivation: 长文档的质量、清晰度和流畅度提升困难；人类编辑是迭代精修而非一次性重写。现有自动系统多为黑箱生成或依赖有监督成对数据，可解释性差且无法捕捉修订的序列性。
AI.method: 提出端到端、指标驱动的RL框架RLDE，将修订形式化为无参考马尔可夫决策过程（无需成对文档-修订目标）。动作空间限定为NOOP/INSERT/DELETE/REPLACE；用Pointer Networks在token级动态选取span，生成类动作交由冻结的BART-base产出上下文感知建议；PPO智能体优化基于可读性、困惑度和语法指标的多目标奖励，并引入SBERT语义保持惩罚以避免退化为过度删除。
AI.result: BEA-2019上各指标均达统计显著（p<0.01）：Flesch易读性49.8→59.4，困惑度63.7→39.8，同时保留93%语义信息；相比GPT-4、LLaMA-2等CoT提示工程模型，以极低推理成本获得高性能；人工评测语义保持4.9/5、编辑质量4.4/5。
AI.conclusion: RLDE表明以RL驱动的序列式、无参考文档修订可在低成本下显著提升可读性与流畅度并保持语义，兼具可解释性与实用价值。

title: Deciding Without Pointing: A Case Study of Whether a Decision Model Localizes the Anomalies It Detects
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Preprint of the technical part of an MSc thesis (Politecnico di Milano). Code and pre-registrations are held privately until venue submission
summary: Decision models can answer a typed question about an image with a probability per option, without generating text. In our case study of Clef-flash (post-trained Qwen3.5-9B backbone) on industrial inspection benchmarks, we ask whether it localizes the anomalies it detects. We obtained uneven results with zero-shot detection: per-category image AUROC 0.924 on MVTec AD and 0.668 on MVTec AD 2. On the former, the decision head's routing attention produces 0.391 mean per-image pixel AUROC, and hiding the image tokens from it leaves detection unchanged. The multimodal LLM's backbone attention does point at the defect, however it falls below a center prior when we change question. It falls below chance if we remove textual context in the question, partly due to backbone attention leaving the object, while the head's map hardly changes. The backbone's states carry the location when probed with normal images, on the test-split images, however, the decision depends on the defect region. A larger model, Clef, that comes with a post-trained Qwen3.8-27B backbone, gives no useful map in the decision head either. We found that it's possible to recover anomaly location by asking question specifically on an image region, retraining the head or reading the backbone, but none matches dedicated few-shot localizers.

AI.tldr: 论文考察决策模型（Clef-flash，Qwen3.5-9B骨干）在工业检测中"检测到的异常是否被定位"。零样本检测AUROC在MVTec AD为0.924，但在MVTec AD 2仅0.668；决策头的路由注意力定位能力很弱（像素AUROC 0.391），且屏蔽图像token不影响检测；骨干注意力虽能指向缺陷，但依赖问题文本、易受中心先验影响。可通过区域提问、重训头或读取骨干恢复定位，但均不及专用少样本定位器。
AI.motivation: 决策式模型能给出概率却不生成文本，其"检测到异常"是否等同于"知道异常在哪里"尚不清楚。作者想检验这类模型的定位能力与决策依据，揭示检测与定位是否解耦。
AI.method: 在工业检测基准（MVTec AD / MVTec AD 2）上零样本评测Clef-flash（Qwen3.5-9B骨干）及更大的Clef（Qwen3.8-27B）；分析决策头路由注意力的像素AUROC、屏蔽图像token的消融、骨干注意力的定位与提问/文本上下文扰动、以及线性探针读取骨干状态。
AI.result: 分类AUROC 0.924（MVTec AD）与0.668（MVTec AD 2）；决策头像素AUROC仅0.391，屏蔽图像token检测不变；骨干注意力会离开物体、去掉文本上下文后低于随机，而头的地图几乎不变；正常图像探针可携带位置，但测试图上决策依赖缺陷区域；更大模型Clef的决策头同样无有效地图。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型的检测与定位明显脱节，决策头不提供可信定位。通过区域级提问、重训头或读取骨干可部分恢复位置信息，但均不如专用少样本定位器。定位能力需专门设计与评测。

title: Revisiting the Survival of Agent-Attributed Code: How Measurement Choices Decide the Verdict
summary: Studies of how long code from AI coding agents survives after it is merged reach conflicting verdicts: agent code is reported to be retained longer than human code, about as long, or modified sooner. Each study makes defensible measurement choices, but how much these choices decide the verdict is unknown. We revisit the survival of agent-attributed code in our earlier study: 854,139 lines that 2,802 merged pull requests (PRs) added to 215 repositories of the AIDev dataset. We vary nine measurement choices in five research questions and build a specification curve of 88 survival analyses, tested under three variance estimators, several observation windows, and permuted labels. For code from human-supervised agents, mostly GitHub Copilot, the choices change the size of the effect but not its direction. For code from the fully-autonomous agent Devin, they decide the verdict. Across repositories, 15 of 22 specifications report it modified sooner when lines are treated as independent, but only 3 when standard errors are clustered by repository, no more than permuted labels produce. Within repositories, no specification detects a difference. LLM intent classifiers agree with human labels about as well as two humans agree with each other, whereas keyword rules do not (kappa = 0.69 to 0.72 against 0.38), and the two reach different verdicts on why agent code is modified. Humans make most modifications to agent code under every unit and window. Re-run on our data, five published designs each change their result with a single choice. Whether agent code survives longer than human code is therefore decided as much by the measurement as by the code. We derive an operationalization checklist for post-merge studies.

AI.tldr: 通过88种规范曲线的生存分析重新审视AI代码合并后的存留问题，发现结论主要由测量选择而非代码本身决定。
AI.motivation: 已有研究对AI编码代理代码合并后是否比人类代码存留更久给出互相矛盾的结论，各研究测量选择看似合理，但这些选择在多大程度上决定了结论尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于AIDev数据集中2802个已合并PR、215个仓库、854139行代码，在5个研究问题下变化9种测量选择，构建88个生存分析的规范曲线；同时测试3种方差估计器、多种观察窗口和置换标签，并比较LLM意图分类器与关键词规则同人工标注的一致性。
AI.result: 对人类监督代理（多为Copilot）代码，测量选择只改变效应大小而非方向；对自主代理Devin代码则改变结论。跨仓库22个规范中15个在行独立假设下报告更早被修改，而按仓库聚类标准误时仅3个，且不优于置换标签；仓库内无任何规范检出差异。LLM分类器与人工一致性接近人工间一致性（kappa 0.69–0.72 vs 0.38）。五种已发表设计在复跑中均因单一选择而改变结果。
AI.conclusion: AI代码是否比人类代码存留更久，在很大程度上由测量方式决定；作者据此提出合并后研究的操作化检查清单。

title: KVUse: Reusable-KV User Memory for Efficient LLM Recommenders
summary: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stored as text in the user memory, every ranking LLM call that consumes them must splice them in the prompt and calculate the KV cache of them during the prefill phase.
