Given these ranking LLM calls are prefill heavy (long prompt but short decoded output) and repeatedly called, these repeated prefill of user profile text dominates the serving. Prefix caching cannot remove it, because these user profiles are preceded by different text in different calls. We present KVUse, which stores the user profiles as reusable key-value (KV) caches instead of text. KVUse trains lightweight LoRA writers by self-distillation, so that the user profile update call produces the reusable KV of the user profile while decoding it, and the LLM can read these reusable KV at new positions and behind new context without recomputation. KVUse also has a customized KV scheduler that uploads the stored reusable KV of the next batch while the current batch is computed, hiding the KV transfer from host memory behind GPU computation. On four InstructRec datasets with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, KVUse shows no statistically significant difference in ranking quality from full prefill over continuous memory update rounds. Under saturated load, KVUse raises the throughput of the downstream scoring path by 4.0x-4.5x and of the profile update path by 1.4x-1.9x.

AI.tldr: KVUse 将 LLM 记忆增强推荐中的用户画像从文本存储改为可复用的 KV 缓存，通过自蒸馏训练的 LoRA writer 在更新画像时顺带产出 KV，并配合 KV 调度器隐藏传输开销，在保持排序质量的同时将打分路径吞吐提升 4.0x-4.5x。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的记忆增强推荐器把用户画像存为自然语言文本，每次排序调用都要把画像拼进 prompt 并重新计算其 KV cache。由于这类调用 prefill 重、decode 短且频繁，重复 prefill 主导了服务开销；而各次调用中画像前缀文本不同，prefix caching 无法消除该开销。
AI.method: 提出 KVUse：1）以自蒸馏方式训练轻量 LoRA writers，使用户画像更新调用在解码画像时就产出可复用的 KV；2）LLM 能在新位置、新上下文之后直接读取这些复用 KV 而无需重算；3）定制 KV 调度器在当前批次计算时预上传下一批次的 KV，把 host 内存到 GPU 的传输隐藏在计算之后。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与四个 InstructRec 数据集上，经过连续多轮记忆更新，KVUse 的排序质量与全量 prefill 无统计显著差异；饱和负载下，下游打分路径吞吐提升 4.0x-4.5x，画像更新路径提升 1.4x-1.9x。
AI.conclusion: 将用户画像以可复用 KV cache 形式存储是消除重复 prefill 开销的有效途径，配合传输调度可在几乎不损失质量的前提下大幅提升记忆增强推荐系统的服务吞吐。

title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can now generate Lean proof scripts that capture the high-level structure of many mathematical arguments. However, these scripts frequently fail on complex theorems: a single missing side condition or misapplied lemma can cause the prover to abort early and discard an otherwise viable proof outline. This paper presents MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs by combining symbolic reasoning with minimal human interaction. At the core of MathEye is angelic proof checking, an optimistic execution model that replaces failing proof fragments with placeholders while preserving the overall structure of the argument. This optimistic check produces an angelic proof that isolates the exact proof obligations that the LLM fails to discharge. Because these unresolved obligations are often logically interdependent, asking a mathematician to address every placeholder directly is inefficient. To minimize human effort, MathEye performs residual analysis over a proof dependence graph that captures symbol-level data flow in the angelic proof. By formulating obligation selection as a MaxSAT optimization problem, MathEye selects a minimal-cost set of essential obligations whose resolution suffices to complete the entire proof. MathEye presents these essential obligations to the mathematician in ordinary mathematical language and uses the mathematician's answers to automatically reconstruct the complete Lean proof. Experiments on 30 real-world benchmarks across analysis and algebra show that MathEye solves 93.3% of the problems while reducing the number of required user interactions by 55%.

AI.tldr: MathEye将不完美的LLM生成Lean证明脚本通过"天使证明检查"定位失败义务，并用依赖图+MaxSAT最小化人工交互，最终重构完整验证证明；30个基准上解决93.3%问题，交互减少55%。
AI.motivation: LLM能生成Lean证明脚本刻画高层论证结构，但复杂定理中一个缺失的边条件或误用引理就会让证明器提前中止，丢弃原本可行的证明框架。需要一种能保留整体结构、只修复关键失败点的方法。
AI.method: 提出angelic proof checking乐观执行模型，用占位符替换失败的证明片段以保留论证结构，隔离出LLM未能完成的证明义务；构建捕获符号级数据流的证明依赖图进行残差分析；将义务选择建模为MaxSAT优化问题，选出最小代价的关键义务集；用普通数学语言呈现给数学家，再依据其回答自动重构完整Lean证明。
AI.result: 在分析与代数领域的30个真实基准上，MathEye解决93.3%的问题，同时将所需用户交互次数减少55%。
AI.conclusion: 结合符号推理与最少人工交互，可有效把有缺陷的LLM证明脚本转化为完全验证的Lean证明，显著提升自动化定理证明的可用性与效率。

title: Beyond Acuity Accuracy: A Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Emergency Triage AI Tools
comment: 82 pages, including 34 pages of supplementary material. 5 figures (4 main figures and 1 supplementary figure)
summary: Patient-facing AI triage tools may support care-seeking and emergency department prioritization, but require evaluation beyond acuity accuracy alone. We developed SAFE-Triage, a framework integrating human review, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and simulation testing across clinical performance, patient interaction, and clinician-facing summary quality. We applied SAFE-Triage to 40 MIMIC-IV-derived emergency vignettes and a 10,030-case acuity analysis comparing prompted LLM triage (PLT) with rule-augmented prompted LLM triage (rPLT). PLT achieved higher emergency severity index (ESI) accuracy (57.5% vs 42.8%, $P < 0.001$), lower undertriage (13.1% vs 29.8%, $P < 0.001$), and higher clinician ratings across all domains. rPLT produced shorter and more stable outputs with higher automated readability scores. SAFE-Triage identified trade-offs between acuity accuracy, undertriage risk, communication quality, readability, and summary quality, supporting pre-deployment refinement and ongoing monitoring by showing where triage tools are efficient, need improvement, or need clinician oversight.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAFE-Triage 评估框架，用于患者端AI分诊工具的多维度评估，并在MIMIC-IV病例上比较提示式LLM分诊(PLT)与规则增强式(rPLT)。
AI.motivation: 患者端AI分诊工具可支持就医决策与急诊优先级排序，但仅靠分诊准确度不足以评估，需要更全面的评估方法。
AI.method: SAFE-Triage框架整合人工复核、自动化指标、LLM-as-judge评估与模拟测试，覆盖临床性能、患者交互、面向临床医生的摘要质量；在40个MIMIC-IV急诊病例小故事和10,030例分诊等级分析中比较PLT与rPLT。
AI.result: PLT的ESI准确率更高(57.5% vs 42.8%, P<0.001)，漏诊(undertriage)更低(13.1% vs 29.8%, P<0.001)，医生评分各维度更高；rPLT输出更短更稳定、自动可读性评分更高。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-Triage揭示了分诊准确度、漏诊风险、沟通质量、可读性与摘要质量之间的权衡，可支持部署前优化与持续监测，指出分诊工具高效、需改进或需医生监督之处。

title: Beyond Appearance: Where Forest Visual Place Recognition Actually Fails
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, accepted to the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA)
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) in forest environments remains challenging because repetitive vegetation, and changes in illumination, season, and viewpoint can make distinct places appear similar and revisited places appear substantially different. In this paper, we investigate whether temporal, linguistic, structural, and geometric context can improve on an appearance-only descriptor, and what limits each representation when it does not. Using MegaLoc as the appearance-based baseline on the WildCross benchmark, we evaluate score-space and descriptor-space sequence matching, vision-language captions and reranking, scene-graph representations, and depth-derived stem graphs across same-direction revisits, extended routes, and reverse traversals. On a same-direction revisit, both sequence matching strategies reach similar Recall@1 (94.1% vs. 91.5%), but recall at 100% precision rises from 50.9% (single-frame MegaLoc) to 71.6% in score space and falls to 36.5% in descriptor space. The remaining context representations provide no consistent improvement over the appearance-based baseline. Same-place captions show limited place-specific discrimination, reranking is constrained by the initial candidate shortlist, and stem-graph matching remains weak even with LiDAR depth.

AI.tldr: 该论文在森林环境下评测多种上下文表征对视觉位置识别(VPR)的增益：仅得分空间序列匹配带来显著提升，语言、场景图与深度主干图均无明显改善。
AI.motivation: 森林VPR面临重复植被、光照/季节/视角变化导致"异处相似、同处相异"，本文探究时序、语言、结构、几何上下文能否超越纯外观描述子，并分析各表征的局限。
AI.method: 以MegaLoc为外观基线，在WildCross基准上评测：得分空间与描述子空间的序列匹配、视觉-语言caption与重排序、场景图表示、深度(含LiDAR)推导的主干图(stem graph)；覆盖同向重访、长路线、反向穿越。
AI.result: 同向重访下两种序列匹配R@1相近(94.1% vs 91.5%)；但100%精度下的召回从单帧50.9%升至得分空间71.6%，而描述子空间降至36.5%。其余上下文表示无一致提升：caption地点区分性有限，重排序受初始候选列表约束，stem图即使有LiDAR深度仍较弱。
AI.conclusion: 得分空间序列匹配是最有效的上下文增强手段；语言、结构、几何上下文在森林VPR中收益有限，瓶颈分别来自判别性、候选召回与匹配鲁棒性。

title: Can Coding Agents Write and Transpile Unit Tests
summary: Coding assistants built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a staple of modern software development, increasingly trusted to execute workflows and modernize code end-to-end. Much of this trust rests on passing tests, which are often written by the coding agents themselves. In this work, we examine the ability of these agents to both write reliable tests and translate them between programming languages. We benchmark three popular coding agents, each evaluated with a native frontier model and high reasoning effort. Verifying across a broad suite of metrics, we find that coding agents far exceed human written suites on traditional measures of coverage. This advantage, however, is uneven: agent test quality degrades sharply with project size, and much of the advantage lies in a greater number of written tests. We also show that agentic test translation---while seemingly strong in aggregate---remains inconsistent and unreliable.

AI.tldr: 论文考察编码智能体自动编写测试及跨语言翻译测试的能力，发现其在覆盖率上远超人工测试套件，但质量随项目规模急剧下降，且测试翻译不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现代软件开发日益依赖LLM编码助手端到端执行工作流与代码现代化，而这种信任很大程度上建立在"通过测试"之上，且这些测试常由智能体自己编写。因此需要审视智能体编写可靠测试以及跨语言翻译测试的真实能力。
AI.method: 对三款主流编码智能体进行基准测试，每款均搭配原生前沿模型并启用高推理努力（high reasoning effort），在广泛指标套件上评估其生成的测试质量与测试翻译表现。
AI.result: 在传统覆盖率指标上智能体远超人工编写的测试套件；但这一优势并不均衡——随项目规模增大，智能体测试质量急剧下降，且优势很大程度来自写出更多测试数量的堆积。智能体测试翻译在总体上看似表现不错，但实际不一致、不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体的测试能力存在"覆盖率虚高"问题，规模扩展性与跨语言翻译可靠性是关键短板，仅凭通过自写测试来建立信任并不可靠。

title: Physics-informed neural networks for spacecraft trajectory optimization with exact boundary conditions
summary: We use neural networks to optimize trajectories by modeling the position as a function of time and minimizing the thrust with respect to the network parameters. This corresponds to an unsupervised training procedure in which physical laws are incorporated directly into the optimization objective. In standard physics-informed neural networks, initial and terminal states are enforced through additional weighted loss terms, resulting in a multi-objective optimization problem that is highly sensitive to the choice of loss weights and can lead to poor convergence and reduced accuracy. To address this challenge, we construct a simple transformation, exploiting the mathematical structure of trajectory optimization problems, to enforce boundary conditions exactly a-priori. This transformation can be interpreted as a reparameterization of the solution space that embeds the boundary conditions directly into the function. This converts the original constrained optimization problem into an unconstrained one over admissible trajectories. I.e. the transformation eliminates the boundary condition penalty terms and reduces the problem to a single-objective optimization. Crucially, trajectory optimization comes with a low-dimensional boundary, which allows particularly simple and stable constructions of distance functions compared to general domains in partial differential equations. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach meaningfully improves convergence behavior and solution accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用变换将轨迹优化问题的边界条件精确嵌入神经网络解的表示中，把带惩罚项的多目标优化转化为无约束单目标优化，从而提升收敛性与精度。
AI.motivation: 标准物理信息神经网络把初末状态作为加权损失项施加，属于多目标优化，对权重选择高度敏感，易导致收敛差、精度低。
AI.method: 以时间为自变量、位置为网络输出，最小化推力（无监督训练，物理规律写入目标）；利用轨迹优化问题的数学结构构造简单变换（解空间重参数化），先验地精确满足边界条件，将约束问题转为可行轨迹上的无约束单目标问题；并指出轨迹优化边界维度低，距离函数构造比一般PDE域更简单稳定。
AI.result: 数值实验表明该方法明显改善收敛行为并提升解的精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过边界条件精确嵌入的变换可消除惩罚项与权重调参难题，是轨迹优化中比标准PINN更稳健有效的建模方式。

title: RegimeCouncil: Paired-Evidence Routing For Memory Conflict Governance In LLM Agents
summary: Language agents rely on long-term memory to personalize responses across extended interactions, yet stored facts quietly go stale as the world changes, and an agent often learns that using memory hurt only through delayed feedback after acting on an outdated record. Before the memory store is updated, how far should that negative feedback propagate: should it suppress memory use only on future queries for that same fact (a local policy), or also across other stored facts (a global policy)? Existing memory systems implicitly fix one of these two sharing scopes at design time. We formulate this online scope choice under hidden validity and delayed feedback as memory conflict governance, and prove that neither fixed policy is sufficient on its own. We then propose RegimeCouncil, a lightweight paired-evidence router that retains both scopes as advisors and arbitrates between them online without retraining the LLM. Using revealed comparisons between answering with memory and answering without memory (the no-memory anchor), a Local Advisor tracks the latest outcome on the queried fact alone, while a Global Advisor pools recent outcomes across all stored facts. A Meta Governor follows the Local Advisor by default to avoid cross-fact interference and switches to the Global Advisor only when global pooling accumulates a strictly positive recent utility margin, guaranteeing finite-time switching under delayed feedback. Across LongMemEval update streams and real-world historical drift on TempLAMA and TAQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o, RegimeCouncil outperforms the better fixed-scope policy by 5.2-7.3 points on primary disagreement episodes and across all 30 held-out settings, while ablations show that removing any of its three modules reduces accuracy by 2-7 points.

AI.tldr: 论文研究记忆更新前的负反馈应局部还是全局传播的问题，提出"记忆冲突治理"形式化框架，并设计RegimeCouncil——双顾问在线路由机制，在局部与全局两种作用域间动态仲裁，无需重训LLM。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体的长期记忆会随世界变化而失效，但智能体往往在依据过期记忆行动后才通过延迟反馈得知出错。现有记忆系统在设计时隐式固定了单一共享范围（局部抑制仅针对同一事实，或全局抑制影响所有事实），论文证明二者单独均不充分。
AI.method: 将在线作用域选择问题在隐藏有效性与延迟反馈条件下形式化为记忆冲突治理。提出RegimeCouncil：一个轻量级成对证据路由器，同时保留两种作用域作为顾问并在线仲裁。Local Advisor仅追踪被查询事实的最新结果；Global Advisor汇总所有事实的近期结果；Meta Governor默认跟随Local以避免跨事实干扰，仅当全局池化累积严格正的近期效用余量时才切换到Global，从而保证延迟反馈下的有限时间切换。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval更新流及TempLAMA、TAQA的真实历史漂移上（Qwen3-30B-A3B与GPT-4o），RegimeCouncil在主要分歧片段上比更优的固定作用域策略高出5.2-7.3分，并在全部30个留出设置中均表现更优；消融显示移除三个模块中任一者都会使准确率下降2-7分。
AI.conclusion: 固定作用域策略不足以应对隐藏有效性与延迟反馈下的记忆冲突，而基于成对证据的在线作用域仲裁可显著优于任一固定策略，且各模块均有必要。

title: What MoE Routing Controls: Causal Interventions on Expert Trajectories
summary: In mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, a token is routed to a sequence of experts across layers. We investigate how forcing tokens onto chosen expert paths influences model behavior. We build a target path from the experts that a concept's or role's tokens most often use, and we add a fixed bias to each target expert's router logit during generation to steer the token toward this expert path. We study two kinds of targets. Format targets concern the form of the output, and concept targets concern its topic. In Qwen3-30B-A3B, we show that steering a format path changes the text the model writes. We also show that steering a concept path shifts the model's next-token probabilities toward the concept, even when the path is built in another language, yet this shift has little effect on the generated text. We investigate why formats reach the text but concepts do not by steering only part of the generation, and find evidence that a format, once started, reinforces itself. We show that the concepts religion and money steer most strongly, and that the effect is concentrated in the middle layers. We attempt to explain why the strength of the effect varies by concept through an analysis of embedding distinctiveness and word frequency.

AI.tldr: 在MoE模型(Qwen3-30B-A3B)中通过给目标专家的路由logit加固定偏置,把token导向"格式路径"或"概念路径",发现格式路径能改变生成文本,而概念路径虽能改变下一token概率但对文本影响很小,原因是格式一旦启动会自我强化。
AI.motivation: 探究强制token沿特定专家路径路由是否以及如何影响MoE语言模型的行为,即路由路径对模型输出的因果作用。
AI.method: 为某概念/角色/格式的token最常使用的专家构建目标路径;生成时对目标专家的router logit施加固定偏置以引导token走该路径。设置两类目标:格式目标(输出形式)与概念目标(主题)。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上实验,并做部分生成阶段引导、分层分析、以及嵌入区分度与词频的归因分析。
AI.result: 格式路径引导可改变生成文本;概念路径引导使下一token概率向该概念偏移(跨语言构建路径也有效),但对生成文本影响甚微。格式一旦启动会自我强化,故能到达文本。概念中religion与money引导效果最强,效应集中于中间层。效果强度随概念变化的解释(嵌入区分度、词频)仅有部分证据。
AI.conclusion: 路由路径对MoE模型输出具有因果影响,但影响程度取决于路径类型:格式路径自增强并传导至文本,概念路径主要停留在概率层面。该差异集中在中间层,并随概念性质而异。

title: Where Should the Lamp Go? Ambient-Aware Lamp Placement for Portraits
summary: Portraits shape first impressions, and lighting is an important factor. Prior work, such as lighting estimation and portrait relighting, edits lighting after capture but does not guide where to place a light before the shot. This leaves an open question: where should a light go to best light a face? Therefore, we propose LightMatch, a preference-grounded inverse lighting framework that disentangles the controllable light from ambient illumination and optimizes its placement. We first learn a Bradley-Terry quality model from pairwise human judgments. A perception head then regresses spherical-harmonic lighting from frozen self-supervised features via cross-attention. Finally, a placement solver isolates the light via spherical-harmonic linearity and optimizes its reachable position. On held-out environments, LightMatch attains 87.8% of the oracle improvement, outperforming the conventional solver that ignores ambient light by a relative 28.4% and the same pipeline with the widely used DPR estimator by a relative 70.5%. It reaches 73.2% on real OLAT faces of unseen identities and, on our real captures, cuts lamp-direction error by 37.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出 LightMatch，一个以人类偏好为基础的逆向光照框架，用于在拍摄前指导灯光该放在哪里，而非事后重打光。
AI.motivation: 人像灯光对第一印象至关重要，但现有的光照估计、人像重打光都只在拍摄后编辑光照，无法在拍摄前告诉摄影师灯应该放在哪里，"如何用一盏灯最好地照亮人脸"仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 1) 用成对人类判断学习 Bradley-Terry 质量模型；2) 感知头通过交叉注意力，从冻结的自监督特征回归球谐光照；3) 放置求解器利用球谐线性可将可控灯与环境光解耦，并优化灯的可达位置。
AI.result: 在留出环境上达到 oracle 改进的 87.8%，分别相对优于忽略环境光的传统求解器 28.4%、使用 DPR 估计器的同管线 70.5%；在未见身份的实拍 OLAT 人脸上达到 73.2%，实拍中灯方向误差降低 37.7%。
AI.conclusion: 用偏好监督 + 球谐解耦的逆向优化，可有效预测最佳的可达灯光位置，显著优于传统求解器与通用光照估计器，并在真实数据上验证。

title: EmbedGym: Letting Coding Agents Develop and Debug Embedded Firmware Without Physical Hardware
summary: Modern coding agents perform well on general software benchmarks because they can run code and unit tests in a closed loop. Embedded firmware development, however, breaks this loop: a program that compiles can still fail on real hardware due to pin polarity, bus protocol, timing, or networking bugs that an agent at a text terminal cannot observe. Existing embedded coding agents either skip hardware execution, drive GPIO-only simulators with multi-second delays, or test on physical boards in a static environment. In this paper, we present EmbedGym, an interactive virtual hardware environment that lets coding agents develop and debug embedded firmware without physical hardware. EmbedGym uses instruction-level microcontroller unit (MCU) emulators to execute the same binary that would be flashed onto a physical board, connects them to 41 peripheral models, an analog circuit simulator, and virtual WiFi/Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) endpoints, and exposes an interface for agents to change sensor inputs, press buttons, and inspect hardware states. On top of it, we build EmbedGym-Bench, which consists of 598 tasks across 6 MCU-framework pairs graded by hidden timed test vectors, using a five-stage multi-agent workflow that synthesizes peripheral models and tasks from datasheets and driver libraries. We expose EmbedGym to a coding agent at three levels and evaluate eight models over more than 14K trajectories. Even when compilation succeeds 99.7% of the time, 19.9% of compiled firmwares fail at runtime (up to 73% on individual targets). In contrast, interactive hardware testing in EmbedGym increases pass rates across models by +4.9% to +14.7% (up to +31% on individual targets). Our results also show that an agent with EmbedGym outperforms prior embedded agent frameworks, and lightweight models with EmbedGym match frontier models without it at 30-70x lower cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EmbedGym，一个基于指令级 MCU 模拟器的交互式虚拟硬件环境，使编码智能体无需物理硬件即可开发调试嵌入式固件，并配套构建了含 598 任务的 EmbedGym-Bench。
AI.motivation: 通用软件智能体可依靠运行代码和单元测试形成闭环，但嵌入式固件开发打破了这一闭环：程序即便编译通过，仍可能因引脚极性、总线协议、时序、网络等问题在真实硬件上失败，而终端智能体无法观测这些硬件层面错误。现有嵌入式智能体要么跳过硬件执行，要么依赖延迟数秒的仅 GPIO 模拟器，要么在静态物理板上测试，均不理想。
AI.method: EmbedGym 使用指令级 MCU 模拟器执行与物理板相同的二进制，接入 41 个外设模型、模拟电路模拟器和虚拟 WiFi/BLE 端点，并向智能体提供改变传感器输入、按键、检查硬件状态的交互接口。在此基础上构建 EmbedGym-Bench：598 个任务、6 种 MCU-框架组合，用隐藏的定时测试向量评分，由五阶段多智能体工作流从数据手册和驱动库合成外设模型与任务。对智能体开放三个层次的接口，在 8 个模型上评估超 14K 条轨迹。
AI.result: 编译成功率高达 99.7% 时仍有 19.9% 的固件运行时失败（单目标最高 73%）；EmbedGym 交互式硬件测试使各模型通过率提升 +4.9% 至 +14.7%（单目标最高 +31%）；搭载 EmbedGym 的智能体优于现有嵌入式智能体框架，轻量模型配合 EmbedGym 可媲美无 EmbedGym 的前沿模型，成本低 30-70 倍。
AI.conclusion: 虚拟硬件交互测试是弥合嵌入式固件开发闭环缺口的关键，EmbedGym 以低成本显著提升智能体的嵌入式计算能力。

title: Higher-Order Interaction Reconstruction via Integral Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Reconstructing higher-order interactions is a fundamental challenge in complex networked systems, with applications in ecological, social, and biological networks. This inverse problem is inherently difficult due to the combinatorial complexity of higher-order structures, the strong nonlinearity of the underlying dynamics, and the prevalence of noisy and sparse observations. In this article, we propose a novel integral physics-informed neural network (IntegralPINN) framework for higher-order interaction reconstruction. Instead of { penalizing derivative-based physics residuals,} we adopt an integral formulation over temporal intervals, which naturally suppresses high-frequency noise and mitigates derivative-induced instability. We further introduce a continuous parameterization of interaction tensors, enabling tractable identification of higher-order structures via gradient-based optimization. We provide theoretical analysis establishing a noise-robust error bound that is independent of derivative amplification when the integration window satisfies an excitation condition. Extensive experiments on ecological dynamics, social contagion, and neuronal synchronization systems demonstrate that IntegralPINN achieves accurate and robust reconstruction under noisy and sparse observations, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出积分型物理信息神经网络（IntegralPINN）框架，用时间区间上的积分形式替代导数残差，实现对高阶复杂网络相互作用的鲁棒、稀疏观测重建。
AI.motivation: 高阶交互重建是复杂网络逆问题，因高阶结构组合复杂度高、动力学强非线性、观测含噪且稀疏而极具挑战。现有基于导数残差的PINN方法在噪声下会放大误差、导致不稳定。
AI.method: 不惩罚导数物理残差，改为在时间区间上采用积分公式，天然抑制高频噪声并缓解导数不稳定；同时引入交互张量的连续参数化，使高阶结构可通过梯度优化可解辨识；并给出理论分析，在积分窗口满足激励条件时建立不依赖导数放大的噪声鲁棒误差界。
AI.result: 在生态动力学、社会传染、神经元同步三类系统上的大量实验表明，IntegralPINN在含噪稀疏观测下实现准确且鲁棒的重建，性能优于现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 积分形式+连续参数化是处理高阶交互逆问题噪声与稀疏性的一种有效、有理论保障的方案。

title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards, providing a concrete setting for the architectural and systems studies. For post-training, we introduce TeleGym, a unified agent execution platform that connects execution, evaluation, and trajectory construction to policy optimization. Disaggregated asynchronous execution, bounded oversampling, and partial rollout accommodate heterogeneous task durations while preserving trajectory continuity across policy updates. Together, these advances establish an Ascend-oriented training foundation for the continued development of Xing 4 across model scales and increasingly demanding reasoning and agent workloads.

AI.tldr: Xing 4 是延续 TeleChat 系列的大模型家族，在昇腾（Ascend）平台上通过架构与训练基础设施的协同优化，完成 285B 模型在 8192 张 910C 卡上的预训练，并提出 TeleGym 智能体后训练平台。
AI.motivation: 延续 TeleChat 谱系，构建面向昇腾国产算力的大模型训练底座，在模型容量与计算、显存访问、执行开销之间取得平衡，并支撑日益增长的推理与智能体负载需求。
AI.method: 架构侧研究稀疏激活、注意力设计、模型深度与宽度、投机解码的权衡；预训练基础设施基于 MindSpore HyperParallel，采用拓扑感知混合切分、高效分布式优化器执行、长序列负载与激活显存协同管理，并结合 CPU 亲和性与核隔离减少主机调度干扰；后训练提出 TeleGym 统一智能体执行平台，连接执行、评估、轨迹构建与策略优化，采用分离式异步执行、有界过采样与部分 rollout。
AI.result: 在 8192 张昇腾 910C 卡上完成 285B 参数模型预训练，为架构与系统研究提供可落地的实验场景；TeleGym 可在异构任务时长下保持轨迹连续性，跨策略更新稳定运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 Xing 4 在多种模型规模及更高难度推理与智能体负载下的持续发展，建立了面向昇腾的训练基础。

title: From Imperfective Paradox to Moorean Absurdity: Single-Chain Reasoning Lock-In and Multi-Candidate Verbalization Across Aspectual and Pragmatic Ambiguity
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 25 tables (single-column arXiv preprint; includes 16,640 Qwen3-8B formal units across 4 preregistered experiments, 1,800 OpenAI format-ablation calls, and 4,240 P16.7 development-slice units across 5 external models)
summary: Natural language entailment and coherence judgments often depend on whether an event merely occurred, reached a telic culmination, satisfied a plan, or was evaluated under multiple pragmatic standards. We test observable consequences of the single-chain premature lock-in hypothesis across four preregistered, sealed formal experiments on Qwen3-8B-Q8_0 (16,640 formal units, temperature=0.0): 15 of 16 hypothesis slots retain confirmatory status (12 rejecting H0 under within-experiment Holm control at alpha_fam=0.05; E3_H3 demoted to descriptive status). In Experiment 1, Direct-CoT vs. MCU differs by 25.00 pp on telic high-confidence completion (Holm p=1.31239e-05), while NLI-CoT collapses by -91.25 pp on uninterrupted atelic items (Holm p=1.81805e-21). Multi-Candidate Verbalization (MCV) elicits K=5 weighted estimates in one call, separating the prompt from unweighted (MCU) and self-weighted (MCW) readouts. Mandarin (E2) and English (E3) expose an Interruption-Anchored Realis Paradox under NLI-CoT. In Experiment 4, MCU-CF raises perceived coherence on implicit Moorean sentences by 26.64 pp over Direct-CoT (Holm p=0.0006), alongside Direct-CF - Direct-CoT = 29.15 pp and MCU-CoT - Direct-CoT = 17.31 pp. A 1,800-call OpenAI ablation and a stage="dev" P16.7 cross-model extension (4,240 planned/collected units across five external models: 4,222 valid, 18 format-missing, 0 transport-missing; <2% missing per slice; OpenAI gpt-4o-mini at top_logprobs=20 achieves 1,000/1,000 valid units) show that discrete NLI-CoT and scalar Direct-CoT judgments dissociate across models. Confirmatory effects concern observable prompt-and-readout protocols; internal premature lock-in remains a hypothesis. All code, stimuli, preregistered analysis plans, and verification tools are available at https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies.

AI.tldr: 研究在Qwen3-8B上进行四项预注册实验，考察"单一链条过早锁定"假说：直接CoT与多候选加权读出等提示-读出协议在事件telicity、完成度、连贯性判断上产生显著且系统的差异。
AI.motivation: 自然语言蕴涵与连贯性判断依赖于事件是否仅仅发生、是否达到telic终点、是否满足计划、或在多重语用标准下被评价；作者希望检验"单一链条过早锁定"假说是否具有可观测的行为后果。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-8B-Q8_0上进行四项预注册、密封的形式化实验（16,640个形式单元，温度=0.0），对比Direct-CoT、NLI-CoT、MCU（无加权）、MCW（自加权）、MCV（多候选言语化，K=5加权估计）等提示-读出协议；用组内Holm控制检验16个假设槽位；并做1,800次OpenAI调用消融及五个外部模型的跨模型扩展。
AI.result: 16个假设槽位中15个保持确证地位（12个在alpha_fam=0.05下组内Holm控制拒绝H0；E3_H3降为描述性）。E1中Direct-CoT与MCU在telic高置信完成上差25.00 pp（Holm p=1.31e-05），NLI-CoT在未打断atelic项目上崩塌-91.25 pp（p=1.82e-21）；E2/E3揭示"NLI-CoT下的打断锚定现实悖论"；E4中MCU-CF使隐式Moorean句连贯性提升26.64 pp（p=0.0006），Direct-CF−Direct-CoT=29.15 pp，MCU-CoT−Direct-CoT=17.31 pp。跨模型扩展有效单元4,222/4,240，显示离散NLI-CoT与标量Direct-CoT判断在不同模型间解离。
AI.conclusion: 确证性效应针对可观测的提示-读出协议，内部的"过早锁定"仍是待检验假说；所有代码、刺激、预注册分析计划与验证工具均已开源。

title: BATMoS: Budget-Aware Guidance Allocation for Efficient Video Diffusion
summary: The effectiveness of a video diffusion model's inference budget depends on where computation is spent along the denoising trajectory. Across eight equal-budget inference configurations, VBench total scores span 4.80 points, highlighting the importance of explicit allocation design. Our key insight is that guidance evaluations are not equally valuable across diffusion time: retaining the sampling updates while selectively reusing guidance can preserve generation quality with fewer denoiser evaluations. We introduce BATMoS (Budget Aware Temporal Mixture of Strategies), which routes between fresh classifier-free guidance and cached guidance using a single pretrained denoiser. A magnitude-based temporal rule assigns guidance reuse to low-magnitude blocks and reserves fresh guidance for the remaining blocks, with a single integer controlling the computation budget. The resulting schedule requires no additional router training or per-budget threshold search. Evaluated on CogVideoX-2B with 4,720 videos per configuration across all sixteen official VBench dimensions, BATMoS achieves the highest total score among the eight allocation policies and comes within 0.10 points of full classifier-free guidance using 20\% fewer branch evaluations. BATMoS also composes with feature reuse, reducing computation from 80 to 62 effective branch evaluations with a 0.11-point decrease in total score. These findings make temporal guidance allocation a practical mechanism for extracting more generation quality from a fixed inference budget.

AI.tldr: 提出BATMoS，通过按去噪时间步和激活幅度分配“新guidance”与“缓存guidance”，在固定推理预算下提升视频扩散生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型的推理预算效果取决于计算在去噪轨迹上的分配方式；不同等预算配置间VBench总分差异达4.80分。作者观察到guidance评估在不同扩散时间上价值不均，可保留采样更新而选择性复用guidance，从而用更少去噪器评估维持质量。
AI.method: BATMoS（Budget Aware Temporal Mixture of Strategies）：用单一预训练去噪器在fresh classifier-free guidance与cached guidance之间路由。基于幅值的时间规则把guidance复用分配给低幅值块，其余块保留fresh guidance；仅用一个整数控制计算预算。无需额外router训练或逐预算阈值搜索。在CogVideoX-2B上评测，每配置4,720个视频，覆盖全部16个官方VBench维度。
AI.result: 在八种分配策略中总分最高，并在少用20%分支评估的情况下距完整CFG仅差0.10分；可与feature reuse组合，将有效分支评估从80降到62，总分仅下降0.11分。
AI.conclusion: 时间维度的guidance分配是从固定推理预算中提取更多生成质量的实用机制。

title: Operating an Agent-Driven Dataset Factory: Discovery, Construction, and Public Release
summary: Turning public data into prediction datasets requires connecting source discovery, task definition, construction, and distribution. We deployed Dataset Factory to perform these steps continuously under a standing release policy. Bounded language-model tasks interpret sources, write construction code, and review task meaning; deterministic software manages state, workers, retries, and publication. Over 81.53 hours, the factory published 14 datasets at an estimated recurring operating expenditure of about \$2.74 per publication. The accounting includes failed attempts, inference, workers, and hosting. Separate agents completed prediction experiments on all twelve evaluated releases. Source review nevertheless identified a task whose construction filters contradicted its population declaration. The original reviewer accepted later-record exclusions without reconciling them with the published selection rule. This experience documents an operating source-to-release workflow and shows why successful execution and consumer use need separate checks of task meaning.

AI.tldr: 部署"数据集工厂"系统，持续将公共数据转化为预测数据集：语言模型负责语义任务（理解数据源、写构建代码、审核任务含义），确定性软件负责状态、worker、重试与发布；81.53小时内发布14个数据集，单次发布经常性运营成本约2.74美元。
AI.motivation: 把公共数据转为预测数据集需串联数据源发现、任务定义、构建与分发等多个环节，缺乏可连续运行、成本可控的端到端工作流；同时需要验证自动化流程能否在真实运营约束下持续产出可用数据集。
AI.method: 构建并部署Dataset Factory，在固定发布策略下持续运行。采用职责分离：有界语言模型任务负责解释数据源、编写构建代码、审查任务含义；确定性软件管理状态、worker、重试和发布。成本核算涵盖失败尝试、推理、worker与托管。
AI.result: 81.53小时内发布14个数据集，单次发布估计经常性运营成本约2.74美元；独立agent在全部12个被评测版本上完成预测实验。但源审查发现某任务的构建过滤条件与总体声明相矛盾，原审查者接受了"排除后续记录"却未与已发布的选择规则协调一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了可运行的 source-to-release 运营工作流；表明成功执行与消费者可用性需要分别检验——自动化流程顺利运行不等于任务语义正确，需对任务含义设置独立检查。

title: A Log-Timescale Perturbation Bound for Selective State Space Models at Every Sequence Length
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Code and recorded runs: https://github.com/jackdoesjava/mamba-v-lob
summary: Mamba models deployed on streaming data, such as limit order book updates, run far past the sequence lengths they were trained on. A guarantee on how much a small change of input can move the hidden state therefore has to hold at every length. The closest existing bound we know of measures the change of the timescale additively, and it grows linearly with the sequence length unless the timescale is bounded away from zero. In this paper, we measure the change on a log scale instead. The key observation is that the decay factor of each step then moves by at most a fixed fraction of that step's input weight, so the per-step errors cannot pile up. Using this, we prove that two runs of a selective-scan cell from a common start stay within a bound that holds at every length, shrinks to zero with the size of the change and needs no lower bound on the timescale. We give a construction showing that, for small changes, this bound is within a factor of about 2 of the best possible, and we extend it to the update used in Mamba's released code when the timescale is bounded above. We then evaluate block-level bounds built from the theorem on two small models trained on one day of order book data. With a bounded timescale, a bound built on the existing analysis is tighter than ours for at most the first 8 steps. With Mamba's softplus timescale, whose certified lower bound is as small as $10^{-21}$, it is looser at every length. Our bounds hold for every input to a block, but they remain more than five orders of magnitude above the changes that gradient attacks find.

AI.tldr: 论文通过在对数尺度上衡量时间尺度变化，为Mamba选择性扫描单元在任意序列长度下提供了隐藏状态变化的稳定性界，且无需时间尺度下界。
AI.motivation: Mamba模型在流式数据上运行时序列长度远超训练长度，需要保证输入的小变化对隐藏状态的影响在任意长度下都有界。已有界以加法方式衡量时间尺度变化，除非时间尺度远离零，否则随序列长度线性增长。
AI.method: 将对时间尺度的变化改为对数尺度衡量，观察到每步衰减因子的变化最多为该步输入权重的一个固定比例，从而逐��误差不会累积。据此证明选择性扫描单元从共同起点出发的两次运行之间的界，并构造例子证明其近似最优（约2倍因子内），再将其扩展到Mamba官方代码中的更新（时间尺度有上界时）。最后在一天订单簿数据上训练的两个小模型上评估块级界。
AI.result: 所得界在任意长度下成立、随变化幅度趋于零、无需时间尺度下界，且在小变化下距最优约2倍以内。实验上：时间尺度有界时，已有分析的界仅在最初至多8步内更紧；Mamba的softplus时间尺度（认证下界低至10^-21）下，已有界在每一长度都更松。界对块的所有输入成立，但比梯度攻击找到的变化仍高五个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 对数尺度分析给出了Mamba流式场景下与长度无关、无需时间尺度下界的紧致稳定性保证，弥补了已有加法分析的缺陷；但其与梯度攻击实际扰动的差距仍超过五个数量级，说明还有改进空间。

title: LoCaR: Localized Canvas Retrieval With Frozen Vision-Language Model
summary: Whole image embeddings can under represent small objects and local attributes that distinguish relevant images for localized queries. We present LoCaR, a training free framework for localized text to image retrieval with frozen vision language models. LoCaR constructs and utilizes independent proposals (SAM2) focusing on the object so as to get a more localized representation that independently encodes each region using the frozen visual encoder. We further study paired-support adaptation as an optional residual that uses matched text region exemplars without updating the underlying encoders. We also introduce LOCFG, a Visual Genome derived benchmark designed to evaluate localized retrieval for smaller and more challenging referents. Across several vision language backbones, our results show that improving the region representation itself is the main source of gain.

AI.tldr: LoCaR 是一个无需训练、基于冻结视觉语言模型的局部化文本到图像检索框架，通过 SAM2 生成独立区域提案并分别编码，缓解整图嵌入对小物体和局部属性表征不足的问题，并提出了 LOCFG 基准。
AI.motivation: 整图嵌入往往会低估小物体以及区分相关图像的局部属性，导致针对局部化查询的检索效果不佳。因此需要一种更细粒度、聚焦目标的区域级表示方法。
AI.method: LoCaR 无需训练，利用冻结的视觉语言模型：先用 SAM2 构建独立的聚焦目标区域提案，再用冻结的视觉编码器对每个区域独立编码以获得局部化表示；此外研究了一种可选的"配对支持适配"残差机制，利用匹配的文本-区域示例，且不更新底层编码器。同时构建了基于 Visual Genome 的 LOCFG 基准，用于评估更小、更难的指代目标的局部化检索。
AI.result: 在多种视觉语言骨干网络上，实验表明提升区域表示本身是主要增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 区域级表示的改进（而非适配机制）是局部化检索性能提升的关键，LoCaR 为无需训练的局部化检索提供了有效方案，并配套 LOCFG 基准推动该方向评估。

title: RISA: Recoverable Sparse Attention for Block-Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) refine multiple tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. Their long-context inference, however, remains bottlenecked by memory-bound attention: every denoising step repeatedly reads a growing historical key--value (KV) cache. Directly applying sparse attention does not fully solve this problem, because different queries can select different pages, inflating the block's collective read set, while repeated support construction adds overhead and permanent eviction can discard information needed later. We present RISA, a recoverable sparse-attention method with shared read plans for block-wise DLMs. RISA exploits the fact that historical KV remains fixed within a block while queries evolve across denoising steps. Newly generated history is organized into exact priority and recovery tiers; seed queries then build a protected, bounded read plan whose indices are reused across the block while attention is recomputed with fresh queries and current-block KV. This separates history preservation from repeated reading and amortizes sparse-support construction without changing the backbone or decoder. On DreamReasoner-8B, RISA retains comparable task performance. At 32K, the default configuration speeds up attention by $2.67\times$ and fixed-trajectory requests by $1.36\times$ over dense, and attention speedup reaches $5.53\times$ at 128K. Across eight settings on three models, RISA decodes faster than the tested MAGE, QUEST, and LoSA budgets at matched KL.

AI.tldr: RISA：面向块扩散语言模型的可恢复稀疏注意力，用块内共享的读取计划（seed query 构建、整块复用）加速长上下文推理，在保持任务性能的同时显著提速注意力。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型虽能并行去噪多个 token，但长上下文推理受内存受限注意力瓶颈制约：每个去噪步都要重复读取不断增长的历史 KV cache。直接套用稀疏注意力效果有限——不同 query 选择的 page 不同会膨胀整块的集合读取量，重复构建支持集带来额外开销，且永久驱逐会丢失后续所需信息。
AI.method: RISA 利用“块内历史 KV 固定、query 随去噪步演化”的特性：(1) 将新生成历史组织为精确优先级层与可恢复层；(2) 由 seed query 构建一个有界且受保护的读取计划，其索引在整块内复用；(3) 用最新 query 与当前块 KV 重算注意力。从而将历史保留与重复读取解耦，摊薄稀疏支持集构建开销，且不改变骨干网络与解码器。
AI.result: 在 DreamReasoner-8B 上任务性能相当；32K 时默认配置注意力提速 2.67×，固定轨迹请求提速 1.36×；128K 时注意力提速达 5.53×。在三个模型、八种设置下，匹配 KL 时解码速度快于 MAGE、QUEST、LoSA。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享读取计划与可恢复分层历史，RISA 有效缓解块扩散模型长上下文推理中的 KV 重复读取瓶颈，在保持性能的同时实现随长度增长的显著加速，并优于现有稀疏注意力基线。

title: Data-Efficient Algal Bloom Segmentation in Freshwater Bodies Using a Three-Stage Transfer Learning Pipeline with Attention-Enhanced Decoding
summary: Harmful algal blooms threaten water quality and public health, yet automated segmentation of bloom regions in freshwater imagery is limited by scarce pixel-level annotations. We present a transfer-learning pipeline that adapts a Swin Transformer U-Net with SCSE decoder attention from ImageNet-1K to water-body segmentation (RIWA, LaRS) and then to algal blooms, together with a model-assisted annotation protocol that expands the labelled algae corpus from 145 to 655 images. In a single-seed ablation on a 41-image validation split (checkpoint S2-A4 and its variants), corpus expansion is the dominant factor (+11 mIoU points); water-body pretraining helps only on the expanded corpus (+1.1 points over ImageNet initialization); SCSE attention adds 0.3 points; and a learnable positional encoding lowers mIoU by 0.6 points and is omitted. Adding 476 images, 188 of them algae-free, reduces false-positive area on non-water scenes from 22.6% to 4.9%. Against nine baselines on a 256-image test split, a separately trained checkpoint of the same architecture (S2-A13) reaches mIoU 0.919 and the highest algae IoU (0.902); a near-duplicate audit indicates train/test overlap in this split, so these scores are likely optimistic.

AI.tldr: 提出迁移学习流程：将Swin Transformer U-Net与SCSE解码注意力从ImageNet迁移到水体分割再迁移到藻华分割，并用模型辅助标注将藻类数据从145扩到655张；扩增数据是主要增益来源（+11 mIoU），测试mIoU 0.919但存在训练/测试重叠隐患。
AI.motivation: 淡水藻华威胁水质与公共健康，但像素级标注稀缺限制了藻华区域的自动化分割。
AI.method: 基于Swin Transformer U-Net + SCSE解码注意力的迁移学习pipeline：ImageNet-1K → 水体分割（RIWA、LaRS）→ 藻华分割；配套模型辅助标注协议扩充藻类语料（145→655张）。在41张验证集上做单种子消融（S2-A4及其变体），并在256张测试集上与9个基线对比（另训S2-A13检查点），辅以近重复审计。
AI.result: 消融：语料扩增贡献最大（+11 mIoU）；水体预训练仅在扩增语料上有效（+1.1）；SCSE注意力+0.3；可学习位置编码-0.6（故弃用）。新增476张（188张无藻）使非水体场景误检面积从22.6%降至4.9%。测试集上S2-A13达mIoU 0.919、藻类IoU最高0.902。
AI.conclusion: 数据扩增与迁移策略有效提升藻华分割并显著降低误检；但近重复审计显示测试集存在训练/测试重叠，上述指标可能偏乐观，需在无重叠划分上重新验证。

title: Agent Trajectories as Evidence for Software Quality Assurance
comment: 3 pages, submitted to ICSE2027 AMPLIFY Workshop https://conf.researchr.org/home/icse-2027/amplify-2027#co-create-software-engineering-research-directions-then-develop-them-towards-ieee-tse
summary: Autonomous software agents increasingly plan, implement, and test software with limited human oversight. Their decisions may introduce implicit assumptions that final code and passing tests do not adequately expose. We propose analyzing observable agent trajectories alongside software and agent specifications and AI generated artifacts as evidence for targeted quality assurance. The aim is to prioritize consequential decisions for scrutiny, investigate their possible contribution to software problems, and inform improvements to specifications and development practices. Industrial experience motivates the idea; available execution records and preliminary analysis methods make it plausible. However, trajectories alone do not establish that decisions are justified, outcomes acceptable, or corrective changes effective. We ask how this evidence can support review, diagnosis, and continuous quality improvement, and when simpler QA approaches suffice. Perspectives from requirements engineering, verification and validation, agent systems, causal inference, empirical software engineering, and human factors could help develop and evaluate the idea.

AI.tldr: 提出将自主软件智能体的可观测轨迹与软件/智能体规范及AI生成物一并作为证据，用于定向质量保障，以识别需重点审查的关键决策。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体在少量人工监督下规划、实现并测试软件，其决策引入的隐性假设无法被最终代码和通过的测试充分暴露，存在质量风险。
AI.method: 以智能体可观测轨迹为核心证据，结合软件与智能体规范、AI生成制品，分析并优先排序后果重大的决策，追溯其对软件问题的影响，并反馈改进规范与开发实践（属立场/愿景型论文）。
AI.result: 工业经验支持该设想的动机，现有执行记录与初步分析方法使其具备可行性；但仅凭轨迹无法证明决策合理、结果可接受或纠正措施有效。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁结合需求工程、验证与确认、智能体系统、因果推断、经验软件工程与人因等视角，来开发并评估该证据驱动方法，同时明确何时更简单的QA方法已足够。

title: Weight-space programming for tractor guidance controller: large language models natively write neural network weights that steer a real tractor
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables (1 in the appendices); includes a field test on a real tractor
summary: Weight-space programming is a process where a large language model reads and writes the weights of a neural network directly, guided by a natural language specification, without an optimiser or gradient descent. This study applies it to automatic tractor guidance, where a 253-parameter neural network steers along paths of lines and arcs and must be adapted when the machine changes, such as a slower steering actuator. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 (also 5.2) edited the network for our research tractor using a small budget of simulated evaluations to repair a network trained for another tractor and write a controller into a network with zero weights. We compared them with an evolution strategy, gradient descent and pure pursuit in simulation and on the real tractor. Both models read the network and analysed the closed loop with control theory correctly, and Fable's repair without simulation succeeded only occasionally. With simulated feedback, both models repaired the trained network in single sessions and wrote a working controller from zero weights, whereas from zero the evolution strategy found none. The controllers written from zero were sparse and in a classical cascaded structure; one model edited the trained network while the other replaced it. Gradient descent reached higher accuracy with far more simulation, and all language model controllers steered the real tractor without intervention, with errors of the same order as pure pursuit. Language models can program the weights of a neural controller directly, much as control engineers design one. We call this Weight-Space Engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文把"权重空间编程"应用于自动拖拉机导航：让大语言模型在少量仿真反馈下直接读写一个253参数神经网络控制器的权重，修复跨机器（如更慢的转向执行器）失配的网络并"从零写出"可工作的控制器，并在仿真与真机对比进化策略、梯度下降和纯追踪。
AI.motivation: 传统控制器适配依赖优化器/梯度下降与大量试错，成本高。作者想验证：大模型能否像控制工程师一样，直接基于自然语言规格读写网络权重，在极小评估预算内完成控制器适配与从零设计，从而提出"权重空间工程"这一新范式。
AI.method: 研究对象为沿直线与圆弧路径转向的253参数网络。GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Fable 5.1/5.2 在小预算仿真评估下：（1）修复为另一台拖拉机训练的网络（含无仿真与有仿真反馈两种设定）；（2）在零权重网络上"写入"控制器。对照组为进化策略、梯度下降与纯追踪，均在仿真与真实拖拉机上测试，并对模型读网络与闭环的控制理论分析正确性做了评估。
AI.result: 两模型均能正确读取网络并对闭环做控制理论分析。无仿真反馈时，Fable的修复仅偶尔成功；有仿真反馈时，两模型均能在单次会话内完成修复并从零写出可用控制器，而进化策略从零未找到任何解。从零写出的控制器稀疏且呈经典级联结构；一模型是"编辑"已训网络，另一模型是"替换"。梯度下降精度更高但仿真消耗远超。所有语言模型控制器均能在真机上无干预转向，误差与纯追踪同一量级。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型能够直接以类似控制工程师的方式编程神经控制器的权重，在极小评估预算下完成修复与从零合成；这被作者命名为"权重空间工程"。其精度不及大规模梯度下降，但样本效率高、结构可解释，展示出LLM作为权重空间工程师的可行性与局限。

title: Big Brains, Tiny Board: Pupavision, an Agentic Physical AI Instrument for Monitoring Drosophila Pupariation and Lifecycle Transitions
summary: Many biology experiments are limited by the availability and ease of use of instruments that monitor and record them. For example, the timing of pupariation in the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, a widely used model organism, can provide biologically relevant information about growth regulation and is often recorded manually. Here, we present Pupavision, a small physical AI instrument built from a single-board Linux computer and a day/night camera for roughly 45 to 75 US dollars in parts. The key idea is that a frontier coding agent runs its agentic harness directly on the tiny board. The model thinks in the cloud, but the agent works on the device. The agent assists image capture, writes code to repair errors, and checks the experiment every day to keep raw data capture reliable. If recording stops, the researcher gets a ping on their mobile phone. A simple deterministic capture service records one image every ten minutes and never depends on the agent. We report a 26-day pilot in a fly incubator (about 3,580 frames), including eleven days in which the agent was logged out and capture continued, and a 51-hour outage whose cause led to the layered design. A researcher-in-the-loop workflow then produces per-vial pupariation curves by tracing selected pupae backward in time from a late reference frame. Future work will validate the assay for lifecycle tracking accuracy against expert-labeled data and expand real-time computer vision analysis. Pupavision offers a blueprint for do-it-yourself agentic instruments that put frontier intelligence on a tiny board, with deterministic code underneath. We present this as an early case study from a pilot lab deployment and contribute lessons learned toward a future where scientific domain experts are empowered by DIY agentic hardware.

AI.tldr: Pupavision 是一款约 45–75 美元、基于单板 Linux 电脑与昼夜相机的"智能体仪器"，把前沿编码智能体直接运行在小板子上，用于自动监测果蝇化蛹时间。26 天中试（≈3580 帧，含 11 天智能体离线）证明确定性采集服务可保障数据可靠性。
AI.motivation: 生物学实验常受限于监测仪器的可用性与易用性；果蝇化蛹时间等关键指标依赖人工记录，费时且易出错。作者希望用低成本、DIY 的智能体硬件降低门槛。
AI.method: 用单板 Linux 计算机加昼夜相机搭建仪器；核心思路是让前沿编码智能体在其自带的 agentic harness 上直接运行于设备端（"模型在云端思考，智能体在设备上工作"），协助图像采集、自动写代码修复错误、每日巡检，并在录制中断时向手机推送提醒；底层由一个与智能体完全解耦、每 10 分钟拍摄一张的确定性采集服务保障。数据分析采用人在回路的工作流：从后期参考帧出发回溯选定蛹的时间，生成每个培养瓶的化蛹曲线。
AI.result: 完成 26 天果蝇培养箱中试，约 3580 帧，其中 11 天智能体登出而采集持续；经历一次 51 小时中断，该故障促成了分层设计。可生成分瓶化蛹曲线。
AI.conclusion: Pupavision 为"把前沿智能放到小板子上、底层由确定性代码兜底"的 DIY 智能体仪器提供了蓝图；作为早期实验室部署案例，作者总结了经验教训，未来将用专家标注数据验证生命周期追踪精度并扩展实时计算机视觉分析。

title: EGS: A Complementary Safety Framework for Educational LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong potential for personalized education, but adolescent-facing deployment raises risks of toxic, biased, misleading, or developmentally inappropriate content. We argue that educational safety should move beyond binary refusal: student queries are often ambiguous or curiosity-driven, requiring contextual guidance rather than simple blocking. We introduce the Educational Guardrail System (EGS), a lightweight, model-agnostic runtime framework that complements intrinsic alignment through query moderation, scenario-aware pedagogical guidance, and response moderation. EGS triages inputs by risk level, redirects gray-zone queries with category-specific educational interventions, and audits outputs before delivery. Experiments across general and education-specific benchmarks show that EGS improves moderation performance, refusal quality, and jailbreak robustness across diverse LLMs. These findings suggest that defense-in-depth guardrails can strengthen safety while preserving the pedagogical utility required in educational LLMs. Our code and model weights will be publicly available to support community adoption.

AI.tldr: 提出教育护栏系统EGS，用查询审核、情境感知教学引导与回复审核三层机制替代二元拒绝，提升教育场景下LLM的安全性与教学可用性。
AI.motivation: LLM用于青少年个性化教育潜力大，但存在有毒、偏见、误导或不适龄内容风险。现有安全对齐多为二元拒绝，而学生提问常模糊或出于好奇，简单屏蔽会损害教学价值，需要情境化引导。
AI.method: EGS是轻量、模型无关的运行时框架，与内在对齐互补：按风险等级对输入分流，对灰区查询施以类别特定的教育干预进行重定向引导，并在输出交付前审核回复。
AI.result: 在通用与教育专用基准上，EGS在多种LLM上均提升了审核性能、拒绝质量与越狱鲁棒性，同时保持教学效用。
AI.conclusion: 纵深防御式护栏可在保障安全的同时保留教育LLM所需的教学价值；代码与模型权重将公开以促进社区采用。

title: Segmentation-Guided Direct Capacity Estimation of Rooftop Photovoltaics from Aerial Imagery
summary: Distribution planners need installation-level inventories of rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity, but interconnection records may be incomplete or spatially aggregated. Conventional image-based estimators segment PV arrays, convert the mask to physical area, and multiply by an estimated power density, coupling capacity prediction to mask-derived area. We propose Direct Head, a segmentation-guided architecture that retains U-Net segmentation and soft-mask pooling while directly regressing nonnegative capacity from PV-region features and area descriptors. We evaluate three independent runs on 7,590 French rooftop installations under the original split and a department-based holdout. Relative to a parameter-matched area-density neural model, Direct Head reduces mean absolute error by 8.7% and 12.5%, and symmetric mean absolute percentage error by 14.0% and 20.7%, respectively. Comparisons with conventional estimators, controlled architecture variants, auxiliary-loss ablations, and representative cases show that segmentation provides useful spatial evidence without requiring capacity to be determined by an area-density product.

AI.tldr: 提出 Direct Head 架构：保留 U-Net 分割与软掩码池化，直接从 PV 区域特征和面积描述符回归非负容量，避免"掩码面积×功率密度"的间接估计。
AI.motivation: 配电网规划需要安装级屋顶光伏容量清单，但并网记录不完整或空间聚合。传统图像估计先分割光伏阵列、将掩码转物理面积再乘功率密度，使容量预测被绑定在掩码面积上，误差累积。
AI.method: 分割引导架构：U-Net 分割 + 软掩码池化，直接由 PV 区域特征与面积描述符回归非负容量。在 7,590 个法国屋顶安装上做三次独立运行，采用原始划分与基于省份（department）的留出测试；并与参数匹配的面积-密度神经模型、传统估计器、受控架构变体、辅助损失消融对比。
AI.result: 相较参数匹配的面积-密度模型，MAE 分别降低 8.7% 与 12.5%，对称平均绝对百分比误差降低 14.0% 与 20.7%。
AI.conclusion: 分割提供有用空间证据，但容量无需由面积-密度乘积决定；直接回归更准确，案例与消融支持该设计。

title: Formal Analysis of a Fault-Tolerant Extension of the ROSACE Flight Controller
summary:
Autonomous avionics controllers must satisfy stringent real-time functional and performance require- ments even in the presence of run-time faults. In this paper, we analyze ROSACE, an open-source control engineering benchmark for flight control systems, focusing on its run-time resilience against faults such as sensor noise and sensor failures. We extend the benchmark with an FDIR (Fault Detection, Identification and Recovery) component based on Triple Modular Redundancy.
  Our approach builds upon COMPASTA, a tool for Model-Based Design developed on top of the TASTE tool by ESA. COMPASTA enables the modeling and injection of faults into a system's design. Moreover, it implements a simulation-based verification and validation workflow, automating the generation and execution of a set of test cases, based on a user-defined notion of coverage. Using COMPASTA, we construct a set of formal models, with faults and with FDIR, and we formally analyze their impact on the system properties. The analysis is based on the coupling of the formal models with the Simulink models used for the simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对开源飞控基准 ROSACE，用基于 TMR 的 FDIR 组件扩展它，并借助 COMPASTA 工具对含故障与 FDIR 的形式化模型进行建模、故障注入与仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 自主航电控制器在运行时故障（如传感器噪声、传感器失效）下仍需满足严格的实时功能与性能要求，因此需要分析 ROSACE 基准的运行时弹性并具备故障检测、识别与恢复能力。
AI.method: 以 ESA TASTE 之上的模型驱动设计工具 COMPASTA 为基础，将带有 TMR 的 FDIR 加入 ROSACE；COMPASTA 支持在设计阶段建模与注入故障，并基于用户定义的覆盖准则自动生成、执行测试用例进行仿真验证；构建带故障和 FDIR 的形式化模型，并将其与仿真用 Simulink 模型耦合，形式化分析其对系统性质的影响。
AI.result: 构建了含故障注入与 FDIR 的形式化模型集合，并通过与 Simulink 仿真的耦合，形式化地评估了故障及 FDIR 对系统性质的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明可将形式化建模、故障注入与仿真验证流程结合，用于评估 ROSACE 飞控系统在故障下的运行时弹性，并为 FDIR 设计提供可分析的工程化方法。

title: Solver to System: LLM Reasoning Across Representations and Execution in Scientific Simulation
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models. 23 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables
summary: Simulators based on partial differential equations (PDEs) are widely used to model physical systems, but generating and interpreting PDE solver code with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. Scientific simulation code is a useful testbed for LLM scientific reasoning because (1) one system can be represented by code, equations, natural language, and numerical trajectories and (2) code can execute successfully while implementing invalid physics. We introduce Solver2System, a dataset of PDE solvers with multiple representations, controlled corruptions, and lexical perturbations, to evaluate whether LLMs can recover the underlying physical system through (1) cross-representation consistency and (2) static and agentic detection of physical invalidity. Across eight open-weight models, LLMs systematically favor some representations when evidence conflicts, and lexical perturbations to code alter interpretation of other unchanged representations. Execution improves physical-validity judgments, but weaker agents can judge correctly without identifying the causal defect. Thus, LLMs may reach correct judgments despite inconsistent representation reconciliation or causal misdiagnosis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Solver2System数据集，用于评估LLM能否从PDE求解器代码中恢复底层物理系统。实验发现LLM在表征冲突时存在系统性偏好，词法扰动会影响对其他不变表征的理解，且执行代码虽改善物理有效性判断但较弱模型常"判断正确却诊断错误"。
AI.motivation: PDE求解器广泛用于物理建模，但用LLM生成和理解求解器代码仍具挑战。科学仿真代码是测试LLM科学推理的理想平台：同一系统可用代码、方程、自然语言和数值轨迹多种表征，且代码可成功运行却实现错误物理。现有评估缺乏对LLM能否跨表征一致性推理及检测物理无效性的系统检验。
AI.method: 构建Solver2System数据集，包含带多表征、受控损坏和词法扰动的PDE求解器。从两个维度评估LLM：(1)跨表征一致性——能否通过代码、方程、语言、轨迹互相印证恢复物理系统；(2)物理无效性检测——静态检测与基于智能体（agentic）的运行检测。在八个开放权重模型上进行实验。
AI.result: LLM在证据冲突时系统性地偏好某些表征；对代码的词法扰动会改变模型对其他未改动表征的解读。执行代码能改善物理有效性判断，但较弱智能体可在未识别因果缺陷的情况下给出正确判断。
AI.conclusion: LLM可能得出正确判断，却伴随不一致的表征调和或因果误诊。这表明当前LLM在科学仿真代码推理上存在表征偏好、脆弱性和"对而不知其因"的问题，Solver2System为诊断这些缺陷提供了基准。

title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
comment: 10 pages, accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Open-weight language models are widely observed to get worse the longer they generate. Often, attempts to fix this involve more training. At high temperature, The sampler, i.e. the rule that picks the next token out of the model's probabilities, decides whether long and agentic generation survives and/or thrives. We test 29 open-weight models from 1B to 122B parameters on ten established benchmarks plus needle retrieval out to one million tokens, covering SWE-bench Verified coding agents, long chain-of-thought reasoning, long-form writing, long structured output and long-context reading. Samplers that keep their pool of candidate tokens small and steady as temperature rises don't lose accuracy. Samplers that let in low-probability tokens fall apart. At temperature 2, coding agents running top-p, top-k or Top-H resolve 0 of 100 GitHub issues, while the same agents running top-nsigma resolve 46 to 62 and win every issue the two samplers disagree on, on three Qwen3.5 models. Over all benchmarks top-nsigma keeps a median 100% of its temperature-1 score where top-p keeps 26%. Counting how many tokens each sampler lets through explains why. In one Llama-3.1-8B story, going from temperature 1 to 2 grows top-p's pool from 4 tokens to 51,845 while top-nsigma stays at 3. Across 133 combinations of sampler setting and temperature, the typical pool size predicts judged quality (Spearman correlation of -0.77), and when we pick the pool at temperature 1 and only apply temperature afterwards, Top-H, min-p and p-less stop collapsing. At the default temperature of 1 most samplers perform about the same, We release all code and data to the public.

AI.tldr: 开放权重语言模型长文本生成越久越差，问题常出在高温下的采样器（sampler）而非训练。作者在29个1B–122B模型、10个基准加100万token检索任务上测试采样器，发现候选池大小是关键：top-p/top-k/Top-H在高温下退化严重，top-nsigma能保持精度。
AI.motivation: 开放权重模型在长生成（代码agent、长链推理、长文写作、长结构化输出、长上下文读取）中质量随长度下降，现有补救多依赖更多训练。作者认为高温下"下一个token如何从概率中挑选"（采样器规则）才是长生成能否存活的关键，而这一点被忽视。
AI.method: 测试29个开放权重模型（1B–122B），覆盖10个已有基准 + 100万token的needle retrieval，任务含SWE-bench Verified代码agent、长链思维推理、长文写作、长结构化输出、长上下文阅读；对比top-p、top-k、Top-H、min-p、p-less、top-nsigma等采样器在不同温度下的表现；用"每个采样器放行的候选token池大小"作机制解释，并在133种采样器设置×温度组合上做池大小与主观质量的相关分析。
AI.result: 温度2下，使用top-p/top-k/Top-H的代码agent在三个Qwen3.5模型上解决0/100个GitHub issue，而top-nsigma解决46–62个，并在两者分歧的issue上全胜。全基准上top-nsigma保持温度1成绩的中位数100%，top-p仅26%。Llama-3.1-8B示例中，温度1→2时top-p候选池从4个token膨胀到51,845个，而top-nsigma稳定在3个。133种组合中，典型池大小可预测质量（Spearman −0.77）；在温度1选池再施加温度，Top-H、min-p、p-less也不再崩塌。温度1（默认）时各采样器表现大致相同。
AI.conclusion: 长生成精度下降主要由高温下采样器放行低概率token导致，而非必须靠更多训练解决。保持候选池小而稳定（如top-nsigma）可维持长生成质量；池大小是可解释、可预测的机制指标。作者公开全部代码与数据。

title: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
comment: 8 pages main text, 20 pages in total, 6 figures, 11 tables
summary: Benchmarks for LLM diagnostic agents are built from retrospective records: the case an agent reads is rewritten from discharge summaries, and unrecorded test results are generated by a simulator that often sees the final diagnosis. HindAudit separates three hindsight channels (the diagnosis given to the simulator, the retrospective context it conditions on, and the agent-facing case text) and measures each with judges trained only on real data. On 27,489 emergency admissions from MIMIC-IV, five registered tests found no leakage into simulated laboratory results: providing the diagnosis to five simulators had a negligible effect, and prompted gatekeepers diluted the diagnostic signal, although exploratory results suggest they can raise agent scores. The largest effect lay in the case text. Against a presentation-time reconstruction from triage records, benchmark-style summaries raised the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7% and discharge histories to 45.3%, and raised six interactive agents' scores while barely changing their ranking. The exploratory gap was reproduced in a registered replication on held-out patients. Masking diagnosis names left it unchanged. Because MIMIC lacks a contemporaneous bedside history, the gap is an upper bound on hindsight. We report all registered outcomes and recommend construction practices.

AI.tldr: 论文提出HindAudit框架，将LLM诊断智能体基准中的"后见之明"泄漏拆分为三个通道（模拟器可见诊断、回顾性上下文、面向智能体的病例文本），并用仅训练于真实数据的判别器分别度量。发现在27,489例MIMIC-IV急诊入院中，模拟检验结果无泄漏，最大泄漏来自病例文本：相比基于分诊记录的就诊时重构，基准式摘要把四个LLM零样本准确率从25.4%抬高到39.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM诊断基准多由回顾性病历（出院小结等）改写而成，未记录的检验结果由常能看到最终诊断的模拟器生成，可能引入"后见之明"信息泄漏，夸大智能体的真实诊断能力，而此前缺乏对各泄漏来源的分离与量化。
AI.method: 提出HindAudit，区分三条后见之明通道（给模拟器的诊断、其条件化的回顾性上下文、智能体面对的病例文本），用仅基于真实数据训练的评判器分别度量；在MIMIC-IV的27,489例急诊入院上开展五项注册检验，比较分诊记录重构、基准式摘要、出院病史三种输入下的零样本准确率与交互智能体表现，并做掩蔽诊断名称与留出患者复现实验。
AI.result: 五项注册检验未发现模拟检验结果泄漏，向五个模拟器提供诊断影响可忽略；提示式把关者削弱了诊断信号，但探索性结果显示可提高智能体得分。最大效应在病例文本：基准式摘要使四个LLM零样本准确率由25.4%升至39.7%，出院病史升至45.3%，六个交互智能体得分上升但排名几乎不变；探索性差距在留出患者上复现，掩蔽诊断名称后差距不变。
AI.conclusion: 后见之明泄漏主要经由病例文本而非模拟器诊断，且可能在不改变智能体排名的情况下系统性抬高绝对分数；由于MIMIC缺少同期床旁病史，所测差距是后见之明的上界。作者报告全部注册结果并提出基准构建建议。

title: When AUC Meets Generative Reconstruction: A Unified Principle for Balanced Visual Representation Learning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require visual encoders that extract fine-grained visual features while constructing semantically disentangled and discriminative representations. Conventional methodologies encounter a fundamental trade-off: contrastive learning enhances inter-class discrimination by suppressing intra-class variability, whereas generative reconstruction emphasizes perceptual fidelity but lacks explicit comparative supervision. The naive aggregation of these objectives via composite loss functions often induces optimization conflicts and instability due to gradient interference within the shared latent space. To resolve this, we introduce a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem within the generative output manifold. Our approach maintains perceptual reconstruction as a supervisory signal and integrates a ranking-based discriminative constraint by systematically ordering matched and mismatched reconstruction outputs. This formulation embeds discriminative information seamlessly into the generative process, alleviating the risk of loss competition. Specifically, we propose AUC Generative Reconstruction (AUCGR), which optimizes the area under the ROC curve (AUC) by ensuring higher scores for matched pairs than for mismatched pairs, and Partial AUC Generative Reconstruction (pAUCGR), which addresses supervision bias by focusing on mismatched comparisons within reliable feature subspaces. The proposed objectives are designed to be plug-and-play, requiring no architectural modifications to existing generative reconstruction frameworks. Theoretical analysis establishes rigorous connections to AUC/pAUC optimization and provides generalization guarantees. Extensive experiments validate that our method advances both discriminative accuracy and fine-grained perceptual representation.

AI.tldr: 提出将生成式重建统一重构为生成输出流形上的判别性排序问题，实现AUCGR与pAUCGR两个即插即用目标，无需改动架构，缓解损失冲突并兼顾判别精度与细粒度感知表征。
AI.motivation: MLLM需要既细粒度又语义解耦、判别性强的视觉编码特征。对比学习提升类间区分但压制类内变化，生成式重建强调感知保真却缺少显式比较监督；用复合损失简单叠加两种目标会因共享隐空间中的梯度干扰引发优化冲突与不稳定。
AI.method: 将生成式重建重新表述为生成输出流形上的判别性排序问题：保留感知重建作为监督信号，同时对匹配与不匹配的重建输出进行系统排序，把判别信息嵌入生成过程。具体提出AUCGR（优化ROC曲线下面积，使匹配对得分高于不匹配对）与pAUCGR（仅在可靠特征子空间内做不匹配比较，缓解监督偏差），并给出与AUC/pAUC优化的理论联系及泛化保证。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了与AUC/pAUC优化的严格联系并提供泛化保证；大量实验表明方法在判别准确性与细粒度感知表征上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将判别约束以排序形式融入生成重建，可避免复合损失的竞争问题，且方法即插即用、无需架构修改，为MLLM视觉编码器提供了兼顾判别性与感知保真度的统一表征学习范式。

title: BehaVerify: A Formal Verification Tool for Behavior Trees
summary: This paper presents BehaVerify, a verification toolbox for behavior trees (BTs) and Neuro-Symbolic BTs. BTs are a graphical language for planning and sequencing behaviors - similar to extended state machines - and are increasingly used in safety-critical domains. BehaVerify enables users to specify a BT using a Domain Specific Language (DSL) with formal syntax and semantics. This language further includes Linear Temporal Logic and Computation Tree Logic specifications. BehaVerify uses an efficient encoding into nuXmv, called fastforwarding, to quickly verify if a specification holds over the BT. Additionally, BehaVerify can generate implementations of the BT in Python and Haskell. Through Python, BehaVerify has been integrated with PyTrees and Robot Operating System (ROS) and has been deployed to several autonomous robotic systems, including for verifying runtime monitors. While prior works have developed the underlying theory, this manuscript focuses on the toolbox usage, functionality and implementation. BehaVerify is open source: https://github.com/verivital/behaverify

AI.tldr: BehaVerify是一个用于行为树（BT）及神经符号行为树的开源验证工具箱，通过DSL建模并编码到nuXmv进行快速形式化验证，同时可生成Python/Haskell实现并集成ROS。
AI.motivation: 行为树越来越多地用于安全攸关领域，但缺乏配套的易用验证工具；已有工作偏重理论，需要面向工具箱的使用、功能与实现的系统性呈现。
AI.method: 提供带形式语法语义的DSL描述BT，支持LTL与CTL规范；采用名为fastforwarding的高效编码转换到nuXmv进行验证；并可生成Python、Haskell实现，通过Python集成PyTrees与ROS。
AI.result: 实现开源工具箱BehaVerify，能在BT上快速验证规范是否成立，已部署到多个自主机器人系统，包括用于运行时监控器的验证。
AI.conclusion: BehaVerify作为开源工具，将形式化验证与行为树工程实践结合，便于在安全关键机器人系统中应用。

title: Large Language Models as Nonlinear Dynamical Systems: The Three Clocks of Depth, Training, and Generation
summary: Language models are dynamical systems. A transformer is iterated over its layers, over the steps of its training and over the tokens it generates, and on each of these three clocks it shows behavior that nonlinear dynamics has studied for a century: fixed points, bifurcations, synchronization, chaos and noise-driven escape from potential wells. The two communities rarely meet, so this behavior is often rediscovered under new names. We build a bridge between them. To describe, we condense about 200 papers into the Three-Clock Dictionary, which maps fifteen concepts of nonlinear dynamics onto each clock and marks every correspondence as proved, measured or conjectured, and we show each concept in a mechanical system and in a language model side by side. To explain, we derive reduced-order models: the softmax is a Boltzmann distribution, gradient descent an Euler step on a nonlinear spring, a loss spike a ball thrown out of a stiff valley, attention on the circle a Kuramoto model, and a repetition loop a well that deepens while it is occupied. We then test these explanations on open language models, on a laptop CPU. Escape from repetition loops in GPT-2 and Pythia follows the Arrhenius law with the logit gap as the barrier, and the barrier deepens and then saturates, so the temperature needed to leave a loop falls like $1/\ln N$ with the generation length $N$ and rises with model size. Coherent text lives in a narrow window of temperatures, which a small reasoning model shares at its recommended temperature. Training makes each Pythia layer more expansive, and a small transformer trains at a multi-mode edge of stability. The third step, solving problems of language models, is still ahead: controllers derived from the escape analysis remove loops but do not yet beat the best fixed temperature. We state twelve open problems where nonlinear dynamics could get there.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"三时钟词典"，把非线性动力学中十五个概念映射到语言模型的层间迭代、训练步与生成 token 三个"时钟"上，并用降阶模型给出解释，在 GPT-2、Pythia 等开源模型上验证（如重复循环逃逸服从 Arrhenius 定律）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在层、训练步、生成 token 三个尺度上表现出固定点、分岔、同步、混沌、噪声驱动逃逸等非线性动力学现象，但非线性动力学与语言模型两个社区少有交流，导致同一现象被反复以新名字重新发现。作者希望搭建桥梁，统一描述并加以解释。
AI.method: 1）综述式"三时钟词典"：将约200篇文献归纳为15个非线性动力学概念，逐一映射到三个时钟并标注"已证明/已测量/猜想"；2）降阶建模：softmax≈玻尔兹曼分布、梯度下降≈非线性弹簧上的欧拉步、loss spike≈被抛出刚性势谷的小球、圆上注意力≈Kuramoto 模型、重复循环≈越陷越深的势井；3）在笔记本 CPU 上对开源模型做实验检验。
AI.result: GPT-2 与 Pythia 的重复循环逃逸服从 Arrhenius 定律，势垒为 logit gap；势垒先加深后饱和，故脱离循环所需温度随生成长度 N 以 1/ln N 下降、随模型规模上升。连贯文本只存在于窄温度窗口，小型推理模型在其推荐温度下亦处于该窗口。训练使 Pythia 各层趋向"扩张"，小 transformer 在多模稳定边缘训练。
AI.conclusion: 描述与解释两步已初步完成，第三步（用该框架解决语言模型问题）尚未达成：基于逃逸分析的控制器能消除循环但未超越最佳固定温度。作者提出十二个开放问题，指出非线性动力学可能在此发力的方向。

title: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents
summary: Tool-augmented medical agents treat whatever their tools return as evidence. We show that this default is costly: medical tools fail silently, and a frozen reasoner cannot ignore what enters its context, so many cases it would have answered correctly are flipped to wrong once tool outputs are added. We call this evidence hijacking. $\mathcal{V}$-information explains the phenomenon: the reasoner has lost the option to ignore, so a tool output can carry negative usable information, and moving the decision of what to keep outside the reasoner restores that option. The theory further shows that part of any filtering gain comes merely from letting the reasoner see less, and only selection by content lets it see better. Building on this, we recast tool-augmented reasoning as evidence governance, which separates deciding what counts as evidence from the reasoner that answers, and propose context-independent evidence governance (CIEG), the first medical agent framework that rules, after acquisition, on whether each individual tool output may enter as evidence. Every tool output is written as a card that can be checked against the raw input; an independent checker that sees only the input and the cards decides which cards become evidence; and the reasoner answers from the admitted cards alone, with no training anywhere. On medical question answering, fundus glaucoma screening, and chest X-ray pneumonia classification, it achieves the highest accuracy among models of comparable scale, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tool-using agents and multi-agent systems built on the same backbone at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 提出"证据劫持"概念，将工具增强推理重构为证据治理，提出CIEG框架：把"是否作为证据"的裁决从推理器外部化，无需训练即在多项医学任务上取得同规模最佳准确率。
AI.motivation: 工具增强医学agent默认把工具返回内容当作证据，但医学工具会"静默失败"，而冻结的推理器无法忽略进入上下文的内容，导致本可答对的样本被污染为错误（证据劫持）。理论分析表明过滤收益部分仅来自"看得更少"，只有基于内容的选择才"看得更好"，因此需要把证据取舍决策移到推理器之外。
AI.method: 以𝒱-information理论解释该现象；据此提出证据治理范式，将"判定何为证据"与"作答推理"分离；实现CIEG框架：每个工具输出写成可对照原始输入核查的card，由独立checker（仅见输入与card）裁定哪些card成为证据，推理器仅基于准入card作答，全程无训练。
AI.result: 在医学问答、眼底青光眼筛查、胸部X光肺炎分类上，准确率在同等规模模型中最高，并显著优于同骨干的SOTA工具使用agent与多agent系统，且成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 冻结推理器无法忽略工具输出，故证据准入必须在推理器外部完成；内容驱动的独立核查式证据治理能有效缓解证据劫持，以零训练、低成本获得更强性能。

title: OfficePrism: Benchmarking Agents on Single-Domain Operations Across Enterprise Business Functions
summary: Broad workplace scores can mix competence within one business function with the extra cost of coordinating across functions and systems, making failures hard to localize. OfficePrism evaluates this prerequisite through 420 single-domain enterprise tasks spanning seven business functions under shared, benchmark-defined L1--L3 task-structure levels. Each task runs in a fresh environment combining a shared synthetic organization with one function-specific domain and yped state access. Our pipeline uses grounded records, business rules, and tool schemas to jointly construct a Chinese-language ticket, a hidden executable reference witness, and an expected response, followed by automated filtering and human curation. The same task set is evaluated through full-schema and search-and-dispatch packages. Across 124 model--harness--package configurations, the per-case joint natural-language-and-database pass rate ranges from 22.6% to 76.4%, with a median of 67.9%. L1 is highest in all 124 configurations, and L2 exceeds L3 in 122. Among 50 configurations sharing the same harness and model labels across both packages, search scores higher in 30, ties in one, and scores lower in 19.

AI.tldr: 提出 OfficePrism 基准，用 420 个单业务域企业任务（覆盖七大职能、统一 L1–L3 任务结构难度）评估智能体在办公场景中的"自然语言+数据库"联合完成能力，并揭示现有模型在跨系统落地任务上的显著短板。
AI.motivation: 宽泛的职场评分会把单一职能内的能力与跨职能、跨系统协调的额外成本混在一起，导致失败难以定位。作者希望构建一个只隔离单一业务域的评测环境，使能力评估更可归因。
AI.method: 每个任务在全新环境中运行，结合共享的合成组织 + 一个职能专属域 + 带类型的状态访问；用有依据的记录、业务规则与工具 schema 联合构造中文工单、隐藏的可执行参考解（witness）和期望回复，并经自动过滤与人工审校；同一套任务通过"全 schema 包"和"搜索-派发包"两种方式评测。
AI.result: 在 124 个模型–harness–包组合中，单例"自然语言+数据库"联合通过率介于 22.6%–76.4%，中位数 67.9%。所有 124 个组合中 L1 均最高，L2 在 122 个组合中高于 L3；50 个同 harness 同模型标签的组合里，搜索包得分更高 30 个、持平 1 个、更低 19 个。
AI.conclusion: OfficePrism 提供了可归因、难度分层的单域企业任务评测；结果显示模型能力随任务结构层级明显下降，且工具/包设计（全 schema 与搜索派发）对得分影响不具单调性，需结合模型与 harness 具体匹配。

title: CueSplat: Learning to Schedule Sparse Deformation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting on Edge Devices
summary: Deformation-based 4D Gaussian splatting (4DGS) enables dynamic scene rendering. However, evaluating deformation networks for all Gaussians at every frame is compute-intensive on edge devices. We find that Gaussian trajectories are often locally predictable, yet prediction reliability varies across Gaussians and time. Thus, we propose CueSplat, a post-training framework that exploits local temporal regularity while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen and retaining its Gaussian set. Specifically, CueSplat predicts Gaussian attributes from recent history and uses a lightweight learned router to select exact deformation updates within a scene-specific budget calibrated offline. Selection accounts for prediction reliability and rendering contribution. Selected indices are reused across nearby frames to reduce routing overhead, while selected Gaussians still receive exact updates each frame. To control accumulated prediction error, we use drift signals to schedule three consecutive full-deformation frames that rebuild the prediction history. Evaluated across four mainstream 4DGS algorithms, CueSplat achieves up to $6.74\times$ and $8.15\times$ speedups on Jetson AGX Orin and Orin NX, respectively, with a negligible quality drop (at most $0.16$ dB in dataset-average PSNR).

AI.tldr: CueSplat是一个训练后框架，利用高斯轨迹的局部时间可预测性，在冻结的4DGS骨干上用学习路由器按预算选择需精确形变更新的高斯，实现边缘设备高效渲染。
AI.motivation: 变形式4DGS每帧对所有高斯评估形变网络计算量大，难以在边缘设备部署；而高斯轨迹往往局部可预测，但预测可靠性随高斯和时间变化。
AI.method: 冻结预训练骨干并保留其高斯集合；从近期历史预测高斯属性；用轻量学习路由器在离线校准的场景预算内，结合预测可靠性与渲染贡献选择需精确形变更新的高斯；所选索引在邻近帧复用降低路由开销，但所选高斯每帧仍获精确更新；用漂移信号调度连续三帧全形变更新以重建预测历史、控制累积误差。
AI.result: 在四种主流4DGS算法上，Jetson AGX Orin与Orin NX分别最高达6.74×和8.15×加速，质量下降可忽略（数据集平均PSNR最多降0.16 dB）。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用局部时间规律与预算化选择性精确更新，CueSplat在保持质量的同时显著加速边缘端4DGS渲染，具备良好通用性。

title: Adaptive Budget Allocation for Smart-Contract Fuzzing: Why Online Feedback Fails to Improve Vulnerability Triage
comment: Accepted to the 22nd International Conference on Mobility, Sensing and Networking (MSN 2026). Camera-ready version. 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Smart-contract fuzzing campaigns share a finite budget and vary widely in the execution cost of a first correct-class vulnerability report. Using trace replay on 143 annotated and 350 bug-injected contracts, we test whether online feedback improves triage. At a mean budget of 100 executions per contract, uniform allocation reaches 72% and 70% of the respective clairvoyant optima. All eight online policies trail uniform on aggregate triage, as do the seven repeated on the bug-injected corpus. Five online signals yield ranking AUCs of 0.32-0.51 for imminent reports. Synthetic-oracle experiments show that sufficiently accurate detection-cost estimates recover more of the gap than detectability rankings. This motivates an offline probability-curve allocator that predicts first-report probabilities across budgets and allocates by predicted gain per execution. In a frozen evaluation on four fresh seeds per corpus, detection-budget AUC improves over uniform by 5.38% and 4.81% on the two source corpora and by 1.99-6.54% on three additional public benchmark subsets.

AI.tldr: 在智能合约模糊测试中，在线反馈无法优于均匀分配；检测代价估计比可检测性排序更关键，据此提出离线概率曲线分配器并取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 智能合约模糊测试预算有限，且各合约产生首个正确类别漏洞报告的执行代价差异很大。作者想检验：在线的运行时反馈能否改善"漏洞分诊"（即决定把执行预算投给哪些合约）这一环节。
AI.method: 在143个带标注合约和350个注入缺陷合约上做轨迹重放实验，平均每合约100次执行的预算下，将8种在线策略（其中7种在注入缺陷语料上重复）与均匀分配及"先知最优"对比；分析5个在线信号的排名AUC；再做合成预言机实验区分"检测代价估计"与"可检测性排序"两种信息的作用；最后提出离线概率曲线分配器——预测各预算下首个报告的到达概率，按"预测增益/执行次数"分配预算。
AI.result: 均匀分配在两组语料上分别达到先知最优的72%和70%；8种在线策略总体均落后于均匀分配；在线信号对"即将产生报告"的排名AUC仅0.32–0.51；合成预言机实验表明准确的检测代价估计能挽回更多差距。零样本冻结评估中，检测-预算AUC相对均匀分配提升5.38%和4.81%（两个源语料），在三个额外公开基准子集上提升1.99–6.54%。
AI.conclusion: 在线反馈在有限预算分诊中不可靠，简单均匀分配已是强基线；更有效的方向是离线建模首个报告的到达概率曲线并按期望增益分配执行预算，该分配器在冻结评估中稳定优于均匀分配。

title: How Much Distribution Shift Can a Clustering Withstand? Exact Split and Merge Certificates for Structured Transports
summary: In clustering, the distribution of the population being clustered is often uncertain or changes over time, so the true distribution may shift away from the nominal distribution used to form the clustering. Once the clustering is committed and each member is assigned to a cluster, such shifts may change the distribution of each cluster. They can make a cluster too spread out for one representative at a given resolution, motivating a split, or bring distinct clusters close enough to share a representative at that resolution, motivating a merge. We make these split and merge events precise using a local stability criterion built on the phase-transition analysis in deterministic annealing. This notion of stability enables us to quantify how robust a clustering is against such events. Furthermore, motivated by applications in which uncertainty and population change are structured, we study shifts whose displacements are restricted to a prescribed subspace. The smallest structured shifts that reach the respective thresholds define the split and merge radii, for which we obtain exact semidefinite programming (SDP) reformulations. The split SDP has only two scalar decision variables. These convex reformulations enable us to combine the radii into a robustness certificate for the full clustering that gives the size of the smallest structured shift that reaches any monitored split or merge threshold.

AI.tldr: 该文用确定性退火中的相变分析建立聚类的局部稳定性判据，精确定义"分裂"与"合并"事件，并在结构化位移子空间下给出分裂/合并半径的精确SDP表述，进而组合成聚类鲁棒性证书。
AI.motivation: 聚类的真实总体分布常不确定或随时间漂移，偏离形成聚类时的名义分布；一旦聚类确定并分配成员，分布漂移会改变各簇分布，使其过于分散（需分裂）或相互接近（需合并），但缺乏量化的稳定性与鲁棒性刻画。
AI.method: 基于确定性退火中的相变分析，构建局部稳定性判据，形式化定义分裂与合并阈值；针对位移限制在给定子空间的结构化漂移，求达到阈值的最小位移（分裂半径、合并半径），并推导出精确的半定规划(SDP)重构——其中分裂SDP仅含两个标量决策变量；最后将各半径合成为整个聚类的鲁棒性证书。
AI.result: 得到分裂半径与合并半径的精确SDP重构（分裂SDP仅两个标量变量），并给出覆盖所有被监测分裂/合并阈值的最小结构化位移规模的全局鲁棒性证书。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以凸优化方式定量刻画聚类对结构化分布漂移的稳定性，使分裂/合并事件的鲁棒性可计算、可认证。

title: Readie: Low-Latency Code Sandboxes for AI Agents
summary:
From quantitative research to personal assistance, AI agents act by iteratively generating and executing code. To decouple the agent harness from code execution, many agents offload execution to dedicated systems called code sandboxes. However, existing code sandboxes suffer from slow startup. Whether they rely on custom snapshots or a single fat image, the root cause is the same: it is hard to build a compact, pre-warmed snapshot that can be shared across diverse agent-generated code while covering nearly all the artifacts (e.g., packages, datasets) it requires.
  In this work, we propose learned startup snapshots for low-latency code sandboxes. Our insight is that while it is hard for a single snapshot to be both compact and cover most workloads, a set of snapshots can achieve both. Each snapshot is small, initializes quickly, and covers a fraction of agent-generated code; together, the set covers most of it. We learn this set from a large training workload by formulating snapshot construction as an optimization problem and solving it with an approximation algorithm. Planned on 15K public and LLM-synthesized scripts, our system, Readie, reduces startup latency by 3-22$\times$ and end-to-end runtime by 1.3-3.3$\times$ compared to existing approaches at the same storage budget.

AI.tldr: 提出"学习式启动快照"方案Readie，用一组小而快的快照覆盖多样化 agent 生成代码所需环境，显著降低代码沙箱冷启动延迟。
AI.motivation: AI agent 通过迭代生成并执行代码来完成任务，代码执行常被卸载到专用 sandbox。现有 sandbox 启动慢，无论用自定义快照还是单一巨型镜像，根因相同：难以构建一个既紧凑又能覆盖多样化 agent 代码所需几乎所有产物（包、数据集等）的预热快照。
AI.method: 核心洞察：单快照难兼顾紧凑与广覆盖，但"一组快照"可以同时满足两点——每个快照小、初始化快，各覆盖一部分 agent 代码，合起来覆盖大部分。将快照集合构建形式化为优化问题，用近似算法求解，并从大规模训练工作负载中学习该快照集合。
AI.result: 在 15K 个公开及 LLM 合成脚本上规划，Readie 在相同存储预算下相较现有方法将启动延迟降低 3–22 倍，端到端运行时降低 1.3–3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 用可学习的小型快照集合替代单一臃肿镜像，是缓解代码沙箱冷启动慢的有效思路，在有限存储开销下取得显著延迟收益。

title: Zero-Dimensional Attention Topology for Linguistic Acceptability
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code and data are provided as ancillary files
summary: Topological summaries of Transformer attention provide sentence representations for linguistic acceptability classification. We examine a zero-dimensional persistent-homology ($H_0$) representation that summarizes minimum-spanning-tree merge values from 144 symmetrized BERT attention graphs into 1,440 features. The retrospective evaluation uses 8,517 downstream training sentences and 521 in-domain and 497 out-of-domain CoLA validation sentences after data-integrity filtering. The recorded out-of-domain Matthews correlation coefficients are 0.438 for the topological representation and 0.508 for attention statistics, compared with 0.545 for BERT. Attention-feature results are retained aggregate measurements; BERT predictions are rescored and length controls are refitted from the accompanying records. Analytical results show that the representation retains token-count information and discards a class of directional attention differences. Source resampling of BERT predictions also demonstrates the sensitivity of uncertainty estimates to the sampling unit. The reported results do not demonstrate a predictive advantage for this fixed topological representation over simpler attention summaries.
