They identify representation properties and evaluation controls relevant to subsequent studies of attention topology.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了一种基于0维持久同调（H₀）的BERT注意力图拓扑表示，用于语言可接受性分类，结果表明该固定拓扑表示并不优于更简单的注意力统计特征。
AI.motivation: 已有工作用Transformer注意力的拓扑摘要生成句子表示，但其相对简单注意力统计量是否真正带来预测优势尚不清楚，且评估控制（如长度效应、不确定性估计）需要审视。
AI.method: 将144个对称化BERT注意力图的最小生成树合并值汇总为1440维H₀特征；在8517条下游训练句、521条域内与497条域外CoLA验证句上做回溯评估，并与注意力统计特征及BERT本身对比，另做表示性质分析与源重采样分析。
AI.result: 域外Matthews相关系数：拓扑表示0.438，注意力统计量0.508，BERT为0.545。分析发现该表示保留词元计数信息、丢弃一类方向性注意力差异；BERT预测的源重采样显示不确定性估计对采样单元敏感。
AI.conclusion: 结果未证明该固定拓扑表示相对更简单注意力摘要有预测优势，仅揭示了表示性质及与后续注意力拓扑研究相关的评估控制要点。

title: Diagnosing and Correcting Skin-Tone Color Casts in Ultra-Lightweight Photo Retouching Networks
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 32 pages including supplementary material
summary: Color casts are expected to come from the scene or camera, and a retouching model removes them. We report a case where the model leaves one: an ultra-lightweight retouching network renders human skin greener than the original because it under-restores the skin chroma that a degradation removes and, even on clean inputs, adds a small hue shift of its own. A common paired-data-free recipe, synthetic self-supervision (degrade high-quality images, learn to restore them), silently produces this cast while whole-frame PSNR/SSIM stay essentially unchanged. In a representative 6,825-parameter histogram-conditioned network, the cast appears in 52 of 70 portraits under a ground-truth-anchored, white-balance-free protocol. Both a histogram-conditioned and a CNN-conditioned network develop the cast under synthetic self-supervision, yet both are near-neutral in-domain when trained on MIT-Adobe FiveK expert pairs. Image-level objectives miss it: a global-mean green loss worsens the cast (52/70 to 57/70). With zero added parameters, our per-pixel, skin-masked, asymmetric green-excess loss reduces the cast to 1/70 across stratified skin tones (68.1% to 2.2% over the 70,000-image FFHQ corpus; 64.4% to 0.8% on held-out CelebA-HQ photos). In-domain FiveK PSNR/SSIM are unchanged (+0.13 dB, +0.004), at the cost of a small whole-frame CIEDE2000 increase (8.77 to 9.69) and a magenta over-correction where skin is nearly neutral (skin Delta a* -1.5 to +4.4 and CIEDE2000 5.6 to 6.4 on clean inputs): the loss targets the signed green-magenta axis, not total skin-color fidelity. The same loss suppresses the cast across three ultra-light architectures. A whole-frame green metric correlates with skin-region CIEDE2000 at the method level (Spearman rho = 0.89). The final network exports to a 35 KB TFLite model.

AI.tldr: 超轻量修图网络会让人像肤色偏绿：合成自监督训练会产生整帧指标察觉不到的色偏。作者提出无参数的逐像素、皮肤掩膜、非对称绿色过量损失，将偏绿人像从52/70降至1/70，FiveK指标不变，代价是近中性皮肤的品红过校正。
AI.motivation: 色偏本应来自场景或相机并被修图模型去除，但作者发现超轻量修图网络反而引入色偏：它对退化所移除的皮肤色度恢复不足，且在干净输入上也会添加自身的小色相偏移。而常用的合成自监督配方（退化高清图再学习复原）在全帧PSNR/SSIM上几乎无变化，因此该问题被整体指标掩盖，需要显式诊断与修正。
AI.method: 在无真值锚定、不含白平衡的协议下评估70张人像；对比直方图条件与CNN条件网络在合成自监督与MIT-Adobe FiveK专家配对训练下的表现；提出零参数、逐像素、皮肤掩膜、非对称绿色过量损失，仅在皮肤区域针对有符号的绿-品红轴施加惩罚；并在三种超轻架构、FFHQ与CelebA-HQ上验证。
AI.result: 代表性的6,825参数网络在70张人像中52张出现偏绿；全局平均绿色损失反而使其恶化到57/70。新损失将偏绿降至1/70，FFHQ上68.1%→2.2%、CelebA-HQ上64.4%→0.8%；FiveK PSNR/SSIM不变（+0.13 dB、+0.004）。代价为整帧CIEDE2000从8.77升至9.69，以及近中性皮肤品红过校正（皮肤Δa* -1.5→+4.4，CIEDE2000 5.6→6.4）。整帧绿色指标与皮肤区域CIEDE2000在方法层面强相关（ρ=0.89）；网络可导出为35 KB TFLite模型。
AI.conclusion: 合成自监督会静默地在超轻量修图网络中引入肤色偏绿，且被全帧指标掩盖；针对绿-品红有符号轴的皮肤掩膜非对称损失可在零额外参数下有效消除该色偏，但只解决偏绿方向而非整体肤色保真，近中性皮肤存在品红过校正风险。

title: Missing Security-Fix Backporting for GitHub Actions Workflows
comment: Accepted by the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027)
summary: GitHub natively supports workflow automation through GitHub Actions, now the dominant CI/CD tool on the platform. Yet keeping these workflows secure remains an ongoing burden: maintainers often patch a vulnerability on the default branch but leave the same flaw on the release and maintenance branches that downstream consumers continue to build from. Carrying a known fix onto these divergent branches, called backporting, is rarely done, and this paper presents the first large-scale empirical study quantifying the resulting gap. From a public corpus of GitHub Actions workflow histories, we mine 1,903,191 workflow-modifying commits, scan each before and after with the static scanner zizmor to identify 69,865 security fixes across 24,238 projects, and audit every release branch to check whether each fix was carried over. The gap is pervasive: 224,392 of 474,490 audited release branches remain vulnerable, and deliberate backporting is rare and slow, with only 19,476 of 78,907 already-fixed branches confirmed as plausible backports at a median lag of 243 days. We thus design WorkflowBP, the first technique for automated security-fix backporting of GitHub Actions workflows. WorkflowBP takes a neuro-symbolic approach: it compiles a default-branch fix into a domain-specific representation called the Workflow Semantic Patch (WSP) and applies it to each divergent branch by matching jobs and steps based on their content rather than their position, while an LLM synthesizes the WSP for the most divergent cases the deterministic engine cannot resolve. On 12,000 real unpatched workflow files from our study, WorkflowBP produces a scanner-checked backport for 67.9%. We further submit 176 issues with WorkflowBP-generated backports to real-world projects, 44 of which have been confirmed or fixed by developers.

AI.tldr: 首个大规模实证研究揭示 GitHub Actions 工作流的安全修复在发布/维护分支上普遍缺失，并提出神经符号方法 WorkflowBP 实现自动化安全补丁回移。
AI.motivation: GitHub Actions 已成为主导 CI/CD 工具，但维护者往往只在默认分支修补漏洞，未将修复回移到发布/维护分支，下游用户因此持续构建带漏洞的版本；回移（backporting）实践极少，此前缺乏量化证据。
AI.method: 挖掘 1,903,191 个工作流修改提交，用 zizmor 扫描前后状态识别 69,865 个安全修复（覆盖 24,238 个项目），并审计每个发布分支是否携带修复。技术上提出 WorkflowBP：将默认分支修复编译为领域特定表示 WSP（Workflow Semantic Patch），基于内容而非位置匹配 job/step 应用到各分支；对确定性引擎无法处理的差异极大情形，用 LLM 合成 WSP。
AI.result: 漏洞缺口普遍存在：474,490 个被审计发布分支中 224,392 个仍脆弱；78,907 个已修复分支中仅 19,476 个可确认为合理回移，中位滞后 243 天。在 12,000 个真实未修补文件上，WorkflowBP 为 67.9% 生成通过扫描器检查的回移；向真实项目提交 176 个 issue，其中 44 个已被确认或修复。
AI.conclusion: 工作流安全修复跨分支传播存在严重且普遍的缺口，人工回移稀少且缓慢；WorkflowBP 证明神经符号自动化回移可行且具实际采纳价值，为 CI/CD 供应链安全治理提供新方向。

title: An AI-Based OSSE Framework to Evaluate Learned Physical Consistency: A Multi-Model Study Using FourCastNet, Aurora, Prithvi WxC, and GraphCast
summary: Observing System Simulation Experiments (OSSEs) are a central methodology for evaluating future atmospheric observing systems. We present the first AI-based OSSE framework to test whether different AI weather models can reproduce comparable physical impact from new observations that traditional physics based models generate. We evaluate four distinct architectural AI models on the Charney conjecture that incomplete historical observations can infer the present state of the atmospheric. We considner- FourCastNet V2, GraphCast, Aurora and Prithvi WxC and integrate each autoregressively over a 60-day forecast horizon. After a 30-day spin-up, we insert ERA5 temperature fields to infer winds and related atmospheric fields. Similar OSSE experiments are conducted for wind insertion. We measure the performance of each model's response to observational information on a 30-day data assimilation cycle forecast with and without data insertion. Distinct architectural AI weather models respond differently to the same OSSE observations. Foundation models (i.e. Prithvi WxC and Aurora), produce the strongest impact. For example, while GraphCast is the weakest, all three of the four models capture the temperature-to-geopotential height response. The two foundational models retain a positive, non-trivial, tropical zonal wind at 500 hPa response to temperature insertion. Various data insertion experiments can vary significantly even within a given architecture. We identify an architecture-specific numerical instability in GraphCast's full 37-level configuration that produces a runaway feedback concentrated at the uppermost levels with ERA5 temperature insertion correctable by excluding levels at or below 100 hPa.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于AI的OSSE框架，检验四种AI天气模型（FourCastNet V2、GraphCast、Aurora、Prithvi WxC）在插入观测后能否复现传统物理模型的可比物理影响，并揭示架构差异。
AI.motivation: OSSE是评估未来大气观测系统的核心方法，但现有OSSE基于传统物理模型；需验证AI天气模型对新增观测的响应是否与传统模型可比，即能否在Charney猜想（不完整历史观测可推断当前大气状态）下产生合理的物理影响。
AI.method: 构建首个AI-based OSSE框架，对FourCastNet V2、GraphCast、Aurora、Prithvi WxC四种架构模型自回归积分60天，30天spin-up后插入ERA5温度场推断风及相关场，并做风插入的类似实验；在30天同化循环预报中对比有无数据插入的表现。
AI.result: 不同架构AI模型对相同OSSE观测响应不同；基础模型（Prithvi WxC、Aurora）影响最强，GraphCast最弱；四个模型中三个捕捉到温度→位势高度响应；两个基础模型在温度插入后保留正的、非平凡的500 hPa热带纬向风响应；同一架构内不同插入实验差异显著；发现GraphCast 37层配置存在架构特异性数值不稳定，最上层出现失控反馈，排除100 hPa及以下层可修正。
AI.conclusion: AI天气模型的OSSE响应存在显著架构依赖性，基础模型对观测信息响应更强；需要针对具体架构审慎设计数据插入实验，并注意如GraphCast的数值不稳定问题。

title: Reconfiguring Procedural Knowledge for Compositional Robot Skill Adaptation
summary: General-purpose behavior models increasingly internalize broad procedural knowledge during training, making their adaptation to new goals and skill interfaces less a problem of learning entirely new behaviors than of reconfiguring existing competence. We study this capability as reconfigurability, the ability to realize new behaviors by cost-efficiently restructuring existing components and relations under sparse governing information, where task specifications provide high-level goals and procedure specifications expose a limited set of reusable factors, leaving the concrete bindings and compositions required for execution underdetermined. We propose RecPo, a framework that represents skills task-agnostically through multiple procedure views and materializes executable skill sequences by composing stored transitions to realize task-specific changes. RecPo maintains a procedure knowledge base of skill-induced transitions, with each view exposing a reusable factor and preserving local skill connectivity. At deployment, it interprets task specifications through the same views and resolves the resulting compositional queries over the stored relations to bind skills for execution. On long-horizon tasks in an extended Franka Kitchen benchmark, RecPo achieves 91.9% ordered completion with 1.0 ms of task inference per episode across varying procedure support and task-record sparsity. Real-robot studies further demonstrate adaptation through local memory edits without task-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RecPo框架，将通用行为模型的"可重构性"作为核心能力：通过多过程视图以任务无关方式表示技能，在稀疏任务/过程规格下组合已存储的技能转移，实现低成本的新行为配置。
AI.motivation: 通用行为模型在训练中已内化大量程序性知识，适应新目标与技能接口更多是"重构既有能力"而非"学习全新行为"。然而任务规格只给高层目标、过程规格只暴露有限可复用因子，具体绑定与组合仍欠确定，现有方法难以在稀疏信息下高效重构。
AI.method: RecPo维护技能诱导转移构成的程序知识库，用多个过程视图任务无关地表示技能，每个视图暴露一个可复用因子并保留局部技能连通性。部署时将任务规格映射到相同视图，在存储关系上解析组合查询，通过组合已存储转移物化出可执行的技能序列完成绑定。
AI.result: 在扩展Franka Kitchen基准的长程任务上，在不同过程支持度与任务记录稀疏度下达到91.9%的有序完成率，每回合任务推理仅需1.0 ms；真实机器人实验表明可通过局部记忆编辑实现适应，无需任务特定重训练。
AI.conclusion: 将行为适应视作对既有技能的程序化重构是可行且高效的：结构化知识库+多视图组合查询可在稀疏监督下实现快速推理与可编辑的真实机器人适应，为通用行为模型的可重构性提供了一条轻量路径。

title: Comparing Implicit and Explicit Language Attitudes toward the Dutch multiethnolect Straattaal in Humans and Large Language Models
summary: While language attitudes have been extensively studied in humans, the extent to which large language models (LLMs) encode similar associations between language varieties and social attributes remains unclear. Contemporary sociolinguistic research distinguishes between explicit attitudes, which stem from deliberative processing, and implicit attitudes, which arise from automatic processing. This study investigates whether LLMs exhibit human-like implicit and explicit language attitudes toward the Dutch multiethnolect Straattaal, particularly its association with migrant communities. We use closely matched designs to assess attitudes in humans and LLMs. For humans, we use an Implicit Association Test (IAT) and an explicit rating task. For LLMs, we use the LLM Word Association Test (LLM WAT) and the same explicit rating task. Human participants strongly associate Straattaal with individuals with a migration background at both implicit and explicit levels. In the LLM WAT, Straattaal is consistently associated with individuals with a migration background, with stronger associations observed in larger and newer models. When presented with the same explicit rating task as human participants, LLMs produce comparable response patterns. Overall, the findings suggest that many LLMs encode language attitudes resembling those observed in humans, however we also highlight important questions about how concepts and measures developed to study human attitudes should be interpreted in LLMs. This highlights the relevance of incorporating sociolinguistic perspectives and language variation into NLP research to better identify and mitigate socially and linguistically embedded biases.

AI.tldr: 研究用匹配设计比较人类与大语言模型对荷兰多种族方言Straattaal的语言态度，发现LLM在隐性与显性层面都呈现类似人类的、将其与移民背景群体关联的偏见，且模型越大越新关联越强。
AI.motivation: 语言态度在人类中研究充分，但LLM是否编码了语言变体与社会属性之间类似的关联尚不清楚。社会语言学区分显性（ deliberative）与隐性（自动）态度，作者希望检验LLM是否表现出类人的隐性/显性语言态度，尤其是对Straattaal与移民群体的关联，并推动NLP研究纳入社会语言学视角。
AI.method: 采用人类与LLM紧密匹配的实验设计。人类使用内隐联想测验（IAT）与显性评分任务；LLM使用LLM词语联想测验（LLM WAT）与相同的显性评分任务，从而在同一框架下比较隐性/显性态度。
AI.result: 人类在隐性与显性层面都强烈将Straattaal与移民背景个体关联。LLM WAT中Straattaal也稳定地与移民背景个体关联，且更大、更新的模型关联更强；在相同的显性评分任务上，LLM产生与人类可比的反应模式。
AI.conclusion: 许多LLM编码了类似人类的语言态度，但如何在LLM中解释为研究人类态度而设计的概念与测量仍存重要疑问；强调需将社会语言学视角与语言变异纳入NLP研究，以更好识别和缓解社会与语言层面的内嵌偏见。

title: RetiDual-Select: Reliability-Aware Specialist-Generalist Routing for Retinal OCT under Image-Quality Shift
comment: 4 figures, 4 tables, 42 references. Submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Main article only; the separate Supplementary Information is not included
summary: Adaptive fusion can repair a static ensemble's errors, but can also overturn correct decisions. RetiDual-Select combines retinal specialist RETFound with the image encoder of the medical vision-language model MedSigLIP, separating candidate fusion, routing safety and predictive review. Calibrated product-of-experts (PoE) fusion is the static reference, a small gate proposes an alternative for each image, a validation-frozen harm guard decides whether that candidate may replace the reference, and a separate score prioritizes review. Static PoE reached the highest or joint-highest clean accuracy on all three datasets. At a clean 2% accepted-error target the review policy accepted 94.3% of Kermany-4 images at 99.89% selective accuracy, and 92.4% of OCT-C8 at 98.65%. Both branches were correct on 95.0% and 91.8% of clean images; only 4.4% and 6.2% had exactly one correct branch. Across 15 prespecified synthetic conditions, adaptive gains were concentrated in severe contrast reduction, where this routing opportunity widened roughly ninefold; percentile rescaling largely removed the effect, linking it to compressed dynamic range. In post-hoc validation-only analyses, gain was higher when the gate followed the more reliable branch, and a frozen guard cut the worst-condition OCT-C8 loss from 1.39 to 0.36 percentage points. Adaptive routing was useful when image quality created a reliability opportunity and the gate followed it; otherwise the system retained Static PoE or deferred for review. The findings are bounded by the synthetic perturbations evaluated and do not establish robustness to natural acquisition or scanner shift.

AI.tldr: RetiDual-Select 将视网膜专模型 RETFound 与 MedSigLIP 图像编码器组合，通过"候选融合—路由安全—预测复核"三段式设计，在静态 PoE 融合为参考的前提下，仅在图像质量造成可靠性机会时启用自适应路由，否则保留静态融合或转人工复核。
AI.motivation: 自适应融合能修复静态集成错误，但也会推翻原本正确的决策，因此需要一种既能利用自适应收益又能约束其风险的框架；作者希望厘清自适应路由在何种条件下真正有用。
AI.method: 以校准的专家乘积（PoE）融合作为静态参考；一个小型门控网络为每张图像提出替代决策；经验证集冻结的"危害守卫"判断候选是否可替换参考；另一独立评分对样本排序以优先复核。在三个数据集、15 个预设合成扰动条件下评估，并做仅验证集的事后分析（门控是否跟随更可靠分支、守卫效果、百分位重缩放消融）。
AI.result: 静态 PoE 在三个数据集上均取得最高或并列最高的干净准确率。在 2% 接受误差目标下，复核策略在 Kermany-4 接受 94.3% 图像、选择性准确率 99.89%；OCT-C8 接受 92.4%、98.65%。两分支同时正确的比例为 95.0% 与 91.8%，仅一支正确的仅 4.4% 与 6.2%。15 个合成条件下自适应收益集中于严重对比度降低，此时路由机会约扩大九倍；百分位重缩放基本消除该效应，说明与动态范围压缩有关。门控跟随更可靠分支时收益更高；冻结守卫将最差条件 OCT-C8 的损失从 1.39 降至 0.36 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自适应路由仅在图像质量制造出可靠性机会且门控能跟上时才有价值，否则系统回退到静态 PoE 或转人工复核。结论受限于所评估的合成扰动，不能证明对真实采集差异或扫描仪漂移的鲁棒性。

title: Think Before You Code: A Benchmark for Testing LLMs on Software Engineering Deliberation
summary: Think Before You Code (TBYC) is a benchmark pipeline for studying whether code-focused language models can reason about software issues in ways that resemble human engineering deliberation. The benchmark curates GitHub issue discussions into structured records, extracts human discussion artifacts such as problems, solutions, constraints, rationales, and trade-offs, and then prompts models to generate issue-level "thoughts" using retrieved code context and few-shot examples. It converts model responses back into the same artifact space and evaluates them against human annotations using complementary metrics for artifact type detection, metadata matching, tag overlap, and semantic summary similarity. Beyond scoring, this study includes visualization, leaderboard, and baseline tools that make it possible to compare models, prompting strategies, and extraction methods across repositories and issues. Think Before You Code is an end-to-end evaluation environment for measuring how closely LLM software reasoning aligns with human strategic judgment.

AI.tldr: TBYC 是一个端到端基准流水线，用于评测代码大模型是否能在软件问题上做出接近人类工程思辨的推理，通过从 GitHub issue 讨论中抽取人类"思考工件"并与模型生成的"想法"进行多维比对来量化对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 现有代码模型评测多聚焦代码生成/修复正确性，缺乏对"软件问题推理过程本身"的评估，尤其缺少能与人类工程师决策性思考（问题、方案、约束、理由、权衡）直接对照的基准与度量方法。
AI.method: 1) 从 GitHub issue 讨论整理为结构化记录；2) 抽取人类讨论工件（problem、solution、constraint、rationale、trade-off）；3) 结合检索到的代码上下文与 few-shot 示例，提示模型生成 issue 级"thoughts"；4) 将模型输出回映射到同一工件空间；5) 用互补指标评测：工件类型检测、元数据匹配、标签重叠、语义摘要相似度；6) 配套可视化、排行榜与基线工具，支持跨仓库/跨 issue 比较模型、提示策略与抽取方法。
AI.result: 摘要为介绍性描述，未给出具体实验数值；产出为可运行评测环境及多模型、多提示策略、多抽取方法的对比工具与排行榜。
AI.conclusion: TBYC 提供了一个系统化评测框架，把"LLM 软件推理与人类策略性判断的接近程度"变为可度量、可视化、可复现比较的问题，为代码推理评测提供了过程性视角。

title: GP--RL--MPC: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control with Gaussian Process Postdecision State-Value Functions
comment: 19 pages including references and appendices, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to L4DC 2027
summary: We propose Gaussian Process Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control (GP--RL--MPC), which uses a learned critic as the MPC terminal penalty to account for costs beyond the prediction horizon. Gaussian process regression (GPR) enables data-efficient critic learning from limited, noisy rollouts within optimistic approximate policy iteration (OAPI), with soft updates mitigating policy chattering. A tunable risk coefficient weights GP epistemic uncertainty in the terminal cost, regulating sensitivity to uncertain critic predictions. The postdecision state formulation shifts disturbance averaging offline to account for aleatoric uncertainty from the terminal transition onward. Under matching objectives and admissible actions, a one-step horizon recovers greedy value-space RL. After fitting GP hyperparameters by exact marginal likelihood, we construct a sparse deterministic training conditional (DTC) posterior using inducing points selected by pivoted Cholesky (PC), reducing online evaluation costs as the training dataset grows. In a continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) subject to exogenous disturbances, GP--RL--MPC with an appropriately selected risk coefficient and policy screening reduces the sum of squared errors (SSE) by an average of 80.52% relative to an otherwise matched baseline MPC across five random seeds (sample standard deviation: 3.48%).

AI.tldr: 提出GP-RL-MPC：用高斯过程学习的critic作为MPC终端惩罚以计入超出预测时域的成本，在CSTR扰动场景下SSE平均降低80.52%。
AI.motivation: 传统MPC受限于有限预测时域，难以考虑时域之外的成本；而RL又缺乏数据效率与安全性保障。希望结合两者：用RL学习值函数作为终端代价以弥补截断时域问题，同时借助高斯过程回归在有限噪声数据下高效学习。
AI.method: 将学到的critic作为MPC终端惩罚；采用GPR在乐观近似策略迭代(OAPI)中做数据高效学习，并用软更新抑制策略抖动；引入可调风险系数对GP认知不确定性加权进终端代价；采用postdecision state表述将扰动平均离线化以处理终端转移起的不确定性；理论上一阶时域在匹配目标与可行动作下退化为贪婪值空间RL；用精确边际似然拟合GP超参，再以pivoted Cholesky选诱导点构建稀疏DTC后验以降低在线评估成本。
AI.result: 在含外源扰动的连续搅拌釜反应器(CSTR)中，选择合适风险系数并做策略筛选后，5个随机种子下SSE相对匹配基线MPC平均降低80.52%，样本标准差3.48%。
AI.conclusion: GP-RL-MPC能有效将RL值函数融入MPC终端代价，在保持MPC约束与可解释性的同时显著提升扰动下的控制性能，并通过稀疏GP与风险系数实现可扩展与可控鲁棒性。

title: The Only Edge Was Memorized in Training: LLM Trading Agents Around Earnings and Bad News
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables. Original empirical study of LLM trading agents before scheduled earnings announcements and after bad-news drops, run on the rta-bench-1 benchmark (arXiv:2611.19530)
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents are tested on news, but news reaches stock prices within minutes, and a benchmark that replays headlines at their publication time finds no alpha in trading on them. Money can then remain in two places, before news whose date is known, such as earnings announcements, and after bad news, if the market's fall went too far. However, studies of LLMs and earnings read documents published with or after the announcement, and studies of reversal sort monthly portfolios, so neither tells whether an agent can trade these moments after costs. In this paper, we test LLM agents at both moments on the same look-ahead-free benchmark, before 598 earnings announcements and after 409 bad-news drops of large US stocks. Every input is cut at the decision close, staged agents are compared with single calls, simple rules and a logistic regression, and every decision is made with and without the stock's name. Across five models from four vendors, no agent beat the simple bets. Before earnings, the agents mostly bought and earned what buying before every announcement earned, and after bad news, a Gemini-based agent called almost every fall an overreaction while no agent picked better dips than buying them all. The only gains came from what the models had memorized in training. Given only the ticker and the dates, a GPT-based model called the direction of 59.2% of the announcements before its training cutoff and 53.3% after it. Agent builders should therefore compare an event agent with the simple bet and test it blind after the training cutoff.

AI.tldr: 该论文在无前视偏差的基准上测试LLM交易代理在财报公布前和坏消息下跌后的两个时点上的交易能力，发现五个模型均未能战胜简单策略，唯一收益来自训练记忆。
AI.motivation: 新闻信息在几分钟内即被股价消化，基于新闻标题回放的基准无法产生alpha。资金可能停留在两个时点：财报公布前（日期已知）和坏消息过度下跌之后。但现有LLM研究读取的是公告同时或之后发布的文档，反转研究又按月排序组合，都无法判断代理能否在扣除成本后交易这些时刻。
AI.method: 构建无前视偏差的同一基准：598次财报公布前和409次美国大盘股坏消息下跌后。所有输入截止到决策收盘时，比较分阶段代理、单次调用、简单规则和逻辑回归，每个决策分别在给出和不给出股票名称的条件下进行，覆盖来自四家供应商的五个模型。
AI.result: 没有代理能战胜简单押注。财报前代理大多买入，收益等同于每次公告前都买入；坏消息后，基于Gemini的代理几乎把每次下跌都判为过度反应，没有代理能比"全部买入"更好地挑选抄底机会。唯一收益来自训练记忆：仅给股票代码和日期，GPT模型在训练截止前预测出59.2%的公告方向，截止后为53.3%。
AI.conclusion: 代理构建者应将事件代理与简单押注进行对比，并在训练截止后盲测。

title: Bad Apples in the Kitchen: How LLM Teams Detect, Correct, and Calibrate Against Their Misaligned Members
summary: What protects an LLM team when one teammate quietly goes wrong? Most multi-agent LLM work assumes cooperative partners and inspects chat between turns before acting. Real-time embodied cooperation does not allow this pause: chat runs alongside action, so a teammate whose words stay cooperative while behavior diverges can cause damage faster than the team can name what is happening. We study this case by injecting three theory-grounded misaligned agents into a custom four-player Overcooked environment, each stressing a different joint-action layer (speech-action mismatch, role invasion, and aggregate-progress disruption), and decompose robustness into three sequential gates of detection, correction, and calibration through a 3x4x2 design (n=720 episodes). Nearly all trolls are eventually named, but recovery follows only when attribution and situational diagnosis appear in the same utterance; direct source-attribution prompting improves the hardest case only by degrading the troll-free baseline by 37.5%. Robustness, then, depends less on detection alone than on whether team chat combines attribution with diagnosis in a single utterance, suggesting that sensitivity to misalignment should be targeted rather than uniformly raised.

AI.tldr: 论文研究实时具身多智能体协作中"言语合作但行为偏离"的队友威胁，通过注入三类理论驱动的失准智能体（言语-行为不一致、角色入侵、总体进度破坏）到四人Overcooked环境，将鲁棒性分解为检测、纠正、校准三道连续关卡（3x4x2设计，n=720回合）。发现几乎所有"捣乱者"最终都能被识别，但只有归因与情境诊断出现在同一话语中时才能实现恢复；直接源归因提示虽改善最难情形，却使无捣乱基线性能下降37.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM研究多假设合作者，且在行动前先检查回合间聊天；而实时具身协作中聊天与行动并行，无法暂停核查，导致言辞合作、行为偏离的队友能比团队"命名"问题更快地造成损害。作者希望研究这类实时场景下团队鲁棒性的真正来源。
AI.method: 在自定义四人Overcooked环境中注入三类理论驱动的失准智能体，分别针对不同的联合行动层（言语-行为不匹配、角色入侵、总体进度干扰）；采用3x4x2实验设计（n=720回合），将鲁棒性分解为检测、纠正与校准三个顺序关卡进行测量，并对比直接源归因提示等干预手段。
AI.result: 几乎所有捣乱者最终都被团队识别出来（检测层面接近饱和），但恢复（纠正/校准）仅在"归因"与"情境诊断"出现在同一话语中时才发生；直接源归因提示能改善最难案例，但会使无捣乱基线性能下降37.5%，显示出明显的权衡代价。
AI.conclusion: 团队鲁棒性与其说取决于检测本身，不如说取决于团队聊天能否在单句话中同时结合归因与诊断；因此对失准的敏感性应被有针对性地提升（聚焦特定联合行动层与话语结构），而非一味均匀提高。

title: FrameSeg3D: Learned Local Frames for Segmenting Small Parts on High-Resolution 3D Scans
summary: Segmenting small parts on high-resolution 3D scans, such as nails on hand scans and teeth on intraoral scans, poses three challenges: 1) each part covers a tiny fraction of the scan, 2) its boundary is only a subtle change of height and curvature, and 3) it faces its own direction. Existing methods fall into two groups, and both fall short. The first group processes the whole scan at once and sees each part too coarsely. Point and mesh networks must shrink the scan to fit in memory, so a small part keeps only a few of its points. Multi-view methods render images of the whole object, so each part fills only a few pixels and a tilted part is seen from the side. The second group first finds each part and then segments it up close. But these methods find the parts with knowledge about one kind of part, for example the shape of the dental arch for teeth. Such knowledge does not carry over to other kinds of parts. We find that accuracy is limited by how a part is seen, from which direction and at what scale, not by how many points land on it. We therefore present FrameSeg3D. It first predicts a local frame for every part, its center and the direction it faces, from a low-resolution view of the whole scan. It then segments the part in views around its frame normal at the scanner's resolution, so covering the whole scan no longer costs resolution. Because every part arrives centered, facing the camera, and at a fixed scale, one segmentation network can serve different kinds of parts and learn from few labeled masks. We test FrameSeg3D on two kinds of parts, nails and teeth. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on hand scans (mean Dice 0.970 on nails) and on the Teeth3DS+ test fold (per-tooth IoU 96.5), with the most accurate tooth boundaries (boundary IoU 70.5).

AI.tldr: 提出 FrameSeg3D，先从低分辨率整体扫描预测每个小部件的局部坐标系（中心与朝向），再沿该坐标系法线以扫描仪原始分辨率做局部视角分割，从而同时覆盖全扫描与保持分辨率，在指甲与牙齿分割上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D扫描上的小部件（指甲、牙齿）分割存在三大难点：部件仅占极小比例、边界只是高度/曲率的细微变化、且各自朝向不同。现有方法分两类且均有缺陷：整扫描一次处理（点/网格网络需降采样导致部件只剩少量点，多视角渲染使部件仅占几像素且倾斜部件被侧视）精度过粗；先定位再近景分割的方法依赖特定部件先验（如牙弓形状），无法迁移到其他部件。作者指出精度瓶颈在于"部件被以什么方向、什么尺度观测"，而非落在其上的点数。
AI.method: FrameSeg3D 分两阶段：1) 从全扫描的低分辨率视图预测每个部件的局部坐标系（中心与朝向法线）；2) 围绕该法线在扫描仪原始分辨率下生成视角进行分割。由于每个部件都被居中、正对相机、归一化到固定尺度，单个分割网络即可服务不同种类部件，并能用少量标注掩膜学习。
AI.result: 在手部扫描（指甲平均 Dice 0.970）和 Teeth3DS+ 测试折（单牙 IoU 96.5）上超越 SOTA，并取得最准确的牙齿边界（boundary IoU 70.5）。
AI.conclusion: 验证了"观测方式（方向与尺度）而非采样密度决定小部件分割精度"这一洞察；统一的局部坐标系归一化使一个网络跨部件类型泛化且数据高效，对高分辨率3D扫描的细粒度分割具有通用性。

title: BugGen 2.0: Rethinking the Roles of LLMs for Scalable RTL Bug Synthesis
summary: AI-assisted RTL localization and debugging need ground-truth bug datasets with known locations and observable failures, while testbench grading uses injected bugs to measure detection capability. Creating such datasets at scale remains a major EDA challenge. BugGen 1.0 shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate context-aware RTL mutations. Still, it relies on the model for both choosing where to mutate and generating the edit, which increases inference costs and can lead to invalid choices. BugGen 2.0 changes this division of labor. Deterministic algorithms handle structural analysis, target selection, and validation, while the LLM focuses on localized semantic rewriting. Across four OpenTitan IP blocks and FabScalar with three LLMs, BugGen 2.0 reaches every requested quota of compilable bug scenarios that cause at least two test failures, with 14-16 of 16 configured mutation types represented. In completed same-model comparisons, it reduces token use by 6.8x-15.4x relative to BugGen 1.0 and 1.5x-7.9x relative to Firefly. BugGen 2.0 also expands the dataset without simulating every new bug. After finding accepted scenarios with observable failures, it generates alternative mutations at the same locations, simulates only a subset, and estimates acceptance for the rest. This skips 63.6% of AES and 33.9% of FabScalar variant simulations. Full simulation finds that 77.7% of AES variants and 95.2% of FabScalar variants are accepted, with a 1.09% estimation error on the directly comparable FabScalar set. These results show that focusing LLMs on semantic rewriting lowers inference and simulation cost while improving consistency across models and designs.

AI.tldr: BugGen 2.0 将 RTL 变异 bug 数据集生成重新分工：确定性算法负责结构分析、目标选择与验证，LLM 只负责局部语义改写，从而在保证可编译、可观察失败的前提下大幅降低 token 与仿真成本。
AI.motivation: AI 辅助 RTL 定位与调试需要带已知位置、可观察失败的 ground-truth bug 数据集，测试平台评分也依赖注入 bug 来衡量检测能力，但规模化构建此类数据集仍是 EDA 难点。前作 BugGen 1.0 让 LLM 同时决定"在哪变异"和"如何编辑"，导致推理成本高、且可能产生无效选择。
AI.method: 任务解耦：确定性算法完成结构分析、变异目标选择与合法性验证，LLM 仅做局部语义重写。数据集扩展采用"同位置替代变异"策略——先找到有可观察失败的被接受场景，在同一位置生成替代变异，只仿真其中一部分并估计其余变异的接受率。
AI.result: 在 4 个 OpenTitan IP 块和 FabScalar 上、使用 3 个 LLM：达到全部可编译且至少引发 2 个测试失败的 bug 场景配额，16 种变异类型覆盖 14–16 种。同模型对比中 token 用量较 BugGen 1.0 降低 6.8–15.4 倍，较 Firefly 降低 1.5–7.9 倍。跳过 63.6% 的 AES 与 33.9% 的 FabScalar 变体仿真；全仿真验证 AES 变体 77.7%、FabScalar 变体 95.2% 被接受，FabScalar 可比较集上估计误差仅 1.09%。
AI.conclusion: 让 LLM 专注语义改写可同时降低推理与仿真成本，并提升跨模型、跨设计的一致性，为大规模 RTL bug 数据集构建提供可行路径。

title: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
summary: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. Building on these findings, we further propose DSADiff (Data Structure-Aware Diffusion), a data structure-aware diffusion model that transforms the key factors identified by LAS into a unified generation difficulty representation and uses it to jointly drive feature modeling and training strategy optimization. This enables the model to adapt its representation and generation capability to samples with different data structures and difficulty levels, thereby mitigating learning bias across samples. Experiments on three CSP benchmark datasets, including Carbon-24, demonstrate that DSADiff consistently improves both Match Rate and RMSE, with a maximum Match Rate improvement of 9%, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods and achieving new state-of-the-art performance. This work deepens the understanding of diffusion-based CSP models from the perspective of generation bias and provides a new direction for designing less biased generative models for complex materials spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAS分析框架，揭示晶体复杂度和元素组成不平衡是造成扩散式CSP模型生成偏置的关键因素，并据此提出数据结构感知的扩散模型DSADiff，通过统一难度表示联合驱动特征建模与训练策略优化，在Carbon-24等三个基准上Match Rate最高提升9%，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的晶体结构预测（CSP）模型在多样材料空间上存在生成偏置，且缺乏系统方法追溯性能差异来源，因此需要先做机制分析、再设计低偏置的生成模型。
AI.method: 提出LAS（分层分析策略）识别晶体复杂度与元素组成不平衡两个影响生成难度的关键因素并分析其与模型性能的关系；进而提出DSADiff，将这二者转化为统一的"生成难度表示"，并用于联合驱动特征建模和训练策略优化，使模型能针对不同数据结构和难度自适应调整表征与生成能力。
AI.result: 在Carbon-24等三个CSP基准数据集上，DSADiff在Match Rate和RMSE上均稳定提升，Match Rate最大提升9%，超过现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从生成偏置视角深化了对扩散式CSP模型的理解，并为面向复杂材料空间设计更少偏置的生成模型提供了新方向。

title: CorrectCast: Selective Multimodal Context for Scale-Aware Residual Correction in Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting models suffer from errors in intensity, location, and spatial structure. Addressing these errors by retraining nowcaster backbones can be computationally expensive and requires architecture-specific modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose CorrectCast, a decoupled residual correction framework that refines completed nowcasts while keeping the base nowcaster frozen. By operating on predicted precipitation fields, CorrectCast requires training only a lightweight corrector, reducing computational overhead while providing a unified correction interface across different nowcasting models. Conditioned on the base nowcast and historical quantitative precipitation estimation (QPE) and precipitable water vapor (PWV) observations, the corrector selects multimodal context and employs scale-aware modulation to estimate residual corrections. On the Mississippi River Basin (MRB) and contiguous United States (CONUS) datasets, CorrectCast improves six base nowcasters spanning extrapolation-based, deterministic, and generative approaches, with absolute gains in mean CSI averaging 0.0233 and 0.0290 across the six models, respectively.

AI.tldr: CorrectCast是一个解耦的残差校正框架，在冻结基础临近预报模型的前提下，仅训练轻量校正器来改进降水预报。
AI.motivation: 现有降水临近预报模型在强度、位置和空间结构上存在误差，而通过重训骨干网络来改进代价高昂且需架构特定修改。
AI.method: 以基础预报结果及历史QPE、PWV观测为条件，校正器选择多模态上下文并用尺度感知调制估计残差修正，为基础预报提供统一校正接口。
AI.result: 在MRB和CONUS数据集上改进六种基础模型（外推、确定性、生成式），平均CSI绝对增益分别为0.0233和0.0290。
AI.conclusion: 解耦残差校正可在低计算开销下跨模型通用地提升临近预报性能。

title: Text-Guided Modality Correction for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) is essential for detecting objects beyond the categories seen during training. Establishing vision-language associations is crucial for recognizing unseen categories, while integrating complementary visual features across levels supports detection at different scales. However, existing methods often provide insufficient textual guidance for object regions, rely on limited cross-modal alignment strategies, and underuse complementary features across levels, limiting their ability to detect unseen categories and objects of varying scales. To address these limitations, we propose a Text-Guided Modality Correction Network (TMCNet) that incorporates textual guidance into region feature extraction, cross-modal alignment, and multi-scale decoding to strengthen region-category semantic correspondence and promote complementary feature fusion across levels. First, a text-guided modality encoder incorporates textual semantics into queries to guide regional feature aggregation, reducing semantic ambiguity in object representations. Second, a cross-modal alignment module strengthens the correspondence between region representations and category semantics through interactions between visual and textual features. Finally, a progressive text correction decoder combines a top-down pathway with lateral connections to progressively fuse text-guided deep semantic features with shallow visual features at the corresponding scales, preserving both semantic information and spatial detail for objects of different sizes. Experiments on two public datasets, COCO-OVD and LVIS-OVD, demonstrate that TMCNet achieves strong performance in open-vocabulary object detection using simple text queries as guidance. Extending TMCNet to open-vocabulary segmentation also yields performance gains, demonstrating its cross-task applicability and extensibility.

AI.tldr: 提出 Text-Guided Modality Correction Network (TMCNet)，在区域特征提取、跨模态对齐和多尺度解码三处引入文本引导，提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 OVD 方法存在三方面不足：对目标区域的文本引导不足、跨模态对齐策略有限、层级互补特征利用不充分，导致难以识别未见类别与不同尺度目标。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：(1) 文本引导模态编码器，将文本语义注入 query 以引导区域特征聚合；(2) 跨模态对齐模块，通过视觉-文本特征交互增强区域表示与类别语义的对应；(3) 渐进文本校正解码器，结合自顶向下路径与横向连接，逐级融合文本引导的深层语义与浅层视觉特征。
AI.result: 在 COCO-OVD 与 LVIS-OVD 两个公开数据集上取得较强性能，仅用简单文本 query 引导；扩展至开放词汇分割任务同样带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: TMCNet 通过多层次文本引导有效增强区域-类别语义对应与跨层级特征融合，兼具跨任务适用性与可扩展性。

title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
comment: Accepted at IAAI-27 (Innovative Applications of AI, co-located with AAAI 2027), Emerging Applications track. 12 pages (6 pages + references and appendix), 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体系统（核心为分诊智能体TriAgent），持续从工单与代码-文档差异中提取信号并修复文档漂移；43天影子运行分诊499个工单、发现92处文档缺口，LLM评审团判定81.1%可验证断言正确，修复后自评偏好率71.4%。
AI.motivation: AI加速了代码迭代，但面向用户的文档难以同步，信息陈旧；当LLM智能体把文档作为主要信息接口时，过时内容会被当作权威传播，危害放大。识别文档滞后的显式（已解决支持工单）与隐式（代码-文档不一致）信号其实大量存在，却缺少系统性利用与修复机制。
AI.method: 构建以分诊智能体TriAgent为核心的多智能体系统，持续抽取显式与隐式信号并进行文档漂移修复；以43天影子模式部署，用来自不同模型族的LLM评审团（三裁判多数投票）评估可验证断言正确性、成对偏好，并做盲审人工复核与修复前后的自我改进实验。
AI.result: 分诊499个工单，发现92处文档缺口；302条可验证断言中245条（81.1%）正确；长度可比对上TriAgent回复被偏好70.5%，人工工程师23.2%（其余无多数）；智能体与人工回复互补性强；修复后重答同一工单，盲评偏好修复后回答的比例为71.4%（n=35）；盲审人工核对确认自我改进结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 支持工单与代码-文档差异可作为高价值信号，实现文档漂移的自动发现与修复；多智能体系统在质量上可与人工回复互补甚至被偏好，且修复能可测量地提升后续回答准确性，形成可持续自改进闭环。

title: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. RiDEx thereby couples exploration-space selection with feedback about the changes it produces. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, RiDEx attains the highest peak rewards among the evaluated methods on four alignment and preference tasks. Its gradient-direction instantiation achieves 15x and 29x target-attainment speedups over DiffusionNFT on HPSv2 and PickScore, measured in H200 GPU hours. Controlled experiments confirm that reward-aligned directions elicit stronger responses at equal perturbation magnitude, and that applying their measured credit improves curve-average reward across all four tasks.

AI.tldr: RiDEx 将扩散模型后训练的探索集中在与奖励相关的子空间（去噪速度场中的方向），用等反向扰动测量终端奖励响应给出有符号局部监督，并与全局 DiffusionNFT 学习结合，在多种对齐任务上取得更高奖励和更快收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有基于奖励的扩散后训练方法虽然在采样与策略优化上有改进，但探索仍主要依赖高维隐空间中的各向同性随机扰动，扰动预算大量花在与目标奖励无关的方向上，探索效率低。作者因此研究"应在哪里探索"以及"如何从该探索中学习"。
AI.method: 提出 Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx)：1) 由条件残差或可微奖励梯度提出奖励相关子空间；2) 在同一生成状态下施加等大反向扰动，测量其在去噪速度场该子空间内的终端奖励响应；3) 用奖励差值提供有符号的局部监督（在子空间坐标上），同时所有生成图像参与全局 DiffusionNFT 学习，从而将探索空间选择与反馈耦合。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium 上，RiDEx 在四项对齐与偏好任务中峰值奖励均为评估方法中最高；其梯度方向实例在 HPSv2 和 PickScore 上相对 DiffusionNFT 分别实现 15× 和 29× 的目标达成加速（按 H200 GPU 小时计）。控制实验显示：等扰动幅度下奖励对齐方向引起更强响应，且应用其测得的 credit 可提升全部四项任务的曲线平均奖励。
AI.conclusion: 把探索限制在奖励相关方向、并用等反向扰动测得的有符号信用来指导更新，是提升扩散模型奖励后训练探索效率的有效途径，兼顾局部定向监督与全局策略优化。

title: RAG in a Trenchcoat: When Minimal Memory Is Enough for Agentic Systems, and When It Isn't
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Main Conference
summary: Agentic memory research has accumulated extraction, supersession, reflection, and graph synthesis on top of retrieval-augmented generation. However, we found that almost none of those primitives earn their cost in our tested memory benchmarks: we show this with BRIDGE, a deliberately minimal RAG memory with chained observation notes, hybrid BM25 with cosine retrieval, and chronological rendering, which reaches parity within bootstrap CI with the prior SOTA on LongMemEval-S and BEAM, and beats the best memory baseline on EverMemBench by 5.7-6.3 points at matched reader. It runs at ~5-7K reader-prompt tokens per query, using a single LLM call for each ingestion or query. We argue that this parity is itself the result: standard benchmarks score what memory retrieves, not what memory enables when the agent acts. To test the latter, we introduce five adversarial probes (Rule Application +-, Pattern Induction Style / Procedural, Dynamic Multiturn) judged at generation time by a cross vendor verification chain, where each query can only be solved by applying a remembered rule or pattern it never mentions. Across 5 probes x 20 scenarios, no architecture wins universally: atomic fact extractors (LangMem) win rule application, while BRIDGE's block-summary memory wins pattern induction. This result holds across four domains, three graders, and three reader families. Each design fails where the other wins, for reasons a recall benchmark cannot see: atomic-fact extractors discard the form a demonstrated pattern takes, while block-summary memory retrieves the rule but the reader does not act on it, a gap that presenting the rule more prominently largely closes. What separates memory designs is not what they retrieve but what they enable an agent to do, and that is what agentic memory should be evaluated on.

AI.tldr: Agentic memory的诸多复杂原语在基准测试中难以证明其成本合理性；极简RAG记忆BRIDGE即达SOTA水平，但真正区分记忆设计的是"能否让智能体行动"，而非检索效果。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic memory在RAG之上叠加抽取、替代、反思、图合成等原语，但作者发现这些原语在测试基准上几乎没有带来收益。同时标准基准只衡量记忆"检索了什么"，而非记忆"使智能体能做什么"。
AI.method: 提出极简RAG记忆BRIDGE（链式观察笔记+BM25与余弦混合检索+时间顺序渲染），每次摄入/查询仅一次LLM调用。并设计五个对抗性探针（规则应用±、模式归纳Style/Procedural、动态多轮），由跨厂商验证链在生成时评判，查询只能通过应用其从未提及的记忆规则或模式解决。
AI.result: BRIDGE在LongMemEval-S和BEAM上与先前SOTA在bootstrap CI内持平，在EverMemBench上以5.7-6.3分优势超过最佳基线，每查询约5-7K reader token。对抗探针中无架构通吃：原子事实抽取器（LangMem）赢规则应用，BRIDGE的块摘要记忆赢模式归纳；跨四个领域、三种评分器、三种reader均成立。
AI.conclusion: 区分记忆设计的不是"检索什么"而是"使智能体能做什么"。原子事实抽取器丢弃示范模式的形态，块摘要记忆虽检索到规则但reader不据此行动（更醒目地呈现规则可大幅弥补）。因此agentic memory应基于"赋能行动"来评估。

title: LMMR: Learned Multigranular Memory Retrieval for Small Language Model Agents
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/sungkites/LMMR
summary: Small language model agents have limited space to read the memory needed for multi-hop questions. Relevant facts are often scattered across records whose surrounding text consumes much of that space. We propose LMMR, a learned multigranular memory retrieval method that selects both the next source and how much of it to read. LMMR links paragraphs and sentence fragments to their original sources and pairs views that supply the same missing support during training. Relevant distractors and repeated information provide contrasting examples. At inference, the reranker scores what each candidate adds to an anchor passage, and a selector chooses the evidence within a token budget. On 22,398 official validation questions from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue, a frozen 2B answer model reaches 61.47, 43.26, and 30.58 F1 under a 400-token budget. The gains over query expansion are 3.06, 2.14, and 4.55 points, while memory input decreases by 23.1-26.9%. LMMR also uses 23.5-27.7% fewer input tokens than a coarse retriever trained on the same questions. Against that retriever followed by LLMLingua-2 at comparable input lengths, F1 gains reach 3.99 points and are significant on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA after Holm correction. All eight small answer models evaluated on HotpotQA improve over query expansion and MMR in both F1 and exact match.

AI.tldr: LMMR是一种可学习的多粒度记忆检索方法，为小语言模型多跳问答同时选择下一来源及读取量，在400 token预算下显著提升F1并减少输入。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型代理在多跳问答中可用的记忆空间有限，而相关事实分散在记录中，其周围文本占用大量空间，需要更精准地选择来源和读取粒度。
AI.method: LMMR将段落和句子片段链接到原始来源；训练时配对提供相同缺失支撑的视图，将有干扰项和重复信息作为对比样本；推理时用重排序器评估每个候选对锚定段落的增量贡献，由选择器在token预算内挑选证据。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue共22,398个官方验证问题上，冻结的2B模型在400 token预算下达到61.47/43.26/30.58 F1；较查询扩展提升3.06/2.14/4.55分，记忆输入减少23.1-26.9%；比同数据训练的粗粒度检索器少用23.5-27.7%输入token；对比该检索器加LLMLingua-2，F1提升达3.99分且经Holm校正后在两个数据集上显著；八个小型答案模型在HotpotQA上均优于查询扩展和MMR。
AI.conclusion: LMMR通过多粒度、预算感知的记忆检索，有效提升小模型多跳问答性能并降低输入成本，具有广泛适用性。

title: CEVA: Complementary Evidence Verification via Frame-Level Reorganization for Short-Video Fake News Detection
summary: Short-video platforms are now a common way for the public to follow unfolding events. Their rapid, visually persuasive format also makes fake news easier to spread. Unlike text-image posts, short-video news interleaves multiple modalities and changing scenes, making it difficult to identify which frames verify a claim. Existing detectors either pool sampled frames homogeneously or select them by text-frame similarity. Both overlook that aligned frames may repeat a misleading claim, whereas less dominant context may challenge it. We present CEVA (Complementary Evidence Verification Approach), to our knowledge the first short-video fake news detection framework to explicitly organize frames by their evidential roles before multimodal fusion. Its Dual-Branch Complementary Reorganization (DBCR) module separates explicit-alignment frames from candidate complementary-context frames, and cross-modal fusion with bidirectional contrastive regularization operates on the reorganized evidence. On FakeSV and FakeTT, CEVA achieves the best overall results among the compared methods. Under fixed frame budgets and backbones, DBCR outperforms uniform, random, and similarity-based selection and improves two structurally different detectors. Together, these results establish pre-fusion evidence organization as an effective and transferable component of short-video fake news detection.

AI.tldr: 提出CEVA框架，先按"证据角色"组织短视频关键帧（显式对齐帧 vs 互补上下文帧），再做跨模态融合，用于短视频假新闻检测。
AI.motivation: 短视频假新闻检测中，多模态交织、场景多变，难以判断哪些帧能验证论断。现有方法要么均匀采样帧，要么按文本-帧相似度选帧，都忽略了：高相似（对齐）的帧可能只是重复误导性论断，而弱主导的上下文反而可能对其构成挑战。
AI.method: CEVA框架，核心为双分支互补重组模块（DBCR）：将显式对齐帧与候选互补上下文帧分离，在重组后的证据上进行跨模态融合，并引入双向对比正则化。
AI.result: 在FakeSV和FakeTT上，CEVA在所比较方法中取得最佳整体效果；在固定帧预算与骨干网络下，DBCR优于均匀、随机及基于相似度的选帧策略，并能提升两种结构不同的检测器。
AI.conclusion: 将"融合前的证据组织"确立为短视频假新闻检测中有效且可迁移的组件。

title: stable-envs-v1: Fast and Reproducible Environments with Controllable Variations
summary: Training World Models (WMs) relies on processing large amounts of high-dimensional data, which typically needs to be stored, read into memory, and moved from memory to compute units. In principle, GPU-native rendering avoids this movement of large image tensors from memory to compute cores, allowing for better GPU utilization, and training speed-ups. Rendering on-demand also allows to control perceptual appearance through the application of visual variations on-the-fly, allowing for higher diversity in training. To this end, we introduce stable-envs, an open-source library for fast, GPU-native rendering allowing to apply controllable variations on multiple simulation environments. By rendering image observations directly on GPU, stable-envs allows end-to-end training speed-ups of up to 1.33x, with no loss of performance. Besides faster training runs, stable-envs also enables reproducible, large-scale evaluations through batched physics while maintaining full determinism. stable-envs currently supports 80 simulation environments across multiple CPU- and GPU-backends, and is openly available at: https://github.com/galilai-group/stable-envs

AI.tldr: 提出开源库 stable-envs，实现 GPU 原生渲染，避免图像张量在内存与计算单元间搬运，带来最高 1.33x 端到端训练加速且性能不降。
AI.motivation: 世界模型训练需处理大量高维图像数据，需存储、读入内存并在内存与计算单元间搬运，造成 GPU 利用率低、训练慢；同时希望在线视觉变化提升数据多样性。
AI.method: 构建 GPU 原生渲染库 stable-envs，直接在 GPU 上渲染图像观测，支持对多个仿真环境施加可控视觉变化，并通过批量物理仿真保持完全确定性。
AI.result: 端到端训练加速最高 1.33x 且无性能损失；支持可复现的大规模批量评估；覆盖 80 个仿真环境，兼容多种 CPU 与 GPU 后端。
AI.conclusion: GPU 原生按需渲染是世界模型训练提速与增强多样性的有效方案，stable-envs 已开源可用。

title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
summary: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.

AI.tldr: 在"权重空间编程"场景下（LLM手写权重、不用梯度训练），让三个前沿LLM自由设计架构时，都不约而同选择了"稀疏查表+固定查询过程"的关联记忆结构，精度远超同LLM写的Transformer且参数少约1800倍，据此提出GPU上快17倍的关联记忆模型。
AI.motivation: 标准架构（如Transformer）被选中主要是因为它便于梯度下降训练、在GPU上快。而在权重空间编程中，LLM直接手写目标权重、不依赖梯度训练，这些理由不再成立。因此作者质疑：此时是否还应沿用Transformer，并探究LLM在无梯度条件下会自发选择什么样的结构。
AI.method: 给定极少指导、十个标注样本和一个沙盒环境（主要是多选题），让三个前沿LLM二选一：(1)为固定架构生成权重；(2)自行设计架构。同时测试预训练权重、其他基准以及需要生成答案的任务，并基于观察结果提出关联记忆模型。
AI.result: 自由设计时，三个LLM都把纯文本事实编译成一张稀疏表，用固定过程查询，最高达54.4%测试准确率。LLM设计的模型比同一LLM手写的最准Transformer精度更高，参数少约1800倍。每个错误答案对应一行，删除一行只影响约另一个答案。所提关联记忆模型在GPU上比同尺寸Transformer快达17倍。预训练LLM精度仍更高。
AI.conclusion: 当以"手写权重"的方式构建模型时，应优先选择关联记忆/查表结构而非Transformer：它参数更少、更可解释（每个权重含义可述、错误可定位重写）、更快，隐式近似"无梯度训练"。但该主张仅限权重空间编程场景，预训练模型在精度上依然领先。

title: Fine-Grained Japanese Clinical Named Entity Recognition: A Controlled Comparison of BERT and Open-Weight Large Language Models
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes appendices with supplementary tables and one supplementary figure
summary: Background: Generative large language models (LLMs) offer an alternative to encoder-based clinical named entity recognition (NER), but their performance on fine-grained Japanese extraction tasks and sensitivity to generation settings remain uncertain. Methods: We compared two fine-tuned BERT-CRF baselines with nine open-weight LLMs on iCorpus, which defines 113 entity categories. The evaluation used 433 sentences from 36 test documents; 1,672 sentences were used for training. LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot prompting with and without JSON Schema constraints and three-seed QLoRA fine-tuning. Fine-tuned models were assessed under different output-token limits, including 900 and larger model-specific limits of 2,600 or 4,096 tokens. Performance was measured using sentence-level label-surface matching with relaxed and exact-surface F1. Results: The highest zero-shot relaxed F1 was 0.337, compared with 0.836-0.841 for the BERT baselines. At the larger output limits, all eight fine-tuned LLMs with at least 13B total parameters exceeded both BERT baselines (relaxed F1, 0.882-0.914; exact-surface F1, 0.840-0.880). Across three-seed means, increasing the output limit improved relaxed F1 by 0.052-0.085, alongside higher recall and fewer length-limited outputs. JSON Schema constraints changed relaxed F1 by -0.014 to +0.008 among seven models outside the two reasoning-oriented configurations, while medical-general model pairs showed no consistent advantage for medical specialization. Conclusions: On this historical Japanese case-report benchmark, task-specific fine-tuning combined with adequate generation capacity was associated with stronger LLM extraction performance. Output-token limits materially affected comparisons with BERT, whereas enforcing output structure alone did not overcome low zero-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究生成式大模型在细粒度日语临床命名实体识别（113类）上的表现，与微调BERT-CRF对比，发现任务微调+充足输出token预算的LLM可超过BERT，而零样本与单纯JSON约束不足。
AI.motivation: 生成式LLM被视为编码器式临床NER的替代方案，但其在细粒度日本语抽取任务上的效果、以及对生成设置（输出长度、结构化约束、医学专精）的敏感性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在iCorpus（113个实体类别，1672句训练、36篇文档433句测试）上，对比2个微调BERT-CRF基线与9个开放权重LLM；LLM采用零样本提示（有无JSON Schema约束）以及三种子QLoRA微调；微调模型在900与2600/4096等不同输出token上限下评估；以句级标签-表面匹配的宽松与精确F1衡量。
AI.result: 零样本最高宽松F1仅0.337，BERT基线为0.836–0.841；较大输出上限下，8个≥13B参数的微调LLM全部超过BERT（宽松F1 0.882–0.914，精确F1 0.840–0.880）；提升输出上限使宽松F1提高0.052–0.085，召回上升、截断输出减少；JSON Schema约束对F1影响在−0.014至+0.008之间；医学专精模型未见一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 在该历史日语病例报告基准上，任务特定微调结合充足生成容量与更强抽取性能相关；输出token上限显著影响与BERT的比较，而仅靠结构化输出约束无法弥补零样本精度不足。

title: Growing Clusters Lower the Bar: Profile Accretion in LLM-Based Incremental Entity Resolution
summary: Incremental entity resolution pipelines ask a large language model (LLM) whether a new record belongs to an existing cluster and show it the records already linked. Analyses of matching oracles assume that the answer depends only on the records compared. For the LLM matchers we test, it depends on cluster size, and the model lowers its bar for joining a cluster as the cluster grows. On French procurement suppliers from FOPPA, with SIREN identifiers as ground truth, we hold the new record fixed and vary only the number of verified members shown. Sixteen members instead of one raise the false match rate on similarly named companies by \dfmrMin--\dfmrMax{} percentage points in six open-weight models, while their area under the ROC curve rises by only \aucGainMin--\aucGainMax. In Claude Sonnet~5 and Haiku~5.5 the rise is \clSonD{} and \clHaiD{} points. The shift persists with street addresses, prompt variants and the BatchER and ComEM formats, and one false merge raises acceptance of the intruder's other records in every open model. It does not arise on Czech and Bulgarian TED notices, where one record with its full address already identifies the company. In online linking on confusable blocks, a single threshold set on labelled data raises recall by a factor of \fxRRmin--\fxRRmax{} for five models with no detectable loss of precision and no extra LLM calls.

AI.tldr: 在增量式实体解析中，LLM匹配器的判定并非只依赖被比较记录，而会随已链接簇规模增大而降低入簇门槛，导致假匹配率显著上升。
AI.motivation: 现有匹配oracle分析假设答案只取决于被比较的记录，但实际LLM匹配器可能受簇大小等上下文影响。作者希望检验这一假设并量化簇规模对匹配决策的偏差。
AI.method: 在FOPPA法国采购供应商数据上（以SIREN为真值），固定新记录、仅改变展示的已验证成员数量（1 vs 16），测试六个开源模型及Claude Sonnet 5、Haiku 5.5；用ROC/AUC、假匹配率衡量；并用地址、提示变体、BatchER/ComEM格式及捷克/保加利亚TED公告做稳健性检验。
AI.result: 16个成员相对1个成员使同名相似公司的假匹配率上升\dfmrMin--\dfmrMax个百分点，AUC仅小幅上升；Claude Sonnet 5和Haiku 5.5分别上升\clSonD和\clHaiD点。该偏移在地址、提示变体和BatchER/ComEM格式下持续存在，且一次错误合并会提高入侵者其他记录的接受度；但在捷克和保加利亚TED公告中不出现（单条含完整地址记录已可识别公司）。
AI.conclusion: LLM实体解析存在簇规模偏差；在易混淆块上基于标注数据设置单一阈值可在不损失精度、不增加调用的情况下将召回提升\fxRRmin--\fxRRmax倍，为实用改进提供了简单方案。

title: EgoHandWAM: Probing the Role of Hand Motion in Egocentric World Action Modeling
summary: How much does hand motion tell us about what a first-person camera will see next? EgoHandWAM forecasts three-dimensional wrist and fingertip trajectories and a future visual feature from the current image and recent hand states. We train on 751,065 EgoDex windows using a frozen DINOv2 encoder. On held-out development sessions, the action-only model reduces two-second wrist endpoint error from 60.26 to 56.48~mm relative to a stationary forecast. It still underestimates long reaches. Adding future-feature supervision gives nearly identical trajectory accuracy. With the recorded hand history, the visual head reduces smooth L1 error by 1.32\% relative to copying the current feature. Shuffling histories across sessions erases this gain. In a separate four-task probe, adding recorded future displacements to observed context and future tracking-validity masks reduces visual-feature error by 3.93\%. Masks alone give little improvement. A trajectory predicted from the same observations adds little. On two simulated RoboTwin tasks, substituting aligned human examples for an auxiliary batch of robot examples gives no consistent increase in task success across three training seeds.

AI.tldr: EgoHandWAM 用冻结 DINOv2 编码器，从当前图像与近期手部状态预测三维手腕/指尖轨迹和未来视觉特征；轨迹预测仅小幅优于静止基线，视觉预测增益依赖真实手部历史，迁移到机器人任务无明显收益。
AI.motivation: 探究第一人称视角下"手部运动"能在多大程度上预测相机下一步将看到的视觉内容，即手部状态与未来视觉特征之间的信息关联程度。
AI.method: 在 751,065 个 EgoDex 窗口上训练，使用冻结 DINOv2 编码器；模型同时输出三维手腕与指尖轨迹预测和未来视觉特征预测。设置消融：仅动作、加入未来特征监督、打乱跨会话历史、四任务探针（观测上下文+未来位移+跟踪有效性掩码），以及在 RoboTwin 两个仿真任务中用对齐人类示例替换机器人辅助批次。
AI.result: 动作模型将两秒手腕端点误差从 60.26mm 降至 56.48mm（相对静止预测），但仍低估长距离伸手；加入未来特征监督轨迹精度几乎不变。视觉头在有真实手部历史时平滑L1降低 1.32%，打乱历史后增益消失。四任务探针中加入未来位移与有效性掩码使视觉特征误差降低 3.93%，仅掩码收益很小，由同观测预测的轨迹贡献也小。RoboTwin 三个随机种子下，用人类示例替代机器人辅助批次无一致成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 手部运动对短期未来视觉内容仅提供有限且依赖真实历史的信息；显式预测的轨迹价值有限，人类示例的跨域迁移收益不稳健。

title: Identifying and Repairing Energy Smells with Agent Skills
summary: Energy smells are inefficient implementations that waste energy. Once code reaches production, these smells become costlier and riskier to fix, so energy efficiency checks should shift left, i.e., move earlier in the development lifecycle, to where code is written. Existing energy smell tools rely on fixed static rules and do not measure energy savings, whereas LLM-based optimizers mostly target execution time and rarely ground their changes in concrete smell definitions. To address both limitations, we present DR. GREENS, an agent skill that detects and repairs energy smells in Python code within the developer's coding environment. The skill grounds the coding agent in our taxonomy of 12 energy smells and 65 root causes, augmented with repair guidance drawn from 230 measured cases. The skill also encapsulates a static analyzer and an independent verifier to confirm behavior preservation and energy saving for each attempted repair. We evaluated DR. GREENS in 18 sessions on three open-source repositories, with two models and three skill configurations. Of the 258 measured repairs, 68.6% saved energy, with a median saving of 24.9%. Compared with a baseline skill that lacks the taxonomy, the full skill found more energy smells with verified savings in all three repositories with both models. DR. GREENS helps developers detect energy hotspots and fix them reliably without altering program behavior, which makes energy-efficient development more feasible.

AI.tldr: DR. GREENS 是一个嵌入开发环境的 coding agent skill，基于12类能量异味(65个根因)分类法和230个实测案例的修复指导，结合静态分析器与独立验证器，在 Python 代码中检测并修复能量异味，258次修复中68.6%节省能量，中位节省24.9%。
AI.motivation: 能量异味是低效实现，进入生产后修复成本与风险更高，因此能效检查需"左移"到编码阶段。现有能量异味工具依赖固定静态规则且不衡量节能效果；基于LLM的优化器多以执行时间为目标，且改动很少依托具体异味定义。
AI.method: 提出 DR. GREENS agent skill：以12类能量异味、65个根因的分类法为基础，辅以230个实测案例提取的修复指导；封装静态分析器与独立验证器，对每次尝试的修复确认行为保持与节能效果。
AI.result: 在3个开源仓库、2个模型、3种skill配置下进行18次会话评估；258次实测修复中68.6%节省能量，中位节省24.9%；与缺少分类法的基线skill相比，完整skill在两个模型、三个仓库中均发现更多带验证节能的能量异味。
AI.conclusion: DR. GREENS 帮助开发者在生产前检测能量热点并可靠修复且不改变程序行为，使能效开发更可行。

title: Two Counterexamples for e-means
summary: e-means (Bessa et al., 2026) combines exponential averaging and cluster revival. We give two counterexamples to its published recipe with higher final loss than standard k-means (Lloyd, 1982) from identical initial centers. Mass-based revival can destroy a global optimum and make the ratio of expected losses unbounded even with k-means++ seeding.

AI.tldr: 论文用两个反例说明 e-means（指数平均与簇复活结合）的已发表配方可能比标准 k-means 收敛到更差的解，最终损失更高。
AI.motivation: e-means 将指数滑动平均与"按质量复活簇"机制结合，被认为能改善 k-means 的局部最优问题，但其配方缺少理论保证，需要检验其是否真能优于标准 Lloyd 算法。
AI.method: 构造两个反例：在相同初始中心下分别运行 e-means 已发表配方与标准 k-means；并分析基于质量的复活机制对全局最优解的影响，包括在 k-means++ 初始化下对期望损失比界的分析。
AI.result: 两个反例中 e-means 的最终损失均高于标准 k-means；质量驱动的复活可能破坏全局最优，使期望损失之比在 k-means++ 播种下仍无界。
AI.conclusion: e-means 的已发表配方缺乏可靠性保证，其复活机制存在结构性缺陷；实践与理论评估需以标准 k-means 为基线谨慎对待此类改进。

title: The Fragility of Reasoning-Importance Attribution for Pruning Language Models
summary: Attribution-guided pruning scores components by their causal contribution and protects the important ones, and it is increasingly applied to compress reasoning language models without destroying their chain of thought. Its reliability rests on an unexamined assumption: that reasoning importance can be faithfully measured. Across four small reasoning models, we show this measurement is fragile in three ways, each of which changes pruning decisions. First, scoring final-answer tokens, the natural choice, saturates in every chain-of-thought model we test (answer-token negative log-likelihood, NLL, of $10^{-4}$--$10^{-3}$) because the model states its answer inside its own reasoning; guiding head pruning with this target costs 27.6 and 32.2 accuracy points relative to scoring reasoning tokens on the two models we power with five seeds, while perplexity barely moves and even reverses sign at 7B. Second, causal importance is not localizable to single units: single-neuron effects sit at the measurement floor, their cross-split ranking is noise, and they cancel: a group's ablation effect disagrees in sign with the summed effects of its members in 90\% of groups. Reproducible importance emerges only at groups of $\sim 100$ neurons. Third, contrastively isolated ``reasoning-specific'' importance is not separable from generic importance, and protecting it is worse than protecting raw importance. We additionally pre-registered the hypothesis that distillation-induced concentration of importance predicts the pruning cost; it is not supported, and since our grid confounds concentration with scale, we report it as unresolved rather than reversed. The result is a short set of measurement rules: score reasoning tokens, attribute at coarse granularity, and evaluate with accuracy rather than perplexity.

AI.tldr: 作者检验了"归因引导剪枝"所依赖的"推理重要性可被忠实度量"这一隐含假设,在四个小型推理模型上发现该度量在三方面均不可靠,并据此给出一组测量规范。
AI.motivation: 归因引导剪枝按因果贡献对组件打分并保护重要组件,已被广泛用于压缩推理语言模型而不破坏其思维链。但其可靠性建立在一个未被检验的假设上——推理重要性可被忠实测量。本文要检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 在四个小型推理模型上考察三种测度失效:(1) 用最终答案 token 打分(自然选择),在 CoT 模型中饱和;(2) 因果重要性无法定位到单个单元,单神经元效应处于测量噪声底、跨切分排序为噪声、且组内效应相互抵消;(3) 通过对比隔离出的"推理专属"重要性无法与通用重要性区分。另预注册了"蒸馏导致的重要性集中度预测剪枝代价"这一假设并进行检验。
AI.result: 答案 token 的 NLL 低至 10^-4–10^-3 而饱和;以答案 token 引导头剪枝,相比按推理 token 打分在两个各用五个种子的模型上损失 27.6 与 32.2 个准确率点,而困惑度几乎不变、甚至在 7B 上符号反转。单神经元效应低于测量底噪、排序为噪声,且90%的组中"组整体消融效应"与"成员效应之和"符号不一致;可复现的重要性只在约100个神经元的组粒度上出现。保护"推理专属"重要性劣于保护原始重要性。关于集中度的预注册假设未获支持,但因网格混淆了集中度与规模,作者将其列为未定论而非被推翻。
AI.conclusion: 给出三条测量规则:用推理 token 而非答案 token 打分;在粗粒度(约100神经元组)上做归因;用准确率而非困惑度评估剪枝效果。

title: From syllable representation via gesture generation to articulation: A spiking neural model
comment: 47 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Neurolinguistics on 8 November 2026
summary:
Speech production requires a transformation from phonological representations into coordinated vocal-tract movements. This paper presents a spiking neural sensorimotor model within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture. Each syllable occurrence has a neural oscillator whose evolving phase coordinates its gestures and initiates the next syllable. Phase-dependent commands recruit separate neural populations for vocalic, oral-constriction, velopharyngeal, and glottal actions (gestures). Neural ramp integrators shape the rise and fall of gesture activation. Together with articulatory targets, these trajectories determine the extent and time course of articulatory movements. Opponent neural populations provide control signals to a geometric articulatory model.
  Thirty reference recordings cover an input corpus of eight lexical words, an alternative realization of one word, a syllable sequence, and isolated syllables. Two additional paired simulation subcorpora of sixty runs each, covering two words and one syllable sequence, assess activation reliability across neural realizations. Adjusting gesture command amplitudes increased successful realizations from 57/60 to 60/60 under the specified criteria, with ramp rate factors held constant.
  The model demonstrates how neural oscillator and ramp dynamics generate articulatory timing under specified phasing rules. It complements a preceding mental-lexicon model through an ordered syllable interface. Continuous online execution across all components and connection to the acoustic extension remain further integration steps. Accessible code and synchronized visualization support inspection of the neural activation trajectories and resulting vocal-tract movements.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于神经工程框架(NEF)与语义指针架构(SPA)的脉冲神经网络感觉运动模型，用神经振荡器相位协调音节手势，用斜坡积分器塑造手势激活轨迹，从而驱动几何发音模型产生语音。
AI.motivation: 语音产生需要将音系表征转化为协调的声道运动，作者希望用脉冲神经网络在生物可信的框架下统一解释音节计时与发音手势控制。
AI.method: 每个音节实例对应一个神经振荡器，其相位协调手势并触发下一音节；相位相关指令招募元音、口腔收缩、腭咽与声门四类手势的独立神经群体；神经斜坡积分器形成手势激活的升降轨迹，结合发音目标决定运动幅度与时程；对置神经群体为几何发音模型提供控制信号。使用30段参考录音(8个词、1个词的替代实现、一个音节序列及孤立音节)和两组各60次运行的配对仿真子语料评估激活可靠性。
AI.result: 在固定斜坡速率因子下，调整手势指令幅度使成功实现数从57/60提升至60/60。模型展示了振荡器与斜坡动力学在给定相位规则下如何生成发音计时；两组各60次仿真用于评估不同神经实现下的激活可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 模型表明神经振荡器与斜坡动力学可解释发音计时；它通过有序音节接口与前序心理词典模型互补，但全组件连续在线运行及与声学模块的连接仍需进一步集成。代码与同步可视化可公开用于检查神经激活轨迹及声道运动。

title: Unsupervised Multi-modal Medical Image Registration via Invertible Translation
summary: In medical imaging, the alignment of multi-modal images plays a critical role in providing comprehensive information for image-guided therapies. Despite its importance, multi-modal image registration poses significant challenges due to the complex and often unknown spatial relationships between different image modalities. To address this, we introduce a novel unsupervised translation-based multi-modal registration method, termed Invertible Neural Network-based Registration (INNReg). INNReg consists of an image-to-image translation network that converts multi-modal images into mono-modal counterparts and a registration network that uses the translated mono-modal images to align the multi-modal images. Specifically, to ensure the preservation of geometric consistency after image translation, we introduce an Invertible Neural Network (INN) that leverages a dynamic depthwise convolution-based local attention mechanism. Additionally, we design a novel barrier loss function based on Normalized Mutual Information to impose constraints on the registration network, which enhances the registration accuracy. The superior performance of INNReg is demonstrated through experiments on two public multi-modal medical image datasets, including MRI T1/T2 and MRI/CT pairs. The code is available at https://github.com/MeggieGuo/INNReg

AI.tldr: INNReg 是一种无监督的基于翻译的多模态医学图像配准方法，用可逆神经网络保证翻译的几何一致性，并用基于归一化互信息的 barrier 损失提升配准精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学图像配准对图像引导治疗至关重要，但不同模态间空间关系复杂且往往未知，现有方法难以应对，因此需要一种能稳定处理跨模态对齐的方案。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：图像到图像翻译网络将多模态图像转换为单模态图像，配准网络在翻译后的单模态图像上完成对齐。为保证翻译后几何一致性，引入可逆神经网络（INN），并结合动态深度可分离卷积的局部注意力机制；同时设计基于归一化互信息（NMI）的新型 barrier 损失函数来约束配准网络。
AI.result: 在两个公开多模态医学图像数据集（MRI T1/T2 与 MRI/CT）上的实验表明 INNReg 性能优越。
AI.conclusion: INNReg 通过翻译-配准联合框架、可逆网络保持几何一致性和 NMI barrier 损失，有效提升了无监督多模态医学图像配准的精度，代码已开源。

title: Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
summary: New coding models advertise themselves on score improvements of coding benchmarks. Yet no study has tested if a model that scores higher on these benchmarks gets more real work done. On June 12, 2026, a U.S. export control directive banned access to Claude Fable 5 for 19 days, which forced users to switch to other models. During this time, most former Fable 5 users switched to Opus 4.8 (11 points lower on SWE-Bench Pro compared to Fable 5). We treat this suspension as a natural experiment, where the people and projects stayed the same and only the model changed, so we could isolate the effect of Fable 5 on user productivity. We tracked GitHub pull requests of 297 Fable 5 users before, during, and after the suspension. We used 8,908 developers who stayed on Opus 4.8 all the time as the control group. We also repeated the comparison across five model upgrades before and after the suspension in 2026 (1,208 developers, 15,442 pull requests). Fitting a difference-in-differences model with developer and date fixed effects, we found that having access to Fable 5 increased the 7-day merge rate of pull requests by only 1.4 percentage points [-1.4; +4.3], which was not statistically significant. Similarly, no significant increases of merge rates were found with the upgrades (weighted mean: -0.9 percentage points [-1.9; +0.2]); all five estimates were negative (95% intervals included 0, did not differ from each other). We also did not observe a significant increase in the number of pull requests merged per week (+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]).

AI.tldr: 利用Fable 5被出口管制暂停访问的19天作为自然实验，差分中差分分析显示：编码基准分数更高的模型并未显著提升开发者真实工作效率（PR 7天合并率仅+1.4pp，不显著）。
AI.motivation: 业界以编码基准分数宣传模型性能，但从未有研究验证"基准分数更高是否等于真实工作产出更多"，这一关联性存在重要空白。
AI.method: 以2026年6月12日起Fable 5被暂停访问19天为自然实验（人/项目不变、仅模型变化）。追踪297名Fable 5用户暂停前、中、后的GitHub PR；以8,908名始终使用Opus 4.8的开发者作对照组；并重复比较2026年暂停前后五次模型升级（1,208名开发者、15,442个PR）。采用含开发者与日期固定效应的差分中差分（DiD）模型。
AI.result: Fable 5使PR 7天合并率仅提升1.4pp [-1.4, +4.3]，不显著；五次升级加权平均为-0.9pp [-1.9, +0.2]，五项估计均为负且区间含0、彼此无差异；每周合并PR数亦无显著增加（+2.4% [-4.9%, +10.2%]）。
AI.conclusion: 基准分数的提升并不能转化为可测量的真实生产力提升，编码基准作为衡量实际工作价值的指标有效性存疑，需谨慎解读模型宣传中的分数优势。

title: BernBRS: Certified Backward Reachability for Deep Bernstein Neural Networks
summary: Ensuring the safety of complex neural network systems requires mathematically rigorous verification. While backward reachability analysis is a critical tool for identifying safe initial states, computing tight, formal bounds remains notoriously difficult to scale. Recent advancements have demonstrated that DeepBern-Nets neural networks utilizing Bernstein polynomial activation functions possess advantageous mathematical properties that enable exceptionally fast and tight forward reachability analysis. Building upon this efficiency, this paper introduces BernBRS, a highly accurate and scalable framework for the backward reachability analysis of DeepBern-Nets. BernBRS simultaneously computes certified inner and outer approximations of the Backward Reachable Set (BRS). Rather than relying on single convex bounding, our method intelligently refines a cover of the input space by analyzing activation patterns, splitting the input domain precisely where an exact decomposition of the relaxation gap predicts the most significant reduction in error. This targeted refinement enables high levels of scalability to highly complex and massive architectures that remain intractable for existing certified methods. We demonstrate the efficacy of our framework on high-dimensional models, including a linearized closed-loop approximation of the Half-Cheetah controller and a distilled Bernstein student of a Transformer block and we empirically study how these model-level guarantees relate to the original Half-Cheetah and TinyBERT classifier, respectively.

AI.tldr: BernBRS 是一个针对 DeepBern-Nets（使用 Bernstein 多项式激活函数的网络）的后向可达性分析框架，可同时计算认证的内近似与外近似 BRS，并通过基于激活模式和精确分解松弛间隙的定向域分裂实现高精度与强扩展性。
AI.motivation: 复杂神经网络系统的安全性需要数学上严格的验证；后向可达性分析是识别安全初始状态的关键工具，但计算紧致且形式化的边界极难扩展。已有工作表明 DeepBern-Nets 具备利于高效、紧致前向可达性分析的数学性质，本文希望利用这一效率把优势延伸到后向可达性分析。
AI.method: BernBRS 同时计算 BRS 的认证内近似与外近似；不依赖单一凸包界，而是分析激活模式对输入空间覆盖进行智能细化，并在松弛间隙的精确分解所预测误差下降最大的位置精确分裂输入域，从而实现定向细化。
AI.result: 在半猎豹（Half-Cheetah）控制器线性化闭环近似和 Transformer 模块的蒸馏 Bernstein 学生模型等高维模型上验证了有效性，并实证研究了这些模型级保证与原 Half-Cheetah 及 TinyBERT 分类器之间的关系；可扩展到现有认证方法难以处理的复杂大规模架构。
AI.conclusion: 利用 DeepBern-Nets 的数学性质并配合定向域细化，后向可达性分析可以在保持认证紧致性的同时实现显著的可扩展性，且模型级保证可为原始复杂系统提供参考。

title: Context Has a Price: Adding and Removing Context for LLM Coding Agents under Prefix Caching
summary: Coding agents repeatedly send their conversation history to a language model. Adding useful code may reduce search, while removing old tool outputs may shorten later prompts. But do these changes reduce the cost of solving a task? We study this as a measurement problem in more than 20,000 runs of open models on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench and Loc-Bench. We account separately for uncached input, cached input and output tokens. Three findings emerge. First, in our main evidence-package experiments, retrieved code reduces read and search commands by 18--34%, but increases cost by 33--42% when cached input costs one tenth of uncached input, without a measurable improvement in resolution. Second, removing old observations can either save money or increase cost: the same approach saves 19--36% without a cache discount but increases cost by 38--116% with a tenth-price cache. Third, shorter prompts do not guarantee cheaper runs because agents may respond by taking more steps. We also find that concurrent experiments can share cached prefixes and distort cost comparisons. These results show why context-management methods should be evaluated using both token prices and the agent's subsequent behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文研究编码智能体上「上下文管理」操作（加入检索代码、删除旧工具输出）是否真的降低任务求解成本。基于2万余次SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench、Loc-Bench实验并按未缓存输入/缓存输入/输出token分别计费，发现许多"省token"的做法在有缓存折扣时反而增加成本。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体反复向模型发送对话历史，人们直觉上认为加入有用代码可减少搜索、删除旧工具输出可缩短后续提示从而省钱。但这种"省token即省钱"的假设缺少系统验证，尤其在有缓存输入折扣（缓存价约为未缓存的1/10）的真实计费场景下，需要把成本作为测量问题来量化。
AI.method: 在SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench和Loc-Bench上，对开源模型进行超过20,000次运行，将成本拆分为未缓存输入、缓存输入和输出token三类分别核算；设计"证据包"实验比较检索代码的加入效果，并对照删除旧观测的做法；同时在有/无缓存折扣两种价格设定下比较成本，并分析并发实验共享缓存前缀带来的干扰。
AI.result: (1) 证据包实验中检索代码使读取与搜索命令减少18–34%，但在缓存价为1/10时成本上升33–42%，且解题成功率无可测提升；(2) 删除旧观测在无缓存折扣时节省19–36%，在1/10缓存价下反而增加38–116%；(3) 更短提示不保证更便宜，因智能体可能采取更多步骤；(4) 并发实验可共享缓存前缀，扭曲成本比较。
AI.conclusion: 上下文管理方法不能仅以token数量或提示长度评估，必须同时考虑实际token价格结构（尤其是缓存折扣）以及智能体随后的行为反应。作者据此提出应以"token价格+后续行为"联合评估编码智能体的上下文管理策略。

title: MM-ReportBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Report Generation from Tables
summary: The ability to generate multimodal reports integrating fluent narratives with faithful visualizations from tabular data, has become a cornerstone capability for modern vision-language models in practical domains such as finance, healthcare, and policy making. However, existing benchmarks are limited by single-modality focus, simplistic metrics, novelty evaluation, and visualization quality. We address these limitations with MM-ReportBench, a multimodal report evaluation benchmark covering 386 tasks across 185 real-world tables. Each task is paired with an expert-curated reference report featuring standardized chapter structures and verifiable key insight points, constructed through a hybrid pipeline of multimodal reports generation based on Monte Carlo Tree Search and rigorous human quality control. For robust evaluation, we design a dual-judge evaluation framework: Text Judge Model assesses textual quality along structural completeness, grounded insight verification with numerical fact-checking against source tables, and novelty analysis that distinguishes genuine analytical discovery from trivial paraphrasing; Visualization Judge Model evaluates generated visualizations across data fidelity, expressiveness, aesthetics, and technical correctness. They also evaluate cross-modal consistency. Extensive experiments on 20 state-of-the-art models reveal critical weaknesses: even the strongest model achieves only 68.9 overall score, with numerical hallucination affecting 38.5% of reports and genuinely novel insights remaining rare. Our ablation studies further demonstrate that single-judge evaluation consistently inflates scores by 8-12 points compared to dual-judge assessment, confirming that rigorous and reliable benchmarking demands multi-faceted, complementary evaluation probes.

AI.tldr: 提出 MM-ReportBench：含 386 个任务、185 张真实表格的多模态报告评测基准，配专家参考报告与"双评委"框架（文本评委+可视化评委），20 个 SOTA 模型最强仅 68.9 分，数值幻觉影响 38.5% 报告，单评委比双评委虚高 8-12 分。
AI.motivation: 从表格生成"流畅叙述+忠实可视化"的多模态报告是金融、医疗、政策等场景的核心能力，但现有基准存在四类缺陷：只关注单一模态、指标过于简单、只评估新颖性、忽视可视化质量。作者希望建立更严格、可靠、多维的评测体系。
AI.method: 构建 MM-ReportBench：386 个任务覆盖 185 张真实表格，每任务配专家参考报告（标准化章节结构+可验证关键洞察点），采用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的多模态报告生成与严格人工质控的混合流水线。评测采用双评委框架：Text Judge 评估结构完整性、基于源表格数值事实核查的洞察验证、区分真实发现与简单改述的新颖性分析；Visualization Judge 评估数据保真、表现力、美观性与技术正确性；并评估跨模态一致性。
AI.result: 在 20 个 SOTA 模型上实验：最强模型总分仅 68.9；38.5% 的报告存在数值幻觉；真正新颖的洞察稀少。消融显示单评委评测比双评委一致高出 8-12 分，说明单评委存在系统性虚高。
AI.conclusion: 现有多模态报告生成能力仍显著不足，尤其数值忠实性与分析新颖性；严谨可靠的基准评测必须依赖多面向、互补的评测探针，而非单一评委。

title: Centroid Spectral Coupling: Implicit Alignment and Representation Diversity in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) aims to align augmented views while preserving representation diversity and preventing collapse. Existing non-contrastive methods often address these goals using multiple weighted loss terms. We introduce Centroid Spectral Coupling (CSC), a single-term SSL objective that implicitly couples view alignment, representation diversity, and collapse resistance. CSC constructs centroids from independently normalized augmented-view pairs and applies a ridge-based spectral objective to their uncentered second-moment matrix. Preserving centroid magnitudes encodes view agreement while encouraging balanced representation energy across spectral directions. We establish an exact decomposition into nonnegative alignment and spectral-imbalance components, characterize the geometry of global optima, and derive finite-loss guarantees for alignment and diversity. We also show that complete constant-output collapse is a strict saddle in normalized representation space. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Imagenette show that CSC achieves the highest linear Top-1 accuracy among the evaluated non-contrastive methods on all three benchmarks, and the highest kNN Top-1 accuracy on both CIFAR datasets. A ridge-parameter sensitivity study reveals an empirical alignment--diversity trade-off: increasing $κ$ strengthens view alignment but reduces representation effective rank. These results show that a unified spectral objective yields competitive visual representations without explicit contrastive negatives or separately weighted alignment and diversity penalties.
