AI.tldr: 提出单损失项自监督目标 CSC（质心谱耦合），用基于 ridge 的谱目标隐式耦合视图对齐、表示多样性与防坍缩，理论上给出分解与最优几何刻画，实验在三个基准上取得最优线性与 kNN 精度。
AI.motivation: 现有非对比方法需多个加权损失项分别处理视图对齐、表示多样性与防坍缩，引入额外超参且难以协调；本文希望用单一目标同时实现三者。
AI.method: CSC 由独立归一化的增强视图对构造质心，对其无中心化二阶矩矩阵施加 ridge 谱目标；保持质心模长编码视图一致性，并在谱方向上均衡表示能量。理论上给出对齐项与谱不平衡项的非负精确分解、全局最优几何刻画、有限损失下对齐与多样性的保证，并证明常数输出坍缩在归一化表示空间中为严格鞍点。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Imagenette 上，CSC 的线性 Top-1 精度在被评估的非对比方法中均最高，两个 CIFAR 数据集上 kNN Top-1 也最高。ridge 参数敏感性研究显示 κ 增大增强对齐但降低表示有效秩，呈经验性对齐—多样性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 统一谱目标可在无显式对比负样本、无需分别加权对齐与多样性惩罚的情况下获得有竞争力的视觉表示。

title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
summary: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rules before acting, the coding adapter writes its own test or scratch files on SWE-bench Pro V2, the constraints adapter carries earlier turns into its answers, the chart adapter measures the marks in code, and the document adapter reads AutomationBench's spreadsheets.

AI.tldr: 对Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B/12B active) 用五个专家构建的任务数据集分别做RL后训练，每个数据集独立训练一个rank-32 LoRA适配器（CISPO、Tinker、无监督阶段），在12个基准上取得+4.5至+13.8分提升。
AI.motivation: 验证在缺乏监督微调阶段的情况下，针对单一专家任务集做独立RL后训练，能否在跨机构（含第三方与Surge AI自建）的多样化基准上带来可复现、可解释的增益，并厘清各适配器"多做了什么"。
AI.method: 在Tinker上用CISPO对五个任务数据集（真实软件工程、复杂约束、长程工具使用、专业图表理解、企业文档推理）逐一训练全新rank-32 LoRA适配器，不设SFT阶段；每个适配器与基座模型在同一任务、harness与设置下对照；并对新解出任务的回答做并排失败模式分析。
AI.result: 12个基准上增益+4.5（IFBench）至+13.8（GDP_pdf，10.4%→24.2%）；SWE-bench Pro V2 86.9%→92.1%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 63.9%→70.3%，MultiChallenge 58.3%→66.6%，AutomationBench 14.8%→27.5%，Chartography 39.4%→50.6%。未用API工具的文档适配器在AutomationBench上另获+8.0分。
AI.conclusion: 单任务集RL后训练可泛化至未见基准，且增益对应明确的行为改变：工具适配器先查数据与规则再行动、编码适配器自建测试/草稿文件、约束适配器沿用前轮上下文、图表适配器用代码测量标记、文档适配器读取表格。基座模型的失败集中于少数固定模式。

title: Every Measurement, Every Direction, All at Once: Multimodal Flow Matching for Molecules and Spectra
summary: Generative modeling in science is often data-limited, where experiments are expensive. However, each experiment may yield several coupled measurements of the same physical entity. Standard generative models often train only on a single direction, discarding supervision from the rest. We argue that each experiment contains more training signal than this asymmetry allows the model to exploit: random masking enables measurements to serve as either conditioning inputs or prediction targets, yielding multiple supervised denoising tasks from a single experiment. We investigate this premise with MOSAIC, a multimodal flow matching transformer over molecular 3D structure and UV, IR, and Raman spectra. MOSAIC is a single model that is capable of any-to-any generation: generating any subset of modalities from any disjoint subset of the others. On QM9S, MOSAIC achieves 88.8% molecular graph recovery, outperforming the strongest spectra-to-structure baseline by 23.2% in structure generation, while simultaneously outperforming a structure-to-spectra specialist model in spectral generation. Ablations show that the any-to-any objective improves structure generation over structure-only training across model sizes. Furthermore, MOSAIC supports arbitrary subsets of available measurements and enables molecular identification by matching generated spectra to experimental references.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC：一个基于多模态流匹配Transformer的任意到任意生成模型，统一建模分子3D结构与UV/IR/Raman光谱。
AI.motivation: 科学生成建模常受数据量限制，但单次实验可产生同一实体的多个耦合测量。标准生成模型通常只训练单一方向（如结构→光谱），丢弃其余监督信号；作者认为随机掩码可让测量互为条件或目标，从而从一次实验获得多个去噪任务。
AI.method: 提出MOSAIC，一个覆盖分子3D结构及UV、IR、Raman光谱的多模态流匹配Transformer；通过随机掩码训练，使任一非空子集模态可生成其余不相交子集，实现任意到任意生成。
AI.result: 在QM9S上达到88.8%分子图恢复率，结构生成比最强光谱→结构基线提升23.2%，同时在光谱生成上超过结构→光谱专用模型；消融显示任意到任意目标在各模型规模下均优于仅结构训练。
AI.conclusion: 任意到任意训练目标能更充分利用有限实验数据；MOSAIC支持任意可用测量子集，并可通过匹配生成光谱与实验参考实现分子识别。

title: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
summary: Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. Worker-to-lead handoffs are a central target for improving conflict detection in multi-agent LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文构建基准与证据流分析器，研究多智能体委派中的记忆不一致：委派提高了冲突双方证据的检索率（50.2%→68.7%），但冲突检测反而下降（16.2%→13.2%），关键瓶颈在工作者到主控的证据交接。
AI.motivation: 多智能体委派让工作者在各自独立上下文中收集证据，导致工作者检索到的事实可能未进入主控（lead）可用证据中，从而产生一致性/记忆不一致问题，但该现象缺乏可控评测手段。
AI.method: 提出基准与"证据流分析器"（evidence-flow profiler），在 Harvey LAB 文档审阅任务中通过受控的事实性冲突，跨三个模型、控制生成开销相当的条件下，对比单智能体执行与强制委派的多智能体执行的检索与冲突检测表现。
AI.result: 强制委派使两类冲突主张的检索率从50.2%升至68.7%，但冲突检测率从16.2%降至13.2%；工作者仅对35.2%的已检索冲突对报告了双方主张。匹配比较显示：同一工作者读到双方主张时检测率高于单智能体，而主张分散在不同工作者时检测率更低。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体委派提升了证据覆盖却损害了冲突检测，证据在工作者间拆分是主要致因；工作者到主控的交接是改进多智能体LLM冲突检测的核心着力点。

title: JET: Just-Enough Exploration Tuning for Efficient Tool-Calling Agents in Repository-Level Question Answering
summary: In repository-level question answering (QA), an agent explores a code repository with tools and should answer a question once enough information is gathered. Nevertheless, we find that LLM agents often continue to invoke tools even after the gathered information is already sufficient to answer. We call this phenomenon over-exploration. Moreover, even though existing methods improve task performance through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories, SFT also propagates the over-exploration in the trajectories to the agent. To mitigate over-exploration, we propose Just-Enough Exploration Tuning (JET), a fine-tuning method that trains the agent to answer once the gathered information is sufficient. JET truncates each training trajectory at the step where the gathered information becomes sufficient, inserts a rationale that explains why the agent can answer at that step, and fine-tunes the agent with a higher loss weight on the rationale. Experiments on two repository-level QA benchmarks with two open-weight 8B models demonstrate that JET reduces tool calls by 11 to 33% on self-generated trajectories while largely preserving the score. On expert trajectories, JET makes 18 to 28% fewer tool calls than SFT while retaining most of the score gain of SFT. In both cases, JET also lowers the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 论文发现仓库级QA中的LLM代理存在"过度探索"（信息已足够仍继续调用工具），并提出JET微调方法使代理在信息充分时及时作答。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在代码仓库QA中即使信息已足够仍继续调用工具（over-exploration）；而现有基于专家轨迹的SFT会把轨迹中的过度探索行为一并传给代理。
AI.method: JET（Just-Enough Exploration Tuning）：对每条训练轨迹在"信息刚好充分"的步骤处截断，插入解释该步为何已可作答的rationale，并在微调时对rationale部分赋予更高的loss权重。
AI.result: 在两个仓库级QA基准、两个开放权重8B模型上：自生成轨迹中工具调用减少11%–33%且基本保持分数；专家轨迹上比SFT少18%–28%工具调用，同时保留大部分SFT的分数增益；两种情况均降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过截断+理由监督的微调，JET能有效缓解过度探索，在保持任务性能的同时显著减少工具调用与推理开销。

title: HandRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Hand Pose Estimation
comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 17 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/GinKenneth/Hand_RSI
summary: Egocentric 3D hand pose estimators still miss hands at the image border, misplace occluded hands and jitter. Such failures are usually fixed by hand-written inference refinements and by fine-tuning, two interdependent steps that are tuned separately. We present HandRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework for a hand pose system that consists of a video estimator and its executable inference harness. In each round, coding agents refine the harness, and a change is accepted only if it improves a composite of all ten benchmark metrics on held-out data without significantly regressing any of them. The accepted harness then guides the estimator through selective distillation, which supervises hand presence and temporal consistency on frames without ground truth, while ground truth supervises pose. Since the updated estimator may change which refinements remain useful, the harness is re-validated on it. Starting from the released ACE-Ego-Hand model, five rounds reduce MPJPE-p by 35% on HOT3D and 11% on ARCTIC and roughly halve jitter. On HOT3D, HandRSI's MPJPE-p is 16% lower than that of ACE-Ego-Hand fine-tuned on the same ground truth. Under a unified protocol, it outperforms nine re-run published methods on all ten metrics of both benchmarks. Hypervolume selection on the accuracy-speed front yields Lite, Medium and Heavy systems running at 20.7 to 41.1 FPS. This report gives the full method, every stage of every round and the complete protocol. Code, evaluator, harnesses and weights are public.

AI.tldr: HandRSI 是一个针对自我中心 3D 手部姿态系统的递归自我改进框架，由视频估计器与其可执行推理 harness 组成。每轮由编码智能体改进 harness，仅在十项基准指标的综合表现提升且无显著回退时接受，再通过选择性蒸馏更新估计器，并交替迭代。五轮后将 HOT3D 的 MPJPE-p 降低 35%、ARCTIC 降低 11%，抖动约减半，并全面超越九个已发表方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心 3D 手部姿态估计仍存在图像边缘漏检、遮挡手错位与时序抖动等问题。此类失败通常靠手工编写的推理后处理与微调两部分修复，而这两步相互依赖却被分开调参，效率低且难以协同优化。
AI.method: 将系统拆为视频估计器与可执行推理 harness，进行多轮递归自我改进：每轮由编码智能体修改 harness，只有在 held-out 数据上十项指标的综合得分提升且无单项显著退步时才接受；被接受的 harness 引导估计器做选择性蒸馏，无真值帧上由 harness 监督手部存在性与时序一致性，有真值帧用真值监督姿态；估计器更新后重新验证 harness 有效性。最终在精度-速度前沿上用超体积选择得到 Lite/Medium/Heavy 三档系统。
AI.result: 从 ACE-Ego-Hand 出发，五轮迭代在 HOT3D 上 MPJPE-p 降低 35%、ARCTIC 上降低 11%，抖动约减半；HOT3D 上比用同批真值微调的 ACE-Ego-Hand 低 16%。统一协议下，在两基准的全部十项指标上优于九个重跑的已发表方法。三档系统运行速度为 20.7–41.1 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 将推理 harness 优化与估计器微调纳入统一的递归闭环，并由 harness 为无真值帧提供监督信号，能有效解决边缘漏检、遮挡错位与抖动问题，且带来跨基准的性能提升。报告公开了完整方法、每轮各阶段、协议、代码、评测器、harness 与权重。

title: VTT: Reading Vehicle Size and Powertrain Type from Motion Trajectory Across Unseen Car Models
summary: Vehicle size and powertrain information can enrich trajectory data for traffic analysis and simulation. We present VTT, a dataset and benchmark for identifying these attributes from motion and controller area network (CAN) signals across unseen car models. The dataset contains 9,062 drives, about 3,950 h, from 1,431 vehicles and 174 car models. It provides three footprint-based size classes, powertrain labels, and evaluation on unseen car models and unseen drivers. Using 60-s windows, we compare four sequence architectures, statistical features and physical features proposed by large language models. Training with auxiliary physical targets, data augmentation and task-specific weighting raises drive-level macro-F1 to 92.6-93.0% for battery-electric versus combustion vehicles and from 62.9% to 67.1% for size classification. On public logs from 4,061 additional drivers, the full-input model identifies powertrain correctly for 86 of 88 car models; size accuracy is 63.2%, close to the internal vehicle-level result of 63.5%. Physical-feature analysis links powertrain recognition to deceleration behaviour and size recognition to steering response. Errors near size-class boundaries and limited gains from longer observations highlight the importance of label resolution and training-fleet coverage for cross-model generalisation.

AI.tldr: VTT是一个从运动与CAN信号识别未见车型的车辆尺寸和动力类型的数集与基准，含9,062次行驶、1,431辆车、174款车型。
AI.motivation: 车辆尺寸与动力总成信息可丰富轨迹数据用于交通分析与仿真，但对其进行跨车型、对未见模型的自动识别缺乏统一数据与评测基准。
AI.method: 构建VTT数据集（9,062次行驶，约3,950小时，1,431辆车，174款车型），提供三类基于占地面积的尺寸类别与动力标签；采用60秒窗口，比较四种序列架构、统计特征及由大语言模型提出的物理特征；并引入辅助物理目标训练、数据增强与任务特定加权。
AI.result: 行驶级macro-F1：电动vs燃油达92.6–93.0%，尺寸分类由62.9%提升至67.1%；在4,061名额外驾驶员的公开日志上，全输入模型对88款车型中86款正确识别动力，尺寸准确率63.2%（接近内部车辆级63.5%）；物理特征分析表明动力识别关联减速行为、尺寸识别关联转向响应。
AI.conclusion: 尺寸类边界附近易出错、更长观测收益有限，说明标签分辨率与训练车队覆盖度对跨车型泛化至关重要。

title: A Visual Information Extraction System Using Multimodal Large Language Models for Scanned Cognitive and Behavioral Assessments
summary:
Objective. Paper-based assessments are common in patient care, but handwriting and scanning artifacts make these forms difficult to process at scale. This study proposes a modular, multimodal LLM-based system with human oversight for extracting fields and scores. We conducted a qualitative analysis of the use of LLMs for hand-drawing analysis.
  Materials and Methods. The system processes cognitive assessments (i.e., MMSE, MoCA, Mini-Cog) and the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment using two modules: 1) a form classifier that assigns a scanned page to a form type, followed by a corresponding 2) score extractor that extracts fields and scores into a schema. A human-in-the-loop design utilizing dual-model validation engages human annotators when two LLMs disagree, limiting manual review to challenging pages only.
  Results. End-to-end accuracy for cognitive assessments was 88%, with most form types exceeding 90%. For the NICHQ Vanderbilt, overall accuracy reached 97.5%, with all form types above 96%. The human-in-the-loop design further improved cognitive assessment accuracy to 97.5% while reducing manual work by 63.8%. In the Mini-Cog Clock Drawing task, qualitative analysis showed that 62.3% of all extraction errors stemmed from ambiguous drawing, in which cases the LLM provided reasonable readings.
  Discussion. Compared to current manual data extraction, our LLM-based system reduces processing time by 10 to 20 times and costs by over 12 times. The modular design allows seamless expansion to additional form types.
  Conclusion. Our system provides an accurate, scalable, and cost-efficient solution for structuring data trapped in handwritten paper forms for clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化多模态LLM系统（表单分类器+分数抽取器，双模型校验人工介入），实现手写纸质量表的结构化抽取，认知评估端到端准确率88%（人工介入后97.5%），Vanderbilt量表97.5%，处理速度提升10–20倍、成本降低12倍以上。
AI.motivation: 纸质量表评估在临床中很常见，但手写和扫描伪影使大规模处理困难，目前多依赖人工数据录入，耗时且成本高。
AI.method: 采用模块化多模态LLM流程：先由表单分类器判定扫描页所属表单类型，再由对应分数抽取器将字段与分数结构化输出。设计human-in-the-loop机制，利用双模型交叉验证，仅在两个LLM结果不一致时才交由人工审核。研究对象为MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog等认知评估及NICHQ Vanderbilt量表，并对Mini-Cog画钟任务进行LLM手绘图分析的定性研究。
AI.result: 认知评估端到端准确率88%，多数表单类型超90%；Vanderbilt整体准确率97.5%，各类型均超96%。人工介入后认知评估准确率升至97.5%，人工工作量减少63.8%。Mini-Cog画钟任务中62.3%的抽取错误源于绘图本身歧义，LLM在这些情况下给出了合理解读。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为手写纸质表单数据的结构化提供了准确、可扩展且高性价比的方案，可支持临床决策；相比人工抽取处理时间缩短10–20倍、成本降低12倍以上，模块化设计便于扩展到其他表单类型。

title: AfriNORM: An Evaluation Benchmark for Normative Reasoning of LLMs Across African Cultures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across various sectors. However, current evaluation benchmarks are insufficient to assess the applicability of these models in local African contexts, as most focus on linguistic fluency (grammar/translation) rather than cultural competence. The few existing benchmarks that measure general knowledge or social conventions do not capture the African deontic modality, i.e., the strict norms and taboos that govern diverse social interactions. In this paper, we introduce AfriNORM, a scenario-based, multiple-choice question dataset designed to measure and diagnose the normative reasoning limitations of LLMs when applied to African sociocultural contexts. We introduce two metrics: a Universal Commonsense Bias Score (UCBS) to quantify commonsense bias in LLM and a Distractor Bias Score (DBS) to quantify an LLM's limited understanding of African cultural norms. We also conduct a case study on the Yorùbá language, identifying confusion gaps in two closed-source LLMs, "Gemini 2.0 Flash" and "GPT-5", and one open-source LLM, "Llama 3.1 8B Instruct" when prompted in English versus Yorùbá. While their accuracy in English is high, their performance in Yorùbá is much lower, attributable to cultural confusion rather than simple bias, indicating that the models exhibit semantic confusion when reasoning about norms in Yorùbá.

AI.tldr: 提出 AfriNORM：面向非洲社会文化情境的场景化多选题基准，用于测量与诊断 LLM 在非规范模态（严格规范与禁忌）上的推理局限，并引入 UCBS 与 DBS 两个指标；约鲁巴语案例显示模型英语准确率高但约鲁巴语显著下降，源于文化混淆而非简单偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评测基准多聚焦语言流畅性（语法/翻译），少数测常识或社会惯例的基准也无法捕捉非洲的去规范模态（支配多元社会互动的严格规范与禁忌），因此无法评估模型在本地非洲语境下的适用性。
AI.method: 构建场景化、多选题数据集 AfriNORM；提出 Universal Commonsense Bias Score (UCBS) 量化模型的常识偏见，提出 Distractor Bias Score (DBS) 量化模型对非洲文化规范理解的不足；并做约鲁巴语案例研究，对比 Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-5 与 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 在英语与约鲁巴语提示下的表现。
AI.result: 三个模型英语提示下准确率高，约鲁巴语下大幅下降；分析表明该下降归因于文化混淆（语义混淆）而非单纯偏见，即在约鲁巴语中推理规范时存在语义混淆。
AI.conclusion: 文化能力而非语言流畅性才是 LLM 在非洲语境落地的关键瓶颈；AfriNORM 与 UCBS/DBS 提供了可诊断的评测框架，揭示模型跨语言规范推理的语义混淆问题。

title: CueClash: Frontier Vision-Language Models Judge 3-D Relations Close to the Picture Plane
summary: A vision-language model (VLM) can judge 3-D relations from the picture or from the ground layout. In photographs the two usually agree. We separate them with CueClash, rendered scenes in which the 2-D cue for each of five relations is right on exactly half the statements. The shortcut gap is accuracy when the cue is right minus accuracy when it is wrong. For Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.6 Flash at low reasoning effort it is +18 to +37 percentage points. It is +7 to +29 without two relations whose cue-wrong items are confounded with borderline cases or occlusion. Given ground coordinates and each relation's definition, they answer 99 to 100% correctly. Pixel measurements with camera depths remove most of the gap for objects fitting through openings. The failure lies in the step from the picture to the layout. The maps that the models draw of the scene from above mostly keep the depth order but, like the picture, shorten depth. GPT-5.5's maps stay close to a copy of the picture. Opus 5.5's and Gemini's maps undo about 0.6 of this shortening. Gemini's then shrink all depths by a further uniform factor. Opus 5.5 follows the picture mainly on fits, and its maps correct depth about as much as human observers of real scenes do. The three models also lose accuracy on CV-Bench photographs where a reliable 2-D cue misleads. In two open models the layout information reaches the language model, but their maps lose much of it.

AI.tldr: 作者用 CueClash（人为渲染、使 2-D 线索一半正确一半错误的场景）分离「从图像看关系」与「从布局看关系」两条通路，发现 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.6 Flash 均存在 +7~+37 个百分点的 2-D 线索捷径偏差，但在给定地面坐标时准确率 99–100%，说明失败发生在「图像→布局」这一步；模型自上而下的俯视图保留了深度顺序却压缩了深度，且深度校正量各异。
AI.motivation: VLM 判断 3-D 空间关系时可依赖图像的 2-D 线索，也可依赖底层地面布局，在真实照片中二者通常一致，因此难以区分模型真正使用了哪条信息。作者希望把这两条通路解耦，量化模型对 2-D 捷径的依赖，并定位失败究竟出在感知、布局推断还是语言推理环节。
AI.method: 构建 CueClash：渲染场景，对五种 3-D 关系，使每条陈述的 2-D 线索恰好在一半题目上正确。以「线索正确时准确率 − 线索错误时准确率」定义 shortcut gap，并在剔除两个与边界情形/遮挡混淆的关系后复核；另设两类对照：直接给定地面坐标与关系定义；给定像素测量与相机深度。进一步让模型绘制自上而下俯视图，分析其深度排序与深度压缩比例，并与人类观察者对比；最后在 CV-Bench 真实照片（可靠 2-D 线索误导）上验证，并考察两个开源模型中布局信息能否到达语言模型。
AI.result: 低推理努力下，Opus 5.5、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.6 Flash 的 shortcut gap 为 +18~+37 个百分点；剔除两个混淆关系后仍为 +7~+29。给定地面坐标时三者准确率 99–100%；给出像素测量与相机深度可消除大部分差距（针对能穿过开口的物体）。俯视图分析显示：模型的地图多保留深度顺序但压缩深度；GPT-5.5 的地图近似照片复制；Opus 与 Gemini 可回补约 0.6 的压缩量，随后 Gemini 还对所有深度施加额外统一缩放。Opus 主要在「能否通过开口」判断上跟随图像，其地图的深度校正程度接近真实场景中的人类观察者。三模型在 CV-Bench 上遇到误导性 2-D 线索时准确率下降。两个开源模型中布局信息确实传入语言模型，但其地图丢失了大量布局信息。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的 3-D 关系错误主要源于「图像→布局」的转换，而非关系定义或语言推理本身；模型存在明显且可量化的 2-D 线索捷径，并在俯视图中系统性地压缩深度。识别并为该瓶颈（尤其是布局生成质量）设计改进，是提升空间推理的关键方向。

title: TempQuant: Learning Adaptive Temperatures for Quantized Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed at low precision, yet quantization can degrade their performance. We study how quantization interacts with decoding settings such as the sampling temperature and top-p by examining how it distorts the model's next-token probabilities. Measuring entropy during generation across deployed temperatures, we find that quantization warms the model on average, and that temperature matters much more for the performance of a quantized model than for its full-precision counterpart. Because quantization and temperature both shape the next-token distribution, we investigate how much the sampling settings can undo what quantization changes, through our method TempQuant, which learns the quantized model's temperature and top-p to bring its next-token probabilities closer to the full-precision model's. We learn these settings at two granularities. The first is a single global setting per requested temperature, which finds nearly the same temperatures that tuning on labeled answers would, without any labels. Model cards typically recommend sampling a quantized model with the same settings as its full-precision counterpart, while we find that different settings can substantially improve its accuracy. On 3-bit Qwen3-4B, for example, global TempQuant raises MATH accuracy from 34% under the configuration recommended for Qwen's quantized releases to 51%. The second sets the temperature and top-p for every token, motivated by our finding that tokens whose rankings flip under quantization tend to need warming, while tokens whose rankings are preserved tend to need cooling. When quantization degrades accuracy substantially, TempQuant recovers much of it, and when degradation is lighter, it still brings the quantized model's behavior closer to the full-precision model's.

AI.tldr: 论文研究量化与解码设置（温度、top-p）的交互，提出TempQuant：通过学习量化模型的温度与top-p，使其下一词分布更接近全精度模型，从而恢复量化造成的性能损失。
AI.motivation: 大模型越来越多以低精度部署，但量化会损害性能。作者希望理解量化如何通过与采样温度、top-p等解码设置的交互而扭曲模型的下一词概率分布。
AI.method: 在部署温度下测量生成过程中的熵，发现量化平均会“加热”模型，且温度对量化模型性能的影响远大于全精度模型。基于量化与温度都塑造下一词分布，提出TempQuant，学习量化模型的温度和top-p以逼近全精度模型的下一词概率，分两种粒度：(1) 针对每个请求温度的单一全局设置；(2) 逐token设置温度和top-p（依据量化后排名翻转的token需要升温、排名保持的token需要降温的发现）。
AI.result: 全局TempQuant无需标签即可找到与用标注答案调参几乎相同的温度。在3-bit Qwen3-4B上，MATH准确率从推荐配置下的34%提升到51%。逐token版本在量化退化严重时能恢复大部分精度，退化较轻时也能使量化模型行为更接近全精度模型。
AI.conclusion: 模型卡通常建议量化模型沿用全精度模型的采样设置，但实验表明不同设置可显著提升准确率；TempQuant通过调整解码设置有效缓解量化带来的性能下降。

title: Fidelity Regret: Measuring Simulator Misspecification in Verifiable Design
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models"
summary: RLVF assumes the verifier evaluates the quantity of interest. In genetic-circuit design, a topological verifier can establish that a program is a valid circuit computing the target function, whereas ranking its physical performance requires a simulator. We measure fidelity regret, the reference simple regret incurred when a cheap simulator selects the design, over a 21,362-design combination subspace spanning 5 measured gate libraries and 3 organisms. Exact ordered-assignment checks retain positive regret in every tested cell while shifting magnitudes in both directions. Mean normalized regret is 0.369 over 72 cells and only 6 have zero regret. The discrepancy depends strongly on the reference axis: the yeast library SC1C1G1T1 has mean regret 0.113 for cytometry quality and 0.801 for growth burden, and every evaluated library--circuit-size pair has positive burden regret. Topological verification ties all valid gate assignments, while an oracle whitelist subject to retaining at least 25% of the design space leaves positive regret in 30 of 52 cells. Design-space optimization and feedback-guided search with frozen language models reach the high-regret regions; on a matched zero-regret control, additional optimization instead reduces regret. At a matched modeled-cost budget, mitigation is budget- and library-dependent. An in-sample fixed rule spending $α{=}0.34$ of the budget re-scoring top cheap-simulator designs achieves mean excess regret 0.016, compared with 0.305 for cheap-only and 0.034 for reference-only selection, improving on cheap-only in 330 of 360 cells. More broadly, any workflow optimized through a simulator or digital twin can satisfy its verifier yet perform poorly on the intended physical objective. Fidelity regret provides a transferable template for detecting this gap before optimization and comparing budget-aware remedies across scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"保真度遗憾"(fidelity regret)：廉价仿真器按目标量选出的设计，相对金标准物理测量所欠的简单遗憾，用以暴露"验证器满足但物理目标不达标"的鸿沟，并在基因线路设计上系统量化与该鸿沟的预算受限缓解方案。
AI.motivation: RLVF(用验证器反馈的强化学习)默认验证器能评估所关心的量。但基因线路设计中，拓扑验证器只能判断程序是否算出目标函数，排序物理性能必须依赖仿真器；廉价仿真器/数字孪生选出的设计可能通过验证却在实际物理目标上表现很差，且这种差距在优化前难以察觉。
AI.method: 在覆盖5个实测门库、3种生物、21,362个设计的组合子空间上度量保真度遗憾(相对参考的归一化简单遗憾)；比较严格有序赋值检查、拓扑验证、受"保留≥25%设计空间"约束的oracle白名单；考察参考轴(流式细胞术质量 vs 生长负担)对差异的影响；测试设计空间优化与冻结语言模型的反馈引导搜索是否落入高遗憾区；并在匹配建模成本预算下，比较"α=0.34预算重评分廉价仿真器头部设计"与纯廉价、纯参考选择。
AI.result: 所有测试单元中严格有序赋值检查均有正遗憾(方向不一)；72个单元平均归一化遗憾0.369，仅6个为零。差异强烈依赖参考轴：酵母库SC1C1G1T1在流式质量上平均遗憾0.113，生长负担上0.801，且每个库-线路规模对负担遗憾均为正。拓扑验证把所有有效门赋值并列；oracle白名单在52个单元中仍有30个正遗憾。优化与反馈搜索能到达高遗憾区，而在零遗憾对照上继续优化反而降低遗憾。匹配预算下缓解效果依预算与库而异：α=0.34重评分方案平均超额遗憾0.016，优于纯廉价(0.305)与纯参考(0.034)，并在360个单元中的330个上改进纯廉价。
AI.conclusion: 任何通过仿真器或数字孪生优化的流程都可能满足验证器却在真实物理目标上表现不佳；保真度遗憾提供了可迁移的模板，用于在优化前检测该差距并跨科学领域比较预算感知的补救措施。

title: Understanding Cross-Modal Inconsistency through Representation Subspaces in Omni Models
summary: Omni Models process audio, vision, and text within a unified language backbone, yet often produce different answers for semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. Existing representation-level analyses do not distinguish between information that predicts whether disagreement will occur and the representation whose perturbation affects the model's answer. In this paper, we estimate a low-dimensional Answer Subspace from answer-position representations and use it to separate answer-related components from the remaining representation. Across three Omni Models and two multimodal reasoning tasks, information predictive of cross-modal inconsistency lies mainly outside the Answer Subspace, concentrating in a reproducible two-dimensional representation that is not explained by a fixed modality offset. Matched interventions reveal distinct behavioral roles: perturbing the Answer Subspace substantially changes the model's predictions, whereas perturbing the disagreement representation, like a random subspace of the same dimensionality, leaves them almost unchanged. Our key finding is that cross-modal disagreement can be induced by misaligning modality-specific answer representations: perturbing the Answer Subspace for only one modality induces disagreement, whereas applying the same perturbation to both largely preserves agreement. Thus, the representation that predicts disagreement is distinct from the answer-level representation through which disagreement can be induced, showing that linear decodability does not imply behavioral efficacy.

AI.tldr: Omni模型跨模态不一致可由"预测性表征"与"行为有效表征"的分离来解释：不一致可预测信息位于Answer Subspace之外，但只有对单一模态的Answer Subspace进行扰动才能诱导不一致。
AI.motivation: Omni模型对语义等价但模态不同的输入常给出不同答案。已有表征级分析未区分两类信息：一类能预测是否会不一致，另一类其扰动会改变模型答案。作者希望厘清二者关系。
AI.method: 从answer位置表征中估计低维Answer Subspace，将答案相关成分与其余表征分离；在3个Omni模型、2个多模态推理任务上分析可预测不一致信息的分布；做匹配干预实验（扰动Answer Subspace vs. 同维随机子空间），并仅对单一模态或同时两模态施加扰动。
AI.result: 不一致的可预测信息主要位于Answer Subspace之外，集中于一个可复现的二维表征，且不能由固定的模态偏移解释。扰动Answer Subspace显著改变预测，而扰动不一致表征（或同维随机子空间）几乎无影响；仅对单一模态扰动Answer Subspace可诱导不一致，对两模态施加相同扰动则基本保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 预测不一致的表征与可诱导不一致的答案级表征是分离的，线性可解码不等于行为有效，跨模态不一致源于模态特定答案表征的错位。

title: SRED: Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation Across Magnifications in Whole-Slide Imaging
summary: In computational pathology, high-magnification whole-slide image analysis preserves tissue detail but requires encoding many patches, whereas lower magnification reduces computation by covering a higher field of view per patch while sacrificing detail. Existing cross-magnification distillation matches features that often encode detail unreachable by low-magnification input, sometimes requiring slide-level labels that limit scalability. To address those issues, we introduce Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation (SRED), which transfers regional event occurrences that encode reachable high-level interactions between details without slide-level labels. We use a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to learn an event dictionary from 20x teacher features. Logical OR pooling records whether each event is detected in any spatially aligned patch, retaining both localized and shared evidence within the corresponding 5x region. A pretrained 5x encoder is fine-tuned to predict these regional targets without slide-level labels. Visual analysis identifies dictionary components responsive to recognizable histological patterns, supporting target interpretation. Compared with native 5x features, SRED improves average macro-F1 by 1.1 points across seven classification and grading cohorts and average C-index by 1.7 points across five survival cohorts. Runtime matches native 5x, with an average 11.58x speedup over 20x.

AI.tldr: SRED 通过稀疏自编码器学习事件字典，将 20x 教师特征中的"区域事件是否发生"作为迁移目标，用逻辑 OR 池化压缩到 5x 区域，在无切片级标签下微调 5x 编码器，实现精度提升与约 11.58 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 高倍率（20x）WSI 保留组织细节但需编码大量 patch、计算昂贵；低倍率（5x）计算少但损失细节。现有跨倍率蒸馏直接匹配特征，而这些特征往往包含低倍率输入无法获得的细节信息，且有时依赖切片级标签，限制可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出 Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation（SRED）：1）用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从 20x 教师特征中学习事件字典；2）对空间对齐的 patch 采用逻辑 OR 池化，记录每个事件是否在对应 5x 区域内任一处被检测到，保留局部与外共享证据；3）微调预训练 5x 编码器去预测这些区域目标，全程不需切片级标签；4）可视化分析验证字典组件对应可识别的组织学模式。
AI.result: 相比原生 5x 特征，SRED 在 7 个分类/分级队列上平均 macro-F1 提升 1.1 个点，在 5 个生存分析队列上平均 C-index 提升 1.7 个点；推理耗时与原生 5x 相同，相对 20x 平均加速 11.58 倍。
AI.conclusion: 以"区域事件是否发生"作为可到达的跨倍率迁移目标，比直接特征匹配更合理且无需切片级标签，兼顾精度与效率，并提供可解释的事件字典。

title: When Passing Checks Do Not Establish Completion: Evidence Interpretation in Coding Agents
comment: 12 pages; supplementary material included as ancillary files
summary: Verification procedures in coding agents must preserve execution facts, interpret their scope and discharge checking obligations. We study these responsibilities through qualified repository checks, controlled evidence consumers and executable workflows. A prospective thirteen-task factorial study finds that correct reported facts need not yield the requested finite verdict. Conversely, all 122 delivered labels in a held-out receipt-supply study are correct, while sixteen responses misreport facts and eleven others exceed authorized scope. Production repair supplies successful controls and finite-supported preservation failures. Across 118 repair episodes on 31 tasks, source interventions separate startup reachability from repair and witness production from the claimed operation. Lifetime and resource controls delimit what passing validation establishes. Generated-note comparisons yield local repair differences but can state false explanations; strong ordinary baselines, new tasks and Skill-transfer studies supply no consistent overall advantage. These results characterize evidence interpretation, applicability and fulfilled actions while limiting claims of general diagnostic superiority, Skill deterioration or deployed folding effects.

AI.tldr: 该文研究编码智能体验证程序在保留执行事实、解释适用范围与完成检查义务上的责任，通过限定性仓库检查、受控证据消费者与可执行工作流进行考察，发现正确报告的事实并不必然产生所请求的有限裁决，证据的解释、适用与履行环节才是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 验证程序不仅要保留执行事实，还需正确解释其作用域并完成检查义务；现有工作可能默认"事实正确即结论正确"，本文要检验这一假设并刻画事实、解释与行动之间的断裂。
AI.method: 采用十三任务的前瞻性因子研究；留出集上的"收据供给"实验（122个交付标签）；118个修复回合、覆盖31个任务的生产修复研究；生命期与资源对照、生成笔记对比，以及强普通基线、新任务与Skill迁移研究。
AI.result: 正确报告的事实未必得到所请求的有限裁决；留出研究中122个标签全部正确，但16个回复误报事实、11个超出授权范围；生产修复中源干预可将启动可达性与修复、证据生成与所声称操作相分离；生成笔记对比产生局部修复差异却可能给出错误解释；强基线、新任务与Skill迁移均未显示一致的总体优势。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了证据解释、适用性与行动履行三方面的问题，同时限制了对通用诊断优越性、Skill退化与部署折叠效应的过度主张。

title: ReMoE: An Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Human Mobility Recovery Forecasting Across Disasters
summary: Human mobility often declines sharply following disasters and subsequently exhibits complex recovery dynamics. Effective forecasting of this recovery is critical for timely assessment and resource allocation. However, existing approaches are often developed for individual events and operate as black boxes, limiting their transferability and interpretability beyond the events they were trained on. Recent studies have identified recurring post-disaster mobility recovery types across disasters, suggesting that recovery knowledge may be transferable. Motivated by this, we propose ReMoE, an interpretable mixture-of-experts framework for cross-disaster mobility recovery forecasting. ReMoE uses a feature-guided router to adaptively combine specialized experts that learn these heterogeneous yet reusable recovery types, producing a region-specific recovery pattern. It further refines this pattern through residual correction informed by forecasts of future hazard conditions. We evaluate ReMoE on a large-scale mobility dataset covering 18 disaster events spanning hurricanes, floods, winter storms, and wildfires. ReMoE is competitive in-distribution and achieves the strongest performance on unseen events and hazard types, with larger gains under greater distribution shifts. Further analyses show that ReMoE yields interpretable learning outcomes and maintains robust performance under uncertainty. Broadly, ReMoE offers a transferable and traceable forecaster that can support anticipatory post-disaster assessment.

AI.tldr: ReMoE：可解释混合专家框架，利用可迁移的灾后恢复类型知识，实现跨灾害人口流动恢复预测。
AI.motivation: 现有灾后人口流动恢复预测方法多为单一事件定制、且是黑箱，跨事件迁移性与可解释性差。近期研究发现不同灾害间存在可复用的灾后流动恢复类型，提示恢复知识可迁移。
AI.method: 提出ReMoE，采用特征引导路由器自适应组合专门学习异质但可复用恢复类型的专家，生成区域specific恢复模式；再用基于未来灾害条件预测的残差校正进一步精化该模式。
AI.result: 在覆盖飓风、洪水、冬季风暴、野火共18个灾害事件的大规模流动数据集上，分布内具竞争力；在未见事件与灾害类型上表现最佳，分布偏移越大增益越明显；分析显示学习结果可解释，且在不确定性下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: ReMoE提供了一个可迁移、可追溯的预测器，可支持灾后前瞻性评估与资源分配。

title: DACE: Diversity-Driven Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robust LLM Safety Alignment
summary: Ensuring robust safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly difficult as adversarial attacks evolve and outpace alignment pipelines built on pre-collected data. Existing co-evolutionary frameworks let the defender chase a moving attacker, yet their training dynamics expose two compounding pathologies: \emph{attack strategy collapse}, where the attacker overfits to a narrow set of high-reward rewrites, and \emph{defense adversarial forgetting}, where the defender loses competence against earlier attacks as the attack distribution drifts. Existing remedies are partial: attacker-side diversity rewards score textual novelty rather than strategy novelty, and defender-side replay relies on discrete judge scores that ignore estimation uncertainty, response stochasticity, and defender non-stationarity. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a diversity-driven adversarial co-evolution framework that targets both pathologies jointly. On the attacker side, \method couples an explicit two-dimensional strategy space (risk category $\times$ attack style) with a \emph{normalized marginal coverage gain} reward, providing a bounded, non-vanishing exploration signal at the strategy layer. On the defender side, \method maintains a unified \emph{Bayesian adversarial replay pool} whose Beta--Bernoulli threat posteriors are refreshed by time decay and sampled via Thompson sampling, anchoring defender training to an evolving threat landscape. Across standard safety, automated-attacker, and general-capability benchmarks, \method improves robustness to out-of-distribution attacks while preserving general capabilities, and yields broader attacker strategy coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRAGE，一个多样性驱动的对抗协同演化框架，从攻击者和防御者两侧同时缓解"攻击策略坍缩"与"防御对抗遗忘"两类病理。
AI.motivation: LLM安全对齐难以应对不断演化的对抗攻击。现有协同演化框架中防御者只能被动追赶攻击者，并存在两个复合问题：(1)攻击策略坍缩——攻击者过拟合到少数高奖励改写；(2)防御对抗遗忘——攻击分布漂移后防御者对早期攻击丧失能力。现有补救均为局部方案：攻击端多样性奖励只衡量文本新颖性而非策略新颖性；防御端回放依赖离散评判分数，忽略估计不确定性、响应随机性和防御者非平稳性。
AI.method: MIRAGE联合处理两类病理。攻击侧：引入显式二维策略空间（风险类别 × 攻击风格），并设计归一化边际覆盖增益（normalized marginal coverage gain）奖励，在策略层提供有界且不衰减的探索信号。防御侧：维护统一的贝叶斯对抗回放池，用Beta–Bernoulli威胁后验、时间衰减刷新与Thompson采样，使防御者训练锚定于演化中的威胁分布。
AI.result: 在标准安全基准、自动化攻击基准和通用能力基准上，MIRAGE提升了对分布外攻击的鲁棒性，同时保持通用能力，并获得更广的攻击者策略覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 将攻击策略多样性建模与不确定性感知的贝叶斯回放结合，可有效抑制攻击坍缩和防御遗忘，为协同演化式安全对齐提供更稳健的范式。

title: Contract-Explicit Evaluation: From Auditing Learned Readers to Scoped Certificates
comment: 50 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary material (Online Resource 1, 14 pages) included as ancillary file. Artifact repository: https://github.com/lutttw/contract-explicit-evaluation. Submitted to Applied Intelligence
summary: Evaluation readings of document-level relation extraction (DocRE) systems depend jointly on the model and the evaluation contract: gold version, scoring function, threshold. Rankings reverse across contracts, yet no existing method determines which comparisons survive the reversal. We address this gap with contract-explicit evaluation: a preregistered five-step protocol (Declare, Measure, Scope, Certify, Hedge), operationalizing the classical concordance decomposition of Kendall's rank correlation, that scopes certifiable regions and delivers distribution-free census certificates across two ecosystems. In the DocRE audit (44 training runs of one in-house architecture family), the scoring dimension scopes to a census certificate (three flagged instances, Clopper--Pearson upper bound 0.146); the confirmatory record includes registered negatives, and the audit prices its own simplification finding---the calibration dial's entire margin is one withdrawn commit. In an LLM-judge census (17 judges, 49,938 battles), 12.25% of leaderboard comparisons require hedging at the pre-declared split criterion (bound 0.124; panel-robust 0.143), with an exploratory two-tier reading certifying 69% at a bound \le 0.072 and a validity decomposition against released human labels (65% of contested battles are judge error, not ambiguity). The cross-model certificate is withdrawn on real confidence scores; the failure spectrum maps the boundary. The protocol, map, ledger, and per-instance artifacts are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"契约显式评估"协议：通过五步预注册流程（Declare, Measure, Scope, Certify, Hedge），操作化Kendall秩相关的经典一致性分解，为文档级关系抽取(DocRE)与LLM裁判两大生态提供免分布假设的普查级证书，从而判定哪些系统排名比较在评估契约(金标版本、评分函数、阈值)反转下仍然成立。
AI.motivation: DocRE系统的评测阅读同时依赖模型与评估契约(金标版本、评分函数、阈值)，排名会随契约反转而反转，但现有方法无法确定哪些比较在反转中依然稳健。这一空白使得排行榜结论的可信度无法量化。
AI.method: 提出契约显式评估：一个预注册的五步协议(Declare声明、Measure测量、Scope界定、Certify认证、Hedge对冲)，操作化Kendall秩相关的一致性分解；在DocRE审计中(单一内部架构族44次训练运行)与LLM裁判普查(17个裁判、49,938场对战)两个生态上构建带Clopper–Pearson上界的免分布普查证书与稳健性面板。
AI.result: DocRE审计中评分维度可界定到普查证书(3个标记实例，Clopper–Pearson上界0.146)，并披露简化偏差成本——校准旋钮的全部裕度仅来自一次撤回的commit；LLM裁判普查中12.25%的排行榜比较需在预声明切分标准下对冲(上界0.124，面板稳健0.143)，探索性两层读取可将69%认证在上界≤0.072，且对已发布人工标签的有效性分解显示65%争议对战系裁判错误而非歧义；跨模型证书在真实置信分数上被撤回，失败谱映射出边界。
AI.conclusion: 评估结论应以"契约"为单位显式声明并可证书化；协议、地图、账本及逐实例工件全部开源发布，为排名比较提供可认证、可对冲的稳健性判定框架。

title: MIRAGE: Motion Identity Reduction via Autoregressive Generative Encoding for Privacy-Preserving Skeleton-based Motion Data
summary: Skeleton motion identifies people through body proportions and movement style, and skeleton streams are increasingly passed to third-party analytics that run action classifiers trained on raw data. A prior adversarial anonymizer adds a per-frame residual in the raw coordinate space but sees one frame at a time; motion retargeting needs a target skeleton and complete sequences, which rules out online use. We present MIRAGE, a target-free, causal anonymizer that adds an identity-reducing residual to each incoming frame in the raw coordinate space, computed by attention over past frames. One causal, optionally windowed mask governs every attention in a rotary-position encoder-decoder, and key/value caches let the trained function run frame by frame; on all 56,578 NTU 60 sequences, batched and streaming outputs differ by at most 7.2e-6 m. Reported results use an unbounded window, so per-stream state grows with stream length. We evaluate against a passive adversary that applies raw-trained identity models and an adaptive adversary that trains on the anonymizer's output, treating the adaptive adversary as the headline, on NTU RGB+D 60 over five generator seeds, alongside the per-frame residual anonymizer of Moon et al. trained identically. When consumers retrain on the released data, MIRAGE keeps 83.9% action recognition (raw 89.1%; Moon et al. 88.7%) while a retrained identity classifier reaches 43.4% re-identification (RI) over 40 subjects, against 69.4% for Moon et al. and 75.4% on raw data. The strongest adaptive attacker still reaches 49.3% (chance 2.5%), so MIRAGE reduces identity leakage; it does not anonymize. Against raw-trained (frozen) classifiers, MIRAGE lowers RI below the strongest retargeting baseline (10.36% vs. 22.09%), but frozen action recognition falls to 37.04% (vs. 75.82%), so at full residual scale it is not a drop-in replacement for raw input to existing frozen models.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE：一种无需目标骨架、因果（逐帧流式）的骨骼动作匿名器，通过注意力对过去帧计算身份削弱残差，在保留动作识别的同时显著降低重识别率。
AI.motivation: 骨骼动作流可凭体型与动作风格识别个人，且常被第三方经原始数据训练的分类器处理；现有逐帧残差匿名器只单帧处理缺乏时序建模，动作重定向需目标骨架与完整序列无法在线使用。
AI.method: 在原始坐标空间对每帧加入身份削弱残差，由对历史帧的注意力计算；编码器-解码器（旋转位置编码）中所有注意力由同一条因果、可选窗口化的掩码控制，配合 KV 缓存实现逐帧流式运行。
AI.result: 在 NTU RGB+D 60 全部 56,578 序列上批量与流式输出差异≤7.2e-6 m。自适应攻击者（重训消费者）下：动作识别 83.9%（原始 89.1%，Moon 等 88.7%），RI 43.4%@40人（Moon 69.4%，原始 75.4%）；最强自适应攻击仍达 49.3%（随机 2.5%）。对冻结分类器 RI 降至 10.36%（重定向基线 22.09%），但冻结动作识别降至 37.04%（基线 75.82%）。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE 减少而非消除身份泄露，非真正匿名化；未设窗口时状态随流长度增长；满残差尺度下不能直接替换原始输入供冻结模型使用。

title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
summary:
Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability.
  Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI

AI.tldr: 提出 RagHarnessDebugger，一种对 RAG 智能体"修复决策"进行全轨迹审计与根因分析的调试框架，揭示被聚合指标掩盖的失败模式并改进系统。
AI.motivation: 智能体 RAG 系统在修复答案时需主动获取证据、试探策略并判断是否需要修复，但准确率等聚合指标会掩盖修复是否真正生效，缺乏对决策过程的可见性。
AI.method: 构建带 Jev 引导的 harness，记录每次修复决策；审计层检查轨迹完整性、验证项是否应用于对应候选、以及接受规则可触达的答案；结合标注错误分析与反事实重放机制追踪执行路径至最终决策。
AI.result: 在 ContractNLI 保密协议及独立复制集上，用两个 reader 模型测试：审计暴露了修复接受成本与回归问题，开发集与复制集分别有 77% 和 76% 的可用但未实现修复缺口；修订后 harness 较 BM25 基线分别提升 3.6 与 3.7 点，较全合同访问参考分数提升 1.1 与 2.4 点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了调试器可对漏修复进行决策根因分析，其核心价值在于提供判断可见性，支撑 RAG 决策的持续改进与可解释性。

title: Synthetic Crystal Data Generation for Diffusion Pretraining in Material Property Prediction
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the AI4Mat Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Diffusion-based pretraining has emerged as a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations in graph neural networks for materials property prediction without requiring quantum-mechanical labels such as energies, forces, and stresses for every pretraining structure. However, the method retains a critical dependency: it requires structures residing near local minima of a potential energy surface, which have traditionally been obtained through costly DFT relaxations of known or physically synthesized compounds. This reliance constrains both the scale and the structural diversity of available pretraining data, leaving large regions of crystal structure space unexplored. In this work, we connect diffusion-based pretraining with synthetic structure generation to reduce this bottleneck. We introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline combining three complementary strategies: perturb-and-relax, generative sampling via MatterGen, and protostructure enumeration. Where structural relaxation is required, we use fast machine-learned interatomic potentials instead of performing a new DFT relaxation for each generated structure. We further compare a coordinate-denoising control with continuous-time variance-preserving (VP) and sub-VP diffusion objectives using a randomly initialized Orb-v2 backbone. The source comparison covers seven MatBench property-prediction tasks, and an eighth task, \texttt{mp\_gap}, is included in the protostructure scaling study. Every synthetic-pretraining condition numerically outperforms random initialization on all seven source-comparison tasks. Scaling the protostructure corpus from 20k to 165k under a fixed 400-epoch schedule numerically matches or exceeds MP-20k pretraining on most tasks; because this protocol increases both data diversity and optimization updates, the result reflects joint data-and-compute scaling.

AI.tldr: 该文将基于扩散的图神经网络预训练与合成晶体结构生成结合，用扰动-弛豫、MatterGen生成采样、原型结构枚举三种策略生成预训练数据，并用机器学习势替代DFT弛豫，缓解预训练数据依赖局部极小结构的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 扩散式预训练可无需量子力学标签学习可迁移表示，但依赖靠近势能面局部极小点的结构，通常需对已知或已合成化合物做昂贵的DFT弛豫，限制了预训练数据的规模与结构多样性，使大量晶体结构空间未被探索。
AI.method: 构建合成数据生成流水线，融合扰动-弛豫、基于MatterGen的生成式采样、原型结构枚举三种策略；需要结构弛豫处使用快速机器学习原子间势替代逐个DFT弛豫；在随机初始化的Orb-v2骨干上比较坐标去噪控制与连续时间VP、sub-VP扩散目标；在七个MatBench性质预测任务上做来源比较，并在原型结构扩展研究中加入第八个任务mp_gap。
AI.result: 所有合成预训练条件在七个来源比较任务上均数值上优于随机初始化；固定400 epoch下将原型结构语料从2万扩展到16.5万，在多数任务上数值上匹配或超过MP-2万预训练。
AI.conclusion: 合成结构生成可有效缓解扩散预训练的局部极小结构瓶颈；原型结构扩展的结果体现数据与计算量的联合扩展效应。

title: SeasonRainBench: Global Seasonal Precipitation
summary: Accurate seasonal precipitation forecasts help societies prepare for drought, flooding, and crop failure months in advance. While data-driven methods have made rapid progress in weather and subseasonal forecasting, operational seasonal precipitation prediction still relies on numerical ensemble systems. These systems are computationally expensive and exhibit biases and drift that increase with lead time, motivating more efficient data-driven alternatives. Yet this transition faces three linked challenges: comparing data-driven forecasts with operational ones requires (1) a global benchmark that does not exist, scoring them requires (2) metrics that capture operational priorities beyond anomaly correlation (ACC) and RMSE, and training them must (3) rely on a single, short observational record. To address the first two challenges, we introduce \BenchName, the first such benchmark, covering monthly precipitation forecasts 1--5 months ahead. It pairs global $1^\circ$ satellite precipitation with oceanic and atmospheric predictors, includes seven operational centers, and provides 310,944 simulated months from 52 climate models for training. Beyond standard scores, we introduce two operationally motivated metrics for anomaly strength and monthly rain-belt position. To address the third challenge, we develop \MODEL, which learns from simulations what the record lacks and transfers it to Earth through three modules: SimForced aligns the climate background, SimMemory transfers a history encoder pretrained on simulations, and SimAnalog supplements Earth labels with simulated analog outcomes. Extensive experiments show that \MODEL{} improves ACC, CRPS, anomaly strength, and rain-belt position by 12.0\%, 3.6\%, 2.9\%, and 0.3\% over the strongest operational or data-driven model, opening a path from simulated worlds to Earth system prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出首个全球季节降水预测基准BenchName，并设计从模拟数据学习并迁移到地球的模型MODEL，在多项指标上超越最强业务/数据驱动模型。
AI.motivation: 季节降水预报对农业与灾害防范意义重大，但业务仍依赖计算昂贵、存在偏差与漂移的数值集合系统；转向数据驱动面临三大挑战：缺全球基准、缺契合业务需求的指标、仅有单一短观测记录。
AI.method: 构建BenchName基准（1–5月提前的全球1°卫星降水+海气预测因子，含7个业务中心与52个气候模式310,944模拟月）；新增异常强度与雨带位置两项业务导向指标；提出MODEL模型，通过SimForced（对齐气候背景）、SimMemory（模拟预训练历史编码器迁移）、SimAnalog（用模拟相似结果补充真实标签）三模块实现模拟到地球的迁移。
AI.result: 相比最强业务或数据驱动模型，ACC提升12.0%、CRPS提升3.6%、异常强度提升2.9%、雨带位置提升0.3%。
AI.conclusion: 打通了从模拟世界到地球系统预测的路径，为数据驱动季节降水预报提供统一评估与训练框架。

title: Visibility Graph Representations of Word Embeddings for Text Classification
summary: Text classifiers depend on representations that expose the distinctions between classes in a form the learning model can use, and a restricted vocabulary changes which representation is most effective. This paper studies natural visibility graphs as an intermediate representation for news topic classification under controlled vocabulary budgets. Word embeddings are averaged into a fixed-length document vector, the vector is read as an ordered numerical series, and its natural visibility graph is passed to a classifier either as an ordered node-degree vector or as an adjacency matrix. On the four-class AG News benchmark, chi-square selection retains 100 to 1,500 words, and the graph inputs are compared with direct embedding-based representations from continuous bag-of-words, skip-gram, GloVe, FastText and BERT. With a fully connected classifier, the degree representation is the most accurate configuration from 700 selected words onward; it reaches its highest accuracy of 91.24% at 1,000 words and exceeds the BERT-based baseline by 0.29 percentage points at 1,500 words. In a separate convolutional comparison, the adjacency input reaches 86.16% at 1,000 words, against 83.12% for the strongest static embedding. The results indicate that visibility-derived features can be competitive once the selected vocabulary provides adequate coverage. We discuss the roles of graph compression, coordinate ordering and classifier choice, and the controls needed to establish the reliability of the small differences observed.

AI.tldr: 在受限词表预算下，将文档词向量均值序列转化为自然可见性图（度序列或邻接矩阵）作为中间表示，用于AG News四分类；从700词起度表示最优，1000词达91.24%，1500词超出BERT基线0.29个百分点。
AI.motivation: 文本分类依赖能暴露类别差异的表示，而受限词表会改变哪种表示最有效；作者希望检验自然可见性图能否作为词表受限场景下的有效中间表示。
AI.method: 将词向量平均为定长文档向量，按顺序视为数值序列，构建自然可见性图，再以有序节点度向量或邻接矩阵送入分类器；在AG News上用卡方选择保留100–1500词，与CBOW、skip-gram、GloVe、FastText、BERT的嵌入表示对比，并使用全连接分类器及卷积分类器两种设置。
AI.result: 全连接分类器下，度表示自700词起最准确，1000词达91.24%，1500词超BERT基线0.29个百分点；卷积对比中，邻接矩阵输入在1000词达86.16%，强于最强静态嵌入的83.12%。
AI.conclusion: 当所选词表覆盖充分时，可见性图派生特征具有竞争力；作者讨论了图压缩、坐标排序与分类器选择的作用，并指出需设置对照以确认小幅差异的可靠性。

title: ARG-Avatar: Animation-Rendering Guidance for Efficient Feedforward Avatar Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from images is important for applications such as gaming and augmented reality. Feedforward methods make avatar reconstruction accessible by reducing inference time to a few seconds, but recent approaches rely heavily on scaling model capacity, training data, and computation. We ask whether such scaling is necessary. To this end, we introduce ARG-Avatar, an efficient feedforward framework with only 68M trainable parameters that achieves SOTA reconstruction quality. Our key insight is that 3D animation and rendering already provide strong geometric correspondences that existing methods largely attempt to learn from data. In light of this, we design the Foreground Avatar Coordinate RoPE attention (FACRoPE) and Intermediate Token Rendering (ITR) pipeline to guide avatar tokens to attend to their corresponding patches. Experiments across multiple datasets show that ARG-Avatar consistently outperforms prior methods when using two or more input images. Compared with LHM++, ARG-Avatar uses approximately 9$\times$ fewer trainable parameters, 4.8$\times$ fewer training sequences, and 14$\times$ less training compute, while running 6$\times$ faster and achieving a 2.7 dB PSNR improvement on the out-of-distribution NeuMan benchmark.

AI.tldr: ARG-Avatar 是一个仅含 68M 可训练参数的高效前馈框架，通过利用 3D 动画与渲染中已有的几何对应关系（FACRoPE 注意力与 ITR 渲染流水线），在无需大规模扩容的情况下达到 SOTA 重建质量。
AI.motivation: 从图像重建可动画 3D 人体化身对游戏与增强现实意义重大。前馈方法虽将推理时间缩短至数秒，但近期方法严重依赖扩大模型容量、训练数据和算力。作者质疑这种扩容是否必要。
AI.method: 提出 ARG-Avatar，核心洞察是 3D 动画与渲染本身已提供强几何对应关系，而现有方法大多试图从数据中学习这些关系。为此设计 Foreground Avatar Coordinate RoPE 注意力（FACRoPE）和 Intermediate Token Rendering（ITR）流水线，引导化身 token 关注其对应图像 patch。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，使用两张及以上输入图时一致优于先前方法。相比 LHM++：可训练参数约少 9 倍、训练序列少 4.8 倍、训练算力少 14 倍，推理快 6 倍，并在分布外 NeuMan 基准上 PSNR 提升 2.7 dB。
AI.conclusion: 证明人体化身重建的高质量并不依赖大规模扩容，通过将已有几何对应关系注入架构设计即可用小模型实现 SOTA 性能。

title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
summary: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to the Gemma 4 edge models E2B and E4B with 66 checked examples covering 11 signal-processing MATLAB subtasks, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on the integrated GPU (iGPU) of a laptop, and deploy the 8-bit integer (int8) models with the adapters through OpenVINO. On held-out variants scored by deterministic checkers, the pass rate rises from 18/66 to 37/66 (LoRA) and 37/66 (QLoRA) for E2B and from 32/66 to 47/66 for E4B (QLoRA). Reading all 159 failing programs shows that the adapters remove most errors of convention, such as the sign of a lag, units and array shapes, but few errors in building signals and noise. Applied at run time, the adapter costs 17-19% of the generation speed.

AI.tldr: 用LoRA/QLoRA微调Gemma 4边缘模型（E2B/E4B），在笔记本iGPU上训练、OpenVINO部署int8权重，使DSP MATLAB代码通过率提升约2-3倍，但运行时损失17-19%生成速度。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型适合在笔记本上离线编写信号处理代码，但在DSP约定（如滞后符号、单位、数组形状）上会产生系统性错误，需低成本、可本地部署的改进方案。
AI.method: 用66个经核查的示例覆盖11个MATLAB DSP子任务，对Gemma 4 E2B与E4B进行SFT（LoRA与QLoRA），在笔记本集成GPU上训练；通过OpenVINO部署int8模型并挂载适配器；用确定性检查器在留出变体上评测，并人工阅读全部失败程序。
AI.result: E2B通过率由18/66升至37/66（LoRA与QLoRA相同），E4B（QLoRA）由32/66升至47/66。错误分析显示适配器基本消除了约定类错误（滞后符号、单位、数组形状），但对信号与噪声构造类错误改善有限。运行时适配器带来17-19%的生成速度开销。
AI.conclusion: 少量高质量示例 + 参数高效微调即可显著纠正边缘小模型的DSP约定性错误，并可在笔记本端量化部署；但数据覆盖偏窄，信号/噪声构造等结构性错误仍需更多数据或方法改进。

title: When does deep reinforcement learning pay off in HVAC supervisory control? Four small Modelica case studies trained directly on FMUs
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Code, models and trained agents: https://github.com/Bingnan-Zhao/hvac-drl-lab
summary:
Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is often proposed for the supervisory control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems. The reported gains are, however, difficult to interpret, because the baselines are often weak and the attainable optimum is seldom known. This paper examines four small, reproducible case studies based on an office building in Brisbane, Australia: pre-cooling under a time-of-use tariff; chiller staging with condenser water reset; chilled water supply temperature reset with a wet cooling coil; and chilled water storage under time-of-use prices and a demand charge. The plants were modelled with the Modelica Buildings library, and in three of the cases a soft actor-critic agent was trained directly on the exported functional mock-up unit (FMU). Each agent was compared with tuned rule-based controllers and, where practicable, with a near-optimal reference from hourly exhaustive search or dynamic programming with perfect foresight.
  In the two cases without storage the agent reached the near-optimal reference, but the margin above a well-chosen rule was small: 1.3% for condenser water reset and 0.18% for chilled water reset. In the latter case two common reset rules consumed more energy than a fixed set point. With a chilled water storage tank the margin was considerably larger. The agent outperformed both rules (-7.8%, compared with -3.9% and -6.3%) and adopted midday charging during the solar off-peak period, yet it obtained only about 45% of the saving achieved by the perfect-foresight schedule and did little to limit the demand peak. In the pre-cooling case a hand-tuned rule remained superior (-12.0% compared with -5.6%). These results suggest that studies of DRL for HVAC control should state the margin between the best rule and a near-optimal reference. Some practical difficulties encountered in training on co-simulation FMUs are also reported.

AI.tldr: 该文用四个小型可复现案例研究，将软演员-评论家（SAC）强化学习控制器与调优规则控制器及近似最优参考（穷举/动态规划）对比，发现无储能的控制任务中RL相对优秀规则的边际收益很小（0.18%–1.3%），有储能的储水案例边际较大但仍仅达完美预见方案的约45%，甚至预冷案例中手调规则优于RL（-12.0% vs -5.6%）。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习（DRL）常被用于HVAC系统监控，但文献报告的节能收益难以解读：基线规则控制器往往较弱，且可达的优化上限鲜为人知，导致收益缺乏可信参照。
AI.method: 基于澳大利亚布里斯班某办公楼构建四个小型可复现案例：分时电价下预冷、冷凝器水路重置的冷机分级、湿盘管冷冻水供水温度重置、分时电价与需量电费下的冷冻水蓄冷。用Modelica Buildings库建模，三个案例将导出的FMU直接用于训练SAC智能体；每个智能体与调优规则控制器对比，并在可行时与逐小时穷举搜索或完美预见动态规划的近似最优参考对比。
AI.result: 两个无储能案例中智能体达到近似最优参考，但相对精心选择的规则的富余量很小：冷凝器水路重置1.3%，冷冻水重置0.18%；后者中两条常见重置规则能耗高于固定设定值。蓄冷案例边际较大：智能体优于两条规则（-7.8%，规则分别为-3.9%和-6.3%），并在太阳能off-peak时段中午充电，但仅取得完美预见方案约45%的节能，且几乎未削减需量峰值。预冷案例中手调规则更优（-12.0% vs -5.6%）。另报告了在协同仿真FMU上训练的实际困难。
AI.conclusion: HVAC领域DRL研究应同时报告“最佳规则与近似最优参考之间的差距”，以正确评估RL的真实价值；许多简单控制任务的可改进空间本就很有限，蓄冷等复杂任务中RL仍显著落后于完美预见上界。

title: Towards Physics-Constrained Rectified Flow for Climate Downscaling: What Projections Can Certify?
comment: Accepted to AIAS+ 2026, ACM ICPS proceedings. 9 pages
summary: Statistical downscaling restores the regional detail behind flooding and crop stress, but diffusion and flow-matching generators can produce sharp fields that break the conservation laws of their coarse input. Physics-Constrained Rectified Flow (PC-RF) is a conditional flow-matching downscaler. Its training penalties target wind divergence, negative precipitation, and mass drift from the coarse total, and a projection after sampling removes the last two exactly. On one corrupted synthetic field with no trained network, the projection drives the Non-negativity Violation Rate (NVR) from 0.236 and the Mass-Conservation Error (MCE) from 0.184 to zero, and the penalties lower the Divergence Error (DE) by about 30%. On ERA5 the projection gives PC-RF and RF-base, the penalty-free rectified-flow baseline, an NVR of exactly zero and an MCE of zero up to float32 rounding. The penalties add no perceptual gain that we can separate from training budget or run-to-run variation. At a matched budget on 2019-2021, PC-RF has no edge over RF-base (SSIM 0.939 vs. 0.942, PSNR 31.81 vs. 31.79, CRPS 0.771 vs. 0.772). Our unprojected CorrDiff reimplementation beats both flow models on PSNR (28.38) and CRPS (1.092) on 2020, yet 45% of its ensemble-mean precipitation cells are negative. On ERA5 a sign error in the divergence operator made that penalty and DE act on a deformation-like term. The fine reference is interpolated from ERA5 and accumulates precipitation over a longer window, so the perceptual scores cannot establish downscaling skill. NVR and MCE need one pass and no fine reference, so we argue they should run first as pass-or-fail checks, with DE as a diagnostic.

AI.tldr: 提出物理约束修正流下行尺度模型PC-RF，用训练惩罚项与采样后投影强制守恒，但实验显示惩罚项无感知增益，投影可零成本保证非负与质量守恒，应作为前置校验。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流匹配生成器虽能恢复区域细节，却产生破坏粗输入守恒律（质量、非负、散度）的尖锐场；且常用感知指标无法证明下行尺度能力。
AI.method: PC-RF：条件流匹配下行尺度器，训练中加入风散度、负降水、质量漂移惩罚；采样后投影精确消除负降水与质量误差。对比RF-base、CorrDiff复现，在合成场与ERA5上评测NVR、MCE、DE及SSIM/PSNR/CRPS。
AI.result: 投影将合成场NVR 0.236、MCE 0.184 降至零，惩罚降DE约30%；ERA5上投影使NVR/MCE精确为零。匹配预算下PC-RF对RF-base无优势（SSIM 0.939 vs 0.942，PSNR 31.81 vs 31.79，CRPS 0.771 vs 0.772）。CorrDiff未投影时PSNR 28.38、CRPS 1.092更优但45%集合均值格点为负。另发现散度算子符号错误。
AI.conclusion: 惩罚项无可分离的感知收益；NVR与MCE仅需一次前向、无需精细参考，建议作为先行的通过/失败检查，DE作诊断量。

title: Route Optimization under Port Congestion and Carbon Reduction: An NSGA-II Approach
summary: Maritime shipping simultaneously faces the dual challenges of escalating port congestion and increasingly stringent decarbonization mandates. Large-scale vessel anchorage at hub ports inflates unit transport costs while generating significant additional \(CO_2\) emissions from idling auxiliary engines. This study develops a multi-objective routing optimization framework that jointly incorporates time, transport, and carbon emission costs under congestion-dependent generalized cost functions. A variational inequality (VI) model is formulated to characterize network equilibrium in vessel route allocation, while the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) is deployed to solve the resulting three-objective optimization problem. The model is empirically validated using China's coastal container network (Shanghai as the primary congested port, Ningbo-Zhoushan as the backup alternative), with sensitivity analyses conducted across congestion levels, carbon tax rates, and fuel price differentials. Key findings indicate that: (1) alternative ports effectively hedge congestion when diversion costs fall below waiting costs, with a diversion threshold at approximately 60 vessel calls; (2) a carbon tax of 80/t \(CO_2\) pushes clean fuel adoption above 50%; and (3) fuel prices primarily influence energy-type selection rather than port diversion decisions, confirming that the two decision dimensions operate independently. These findings offer actionable decision support for port authorities, regulators, and shipping operators seeking to balance economic efficiency with environmental sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建考虑拥堵的多目标船舶航线优化框架，用变分不等式刻画网络均衡、NSGA-II求解三目标问题，实证发现分流阈值约60航次、碳税80美元/吨可使清洁燃料采用率超50%，且燃料价格仅影响能源类型而不影响港口分流决策。
AI.motivation: 航运业同时面临港口拥堵加剧与脱碳法规趋严的双重压力：枢纽港大规模船舶锚泊推高单位运输成本，且闲置辅机产生大量额外CO2排放，亟需在拥堵与减排间协同优化航线决策。
AI.method: 构建同时纳入时间、运输与碳排放成本的多目标路径优化框架，采用拥堵依赖的广义成本函数；用变分不等式（VI）模型刻画船舶航线分配的网络均衡，并部署非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）求解三目标优化问题；以中国沿海集装箱网络（上海为主拥堵港、宁波舟山为备选港）进行实证与敏感性分析（拥堵水平、碳税率、燃料价差）。
AI.result: (1) 当分流成本低于等待成本时备选港可有效对冲拥堵，分流阈值约为60航次；(2) 碳税达80美元/吨CO2时，清洁燃料采用率超过50%；(3) 燃料价格主要影响能源类型选择而非港口分流决策，表明两个决策维度相互独立。
AI.conclusion: 研究为港口管理机构、监管者与航运经营者提供可操作决策支持，以权衡经济效率与环境可持续性；拥堵分流与清洁能源选择构成两个相对独立的决策维度。

title: Joint-ID: Transformer-based Joint Image Enhancement and Depth Estimation for Underwater Environments
comment: 11 pages. (c) 2023 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Underwater imaging is a challenging task due to factors such as scattering, absorption, and turbulence, which degrade image quality and limit visibility. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for enhancing underwater images that leverages the benefits of joint learning for simultaneous image enhancement and depth estimation. We introduce Joint-ID, a transformer-based neural network that can obtain high-perceptual image quality and depth information from raw underwater images. Our approach formulates a multi-modal objective function that addresses invalid depth, lack of sharpness, and image degradation based on color and local texture. We design an end-to-end training pipeline that enables joint restoration and depth estimation in a shared hierarchical feature space. Additionally, we propose a synthetic dataset with various distortions and scene depths for multi-task learning. We evaluate Joint-ID on synthetic and standard datasets, as well as real underwater images with diverse spectra and harsh turbidity, demonstrating its effectiveness for underwater image enhancement and depth estimation. Furthermore, we demonstrate the ability of Joint-ID to perform feature matching and saliency detection for visually guided underwater robots. Our proposed method has the potential to improve the visual perception of underwater environments and benefit applications such as oceanography and underwater robotics. Supplements are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/joint-id/home

AI.tldr: Joint-ID：基于Transformer的联合学习网络，同时实现水下图像增强与深度估计。
AI.motivation: 水下成像受散射、吸收和湍流影响，图像质量下降、能见度受限；单一任务方法难以充分利用增强与深度估计间的互补信息。
AI.method: 提出联合学习框架Joint-ID，采用Transformer在共享分层特征空间中端到端地同时进行图像复原与深度估计；设计多模态目标函数，处理无效深度、清晰度不足及基于颜色与局部纹理的图像退化；并构建含多种退化类型与场景深度的合成数据集用于多任务学习。
AI.result: 在合成数据集、标准数据集及不同光谱与强浑浊度的真实水下图像上评估，验证了图像增强与深度估计的有效性；并展示其支持特征匹配与显著目标检测，可服务于视觉引导的水下机器人。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习可提升水下视觉感知能力，有望应用于海洋学与水下机器人等领域；代码/资料已在项目主页公开。

title: Learning Regions of Attraction for Transverse Feedback Linearization under Controller Singularities
comment: 27 pages (10 main + references + appendix), 1 figure, 8 tables
summary: Transverse feedback linearization (TFL) achieves path following by exactly linearizing the error dynamics, but its controller is undefined on a singular set, such as zero speed for a unicycle or zero thrust for a quadrotor. The constrained region of attraction, the set of initial states from which the closed loop converges to the path without violating state or regularity constraints, determines where the controller can be safely activated. Exploiting the exact linear error dynamics, we show that this region is the largest forward invariant subset of the admissible set. We then decompose its state-constrained Zubov value function into an analytically known quadratic cost-to-go and a safety value function. We learn only the latter, by fitted value iteration without infinite-horizon trajectory labels. The resulting estimate combines an inner layer verified by interval branch and bound with a learned outer layer tested on samples. On a unicycle following a circle and a sinusoid and on a planar quadrotor, it covers on average 72.0%, 83.4% and 19.1% of the simulated region of attraction. In comparison, the quadratic cost-to-go and two physics-informed neural network (PINN) solvers of Zubov's equation cover at most 11.3%, 4.0% and 0.0% on average. Code and animations are available at https://gradslab.github.io/roa_tfl

AI.tldr: 该论文研究横向反馈线性化(TFL)路径跟踪控制器在何处可安全激活，提出将状态约束Zubov值函数分解为已知二次代价与学习型安全值函数，从而高效估计受限吸引域。
AI.motivation: TFL能在误差动力学上实现精确线性化，但其控制器在奇异集（如独轮车零速度、四旋翼零推力）上无定义，且存在状态与正则性约束。判断从哪些初始状态出发能无违规收敛到路径（即受限吸引域）对安全激活至关重要，而现有方法（二次代价、PINN求解Zubov方程）覆盖能力很弱。
AI.method: 利用精确线性误差动力学，证明受限吸引域是可行集的最大前向不变子集；将状态约束Zubov值函数分解为解析已知的二次cost-to-go加一个安全值函数，仅用无无限时域轨迹标签的拟合值迭代学习后者；最终估计由区间分支定界验证的内层与采样式测试的学习外层组合而成。
AI.result: 在独轮车跟踪圆、正弦轨迹以及平面四旋翼上，分别平均覆盖仿真吸引域的72.0%、83.4%和19.1%；对比之下，二次cost-to-go与两种PINN求解Zubov方程的方法平均最多仅覆盖11.3%、4.0%和0.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解Zubov值函数并只学习安全部分，配合可验证的内层结构，所提方法显著优于基线，能给出更可靠的TFL控制器可安全激活区域估计，尤其对四旋翼等强约束系统仍有提升空间。

title: Cross-cultural Adaptation of Recipes for Low-Resource Languages: A Benchmark and Multilingual Culinary Lexicon for Hausa, Yorùbá, and Igbo
summary: Recent multilingual large language models (LLMs) have improved machine translation, yet culturally adaptive translation for low-resource languages (LRLs) remains underexplored. This is particularly challenging for recipes, where ingredients, cooking tools, measurements, and procedures may require adaptation to the target cultural context. In this work, we introduce ReciLoReL, a benchmark of 600 expert-translated and culturally adapted recipes across Yorùbá, Hausa, and Igbo (three of the most prominent languages in Nigeria), and ReciLex, a multilingual culinary lexicon containing approximately 15,000 translated entities across ten recipe entity categories, including ingredients, tools, chef actions, state of tools, and durations. We evaluate state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs for English-to-LRL recipe translation under zero-shot and few-shot settings and investigate whether augmenting LLMs with ReciLex improves culturally adaptive recipe translation without requiring large target-language recipe corpora for training or fine-tuning. Beyond conventional reference-based translation evaluation using BLEU, chrF, and TER, we introduce five criteria for evaluating cultural adaptation, adapted from established cross-cultural adaptation methods. Across the selected LLMs and languages, ReciLex improves average BLEU from 13.57 to 14.51 and chrF from 37.89 to 38.74, while reducing TER from 77.14 to 75.12. Human evaluation further shows improvements ranging from 0.11 to 0.36 points across the five cultural adaptation evaluation criteria on a five-point scale. Overall, our work provides new resources, evaluation criteria, and empirical evaluation for studying culturally adaptive recipe translation in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReciLoReL基准（600条专家翻译并文化适配的尼日利亚三种低资源语言食谱）与ReciLex多语言烹饪词典（约15,000条实体），并证明用ReciLex增强LLM可在无需大规模目标语言语料训练的情况下提升文化适配食谱翻译质量。
AI.motivation: 多语言LLM虽提升了机器翻译，但低资源语言的文化适配翻译仍研究不足；食谱中的食材、厨具、计量与步骤往往需要按目标文化进行适配，而现有资源与评测标准缺失。
AI.method: 构建ReciLoReL（Yorùbá、Hausa、Igbo共600条专家翻译食谱）和ReciLex（十类食谱实体、约15,000条译名）；在零样本与少样本设置下评测主流多语言LLM的英→低资源语言食谱翻译，并测试ReciLex增强（免训练/微调）；除BLEU、chrF、TER外，提出五项借鉴跨文化适配方法的评估准则。
AI.result: ReciLex增强使平均BLEU由13.57升至14.51、chrF由37.89升至38.74、TER由77.14降至75.12；人工评估在五项文化适配准则上提升0.11–0.36分（五分制）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低资源场景下的文化适配食谱翻译提供了新资源、评估准则与实证结果。

title: ExplicitIR: Explicit Spatial Policy Fields for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clean images blindly from inputs with various degradation types and levels using a single model. However, the adaptation policy in most existing methods remains implicitly encoded in feature representations, leaving the restoration decision neither explicitly represented nor independently controllable. Since real-world degradations vary spatially, applying uniform updates across the entire image leads to over-smoothing of clean areas and under-correction of localized degradations. To address these limitations, we present ExplicitIR, which represents the restoration policy as two explicit per-pixel fields: Budget, which determines where and how strongly to update, and Style, which selects between narrow and wide context windows. Specifically, ExplicitIR incorporates a Spatial Policy Estimator (SPE) to predict these fields, explicitly representing the restoration policy and capturing spatially-varying degradations, which are then applied by Policy-Adaptive Decoder Blocks (PADB) through adaptive fusion of narrow- and wide-window responses, enabling independent control and precise local modulation. This design enables spatially-adaptive restoration in a single forward pass, without requiring task labels, prompts, or test-time degradation estimators. Extensive experiments on three-task and five-task benchmarks demonstrate that ExplicitIR achieves performance competitive with the strongest all-in-one baselines.

AI.tldr: ExplicitIR 将一体化图像修复策略显式表示为逐像素的 Budget 与 Style 两个场，用 Spatial Policy Estimator 预测并由 Policy-Adaptive Decoder Blocks 执行，实现空间自适应修复且无需任务标签、提示或测试时退化估计。
AI.motivation: 现有一体化修复方法的自适应策略隐式编码在特征中，修复决策不可显式表示也不可独立控制；且真实退化空间分布不均，全图统一更新会使干净区域过度平滑、局部退化修正不足。
AI.method: 提出 ExplicitIR：用 Spatial Policy Estimator 预测两个逐像素显式场——Budget（决定在何处、以多大强度更新）与 Style（在窄/宽上下文窗口间选择）；再由 Policy-Adaptive Decoder Blocks 融合窄窗与宽窗响应来施加策略，实现独立控制与精确局部调制，单次前向即可完成空间自适应修复。
AI.result: 在三任务和五任务基准上的大量实验表明，ExplicitIR 的性能与最强的一体化基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 将修复策略显式化为可独立控制的逐像素场，是一种有效且轻量约束的一体化修复范式，无需任务标签、提示或测试时退化估计器。

title: Towards Optimism-Pessimism Trade-off in Model-based Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) enables sample-efficient adaptation by leveraging offline pre-training for online fine-tuning. However, the distribution shifts between offline and online stages often hinder fine-tuning performance. Many existing methods encode the optimism-pessimism trade-off through a single-objective formulation. Selecting its trade-off coefficient through online fine-tuning can require costly bi-level optimization. We identify the balance established during offline training as a key challenge: in our motivating experiments, optimistic policies adapt better to novel tasks, whereas pessimistic policies perform better on the same online tasks. To address this challenge, we propose a bi-objective formulation that captures this trade-off, yielding a Pareto policy pool during offline training. This policy pool enables adaptive selection during online fine-tuning across diverse online tasks. To generate the pool, we introduce Multi-Objective Soft Actor-critIC (MOSAIC), which solves bi-objective problems and constructs diverse Pareto policies. After offline training, a contextual bandit algorithm hierarchically selects the most suitable policy for fine-tuning at each online interaction step. Empirically, our pipeline, Hierarchical Pareto Policy Pool (HiP3), achieves the strongest aggregate performance across both same and novel online tasks and maintains its advantage under stronger distribution shifts. Comprehensive ablations further clarify the roles of the policy pool, MOSAIC-based pool construction, and the online selection mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiP3框架：离线阶段用多目标SAC（MOSAIC）求解乐观-悲观权衡的双目标问题，构建Pareto策略池；在线微调阶段用上下文赌博机分层选择最合适的策略，从而在分布偏移下自适应选择，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的离线到在线RL中，离线与在线阶段存在分布偏移，阻碍微调。现有方法用单目标编码乐观-悲观权衡，其权衡系数需通过在线微调进行昂贵的双层优化；且实验发现离线训练中确立的平衡是关键难题——乐观策略更适应新任务，悲观策略在同样在线任务上表现更好，固定单一平衡难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出双目标公式刻画乐观-悲观权衡，离线训练产出Pareto策略池。为此设计MOSAIC（Multi-Objective Soft Actor-critIC）求解双目标问题并构建多样化的Pareto策略；离线训练后，用上下文赌博机算法在每个在线交互步骤分层选择最适合微调的策略。
AI.result: 在相同任务与新颖在线任务上，HiP3均取得最强综合性能，并在更强分布偏移下保持优势。消融实验进一步阐明策略池、MOSAIC构建方式及在线选择机制的作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过双目标建模与Pareto策略池加在线分层选择，避免了单目标权衡系数的昂贵双层优化，使离线到在线微调能自适应不同在线任务，验证了方法的有效性。

title: ConfGuard: a physics-grounded reference monitor for predictive-maintenance large-language-model agents
summary: Large-language-model agents now close the industrial predictive-maintenance loop, reading sensor windows, retrieving procedures and dispatching work orders. Two attack channels meet there: injected text in a retrieved document can hijack the decision, and a bounded sensor perturbation can corrupt the remaining-useful-life estimate behind it. Recent agent defenses police data provenance and tool privilege but cannot tell whether a prognostic quantity is physically plausible. ConfGuard is a reference monitor with a physics-grounded policy. Its conformal monitor tests each prediction, anchored to the asset's admitted history, against degradation physics: capped remaining life never rises and falls at most one cycle per cycle. Calibrating its threshold over whole asset trajectories lets the operator set the expected share of a clean asset's windows the running monitor escalates. A physics-policy validator checks the agent's maintenance-urgency decision against the decision a deterministic policy derives from the same interval. On all 10,196 C-MAPSS test windows the monitor cuts a covert attacker's reach on healthy assets from 0.529 to 0.046 and closes suppression of failing assets (0.151 to 0), escalating 0.027 of clean windows against a 0.05 target, while the fixed physical range it replaces leaves both attacks open. Behind a Qwen3-14B planner the composed monitors hold urgency-class injection to 0.00 and the universal sensor attack to 0.12, against 0.29 and 0.54 for a defended prompt. An adaptive attacker defeats a Mahalanobis detector on 0.504 of windows and adversarial training on 0.485. We report an attack class the projection misses.

AI.tldr: ConfGuard 是一个基于退化物理规律的一致性参考监控器，用共形方法校验 RUL 预测与维护紧迫度决策，可在 LLM 代理预测性维护闭环中同时抵御文档注入与传感器扰动攻击。
AI.motivation: LLM 代理已用于工业预测性维护闭环，面临两条攻击通道：检索文档中的注入文本可劫持决策，有界传感器扰动可污染剩余寿命（RUL）估计。现有代理防御只管制数据来源与工具权限，无法判断预测量的物理合理性。
AI.method: ConfGuard 含两个组件：(1) 共形监控器，将每个预测锚定在资产已承认的历史上，按退化物理规则检验——封顶剩余寿命不得上升，且每周期至多下降一个周期；在完整资产轨迹上校准阈值，使操作者可设定干净资产窗口的期望告警比例。(2) 物理策略验证器，将代理给出的维护紧迫度决策与确定性策略基于同一区间推导的决策对比。
AI.result: 在全部 10,196 个 C-MAPSS 测试窗口上，监控器将隐蔽攻击者在健康资产上的影响从 0.529 降至 0.046，并将对故障资产的抑制从 0.151 降至 0；干净窗口告警率 0.027（目标 0.05）。替代的固定物理范围对两类攻击均无防护。在 Qwen3-14B 规划器下，组合监控将紧迫度类别注入压至 0.00，通用传感器攻击压至 0.12（受防御提示分别为 0.29 与 0.54）。自适应攻击可分别攻破 Mahalanobis 检测器（0.504）与对抗训练（0.485）。
AI.conclusion: 物理锚定的共形一致性监控可有效防御预测性维护代理中的注入与传感器攻击，且优于固定范围、统计检测与对抗训练等基线；但作者也报告了一类投影方法无法覆盖的攻击类型，提示仍有开放挑战。

title: StitchRAG: Constructing Compact and Evidence-Preserving Contexts for RAG with Diffusion-Based Stitching
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external evidence. However, long retrieved contexts incur computational overhead and can even hurt performance due to noisy or irrelevant content. We propose \textsc{StitchRAG}, a framework for constructing compact context in RAG. \textsc{StitchRAG} builds a faithful, information-dense context while dynamically compressing the retrieved passages. We adapt the size reduction ratio to each passage by formulating a utility maximization trading-off the retained information and computation costs. We then extract answer candidates and query-related keywords from passages as anchors and collect passage sentences containing anchors under the derived size constraint. Finally, we connect or stitch the collected sentences together using text diffusion to form a coherent and natural context. Experiments on five open-domain QA benchmarks show that \textsc{StitchRAG} consistently outperforms diverse multi-step and compression baselines. Extensive ablations show the effectiveness of dynamic size allocation, anchor preservation, and diffusion-based stitching.

AI.tldr: StitchRAG通过动态压缩检索段落、锚点句提取与文本扩散拼接，构建紧凑且连贯的RAG上下文，在五个开放域问答基准上超越多步与压缩基线。
AI.motivation: RAG依赖外部证据提升事实性，但长检索上下文带来计算开销，且噪声或无关内容反而可能损害性能，因此需要构建信息密集的紧凑上下文。
AI.method: 将各段落的压缩比动态化，用效用最大化在保留信息与计算成本间权衡；从段落中提取答案候选与查询相关关键词作为锚点，在尺寸约束下收集含锚点的句子；再用文本扩散将句子连接/拼接为连贯自然的上下文。
AI.result: 在五个开放域问答基准上持续优于多种多步方法和压缩基线；消融实验验证了动态尺寸分配、锚点保留与扩散式拼接的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑上下文构建是提升RAG效率与效果的有效途径，动态分配、锚点保留和扩散拼接是关键设计。

title: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
comment: 13 pages. (c) 2024 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media, including reprinting/republishing this material for advertising or promotional purposes, creating new collective works, for resale or redistribution to servers or lists, or reuse of any copyrighted component of this work in other works
summary: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization.
