In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIDENT——一种快速轻量的学习式水下感知系统，用共享主干加三个并行解码器同时完成图像增强、深度估计与不确定性建模，性能与效率均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 水下成像受光传播影响，普遍存在纹理模糊与色彩对比度低的问题，严重削弱机器人稳定作业所需的感知能力；而已有方法多只处理单一任务，难以兼顾多任务精度与实时性、轻量化需求。
AI.method: 提出TRIDENT模型：一个共享backbone用于高效特征共享，加三个并行解码器分别处理图像增强、深度估计和不确定性估计；以快速轻量方式设计，并通过复杂参数化进行联合训练（多任务联合学习）。
AI.result: 在多个标准数据集上，图像增强和深度估计均显著优于现有方法；尽管同时执行三项任务，其内存占用与推理时间仍优于其他方法；联合学习方法在特征匹配上表现出鲁棒性，并从2-D视觉任务平滑扩展到3-D视觉任务。
AI.conclusion: 验证了共享主干+多解码器的联合学习水下感知框架可在效率与精度间取得良好平衡，为2-D到3-D的水下视觉系统提供统一且轻量的解决方案。

title: An Optimization Framework for Denoising Generation
summary: Noise-unconditioned denoising learns a single score, so generation can be viewed as gradient ascent on a fixed log-density landscape. This optimization interpretation leaves two questions: do trajectories approach meaningful data, and do different initializations retain diverse outcomes? We establish both phenomena for empirical and population multi-scale Gaussian-mixture objectives. Under explicit posterior and landscape conditions, ascent converges almost surely within $O(mσ_{\min}^2/τ)$ of an $m$-dimensional reference manifold with reach at least $τ$. We derive a source--sink identity for the same fixed field and use it to prove finite-resolution regional coverage. In an affine construction, we further identify a positive-bandwidth regime where even empirical-score optimization can avoid training-sample memorization while preserving diversity at the training resolution. The same fixed objective naturally supports penalty-guided controllable generation. Experiments support our predicted mechanisms, show improved robustness under large-step guidance, and demonstrate downstream gains consistent with finite-data generative generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文为"噪声无关去噪"(单一固定得分场)的生成过程提供理论刻画：梯度上升轨迹既收敛到有意义的数据流形附近，又能在不同初始化下保持多样性，并给出有限分辨率区域覆盖与避免记忆训练样本的条件。
AI.motivation: 噪声无关去噪只学习单一得分，生成等价于在固定对数密度景观上做梯度上升。这种优化视角下有两个未解问题：轨迹是否真的逼近有意义的数据？不同初始化是否仍保持多样结果？作者希望从理论上同时确立这两点。
AI.method: 针对经验与总体两种多尺度高斯混合目标，在显式后验与景观条件下证明上升以概率1收敛到某个m维参考流形的 O(mσ_min²/τ) 邻域(该流形reach至少为τ)；对同一固定场导出源–汇(source–sink)恒等式，用以证明有限分辨率下的区域覆盖；构造仿射实例，识别出正带宽区间，使经验得分优化在训练分辨率下既避免记忆训练样本又保持多样性；同一固定目标天然支持惩罚引导的可控生成。
AI.result: 理论上同时给出收敛到参考流形与多样初始化的保证，以及有限分辨率区域覆盖结论；仿射构造中刻画了防记忆且保持多样性的正带宽机制。实验验证了所预测机制，显示在大步长引导下鲁棒性更好，并观察到与有限数据生成泛化一致的下游收益。
AI.conclusion: 固定(噪声无关)得分场的梯度上升兼具趋近数据流形与保持多样性两种性质，可在正带宽机制下避免样本记忆，并支持惩罚引导的可控生成，为单得分生成模型的可用性提供了理论与实验依据。

title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference, but its optimal configuration depends jointly on workload characteristics, GPU hardware, and available memory. For example, on the RTX~5090, the state-of-the-art speculative drafter DFlash achieves $3.50\times$ the throughput of autoregressive (AR) decoding at low concurrency, but only $0.76\times$ at high concurrency with short outputs. We present SpecSearch, a hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length, and precision across workload--GPU pairs. Its analytical cost model captures memory and compute constraints to identify feasible configurations and narrow the search space for throughput optimization. Guided by this model, calibration measurements are collected from multiple GPUs. Using the measurements, a Jev-based predictor learns to select high-throughput decoding configurations on held-out GPUs without requiring deployment-GPU calibration. The predictor is parameter-efficiently trained on calibration data, while adapting a frozen Qwen3-4B using LoRA adapters and a linear correction layer. Across NVIDIA RTX~5090, H100, L40 and AMD MI300X GPUs, SpecSearch with full calibration achieves an average of $2.01\times$ the throughput of AR and $1.36\times$ the throughput of SD, both served by vLLM. The proposed Jev-based predictor closely matches this search performance with $1.30\times$ throughput improvement over SD with vLLM, while eliminating the need for held-out GPU calibration. Additionally, it retains $97.36\%$ of the throughput achieved by SpecSearch that utilizes full calibration.

AI.tldr: SpecSearch 是一个硬件感知的搜索引擎，联合优化解码策略、草稿长度和精度，以提升 LLM 推理吞吐；其 Jev 预测器可在未见 GPU 上免校准地选择高性能配置。
AI.motivation: 投机解码（SD）的最优配置同时取决于负载特征、GPU 硬件和可用内存，例如 DFlash 在 RTX 5090 低并发下达自回归 3.50 倍吞吐，但高并发短输出时仅 0.76 倍，说明需要按工作负载-GPU 对进行自适应配置搜索。
AI.method: 提出 SpecSearch：用解析代价模型刻画内存与计算约束，识别可行配置并缩小搜索空间；基于该模型在多个 GPU 上采集校准测量；用基于 Jev 的预测器学习选择高吞吐配置，以 LoRA 适配器加线性校正层对冻结的 Qwen3-4B 做参数高效训练，从而无需在部署 GPU 上校准。
AI.result: 在 RTX 5090、H100、L40 和 AMD MI300X 上，完整校准的 SpecSearch 平均吞吐为 AR 的 2.01 倍、vLLM SD 的 1.36 倍；Jev 预测器达到 vLLM SD 的 1.30 倍，并保留完整校准方案 97.36% 的吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的联合配置搜索可显著提升 LLM 推理吞吐，且基于解析模型的预测器能在未见 GPU 上泛化，消除部署端校准成本，同时保持接近最优的搜索效果。

title: Compact and Decodable Electrocardiogram Text for Large Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Preprint of a chapter submitted to "Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: Methods, Systems, and Applications" (Karabük University Press). Code: https://github.com/ekabullar/-ecg26c-llm
summary: When a twelve-lead electrocardiogram is written as text for a large language model, the number of tokens has to be balanced against the information lost through compression. This paper presents a deterministic encoding that writes eight independent leads as amplitude letters and exact time gaps and recovers the remaining four limb leads algebraically. The key points are selected with a cardiac-cycle-dependent tolerance, the amplitudes are parameterized by a 26-letter logarithmic codebook learned from a training set, and a 10-step tolerance schedule keeps all records within a fixed token budget. The encoding was applied to 21,388 records from the public PTB-XL database and evaluated using an exact decode-and-re-encode round trip, waveform reconstruction error, and a paired comparison of convolutional classifiers trained with 5 different seeds on signals from the original and decoded databases. All records were contained in 4,080 tokens (average: 2,866 tokens, 64.3% fewer than a per-sample transcription), and all stored lead strings were exactly reproduced. The average correlation between the decoded and reference signals was 0.982. The macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.9167 for the reference signals and 0.9157 for the decoded signals (paired difference -0.0010; 95% patient-level bootstrap interval, -0.0028 to 0.0007), within the pre-specified non-inferiority margin of -0.010; this is not a confirmatory result, because the test fold had been used during encoder development. The diagnostic content of a compact text can therefore be preserved, while the language model's ability to read the text is yet another matter.

AI.tldr: 提出一种确定性心电图文本编码：将8个独立导联编码为幅值字母+精确时间间隔，其余4个肢体导联代数恢复，在4080 token内压缩21,388条PTB-XL记录且诊断性能不劣于原始信号。
AI.motivation: 将十二导联心电图写成文本输入大语言模型时，token数量与压缩造成的信息损失需要权衡。目标是在固定token预算下保留诊断信息。
AI.method: 8个独立导联写成幅值字母与精确时间缺口，4个肢体导联由代数关系精确恢复；关键点按心动周期相关容差选取；幅值用训练集学习的26字母对数码本参数化；10步容差调度保证所有记录在固定token预算内。在PTB-XL的21,388条记录上评估：精确解码-重编码往返、波形重建误差，以及5个随机种子训练的卷积分类器的配对比较。
AI.result: 所有记录均在4,080 token内（平均2,866，较逐样本转录减少64.3%），存储导联串完全精确复现；解码与参考信号平均相关0.982；宏平均AUC为参考0.9167、解码0.9157（配对差-0.0010，95%患者级bootstrap区间-0.0028至0.0007），在预设非劣性界值-0.010内；但因编码器开发阶段已使用测试折，该结果不属确证性结论。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑文本编码可保留心电图的诊断内容，但语言模型能否读取该文本则是另一问题，需要进一步验证。

title: CoSphere-SLAM: Multi-Agent Panoramic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Spherical Loop Closure
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project website: https://cosphere-slam.github.io
summary: Dense collaborative mapping is essential for search and rescue, building inspection, and warehouse automation, where panoramic cameras capture the entire surroundings in a single frame. Unlike pinhole agents that share views only at similar headings, panoramic agents observe overlapping scenes at any 3D orientation, yet searching full rotations also produces mutually consistent false loop closures across distinct symmetric rooms. Moreover, continuous monocular scale drift splits rigidly merged maps at revisited surfaces, while depth noise at short baselines distorts loop translation directions. To address these challenges, we propose CoSphere-SLAM, the first multi-agent Gaussian splatting SLAM framework for panoramic cameras, whose spherical loop closure aligns spherical features over $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ via fast Fourier correlation across arbitrary orientations and rejects symmetric false closures through global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ consensus. Building on these closures, directional global optimization solves a per-keyframe $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ pose graph with log-scale regularization to correct scale drift while separating optical-flow translation directions from depth-based magnitudes. Finally, omnidirectional Gaussian fusion transforms each Gaussian with its keyframe similarity and renders Gaussians at their maximum ray response to jointly refine poses and maps. Experiments on indoor and cross-session multi-agent panoramic benchmarks demonstrate that CoSphere-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art trajectory accuracy and rendering quality among single-agent and multi-agent methods. Project website: https://cosphere-slam.github.io.

AI.tldr: CoSphere-SLAM是首个面向全景相机的多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM框架，通过SO(3)球面回环与Sim(3)全局优化解决对称房间误回环、尺度漂移和深度噪声问题，在室内及跨会话多智能体基准上取得SOTA轨迹与渲染精度。
AI.motivation: 全景相机单帧即可覆盖全场景，适合搜救、巡检与仓储自动化的密集协同建图。但全景智能体可在任意3D朝向观察到重叠场景，全旋转搜索会产生跨对称房间的相互一致假回环；同时单目连续尺度漂移会使重访表面处刚性合并的地图断裂，短基线下的深度噪声又会扭曲回环平移方向。
AI.method: 1) 球面回环：通过快速傅里叶相关在SO(3)上对球面特征做任意朝向对齐，并用全局Sim(3)一致性拒绝对称假回环；2) 方向性全局优化：对每关键帧构建Sim(3)位姿图，加入对数尺度正则修正尺度漂移，并将光流平移方向与基于深度的幅值分离；3) 全向高斯融合：按关键帧相似度变换高斯，在最大射线响应处渲染，联合优化位姿与地图。
AI.result: 在室内与跨会话多智能体全景基准实验中，CoSphere-SLAM在单智能体与多智能体方法中均取得最优的轨迹精度与渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将全景相机与高斯泼溅SLAM结合于多智能体协同建图，验证了SO(3)球面回环、Sim(3)方向性优化与全向高斯融合的有效性。

title: Sample-efficient Personalization of Large Language Model Alignment with Multidimensional User Preference Data
summary: Preference alignment has become a central tool to align large language models (LLMs) with human values and desired behavior, and its online variant can further advance their capabilities beyond what static data alone offer by repeatedly generating and labeling new responses with human feedback. But costly, time-consuming annotations limit its scalability, making sample efficiency essential, and existing methods typically seek to improve it by expanding coverage of the response space or selecting pairs with the highest uncertainty for comparison. Although they are effective, these methods quantify uncertainty from the perspective of the LLM, which may differ from the uncertainty perceived by the user: a pair can appear highly uncertain to the LLM even when past comparisons from the user already imply a clear ordering. In this paper, we propose multidimensional preference-guided online direct preference optimization (MPG-DPO), which leverages low-cost multidimensional evaluations from automated verifiers on the user historical comparisons to construct a personalized preference cone guiding response selection for online preference alignment. Specifically, it first discards responses that are confidently dominated under the estimated user preference, then selects two responses that are competitive under the retained preference cone yet exhibit the strongest unresolved disagreement. Theoretical analysis shows that, with high probability, the fraction of queries spent on cone-dominated responses vanishes as learning progresses. Experiments across multiple LLM families show that MPG-DPO outperforms strong contenders under matched query budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 MPG-DPO，用多维偏好锥指导在线偏好对齐中的样本选择，提高查询效率。
AI.motivation: 在线偏好对齐需反复生成并标注响应，标注成本高，因此样本效率关键。现有方法通过扩大响应空间覆盖或选择LLM视角下不确定性最高的响应对来提升效率，但这种不确定性可能与用户感知不一致：某些响应对对LLM看似高度不确定，但用户的历史比较已隐含明确排序。
AI.method: MPG-DPO 利用自动验证器对用户历史比较进行低成本多维评估，构建个性化偏好锥来指导响应选择。具体先丢弃在估计偏好下被明确支配的响应，再在保留的偏好锥内选择两个具竞争力但在偏好锥上存在最强未解决分歧的响应进行在线DPO对齐。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，随着学习推进，用于锥支配响应的查询比例以高概率趋于零。在多个LLM系列上的实验显示，在相同查询预算下 MPG-DPO 优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 从用户视角而非LLM视角量化不确定性，并借助多维偏好锥进行响应选择，可显著提升在线偏好对齐的样本效率。

title: Streaming On-Policy Distillation: Decoupling Three Clocks for Stage-Wise Supervision Consumption
summary: In on-policy distillation (OPD), response completion, supervision delivery, and parameter updates need not share the same granularity. We develop streaming OPD by decoupling these three clocks: a response repeatedly delivers newly generated segments while generation continues, retaining the full causal prefix at each delivery and computing loss only on new positions. A consumption protocol then organizes supervision budgets, position selection, staleness handling, and update scheduling, allowing control over quantity, coverage, and version lag across training stages. In GSM8K experiments distilling Qwen3-4B into Qwen3-0.6B with VERL, supervised-budget matching reduces the early gap between best test accuracies over seven common candidates from 4.55 to 2.42 points. Synchronous continuation from the same checkpoint reaches 73.39% best test accuracy over seven common candidates at u=384,...,576, versus 74.30% synchronous and 71.95% budget-matched (differences -0.91 and -2.35 points); an unpaired extended record reaches 76.12%. Freshness filtering and disagreement-overlap selection improve local peaks but do not establish sustained advantages. A system prototype shows lower data-supply waiting times without establishing an equal-update speedup. Quality recovery and supply-side benefits are assessed separately; end-to-end gains must account for continuation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"流式在线策略蒸馏"(streaming OPD)，将响应生成、监督交付与参数更新三种时钟解耦，并设计消费协议管理监督预算、位置选择、陈旧度与更新调度，在GSM8K上验证其效果与局限。
AI.motivation: 在on-policy distillation中，响应补全、监督信号交付与参数更新通常被绑定在同一粒度上，限制了训练灵活性与数据供给效率；作者希望解耦三者，从而在数量、覆盖范围与版本延迟上实现分阶段可控。
AI.method: 将三种时钟（响应生成、监督交付、参数更新）解耦：生成过程中反复交付新生成片段，每次交付保留完整因果前缀、仅在新位置上计算损失；并设计消费协议，组织监督预算、位置选择、陈旧度处理与更新调度。实验用VERL将Qwen3-4B蒸馏到Qwen3-0.6B，在GSM8K上评测，与同步训练及预算匹配方案对比，并分析新鲜度过滤、分歧重叠选择及系统原型的表现。
AI.result: 监督预算匹配将七个候选中最优测试准确率的早期差距从4.55降至2.42点；同检查点同步续训在u=384,...,576时达73.39%，对比同步74.30%（-0.91）与预算匹配71.95%（-2.35），非配对延长记录达76.12%。新鲜度过滤与分歧重叠选择仅提升局部峰值，未形成持续优势；系统原型降低了数据供给等待时间，但未确立等更新次数下的加速。
AI.conclusion: 流式OPD在质量恢复与供给侧收益需分别评估，端到端收益必须计入续训成本；其局部改进不足以证明稳定的整体优势，仍需进一步验证。

title: Cross3DGS: Unified Vulkan-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting Training from Workstations to Mobile Devices
comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027 Workshop on Eyes of the Future (EOF). 19 pages including appendix
summary: Scenes captured with handheld and wearable cameras are still shipped to a CUDA workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) training. Training on the device that captured them, or on its companion phone or laptop, requires more than translating kernels: GPUs and drivers differ in parallel features, memory limits, and command submission, and these differences decide whether a training schedule executes and returns the correct update. We present Cross3DGS, a cross-vendor, cross-platform Vulkan trainer that keeps one optimizer and chooses its execution schedule per device in two steps: rules on device limits, workload size, and observed driver failures exclude the schedules known not to run correctly, and a fixed preference order selects one of the remaining feasible schedules. The same core completes standard-quality training (30k updates, one million Gaussians) on every configuration we measured, spanning NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD, and Apple GPUs and including Android devices and an iPhone, whereas the existing portable trainers VkSplat and Brush do not run on some of the mobile GPUs. Averaged over 11 scenes on a workstation, Cross3DGS has higher quality than VkSplat with no significant difference in training time, and Brush reports about three times the training time at comparable quality. The final quality of Cross3DGS is nearly identical across devices. A mobile application turns a handheld capture into a viewable model entirely on the device.

AI.tldr: 提出跨厂商、跨平台的Vulkan 3DGS训练器Cross3DGS，通过规则过滤+固定偏好顺序为每类设备选择可正确执行的训练调度，使单一优化器在NVIDIA/Intel/Arm/Qualcomm/AMD/Apple GPU（含Android与iPhone）上完成标准训练，移动端可全流程端上建模。
AI.motivation: 手持/可穿戴设备采集的场景仍要传到CUDA工作站做3DGS训练。设备端训练不只是内核移植问题：各GPU与驱动在并行特性、内存限制、命令提交方式上存在差异，这些差异直接决定训练调度能否正确执行并给出正确更新。
AI.method: Vulkan跨厂商跨平台训练器，保持单一优化器；按设备分两步选择执行调度：(1) 基于设备限制、工作负载规模和观测到的驱动失败的规则，排除已知无法正确运行的调度；(2) 在剩余可行调度中按固定偏好顺序选取。
AI.result: 在所有实测配置上完成标准质量训练（30k次更新、100万高斯），覆盖NVIDIA、Intel、Arm、Qualcomm、AMD、Apple GPU，含Android设备与iPhone；而VkSplat和Brush在部分移动GPU上无法运行。工作站11个场景平均：质量优于VkSplat且训练时间无显著差异，Brush在相当质量下训练时间约为其三倍。跨设备最终质量近乎一致。
AI.conclusion: 跨设备可移植的3DGS训练在统一优化器+设备自适应调度选择下可行，且质量跨设备稳定；并实现将手持采集直接在设备上转为可查看模型的移动应用。

title: Communicate the Change: Efficient Expert Parallelism via Activation Compression
summary: Scaling has driven the success of large language models (LLM), with sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures enabling greater parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation. At large scales, MoE models rely on expert parallelism to distribute experts across devices. Each MoE layer requires two synchronous collective communication steps during inference: dispatching hidden states to the activated experts and combining the resulting expert outputs. As compute throughput has outpaced interconnect bandwidth, these synchronous collectives have become a major bottleneck to MoE scaling and efficiency. We address this challenge with EchoMoE, a lightweight architecture modification that retrofits existing MoE models, requiring approximately 8,500x fewer training tokens than full pretraining. Motivated by the observation that transformer blocks update the residual stream incrementally, we use a hidden state from an earlier layer as a reference and communicate only the compressed difference between it and the current state, rather than communicating each hidden state in full. EchoMoE periodically refreshes these reference states and transmits only the compressed differences synchronously, reducing the traffic on latency-critical paths without significant computational overhead. EchoMoE reduces inter-node communication volume by 58% and improves throughput by 22.6%, while preserving average performance within 3.8 percentage points across 18 benchmarks. EchoMoE further improves inference throughput by up to 2.38x over bandwidth-constrained Ethernet, paving the way for wide-area distributed inference. EchoMoE also tolerates quantization of the communicated representations without measurable quality loss. We release an efficient implementation for applying EchoMoE to pretrained MoE models, together with an inference integration for vLLM.

AI.tldr: EchoMoE 通过只传输隐藏状态与早期层参考状态之间的压缩差分量，减少 MoE 专家并行推理中两次同步通信的瓶颈，在 18 个基准上平均性能下降 3.8 个百分点以内的情况下，降低 58% 跨节点通信量并提升 22.6% 吞吐。
AI.motivation: 大规模 MoE 模型依赖专家并行，每层推理需两次同步集合通信（dispatch 与 combine）。由于算力增长快于互联带宽，这些同步通信已成为 MoE 扩展与效率的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 EchoMoE：一种轻量架构改造，可对现有 MoE 模型进行改造，所需训练 token 比完整预训练少约 8500 倍。基于 transformer 块对残差流进行增量更新的观察，使用早期层的隐藏状态作为参考，仅通信其与当前状态间的压缩差值，而非完整隐藏状态；周期性刷新参考状态，仅同步传输压缩差分，计算开销小。
AI.result: 跨节点通信量减少 58%，吞吐提升 22.6%，18 个基准平均性能保持在 3.8 个百分点以内；在带宽受限以太网上推理吞吐最高提升 2.38 倍；对传输表示量化具有容忍度且无明显质量损失；发布了高效实现及 vLLM 推理集成。
AI.conclusion: EchoMoE 以低训练成本和低计算开销有效缓解 MoE 推理通信瓶颈，为广域分布式推理铺路，并提供开源实现与 vLLM 集成。

title: Harnesses That Improve Themselves: A Unifying Framework for Self-Improving Agent Harnesses
summary: Whether a foundation model succeeds as an autonomous agent depends as much on its runtime software as on its weights. This runtime, the agent harness, manages context and memory, steers multi-turn control, executes tool actions in sandboxes, and verifies work before stopping. Because models differ in how they use tools and how they fail, a static harness tuned for one model or task often stalls, wastes tokens, or regresses on another. This bottleneck has driven a shift from prompt tuning to self-improving agent harnesses: systems that inspect their own execution traces, separate runtime bugs from model limits, and rewrite their own code. We present a unifying architectural and design framework for self-improving agent harnesses. The framework pairs four editable runtime components (context and state, agent control, action interfaces, and verification and recovery) with a four-stage loop that diagnoses failures, proposes code patches, validates candidates, and deploys updates. Using this framework, we show how optimizers trace errors across long trajectories and discover reusable runtime mechanisms such as pre-stop verifiers, loop breakers, and persistent memory. We further show why full-harness rewrites overfit or break across modules, and how modular updates with validation gates generalize across models while bounding token cost. To keep self-modification safe, we establish practical defenses against recurring failure modes including prompt bloat, benchmark gaming, and evaluator tampering. Finally, experiments on SWE-bench Lite validate this framework, showing that gated modular evolution outperforms prompt reflection and full-harness rewrites across models and repositories at a fraction of the token cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将自改进型智能体运行时（agent harness）划分为四个可编辑组件，并通过"诊断—打补丁—验证—部署"四阶段循环实现自我进化；在 SWE-bench Lite 上验证门控式模块化演进优于提示反思和整体重写，且 token 成本更低。
AI.motivation: 基础模型能否成为自主智能体，不仅取决于权重，也取决于其运行时软件（harness），包括上下文/记忆管理、多轮控制、沙箱工具执行与停止前验证。由于不同模型在使用工具和失败方式上存在差异，为单一模型或任务调好的静态 harness 往往在其他场景下停滞、浪费 token 甚至性能退化。这一瓶颈促使研究从提示调优转向可自我改进的 harness。
AI.method: 提出统一的架构与设计框架：一方面包含四个可编辑运行时组件（上下文与状态、智能体控制、动作接口、验证与恢复）；另一方面包含四阶段循环（诊断失败、提出代码补丁、验证候选、部署更新）。基于该框架，优化器可跨长轨迹追踪错误，并发现可复用的运行时机制（如停止前验证器、循环中断器、持久记忆）；同时采用带验证门控的模块化更新，并建立针对提示膨胀、基准游戏化和评估器篡改等失败模式的防御措施。
AI.result: 框架分析表明：整体式 harness 重写容易过拟合或在模块间互相破坏；而带验证门控的模块化更新可在不同模型间泛化并约束 token 成本。SWE-bench Lite 实验验证了该框架：门控式模块化演进在多个模型和代码库上优于提示反思与整体重写，且仅需一小部分 token 成本。
AI.conclusion: 自改进智能体 harness 应围绕可编辑组件与分阶段进化循环来设计，并采用模块化、带验证门控的更新策略以兼顾泛化性与成本；同时需配套安全防御以约束自我修改带来的风险。

title: When Do Typed Decision Models Work in Transportation? Evidence from Travel Choice and Traffic Signal Control
summary: Typed decision models combine natural-language understanding with a structured interface that returns a selected action and an option-level probability distribution without generating lengthy textual responses. Their low inference cost and response latency make them attractive for transportation problems with predefined alternatives. This paper investigates their effectiveness, robustness, and efficiency in two representative transportation tasks: individual travel-mode choice prediction and sequential traffic signal control. We systematically evaluate TypeSafe Jev and GPT-6 Luna Decisions against conventional transportation methods, reinforcement learning algorithms, and four chat-based large language models. Experiments on the Swissmetro dataset show that typed decision models achieve lower prediction accuracy than traditional discrete choice models and the strongest chat-based baseline, while their performance varies substantially with input representation and question framing. In closed-loop traffic signal control experiments, typed decision models demonstrate competitive performance against established controllers in several scenarios, but exhibit performance degradation under more challenging network conditions. Furthermore, the typed models achieve lower inference latency and computational cost than the evaluated chat-based large language models, highlighting their potential for efficient, zero-shot transportation decision-making. Overall, these findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of typed decision models, emphasizing the importance of input design, task characteristics, and robustness evaluation for their effective application in transportation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文评估"类型化决策模型"（如TypeSafe Jev、GPT-6 Luna Decisions）在两种交通任务中的效果、鲁棒性与效率，发现其推理延迟低但精度与鲁棒性存在局限。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型只返回选定动作与选项级概率分布、不生成冗长文本，推理成本与延迟低，适合有预定义选项的交通决策问题；但其实际有效性、鲁棒性和效率尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 在两类代表性任务上系统对比：个体出行方式选择预测（Swissmetro数据集）与闭环交通信号控制。基线包括传统交通方法（离散选择模型）、强化学习算法以及四个对话式大语言模型；同时考察输入表示与问题框架的影响。
AI.result: Swissmetro上，类型化模型的预测精度低于传统离散选择模型和最强的对话式基线，且性能随输入表示和问题表述显著变化；闭环信号控制中在部分场景可与成熟控制器竞争，但在更具挑战的网络条件下性能下降；推理延迟与计算成本低于所评估的对话式大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策模型具备高效零样本交通决策的潜力，但也存在明显局限；其有效应用依赖于输入设计、任务特性以及对鲁棒性的充分评估。

title: PhyVGGT: Feed-Forward Articulated Object Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://phyvggt.github.io
summary: Reconstructing an articulated object with its 3D movable parts, joint parameters and unseen articulation states from an uncalibrated monocular video is essential for robot manipulation and interactive digital twins. Existing per-scene optimisation methods require minutes to hours and external depth or camera poses, whereas feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct dense point maps in one pass without segmenting movable parts or inferring joints. Even on these monocular point maps, regressing or fitting continuous joints directly fails on casual videos, since cross-frame attention blurs moving part boundaries in deep layers, underestimates motion along the viewing ray and leaves continuous axes ill-conditioned under small opening angles. To address these challenges, we propose PhyVGGT, a single-pass framework on a frozen 3D foundation model that anchors moving-part matching and closed-form joint estimation to the undistorted geometry of the stationary base. First, our Part and Motion Decoder fuses intermediate per-frame tokens with global tokens and references part queries to a static-base query to segment 3D parts, align point maps on the static base and predict learned Bingham priors. Second, our Kinematic Inference Layer fits an orthogonal Manhattan frame to static surface normals, selects the joint axis in closed form under a Bingham posterior combining pairwise motion scatter with the learned priors, and solves a linear system for the hinge pivot to drive unseen states. Trained solely on synthetic data, PhyVGGT achieves state-of-the-art monocular performance across five benchmarks, outperforming FAMOS and monocular ArtiPoint, surpassing posed RGB-D ArtiPoint in median error, and running in 6.8 s per 48-frame video against hours of per-scene optimisation in Articulat3D. Project page: https://phyvggt.github.io.

AI.tldr: PhyVGGT 是一个基于冻结 3D 基础模型的单次前向框架，可从无标定单目视频中重建铰接物体的可动部件、关节参数与未见铰接状态，仅用合成数据训练即在五个基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从无标定单目视频重建带 3D 可动部件、关节参数及未见铰接状态的铰接物体，对机器人操作与交互式数字孪生至关重要。现有逐场景优化方法需数分钟到数小时且依赖外部深度或相机位姿；前馈 3D 基础模型虽能一次重建稠密点图，却不分割可动部件、不推断关节。即使在这些单目点图上，直接回归或拟合连续关节在随手拍视频上也会失败：深层跨帧注意力模糊运动部件边界、沿视线方向运动被低估、小开合角下连续轴病态。
AI.method: 提出 PhyVGGT，在冻结 3D 基础模型上的单次前向框架，将可动部件匹配与闭式关节估计锚定到静止基座的未失真几何。其一，Part and Motion Decoder 融合逐帧中间 token 与全局 token，并以静态基座查询为参照约束部件查询，实现 3D 部件分割、在静态基座上对齐点图并预测学习到的 Bingham 先验。其二，Kinematic Inference Layer 对静态表面法向拟合正交 Manhattan 框架，在结合成对运动散射与学习先验的 Bingham 后验下闭式选取关节轴，并解线性系统求铰链枢轴以驱动未见状态。
AI.result: 仅在合成数据上训练，PhyVGGT 在五个基准上取得单目 SOTA：优于 FAMOS 与单目 ArtiPoint，中位误差超过已标定 RGB-D 的 ArtiPoint；48 帧视频推理仅 6.8 秒，而 Articulat3D 逐场景优化需数小时。
AI.conclusion: PhyVGGT 以单次前向、冻结基础模型加闭式几何推理的方式，解决了随手拍单目视频中铰接物体重建的鲁棒性与效率问题，在精度和速度上均显著优于现有单目及逐场景优化方法，具备机器人与数字孪生应用潜力。

title: Learning Optimal Transport Plans Via Autoregressive Token Regression
summary: Optimal Transport (OT) provides a principled framework for finding the minimum cost coupling between probability distributions. Classical solvers remain the gold standard for this task. At the same time, OT is an ideal testbed for studying whether learning-based amortized models can internalize the structure of OT type problems. Here, ground-truth solutions are available and marginal constraints are explicitly defined. Also, exact discrete solutions have well-characterized sparsity. We describe ToR-OT, a transformer-based model that learns to predict discrete OT plans through autoregressive token regression. We reframe OT into a structured sequence generation task. ToR-OT decodes sparse transport plans as sequences instead of solving an optimization task at test time. We focus on three properties: (a) Zero-shot generalization: pretraining on a large synthetic corpus of OT instances allows a single model to generalize to unseen distribution pairs and heterogeneous cost metrics without retraining, (b) Sparse primal decoding: by exploiting the inherent sparsity in exact discrete OT solutions, the decoder predicts only nonzero entries (avoids dense coupling outputs), (c) Amortized inference: on low-dimensional discrete problems, ToR-OT gives accurate approximate plans and compares favorably with per-instance neural OT baselines. Overall, ToR-OT is not yet a replacement for classical solvers, but a step toward understanding how autoregressive transformers can learn structure of constrained optimization problems like OT.

AI.tldr: 提出ToR-OT，将离散最优传输(OT)问题重构为结构化序列生成任务，用自回归Transformer直接解码稀疏传输方案，实现零样本泛化与摊销推理。
AI.motivation: 经典OT求解器仍是金标准，但OT是研究学习型摊销模型能否内化约束优化问题结构的理想试验台：真值可得、边际约束明确、精确离散解具有良好刻画的稀疏性。
AI.method: ToR-OT是一个基于Transformer的模型，通过自回归token回归学习预测离散OT方案。它将OT重构为结构化序列生成任务，测试时以序列形式解码稀疏传输方案（仅预测非零项），而非求解优化问题。在大规模合成OT实例语料上预训练。
AI.result: 聚焦三方面：(a)零样本泛化——单一模型可泛化到未见分布对及异质代价度量而无需重训；(b)稀疏原始解码——利用精确离散解的稀疏性只预测非零项，避免稠密耦合输出；(c)摊销推理——在低维离散问题上给出准确近似方案，并与逐实例神经OT基线相比具有优势。
AI.conclusion: ToR-OT尚不能替代经典求解器，但是理解自回归Transformer如何学习OT等约束优化问题结构的一步。

title: MCTS Is Counting the Wrong Thing: Learning Exploration Counts for LLM Reasoning
summary: Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) has powered landmark successes in reinforcement learning, yet its gains in LLM reasoning can remain modest despite substantial search effort. We identify an overlooked bottleneck: what MCTS counts. Standard UCT assigns independent visit counts to textual branches, allowing different formulations of the same reasoning strategy to repeatedly receive exploration bonuses. Our theoretical analysis shows that this count fragmentation can impair exploration efficiency, as quantified by increased cumulative regret. To address this problem, we introduce Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS (LPC-MCTS), which changes only the exploration statistic in UCT. A lightweight Coin-Flipping Network head on the policy's hidden representations estimates representation coverage, enabling related branches to share exploration evidence. Across 5 mathematical-reasoning and 7 search benchmarks, LPC-MCTS consistently outperforms strong MCTS baselines. Holding each LPC-MCTS-trained policy fixed, replacing standard MCTS counts at inference improves average mean@16 accuracy across 5 mathematical benchmarks by 3.79 percentage points on Qwen2.5-7B and 2.71 points on Qwen3-4B. Applying LPC-MCTS during both training and inference yields gains of 4.96 and 4.37 points over standard MCTS, respectively. Together, our theory and experiments show that changing what MCTS counts can substantially improve its exploration efficiency and reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: MCTS在LLM推理中收益有限，瓶颈在于"计数什么"：标准UCT对文本分支独立计数导致同一推理策略的多种表述重复获得探索奖励。作者提出LPC-MCTS，仅改UCT的探索统计量，用Coin-Flipping Network从策略隐表示估计表征覆盖，使相关分支共享探索证据；理论与实验表明可提升探索效率与推理性能。
AI.motivation: MCTS虽在强化学习中有里程碑式成功，但在LLM推理中即使投入大量搜索也收益有限。作者指出被忽视的瓶颈是MCTS"计数什么"：标准UCT给文本分支分配相互独立的访问计数，使同一推理策略的不同表述反复获得探索奖励，造成计数碎片化。理论分析表明这种碎片化会加剧累积遗憾、损害探索效率。
AI.method: 提出Learned Pseudo-Count MCTS（LPC-MCTS），只修改UCT中的探索统计项。具体做法是在策略网络的隐表示上附加一个轻量级Coin-Flipping Network头，估计表征覆盖度，从而生成伪计数，让语义相关的分支共享探索证据。
AI.result: 在5个数学推理与7个搜索基准上，LPC-MCTS一致优于强MCTS基线。固定LPC-MCTS训练的策略，仅将推理阶段的计数替换为LPC计数，5个数学基准上mean@16平均提升3.79个百分点（Qwen2.5-7B）和2.71个百分点（Qwen3-4B）；训练与推理均使用LPC-MCTS时，相对标准MCTS分别提升4.96和4.37个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实验共同表明，改变MCTS"计数什么"即可显著提升探索效率与推理表现；表征级伪计数共享是一种轻量且有效的改进方向。

title: The Shared Word: Evaluating Language Models on Dutch Word Puzzles
summary: Many LLM benchmarks for languages other than English are translated, multiple-choice, or difficult to score automatically. We introduce The Shared Word (TSW-NL), a Dutch benchmark built around four core principles: it is language-specific, open-vocabulary, human-curated, and deterministically scored. Each puzzle gives three clues that describe different senses or uses of the same Dutch word. The clues are individually ambiguous, requiring the solver to combine evidence across multiple clues. We construct the benchmark from Dutch Wikipedia disambiguation pages, followed by automatic filtering and extensive manual curation. The final dataset contains 222 instances, with three independent human answers per test item. The task is clearly challenging: scores in our human study range from 49.5% to 61.0% and the highest-scoring open-weight model we tested reaches only 39.3%. Many others even score below 20%. At the same time, closed-source models show great progress: GPT-4.1 (April 2025) scores 59.2%, whereas GPT-5.6 Sol with max reasoning scores 88.8%. We believe this task provides a useful addition to Dutch model evaluation, plus a clear recipe that can be applied to construct a similar benchmark for other languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 The Shared Word (TSW-NL)，一个荷兰语基准，要求根据三条分别描述同一荷兰语单词不同义项或用法的线索猜出该词，具有语种特定、开放词表、人工精编和确定性评分四个特点。
AI.motivation: 现有非英语 LLM 基准多为翻译、选择题或难以自动评分；作者希望构建语言特定、可自动确定性评分且真正有挑战性的荷兰语评测集，并提供可复用到其他语言的构建范式。
AI.method: 从荷兰语维基百科消歧义页面构建数据，经自动过滤与大量人工精编，最终得到 222 个实例；每个测试项含三名独立人类作答。每个谜题给出三条单独看歧义较大、需综合多线索推断的提示，共同指向同一个荷兰语单词的不同义项或用法。
AI.result: 任务难度高：人类得分 49.5%–61.0%；测试中最高分开源权重模型仅 39.3%，许多模型低于 20%；闭源模型进展明显，GPT-4.1 (2025年4月) 得 59.2%，GPT-5.6 Sol (最大推理) 得 88.8%。
AI.conclusion: TSW-NL 为荷兰语模型评测提供有益补充，其构建方法可迁移到其他语言，用于建立类似基准。

title: Multispectral-Polarization-Infrared Multi-Aperture Camouflaged Vehicle Detection
summary: Camouflaged vehicle detection is challenging because camouflage suppresses discriminative cues across sensing modalities. Existing multimodal methods often require precise pixel-level registration and feature-level fusion, creating a trade-off between accuracy and latency. We propose a spectral-polarization-infrared tri-modal detection framework co-designed with a multi-aperture imaging setup to exploit complementary imaging physics. A consensus-guided decision-level fusion strategy combines cross-modal detections within bounded registration tolerances, reducing dependence on precise alignment while maintaining accuracy and real-time performance. We construct a tri-modal camouflaged vehicle dataset containing infrared, polarization, and spectral data. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves 82.7% mean Average Precision (mAP) with an end-to-end latency of 16 ms, outperforming representative feature-level fusion approaches. On the public MID-1K dataset, the framework generalizes to RGB-Depth-Infrared modalities without architectural modification and improves mAP@0.5 by 5.7% over state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate the potential of decision-level consensus fusion and multi-aperture sensing for robust and deployable camouflaged vehicle detection.

AI.tldr: 提出光谱-偏振-红外三模态检测框架，配合多孔径成像与共识引导的决策级融合，实现高精度、低延迟的伪装车辆检测。
AI.motivation: 伪装会抑制各传感模态的判别线索，而现有多模态方法依赖像素级精确配准和特征级融合，导致精度与延迟难以兼顾。
AI.method: 采用光谱、偏振、红外三模态，并设计多孔径成像装置利用互补成像物理特性；提出共识引导的决策级融合策略，在有限配准容差内融合跨模态检测结果，降低对精确对齐的依赖；并构建包含红外、偏振和光谱数据的三模态伪装车辆数据集。
AI.result: 自建数据集上达82.7% mAP，端到端延迟16 ms，优于代表性特征级融合方法；在公开MID-1K数据集上无需改动架构即可迁移至RGB-Depth-Infrared模态，mAP@0.5较SOTA提升5.7%。
AI.conclusion: 决策级共识融合与多孔径传感在伪装车辆检测中具备鲁棒性与可部署性潜力，并可跨模态泛化。

title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
summary: Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $Θ(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. Across 14 benchmarks from 5 benchmark families, the rank-1 adjustments range from approximately 0.09 to 3.86 percentage points. In our SWE-bench Verified snapshot, the tied leaders receive an adjustment of 0.90 percentage points. Such overstatement is large enough to make the apparent winner statistically fragile. Thus, we use the same bootstrap to further quantify the intervals of plausible rank positions for each model and group models into tiers. We establish sufficient conditions for consistent recovery of population tiers. On SWE-bench Verified, this procedure places 13 of 173 models in the leading tier. We combine the score adjustment and rank intervals in the Rank Uncertainty and Leaderboard Evaluation Report (RULER). We validate its finite-sample performance using sample splitting and calibrated simulations, and advocate publishing RULER alongside raw rankings so readers can assess both reported performance and the precision of the ordering. RULER also provides guidance for benchmark design that accounts for selection effects and ranking uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示公共LLM榜单中存在"赢家诅咒"与"排名诱导偏差"，提出m-out-of-N bootstrap方法校正排名偏差，并构建RULER报告同时给出校正后分数、排名置信区间与模型分层。
AI.motivation: LLM榜单被用于模型评估与选型，但排名靠前的模型因选取噪声分数而系统性高估真实能力（赢家诅咒），且同一选择效应会扭曲整个榜单（排名诱导偏差），现有报告未考虑这种排名不确定性。
AI.method: 提出m-out-of-N bootstrap校正方法，假设固定模型池、任务独立同分布有界，允许模型间任意任务内相关；在存在正间隔的精确总体分层下证明该方法将Θ(N^{-1/2})排名偏差降至期望残差o(N^{-1/2})；并用同一bootstrap量化每个模型合理排名区间、进行模型分层，给出分层一致恢复的充分条件，最终整合为RULER报告。
AI.result: 在5个基准族共14个基准上，排名第1的调整幅度约0.09–3.86个百分点；SWE-bench Verified快照中并列领先者被下调0.90个百分点，足以使表面赢家统计上不稳健。分层程序将173个模型中的13个归入领先层。通过样本拆分与校准模拟验证了有限样本表现。
AI.conclusion: 建议在发布原始排名的同时发布RULER，使读者能评估报告性能与排序精度；RULER还为考虑选择效应和排名不确定性的基准设计提供指导。

title: Learning to Edit IFC Building Models: Verifiable Checkers as the Training Signal for Dependency-Aware Editing Agents
summary: Editing a building information model in the Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) schema requires propagating changes to dependent elements while preserving unrelated entities. Existing language-model agents for IFC editing use prompted models without learning from edit outcomes. Target-file comparisons do not specify which alternative edits are allowed or which unrelated entities must remain unchanged. We present IfcGym, a CodeAct environment in which a language model edits IFC through executable code and four checkers verify validity relative to the input model, intent, dependency and preservation against a task specification. Their conjunction is strict success. IfcEdit distils verified teacher episodes into a Qwen3.5-9B student through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with strict success as the reward. On IfcEditBench, 1,990 editing tasks on 13 held-out real projects, the final student reaches 86.78% strict success, from 79.15% after SFT. The paired confidence interval for the difference from its teacher includes zero; the same recipe on a 27B model reaches 91.76% and exceeds the teacher. On the public benchmarks BIM-Edit and BIBIMBAP the final student scores 55.19 and 54.50. On IfcEditBench, the students outperform all prompted models except the teacher under matched tool access; both evaluated frameworks also score lower. Rewarding all four checkers yields 4.83 points more strict success than rewarding intent and validity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 IfcGym 代码执行环境与四项检查器（有效性/意图/依赖/保持），并用 SFT+GRPO 蒸馏训练小模型编辑 IFC 模型，9B 学生达 86.78% 严格成功率。
AI.motivation: 在 IFC 模式中编辑 BIM 模型需将改动传播到依赖元素、同时保留无关实体；现有语言模型智能体仅靠提示、不从编辑结果中学习，且目标文件对比无法界定允许的替代编辑与必须不变的元素。
AI.method: 构建 IfcGym（CodeAct 环境，模型通过可执行代码编辑 IFC，四个检查器联合构成“严格成功”）；IfcEdit 将已验证教师轨迹经 SFT 蒸馏进 Qwen3.5-9B 学生，再以严格成功为奖励做 GRPO。
AI.result: IfcEditBench（13 个留出真实项目、1,990 任务）：最终学生 86.78%（SFT 后 79.15%）；与教师差值的置信区间含零；同配方 27B 模型达 91.76% 并超过教师；公开基准 BIM-Edit 55.19、BIBIMBAP 54.50；匹配工具下优于所有提示模型（除教师）及两个对比框架；四项检查器全奖励比仅意图+有效性高 4.83 分。
AI.conclusion: 多检查器联合奖励的代码执行强化学习方法可让小模型在 IFC 编辑上逼近甚至超越教师模型，检查器设计对性能至关重要。

title: Can Decision Models Replace LLMs in Real-World Contact Center Classification and Judging Tasks?
summary: Contact center systems often need to make bounded decisions, such as identifying a caller's intent, retrieving the knowledge-base article that answers a query, assessing agent compliance, or judging the output of AI models used in production. Decision models return a typed answer and its probability directly, making them a promising cost-effective alternative to generative Large Language Models (LLMs) in such bounded conversational tasks. However, their effectiveness in real-world contact center applications remains unclear. In this paper, we compare nine decision models against thirteen generative LLMs in zero-shot settings across eight contact center use cases: six classification tasks and two judging tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that many decision models can match the performance of frontier LLMs on contact center classification, and API-based closed decision models achieve this at the lowest per-request cost among the API models we evaluate. We further observe that their confident predictions are more accurate, enabling selective routing in real-world production scenarios. Across classification tasks, the main weakness of most decision models is abstention: they rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of their gap to the strongest LLMs (although Gemini-Decision-1 is the notable exception in this regard). We also find that the judging quality of decision models drops sharply for smaller models, and they are also more prone to position bias. In short, our findings provide practical guidance for selecting decision models based on abstention behavior, confidence, and deployment cost, rather than overall accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 论文对比了9个决策模型与13个生成式LLM在8个客服场景（6个分类+2个判断）零样本设置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 客服系统常需做有界决策（识别意图、检索知识库文章、评估坐席合规、判断AI输出），决策模型直接返回带类型的答案及概率，可能比生成式LLM更经济高效，但其真实效果尚不明确。
AI.method: 在零样本设置下，将9个决策模型与13个生成式LLM在8个客服用例（6个分类任务、2个判断任务）上进行系统性对比，并分析每请求成本、置信度校准、弃答行为及位置偏差等维度。
AI.result: 许多决策模型在分类任务上可媲美前沿LLM；基于API的闭源决策模型在API模型中每请求成本最低；其高置信预测更准确，支持选择性路由。主要弱点是很少选择"无答案"选项（Gemini-Decision-1除外），这构成与最强LLM差距的主要来源；判断任务上小模型质量骤降且位置偏差更明显。
AI.conclusion: 选择决策模型应综合考量弃答行为、置信度与部署成本，而非仅看整体准确率，为客服场景的实际选型提供指导。

title: SARVIA: Fast-Adapting the Strong SAR Foundation Models That Are Already in Your MLLMs
summary: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) foundation models provide transferable representations for diverse perception tasks in all-weather Earth observation. However, their development often relies on costly large-scale SAR pretraining, raising the question of whether such extensive domain-specific pretraining is necessary. We find that modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) already provide visual encoders that can outperform dedicated SAR foundation models as downstream initializations. This motivates a new paradigm: reuse general visual capabilities and devote domain training to brief specialization. We therefore introduce SARVIA, an adaptive post-pretraining method that specializes modern MLLMs using self-supervised visual questions with computable answers. These questions are constructed from unlabeled observations through general image tasks that capture spatial relations and SAR-specific tasks that exploit native measurements and SAR--optical correspondence. A shared answer-prediction objective jointly trains low-rank adapters across visual and language components, with loss-driven task sampling. We then export the adapted visual encoder as a standalone backbone. With 600 adaptation steps and 2 GPU-hours, SARVIA outperforms the compared foundation models on all six SAR detection and segmentation benchmarks. Compared with dedicated SAR pretraining, SARVIA reduces domain-training costs by orders of magnitude while improving visual transfer across architectures and scales. This new paradigm shifts the emphasis from repeated, costly pretraining to a reusable specialization process that can benefit from advances in open MLLMs. Dataset and code: https://github.com/zcablii/SARVIA.

AI.tldr: 提出SARVIA，一种自适应后预训练方法：复用现代MLLM的视觉编码器，用自监督"可计算答案"的视觉问答任务进行短暂领域特化，仅600步/2 GPU小时即在六个SAR检测与分割基准上超越专用SAR基础模型。
AI.motivation: SAR基础模型通常依赖昂贵的大规模领域预训练。作者发现现代多模态大模型的视觉编码器本身已优于专用SAR基础模型作为下游初始化，因此质疑大规模SAR预训练的必要性，提出"复用通用视觉能力+短暂领域特化"的新范式。
AI.method: 从无标注观测构建带可计算答案的自监督视觉问题：通用图像任务捕捉空间关系，SAR特定任务利用原生测量与SAR-光学对应关系。以共享的答案预测目标联合训练视觉与语言部分的低秩适配器，并采用损失驱动的任务采样；最后导出适配后的视觉编码器作为独立骨干。
AI.result: 仅600步适配、2 GPU小时，SARVIA在全部六个SAR检测与分割基准上优于对比的基础模型；相比专用SAR预训练，领域训练成本降低数个数量级，并跨架构与规模提升视觉迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将重点从反复、昂贵的预训练转向可复用的特化流程，使SAR领域能力可持续受益于开放MLLM的进步；数据集与代码已开源。

title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
summary: Weight-space programming (WSP) lets a language model construct executable weight updates for another network. We study diffusion concept editing through an interface in which programs define training contexts, preservation constraints and update directions, while a shared numerical fitter selects their coefficients. We compare generated programs with published editors, a shared-panel hand-written baseline and budget-matched search over conventional edits on 24 TIMED test edits for Stable Diffusion 1.4. The preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over the strong baseline. In an exploratory comparison, one-shot Astra programs improve fresh-scene VLM joint success, which requires subject presence together with whole-image target matching, by +10.0 points over the shared-panel baseline, while CLIP relative match shows no detectable change. These programs organise adjustable directions around protected text-state subspaces. Probing and rewriting the Astra programs then raises CLIP by +6.2 points while joint success changes by -9.7. On a fixed 144-image sample, five additional evaluators give point estimates in the same directions under whole-image target matching; checks of subject-local change give less decisive differences. Together, these results identify useful behaviour in complete generated programs and show that score-guided revision need not preserve it: program construction and revision should be evaluated as distinct stages of a WSP pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"权重空间编程"(WSP)用于扩散模型概念编辑：由程序定义训练语境、保持约束与更新方向，共享数值拟合器求系数。在Stable Diffusion 1.4的24个TIMED测试编辑上，预注册的重写流程相对强基线无优势；但探索性分析中，一次性生成的Astra程序在全新场景的VLM联合成功率上比共享面板基线高10.0点，而CLIP相对匹配无显著变化。对Astra程序进行探针与重写后CLIP提升6.2点，但联合成功率下降9.7点。144图固定样本上五个额外评估者在整图匹配下给出同向估计。结论：完整生成程序具有可用行为，且评分引导的修订未必能保留该行为，程序构建与修订应作为WSP流程中两个独立阶段评估。
AI.motivation: 现有权重空间编程与扩散概念编辑方法多为端到端黑箱或手工编辑，缺少对"由程序构造更新"这一接口的系统检验；且程序生成与后续基于评分的修订通常被混为一体评估，无法判断修订是否破坏生成程序中的有效行为。
AI.method: 提出一种接口：程序显式定义训练语境、保持约束与更新方向，由共享数值拟合器统一选择系数。在Stable Diffusion 1.4上使用24个TIMED测试编辑，将生成程序与已发表编辑器、共享面板手写基线、以及同等预算下对常规编辑的搜索进行对比。随后进行探索性分析：对比一次性Astra程序与基线；对Astra程序做探针与重写；并在固定144图样本上用五个额外评估者复核，分别考察整图目标匹配与主体局部变化两种指标。
AI.result: 预注册重写流程相对强基线无优势。探索性比较中，一次性Astra程序在需要主体存在且整图目标匹配的VLM联合成功率上比共享面板基线高+10.0点，CLIP相对匹配无显著变化。探查并重写Astra程序后，CLIP提升+6.2点，但联合成功率变化-9.7点。五个额外评估者在整图目标匹配下给出同向点估计；主体局部变化的差异较不确凿。
AI.conclusion: 完整生成的程序包含有价值的行为，但评分引导的修订并不必然保留这些行为；程序构建与程序修订应被作为WSP流程中两个独立环节分别评估。结果也提示单一CLIP类指标不足以反映概念编辑的实际可用性。

title: Efficient Wide-Beam Generative Retrieval with Model-Native Trie Decoding and Shared-Context Attention
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) predicts catalog entries as short semantic identifiers (SIDs). Trie-constrained beam search keeps these identifiers valid, but wide beams expose two serving costs: vocabulary-wide score tensors that are mostly discarded, and repeated attention over the same prompt. We present Trie-Head, a model-native output interface that stores the identifier trie as validated GPU tensors. Compared with a Python custom logit processor (CLP), it reduces CPU--GPU coordination and memory traffic by avoiding Python constraint callbacks and vocabulary-wide candidate buffers. It scores compact codebook candidates and streams the full-vocabulary normalizer, preserving the original model's valid-token scores in real arithmetic without retraining. Shared-context attention complements this output path by reusing prompt key/value blocks across beams while preserving their private decode tails. We implement both mechanisms in SGLang and evaluate candidate sourcing for LinkedIn Hiring Assistant and qualification retrieval for the Qualification Retrieval Platform. The combined system improves closed-loop throughput by up to 5.57x over the CLP baseline and up to 2.63x over BF16 FlashRec at a common beam width of 200 on the Qualification Retrieval Platform workload.

AI.tldr: 提出 Trie-Head 输出接口与共享上下文注意力，在 SGLang 中加速生成式检索的束搜索服务，闭环吞吐最高提升 5.57x（相对 CLP）与 2.63x（相对 BF16 FlashRec）。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索用树约束束搜索保证 SID 合法，但宽束搜索带来两大服务开销：一是构造覆盖全词表的打分张量、其中大部分被丢弃；二是各束重复对同一 prompt 做注意力计算。现有 Python 自定义 logit 处理器（CLP）还引入大量 CPU–GPU 协调开销。
AI.method: 1) Trie-Head：将标识符 trie 以经验证的 GPU 张量形式存储，作为模型原生输出接口，避免 Python 约束回调与全词表候选缓冲，只对紧凑码本候选打分，并以流式方式计算全词表归一化项，在实数运算下保持原模型合法 token 分数，无需重训练；2) 共享上下文注意力：跨束复用 prompt 的 key/value 块，同时保留各束私有的解码尾部；两者均在 SGLang 中实现。
AI.result: 在 LinkedIn Hiring Assistant 的候选来源选择与 Qualification Retrieval Platform 的资格检索任务上评测。在 QRP 负载、束宽 200 时，闭环吞吐相对 CLP 基线最高提升 5.57x，相对 BF16 FlashRec 最高提升 2.63x。
AI.conclusion: 通过将约束结构下沉到 GPU 张量输出层并复用共享上下文 KV，可在不改变模型分数语义、不重训练的前提下显著降低生成式检索束搜索的服务开销，获得大幅吞吐收益。

title: Large Language Models Have Not Yet Transformed Science
summary: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) in late 2022 has raised questions about the future of science, but assessing their impact requires understanding how scientific practices were already evolving. We analyze 2.5 million full-text papers across five disciplines from 2015 to 2025, tracing trends over a broad spectrum of lexical, structural, epistemological, and social dimensions. Aside from frequency shifts in some words, most pre-2023 trends continued with limited detectable breaks. Among the notable exceptions, growth in computer science coauthor teams accelerated significantly in Asia, while apparent declines in biomedical topic diversity largely reflected standardization in article formats. Our study establishes an empirical foundation for monitoring the health of global science as LLM adoption deepens.

AI.tldr: 分析了2015–2025年五大领域250万篇论文全文，发现2023年LLM出现后大多既有趋势并未显著断裂，仅有少数例外（如亚洲CS合作团队加速增长、生物医学格式标准化导致的"主题多样性下降"假象）。
AI.motivation: LLM在2022年末兴起，引发对其科学影响的讨论，但判断影响需先了解科学实践本身的演化轨迹，需建立可比较的实证基线。
AI.method: 基于五个学科、2015–2025年共250万篇论文全文，从词汇、结构、认识论与社会等多维度追踪趋势，并检测2023年前后是否出现断点。
AI.result: 除部分词频变化外，多数2023年前的趋势延续、断点有限；显著例外是亚洲地区CS合著团队增长明显加速，生物医学主题多样性"下降"主要源于文章格式标准化。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在LLM普及加深背景下监测全球科学健康提供实证基础与基线框架。

title: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
summary: Latent diffusion models rely on a decoder to map denoised latents to pixels, adding complexity and inference cost. We introduce Decoding Without a Decoder (DWD), which lets a finetuned diffusion transformer produce final pixels directly through a linear head. Unlike previous methods, where the denoising output leads to final pixels, DWD separates the two roles: the original denoising head continues to drive sampling, then the new DWD head predicts the pixels at the final step. We extend pretrained latent models with DWD efficiently by finetuning only the last few transformer blocks, training the DWD head with pixel quality losses while anchoring the denoising head to the pretrained model to preserve the sample trajectory. Across latent image and video generators, DWD removes the decoder and reduces inference cost while maintaining or even improving pixel quality. On Wan video generation, it visibly reduces detail distortion and flickering, lowering warping error by 23%. Remarkably, the same separation also improves pixel diffusion models that do not even use a decoder: a final-step DWD head produces substantially better texture detail in text-to-image generation, and improves ImageNet FID from 1.55 to 1.43, a new state of the art among pixel flow models.

AI.tldr: 提出DWD（Decoding Without a Decoder），通过在最后一步用线性头直接预测像素，移除潜空间扩散模型的解码器，降低推理成本并保持/提升画质。
AI.motivation: 潜空间扩散模型依赖解码器将去噪后的潜变量映射到像素，增加复杂度和推理成本；现有方法中解码器难以兼顾质量。
AI.method: 分离去噪与像素预测两种角色：原去噪头继续驱动采样，新增DWD头仅在最后一步预测像素。高效微调：仅微调最后几个Transformer块，用像素质量损失训练DWD头，并将去噪头锚定到预训练模型以保持采样轨迹。
AI.result: 在图像与视频生成上移除解码器并降低推理成本，画质持平或提升；Wan视频生成中减少细节失真和闪烁，warping error降低23%；像素流模型中ImageNet FID从1.55提升到1.43，刷新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: DWD通过最后的线性头替代解码器，适用于潜空间及像素扩散模型，兼顾效率与质量。

title: Spatially local mini-batching for implicit neural representations
summary: Neural surrogates based on implicit neural representations (INRs) are typically trained on mini-batches spread over the whole domain, since a generic INR loses accuracy when every point of a batch lies in one small region. We show that low-rank neural representations (LRNRs), INRs whose weight matrices are products of shared bases with coefficients emitted by a small hypernetwork, can be trained with spatially local mini-batches. Each step uses the points of one time snapshot of an adaptive-mesh numerical solution inside one small cell, with snapshots and cells drawn according to the refinement of the mesh. We posit that such training is enabled by the structural property of LRNRs, as a local step reaches the shared bases only through the $r$ coefficients of each layer, and keeps one cell from rewriting the network. By a Kolmogorov-width argument, we show that when restricted to a small cell, the hidden states of LRNRs lie close to a low-dimensional subspace, which suggests the local steps only affect low-rank subspaces of the shared bases. On six hyperbolic-conservation-law problems with solutions computed using adaptive mesh refinement, one local training recipe reaches 1.1-2.3% relative $L^2$ error with a tenth of the parameters of a dense network of the same width. Finally, we provide a comparison by training a hypernetwork-SIREN, a DeepONet, and a Fourier neural operator (FNO) of the same size with the same local batches and training budget. We observe that these baselines reach 16-78% where the LRNR reaches 4.9%. Interestingly, we also observe that local training has a significant effect on the per-cell low-dimensional structure even in a wide generic hypernetwork-SIREN.

AI.tldr: 提出低秩神经表示（LRNR）——权重矩阵由共享基与小型超网络输出的系数相乘构成——可用空间局部小批量（单个时间快照、单个自适应网格小单元）训练，并在六个双曲守恒律问题上以十分之一参数达1.1–2.3%相对L2误差。
AI.motivation: 通用隐式神经表示（INR）若一个batch的点全落在小区域内会显著失真，因此通常需要全定义域采样，训练成本高且难以利用自适应网格结构。作者希望让神经代理能像数值求解器一样按局部单元增量训练。
AI.method: 构造LRNR：每层权重为共享基的乘积，系数由小型超网络产生。训练时每步只取自适应网格解在一个小单元内的一个时间快照点，快照与单元按网格细化程度采样。理论上用Kolmogorov宽度论证：限制在小单元内时LRNR隐状态接近低维子空间，局部步只通过每层r个系数影响共享基。实验在六个双曲守恒律问题上与同尺寸的hypernetwork-SIREN、DeepONet、FNO在相同局部batch与预算下对比。
AI.result: 一个局部训练配方即达1.1–2.3%相对L2误差，参数仅为同宽度稠密网络的十分之一；同尺寸同预算的基线为16–78%（LRNR为4.9%）。此外，局部训练即使在宽泛的hypernetwork-SIREN中也能诱发显著的逐单元低维结构。
AI.conclusion: LRNR的结构特性使空间局部小批量训练成为可能且有效，兼顾精度与参数效率；局部训练与低维结构之间存在相互促进关系，提示未来神经代理可借鉴自适应网格的局部性设计。

title: EviDARL: Evidence-Centric Dual-Agent Reasoning via Alternating Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Table Question Answering
summary: Despite advances in LLM-based table reasoning, most studies focus on single-table settings. Multi-table QA requires multi-hop reasoning over complex table relationships and evidence dispersed across long contexts, often without verifiable intermediate traces. To address these challenges, we introduce EviDA, an evidence-centric dual-agent framework comprising an Evidence Construction Agent and a Reasoning and Answering Agent. The Evidence Construction Agent generates and executes table-manipulation programs over complete tables to produce question-specific evidence and verifiable intermediate traces, simplifying subsequent reasoning. The Reasoning and Answering Agent then performs multi-hop reasoning over this evidence to derive final answers. We further introduce EviDARL, which combines agent-specific fine-grained rewards with parameter-efficient alternating reinforcement learning to improve collaboration between the agents. By optimizing each agent in turn while holding the other fixed, EviDARL enables bidirectional adaptation between evidence construction and answer reasoning. Experiments on MMQA and TQA-Bench demonstrate that EviDARL substantially outperforms competitive open-model and multi-table reasoning baselines under constrained model and training budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出EviDA双智能体框架（证据构建+推理问答）用可执行表操作程序生成可验证的中间证据，并用EviDARL交替强化学习优化两智能体协作，在多表QA基准上以有限预算显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM表格推理多聚焦单表场景；多表QA需跨复杂表关系做多跳推理、证据分散于长上下文，且往往缺乏可验证的中间推理轨迹。
AI.method: EviDA：Evidence Construction Agent在完整表上生成并执行表操作程序，产出问题特定的证据与可验证中间轨迹；Reasoning and Answering Agent基于该证据做多跳推理给出答案。EviDARL：为各智能体设计细粒度奖励，采用参数高效的交替强化学习，轮流优化一个智能体、固定另一个，实现证据构建与答案推理的双向适配。
AI.result: 在MMQA与TQA-Bench上，EviDARL在受限模型与训练预算下大幅优于竞争性开源模型与多表推理基线。
AI.conclusion: 以证据为中心的双智能体分解加上交替强化学习，可有效应对多表多跳QA，并在有限资源下取得优异表现。

title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
summary: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.

AI.tldr: 提出 TPHC，将张量并行(TP)分片与 Hyper-Connection 流结合，使各残差流可接收不同分片输出的混合，从而提升流间独立性且开销极小。
AI.motivation: mHC 将残差流扩展为 N 条并行流并稳定了大规模训练，但当流数超过 4 时收益很小；原因是每个子层只写单一输出到所有流，限制了各流被差异化更新的能力。
AI.method: 将 TP 分片与 HC 流集成：为每个 TP 分片路由一份独立的残差流混合，并在写回时保持各分片输出分离，使每条流可接收这些输出的不同混合；该设计不增加注意力/FFN 子层的参数与 FLOPs，并在 TP 下原生支持流分片。
AI.result: 8B 模型四流配置下训练时间仅比 mHC 多 9%，流数 4→16 仅增 19%；1.1B 模型训练 100B tokens，相比同流数 mHC（N∈{4,8,16}）验证损失降低 0.7–1.0%，六个常识推理基准平均零样本准确率提升 0.3–0.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用 TP 分片增强残差流更新的表达力与独立性，TPHC 在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下显著改善大规模 Transformer 训练效果。

title: Cross-Modal StateKV Injection for Communication in Multi-LLM Systems across Temporal Segments
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Equal contribution: Xiaoqian Zhang and Zhihao Zhang
summary: Video understanding with multiple multimodal language models requires a communication interface that can transfer complementary visual observations. Text-based communication is interpretable, but introduces an intermediate generation stage and can omit information relevant to subsequent reasoning. We study Cross-Modal StateKV Injection, a provider--carrier framework that communicates through key--value (KV) states at visual-token positions. Provider models observe complementary video frames; their visual KV states are aligned and projected into the carrier representation space and integrated through gated residual updates. Injection preserves the carrier KV-cache sequence length, while retaining the additional computation required by the providers and the communication module. The reported experiments on MLVU and Video-MME compare carrier-only inference, text-based communication, and StateKV with two provider architectures. Results show modest, task-dependent accuracy gains and lower reported latency than the evaluated text-communication baseline, with some categories remaining unchanged or decreasing. Increasing provider-side frame coverage offers additional gains on selected tasks without extending the carrier cache. These findings motivate further study of visual KV communication under explicitly controlled observation and computation budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Cross-Modal StateKV Injection，让多个多模态模型在视觉 token 位置的 KV 状态上通信：provider 模型观察互补视频帧，其视觉 KV 经对齐、投影并由门控残差注入 carrier 的 KV-cache，从而在不增加缓存长度的前提下传递互补视觉信息。
AI.motivation: 多模型视频理解需要能传递互补视觉观测的通信接口。纯文本通信虽可解释，但引入中间生成阶段，且会丢失后续推理相关信息。
AI.method: provider–carrier 框架：provider 观察不同帧，其视觉位置 KV 状态对齐并对齐投影到 carrier 表征空间，通过门控残差更新整合进 carrier KV-cache，保持序列长度不变，仅额外付出 provider 与通信模块的计算。
AI.result: 在 MLVU 与 Video-MME 上对比 carrier 单独推理、文本通信和 StateKV（两种 provider 架构）：准确率提升幅度不大且依赖任务，报告延迟低于文本通信基线，部分类别持平或下降；增加 provider 侧帧覆盖在部分任务上有额外收益且不扩展 carrier 缓存。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在明确控制观测与计算预算的条件下进一步研究视觉 KV 通信；当前增益有限，需更严格的预算设定与更充分验证。

title: PCGRL for Complex Platformers: Synthesizing Playable and Diverse Levels via Inflated Envelopes and Forward Curricula
summary: Procedural Content Generation via Reinforcement Learning (PCGRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for automated game development. However, existing PCGRL frameworks still suffer from severe exploration bottlenecks and scaling limitations when faced with long-sequence generation tasks governed by strict rigid-body rules and non-linear kinematic boundaries (e.g., platformer constraints). Consequently, traditional approaches frequently fail to maintain reliable level solvability on large-scale canvases. To address these challenges, we present a physics-aware, curriculum-guided PCGRL framework. First, we construct an "Inflated Volume Envelope" mechanism, which provides a physics-constrained representation that incorporates continuous kinematic feasibility into the discrete state space of the MDP. Second, to alleviate the sparse reward challenge induced by extremely long decision sequences, we introduce intermediate state-transition feedback and a multi-stage forward extension curriculum learning framework, enabling informative value estimation and stable credit assignment over long-horizon trajectories. Finally, to resolve the issue where deterministic policies after convergence generate highly monotonous map paths with a lack of diversity, we activate high-entropy stochastic inference during the synthesis phase, regularized by a post-hoc parallel rejection filtering mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances structural diversity while maintaining high physical playability across multi-scale environments. Comparative evaluations across multi-scale canvases demonstrate that our framework maintains superior convergence stability and dimensional scalability, reliably synthesizing solvable levels where traditional PCGRL baselines degrade.

AI.tldr: 提出物理感知、课程引导的PCGRL框架，通过膨胀体积包络、中间状态反馈与多阶段课程学习、以及高熵随机推理加后验拒绝过滤，解决长序列关卡生成中的探索瓶颈、稀疏奖励与多样性不足问题。
AI.motivation: 现有PCGRL框架在长序列生成任务中受严格刚体规则和非线性运动学边界（如平台游戏约束）影响，存在严重探索瓶颈和扩展性限制，在大画布上难以保证关卡可解性；同时收敛后的确定性策略生成路径单调、缺乏多样性。
AI.method: 1) 构建"Inflated Volume Envelope"机制，将连续运动学可行性编码进MDP的离散状态空间，形成物理约束表示；2) 引入中间状态转移反馈与多阶段前向扩展课程学习，缓解超长决策序列的稀疏奖励，实现稳定价值估计与信用分配；3) 在合成阶段启用高熵随机推理，并以后验并行拒绝过滤机制进行正则化以提升多样性。
AI.result: 多尺度环境实验表明框架在保持高物理可玩性的同时显著提升结构多样性；跨多尺度画布的对比评估显示其收敛稳定性和维度可扩展性更优，能可靠合成可解关卡，而传统PCGRL基线性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知表示、课程引导训练与随机推理解码三者结合，可有效突破PCGRL在长序列、强物理约束场景下的探索与扩展瓶颈，兼顾可解性、稳定性与多样性。

title: Multistage Contextual Optimization for Vehicle Repositioning
summary: Ride-hailing platforms reposition idle vehicles to improve spatial supply-demand balances. This problem is prediction-driven and multistage: at each stage, the platform forecasts future demand, executes current decisions, and uses the resulting state to initialize the next stage. We formulate a multistage linear program (LP) with a macroscopic fundamental diagram (MFD) linking accumulation to trip completion. We then develop a multistage contextual optimization approach that uses decision performance to train the prediction model. The learning problem combines multiple coupled stages, context that depends on earlier decisions, and predictions that affect the objective, the constraint matrix, and the right-hand side of the LP. We derive the exact gradient, which has three parts: parameters change forecasts and hence decisions; earlier decisions change the current decision through the inherited state; and this state also changes forecasts as context. An equivalent adjoint uses reverse vector-Jacobian products, avoiding full solution and state-parameter Jacobians. Finally, forward propagation solves many stage LPs one after another, which makes training slow. We propose a parallel block evaluation algorithm that solves blocks of consecutive stages in parallel and repeatedly feeds each block output to the next block. We prove that the algorithm recovers the serial trajectory within a finite number of passes and that its gradient error remains bounded when it stops early. On New York City ride-hailing data, multistage contextual optimization yields 7.7% to 9.1% more business benefit than the same predictor trained by mean squared error, outperforms all compared baselines from five paradigms, and even outperforms realized demand fed to the same policy. With eight workers, parallel block evaluation shortens training by a factor of 1.86 without loss of decision performance.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段情境优化方法训练网约车空车调度预测模型，并设计并行分块评估加速训练。
AI.motivation: 空车重定位是预测驱动、多阶段问题：每阶段先预测需求、再做决策、状态传递到下一阶段。传统以均方误差训练预测器与最终决策目标不一致，需用决策表现来训练预测。
AI.method: 构建含宏观基本图（MFD）的多阶段线性规划模型（累积量与出行完成量关联）；提出多阶段情境优化，用决策性能训练预测器。学习问题含多耦合阶段、依赖前期决策的情境、以及影响LP目标/约束矩阵/右端项的预测。推导精确梯度（三部分：参数影响预测进而影响决策；前期决策经继承状态影响当前决策；状态作为情境影响预测），并用反向向量-雅可比积的伴随方法避免完整雅可比。另提出并行分块评估算法：并行求解连续阶段块并迭代传递，证明有限次传递可恢复串行轨迹、提前停止时梯度误差有界。
AI.result: 在纽约市网约车数据上，多阶段情境优化比用MSE训练的同一预测器多带来7.7%–9.1%商业收益，优于五个范式的全部基线，甚至优于将真实需求输入同一策略。八线程下并行分块评估将训练时间缩短1.86倍且无决策性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 以决策性能端到端训练预测器并结合高效并行训练，可显著提升网约车空车重定位的实际收益，且训练加速不损性能。

title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
summary: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.

AI.tldr: 提出VFM树注意力验证器，并行对N条自然语言准则给出"Yes/No/不适用"三元判定，并用394K条CriteriaBank数据预训练，实现高效运行时验证。
AI.motivation: AI agent受数百条自然语言准则约束，但现有验证器无法高效地针对大批准则逐条评估输出，并判断哪些被满足、违反或不适用。
AI.method: VFM采用树注意力结构，编码共享上下文与目标文本，并并行对所有N条准则打分，输出独立的逐准则三元判定；在CriteriaBank（394K条(context,target,criterion,verdict)元组、逾32.1万种准则字符串）上预训练，并做微调。
AI.result: 微调后的VFM-4B在合成治理基准上超过GPT-5.4；在DynaBench多准则基准上，trace级失败检测优于DynaGuard-4B，且逐准则判定可定位被违反的规则，支持聚焦升级到大模型CoT裁判。单张H100上，4K token上下文对1,000条准则评估<2秒、显存<11GB。
AI.conclusion: CriteriaBank预训练提升跨域迁移（尤其低数据场景），全量数据下与强直接微调基线相当；VFM-4B高效低成本，适合运行时验证。

title: Inertial Video World Models
summary: The physical world has inertia: it evolves from what already exists rather than being recreated at every instant. However, many existing video world models lack an explicit mechanism for inertial state evolution, leaving the continuity of motion and structure implicit in video prediction. During autoregressive rollouts, repeated reconstruction can accumulate errors and destabilize the predicted dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce InertialWorld, an Inertial Video World Model that makes inertia a structural prior for autoregressive prediction: existing scene evidence is carried across time rather than reconstructed at every step. Central to this formulation is Inertial Memory, which turns memory from passive predictive context into an evolving video state with two complementary views: a dense Eulerian grid preserves scene-aligned evidence, while persistent Lagrangian carriers bind local content to learned canonical coordinates. At each step, the model transports the carrier content according to action-conditioned motion, predicts the complete next video state from the transported carriers and dense grid, and uses a learned gate to combine transported and newly predicted content into the memory for the next step. Extensive experiments across multiple domains, including robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation, demonstrate that InertialWorld achieves competitive autoregressive prediction performance against strong video world model baselines. Codes link: https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/InertialWorld

AI.tldr: 提出 InertialWorld，将"惯性"作为视频世界模型的结构先验：用 Inertial Memory 以欧拉网格＋拉格朗日载体跨时间携带场景证据，而非每步重建，从而抑制自回归累积误差。
AI.motivation: 物理世界具有惯性（状态由已有状态演化而来），但现有视频世界模型缺乏显式的惯性状态演化机制，运动与结构连续性仅隐含于预测中；自回归推演时反复重建会累积误差并破坏动力学稳定性。
AI.method: 以 Inertial Memory 作为演化的视频状态，含两种互补表示：密集欧拉网格保存场景对齐证据，持久拉格朗日载体把局部内容绑定到学习的规范坐标。每步按动作条件运动传输载体内容，由传输后的载体与密集网格预测完整下一帧状态，再用学习门控将传输内容与新预测内容融合进下一步记忆。
AI.result: 在机器人操作、3D 游戏仿真、开放世界导航等多领域实验中，自回归预测性能与强视频世界模型基线相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将惯性显式化为结构先验可有效提升视频世界模型自回归预测的连续性与稳定性，双视图记忆与门控融合机制是可行且通用的方案。

title: Perception into Imagination: Executable Memory for World Models
summary: Physical agents must use what they previously saw or touched after visibility or contact is lost. Their actions change the implications of these remembered facts. We introduce executable perceptual memory (EPM), a world-model framework that advances explicit perceptual state alongside neural latent dynamics during imagination. Its evolving read-out informs reward prediction, value estimation and policy learning. We align reward inputs with the transitions that produced them and supervise the reward head on open-loop rollouts of recorded actions. On Memory Maze $13\times13$, EPM reaches 30.37 return at 1M interactions, compared with 23.37 when the same evolving read-out informs only policy and value on a common perceptual front end: a gain of 7.00 [3.80, 10.21]. The complete method also improves control on $9\times9$ and in MiniWorld. Probes of remembered, out-of-view arrivals show stronger reward anticipation in both visual implementations. Concentration, tactile recovery and real tactile frames demonstrate complementary roles of remembered facts in imagined-policy training, motion-dependent decisions and sensory-content retention. EPM connects persistent perception to the predicted consequences and learning signals of a world model for Physical AI.

AI.tldr: 提出"可执行感知记忆"(EPM)世界模型框架，在想象过程中将显式感知状态与神经隐动力学并行推进，其演变读出用于奖励预测、价值估计与策略学习，在Memory Maze等任务上显著提升控制性能。
AI.motivation: 物理智能体在失去可见性或接触后，仍需利用此前看到或触摸到的信息，且其行动会改变这些记忆事实的含义。现有世界模型仅靠神经隐状态难以显式保持并演化这类感知记忆。
AI.method: EPM在世界模型想象的rollout中，一边推进神经隐动力学，一边显式推进感知状态；演化读出同时供给奖励预测、价值估计和策略。奖励输入与其对应的状态转移对齐，并在记录动作的开环rollout上监督奖励头。
AI.result: Memory Maze 13×13上1M交互时回报30.37，对比仅用同一读出驱动策略与价值的23.37，增益7.00 [3.80, 10.21]；9×9与MiniWorld控制亦提升。探针显示两套视觉实现对视野外到达的奖励预期更强；专注、触觉恢复与真实触觉帧实验印证记忆事实在想象策略训练、运动相关决策、感官内容保持中的作用。
AI.conclusion: EPM将持久感知与预测后果及学习信号衔接，为Physical AI的世界模型提供显式感知记忆路径。

title: Reliable Evaluation of AI Agents for Investment Research: A Framework for Performance and Validity Assessment
summary: We consider the problem of evaluating AI agents undertaking investment-research tasks, where agents interact with external information sources and computational tools to produce financial analyses and research reports. An important challenge is that the quality of an agent's final output does not necessarily reflect the quality of its execution process, while the reliability of the resulting assessment also depends on the validity of the evaluation procedure. Furthermore, investment-research tasks differ considerably in their requirements for numerical accuracy, information retrieval, financial analysis and supporting evidence, making it difficult to assess agent performance using a uniform set of criteria. We propose a domain-oriented evaluation framework that distinguishes outcome quality from execution quality and accommodates these differences through task-specific criteria, deterministic validators and independent large language model judges. We also introduce an evaluation-validity mechanism that examines the integrity of evaluation inputs, reference information, supporting evidence and grading outputs, with expert review used to resolve identified deficiencies and significant grading disagreements. Numerical results show that the proposed framework can distinguish differences in agent performance across evaluation dimensions, while identifying potential reliability issues in the evaluation process. The associated implementation and evaluation materials will be made available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出面向投资研究任务的AI智能体评估框架，将结果质量与执行过程质量分开评估，结合任务特定标准、确定性校验与独立LLM评审，并引入评估有效性机制。
AI.motivation: 投资研究智能体的最终输出质量不能反映其执行过程质量，评估可靠性还取决于评估程序本身的有效性；同时该类任务在数值准确性、信息检索、金融分析和证据支持等方面要求差异大，难以用统一标准评估。
AI.method: 领域导向的评估框架：区分outcome quality与execution quality，采用任务特定标准、确定性校验器（deterministic validators）与独立LLM评审相结合；并设计评估有效性机制，检查评估输入、参考信息、支撑证据与评分输出的完整性，由专家复核解决缺陷与重大评分分歧。
AI.result: 数值结果显示该框架能在多个评估维度上区分智能体性能差异，同时识别出评估过程中潜在的可靠性问题。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为投资研究智能体提供了更细粒度且更可信的评估方式，兼顾过程与结果并保障评估有效性；实现与评估材料将开源至GitHub。

title: What's in a Tree ? Hierarchical $n$-gram models as controlled approximators of language
summary: Hierarchical models have been proposed as synthetic settings for studying language. However, their relevance to realistic language corpora remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce tree-grams, autoregressive generative $n$-gram models that build the conditional probability tensor $p(x_n \mid x_{1:n-1})$ through a hierarchical composition of order-2 and order-3 tensors. $n$ controls the maximal context window, whereas a rank hyperparameter $d$ controls model capacity, yielding an interpretable and systematically scalable family of approximators of language. We show how tree-grams outperform existing $n$-gram baselines, while remaining competitive with deep transformer-based language models. We demonstrate the utility of such controlled approximations by using tree-grams as generative models. In particular, we show that hyperparameter transfer under $μ$P can be made more robust when narrower models are tuned on simpler data, generated by tree-grams with moderate $n$ and $d$. In addition, we show that entropy and effective range of correlations control performance gap after fine-tuning. This is because tree-grams allow us to explicitly control horizon and capacity. When allowed to route across candidate topologies, we observe emergent sparsity in tree-grams. Such concentrated routing permits pruning upto 95\% of topologies without significant change in performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 tree-grams：一种通过二阶和三阶张量分层组合构建条件概率张量的自回归 n-gram 生成模型，n 控制上下文窗口、d 控制容量。它能超越现有 n-gram 基线并媲美 Transformer，且可作为可控生成模型研究超参数迁移、微调泛化与稀疏路由。
AI.motivation: 分层模型常被用作研究语言的合成设定，但其与真实语言语料的相关性尚缺乏探索；作者希望获得一个可解释、可系统扩展的语言近似模型族。
AI.method: 提出 tree-grams：用二阶与三阶概率张量的分层组合来构造 p(x_n | x_{1:n-1})，n 为最大上下文窗口，秩超参数 d 控制模型容量；并可让模型在候选拓扑间路由，观察路由稀疏性。
AI.result: tree-grams 优于现有 n-gram 基线，并与基于 Transformer 的深度语言模型具有竞争力；用其生成简单数据时，使 μP 下的超参数迁移更稳健；熵与有效相关范围可解释微调后的性能差距；拓扑路由呈现涌现稀疏性，剪枝高达 95% 的拓扑而性能无明显下降。
AI.conclusion: tree-grams 提供了一个可控的语言近似框架，能显式控制预测视野与模型容量，从而支持超参数迁移、泛化分析和拓扑剪枝等研究。

title: SIDUMN: Self-Supervised Image Denoising Under Symmetric Multiplicative Noise
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
summary: Self-supervised denoising is challenging when the corruption is multiplicative and signal-dependent. In this letter, we propose SIDUMN, a symmetric noisier framework for self-supervised denoising under mean-one symmetric multiplicative noise. Given noisy observations and the noise law, the method samples an independent synthetic noise factor from the same law and constructs two complementary noisier images by applying the factor and its reflection about one. The denoising network is trained to predict one noisier image from the other, and at inference the reconstructions of $K$ such antithetic pairs are averaged. We show that the population target of the training loss is the clean conditional mean minus a multiplicative cross-term. We further prove that, for any trained network, antithetic averaging never increases the expected squared error of a single noisier-input reconstruction. Numerical results validate the theoretical findings and the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出 SIDUMN，一种面向均值一对称乘性噪声的自监督去噪框架：用同分布噪声因子及其关于1的反射构造互补的"更噪"图像对，让网络互相预测，推理时对K对反演对的重建取平均。
AI.motivation: 自监督去噪在乘性、信号相关噪声下很难，因为常规加性噪声假设与Noise2Noise类配对构造均不适用，缺少理论保证。
AI.method: 给定含噪观测与噪声分布，采样独立噪声因子并与关于1的反射因子分别作用于图像，得到两张互补更噪图像；网络由其中一张预测另一张；推导训练损失的总体目标为干净条件均值减去一个乘性交叉项；推理时对K个反演对重建取平均。
AI.result: 证明总体训练目标是干净条件均值减去乘性交叉项；并证明对任意已训练网络，反演平均不会增大单次更噪输入重建的期望平方误差。
AI.conclusion: 理论与数值实验共同验证了 SIDUMN 在均值一对称乘性噪声下自监督去噪的有效性与反演平均的收益。

title: Similar Is Not Useful: Selecting In-Context Demonstrations by Closed-Loop Utility
summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies fill their context with the demonstrations whose frames look most like the current observation under frozen DINOv2 embeddings. We ask whether visual similarity selects the demonstrations that make the policy succeed. For a frozen retrieval-augmented VLA (RICL on $π_0$-FAST, LIBERO), we make the demonstration pool swappable at run time and score each demonstration's utility by regressing the closed-loop success of 60 fixed-size pools on their membership. On initial states disjoint from those used for scoring, pools of the five highest-utility demonstrations succeed on 66.4% of 760 paired episodes across 19 tasks, pools of the five most similar on 55.7%, and random pools on 55.5%. Utility beats similarity by 10.8 points ($p=3.2\times10^{-6}$; positive on 15 of 18 untied tasks), including on 12 tasks the policy was never primed on, and similarity-selected pools do no better than random ($+0.1$ points). Within a task, a pool's visual similarity to the test scenes tracks its success at Spearman 0.10; across tasks, similarity separates tasks whose scenes differ and falls to chance when two tasks share a scene. The gain comes from on-task closed-loop evidence: best-of-ten direct search over pools recovers two-thirds of it with 100 rollouts. Against the shipped 20-demonstration pool, utility-curated pools of five lead by 7.0 points over 560 paired episodes from two evaluation runs ($p=0.006$), and utility-ordered retrieval inside the full pool leads by 4.5 points ($p=0.055$).

AI.tldr: 该论文检验检索增强VLA策略中"视觉相似度"是否真的选出了能让策略成功的演示，并提出以闭环成功率估计演示效用的方法；按效用选取的5条演示池显著优于按相似度或随机选取的池。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强VLA（如RICL on π0-FAST）用冻结DINOv2嵌入，将"帧看起来最像当前观测"的演示填入上下文。但视觉相似度是否等于任务有用性从未被检验——作者要问：视觉相似度选出的演示是否真的让策略成功？
AI.method: 在冻结的检索增强VLA上使演示池可在运行时替换；用回归方法，以60个固定大小演示池的闭环成功率为因变量、池成员身份为自变量，估计每条演示的效用（utility）。在LIBERO、19个任务、760个配对回合上比较三类池：效用最高5条、视觉最相似5条、随机5条。
