AI.result: 效用池成功率66.4%，相似池55.7%，随机池55.5%。效用比相似度高10.8个点（p=3.2e-6，18个非并列任务中15个为正），其中12个任务策略从未被预训练过；相似池不优于随机（+0.1点）。任务内相似度与成功的Spearman相关仅0.10；跨任务时相似度只区分场景不同的任务，场景相同时降为随机。direct search（十选一、100次rollout）可恢复三分之二的增益。对比已发布的20条演示池，效用精选的5条池在560个配对回合上领先7.0点（p=0.006）；全池内按效用排序检索领先4.5点（p=0.055）。
AI.conclusion: 视觉相似度并非好的演示选择信号，关键在于"在任务上的闭环证据"。效用驱动的演示策展能显著提升检索增强VLA，且增益可通过在线rollout获得。

title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
summary: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. Members share backgrounds while evidence, patient states, or task goals change; each has its own medical scoring requirements. A 70-person medical team annotates and reviews the simulated cases and their rubrics. Human review of 700 full-context responses from the original evaluation yields 90.5% pooled agreement with the original automated judgments at the rubric-item level. We report full-context and query-only results for seven general-purpose models and Ant Afu. Across the eight systems, full- query differences range from 11.83 to 31.76 case points and from 10.87 to 38.97 geometric cluster points. GPT-6-Astra leads both full-context metrics at 75.03 and 60.42, followed by Claude-Opus-5-5 and Ant Afu. Cross-condition differences describe score changes under the reported evaluation settings. Response comparisons reveal failures in checking historical information, expressing uncertainty when warranted, and ensuring recommendations respect required conditions. The resource supports model comparison and targeted follow-up evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出中文医疗基准 HealthCLBench，围绕"健康情境学习"评估模型在固定参数下于推理时获取、整合并应用情境、且能应对事实/证据/任务目标变化的能力，揭示现有模型在历史信息核查、表达不确定性、推荐满足必要约束等方面的失败。
AI.motivation: 复杂健康对话需要基于个体信息与当前有效证据作答，且需随事实、证据或任务目标变化而调整；而中文医疗基准尚未系统结合显式情境难度、受控病例变体与成员特定医学标准来评测开放式回答。
AI.method: 构建 HealthCLBench：328 个受控簇、1,103 个病例、4,931 条评分标准，覆盖医疗问诊与日常健康管理；同簇成员共享背景但证据、患者状态或任务目标变化，各自配专属医学评分要求；由 70 人医学团队标注审核，并人工复核 700 条全上下文回答（条目级 90.5% 一致率）；对比 7 个通用模型与 Ant Afu 的全上下文/仅查询两种设置。
AI.result: 八系统中全上下文与仅查询差异为 11.83–31.76 病例分、10.87–38.97 几何簇分；GPT-6-Astra 以 75.03/60.42 领先，其后为 Claude-Opus-5-5 与 Ant Afu；响应对比暴露历史信息核查不足、该表达不确定性时缺失、推荐未满足必要条件等失败。
AI.conclusion: 该资源可支持模型对比与针对性后续评测，说明上下文学习能力差异显著且普遍存在情境一致性缺陷。

title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
summary:
Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows.
  This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures.
  Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence.
  Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出"自然语言编程"(NLPg)概念，将提示重构为外化认知目标的动态认知 artefact，并以"对话工作记忆"框架解释提示与对话状态如何充当分布式外部记忆，支撑长程推理连续性。
AI.motivation: 经典NLP把语言当作计算对象（分析、分类、翻译、生成），而LLM使自然语言日益成为可执行的认知媒介，用于组织推理、编排问题求解与调控人机混合工作流；现有研究仅关注语言理解或提示技术，缺乏对提示作为认知程序的理论与认识论阐释。
AI.method: 理论/概念性研究：以分布式认知、延展心智、元认知与对话学习理论为基础，提出NLPg作为传统NLP的理论与认识论延伸；将提示界定为动态认知 artefact（外化目标、约束、假设、验证标准与中间推理状态）；提出"对话工作记忆"概念，并把现有记忆架构（BTMA、SKGE、RMR）映射到情节、语义、元认知三层。
AI.result: 构建了NLPg的理论框架与分层记忆映射，说明情节、语义与元认知层如何共同支持长程对话连贯性；论证提示即一种在人机分布式记忆架构内运作的对话式认知编程。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言同时充当通信媒介、可执行规范、认知脚手架与分布式记忆架构；论文由此提出超越符号界面范式的"后符号、后界面"范式，并讨论其对计算语言学与AI中介知识系统的启示。

title: Breaking Visual Conventions: Spectrally Coupled Weight Perturbation for Creative Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models often produce high-quality images that follow familiar visual conventions, even in response to open-ended prompts such as ``a creative [CLS]''. Existing methods encourage novelty by exploring semantic conditions or modifying features and guidance during denoising. Pretrained weights offer a complementary source of creative variation, but unstructured perturbations can have little visual effect or degrade image quality. We introduce Coupled Spectral Perturbation (CosPert), a training-free method that targets attention projections in layers identified by a one-time sensitivity analysis. For each projection, CosPert uses a shared random transformation and its transpose to couple updates to the singular-vector factors while perturbing the spectral gains. A common relative budget calibrates the magnitude of weight changes across projections, and a sigmoid schedule concentrates their influence in early denoising and gradually attenuates them during refinement. CosPert provides plug-and-play creativity enhancement at inference time. Once the perturbations are prepared, sampling requires no auxiliary networks or additional model evaluations. On both FLUX.1 and Stable Diffusion 3.5, CosPert enhances visual creativity, producing more varied object structures while preserving category identity. Across 50 object categories, CosPert achieves the highest mean CREward among the evaluated methods while maintaining strong prompt alignment.

AI.tldr: CosPert：一种免训练的推理期方法，通过对注意力投影做耦合谱扰动来提升文生图模型的创造性，同时保持类别身份与提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型即使面对"a creative [CLS]"这类开放式提示也倾向输出符合常见视觉惯例的图像。已有提升新颖性的方法依赖语义条件探索或修改去噪过程中的特征与引导，而预训练权重这一互补的创意变化来源尚未被结构化利用——无结构扰动往往视觉影响微弱或损害图像质量。
AI.method: 1) 通过一次性敏感性分析定位若干层的注意力投影作为扰动目标；2) 对每个投影使用同一随机变换及其转置，耦合更新奇异向量因子，同时扰动谱增益；3) 采用统一的相对预算跨投影校准权重改动幅度；4) 用sigmoid调度使扰动在去噪早期集中生效、在细化阶段逐渐衰减。方法为即插即用，扰动准备完成后采样无需辅助网络或额外模型评估。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1与Stable Diffusion 3.5上，CosPert提升视觉创造性，生成更多样的物体结构且保持类别身份；在50个物体类别上，于评估方法中获得最高平均CREward，同时维持较强的提示对齐。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、受控的权重谱扰动是提升T2I创造性的有效且低成本途径，且无需训练或额外推理开销，可与现有方法互补。

title: VRLLM: Turning LLMs into Powerful Tabular Classifiers
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text, but whether pretrained LLMs are effective for large-scale tabular classification remains unclear, as many previous works demonstrate that LLMs' tabular data classification performance falls behind tree-based models or neural architectures designed for tabular data. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. We also benchmark frontier LLMs on the same task and analyze their prediction behavior across model families and generations. Our interpretability experiments suggest that VRLLM learns feature-specific predictive associations, while component ablations indicate that the earliest two FFN layers contribute to the emergence of linearly decodable task information. Our paper provides an engineering recipe and a focused empirical case study on adapting compact LLMs to industrial tabular prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: Visa Research 用数十亿行标注表格数据微调预训练 Llama 3.2 1B（称 VRLLM），使其在工业级大规模表格分类任务上超越多种表格分类器乃至其生产级深度模型，并公开数据准备、训练配方、消融实验与部署验证。
AI.motivation: 既有研究普遍认为，预训练 LLM 在表格数据分类上不及树模型或专用表格神经网络，"LLM 能否胜任大规模表格分类"仍不明确，尤其是缺乏工业场景下的大规模实证。
AI.method: 在一个紧凑 LLM（Llama 3.2 1B）上用数十亿行标注表格数据进行有监督微调，系统覆盖数据准备流程、训练配方、设计选择的消融研究和部署验证；同时在同一任务上评测前沿 LLM，分析不同模型家族与代际的预测行为，并用可解释性实验与组件消融（尤其前两个 FFN 层）探查任务信息的形成机制。
AI.result: VRLLM 优于广泛的表格分类方法与有竞争力的生产级深度学习模型；可解释性实验表明模型学到了特征特定的预测关联，组件消融显示最早的 FFN 层有助于线性可解码任务信息的出现；前沿 LLM 的预测行为在不同家族/代际间存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一份将紧凑 LLM 适配到工业级表格预测任务的可复现工程配方与聚焦的实证案例研究，说明经大规模微调的 LLM 可作为强表格分类器，并揭示了相关内部机制。

title: Seeing What Still Holds: How Waiting Control Changes Cooperative Recovery
summary: Changing the holding reference during a fixed-duration wait can reverse the ranking of visual recovery methods. We introduce AuditEmbodied, a paired execution and trajectory evaluation framework that independently varies holding references and waiting duration while keeping recovery executors frozen. A 960-execution factorial on 20 initialization seeds compares CAD-feedback and landmark-based recovery from identical post-wait physical states within each holding and waiting condition. Protected completion requires successful recovery under the declared execution constraints. At a 1 s wait with registered wrist references, their protected completion counts change from 6/40 versus 19/40 under registered holding to 34/40 versus 22/40 under position-only holding. Trajectory analysis localizes the main separation to grasp formation: small observation-time target residuals precede large tracking errors. Joint diagnostics and controlled interventions characterize persistent tracking constraints. On fresh seeds, gradual position reanchoring improves CAD recovery's long-wait completion by 42.5 percentage points and reduces mean complete recovery time by 6.06 s relative to registered holding. Additional evaluations with pretrained policies, handover, and a mass-matched geometry characterize holding-reference sensitivity across executors and physical regimes. These findings establish holding reference as an explicit evaluation condition for comparing visual recovery performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AuditEmbodied 配对执行与轨迹评估框架，发现"保持参考系"会逆转视觉恢复方法的排序，应作为显式评估条件。
AI.motivation: 固定时长等待中的保持参考系变化会颠倒视觉恢复方法的排序，说明现有评估未把保持参考系当作控制变量，比较结果可能不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 AuditEmbodied 配对执行与轨迹评估框架：独立改变保持参考系与等待时长，固定恢复执行器；在20个初始化种子上做960次执行的析因实验，在相同物理状态、同一保持/等待条件下配对比较CAD反馈与基于地标的恢复；结合轨迹分析、联合诊断与受控干预。
AI.result: 1s等待+注册腕部参考下，受保护完成数从注册保持的6/40 vs 19/40，变为仅位置保持的34/40 vs 22/40，排序逆转；轨迹分析将差异定位到抓取形成阶段（观测时刻小目标残差先于大跟踪误差）；新种子上渐进位置重锚定使CAD恢复长等待完成率提升42.5个百分点、平均完整恢复时间减少6.06s；并在预训练策略、交接与质量匹配几何上复现敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 保持参考系应作为比较视觉恢复性能的显式评估条件；方法排序对参考系高度敏感，需在评估中明确声明与控制。

title: Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at Human-Robot Dialogue(HRD) Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通信增强的贝叶斯任务分配框架，使智能体在部分可观测下通过对话降低不确定性，并保持基于显式概率信念的决策，在动态到达任务的Overcooked环境中优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协作需随目标与职责演化和调整任务分配，但既有框架常假设目标静态、完全可观测，或依赖LLM却缺乏可验证的任务分配/意图信念，难以适用于智能体间信息不完整的真实协作场景。
AI.method: 构建通信增强的贝叶斯任务分配框架：智能体用对话减少对环境和协作者的不确定性，任务分配决策基于显式概率信念；在扩展了动态到达任务、并区分完全/部分物体空间可观测性的Overcooked域中评测。
AI.result: 通信智能体在两种观测设置下均稳定优于朴素LLM智能体；完全可观测下与非通信任务分配基线相当，部分可观测且任务复杂度上升时显著更优，平均提速0.585、平均提前18个时间步完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 该智能体在部分可观测环境中进行动态任务分配更高效，且可用信息越少，通信的作用越重要。

title: M$^3$-Test: Coverage Gaps in Joint-Perturbation Testing of Visual Question Answering
summary: A visual question answering (VQA) model can pass every image-only and question-only test yet fail when the same changes occur together. Standard robustness reports average over conditions and therefore cannot say which accepted requests remain vulnerable. We introduce M3-Test, a coverage audit that aligns each clean input with its single-modality variants and a complete 5x5 family, 4x4 strength joint library, so that any reduced test suite can be replayed on the same requests. Across 2.6 million responses from four vision-language models, joint failures affect 26-29% of the Qwen questions that pass all 40 single-modality tests, although fewer than 0.6% of their joint records fail. Passing the 25 maximum-strength corners does not close this gap: 11-14% of the accepted questions still fail elsewhere in the library. Re-executing the archived failures reproduces about 90% of them, against a 0.3-0.6% flip rate among matched passing controls, and re-checking the most fragile failure records supports 80-89% of them. On the evidence examined, neither execution noise nor grading error can fully account for the gap. The same aligned grids make previous evaluations reusable. On held-out images, a risk order learned from other models discovers about 80% of affected Qwen questions within 25 additional queries, compared with 65-68% for maximum-first and 53-57% for pairwise covering arrays. M3-Test thus turns a passing robustness suite into a request-level account of what remains untested, supporting acceptance, regression review and test allocation.

AI.tldr: 提出 M3-Test 覆盖审计方法，揭示 VQA 模型"单模态全过却联合失败"的漏洞，并给出可复用的请求级风险评估。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒性报告仅在条件上取平均，无法指出哪些"已通过"的请求仍潜藏脆弱；模型可能通过所有 image-only 与 question-only 测试，却在二者同时变化时失败。
AI.method: 构建 M3-Test 覆盖审计：将每个干净输入与单模态变体及 5x5 完整联合强度库对齐，使任何精简测试套件都能在同一请求上重放；对 4 个视觉语言模型的 260 万条响应进行对齐网格分析，并学习跨模型的风险排序。
AI.result: 通过全部 40 项单模态测试的 Qwen 问题中 26-29% 存在联合失败（联合记录失败率<0.6%）；通过 25 个最大强度角点后仍有 11-14% 在库内其他处失败；重跑归档失败可复现约 90%（对照翻转率仅 0.3-0.6%），最脆弱记录复查支持 80-89%。跨模型学到的风险排序在新图像上 25 次额外查询可发现约 80% 受影响问题，优于最大优先（65-68%）和成对覆盖数组（53-57%）。
AI.conclusion: 执行噪声与评分误差不足以解释该差距；M3-Test 将"通过的鲁棒性套件"转化为请求级的未测风险清单，支持验收、回归审查与测试资源分配。

title: BQ-LoRA: Binary-Quantized Low-Rank Adapters as Implicit Regularizers for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of quantized large language models is dominated by QLoRA, which combines 4-bit weight quantization with FP16 low-rank adapters. We ask whether the FP16 adapter precision is necessary. Replacing it with a single binary bit per adapter parameter, combined with a learned per-layer scale $s$ and a Scaled Straight-Through Estimator, reduces adapter storage by 13-16x. We introduce two variants -- NormScale, which binarizes under a norm-preserving scale with a clipped STE, and LearnThresh, which makes the binarization threshold learnable -- unified under a framework we call BQ-LoRA. Our main theoretical contribution is a tight characterization of the BQ-LoRA hypothesis class: it has bounded entrywise norm, a typical-set spectral norm bound that is $Θ(r)$ times sharper than the worst case, a full-rank, near-isotropic update, and consequently a Rademacher complexity that yields an explicit $\tilde{O}(s_{\max}α\sqrt{d_{out}/(rn)})$ generalization bound. FP16 LoRA has no comparable a priori norm or isotropy control. On Qwen2.5 (1.5B-72B), BQ-LoRA exceeds QLoRA's benchmark averages at every scale by 0.8-3.5 points; on LLaMA-2 (7B/70B) it remains competitive at the same storage reduction but does not uniformly lead the strongest FP16-adapter baselines (LoftQ at 7B, QLoRA at 70B). On Qwen2.5-7B the binary adapter preserves the 4-bit base WikiText-2 PPL within 0.06 (9.86 vs. 9.80) while QLoRA worsens it by 0.59. The reduction applies to inference-time adapter storage and serving; training memory matches QLoRA and step time rises by under 4%. We translate the storage saving into a deployment study, BQ-SGMV, by extending Punica's SGMV kernel with a binary inner-product primitive: the same A100-80GB holds 15.6x more adapters in HBM, and our research prototype eliminates cache misses under a skewed synthetic workload.

AI.tldr: 提出BQ-LoRA，用每参数1比特的二值化适配器替代FP16适配器，配合逐层可学习尺度与缩放直通估计器，使适配器存储降低13-16倍，并从理论上刻画其假设类的范数、谱范数、各向同性及Rademacher复杂度，给出显式泛化界；在Qwen2.5上全面超越QLoRA，并通过BQ-SGMV内核实现服务层面的显著扩展。
AI.motivation: QLoRA以4-bit权重加FP16低秩适配器成为主流参数高效微调范式，但适配器仍占FP16精度存储开销。作者质疑FP16适配器精度是否必要，希望在几乎不损失性能的前提下大幅压缩推理期适配器存储并提升多适配器服务能力。
AI.method: 将适配器参数二值化为单比特，配合可学习逐层尺度s和Scaled Straight-Through Estimator，提出两个变体：NormScale（保持范数的尺度下二值化并使用截断STE）与LearnThresh（可学习二值化阈值），统一为BQ-LoRA框架。理论上刻画其假设类：逐元素范数有界、典型集谱范数界比最坏情况锐Θ(r)倍、满秩近各向同性更新，进而得到Rademacher复杂度与显式泛化界。工程上将Punica的SGMV内核扩展出二值内积原语（BQ-SGMV）。
AI.result: Qwen2.5（1.5B-72B）上各规模基准均值均超QLoRA 0.8-3.5分；LLaMA-2（7B/70B）在同存储下具竞争力但不全面领先最强FP16适配器基线（7B为LoftQ、70B为QLoRA）。Qwen2.5-7B上二值适配器将4-bit基座WikiText-2 PPL维持在9.86（原9.80，仅差0.06），而QLoRA恶化0.59。训练显存与QLoRA相当，单步时间增加不到4%。BQ-SGMV原型在A100-80GB上HBM可容纳15.6倍适配器，并在偏斜合成负载下消除缓存未命中。
AI.conclusion: FP16适配器精度并非必要：单比特适配器加可学习尺度即可在多数场景匹配或超越QLoRA，同时带来13-16倍存储缩减；且二值化假设类具备FP16 LoRA所缺乏的先验范数与各向同性控制，从而获得显式泛化保证。收益主要体现在推理期适配器存储与多适配器服务，训练侧无额外代价。

title: AutoE2E: Don't speak - Language free end-to-end autonomy A Real-Time Driving Model for L2++ ADAS and L4 Robotaxis
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 6 tables. Code, model checkpoints and evaluation pipeline released at https://github.com/autowarefoundation/auto_e2e(v1.0 tag, Apache-2.0)
summary: AutoE2E is an open-source end-to-end driving model developed by the Autoware Foundation Robotaxi Working Group. It introduces a temporal bird's-eye-view (BEV) architecture that combines multi-camera perception, HD-map information and route conditioning to predict future vehicle motion. The evaluated model uses a pretrained camera-BEV backbone, temporal feature fusion and a lightweight recurrent trajectory planner. It contains approximately 79.9 million parameters, of which approximately 1.45 million are trainable in the evaluated configuration. The v1.0 release provides model checkpoints, training and evaluation code, and DataModelConsole, a dashboard for visualizing and inspecting model experiments. On the KITScenes validation benchmark, the fine-tuned checkpoint achieves an average displacement error (ADE) of 0.745 m and a final displacement error (FDE) of 2.020 m at a three-second prediction horizon. The paper also reports preliminary real-vehicle research conducted with the Technical University of Munich's EDGAR platform, alongside ongoing collaboration with the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. AutoE2E v1.0 is an early open research release. Its quantitative evaluation is open-loop, and the model has not yet demonstrated validated closed-loop autonomous driving. The release is intended to provide the autonomous-driving community with an inspectable baseline for further research, experimentation and collaborative development.

AI.tldr: AutoE2E v1.0 是 Autoware 基金会 Robotaxi 工作组开源的时间 BEV 端到端驾驶模型，含约 7990 万参数（可训练约 145 万），在 KITScenes 验证集 3 秒预测下 ADE 0.745 m、FDE 2.020 m，并附带模型检查点、训练评估代码与 DataModelConsole 可视化工具。
AI.motivation: 为自动驾驶社区提供一个可检视（inspectable）的开源端到端基线，便于复现、实验和协作开发，弥补现有端到端方案多为闭源或不可检查的不足。
AI.method: 采用时间鸟瞰图（BEV）架构：融合多相机感知、HD 地图信息与路线条件，预测未来车辆运动；使用预训练相机-BEV 骨干网络、时序特征融合以及轻量级循环式轨迹规划器，评估配置下仅微调少量参数。
AI.result: 在 KITScenes 验证基准上，微调检查点在 3 秒预测时域取得 ADE 0.745 m、FDE 2.020 m；另报告与慕尼黑工业大学 EDGAR 平台开展的初步实车研究，以及与卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院的持续合作。
AI.conclusion: v1.0 属于早期开放研究版本，定量评估为开环，尚未验证闭环自动驾驶能力，定位为社区可检查的基线以推动后续研究、实验与协同开发。

title: MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
summary: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 在统一的200语言、9000+评测设置下比较8种LoRA方法，发现LoRA提升翻译拟合、降低阅读理解，且对小语种收益最大，应视为定向工具而非通用多语能力提升手段。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍假设带路由的低秩适配器（routed low-rank adapters）可提升LLM对低资源语言的支持，但该假设从未在共享的多语评测协议下经实证检验，本文填补这一空白。
AI.method: 冻结基座模型，在200种语言、9000余个评测设置上对比8种LoRA方法；并检验缩减规模搜索所选出配置能否预测大规模下的相对性能。
AI.result: 缩减规模搜索能找到可用配置，但无法可靠预测相对性能——排名第一的配置在大规模下从不是最优；LoRA稳定提升翻译数据的语言模型拟合、一致性地损害阅读理解，且对低资源语言收益最大。
AI.conclusion: LoRA方法应被视为面向特定任务的定向工具，而非提升LLM多语能力的通用手段；小规模超参搜索结论需谨慎外推。

title: DAP-MR: Degradation-Aware Prompt-Magnitude Routing for Real-World Ultrasound Super-Resolution
summary: When super-resolution models designed for natural images are used on ultrasound scans, relying on semantic text prompts can lead to unreliable results. The tags these models generate often do not match the actual restoration needs, and specialized medical terms may be misunderstood by general-purpose text encoders. Instead, prompts focused on common image degradations are more directly useful for guiding restoration. However, using a single prompt to describe both the type and severity of image degradation can entangle these factors, making it hard for the model to know how strong the degradation is. To address this limitation, we introduce Degradation-Aware Prompt--Magnitude Routing (DAP-MR). Each degradation type is represented by a dedicated token initialized from the contextualized EOS embedding of a degradation-oriented prompt and subsequently adapted during ultrasound SR training. A separate magnitude router predicts a continuous, input-dependent magnitude that modulates the corresponding token. Thus, language provides a degradation-aware initialization for what should be restored, while magnitude routing supplies an explicit signal for how strongly it should influence restoration. DAP-MR can be added to both one-step and multi-step diffusion super-resolution frameworks without changing their core structures. Our experiments--on synthetic datasets with both in-domain and under anatomical-domain shift, as well as unpaired real-world ultrasound data--show that DAP-MR delivers better restoration quality and generalizes more consistently across different domains.

AI.tldr: 提出DAP-MR方法，用退化类型专用token分离"类型"与"强度"，提升超声图像超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 自然图像超分模型直接用于超声时，语义文本提示不可靠：生成标签与实际修复需求不符，专业医学术语也常被通用文本编码器误解；而单一提示同时描述退化类型与强度会混淆二者，模型难以判断退化程度。
AI.method: 每个退化类型对应一个专用token，由其退化导向提示的上下文化EOS嵌入初始化，并在超声SR训练中自适应调整；另设独立的强度路由器，预测连续、依赖输入的强度值来调制对应token。语言提供"修复什么"的退化感知初始化，强度路由提供"多强影响"的显式信号。
AI.result: 可插入单步与多步扩散超分框架而无需改动核心结构；在含域内及解剖域偏移的合成数据集和不成对真实超声数据上，修复质量更好、跨域泛化更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 将退化类型与强度解耦的提示设计能显著提升超声超分效果与鲁棒性，且具良好框架兼容性。

title: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. We derive a scaling law that unifiedly describes these dynamics, enabling accurate loss predictions across mixture ratios, training steps, and model sizes. Crucially, our law characterizes the trade-off between early and late fusion: under a fixed data budget, early fusion preserves text performance while late fusion favors vision performance, yielding a trade-off that increasingly tilts toward early fusion as model size scales. Extensive experiments confirm that our scaling law reliably captures multimodal learning dynamics and governs fusion decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析多模态预训练（早期融合 vs 晚期融合）的学习动态，提出统一缩放定律，刻画基础学习轨迹与模态竞争导致的分布偏移，可跨混合比例、训练步数与模型规模预测损失。
AI.motivation: 早期融合与晚期融合范式的根本权衡尚不清楚，导致训练配方昂贵且依赖启发式经验。
AI.method: 系统分析视觉-语言预训练的学习动态，将验证损失分解为基础学习轨迹（不同数据类型贡献速率不同）与模态竞争驱动的分布偏移，并据此推导统一缩放定律。
AI.result: 缩放定律能准确预测不同混合比例、训练步数和模型规模下的损失；在固定数据预算下，早期融合保持文本性能而晚期融合偏好视觉性能，且随模型规模增大，权衡逐渐倾向早期融合。
AI.conclusion: 大量实验证实该缩放定律可靠刻画多模态学习动态，并可指导融合方式的选择决策。

title: Symbolic Abstraction Refinement
summary: Autonomous systems choose actions whose outcomes are uncertain and are subject to time constraints. Probabilistic timed automata (PTAs) model exactly this, and verifying one answers a question about the system's decision-making: the maximum probability of reaching a goal, or the minimum probability of reaching a hazard, that a controller can guarantee. Verification normally works over symbolic states, each pairing a discrete location with a region of clock values, and its difficulty is that the best behavior generally varies within such a region. The PRISM verifier's most capable PTA method responds by splitting regions until each is uniform, rebuilding the transitions that reach them and propagating the split backward through the state graph of a stochastic game, a cascade of graph reconstruction that partitions regions the property never depends on. We present SYMAR, which instead makes the value function symbolic: each symbolic state carries a function from sub-regions of its clock region to probability bounds, so refinement is the appearance of new sub-regions in that function, and previously generated states are never split nor their incoming transitions reconstructed. Both sources of PTA nondeterminism, the timing and the choice of actions, are captured implicitly by the preimage computation that produces those sub-regions. Heuristic forward search then bounds how much refinement is done at all, expanding an And-Or graph from the initial state along the most promising behaviors so that effort is confined to the property-relevant fragment, guided by bounds and preferred actions from a single unrefined run of the existing method; a partial-refinement backup keeps the otherwise combinatorial sub-region count lean, and every stored interval provably contains the true probability. On the PRISM PTA benchmarks, whose subproblems recur in autonomous systems (distributed agreement under contention, leader election, and self-configuration without central coordination), SYMAR is up to 108x faster, solves an instance on which the existing method exhausts the time limit, and is markedly less sensitive to the deadline constant, resolving one instance in a 37-node search graph, unchanged as the deadline triples, where the existing method needs 86,380 abstract states and 73 refinement rounds.

AI.tldr: SYMAR将概率时间自动机(PTA)验证中的值函数符号化，避免区域拆分与图重构，并结合前向启发式搜索，在PRISM基准上比现有方法最高快108倍。
AI.motivation: PTA验证通常在符号状态(位置+时钟区域)上进行，但区域内最优行为往往不一致。PRISM最强方法需反复拆分区域、重建转移并反向传播，造成大量与性质无关的无效划分，且对截止时间常数敏感。
AI.method: 让每个符号状态携带一个从时钟子区域到概率界的函数，细化即函数中出现新子区域，已有状态无需拆分或重建入边；时间与动作两种非确定性由生成子区域的原像计算隐式捕获。再用前向启发式搜索在And-Or图上按最有希望的行为展开，以现有方法一次未细化运行得到的界与偏好动作作引导；部分细化回填控制子区域数量，所有区间均为真实概率的可靠界。
AI.result: 在PRISM PTA基准(竞争下的分布式一致、领导者选举、无中心自配置)上最高快108倍，解决了原方法超时的实例；对截止时间常数不敏感——某实例仅需37节点搜索图且截止时间三倍后不变，而原方法需86,380个抽象状态与73轮细化。
AI.conclusion: 符号化值函数加启发式前向搜索可显著缩小PTA验证的细化范围，兼顾正确性(可靠界)与效率，适用于自主系统的实时决策验证。

title: Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI
summary: We investigate how language models process negation in natural language inference (NLI). We propose the \textit{Polarity Composition Hypothesis}, a high-level causal model of this computation. Behavioral evaluations show that language-model predictions largely conform to the proposed hypothesis. Using Distributed Alignment Search, we identify causally effective subspaces aligned with the variables in the polarity-composition hypothesis. These representations transfer across negation forms and partially to a subset of MNLI. We release the dataset and code.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"极性组合假说"作为语言模型处理NLI中否定语义的高层因果模型，行为实验表明模型预测与该假说基本一致，并用分布式对齐搜索找到与假说变量因果对应的子空间表征，这些表征可跨否定形式迁移，并部分迁移至MNLI子集。
AI.motivation: NLI中否定语义的处理机制尚不清楚，缺乏对语言模型内部计算的可解释因果解释，作者希望用可检验的因果模型刻画模型如何组合极性信息。
AI.method: 提出Polarity Composition Hypothesis（极性组合假说）作为高层因果模型；通过行为评测检验模型预测是否符合该假说；使用Distributed Alignment Search（DAS）定位与假说变量因果对齐的子空间表征。
AI.result: 行为评测显示语言模型预测大体符合该假说；DAS识别出因果有效的子空间；这些表征能跨不同否定形式迁移，并部分迁移到MNLI的某个子集。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型对NLI中否定的处理可由极性组合假说较好地解释，且相应内部表征具有因果性与一定泛化性；作者公开数据集与代码。

title: PURE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Granularity Multimodal Identity Matching
summary: Identity matching asks whether two records denote the same identity, yet the answer depends on the target granularity. Two records may match at the base level but not at the variant level: they share an underlying design while differing in attributes such as color or size. Final matching accuracy does not separately characterize the capabilities involved. To study this problem, we use e-commerce as a challenging real-world domain. We introduce PURE, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching covering four capability dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, and Evidence-grounded Judgment. The benchmark comprises 1,457 multiple-choice questions across 14 tasks, derived from real-world matching pairs and verified by two domain experts. Across ten recent MLLMs, overall scores range from 47.1% to 86.0%. Understanding receives the highest mean score and Judgment the lowest, with weaknesses in visual difference localization and variant-level rule judgment. Modality ablations show that models benefit from multimodal evidence but can incorrectly identify conflicts between matching records. In direct matching, most models recognize matching pairs more reliably than non-matching pairs at the base level, whereas the reverse holds at the variant level. PURE therefore reveals what aggregate matching accuracy hides: not only whether models judge a pair correctly, but where they struggle to interpret evidence and apply matching criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出PURE基准，用四维度、14任务、1457道多选题诊断多粒度多模态身份匹配能力，揭示总体匹配准确率掩盖的模型弱点。
AI.motivation: 身份匹配的答案依赖目标粒度：两记录可能基础层匹配但变体层不匹配（同一设计但颜色/尺寸不同）；而单一总体准确率无法区分模型各项能力表现。
AI.method: 以电商为真实场景，构建PURE诊断基准，涵盖感知、理解、推理、证据支撑判断四个能力维度，14个任务共1457道多选题，源自真实匹配对并经两名领域专家验证；评测十个近期MLLM，并进行模态消融与直接匹配分析。
AI.result: 模型总体得分47.1%–86.0%；理解维度最高、判断维度最低；弱在视觉差异定位与变体层规则判断。模态消融显示模型受益于多模态证据但会误判匹配记录间的冲突；基础层多数模型更善识别匹配对，变体层则相反。
AI.conclusion: PURE揭示了聚合准确率所掩盖的信息：不仅模型是否判断正确，还显示其在证据解读与匹配准则应用上的具体薄弱环节。

title: Fair Bubble Sort: Provably Optimal Fair Ranking with Continuous Sensitive Attributes
comment: 35 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/Ambress92/FairBubbleSort
summary: Most fair-ranking methods assume categorical protected attributes, requiring continuous attributes such as age or income to be discretized into groups. This introduces arbitrary thresholds, loses fine-grained information, and ignores the natural ordering of the attribute. In this paper, we study the problem of fair ranking with continuous protected attributes without relying on thresholding. We introduce Continuous Pairwise Parity (CPP), a fairness notion based on Kendall correlation between ranking positions and the protected attribute, and seek rankings that satisfy a prescribed CPP constraint while minimizing their Kemeny distance from an initial score-based ranking. To solve this problem, we propose Fair Bubble Sort (FBS), an efficient post-processing algorithm based on targeted adjacent swaps. We prove that FBS is exactly optimal for the unweighted Kemeny distance and provide approximation guarantees for the score-weighted setting. FBS is output-sensitive, with running time determined by the number of swaps required to meet the fairness constraint. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that FBS is scalable and consistently outperforms discretization-based baselines, achieving a superior fairness-accuracy Pareto front.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续成对均等（CPP）公平概念，基于排序位置与连续保护属性之间的Kendall相关性，并设计Fair Bubble Sort（FBS）后处理算法，在最小化与初始排序的Kemeny距离下满足CPP约束。
AI.motivation: 现有公平排序方法多假设保护属性为类别型，需将年龄、收入等连续属性离散化分组，这会引入任意阈值、丢失细粒度信息并忽略属性的自然顺序。
AI.method: 定义CPP公平性（基于Kendall相关），将问题建模为在CPP约束下最小化与初始分数排序的Kemeny距离；提出基于定向相邻交换的高效后处理算法FBS，并给出无权重Kemeny距离下的精确最优性证明与分数加权情形下的近似保证。
AI.result: FBS为输出敏感算法，运行时间由满足公平约束所需的交换次数决定；在合成与真实数据集上可扩展性好，并持续优于基于离散化的基线，实现更优的公平性-准确性Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: 无需阈值化的连续保护属性公平排序是可行且高效的，FBS在理论与实验上均表现出色，为连续属性公平排序提供了新范式。

title: ROSMonitoring in Action: Runtime Monitoring and Enforcement for ROS 2 Actions
summary: Robotic applications often rely on long-running operations, such as navigation, manipulation, and inspection, which in ROS~2 are commonly implemented as actions. Unlike topics and services, actions involve a structured lifecycle comprising goal submission and acceptance, feedback, status updates, result retrieval, and cancellation. Existing versions of ROSMonitoring support topics and services, but do not reconstruct this lifecycle or expose action-level events to a runtime-verification oracle. In this paper, we extend ROSMonitoring with runtime monitoring and enforcement for ROS~2 actions. Actions are declared directly in the monitoring configuration and automatically instrumented through the underlying ROS~2 communication endpoints. The generated monitor reconstructs action-level events, correlates them through goal identifiers, maintains the state of active goals, and translates violations into protocol-aware enforcement operations. These include goal rejection, cancellation, message suppression, and protocol-compliant responses generated directly by the monitor when the original communication cannot be forwarded. We evaluate the implementation through controlled stress tests that vary the number of action invocations, workload size, and client–server topology. The results show approximately linear growth in monitoring cost with repeated action invocations under a fixed workload, while larger action workloads and a greater number of configured client–server pairs introduce additional overhead. These results characterise the scaling behaviour of the current implementation under the tested sequential workloads while highlighting the main performance limitations of the current synchronous implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文将 ROSMonitoring 扩展至 ROS 2 actions，通过配置声明与自动插桩重建 action 生命周期事件，并以 goal 标识关联状态，实现协议感知的运行时验证与执行（拒绝、取消、消息抑制、合规响应），并给出性能评估。
AI.motivation: 现有 ROSMonitoring 仅支持 topics 与 services，无法重建 actions 的结构化生命周期（goal 提交/接受、feedback、状态更新、结果获取、取消），因而无法向运行时验证 oracle 暴露 action 级事件。
AI.method: 在监控配置中直接声明 actions，借助底层 ROS 2 通信端点自动插桩；生成的监控器重建 action 级事件、按 goal ID 关联并维护活跃 goal 状态，将违规转化为协议感知的执行操作（goal 拒绝、取消、消息抑制，以及无法转发时由监控器直接生成合规响应）。
AI.result: 受控压力测试改变 action 调用次数、工作负载大小与客户端-服务器拓扑：固定工作负载下重复调用时监控开销近似线性增长；更大 action 工作负载与更多客户端-服务器配置对会带来额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了当前实现在顺序工作负载下的扩展特性，并指出当前同步实现的主要性能瓶颈。

title: Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
summary: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44\% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure--residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: https://github.com/haihuang-ml/structure-residual

AI.tldr: 论文提出"结构-残差"表征先验，用BBC（边界瓶颈概念）与CC（连续概念）两种方式将表征拆为结构+实现细节，在GPT-2 Medium上把NLL降低1.44%，且深度偏好互补。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型仅靠next-token prediction同时学习预测行为与内部表征，表征结构本身并非显式归纳偏置。受Kolmogorov复杂度的两部分编码启发，作者希望将表征中"结构"与"实现细节"显式分离。
AI.method: 提出structure–residual原则并以两种方式实现：(1) BBC——让信息经由边界载体在token片段间路由，同时保留局部自回归计算；(2) CC——正则化表征几何，诱导出低频结构/高频残差的谱分解。作者推导两种视角下的编码界，并证明当片段内路径能量趋零时，多重度校正的边界注意力变得精确。
AI.result: BBC与CC呈现显著不同的深度偏好：BBC在浅层最有效，CC在深层最有效。300M训练token下二者结合使GPT-2 Medium的NLL改善1.44%，增益在训练至20B token时仍保持。表征诊断显示BBC提升边界状态的相对预测重要性，CC降低谱残差能量。
AI.conclusion: 结构-残差先验能够超越纯next-token prediction改善语言模型预训练；两种实现的分层互补性提示应按深度配置此类偏置。

title: SandBAR: A Band-Asymmetric Architecture for Underwater Image Restoration with Removable Frequency Scaffolding
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Camera-ready version. 9 pages, 6 figures
summary: Light scattering, absorption and turbidity degrade underwater imagery through complementary frequency tendencies: large-scale, channel-dependent appearance distortions and local high-frequency detail loss. This band asymmetry motivates different forms of restoration for global colour and local structure. Our primary contribution is SandBAR, a novel unified band-asymmetric architecture for underwater image restoration. Rather than treating frequency processing as an isolated module, SandBAR organises the restoration pipeline around band asymmetry at the block, encoder and objective levels. Within this architecture, we introduce a novel band-asymmetric sandwich block with a reserved post-attention repair slot and the Split-band Parallel Asymmetric Repair Kernel (SPARK), a novel module that applies channel-aware large-support correction to the low band, which predominantly carries large-scale appearance distortions, and lightweight local refinement to the detail-bearing high band, thereby restoring global colour while preserving fine structure. To deliver the global cast to the depth at which the network represents global structure, a learnable low-frequency guidance path injects a low-pass view of the input into the deep encoder, and a three-scale spatial-frequency objective supervises the same axis throughout the decoder. Building on the reserved post-attention slot, we further introduce Post-attention Scaffold Training (PaST), a novel removable nonlinear scaffolding scheme that trains the permanent SandBAR graph under band-specific capacity and runs it at inference without that capacity. SandBAR reaches 29.89 / 28.92 / 22.77 dB on EUVP / LSUI / UIEB and establishes a new three-domain mean state of the art on the benchmark family, exceeding the strongest published result by approximately 1.0 dB. PaST adds no parameters or FLOPs at inference and preserves matched latency.

AI.tldr: 提出SandBAR，一种频带非对称的水下图像复原统一架构，在块、编码器和目标三个层面组织复原流程，显著刷新多基准SOTA。
AI.motivation: 水下光散射、吸收与浑浊对图像的影响呈现互补的频率特性：大尺度、通道相关的色彩失真与局部高频细节丢失。这种频带不对称性要求对全局颜色和局部结构采用不同的复原方式。
AI.method: 核心是频带非对称三明治块（保留注意力后修复槽）与SPARK模块：对以大幅外观失真为主的低频带做通道感知大感受野校正，对承载细节的高频带做轻量局部精修；并设计可学习低频引导路径将输入低通视图注入深层编码器，解码器上以三尺度空频目标监督；另提出可移除的Post-attention Scaffold Training（PaST）非线性脚手架训练方案。
AI.result: 在EUVP/LSUI/UIEB上分别达到29.89/28.92/22.77 dB，在基准族上建立新的三域平均SOTA，超过最强已发表结果约1.0 dB；PaST在推理时不增加参数或FLOPs且保持同等延迟。
AI.conclusion: 以频带非对称贯穿块、编码器与目标设计可有效同时恢复全局颜色与细细节，PaST提供无推理开销的训练增益。

title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
summary: Parallel Looped Transformers (PLTs) use otherwise idle decoding compute by overlapping recurrent iterations. However, vanilla PLTs scale poorly with depth: they exhibit training-loss spikes, and their quality gains shrink as more loops are added. The benefit of additional loops depends on the information available to each iteration, so we examine whether the existing computational dependencies limit effective depth scaling. We find that only the preceding in-trajectory state is passed across loop boundaries, even though completed cross-trajectory representations are already available. Based on this finding, we propose InfuseLoop, a cross-trajectory latent injection mechanism. It aggregates causally available hidden states from later prediction trajectories through lightweight attention residuals. This design preserves token-parallel training and concurrent loop execution, and requires only $O(Rd)$ additional hidden-state storage. Experiments show that InfuseLoop eliminates training-loss spikes and improves validation-loss scaling up to eight loops. At eight loops, InfuseLoop reduces perplexity by 3.4--17.1% relative to vanilla PLTs and by 10.5--37.3% relative to the non-looped baseline. It also improves average downstream accuracy by 0.84 and 1.99 percentage points over these two baselines. InfuseLoop incurs only 0.3% decoding time over vanilla PLTs and 23.3% over the non-looped baseline, while keeping the same logical KV-cache footprint as vanilla PLTs.

AI.tldr: 提出 InfuseLoop，一种跨轨迹隐状态注入机制，解决并行循环 Transformer 深度扩展差的问题。
AI.motivation: 并行循环 Transformer（PLT）利用空闲解码算力重叠循环迭代，但随循环加深出现训练损失尖峰、收益递减。作者怀疑现有计算依赖（每个迭代仅传递前一条轨迹的状态）限制了有效深度扩展。
AI.method: 诊断为循环边界仅传递前序轨迹状态，而完整的跨轨迹表示已可用。据此设计 InfuseLoop：通过轻量注意力残差，聚合后续预测轨迹中因果可用的隐状态；保持 token 并行训练与循环并发执行，仅需 O(Rd) 额外存储。
AI.result: 消除训练损失尖峰，八循环内验证损失扩展改善。八循环时困惑度较 vanilla PLT 降 3.4%–17.1%，较非循环基线降 10.5%–37.3%；下游平均准确率分别提升 0.84 与 1.99 个百分点。解码时间仅增加 0.3%（对 PLT）与 23.3%（对基线），逻辑 KV-cache 占用不变。
AI.conclusion: 跨轨迹隐状态注入能有效解锁 PLT 的深度扩展收益，且开销极小、兼容现有并行训练与缓存结构。

title: Proceedings of the 2026 XCSP3 Competition
summary: This document constitutes the proceedings of the 2026 XCSP3 Competition. The results of this competition of constraint solvers were presented at FLOC (Federated Logic Conference) 2026 Olympic Games, held in Lisbon, Portugal from 20th to 29th July, 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文是2026年XCSP3约束求解器竞赛的会议论文集，汇总了在FLOC 2026期间（2026年7月20–29日，葡萄牙里斯本）公布并展示的各约束求解器竞赛结果。
AI.motivation: XCSP3作为约束编程领域通用的建模与交换格式，需要一个标准化的竞赛平台来横向比较不同约束求解器（如CP、SAT、MIP、SMT等）在统一基准上的性能，从而推动求解器发展与评测规范的统一。
AI.method: 以XCSP3格式构建统一基准实例集，组织各求解器参赛并在相同评测规则与资源限制下运行，收集、校验并统计成绩，最终整理成竞赛论文集与结果报告。
AI.result: 竞赛结果在FLOC 2026 Olympic Games（2026年7月20–29日，里斯本）上正式公布与展示，形成涵盖各求解器表现的完整数据集与排名。
AI.conclusion: 该论文集为约束求解领域提供了权威、可复现的横向评测参考，有助于社区了解当前求解器能力边界并指导后续研究与工程选型。

title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
comment: 18 pages, 13 tables. Under review at ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle)
summary: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.

AI.tldr: 论文审计了"定位并消融LLM中承载社会偏见的注意力头"这一类方法：这些方法仅以公平性指标验证效果，却从未证明选头所用的统计量真的度量了偏见。作者在Qwen-2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B上复现并检验，发现该统计量主要被prompt身份和表面混淆（长度、标签共线）解释，实质结论（偏见集中在中后层、消融可降低不公平率）均不成立。
AI.motivation: 主流"注意力头定位—消融去偏"工作只验证消融后公平性指标是否变好，而不验证选头统计量本身是否测量偏见，存在循环论证/缺乏构念效度的问题。作者希望审计这一范式是否可靠。
AI.method: 对Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct重跑该分析：将头图（head map）与"标签无关"的响应长度图做相关性分析（ρ=-0.950/-0.768）；设计打破长度—标签耦合的干预实验（固定prompt）；分解统计量方差来源；检验层间分布及消融效果；并做互补头集的对照实验（在相反标签上评分）。
AI.result: 头图与长度图高度负相关，看似表明混淆；但固定prompt下长度仅解释1%方差，prompt身份解释64%，且排序对长度非单调。固定prompt内，公平标签、响应长度与受保护群体token出现呈φ=0.95共线（部分由标注规则定义），观测分析无法归因。实质性主张独立失败：偏见选择性在两个模型的任何参考解读下都不呈现后层集中；所测试的任何头集消融均未降低不公平率。但其补集（在相反标签上评分）可靠地破坏拒答行为（p=2.7×10⁻⁵），说明流程本身在此尺度上可检出效应。
AI.conclusion: 这类"逐头定位—消融"方法的核心统计量缺乏构念效度，其可归因性受共线性与表面混淆的限制，且没有任何同族方法做了能做出归因的实验；作者认为仍需更强的实验设计（干预而非观测）来支撑偏见定位的主张，并指出流程灵敏度本身是足够的。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Truly Understand Images? A Benchmark Beyond Commonsense Bias
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks. However, it remains unclear whether their predictions are grounded in the visual content itself or are largely driven by statistical co-occurrence patterns and commonsense correlations learned from large-scale image-text corpora. Existing vision-language benchmarks predominantly consist of samples that conform to human commonsense, allowing models to achieve strong performance by exploiting dataset priors rather than genuinely understanding image content. To address this limitation, we present ContraSense, a systematically constructed benchmark for evaluating faithful vision-language understanding. ContraSense consists of carefully curated counter-intuitive image-text pairs that deliberately violate common expectations, substantially reducing the effectiveness of statistical biases and requiring models to rely on visual evidence for reasoning. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on a diverse set of representative open- and closed-source MLLMs. The results reveal a substantial performance gap between current MLLMs and humans: even the strongest closed-source model achieves only about 60\% accuracy, compared with 96.04\% for human participants. These findings demonstrate that current MLLMs still struggle with faithful visual understanding and highlight the need for more robust multimodal reasoning grounded in image content. The ContraSense benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingLin00/ContraSense.

AI.tldr: 提出反直觉图像-文本对基准 ContraSense，揭示 MLLMs 依赖统计先验而非真正视觉理解。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言基准样本大多符合人类常识，模型可借助数据集先验与统计共现取得高分，难以判断其预测是否真正基于图像内容。
AI.method: 系统构建 ContraSense 基准，由精心筛选的反直觉图文对组成，刻意违背常见预期以削弱统计偏差，迫使模型依赖视觉证据推理；并对多种开源与闭源 MLLMs 进行全面评测。
AI.result: 当前 MLLMs 与人类存在显著差距：最强闭源模型仅约 60% 准确率，人类参与者达 96.04%，表明模型在忠实视觉理解上仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 现有 MLLMs 仍难以实现忠实视觉理解，亟需更稳健、真正以图像内容为基础的多模态推理；基准已公开。

title: Encoding, Decodability, and Use: A Five-Layer Framework for Benchmark Measurement Audits with Evidence from UAV Intent Recognition
summary: Benchmark accuracy is routinely read as evidence that a model understands the construct the benchmark measures. We propose and instantiate on AeroIntent a five-layer framework that decomposes that reading into observation, representation, decoding, use, and behaviour. The framework separates encoding, decodability, and use as distinct levels. In the instantiation, the observation layer is unreliable on 7 of the 20 Drone programs and floors the direct visual correlate of radial velocity at a 0.26\% scale change. The representation layer exposes two task-designed RGB features with nominal signals. RAFT flow radial bias reaches $r=+0.257$ ($p=0.030$), and bounding-box optical-flow divergence reaches $r=+0.203$ ($p=0.029$). No multi-feature readout gives a fold-mean test correlation above the cluster minimum detectable effect (MDE), and the largest positive global out-of-sample correlation is $r=+0.080$. The decoding layer sets the MDE at $|r|=0.599$ at the multi-feature Bonferroni threshold ($α=0.00714$, power 0.80), and the observed $r=+0.080$ has power 0.00. Two injection experiments establish the MDE's condition from both sides: aligned injections are detected at or above the simulated power, and orthogonal injections are not detected. The use layer finds accuracy consistent with program memory (program-identity 0.937/0.597/0.210) and multi-region static cues. The behaviour layer is consistent with accuracy not requiring a radial-velocity readout (appearance 0.6552 vs bounding-box trajectory 0.4080, cluster-level paired $Δ=+0.2471$, $p=0.0132$).

AI.tldr: 提出五层框架（观察、表征、解码、使用、行为）拆解“基准准确率=模型理解构念”的默认读法，并在 AeroIntent 上落地：多数层次证据不支持模型真正读取径向速度。
AI.motivation: 论文要挑战把基准准确率直接解读为“模型理解该基准所测构念”的常见做法，主张把编码、可解码性与使用区分为不同层级，逐层检验准确率背后的真实机制。
AI.method: 提出并实例化五层框架：observation（观察）、representation（表征）、decoding（解码）、use（使用）、behaviour（行为）。在 AeroIntent 数据集上做相关性分析、多特征读出与样本外测试、基于簇的最小可检测效应（MDE）与 Bonferroni 阈值下的功效计算，并做对齐/正交注入实验验证 MDE，以及行为层的簇级配对比较。
AI.result: 观察层在 20 个 Drone 程序中 7 个不可靠，径向速度的直接视觉对应量在 0.26% 尺度变化处触底。表征层仅两个任务设计的 RGB 特征有名义信号：RAFT 光流径向偏置 r=+0.257（p=0.030），边界框光流散度 r=+0.203（p=0.029）；无任何多特征读出的折均测试相关超过簇 MDE，最大全局样本外相关仅 r=+0.080。解码层 MDE 为 |r|=0.599（α=0.00714，功效 0.80），观察值 r=+0.080 功效为 0.00；注入实验从两侧验证 MDE。使用层发现准确率可由程序记忆（0.937/0.597/0.210）与多区域静态线索解释。行为层显示准确率不依赖径向速度读出（外观 0.6552 vs 边界框轨迹 0.4080，Δ=+0.2471，p=0.0132）。
AI.conclusion: 基准准确率不足以证明模型理解所测构念；在 AeroIntent 上模型的表现更可能源于程序记忆与静态外观线索，而非径向速度的编码与使用。该框架提供了可复用的、从观察到行为逐层审计基准有效性的方法。

title: Think Once, Act Fast: Cost-Effective Recursive Self-Improvement for Decision Model Harness
summary: Fast System-1 models enable responsive actions but struggle with complex or unfamiliar tasks. Large language model (LLM)-based System-2 provides strong reasoning capabilities, yet repeated invocation incurs substantial latency and computational costs. To bridge this gap, we propose JevRSI, a System-1/System-2 collaboration framework that transforms LLM reasoning into transferable decision support through recursive harness improvement. A Jev-style System-1 model enables low-latency action selection, while an asynchronous System-2 LLM develops a modular harness. The harness integrates procedures, state memory, and world models to provide decision contexts spanning the past, present, and future. Utility-driven retrieval selects modules based on both contextual relevance and their utility on previous tasks. Environmental feedback guides targeted revisions and enables recursive self-improvement. Experiments across three datasets show that JevRSI consistently improves decision quality, matching or surpassing LLM agents in several settings. It preserves low-latency execution with favorable performance-cost trade-offs. Moreover, System-2 development interventions decrease as the harness evolves, amortizing System-2 costs through continuous improvement. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/JevRSI.

AI.tldr: JevRSI是一个System-1/System-2协作框架，将LLM推理转化为可迁移的决策支持模块（harness），实现低延迟与低成本的可递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: System-1模型响应快但难处理复杂/陌生任务；System-2 LLM推理强但反复调用延迟和成本高。需兼顾两者优势。
AI.method: Jev式System-1做低延迟动作选择；异步System-2 LLM开发模块化harness（含流程、状态记忆、世界模型，提供过去/现在/未来决策上下文）；基于上下文相关性与历史效用的utility-driven检索选取模块；环境反馈指导针对性修订并实现递归自我改进。
AI.result: 三个数据集上持续提升决策质量，部分设置达到或超过LLM智能体；保持低延迟及良好性能-成本权衡；随harness演进，System-2介入减少，实现成本摊销。
AI.conclusion: JevRSI通过可递归改进的模块化harness有效桥接System-1与System-2，兼顾效率与推理能力，并通过持续自改进降低System-2开销。

title: Leveraging Segmentation Representations for Efficient Classification: A Self-Configuring Framework Based on nnU-Net
summary: We propose a self-configuring framework that extends the nnU-Net workflow to both segmentation and classification in 3D medical imaging. Building on nnU-Net's self-configuring method, the framework reuses representations learned by a segmentation model for image-level classification. Its encoder features and predicted segmentation probabilities are used by a lightweight classifier. Two information-sharing strategies are investigated. In the frozen-backbone branch, features are augmented with region-of-interest information, predicted foreground volume, and segmentation confidence. In the adaptation branch, the final encoder stage is partially fine-tuned for classification, with an auxiliary segmentation loss to preserve segmentation-related information. Additional five-fold experiments showed that more complex configurations did not consistently improve classification performance. On the public validation leaderboard, our selected framework achieved an Overall score of 0.8056. In the official FLARE 2026 Task 2 final evaluation, our framework ranked first overall, achieving the highest DSC, NSD, and AUROC across all four testing tasks, including two hidden testing tasks. Local inference measurements also remained below the challenge limits of $60 \mathrm{s}$ per case and $4 \mathrm{GB}$ GPU memory. These results demonstrate the practical value of reusing segmentation representations for classification while maintaining a simple and efficient framework.

AI.tldr: 提出一个自配置框架，将 nnU-Net 工作流扩展到3D医学影像的分割与分类任务，通过复用分割模型表示进行图像级分类，在FLARE 2026 Task 2获得第一名。
AI.motivation: 希望复用分割模型学到的表示来完成图像级分类，同时保持框架简单高效，并满足挑战赛的时间与显存限制。
AI.method: 基于nnU-Net的自配置方法，用轻量分类器消费分割模型的编码器特征与预测分割概率。研究两种信息共享策略：(1) 冻结骨干分支，特征融合ROI信息、预测前景体积与分割置信度；(2) 适配分支，部分微调最后编码器阶段并加辅助分割损失以保留分割相关信息。
AI.result: 五折实验显示更复杂配置未持续提升分类性能；公开验证榜Overall得分为0.8056；FLARE 2026 Task 2官方最终评测总排名第一，在全部四个测试任务（含两个隐藏任务）上取得最高DSC、NSD与AUROC；本地推理低于60秒/例与4GB显存限制。
AI.conclusion: 复用分割表示进行分类具有实际价值，且能保持框架简单高效；过度复杂的配置并不必然带来收益。

title: Eyes in the Update? Learning Where Rewards Land in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal post-training has moved from broad instruction tuning toward reinforcement learning for image and video reasoning, where outcome rewards can improve final-answer accuracy. Yet these rewards are assigned to complete generated trajectories, while visual evidence is used only at sparse and uneven positions inside the response. Recent work has begun to make multimodal RL more token-sensitive through grounding signals or external token-level weighting. We ask a more specific question: can the allocation of the same trajectory-level reward be inferred from the model's own multimodal computation, rather than from an auxiliary annotator, perception module, or process label? We propose Gaze-RL, a representation-driven policy optimization method that redistributes completion-level advantage through a latent reward landing field. The field is computed from internal cross-modal geometry and local predictive uncertainty, assigning larger update weight to positions that are both visually anchored and decision-bearing while remaining mean-one, so the total credit of each rollout is preserved and only its positionwise allocation changes. Gaze-RL requires no process supervision, auxiliary perception module, or architectural modification, and improves both Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 across a broad range of image and video benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Gaze-RL 提出一种表征驱动的策略优化方法，利用模型内部跨模态几何与局部预测不确定性构造"隐式奖励落点场"，将轨迹级奖励在 token 间重分配，实现无需过程监督或辅助模块的多模态 RL 细粒度信用分配。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 RL 的结果奖励仅作用于整条生成轨迹，而视觉证据只出现在稀疏、不均衡的位置；已有 token 敏感方法依赖额外定位信号、外部加权或过程标签。论文希望仅凭模型自身多模态计算推断奖励该如何分配到各位置。
AI.method: 计算由内部跨模态几何与局部预测不确定性构成的隐式奖励落点场，对"视觉锚定且决策相关"的位置赋予更大更新权重；该权重保持均值为 1，从而保留每条 rollout 的总信用、仅改变其位置分布。方法不需过程监督、辅助感知模块或结构修改。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3.5 上于广泛图像与视频基准取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级奖励的位置分配可由模型自身表征推断，无需外部标注即可实现 token 级敏感的信用分配，并与现有架构/训练流程兼容。

title: PACD: Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding for Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations in Omnimodal Large Language Models
summary: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) integrate audio, video, and text for multimodal reasoning, yet remain vulnerable to cross-modal hallucinations, where one modality improperly influences predictions about another. Existing training-free decoding methods mitigate these errors through modality perturbation or relevance-based weighting. However, due to interference from irrelevant modality cues during fusion and difficulty detecting shared errors, these methods may suppress correct unimodal predictions and allow erroneous consensus to persist. To address these limitations, we propose Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding (PACD), a training-free framework for mitigating cross-modal hallucinations. PACD comprises two complementary paths based on whether the branches reach consensus. For non-consensus cases, Relevance-Guided Candidate Arbitration identifies task-relevant unimodal evidence and selectively arbitrates between predictions using alternative candidates. For consensus cases, Provenance-Based Consensus Recovery leverages the outranking principle to evaluate the consistency and strength of layer-wise modality evidence for alternative answers, selectively resolving erroneous consensus under confidence constraints. Extensive experiments on four Omni-LLMs and five benchmarks across two tasks demonstrate the superiority of PACD. Compared to existing methods, PACD achieves up to 27.6% relative improvement over standard decoding across CMM, AVHBench, and SVHalluc for cross-modal hallucination mitigation, and an average relative improvement of 7.7% over best baseline across OmniVideoBench and FutureOmni for general audio-visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的Provenance-Aware Consensus Decoding (PACD)框架，通过"非共识-共识"双路径分别进行相关性引导的候选仲裁与基于来源的共识恢复，缓解Omni-LLM的跨模态幻觉，在多个模型和基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM在音视频文本融合推理中易产生跨模态幻觉；现有免训练解码方法受无关模态线索干扰且难以检测"共享错误"，可能压制正确的单模态预测、放任错误共识持续存在。
AI.method: PACD为免训练框架，按各分支是否达成共识分两条互补路径：1）非共识情形采用Relevance-Guided Candidate Arbitration，识别任务相关的单模态证据，并用替代候选进行选择性仲裁；2）共识情形采用Provenance-Based Consensus Recovery，借助outranking原则评估逐层模态证据对备选答案的一致性与强度，在置信度约束下选择性地纠正错误共识。
AI.result: 在4个Omni-LLM和5个基准（2类任务）上验证：相比标准解码，在CMM、AVHBench、SVHalluc上跨模态幻觉缓解最高相对提升27.6%；在OmniVideoBench、FutureOmni上通用音视频推理平均相对提升7.7%。
AI.conclusion: PACD通过区分共识/非共识场景并利用相关性证据与逐层来源信息，有效抑制跨模态幻觉，同时保持通用推理性能，且无需额外训练。

title: CoBoVLA: Decoupling Language from Action with Discrete Codes for Robust and Interpretable Robot Manipulation
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, and supplemental material included
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve high success rates on the LIBERO benchmark but remain sensitive to paraphrasing. Existing VLAs ranging from 0.6B to 7.5B parameters experience a 22-52 point performance drop on LIBERO-Para while SmolVLA exhibits an even larger decline, from 83\% to 8\%. Because most VLAs jointly learn language understanding and action generation, it is difficult to determine whether a failure originates from misunderstanding an instruction or executing it incorrectly. To address these challenges, we introduce CoBoVLA, or CodeBookVLA, a 250M-parameter VLA that decouples language understanding, planning, and control through learned discrete interpretable codes. A text encoder maps the instructions to shared step codes, which a visual planner then converts into action code sequences executed by a language-independent actor. This design improves robustness to instruction paraphrasing while allowing failures to be traced to individual stages. It also enables efficient real-time control on resource-constrained hardware by encoding instructions only once and using compact discrete representations to keep each component lightweight. CoBoVLA achieves 91.4\% success on LIBERO-Goal, compared with 82.8\% for SmolVLA, under a matched protocol, with 17 ms per control step latency. On LIBERO-Para, it achieves 81.1\% across 4,092 unseen paraphrases and 78.5\% on matched episodes, compared with 36.5\% for SmolVLA LoRA fine-tuned on paraphrases. Without two-step demonstrations, CoBoVLA completes 48.8\% of 160 free-form two-step tasks. Finally, success reaches 91\% when instructions are correctly encoded but falls to 27.2\% otherwise, identifying language understanding as the main source of remaining failures. Together, these results demonstrate that decoupling language understanding and control can improve instruction robustness while making VLA failures easier to diagnose.

AI.tldr: CoBoVLA 是一个 250M 参数的 VLA 模型，通过学习离散可解释代码将语言理解、规划与控制解耦，从而提升对指令改写的鲁棒性并便于定位失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在 LIBERO 上表现好但对指令改写敏感（0.6B–7.5B 模型在 LIBERO-Para 上掉 22–52 分，SmolVLA 从 83% 跌至 8%）；且因语言理解与动作生成联合学习，难以判断失败是理解错误还是执行错误。
AI.method: 设计三阶段解耦架构：文本编码器将指令映射为共享步骤代码，视觉规划器将其转为动作代码序列，由语言无关的执行器执行；指令仅编码一次，采用紧凑离散表示实现轻量实时控制。
AI.result: LIBERO-Goal 成功率 91.4%（SmolVLA 82.8%），控制步延迟 17 ms；LIBERO-Para 在 4092 条未见改写上 81.1%、匹配回合 78.5%（LoRA 微调的 SmolVLA 为 36.5%）；无两步演示时完成 48.8% 的自由形式两步任务；指令正确编码时成功率达 91%，否则仅 27.2%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦语言理解与控制可同时提升指令鲁棒性和失败可诊断性，剩余失败主要源于语言理解环节。

title: How Many Training Labels Are Wrong? Auditing a Fitted Model through Gradient Allocation
summary: How many labels in a training set are wrong, and which ones? The usual answers read a held-out set or the model's outputs. A held-out reading depends on how the held-out set was drawn, and an output-based reading fails once the model has fitted its wrong labels, because the loss of a fitted wrong label is small and the prediction agrees with it. We read the answer from the per-example gradients of a single trained model. Each example, together with its label, asks the network to change in a particular way. We normalise the magnitudes of its gradient into a gradient allocation and compare it with the mean allocation of every class. An example is flagged when relabelling it as its nearest other class makes its allocation fit better than under its own label, and the share of flagged examples is the reading of the noise rate. The rule has no threshold and needs no clean data, no held-out set and no further training. After the model has fitted 99-100% of its wrong labels, the allocation still separates wrong from right labels with an AUC of 0.94-0.96 on the noisiest human labels of CIFAR-10N, where a feature-space margin falls to 0.79-0.84 and the loss, the gradient norm and the self-influence of an example to 0.73-0.76. On such a fitted model, readings of the noise rate from predictions or feature margins fall to 0-6% at true rates of 8-58% on CIFAR-10 with ViT-S, while the audit reads 54-96% of the true rate, and at least 93% of the examples it counts carry wrong labels. On a briefly trained model, before the wrong labels are fitted, the reading lies within 1.7 percentage points of the true noise rate on CIFAR-10 from 0% to 58% noise. Confident learning, which trains four further models, separates wrong labels about as well (AUC 0.925-0.998 against 0.900-0.995) and mostly reads the noise rate more closely, at a lower precision. An audit of 5,000 examples takes 14 to 27 seconds on one GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依靠单个已训练模型的逐样本梯度来审计训练集标签噪声的方法：将梯度幅值归一化为"梯度分配"，与各类别平均分配比较，若改标为最近的另一类能使分配拟合更好则标记为错误标签，标记比例即为噪声率估计。
AI.motivation: 现有错误标签数量估计依赖留出集（受抽样方式影响）或模型输出（模型拟合错误标签后损失小、预测与错标一致而失效），因此需要一种不依赖干净数据、留出集或额外训练，且在模型已拟合错误标签后仍有效的审计方法。
AI.method: 从单个训练模型的逐样本梯度出发，将梯度幅值归一化为梯度分配，与每个类别的平均分配进行比较；当把样本重标为最近的其他类别时其分配拟合更优，则标记该样本为错误标签；用被标记样本占比作为噪声率读数。该方法无阈值、无需干净数据、无需留出集和再训练。
AI.result: 在模型已拟合99-100%错误标签的情况下，CIFAR-10N最难人类标签上AUC达0.94-0.96（特征空间margin降至0.79-0.84，损失、梯度范数和自影响为0.73-0.76）；在CIFAR-10+ViT-S上，预测/特征margin的噪声率读数为真实值的0-6%（真实8-58%），而本方法读到54-96%，且计数样本中≥93%确实为错标。短训练模型上（错标未被拟合前）读数与真实噪声率误差在1.7个百分点内（0-58%噪声）。与置信学习相比分离能力相近（AUC 0.900-0.995 vs 0.925-0.998），后者噪声率读数更接近但精度较低。5000样本审计单GPU耗时14-27秒。
AI.conclusion: 逐样本梯度分配提供了一种无需阈值、无需干净/留出数据、无需再训练的高效标签噪声审计手段，即便在模型已拟合错误标签后仍能可靠区分正确与错误标签并较准确估计噪声率。

title: From Ideal to Real: Integrating Language Models into Smart Home for Human-Centric IoT Safety and Security Fuzzing
summary: Integrating IoT devices into household systems offers enhanced control over living environments. However, as these devices become pervasive in critical sectors such as healthcare, transportation, and home automation, they expose inter-rule vulnerabilities that may lead to privacy breaches, data theft, and physical harm. Traditional fuzz testing methods, which often operate in simulated environments assuming ideal human decisions, fail to account for the complexities of human interactions that can influence device operations in smart homes, potentially leading to unforeseen consequences. To reveal the impact of real human decisions and discover unexpected inter-rule vulnerabilities, we introduce an enhanced version of IoT Fuzz for smart homes by integrating large language models to emulate human decision-making processes. Our novel approach adds a layer of realism and unpredictability to the testing environment, more accurately capturing the diverse and dynamic nature of human interactions in smart home settings.

AI.tldr: 提出增强版IoT Fuzz，集成大语言模型模拟人类决策，以发现智能家居中由真实人类交互触发的跨规则漏洞。
AI.motivation: IoT设备在医疗、交通、家居等关键领域普及，暴露跨规则漏洞，可能导致隐私泄露、数据窃取和人身伤害；传统模糊测试多在仿真环境、假设理想人类决策，无法反映真实人类交互对设备行为的复杂影响。
AI.method: 在IoT Fuzz基础上引入大语言模型（LLM）层，用于模拟人类决策过程，为测试环境增加真实性与不可预测性，从而更贴近智能家居中人类交互的多样性与动态性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化结果；声称该方法能更准确地刻画人类交互，并揭示真实人类决策影响下未被预期的跨规则漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM作为人类决策模拟层集成到IoT模糊测试中，可提升智能家居安全测试的真实性和漏洞发现能力。

title: SignAligner: Dual-Granularity Span Generation for Sign Language Alignment
summary: Large sign-language corpora benefit from temporal labels at two scales: subtitle spans for subtitle alignment and word spans for sign spotting. Sign spottings already locate words in time at corpus scale, but training subtitle alignment jointly on subtitle and word spans remains underexplored. We present SignAligner, a prompt-conditioned visual-language span generator that maps a sign-language video and a subtitle-sentence or target-word query to a textual start/end frame interval. It is first trained jointly on subtitle spans and word spans from sign spottings, then refined with overlap-based rewards while retaining auxiliary word examples. On the subtitle test set of the British Broadcasting Corporation-Oxford British Sign Language (BOBSL) corpus, the refined model reaches 66.68 F1@0.50 (F1 with a temporal intersection-over-union threshold of one half), the best among compared systems without external sign-video resources. This overlap-reward refinement outperforms cross-entropy continuation from the same jointly trained model. Joint training with word spans improves subtitle alignment in a pair of our generators matched in code, labels and maximum update budget. The advantage remains after both models of the pair are refined with overlap rewards. For word queries, the refined model follows the queried word, not a fixed position in the video: when the word's sign lies away from the video centre, it is far more accurate than predictions that use position alone. Together, these findings support one shared span generator refined with overlap rewards, aligning subtitles and producing word spans for human review.

AI.tldr: SignAligner 是一个提示条件化的视觉-语言时间跨度生成器，将手语视频与字幕句子或目标词查询映射为起止帧区间。它先用字幕跨度和词跨度联合训练，再用基于重叠的奖励微调，在 BOBSL 字幕测试集上达到 66.68 F1@0.50。
AI.motivation: 大型手语语料需要两个尺度的时间标签（字幕跨度用于字幕对齐，词跨度用于手语词定位）。虽然 sign spotting 已能在语料规模定位词，但利用词跨度与字幕跨度联合训练字幕对齐仍研究不足。
AI.method: 提出提示条件化的视觉-语言跨度生成器：输入手语视频加字幕句子或目标词查询，输出文本形式的起止帧区间；先联合字幕跨度与来自 sign spotting 的词跨度训练，再用基于重叠的奖励微调，并保留辅助词样本。
AI.result: 在 BOBSL 字幕测试集上取得 66.68 F1@0.50，为无外部手语视频资源对比系统中最优；重叠奖励微调优于同模型的交叉熵续训；在代码、标签与更新预算匹配的生成器对中，词跨度联合训练提升字幕对齐，且在双方都奖励微调后仍保持优势；对词查询，模型能跟随所查询词而非固定视频位置。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用单一共享跨度生成器加重叠奖励微调，同时完成字幕对齐与生成供人工审核的词跨度。

title: Escaping Latent Traps by Remembering: Training-Free Episodic Kernel Repulsion for World-Model Planning
summary: Latent world models plan towards a goal image by minimising the distance between predicted and goal latents. This distance is not geodesic: it has local minima, latent traps, behind walls, at corners and in dead ends, and memoryless receding-horizon replanning keeps the agent in them, revisiting states far from the goal. We propose Episodic Kernel Repulsion (EKR), a training-free cost term that penalises candidate plans by a top-$k$ Gaussian kernel to a novelty-gated memory of the latents the agent has actually visited, rescaled by the current base cost so that its strength is comparable across models. Across two JEPA world models and four benchmarks, EKR raises average success from 31.8% to 46.7% (LeWM) and from 54.7% to 64.0% (H-JEPA) with the same model, planner and budget. Same-memory counterfactuals show that, in most settings, EKR pushes plans away from visited states, in navigation, often at a higher base cost; stuck episodes and revisits drop accordingly. In seven of eight settings it matches or exceeds $4\times$ samples at $0.8$--$1.5\times$ compute. Without tuning, it transfers to DINO-WM with CEM: $+6.7$ and $+19.3$ points on official and longer-goal Wall tasks, and from 44.7% to 100.0% and from 21.0% to 32.0% on long-horizon PointMaze and Push-T.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的EKR代价项，用情节记忆+高斯核排斥惩罚重复访问的latent，缓解世界模型规划中的latent陷阱与局部极小，显著提升多模型多任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型通过最小化预测latent与目标latent的距离来规划，但该距离非测地、存在局部极小（墙后、拐角、死胡同的"latent陷阱"），无记忆的滚动时域重规划会让智能体困在其中并反复访问远离目标的状态。
AI.method: EKR（Episodic Kernel Repulsion）：无需训练的代价项，对候选计划施加基于top-k高斯核的排斥项，核作用于经过新颖性门控的"智能体实际访问过的latent"情节记忆；并按当前基础代价重缩放，使排斥强度在不同模型间可比。仅叠加在原有模型、规划器与预算之上。
AI.result: 在两个JEPA世界模型和四个基准上，平均成功率LeWM由31.8%升至46.7%，H-JEPA由54.7%升至64.0%（同模型、同规划器、同预算）。同记忆反事实实验显示EKR将计划推离已访问状态，导航中常以更高基础代价换取；卡住与重访显著下降。八个设置中七个达到或超过4倍采样（0.8–1.5倍计算）。无需调参即可迁移到DINO-WM+CEM：官方与长目标Wall任务+6.7和+19.3分；长时程PointMaze 44.7%→100.0%，Push-T 21.0%→32.0%。
AI.conclusion: 一种简单的、训练无关、可即插即用的记忆性排斥代价能有效打破潜空间规划的局部极小与重访循环，并以更低计算优于暴力增加采样，且具备跨模型、跨规划器、跨任务的零调参迁移能力。

title: RehearsalBench: Can AI Predict What Happens When You Change a Company?
summary: Organizations increasingly ask AI systems what will happen if they change how they operate: which work to automate, which team to resize, what a voice agent will do to waiting times. We introduce RehearsalBench, a benchmark that measures whether AI models can diagnose an operation, choose an intervention, and forecast its consequences. Each model is placed in a simulated bank contact center fitted to real call-level records, sees only what a manager would see, and submits a plan and forecasts that are then played out across 200 seeded futures and three plausible versions of the organization. Decisions are scored in dollars at the stakeholders' stated valuations; forecasts are scored on the effect of each change relative to doing nothing. Ten models made 280 attempts across 14 organizations. The best model, GPT-6 Astra, improved on doing nothing by 6.8% of the no-change cost and made 77% less forecast error than a forecaster who always predicts no effect. On average, every model forecast the direction of every specified effect correctly, but models erred on the size of the same effects in the same direction, overstating a voice agent's effect on repeat contacts about five-fold. No model ever recommended holding off when doing nothing was the right choice. To test external validity, twelve models forecast 33 real organizational changes with known outcomes. Under verdict rules fixed in advance, the benchmark's forecast ranking agreed with the real-world ranking (Spearman $ρ= 0.92$, 95% lower bound 0.50). We report the result alongside an inconclusive first test, the analysis choices made after outcomes were seen, and evidence that part of the agreement reflects how well models size their uncertainty.

AI.tldr: RehearsalBench 是一个评估 AI 模型能否"诊断运营问题、选择干预、预测后果"的基准：模型在拟合真实通话数据的模拟银行联络中心中提交方案与预测，经 200 个随机未来与 3 个组织版本推演，以美元计分。10 个模型 14 个组织共 280 次尝试，最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra 比"什么都不做"改善 6.8% 成本、预测误差比无效应基线低 77%；但所有模型普遍高估效应幅度（语音代理对重复联系效应约高估 5 倍），且从未在应当不作为时建议暂缓。外部效度检验中 12 个模型预测 33 个真实组织变革，排名与真实世界一致（Spearman ρ=0.92）。
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地用 AI 回答"改变运营方式会发生什么"（自动化哪些工作、裁减哪个团队、语音代理对等待时间的影响），但缺乏衡量模型能否端到端诊断运营、选择干预并预测后果的评测手段。现有基准缺少真实组织约束、多未来推演与利益相关者货币化评分，也缺少与现实结果的对照。
AI.method: 构建 RehearsalBench：在贴合真实通话级记录的模拟银行联络中心中，模型仅见管理者可见信息，提交方案与预测，并在 200 个固定种子的未来及 3 个合理组织版本上推演。决策以利益相关者声明的估值折算美元评分；预测按各改变相对于"不变"的效应评分。另用 12 个模型预测 33 个结果已知的真实组织变革做外部效度检验，判定规则预先固定。
AI.result: 10 个模型 14 个组织共 280 次尝试。最佳模型 GPT-6 Astra 比无变化成本改善 6.8%，预测误差比"永远预测无效应"的基线低 77%。平均而言所有模型对每个设定效应的方向判断正确，但同向系统性偏差幅度：语音代理对重复联系的效应高估约 5 倍。没有模型在"不作为"为最优时建议暂缓。外部检验中预测排名与真实世界排名一致（Spearman ρ=0.92，95% 下界 0.50），并报告了此前一次不确定的首测、结果已知后所作的分析选择，以及一致性的部分来源在于模型对不确定性的标定能力。
AI.conclusion: AI 模型已能正确判断运营干预的效应方向，但在效应大小的定量估计上存在系统性同向偏差，且缺乏"按兵不动"的判断能力。基准排名与现实组织变革结果具有较强外部一致性，但该一致性部分取决于不确定性标定，需结合事后分析选择谨慎解读。

title: SpatialMind: Adaptive Multi-Level Geometric Fusion for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate promising capabilities in 2D visual understanding, yet remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Recent studies explore integrating 3D reconstruction models into MLLMs. However, these approaches either use a single geometric granularity across all tasks or adopt a fixed multi-level fusion scheme, regardless of task-specific reasoning requirements. Through systematic experiments on multi-level geometric fusion, we find that spatial tasks at different cognitive levels (e.g., distance estimation vs. route planning) require geometric representations of different granularities, revealing that fixed fusion cannot accommodate diverse spatial reasoning requirements. To bridge this gap, we propose SpatialMind, a task-adaptive framework for dynamically integrating multi-level geometric representations. SpatialMind employs GeoFus, a multi-layer geometric fusion module built around a gating network jointly conditioned on textual instructions, visual semantics, and geometric representations. This network adaptively modulates the contributions of shallow, intermediate, and deep geometric features across the layers of the LLM decoder. Furthermore, we introduce a negative-entropy regularization loss to mitigate gate collapse. Gate visualizations indicate that GeoFus adapts geometric granularity to task requirements. Experiments demonstrate that SpatialMind achieves competitive performance across spatial benchmarks, attaining a state-of-the-art score of 72.3 on VSI-Bench. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhaosb-star/SpatialMind.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialMind，通过任务自适应的多层几何特征门控融合（GeoFus）提升 MLLM 的三维空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有将 3D 重建模型集成进 MLLM 的方法要么对所有任务只用单一几何粒度，要么采用固定的多层级融合方案；作者通过实验发现不同认知层级的空间任务需要不同粒度的几何表征，固定融合无法满足多样化需求。
AI.method: SpatialMind 框架包含 GeoFus 模块：以文本指令、视觉语义和几何表征共同作为条件的门控网络，自适应调节浅层、中层、深层几何特征在 LLM 解码器各层的贡献；并引入负熵正则损失以缓解门控坍缩。
AI.result: 门控可视化显示 GeoFus 能按任务需求调整几何粒度；在空间基准上取得有竞争力的表现，VSI-Bench 达到 72.3 的 SOTA 分数。
AI.conclusion: 任务自适应的几何粒度动态融合优于固定融合方案，是多模态大模型三维空间推理的有效方向；代码已开源。

title: Right Labels, Wrong Reasons: Signed Feature Attribution for Multi-Label Explainability
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted at the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027), Gold Coast, Australia, February 2027
summary: When a multi-label classifier assigns the right labels, it may do so for the wrong reasons. Diffuse feature combinations may vary across classifier families and lack a dominant feature. This paper proposes FLEX (Fisher LDA Explainer), a global surrogate that fits a single direct multi-label Fisher LDA over the full binary label matrix, producing signed feature attribution lists for each label in a single coherent coordinate system. Across the evaluated benchmarks and classifier families, FLEX reproduces the black box's predictions with consistently high fidelity. Pooling covariance across labels outperforms a per-label alternative on most datasets, with the advantage growing largest where labels are numerous and positive examples are scarce. FLEX's fidelity-complexity Pareto curve is monotonically increasing, giving practitioners a predictable path to higher-fidelity explanations as more features are used, and its in-sample fidelity matches or leads Binary Relevance alternatives once a modest feature budget is allowed. The magnitude of each discriminant weight vector bounds its label's separability, flagging labels that may be predicted correctly for the wrong reasons. The evaluated classifiers largely agree on which predictions to make, but reach those decisions through different feature subsets when no single feature dominates.

AI.tldr: 提出FLEX，一个全局代理解释器：对完整二值标签矩阵拟合单个直接多标签Fisher LDA，为每个标签生成统一坐标系下的带符号特征归因，并以判别权重模长量化标签可分性。
AI.motivation: 多标签分类器即使给出正确标签，也可能基于错误的特征理由；而弥散型特征组合在不同分类器族之间变化大、缺乏主导特征，导致解释困难、跨模型难以比较。
AI.method: FLEX（Fisher LDA Explainer）作为全局代理模型，直接在完整二值标签矩阵上拟合一个多标签Fisher LDA，跨标签共享协方差以获得单一一致坐标系的逐标签带符号特征归因；并用每个判别权重向量的模长衡量该标签的可分性。
AI.result: 在所评估的基准与分类器族上，FLEX复现黑箱预测的保真度持续偏高；跨标签池化协方差在多数数据集上优于逐标签方案，且优势在标签多、正例稀缺时最大；保真度-复杂度Pareto曲线单调递增，样本内保真度在适度特征预算下持平或领先Binary Relevance方法；权重模长可标记"正确但理由错误"的标签。
AI.conclusion: FLEX为多标签模型的全局解释提供了统一、可调的框架；结果表明被评估的分类器在"做什么预测"上大致一致，但在无主导特征时通过不同特征子集达成决策。

title: SciWorkBench: A Benchmark for Real Scientific Workflows
summary: Language models are increasingly being used as agents capable of planning and executing projects, as well as refining their actions through feedback. This shift raises a question: can current agents complete projects like real scientists?
