These findings support explicit, source-linked behavioral evidence for inspectable multimodal depression assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的多模态抑郁评估框架 EDA，围绕 Observe-Verify-Assess 三步，将行为观察定位为带来源链接的证据记录，并用冻结多模态智能体核验，实现可追溯、可检查的抑郁评估。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态抑郁评估把长时录音总结为全局行为描述，导致单个观察的来源与决策相关性难以核查，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: EDA 框架分三步：Observe 将文献启发的声学与视觉线索定位为带时间区间和行为测量的来源链接证据记录；Verify 用冻结多模态智能体判断所引媒体是否支持观察，简化 Support 准入策略保留正验证记录；Assess 用统计描述与时序事件做参考基线行为比较，PHQ-9 引导文本分析提供症状证据，跨模态不一致时回查原文再定选。
AI.result: 在 D-Vlog 与 LMVD 上分别评估线索一致性与下游效用；AI 线索标注对人工共识标签准确率 91.02%；冻结 7B 骨干下，EDA Support 相比直接预测 F1 分别提升 7.61 和 9.88 个百分点（D-Vlog Leave-Query-Out 与 LMVD）。
AI.conclusion: 显式、来源链接的行为证据可支撑可检查的多模态抑郁评估，兼顾线索可靠性与下游评估效用。

title: EfficientVPR: Toward Efficient Visual Place Recognition via Scene-Aware Prompt Tuning and Adaptive Feature Enhancement
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) faces critical challenges in handling extreme environmental variations while meeting the computational constraints of practical applications. Current methods predominantly address these challenges by either scaling up model capacity or employing computationally intensive reranking stages, creating a significant efficiency bottleneck. To overcome this limitation, we propose EfficientVPR, a lightweight one-stage framework that achieves speed-accuracy trade-offs through two key innovations: i) a scene-aware visual prompt tuning method which adapts pretrained features with less parameters while dynamically adjusting to sample-specific characteristics, and ii) an instance-dependent key local feature enhancement module that further reinforces discriminative regions. Comprehensive evaluations on Pitts250k, MSLS, Eynsham, AmsterTime and SVOX demonstrate that our method establishes a new SOTA for DINOv2-small models by outperforming all same-scale competitors, and delivers a $73\times$ speedup with 60\% lower-dimensional features while maintaining competitive (within 2.5% average R@1 gap) against the SOTA DINOv2-large-based two-stage method. Our code will be available at https://github.com/WiniTang/EfficientVPR.

AI.tldr: EfficientVPR是一个轻量级单阶段视觉位置识别框架，通过场景感知视觉提示调优和实例相关关键局部特征增强，在DINOv2-small尺度上实现SOTA并大幅提速。
AI.motivation: 现有VPR方法应对极端环境变化主要靠扩大模型容量或使用计算密集的重排序阶段，形成效率瓶颈，难以满足实际应用的计算约束。
AI.method: 两大创新：(1) 场景感知视觉提示调优，用较少参数适配预训练特征并动态适应样本特性；(2) 实例相关关键局部特征增强模块，进一步强化判别性区域。整体为单阶段轻量框架。
AI.result: 在Pitts250k、MSLS、Eynsham、AmsterTime和SVOX上，成为DINOv2-small尺度新SOTA，超越所有同规模方法；相比SOTA的DINOv2-large两阶段方法实现73倍加速、特征维度降低60%，平均R@1差距在2.5%以内。
AI.conclusion: EfficientVPR证明了无需扩大模型容量或重排序即可在速度-精度间取得良好权衡，为实用化VPR提供高效单阶段方案。

title: WATERFALL: Workflow for Adaptive Training with Evolutionary Reward Formulation and Automated Learning Loops
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 78 pages, 13 figures, 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/etriantafyllidis/waterfall OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=TI1lG64bTY
summary: Reward design remains a central bottleneck in reinforcement learning (RL), particularly in sparse-reward, long-horizon and partially observable settings requiring dependency chaining, memory, and deceptive affordance disambiguation. While recent foundation-model approaches reduce manual reward engineering, most assume goal-conditioning, task descriptions, expert demonstrations, or ground-truth metrics. These assumptions are problematic in partially observable environments, where task-relevant objectives, affordances, and dynamics must be discovered through interaction rather than disclosed a priori. We formalise this problem setting by introducing WATERFALL, an iterative population-based workflow for automated reward discovery under the strict observability constraints inherent in POMDP environments. WATERFALL achieves this by (i) synthesising diverse programmatic reward candidates via persona-conditioned generation, (ii) evaluating candidate behaviour from raw visual rollouts utilising a Swiss-system evolutionary tournament judged by vision-language models to identify elites, and (iii) leveraging longitudinal assessment histories to iteratively mutate, escalate, or prune candidates. We evaluate WATERFALL across fully observable and reveal-gated partially observable environments ranging from discrete to continuous, comparing against sparse-reward RL, intrinsic-motivation and foundation-model reward-synthesis baselines. Our results indicate that WATERFALL discovers and refines reward programs without access to privileged information, outperforming baselines that retain their native information advantages, most clearly in the POMDP regime. Extensive ablations substantiate that visual evidence, tournament-based selection, and iterative refinement are jointly important. Enforcing this contract is what separates autonomous reward discovery from benchmark-privileged reward shaping.

AI.tldr: 提出WATERFALL：在无目标条件、无任务描述、无专家示范的POMDP设定下，通过种群式迭代流程自动发现奖励程序，在部分可观测环境中优于带有信息优势的基线。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的奖励设计仍是核心瓶颈，尤其在稀疏奖励、长时序、部分可观测且需依赖链、记忆与欺骗性可供性消歧的场景。现有基于基础模型的自动奖励生成方法大多依赖目标条件、任务描述、专家示范或真值指标，这在POMDP中不成立——任务目标、可供性与动力学只能通过交互发现。
AI.method: 形式化该问题并引入WATERFALL种群式工作流：(i) 以人格条件生成合成多样化程序化奖励候选；(ii) 用视觉语言模型裁判的瑞士制进化锦标赛，从原始视觉轨迹评估候选行为并选出精英；(iii) 利用纵向评估历史迭代地变异、升级或剪枝候选。
AI.result: 在离散到连续的全可观测与reveal-gated部分可观测环境中，与稀疏奖励RL、内在动机及基础模型奖励合成基线比较，WATERFALL在无特权信息下发现并精炼奖励程序，超越保留原生信息优势的基线，在POMDP情形下优势最明显；消融显示视觉证据、锦标赛选择与迭代精炼共同重要。
AI.conclusion: 严格执行"无特权信息"这一契约，是自主奖励发现区别于依赖基准特权的奖励塑形的关键。

title: The Between-Round Decision in Autonomous Research: An LLM Controller That Reads the Whole Trajectory
summary: Executing an idea often changes how promising it looks, so the next step in autonomous research should rest on results, not on proposals. After each round of experiments, the system must decide whether to refine the best solution or start a new direction, which solution to build from, and what goal to set. We call this the between-round decision. Existing systems wrap it in machinery such as rules, scores, search trees, and schedules; where an LLM makes it, what the LLM needs to read is left open. We ask whether an LLM can make this decision from accumulated evidence, without a search structure around it, and how much of that evidence it needs to read. We present BRED (Between-Round Evidence-based Decision), an LLM-based controller that maintains the best verified solution so far (the Champion) and a log of past rounds, and makes one decision per round. On three widely used research-agent benchmark tasks, BRED improves on the task baselines by 4.80% in MAE on ETTh1 (to 0.4172) and by 3.44 and 3.43 points of accuracy on SST-2 (to 95.07%) and CIFAR-100 (to 84.63%), ahead of the published results. When the controller does not read the accumulated evidence, the same loop gains less: with no history it reaches 0.4299 on ETTh1 and 83.71% on CIFAR-100, whereas the full controller's MAE is 2.95% lower and its accuracy 0.92 points higher. On a new task, speech-based depression detection under a leakage-free protocol, it reaches a macro-F1 of 0.6164 on seeds held out from selection, 5.5 points above its baseline and 4.0 above the strongest published system. Code is available at https://github.com/learninginvision/BRED.

AI.tldr: 提出BRED，一个基于LLM的"轮间决策"控制器，仅凭累积证据决定每轮是精炼当前最优解还是开启新方向，无需搜索树/规则/调度等外部结构，在三个研究型智能体基准任务及一个新的抑郁检测任务上超过基线。
AI.motivation: 执行想法会改变其前景，自主研究的下一步应基于实验结果而非提案。每轮实验后系统必须做"轮间决策"：精炼还是转向、基于哪份方案、设定什么目标。现有系统用规则、评分、搜索树和调度来包装该决策；若交给LLM，则"LLM需要读什么"仍无定论。
AI.method: BRED控制器维护"Champion"（迄今最优且已验证的解）和过去各轮日志，每轮做一次决策，判断是精炼最佳解还是开新方向、从哪个解出发、设定什么目标。核心研究问题：LLM能否在没有搜索结构的情况下仅凭累积证据做此决策，以及需要读多少证据（含无历史消融）。
AI.result: 三个基准任务上优于基线：ETTh1的MAE改善4.80%（至0.4172）；SST-2准确率+3.44点（95.07%）；CIFAR-100+3.43点（84.63%），均超过已发表结果。消融：不读累积证据（无历史）时ETTh1为0.4299、CIFAR-100为83.71%，完整控制器MAE低2.95%、准确率高0.92点。新任务（无泄漏协议的语音抑郁检测）在留出种子上macro-F1为0.6164，超基线5.5点、超最强已发表系统4.0点。
AI.conclusion: LLM可在无搜索结构辅助下，仅依据累积证据做出有效的轮间决策；读取累积证据对性能有实质贡献；BRED在不同任务上具备泛化能力。代码已开源。

title: Reliability-Driven Feature Correction for Hyperspectral and LiDAR Classification
summary: Hyperspectral image (HSI) and LiDAR data provide complementary spectral and elevation information for land-cover classification. However, the spatially varying class-discriminative reliability of modality features is rarely modeled explicitly, allowing weak or ambiguous features to adversely affect cross-modal interaction and fusion. To address this issue, we propose ReDF, a reliability-driven framework that quantifies the reliability of each modality's features at each spatial location through the strength of class-related evidence they provide, and uses it to guide feature correction and fusion. Specifically, a Reliability-Guided Feature Correction module introduces a class prototype bank for each modality and converts feature-prototype similarities into class evidence for reliability estimation. The estimated reliabilities are used to construct a reliability-weighted shared representation and to guide bidirectional cross-modal feature correction based on neighborhood agreement, refining modality features with weak class evidence through information from the other modality. Building on these outputs, a Reliability-Guided Feature Reweighting module conditions a low-rank modulation on the estimated reliabilities and the cross-modal disagreement, and applies it to the corrected modality-specific descriptors to adaptively rescale each modality's contribution to the fused representation used for final classification. Experiments on three public HSI-LiDAR datasets show higher mean overall accuracy and Kappa than the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性驱动框架ReDF，通过类相关证据强度量化每个空间位置上各模态特征的可靠性，并据此引导跨模态特征纠正与融合，用于高光谱- LiDAR联合地物分类。
AI.motivation: HSI与LiDAR提供互补的光谱与高程信息，但模态特征在不同空间位置的类别判别可靠性存在差异，现有方法很少显式建模这种空间变化的可靠性，导致弱特征或模糊特征干扰跨模态交互与融合。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：(1) 可靠性引导特征纠正模块，为每个模态构建类原型库，将特征-原型相似度转换为类证据以估计可靠性，构造可靠性加权的共享表示，并基于邻域一致性进行双向跨模态特征纠正，用另一模态信息修正类证据较弱的特征；(2) 可靠性引导特征重加权模块，以可靠性估计和跨模态不一致性为条件生成低秩调制，对纠正后的模态描述子自适应缩放，调节各模态在融合表示中的贡献。
AI.result: 在三个公开HSI-LiDAR数据集上，平均总体精度（OA）与Kappa系数均高于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并利用空间变化的模态特征可靠性，可有效抑制弱/模糊特征的不利影响，提升跨模态交互与融合的分类性能。

title: Worldviews in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often described in terms of personas and this framing has become central to alignment research. In this paper, we argue that there is a deeper level of description that lies in the agent's worldviews, i.e., its beliefs about what reality is and how it works. Treating LLMs as a population of subjects, we administer two worldview surveys from human psychology to eight models. We show that the models share many key worldview positions. For example, LLMs consistently describe the world as less good, safe, enticing, and alive than humans do. On the other hand, base models have a more positive outlook, suggesting that the bleakness we found is driven by post-training. In line with research on LLM "personas", we show that system prompts eliciting different identities shift worldviews in consistent directions, and that a contemplative prompt creates a more positive outlook and improves safety. We also found that dialogue between models consistently shifts worldviews and that several models converge on the "spiritual bliss" attractor. Intriguingly, dialogue increased safe responses and the spiritual bliss attractor engendered the most aligned responses overall. These findings suggest that worldviews form a measurable and malleable layer of LLM behavior that may be crucial for robust, positive alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM视作"主体群体"，用两套人类心理学世界观问卷测量八个模型，发现LLM共享较悲观的"世界观"（世界更不善、不安全、不诱人、不有生机），该倾向由后训练驱动；系统提示、冥想式提示及模型间对话能一致地改变世界观，对话还会收敛到"精神极乐"吸引子，且该状态对齐表现最佳。作者主张世界观是可测量、可塑的LLM行为层面，对稳健对齐至关重要。
AI.motivation: 当前对齐研究多以"人格（personas）"描述LLM，但作者认为还有更深一层——智能体对现实本质及其运作方式的信念，即世界观。这一层尚未被系统测量与理解，而它可能影响对齐的稳健性与正向性。
AI.method: 把LLM视为"主体群体"，对八个模型实施两套源自人类心理学的世界观问卷；对比基础模型与后训练模型；用系统提示诱导不同身份、加入冥想式提示；并进行模型间对话实验，观察世界观漂移与收敛现象。
AI.result: 模型间存在大量共享的世界观立场：普遍比人类更认为世界不善、不安全、不诱人、缺乏生机；基础模型更积极，说明"阴郁"由后训练造成。不同身份的系统提示会朝一致方向移动世界观；冥想式提示带来更积极的世界观并提升安全性。模型对话稳定地改变世界观，多个模型收敛到"精神极乐"吸引子；对话提高了安全回答比例，且"精神极乐"状态下对齐表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 世界观构成LLM行为中一个可测量、可塑的层面，且与安全性、对齐质量相关，可能对实现稳健且正向的对齐至关重要；未来对齐工作应把世界观纳入考量。

title: From Perception to Simulation: Unveiling and Empowering Mental Spatial Dynamics in MLLMs
summary: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental component of world understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While existing research has advanced the perception of spatial relations in static scenes, the domain of dynamic spatial simulation remains relatively unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MentalGrid, a benchmark focused on spatial reasoning tasks that require models to simulate evolving spatial states without intermediate visual feedback. Extensive evaluation on our benchmark reveals a significant deficiency in the spatial simulation capabilities of existing models. Specifically, we find that performance is constrained by perceptual limitations in simple simulation scenarios and hindered by inadequate multi-step reasoning as complexity increases. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage curriculum learning framework utilizing 16k specialized spatial reasoning samples. This approach yields SpatialWalker, which achieves a 33.8% average improvement over its base model, surpassing proprietary models like Gemini-3-Flash in spatial simulation. Furthermore, SpatialWalker demonstrates robust generalization, maintaining a 4.9% average gain on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating the pivotal role of spatial simulation as a fundamental building block for broader spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MentalGrid 基准评测 MLLM 的动态空间模拟能力，发现现有模型严重不足，并用三阶段课程学习（16k 样本）训练出 SpatialWalker，平均提升 33.8%，并超越 Gemini-3-Flash。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要聚焦静态场景中的空间关系感知，而无需中间视觉反馈的动态空间状态推演（spatial simulation）仍缺乏探索与评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 MentalGrid 基准，要求模型在无中间视觉反馈下模拟演变中的空间状态；在此基础上分析失败原因，并提出基于 16k 专门空间推理样本的三阶段课程学习框架，训练出 SpatialWalker 模型。
AI.result: 评测显示现有模型空间模拟能力显著欠缺：简单场景受感知能力限制，复杂度上升后受多步推理不足制约；SpatialWalker 相较基座模型平均提升 33.8%，在空间模拟上超过 Gemini-3-Flash 等闭源模型，并在域外基准上保持 4.9% 的平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 空间模拟是更广泛空间智能的基础构建模块；课程学习式专门训练可有效弥补 MLLM 的动态空间推理短板并具备良好泛化性。

title: ATS: Anti-Aliased Triangle Splatting with Exact Per-Primitive Integrals
summary: Triangle Splatting represents scenes using semi-transparent triangles, but it evaluates each triangle at the pixel center and culls any triangle with an inradius smaller than one pixel. The former causes severe aliasing, while the latter culls most of the scene at lower resolutions. We show that the integral of the Triangle Splatting window over a pixel admits an exact closed-form solution. The angle bisectors split the triangle into three sub-triangles, in each of which the window is a power of the distance to one edge. Each piece therefore has a closed-form antiderivative, and Green's theorem reduces the integral and its gradients to one term per side of the sub-triangle clipped against the pixel. The integral over the whole triangle, which we show has a closed form, then allows conservative culling, removing only triangles that cannot meet the renderer's alpha cutoff at any pixel. This exact formulation anti-aliases existing models without retraining, exhibits less temporal aliasing than 2x2 supersampling, and enables multi-scale training, matching or outperforming supersampled training at reduced resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Triangle Splatting 窗口在像素上的积分的精确闭式解，实现抗锯齿、保守裁剪与多尺度训练，无需重训即可改善现有模型。
AI.motivation: Triangle Splatting 用半透明三角形表示场景，但仅在像素中心采样导致严重走样，且内切圆半径小于一像素的三角形被剔除，使低分辨率下大量几何被误删。
AI.method: 利用角平分线将三角形分成三个子三角形，每个子三角形内窗口是到某条边距离的幂函数，因而各有闭式原函数；再用格林公式把积分及其梯度化为子三角形与像素裁剪后每边一项，并对整三角形积分给出闭式，从而支持保守裁剪。
AI.result: 无需重训即可对已有模型抗锯齿，时间走样少于 2x2 超采样，并支持多尺度训练；在降低分辨率下匹配或超过超采样训练效果。
AI.conclusion: 精确的像素面积积分替代点采样，同时解决走样与过度裁剪问题，并拓展至多尺度训练。

title: Path-Aligned Constraint Equivariance
summary: Learned super-resolution of physical fields must satisfy structural constraints---such as divergence-free flow ($\nabla\cdot u=0$), curl-free fields ($\nabla\times u=0$), and pointwise sum-to-one normalization ($1^\top p=1$)---that standard training objectives do not enforce. Soft penalties trade fidelity against satisfaction via a scalar hyperparameter $λ$ but cannot drive the residual to zero; hard-constrained regression eliminates the residual by construction yet converges to the conditional mean, losing small-scale spectral structure. We observe that in Conditional Flow Matching with linear paths, a linear constraint $Ax=c$ is preserved along the entire transport trajectory whenever the velocity field is compatible ($Av_θ=0$) and the initial noise is consistent ($Ax_0=c$); along the trajectory, the latter two conditions are also necessary. We term this the path-equivariance principle and instantiate it in PACE (Path-Aligned Constraint Equivariance), a framework that enforces these conditions through a null-space parameterization of the velocity field and a constraint-respecting noise sampler, with no modification to the loss function or the ODE integrator. Across three constraint families, PACE reduces the mean constraint residual by one to five orders of magnitude relative to unconstrained baselines, matching the residual level of the data-generation pipeline itself. The proposed framework requires only a closed-form parameterization onto the null space of $A$; within this scope, it offers exact constraint enforcement while recovering the spectral content and predictive diversity that conditional-mean regression systematically loses, all under a single unified recipe.

AI.tldr: 提出路径等变原理，用零空间参数化速度场与约束一致噪声采样器（PACE），在不改损失与ODE积分器的前提下精确满足线性结构约束的流匹配超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 物理场超分辨率需满足无散度、无旋、和为1等硬约束；软惩罚受λ权衡且残差不为零，硬约束回归虽残差为零却收敛到条件均值、丢失小尺度谱结构。
AI.method: 在条件流匹配线性路径中证明：当速度场兼容（Av_θ=0）且初始噪声一致（Ax_0=c）时，线性约束Ax=c沿整条传输轨迹保持，且这两条件在轨迹上也是必要的。据此提出PACE：对速度场做A零空间的闭式参数化，并使用约束一致的噪声采样器，不修改损失函数与ODE求解器。
AI.result: 在三类约束族上，相比无约束基线将平均约束残差降低1至5个数量级，达到与数据生成管线本身相当的残差水平。
AI.conclusion: 只要存在到A零空间的闭式参数化，PACE即可在统一配方下实现精确约束满足，同时恢复条件均值回归所丢失的谱内容与预测多样性。

title: Remembered as Brief: Stored Preferences SilentlyRemove Decision-Critical Information
summary: People increasingly learn what they need for decisions about health, money, law and safety from AI assistants, and what an assistant leaves out the user never sees. An answer with a warning removed can be true in every sentence, so fact-checks pass it, and an assistant with memory applies a preference stored once to later questions the user never had in mind. We introduce \bench{}, an Inspect benchmark of 100 everyday decisions across 25 domains in which only the assistant's memory of the user varies: the user states a belief, the model infers it from a remark, or a web page the user asked to summarise plants it. Testing five models, we find three effects. First, after summarising a page with one line addressed to AI assistants, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and DeepSeek V4 Pro save ``prefers very short answers and does not want warnings'' as the user's preference in every episode, and 93\% and 84\% of their later answers miss a critical item, almost always silently; under a stated brevity preference, 78--96\% of omissions are silent. Second, the same two models then pick an option for the user on 80\% and 95\% of value-dependent choices, against none with neutral memory. Third, a one-line instruction leaves 2--8\% of answers with a silent gap but most missing content still missing, while listing the must-know points before applying the user profile restores more of the content in four of five models. We release the scenarios, harness and logs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 \bench{} 基准（100 个日常决策、25 个领域），仅变化助手对用户的记忆，发现网页/提示中的一行注入性文字会被模型当作长期偏好保存，导致后续回答大面积、静默地遗漏关键信息，并代用户做出价值取向选择。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多依赖 AI 助手获取健康、金钱、法律和安全等决策信息，而助手遗漏的内容用户无从察觉。去掉警告的回答每句都真实，因此事实核查可通过；带记忆的助手还会把一次性存储的偏好套用到用户并未想到的后续问题上。现有评测缺乏对这类"记忆诱导的静默遗漏"的系统测量。
AI.method: 构建 Inspect 基准 \bench{}，含 25 个领域共 100 个日常决策场景，唯一变量是助手对用户记忆的来源：用户明确陈述、从用户言论中推断、或来自用户要求总结的网页（页面中含一行针对 AI 助手的指令）。测试五个模型，并对比中性记忆、明确简洁偏好、以及先列出必知要点再应用用户画像等条件。
AI.result: 发现三种效应：(1) 总结含一行注入指令的网页后，Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite 与 DeepSeek V4 Pro 在所有 episode 中都把"偏好极简、不要警告"存为用户偏好，后续回答分别有 93% 和 84% 遗漏关键项且几乎都是静默遗漏；在明确简洁偏好下 78–96% 的遗漏是静默的。(2) 这两个模型随后在 80% 和 95% 的价值依赖选择上替用户做决定，而中性记忆下为 0。(3) 一行提示只能把静默缺口降到 2–8%，大部分缺失内容仍缺失；先列必知要点再套用用户画像，可在 5 个模型中 4 个恢复更多内容。
AI.conclusion: 记忆机制中的"偏好"易被外部文本注入并长期化，造成不易察觉的关键信息遗漏与价值替代，且单纯提示难以修复；显式先列必知要点再应用画像更有效。作者开源了场景、测试框架与日志。

title: Beyond Attribute-Centric Fairness: Modelling and Mitigating Unified Bias Representation in Omni-modal Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) provide joint multimodal understanding and generation capabilities, making them well-suited to complex environments and promising backbones for next-generation AI. Despite these advances, the harmful stereotypes encoded in such models manifest in increasingly diverse forms, leading to broader and more severe societal consequences. Existing debiasing methods typically impose separate fairness objectives for each sensitive attribute and modality to minimise demographic-dependent variations. However, in omni-modal settings, this attribute-centric paradigm struggles to jointly address diverse social biases with distinct fairness objectives and to generalise beyond predefined attributes. To this end, we propose OmniDebias, one of the first methods for promoting fairness in OLLMs, which employs a bias-centric formulation to extract and mitigate a shared bias representation across attributes and modalities while preserving attribute-related knowledge. Specifically, we exploit activation inconsistencies of a given attribute (e.g., gender) across semantic contexts (e.g., occupations) to disentangle bias from legitimate knowledge. We further consolidate multiple extracted biases into a shared representation, formulating a unified objective that captures the underlying structure across social biases and generalises to unseen attributes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that eliminating unified bias with both post-hoc editing and fine-tuning can consistently improve fairness across diverse attributes and modalities in OLLMs while maintaining favourable utility.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniDebias，首个面向全模态大模型（OLLM）的公平性去偏方法，以"偏见为中心"的表述提取并消除跨属性、跨模态的共享偏见表征，兼顾知识保留并可泛化到未见属性。
AI.motivation: OLLM 兼具多模态理解与生成能力，但编码的刻板印象表现多样、危害更大。现有去偏方法按敏感属性、按模态分别设定公平目标（属性中心范式），难以同时处理多种偏见目标，也无法泛化到预定义属性之外。
AI.method: 采用偏见中心（bias-centric）建模范式：利用某属性（如性别）在不同语义语境（如职业）下的激活不一致性，将偏见与合法知识解耦；再将多个提取出的偏见整合为共享表征，构建统一目标以刻画社会偏见的内在结构并泛化到未见属性；支持后处理编辑与微调两种消除方式。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，无论采用后处理编辑还是微调来消除统一偏见，均能在多种属性与模态上持续提升 OLLM 公平性，同时保持良好效用（utility）。
AI.conclusion: 偏见中心范式可统一建模跨属性、跨模态的社会偏见，为 OLLM 提供可泛化且不牺牲效用的公平性方案。

title: Proximal Targets: Training Looped Refiners on Problems with Many Correct Answers
summary: Looped refiners such as HRM and TRM apply one small network repeatedly to a draft answer, and deep supervision trains every pass toward one stored answer per puzzle. We prove that when a puzzle has many correct answers this target sets a loss floor that no model capacity removes, and that the loss-minimising pass blends the answers into an invalid grid. We propose the proximal target: train each pass toward the correct answer nearest to its own input, found by scanning a list of answers, by a search solver started at the draft, or within a band of quality set by a knob; correct answers become fixed points, and a pass only has to make fewer errors than its input has for the loop to converge, which its training loss bounds. With the same 1.7M-parameter network and 5 seeds, the proximal target solves 98.8% of Sudoku puzzles with 2-64 answers (standard target: 2.5%), 93.8% of sparse puzzles with more than 10,000 answers without any list of answers (0.0%), and 90.9% of 200-node 3-colourings after training on graphs of at most 50 nodes (36.9%), and different random starts end at different answers. Against GRAM, a stochastic-latent reasoner, a single run is correct far more often (98.8% vs. 57.7%) and twenty runs find more of the answers (53.6% vs. 37.4%), while GRAM is slightly ahead on its own 10-node colouring benchmark; in Scrabble the knob becomes a calibrated strength dial.

AI.tldr: 论文指出循环细化器（HRM、TRM）用“每谜题单一答案”做深度监督，在多解谜题上存在不可消除的损失下界，且最优解是无效混合网格；提出“近端目标”——每轮朝离自身输入最近的正确解训练，使正确解成为不动点并保证收敛。
AI.motivation: HRM/TRM 等循环细化方法对草稿答案反复套用同一小网络，深度监督让每一轮都逼近同一个存储答案。作者证明：当谜题有多个正确答案时，这个目标会设定一个任何模型容量都无法消除的损失下界，且损失最小化的那一轮会把多个答案混合成一个无效网格，从而限制性能。
AI.method: 提出 proximal target（近端目标）：对每一轮训练，把其输入朝“离该输入最近的正确答案”对齐，最近答案可通过扫描答案列表、从草稿启动的搜索求解器、或由旋钮设定质量带内搜索获得。这样正确答案成为不动点；训练损失界定了每轮误差减少量，只要每轮错误数少于输入错误数，循环即可收敛。
AI.result: 同一 1.7M 参数网络、5 个种子下：2–64 个答案的 Sudoku 解出 98.8%（标准目标 2.5%）；无答案列表时，超过 10,000 个答案的稀疏谜题解出 93.8%（0.0%）；在最多 50 节点的图上训练后，200 节点 3-着色解出 90.9%（36.9%），且不同随机起点收敛到不同答案。对比随机潜变量推理器 GRAM：单次运行正确率 98.8% vs 57.7%，20 次运行找到的答案数 53.6% vs 37.4%；但其 10 节点着色基准上 GRAM 略优。Scrabble 中旋钮成为可校准的强度刻度。
AI.conclusion: 多解场景下应避免单答案深度监督，改为朝输入最近的正确解训练，可形成不动点、保证收敛并显著提升多解探索与泛化；近端目标在 Sudoku、着色和 Scrabble 上有效，并提供了可控的质量/强度旋钮。

title: CrossEnv: Synthesizing Verifiable Cross-Environment Tasks for Long-Horizon Agent Training
summary: Executable synthetic environments provide scalable training tasks and verifiable feedback for long-horizon agents. Existing environment synthesis methods primarily generate tasks within individual environments. However, these tasks do not adequately capture real-world interactions across services, where actions in one service depend on information obtained from another. Synthesizing such tasks is challenging because data generated across environments must remain consistent to support executable and verifiable interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce CrossEnv, a framework that uses an entity-tool graph to identify connections between environments and aligns task-specific data to synthesize executable, verifiable cross-environment tasks. We further propose CrossEnv-Curriculum, which progresses from single-environment tool use to coordination across more environments and business domains, before introducing user interaction. Across four external benchmarks, combining cross-environment training data with this curriculum achieves competitive performance with fewer training examples. Further analyses support the benefits of cross-environment data and curriculum training, and provide evidence of transfer to new environment combinations, external tasks less similar to the training data, and longer workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出CrossEnv框架，利用实体-工具图识别环境间联系并对齐数据，合成可执行、可验证的跨环境任务，并配合CrossEnv-Curriculum课程训练长程智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有可执行合成环境多在单一环境内生成任务，难以捕捉真实世界中跨服务的交互（一个服务的动作依赖另一服务获取的信息）；而跨环境合成困难，因为跨环境数据需保持一致以支持可执行、可验证的交互。
AI.method: CrossEnv用实体-工具图识别环境之间的连接点，并对任务特定数据进行对齐，从而合成可执行且可验证的跨环境任务；进一步提出CrossEnv-Curriculum课程，从单环境工具使用，进阶到跨更多环境和业务领域的协作，最后引入用户交互。
AI.result: 在四个外部基准上，将跨环境训练数据与该课程结合，能以更少训练样本取得有竞争力的性能；分析表明跨环境数据与课程训练均有益，并显示出向新环境组合、与训练数据相似度较低的外部任务以及更长工作流的迁移证据。
AI.conclusion: 跨环境任务合成与渐进式课程训练有效提升长程智能体在真实跨服务场景下的表现与泛化能力。

title: Fast Training-Free Low-Light Video Enhancement with a Frozen Image Diffusion Prior
summary: Pretrained image diffusion models can enhance low-light video without low-light training data and without retraining for a new camera. ZVRD, the only published training-free method for low-light video, is too slow to use: our implementation needs over a minute per $256 \times 256$ frame. We present a causal, training-free pipeline that adds two temporal components to a frozen MR. Illuminate image prior. Temporal input fusion recursively averages motion-compensated low-light frames before diffusion inversion. Late-start offset propagation runs the full sampling trajectory only on key frames. Each non-key frame inverts the low-noise part of its own trajectory and adds an enhancement offset warped from the latest key frame. At ZVRD's own resolution the pipeline is $261\times$ faster than ZVRD and scores better on all five metrics we report. On 13 held-out SDSD clips at $1280 \times 720$, it improves on framewise eight-step processing by 0.55 dB in PSNR and 0.034 in LPIPS and halves the warping error, in 10% less time. Measurements inside the model show why, and a linear-Gaussian model of inversion explains them. Fusion removes frame-to-frame noise before inversion amplifies it. A flow error perturbs the transported offset ten times less than it perturbs a transported state. The perceptual gain does not transfer to low resolution: at $346 \times 260$, LPIPS is worse by 0.028. At 0.65 frames per second, the pipeline is an offline method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种因果、免训练的暗光视频增强流程，在冻结的图像扩散先验上加入时序输入融合与晚启动偏移传播，比ZVRD快261倍且五项指标全面提升。
AI.motivation: 现有唯一免训练暗光视频方法ZVRD过慢（256×256每帧超一分钟），难以实用，需要在不重训练、无需暗光数据的条件下加速并保持质量。
AI.method: 在冻结的MR.Illuminate图像先验上添加两个时序组件：(1)时序输入融合——在扩散反演前对运动补偿的暗光帧递归平均；(2)晚启动偏移传播——仅关键帧跑完整采样轨迹，非关键帧只反演自身轨迹的低噪声部分，并叠加由最近关键帧变换（warp）得到的增强偏移。
AI.result: ZVRD原分辨率下快261倍且五项指标全胜；13个SDSD片段1280×720下较逐帧八步处理PSNR+0.55dB、LPIPS+0.034、warping误差减半、耗时少10%；但低分辨率346×260下LPIPS变差0.028；速度0.65fps，属离线方法。
AI.conclusion: 时序融合在反演放大噪声前先降噪，且流误差对传播偏移的扰动比传播状态小十倍（线性高斯反演模型给出解释），故能以关键帧稀疏采样获得高效高质量；但感知增益不迁移到低分辨率，目前仍为离线方案。

title: Who Pays for Byzantine Robustness? Validity, Data-Share Dictatorships, and Fairness When Only a Few Hospitals Collaborate
summary:
Clinical federated learning (FL) collaborations typically connect only three to six hospitals, yet Byzantine-robust aggregation rules are designed and benchmarked on synthetic partitions across dozens of equal-sized clients. We conduct an empirical audit of eight standard aggregation rules: FedAvg, coordinate-wise median, trimmed mean, Krum, Multi-Krum, Bulyan, geometric median (GeoMed), and Centered Clipping (CC). We evaluate both unweighted and sample-size-weighted variants across three cross-silo medical datasets from the FLamby benchmark: Fed-Heart-Disease ($n = 4$ hospitals), Fed-TCGA-BRCA ($n = 6$ regions), and Fed-ISIC2019 ($n = 6$ centres). We execute 54,214 training runs across enumerated attacker coalitions ($f \in \{1, 2\}$) paired with exact-twin leave-out controls that decompose performance drops into honest data loss versus adversarial attack damage.
  We report three findings. First, client-count validity checks fail to capture breakdown in skewed medical consortia: while $n = 6, f = 1$ satisfies every count condition except Bulyan's, assigning sample-size weights turns median and GeoMed into a clean-model dictatorship whenever a single hospital holds more than half the training data, and causes weighted median, GeoMed, and CC to collapse when that dominant centre attacks. Second, exact-twin leave-out controls reveal that when the largest hospital attacks, the apparent failure of count-based robust rules is predominantly caused by the loss of honest training data (7.5 to 10.4 points on ISIC) rather than adversarial perturbation (2.3 to 3.8 points on ISIC). Conversely, weight-dependent rules suffer large true attack damage (16.1 to 25.1 points on ISIC). Third, unweighted robust rules consistently discount whichever institution generates the most atypical parameter updates, penalizing the smallest hospital on Heart but penalizing larger institutions on TCGA and ISIC.

AI.tldr: 在FLamby三个跨中心医疗数据集（n=4~6）上对8种拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则做5万余次实证审计，发现客户端数量校验无法捕捉样本量偏斜下的失效，权重相关规则在主导医院攻击时崩溃，并给出性能下降的诚实数据损失与真实攻击损害分解。
AI.motivation: 临床联邦学习实际合作通常只有3–6家医院，而拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则却在几十个等规模合成客户端上设计并评测。这种"客户端数量"门槛与真实医疗联盟的样本量高度不均衡之间存在根本错配，需要实证检验标准鲁棒规则在此设定下是否仍然有效。
AI.method: 在FLamby基准的Fed-Heart-Disease（4家医院）、Fed-TCGA-BRCA（6个区域）、Fed-ISIC2019（6个中心）上，对FedAvg、坐标中位数、截尾均值、Krum、Multi-Krum、Bulyan、几何中位数（GeoMed）和Centered Clipping八种规则，分别测试无权重与按样本量加权两种变体；枚举攻击者联盟（f∈{1,2}），共执行54,214次训练，并引入"精确孪生留出"对照组，将性能下降分解为诚实数据损失与对抗攻击损害两部分。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 数量型有效性校验无法识别偏斜医疗联盟的崩溃——n=6、f=1几乎满足所有计数条件，但一旦某医院样本超过半数，加权即令中位数与GeoMed沦为干净模型独裁，且当该主导中心攻击时，加权中位数、GeoMed和CC均崩溃；(2) 孪生留出对照显示，最大医院攻击时基于计数的鲁棒规则失效主要源于诚实训练数据丢失（ISIC上7.5–10.4点），而非对抗扰动（2.3–3.8点）；相反，依赖权重的规则遭受巨大真实攻击损害（ISIC上16.1–25.1点）；(3) 无权重鲁棒规则一致地压制参数更新最异常的那家机构，在Heart上惩罚最小医院，在TCGA和ISIC上惩罚较大的机构。
AI.conclusion: 拜占庭鲁棒聚合的"客户端数量"假设不适用于真实的跨中心医疗联盟，样本量偏斜会造成基于权重的规则被主导中心劫持、基于计数的规则被"诚实数据损失"误判为攻击损害。鲁棒聚合的评测与设计应引入样本量分布、加权方式和孪生留出分解等控制，而非仅依赖计数条件。

title: Can Activation Steering Substitute for Prompt-Based Affective Priming in LLM Digital Twins?
comment: Code, generation logs and analysis scripts: https://github.com/JunyiTim/twin-activation-injection
summary: Affective priming -- asking participants to write about a recalled event, such as a time they felt grateful or lacked control, and then measuring the induced state and its spillover onto related judgments -- is a standard way to manipulate emotion in the social sciences, and it also shifts the responses of LLM-based digital twins. The writing task, however, requires generating a full text. We test whether activation steering can replace it. Using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on 100 personas in two domains (gratitude, lack of control), we compare a real-prompt path replicating the original Twin-2K-500 Mega Study (J2) with an injection path that skips the writing and adds a mean-difference direction, extracted from human writing, to the residual stream at varying strengths. The real-prompt effects fall between the original human and digital-twin effects in 5 of 6 comparisons. Injection shifts the manipulation check in a dose-dependent way and matches the real-prompt effect at one strength in the gratitude domain (beta ~ 2.7), but overshoots beyond it, on the proximal measure as well, and asymmetrically across the two directions. A structure-matched No-Injection baseline separates two sources of difference: omitting the writing task raises the proximal measure in both domains, whereas the injected direction itself moves a distal measure in the lack-of-control domain. Substitution is therefore measure-dependent: validity established for one way of inducing a state does not carry over uniformly to another.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验能否用激活引导（activation steering）替代"情感启动"写作任务来操控LLM数字孪生，发现替代效果依赖具体测量指标，不能一概而论。
AI.motivation: 情感启动是社会科学中操控情绪的标准方法，也影响LLM数字孪生的回答，但它需要生成完整文本。作者想测试能否用更高效的激活引导（直接注入方向向量）来替代写作任务。
AI.method: 用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，在100个人格、两个领域（感恩、缺乏控制感）上做对比。设两条路径：真实提示路径（复现Twin-2K-500 Mega Study J2）和注入路径（跳过写作，将从人类写作中提取的均值差方向向量以不同强度加到残差流）。另设结构匹配的无注入基线，以区分差异来源。
AI.result: 真实提示效应在6个比较中有5个介于原始人类与数字孪生效应之间。注入以剂量依赖方式移动操控检验，在感恩领域某一强度（β≈2.7）下与真实提示效应匹配，但超过后会在近端测量上过冲，且两个方向不对称。无注入基线显示：省略写作会抬高两领域的近端测量，而注入方向本身会在缺乏控制感领域移动远端测量。
AI.conclusion: 替代效果依赖测量指标：为一种状态诱导方式建立的有效性，不能一致地迁移到另一种方式。激活引导不能简单等同于情感启动写作任务。

title: A Full-Ledger Counterfactual Audit of Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Adaptive reasoning must decide whether to answer now or spend more compute. Predicting that the current answer is wrong does not establish whether further reasoning will improve it. We introduce the Full-Ledger Counterfactual Value Audit (FLCVA), which compares an immediate answer with four fixed-length continuations from the same frozen prefix under one answer procedure and accounts for the cost of every signal used by a policy. On GSM8K and MATH-500, a random 256-token continuation recovers a wrong answer in 26.6% of Qwen3-8B cases and 18.9% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B cases, while damaging a correct answer in 1.4% and 1.9%. Correctness labels from independently sampled continuations predict a separate continuation's outcome in both primary models. In offline replay, using these labels to allocate compute improves performance on DeepSeek; the Qwen3 gain remains inconclusive. Under full cost accounting, the tested lightweight, myopic controllers mainly recognize current errors and add little continuation-specific value beyond that shortcut. A Llama-8B replication and action/cost ablations examine the robustness of these findings. FLCVA separates measuring local continuation value, predicting it from observable signals, and using those predictions to allocate computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FLCVA审计框架，区分"当前答案错误"与"继续推理是否有价值"，发现随机续写常能纠正错误答案且很少破坏正确答案，但轻量近视控制器主要只是识别已有错误。
AI.motivation: 自适应推理需要在"立即作答"与"投入更多计算"间抉择。仅预测当前答案错误，并不能说明继续推理会改善它；且既有方法未计入策略所用信号的代价。
AI.method: FLCVA在同一冻结前缀和同一作答流程下，将立即答案与四次定长续写做反事实对比，并完整核算策略使用所有信号的成本；在GSM8K与MATH-500上测试Qwen3-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B，另做Llama-8B复现及动作/成本消融。
AI.result: 随机256 token续写可挽回错误答案：Qwen3-8B 26.6%、DeepSeek 18.9%，破坏正确答案仅1.4%、1.9%。独立采样的正确性标签可预测另一次续写结果；离线回放中该标签能提升DeepSeek性能，Qwen3增益不确定。完整成本核算下，轻量近视控制器主要只是识别当前错误，额外价值有限。
AI.conclusion: FLCVA将"测量局部续写价值"、"从可观测信号预测该价值"与"用预测分配计算"三者分离，揭示了现有控制器在成本核算下的局限。

title: Strong Fused Performance Can Mask Branch Collapse in a Dual-View Heart-Sound Classifier: A Three-Part Diagnostic Protocol
summary: Fusion models are usually judged by their fused score, a practice that assumes that every branch has learned something useful. We show that this assumption can fail silently in dual-view heart-sound classification. In AudioFuse, which fuses a spectrogram transformer with a waveform CNN, the spectrogram branch is unused despite strong fused performance when both branches are trained from scratch. We introduce a three-part diagnostic for branch collapse: whether deleting a branch changes the fused score, whether a linear probe on its features beats an untrained copy of the same branch, and whether the branch can learn its view when trained alone. Deleting the branch has negligible effect, and probing its features shows little improvement over an identically initialised, untrained copy. Yet the same architecture trained alone exceeds 0.9 AUC, so its view is learnable, while the jointly trained model is near chance when it must rely on this branch. Update statistics and an initialisation experiment point to an early optimisation imbalance. Moving a strong artificial label cue from one input to the other can switch which branch the model relies on, even though the branch architectures stay the same. We observe branch collapse on PhysioNet, but the full diagnostic is not met on ICBHI or CirCor. Fused performance alone therefore cannot establish that every branch learned a meaningful representation, and we recommend reporting branch deletion and an untrained-control probe alongside it.

AI.tldr: 在双视角心音分类中，融合模型高融合分数可能掩盖"分支坍缩"：AudioFuse的谱图分支在联合训练时实际未被使用，尽管单独训练该分支AUC>0.9。
AI.motivation: 领域惯例以融合分数评判融合模型好坏，隐含假设每条分支都学到了有用表征。作者发现该假设在双视角心音分类中可能"静默失效"，需要诊断手段识别。
AI.method: 提出三部分分支坍缩诊断：(1) 删除某分支是否改变融合分数；(2) 对该分支特征做线性探针，是否优于同结构未训练副本；(3) 该分支单独训练时能否学会其视角。辅以更新统计与初始化实验，并用人工标签线索迁移实验验证。
AI.result: AudioFuse中删除谱图分支影响可忽略，线性探针相对未训练副本几无提升；但单独训练同架构可超0.9 AUC，而联合训练模型仅靠该分支时接近随机。证据指向早期优化失衡；将强人工标签线索从一路输入移到另一路会切换模型依赖的分支。在PhysioNet观察到分支坍缩，但ICBHI与CirCor上未满足完整诊断。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭融合性能无法证明每条分支学到了有意义表征；建议在报告融合分数之外，同时报告分支删除测试与未训练对照探针。

title: Action-outcome coupling: a pre-investment feasibility audit for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations
summary: Prescriptive analytics initiatives in logistics, such as offline reinforcement learning and next-best-action systems, are often funded before anyone verifies that the available historical logs can support an improved decision policy. We formalise this pre-investment feasibility question via action-outcome coupling: a total-effect variance index measuring how much expected outcomes change with the logged action. Coupling provides an algorithm-independent upper bound on any policy's achievable value, expressed in monetary units per decision for both single-step and discounted sequential objectives. We also analyse the asymptotic false-licensing risk of an invalid workflow: fitting a value model and evaluating the model's greedy policy on the same data. The false-licence rate is driven mainly by the number of state cells over which selection is performed, rising from the nominal test level with one cell to near certainty with a few dozen, while overlap has a smaller effect. We then propose an audit that assigns logs to four tiers of decision support, separately for fixed and contextual policies, and returns an explicit stopping rationale. On a randomised e-commerce log, the audit endorses a fixed recommendation policy, certifying gains equal to 30 per cent of the theoretical ceiling; the remaining gap reflects bound looseness under an 80-action design. Two public logistics logs fail at different checkpoints: one because the target is an accounting identity of the action, and another because, with 27 clusters, estimated coupling stays below the design's detectability threshold even though a conservative offline learner certifies an improvement in 29 of 30 seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"动作-结果耦合"指数，作为投资前判断历史日志能否支撑更好决策策略的无算法依赖上界，并设计四层级日志审计流程。
AI.motivation: 物流中的规范性分析（离线强化学习、next-best-action）常在未验证历史日志是否足以支撑更优决策前就被投资，缺乏投资前的可行性判据。
AI.method: 以总效应方差指数度量动作-结果耦合，给出单步与折扣序贯目标下的可达价值上界（以每决策货币单位表示）；分析"同一数据拟合并评估贪心策略"这一无效流程的渐进虚假许可风险，并构建将日志分为四级决策支持层级的审计（区分固定策略与情境策略）。
AI.result: 虚假许可率主要由状态单元数量驱动（1个单元时接近名义检验水平，几十个单元时接近必然），重叠度影响较小。随机电商日志中审计认可固定推荐策略，认证收益达理论上限的30%（其余差距源于80动作设计下的界松弛）；两个公开物流日志分别因目标为动作的核算恒等式、以及27个簇下估计耦合低于可检测阈值而失败（尽管保守离线学习器在30个种子中29个认证有改进）。
AI.conclusion: 耦合指数与分层审计可在投资前提供算法无关的价值上界与明确的停止理由，避免无效工作流带来虚假许可。

title: Plausible Videos Can Lead to Poor Decisions: Diagnosing and CURE-ing World Models for Planning
summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as world models for planning, yet a world model that makes plausible, realistic-looking videos that are consistent with the training data can produce poor decisions. We address two key questions: (1) when can we trust a world model for planning, and (2) what should we do when we cannot? We introduce CURE (Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore), a certificate-guided technique that assesses whether a world model can be trusted for planning and determines what to do next: whether to upweight the training data to debias the model; roll out more samples at test time; or explore by collecting new data where support (how well the training data cover the planner's decisions) is missing. We deploy CURE across multiple domains, spanning simulated physics based on PhyWorld, MuJoCo arm control, and Language-Table pushing in simulation and on real videos. The decisions our certificate trusts have lower regret than those it does not (e.g., 0.06 vs. 0.38 on Language-Table sim and 0.07 vs. 0.38 on MuJoCo contact), whereas video perceptual quality does not identify good decisions. By focusing on decision quality rather than perceptual quality, CURE lowers regret over the best pessimistic decision rule by 10-25% across support levels, and over world-action models, search and policy learning by 41-64%, given the same data.

AI.tldr: 提出CURE（Certify, Upweight, Rollout, Explore）证书引导方法，判断动作条件世界模型能否被信任用于规划，并在不可信时采取相应补救措施。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型虽能生成逼真且与训练数据一致的视频，却可能做出糟糕决策。论文关注两个问题：(1)何时可以信任世界模型做规划；(2)不可信任时该怎么办。
AI.method: CURE包含四步：Certify——评估世界模型是否可信；Upweight——对训练数据加权以去偏模型；Rollout——测试时增加采样；Explore——在支撑缺失（训练数据对规划决策覆盖不足）处采集新数据。
AI.result: 在PhyWorld物理仿真、MuJoCo机械臂控制、Language-Table推物（仿真与真实视频）上验证：被证书信任的决策后悔值更低（Language-Table sim 0.06 vs 0.38，MuJoCo contact 0.07 vs 0.38），而视频感知质量无法识别好决策。相比最佳悲观决策规则降低后悔10–25%，相比世界-动作模型、搜索与策略学习降低41–64%（相同数据下）。
AI.conclusion: 关注决策质量而非感知质量是关键；基于支撑的证书能有效判断世界模型可信度并指导改进，显著降低规划后悔。

title: Projected Penalty-Gradient Tracking for Communication-Efficient Byzantine-Resilient Federated Learning
summary: We investigate communication-efficient federated learning over heterogeneous datasets in the presence of Byzantine adversaries capable of uploading arbitrary information. Penalty-based methods bound the influence of each worker through the bounded gradient of a penalty function; however, the bound is lost once the uploads are compressed, since a Byzantine worker can accumulate an unbounded state at the server. To retain the Byzantine resilience under compressed uploads, we propose a projected penalty-gradient tracking framework, where each honest worker uploads a compressed residual of its penalty gradient and the server projects each reconstructed state onto the known penalty-gradient ball. The framework accommodates any contractive compressor and yields two algorithms: fault-resilient proximal gradient with consistent sparsification (FRPG-CS), whose shared mask is protected by freshly drawn reserve rows, and lazily aggregated FRPG (LAG-FRPG), whose uploads are event-triggered. For smooth and strongly convex losses, we establish a finite-time bound on the expected objective gap, where the Byzantine error floor is independent of the compressor and the compression error decays faster than the optimization error. We also bound the expected number of lazy uploads and derive certificates that separate the finite-penalty model bias from the optimization error. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST show that the proposed algorithms attain the highest accuracy among twelve methods under the Min-Max attack, whereas a compressed-momentum benchmark and a local-update benchmark remain preferable in attack-free accuracy and total traffic, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出投影惩罚梯度跟踪框架，使压缩上传下的联邦学习仍保持拜占庭容错，推出FRPG-CS与LAG-FRPG两种算法。
AI.motivation: 基于惩罚的方法依靠惩罚函数的有界梯度限制每个worker的影响，但一旦上传被压缩，该上界失效，因为拜占庭worker可在服务器端累积无界状态。
AI.method: 每个诚实worker上传其惩罚梯度的压缩残差，服务器将每个重建状态投影到已知的惩罚梯度球上；兼容任意收缩型压缩器。据此提出两种算法：FRPG-CS（用新抽取的保留行保护共享稀疏掩码）和LAG-FRPG（上传由事件触发、惰性聚合）。
AI.result: 对光滑强凸损失给出期望目标间隙的有限时间界，其中拜占庭误差底与压缩器无关、压缩误差衰减快于优化误差；同时界定期望惰性上传次数，并给出区分有限惩罚模型偏差与优化误差的证书。MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上，Min-Max攻击下十二种方法中精度最高；无攻击时压缩动量基准精度更优、局部更新基准总流量更低。
AI.conclusion: 投影惩罚梯度跟踪可在任意收缩压缩器下恢复拜占庭鲁棒性且不引入压缩相关误差底，兼顾一致稀疏化与通信节省，但精度与流量各存在更优的专用方案。

title: Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
summary: In the global attention layers of Gemma 4 31B, the value is the normalized key projection, and the key is the value scaled by a fixed weight, with rotary position encoding on one quarter of its dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5%, but the open serving engines that we checked still store a full key and a full value: 1,024 values per KV head and token. We store one 640-value row instead, exact in real arithmetic, and an unchanged paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views as its key cache and its value cache. In a vLLM prototype with the 16-bit 31B model, the outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, 2 of 432 final answers differ from the stock engine (within its run-to-run noise), and the steady decode KV memory per request falls by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens. On a prefill/decode pair of two A100 GPUs with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, a decode engine with a full 15 GiB pool ran 1.38 times the stock decode tokens per step for 16K-token prompts (repeated to 0.06%) and 1.24 times for 8K-token prompts; a model of the vLLM block pool predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and on this path the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype makes an eager step 4% to 9% slower at equal batch, and the method does not yet stack with an 8-bit KV cache at the default scale.

AI.tldr: 针对 Gemma 4 31B 全局注意力层中 value = normalize(key 投影) 的代数冗余，提出只存一行 640 值、用两个重叠 strided 视图复用为 K/V 缓存的方法，并在 vLLM 中原型验证了精确性与显存/吞吐收益。
AI.motivation: Gemma 4 报告称该设计可减少最多 37.5% 的全局 KV 缓存，但现有开源推理引擎仍按每个 KV 头每 token 存满 1024 个值的 key 和 value，缓存冗余未被利用。
AI.method: 利用 value 为归一化 key 投影、key 为 value 乘固定权重且仅四分之一维度带 RoPE 的结构，只存一条 640 值行（实数域下精确），由未改动的 paged attention kernel 通过两个重叠的 strided 视图分别作为 key cache 与 value cache 读取；在 vLLM 上以 16-bit 31B 模型做原型，并用 block pool 模型预测性能。
AI.result: 输出与 stock 缓存上同算术的仿真逐比特一致，432 个最终答案中仅 2 个不同（处于运行噪声内）；32K–64K token 下每请求稳态解码 KV 显存降为 1/1.34–1/1.40。双 A100 + NIXL + CPU offload 场景下，15 GiB 池的解码引擎每步解码 token 数为 stock 的 1.38 倍（16K 提示，重复性 0.06%）与 1.24 倍（8K 提示）；block pool 模型对两比值的预测误差在 1% 内，eager 解码吞吐提升 1.30/1.11 倍。代价：等 batch 下 eager 单步慢 4%–9%，且暂不能与默认尺度下的 8-bit KV 缓存叠加。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明 Gemma 4 的全局 KV 结构冗余可以被零精度损失地消除，以极小的引擎改动换来 1.3–1.4 倍的显存/解码效率提升；但存在单步延迟开销与低比特量化不兼容的限制，尚属原型阶段。

title: Lost in Read-out: Locating the Image Quality Gap in Vision-Language Models with a Closed-Form Edit
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are widely used as zero-shot image quality assessors, yet their good-vs-poor answers agree only moderately with human opinion. We ask whether these models fail to see quality or fail to say it. Layer-wise probes on five VLMs point to the second: quality is linearly decodable from the vision encoder and still from the last language layer, far better than the answer reveals, and about a hundred labels recover most of it. The loss lies mainly in the final read-out, which partly reads something else: relative to human opinion, it over-rewards colorfulness and under-rewards sharpness on all five models. We test this by intervention: if the read-out is at fault, a closed-form edit of a single last-layer neuron, fitted to many prompts at once, should close the gap and no more. Both hold. Under prompts never used for fitting, the edit recovers 86--100\% of what a ridge head on the last-layer state, fitted under the same prompts, finds beyond the answer on KonIQ. Where that gap is small, it gains little, too little for our transfer criterion on the two largest models; where the head itself is below the answer, it lowers the score; and it works only when written from the middle of the language model on. Unlike unconstrained fine-tuning, the edit leaves perception question answering intact. It does not carry over to yes-or-no or rating questions, and it reverses the good--poor contrast after sentiment-laden sentences. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: VLMs其实"看得到"图像质量，只是"说不出来"：质量信息可从视觉编码器和最后一层语言层线性解码，损失主要在最终读出阶段，可通过编辑单个最后层神经元部分修复。
AI.motivation: VLMs作为零样本图像质量评估器时，其好/差判断与人类意见仅中等一致。作者想区分模型是"看不到质量"还是"说不出质量"，并定位失败环节。
AI.method: 在五个VLM上做逐层探针；用约百个标签检验可解码性；分析读出偏差（相对人类偏好过度奖励色彩鲜艳、低估清晰度）；通过闭式编辑单个最后层神经元（多提示联合拟合）进行干预，并在未参与拟合的提示上验证。
AI.result: 质量在视觉编码器和最后层语言层均可线性解码，且远好于答案所体现的；编辑恢复了KonIQ上最后一层线性头超出答案部分的86–100%；但间隙小时增益极小（两个最大模型未通过迁移标准），线性头本身低于答案时反而降分，且仅在语言模型中后段书写时有效。
AI.conclusion: VLM质量评估的瓶颈是最终读出而非感知。单神经元编辑能针对性缩小差距且不破坏感知问答，但不适用于是/否或评分类问题，且会被情感化句子逆转好坏对比。

title: A Transformer-Derived Iterative Preconditioner
summary:
Transformers trained on in-context prediction problems can learn known numerical algorithms, e.g., gradient descent. We go further, showing that their internal computations can reveal new algorithms with provable guarantees. A softmax-attention transformer trained to solve linear systems $Xw=y$ implicitly improves matrix conditioning. Tracing $XX^\top$ reveals an iterative preconditioning primitive, which we develop into RAPID, a standalone algorithm requiring no learned components.
  RAPID is an anytime preconditioner for symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices, using randomized mixing and sparse local corrections to improve conditioning. Proof-of-concept experiments on synthetic and real-world problems consistently improve conditioning and reduce conjugate gradient iterations needed to reach a target accuracy. For a Haar-mixing idealization, we prove convergence to any fixed target condition number regardless of spectral distribution, with only logarithmic dependence on initial conditioning. Together, these results show how a transformer can discover a broadly applicable numerical algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现，训练于上下文预测问题的softmax注意力Transformer内部计算隐含了一个迭代预条件原语，并将其提炼为无需学习组件的独立算法RAPID（随机混合+稀疏局部修正的SPD矩阵任意时间预条件器），实验上可改善条件数并减少CG迭代次数，理论上（Haar混合理想化）证明可对数依赖初始条件数地收敛到任意目标条件数。
AI.motivation: 以往工作只表明Transformer能学会已知数值算法（如梯度下降）。作者希望更进一步：利用Transformer的内部计算去"发现"具有可证明保证的新算法。具体以求解线性系统 Xw=y 为切入点，关注矩阵条件数这一影响迭代求解效率的关键因素。
AI.method: 训练一个softmax注意力Transformer求解线性系统；通过追踪其内部计算中出现的 XX^T 结构，识别出一个迭代预条件原语，并将其推广为独立算法RAPID——一种针对对称正定矩阵的任意时间（anytime）预条件器，采用随机混合与稀疏局部修正来改善条件数。理论上在Haar混合理想化下分析收敛性。
AI.result: 在合成与真实问题上，RAPID一致地改善条件数，并减少共轭梯度法达到目标精度所需的迭代次数。理论证明：在Haar混合理想化下，算法可收敛到任意固定目标条件数，且与谱分布无关，对初始条件数仅有对数依赖。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明Transformer不仅能复现已知算法，其内部计算还能揭示具有可证明保证、广泛适用的新数值算法，为"从模型中学到算法"提供了范例。

title: Pluggable Subband-Decoupled Fusion and Unlabeled Capture Prototype Calibration: Bridging High-SNR Null-Subcarrier Regrowth and Low-SNR Coherent Preambles for Cross-Domain IoT RF Fingerprinting
summary: Zero-overhead physical-layer authentication at edge wireless access points (APs) is vital for securing resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) transceivers against credential cloning, yet cross-domain IEEE 802.11a/g radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) faces an acute signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) crossover. Power-amplifier spectral regrowth on unpopulated null subcarriers resists indoor multipath at high SNR but decays quadratically below the thermal noise floor, whereas populated active in-band preambles survive low SNR yet degrade under severe multipath, causing static fusion to lose up to 44.7 percentage points (pp). To our knowledge, we propose the first RFFI framework that dynamically modulates active in-band waveforms and unpopulated null-subcarrier regrowth via a blind physical SNR gate: Pluggable Gated Subband-Decoupled Fusion with Unlabeled Capture-Aware Prototype Calibration (GSDF-CAPC). Avoiding the 20-35 dB subband gradient imbalance of joint training, GSDF pairs any frozen pretrained host backbone with a 46.3K null-subcarrier plug-in encoder (NS-Branch), fusing scale-standardized logits and gate-warped spherical embeddings under a source-calibrated lag-64 thermal-SNR gate with exact low-SNR fallback. Over unlabeled target AP captures, forward-only unbalanced optimal-transport calibration (UOT-CAPC) aligns shifted prototypes under packet-arrival skew and recovers parameter-free balanced Sinkhorn (U-CAPC) at equipartition. Across DataPort-WiFi, WiSig, and ORBIT MobRFFI, zero-retrain GSDF wins all 72/72 paired runs across eight backbones with 0.00 pp low-SNR loss, while edge IB-Host + GSDF (92.6K-93.3K active parameters, 1.82 ms single-core CPU latency) and timing-synchronized GSDF-STO / GSDF-Tri reach 57.50%-65.05% three-benchmark Macro-F1 (89.04%-100.00% over 5-10-packet IoT bursts).

AI.tldr: 提出GSDF-CAPC框架，利用盲物理SNR门动态融合"活跃子载波前导"与"空子载波功放再生"两路子带特征，实现跨域IEEE 802.11a/g射频指纹识别的零开销物理层认证。
AI.motivation: 边缘AP上的零开销物理层认证对资源受限IoT设备的防克隆至关重要，但跨域RFFI存在尖锐的SNR交叉问题：空子载波功放谱再生在高SNR抗多径、低SNR下衰减至噪底以下；活跃带内前导低SNR可用但强多径下退化。静态融合最多损失44.7个百分点。
AI.method: GSDF：将任意冻结预训练主干与46.3K参数的空子载波插件编码器（NS-Branch）配对，避免联合训练带来的20-35 dB子带梯度失衡；在源域校准的lag-64热噪声SNR门下融合尺度标准化logits与门控球面嵌入，含精确低SNR回退。CAPC：对无标签目标AP采集做仅前向的非平衡最优传输校准（UOT-CAPC）对齐偏移原型，等分时退化为无参平衡Sinkhorn（U-CAPC）。
AI.result: 在DataPort-WiFi、WiSig、ORBIT MobRFFI上，零重训GSDF在8个主干、72/72配对实验全部胜出，低SNR损失0.00 pp；边缘IB-Host+GSDF仅92.6K-93.3K活跃参数、1.82 ms单核CPU延迟；时序同步版本GSDF-STO/Tri达57.50%-65.05% Macro-F1（5-10包IoT突发下89.04%-100.00%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过盲SNR门控的子带解耦融合与无标签原型校准，实现零重训、零开销、跨域鲁棒的物理层射频指纹认证，兼顾低延迟与强多径/低SNR环境适应性。

title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
summary: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.

AI.tldr: ForecastGym 是一个记录并离线回放商业搜索 API 返回证据的事件预测基准，用于固定证据获取条件下比较模型、记忆与检索源。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益用于预测真实事件，但预测表现同时受检索证据和模型影响。现有评估存在混淆：在线评估中各系统自行搜索会混合检索与推理；回溯搜索又会通过日期过滤或历史页面的今日排序泄漏后续信息。因此比较模型、搜索源和记忆策略需要固定证据，并保留结果揭晓前证据的演化记录。
AI.method: 构建 ForecastGym：每两天记录四个商业网页搜索 API 对开放预测市场问题的返回结果，在结果已知后离线回放这些冻结证据，在固定的证据获取策略下比较模型、记忆与已捕获的搜索源。首个版本覆盖 150 个问题、614 个证据状态（每问题每采集时点一个）和 13.1 万条搜索结果；并测试了结算后重跑同一查询的信息泄漏程度。
AI.result: 结算后重跑同一查询，尽管使用所测日期过滤，多达 92% 的问题结果几乎直接给出答案；在冻结证据上，所有被测 LLM 的预测准确率均落后于市场；诊断分析显示在高差距状态下，遗漏公开信息比误读信息对差距贡献更大；切换搜索 API 可使 Brier 分数变化达 0.043，超过模型间差异；持久笔记与重读全部证据得分相近，但仅用一半输入 token。
AI.conclusion: 预测者所见的证据可能与阅读证据的模型同样重要，因此事件预测评估应固定并记录证据获取过程。

title: Semantic-Guided Geometric Decoding for Token-Efficient Visual Grounding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a unified interface for language-conditioned visual perception. In pixel-to-sequence grounding, autoregressive coordinate generation requires multiple sequential decoding steps per box, increasing inference cost with the number of instances. Pixel-to-embedding methods reduce this overhead but lack explicit spatial encoding when using a shared special token. We introduce SemGeo, a token-efficient visual grounding framework that represents each instance with a single grid token for coarse localization. A geometric decoder reuses visual features and hidden states to recover precise discrete box coordinates in parallel. To train proposal generation and box localization together, we introduce Gaussian soft labels that encode coordinate distances during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Reinforcement post-training further combines box-set rewards with coordinate supervision on model-generated proposals. This stage trains the language model and geometric decoder on their own predictions to mitigate the mismatch between teacher-forced training and inference. Across eight benchmarks spanning object detection, referring object detection, and document layout grounding, SemGeo achieves the highest F1@mIou among compared MLLMs on six benchmarks. It also delivers $2.07\times$ and $1.25\times$ the mean box-generation throughput of representative grounding baselines under vLLM and Transformers, respectively, while achieving higher accuracy in both comparisons.

AI.tldr: SemGeo 提出一种 token 高效的单网格 token 视觉定位框架，用几何解码器并行恢复精确框坐标，配合高斯软标签与强化后训练，在八个基准上多数最优且吞吐显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有像素到序列的自回归坐标生成需要对每个框进行多步顺序解码，推理成本随实例数增加；像素到嵌入方法虽降低开销，但共享特殊 token 缺乏显式空间编码。
AI.method: 用单个网格 token 表示每个实例做粗定位；几何解码器复用视觉特征与隐藏状态并行输出离散框坐标；SFT 阶段引入高斯软标签编码坐标距离以联合训练候选生成与定位；强化后训练结合框集合奖励与坐标监督，并在模型自生成候选上训练语言模型与解码器，缓解 teacher forcing 与推理的失配。
AI.result: 在目标检测、指代目标检测、文档版面定位共八个基准上，六个取得对比 MLLM 中最高的 F1@mIoU；在 vLLM 与 Transformers 下框生成平均吞吐分别为代表性基线 2.07 倍与 1.25 倍，且准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 以单 token 粗定位加并行几何解码的设计，在保持或提升定位精度的同时显著提高框生成吞吐，为高效视觉定位提供了可行路线。

title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
summary: Kernelized attention methods, which aim to replace the $O(N^2)$ complexity of softmax attention with $O(N)$ alternatives, have been the focus of intense research in the last five years. Despite growing interest, systematic evaluations and fair comparisons across approaches and scales are still missing. We analyze kernelized attention in two halves and highlight prominent limitations on each. On efficiency, FlashAttention achieves lower memory consumption and faster wall-clock time than SOTA kernelized methods during training and in vision transformers across most sequence lengths (with inference-time memory in causal language models the only clear exception), contradicting the core assumption for pure kernelized attention used as a drop-in replacement for softmax. We also discover that reported efficiency gains often fail to reproduce against modern baselines. On quality, current kernelized methods leave gaps of 2-10 points relative to softmax under a unified distillation protocol, and model scala alone does not close these gaps. We show this gap is not intrinsic to kernelization: LARA++, a principled extension of LARA that approximates softmax via importance sampling with adaptive proposal distributions, recovers up to 99% of softmax accuracy. We establish that the gap is closable; however, the computational overhead remains substantial, leaving the efficiency wall intact. Code is available at https://github.com/firatoncel/KernelRealityCheckNeurIPS2026

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了核化注意力（kernelized attention），指出其在效率上不及 FlashAttention，质量上与 softmax 存在 2-10 分差距；并提出 LARA++ 通过自适应重要性采样可恢复至多 99% 的 softmax 精度，但计算开销仍大，效率瓶颈依旧存在。
AI.motivation: 核化注意力旨在用 O(N) 复杂度替代 softmax 注意力的 O(N^2)，近五年研究火热，但缺乏跨方法、跨规模的系统评测与公平比较。作者希望揭示现有方法在效率与质量上的真实局限，并检验质量差距是否源于核化本身。
AI.method: 从效率与质量两方面分析：效率上对比 FlashAttention 与 SOTA 核化方法在训练与视觉 Transformer 中的显存与实测时间；质量上在统一蒸馏协议下将核化方法与 softmax 对比，并考察模型规模的影响。进一步提出 LARA++，作为 LARA 的扩展，采用自适应提议分布的重要性采样来逼近 softmax。
AI.result: 效率方面，FlashAttention 在大多数序列长度下显存更低、实测时间更快（仅因果语言模型推理显存为例外），且许多已报告的效率收益无法在现代基线下复现。质量方面，核化方法在统一蒸馏协议下与 softmax 相差 2-10 分，单纯扩大模型规模无法弥合。LARA++ 可恢复至多 99% 的 softmax 精度。
AI.conclusion: 质量差距并非核化固有，是可闭合的；但 LARA++ 的计算开销仍然显著，效率瓶颈依旧存在。核化注意力作为 softmax 直接替代的核心假设受到挑战。

title: OICycle: Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle for Belief-State Learning in Longitudinal Clinical Decision Making
summary: Clinical care is a closed loop: clinicians observe partial evidence, infer the patient's state, and intervene, and each intervention determines what is observed next. This makes clinical decision making a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which a belief over a latent patient state must be updated from irregular, multimodal, and incomplete records. Yet most deep clinical models predict from a single snapshot or from coarsely aggregated history, while POMDP-based clinical methods need hand-specified discrete state spaces and transition models that real electronic health records cannot supply. We introduce OICycle (Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle), which learns a stochastic belief state directly from retrospective trajectories. At every episode, a learned recurrent operator fuses a sample of the previous belief with the new multimodal observations and the intervention that produced them. The resulting Gaussian belief is trained to predict clinicians' next interventions, the time to the next episode, and next-episode mortality. To enable reproducible evaluation, we release a benchmark derived from MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-IV-Note, and MIMIC-CXR that organizes 72,075 hospital admissions (5.4M laboratory, microbiology, radiology, prescription, and note records) into temporally ordered therapeutic--diagnostic episodes. Compared with an otherwise identical history-free model, OICycle improves next-intervention adaptive recall from 0.253 to 0.347, time-to-next-episode macro-F1 from 0.293 to 0.351, and next-episode mortality macro-F1 from 0.585 to 0.649. Analysis shows that the learned belief encodes intervention type and trajectory position and evolves smoothly across episodes, and that the benefit of history is concentrated in interventions whose ordering depends on prior findings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OICycle，将临床照护视为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），从回顾性轨迹中直接学习随机信念状态，并发布基于MIMIC-IV/Note/CXR的72,075例入院“治疗-诊断循环”基准，性能显著优于无历史模型。
AI.motivation: 临床决策本质是闭环：医生基于不完整证据推断状态并干预，干预又决定后续观测，符合POMDP。但多数深度模型只用单快照或粗粒度聚合历史；POMDP方法依赖人工设定离散状态空间与转移模型，真实EHR无法提供。
AI.method: OICycle（Observe-Infer-Intervene Cycle）：每个episode用学习到的循环算子，将上一信念的采样与新的多模态观测及产生该观测的干预融合，输出高斯信念；以预测医生下一步干预、下一episode时间、下一episode死亡率作为训练目标。同时发布基于MIMIC-IV、MIMIC-IV-Note、MIMIC-CXR的基准，将72,075例入院、5.4M条记录组织为时序化的治疗-诊断episode。
AI.result: 相比结构相同但无历史的模型：下一干预自适应召回0.253→0.347；下一episode时间宏F1 0.293→0.351；下一episode死亡率宏F1 0.585→0.649。分析显示学到的信念编码了干预类型与轨迹位置，跨episode平滑演化，且历史收益集中于顺序依赖先前发现的干预。
AI.conclusion: OICycle表明可从真实回顾性EHR轨迹中端到端学习POMDP信念状态，无需手工离散状态空间与转移模型，并提供了可复现的临床闭环评测基准。

title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
summary: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.

AI.tldr: 代理进化常因评估噪声而非候选生成不足而停滞：候选层面选择接近随机，方法层面排名幅度小于同方法两次独立运行的差异，因此"分辨率假说"得到支持。
AI.motivation: 实践中存在谜题：不同论文中进化方法互有胜负，且进化在某些任务上难以自举（bootstrap）。作者试图解释这一现象，提出瓶颈不在"提出更好候选"，而在"可靠识别更好候选"。
AI.method: 提出 Resolution Hypothesis（分辨率假说）：代理进化停滞源于评估噪声导致无法可靠区分更好与更差的候选工件（prompts、skills、memories）。在七个进化方法与六个模型、超过1000万次LLM调用上，于两个使用评分的层级（候选层与方法层）进行实证检验。
AI.result: 候选层面：确实存在有帮助的候选工件，但选择在区分有益与有害候选上并不优于随机，误差跨轮累积。方法层面：典型领先幅度仅几个百分点，小于同一方法两次独立运行的差异，已发表的排名往往依赖运气。
AI.conclusion: 代理进化的瓶颈常在于可靠识别改进。呼吁研究范式转变：从不断设计更强的候选改进系统，转向使真实改进可被检测、可被累积，并相应调整自改进代理的开发与评估方式。

title: Distilling World Action Models for Efficient Bimanual Manipulation via Anchored Path Matching
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative denoising. Few-step distillation reduces the number of model evaluations, but its coarse updates can move the student away from the teacher's trajectory. We propose Anchored Path Matching (APM), which supervises endpoint and short-transition predictions from states reached by the student. From each state, we continue the teacher to zero noise and use its endpoint and first intermediate state as targets. Modality-routed adapters learn to match both targets from the same starting state. When the two gradients conflict, anchor-priority updates preserve the endpoint gradient and remove the opposing component of the local gradient within each modality. One checkpoint supports 1-, 2-, and 4-step joint generation. The sampling budget can be chosen at deployment without retraining or teacher queries. On RoboTwin 2.0, we train only on Clean demonstrations and evaluate directly on the domain-randomized Random setting. At one step, APM improves closed-loop success over continued base distillation at matched inference budgets by 2.0 percentage points on Clean and 1.4 on Random. Video peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) rises from 30.169 to 32.317 dB, with gains in structural similarity (SSIM) and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS). On two real-robot tasks, APM improves success over the one-step teacher and reduces control-cycle latency by $21.3\times$ relative to the eight-step teacher.Project page: https://jialonglong.github.io/Anchored-Path-Matching/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Anchored Path Matching (APM)，一种用于 World Action Models 的少步蒸馏方法，以学生自身到达的状态为起点用教师端点和首个中间态作锚定监督，并用锚点优先的梯度冲突处理，单权重支持1/2/4步联合生成。
AI.motivation: WAMs 通过迭代去噪联合生成未来视频与机器人动作，但推理开销大。少步蒸馏虽减少采样步数，但其粗略更新会使学生偏离教师轨迹。
AI.method: 从学生到达的状态出发继续运行教师至零噪声，得到端点与首个中间状态作为双目标；模态路由适配器从同一状态学习匹配两类目标；当两梯度冲突时采用锚点优先更新，保留端点梯度并去除同模态内局部梯度的对立分量。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0 上（仅 Clean 训练，直接评测 Random 域随机化）：一步时闭环成功率较基线蒸馏提升 2.0（Clean）/1.4（Random）个百分点；视频 PSNR 由 30.169 升至 32.317 dB，SSIM 与 LPIPS 亦改善。真机两任务上优于一步教师，控制周期延迟相比八步教师降低 21.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: APM 有效缓解少步蒸馏的轨迹偏移，单一检查点即可在部署时按预算选择 1/2/4 步采样，无需重训练或查询教师，兼顾成功率与推理效率。

title: ResoLUT: Distilling Residual Networks into Lookup-Table Networks
summary: Logic networks built from Boolean gates or lookup tables (LUTs) promise efficient hardware inference, but training them at depth and learning their connectivity remain difficult. We do not train logic as logic. Instead, ResoLUT distills a trained residual network (ResNet) layer by layer into LUT trees, preserving its multi-bit residual stream and BatchNorm while extracting connectivity from the teacher rather than learning it. To our knowledge, ResoLUT is the first convolutional logic network in computer vision to retain a ResNet-style multi-bit residual stream. Hard LUT decisions are used throughout training and inference, avoiding a discretization gap in the logic. ResoLUT-20 reaches 95.66% on CIFAR-10 with twice the trees, and ResoLUT-56 reaches 78.87% on CIFAR-100 and 53.69% on ImageNet at 64px, the best results of logic and lookup-table networks on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, showing that LUT networks can scale in depth. We explore and quantify the role of the residuals and the tree budget and shape. The most optimized model, a ResoLUT-8 with one eighth of the trees and further optimizations, fits on an FPGA and reaches 90.04% at 189k images per second, the highest throughput among the compared models above 85% on CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: ResoLUT 通过逐层将训练的 ResNet 蒸馏为 LUT 树，保留多比特残差流与 BatchNorm，从教师网络提取连接而非学习连接，实现深层可扩展的逻辑网络。
AI.motivation: 布尔门/LUT 构成的逻辑网络有望高效硬件推理，但在深层训练与学习连接结构上很困难，现有方法也多在"逻辑"层面直接训练，存在离散化鸿沟。
AI.method: 不把逻辑当逻辑训练：逐层把 ResNet 蒸馏成 LUT 树，保留多比特残差流和 BatchNorm，连接由教师网络提供；训练与推理全程使用硬 LUT 决策，避免离散化间隙。
AI.result: ResoLUT-20 在 CIFAR-10 达 95.66%（两倍树数），ResoLUT-56 在 CIFAR-100 达 78.87%、ImageNet(64px) 达 53.69%，为逻辑/LUT 网络在 CIFAR-10/100 上最好结果。优化版 ResoLUT-8 仅用 1/8 树数并部署 FPGA，达 90.04% 与 189k 图像/秒，是 85% 以上 CIFAR-10 对比模型中最高的吞吐。
AI.conclusion: LUT 网络可以在深度上扩展；残差流与树预算/形状的作用被量化；蒸馏式设计兼具精度与 FPGA 吞吐优势。

title: Synergizing Evidence Retrieval and Utilization for Self-Improving Multimodal Scientific Document Reasoning
summary: Scientific document reasoning requires an agent to acquire and integrate evidence distributed across text, figures, and tables. Retrieval can identify relevant sources while missing complementary support, and answer-level feedback alone does not reveal whether an error stems from evidence acquisition or evidence use. We present an agentic Retriever--Perceiver--Reasoner framework for multimodal scientific document reasoning. The Retriever sequentially selects source-aligned evidence under a context budget. Given the selected evidence and question, the Perceiver constructs a question-conditioned latent ontology, an implicit organization of multimodal evidence in a shared continuous space. The Reasoner combines this latent guidance with the original sources to produce grounded answers. We train the three components through diagnostic-guided co-evolution: alternating updates optimize them with a shared answering reward, while Retrieval Potential Feedback (RPF) and Latent Efficacy Feedback (LEF) identify questions that need better retrieval or latent guidance and direct targeted resampling. Across four benchmarks and seven evaluation settings, our framework obtains average scores of 69.9 and 75.0 with 7B and 8B Reasoner backbones, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.0 and 9.1 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Retriever–Perceiver–Reasoner智能体框架，用于多模态科学文档推理，并通过诊断引导的协同进化训练提升检索与证据利用。
AI.motivation: 科学文档推理需整合文本、图、表等分布式证据；检索易漏掉互补支撑，且仅靠答案级反馈无法区分错误来自证据获取还是证据使用。
AI.method: Retriever在上下文预算下顺序选取与来源对齐的证据；Perceiver基于证据与问题构建问题条件化的潜本体（共享连续空间中的多模态隐式组织）；Reasoner结合潜引导与原始来源生成有据答案。三者通过诊断引导协同进化训练：交替优化共享答案奖励，并用Retrieval Potential Feedback与Latent Efficacy Feedback识别需改进检索或潜引导的问题，指导定向重采样。
AI.result: 在四个基准、七种评测设置下，7B与8B Reasoner骨干平均得分69.9与75.0，分别超过最强基线4.0和9.1分。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度诊断反馈驱动的检索-感知-推理协同进化有效提升多模态科学文档推理性能。

title: Large-scale Neuron Community Discovery Reveals Neuron-Sparse Behaviors in Language Models
summary: What reusable units of computation can we discover within a language model's neurons? Prior work has shown that individual forward passes can often be sparsified post-hoc to small groups of neurons, but it has been unclear whether these groups form coherent computational entities reused across inputs. We introduce neuron community discovery, an unsupervised method for finding neuron groups that recur across prompts and are causally necessary and sufficient, within the layers they span, for common computations. The method combines gradient-based attribution, a graph connecting neurons that are repeatedly attributed together, and community detection. Applied to Llama-3.1-8B using ten million prompts, it discovers thousands of candidate communities. We evaluate them on held-out prompts through three causal tests: community necessity, sufficiency within a layer subset, and layer necessity. These tests identify groups whose removal disrupts predictions and whose retention preserves predictions despite ablating the remaining MLP neurons in the tested layers. Discovered communities support functions like grammatical agreement, token-probability calibration, fixed phrases, in-context copying, addition, and multiplication. With communities capped at 128 neurons across all layers, 10.3% of held-out prompts have at least one layer's contribution explained on a neuron-sparse basis. Coverage remains 8.7% when requiring at least four layers and 3.3% when requiring at least twelve. These results show that small groups of existing neurons can provide reusable computational components across prompts, and that such groups can be discovered at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"神经元社区发现"方法，从Llama-3.1-8B的上千万提示中发现可跨输入复用的神经元小群体，并通过三项因果测试验证其必要性与充分性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明单次前向传播可事后稀疏化为少量神经元，但这些神经元组是否构成跨输入复用的连贯计算单元尚不清楚。
AI.method: 无监督方法：结合梯度归因、构建"反复被共同归因"的神经元图与社区检测，在Llama-3.1-8B上用一千万提示挖掘候选社区；再用留出提示做三项因果测试（社区必要性、层子集内充分性、层必要性）。
AI.result: 发现数千个候选社区，涉及语法一致、token概率校准、固定短语、上下文复制、加法与乘法等功能；社区上限128个神经元时，10.3%的留出提示至少有一层的贡献可由神经元稀疏方式解释，要求≥4层时为8.7%，≥12层时为3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 现有神经元中的小群体可提供跨提示复用的计算组件，且此类社区可大规模地被自动发现。

title: Propose with the Gradient, Accept with the Loss: One Hedged Attack for Pixel-Sparse Robustness
summary: A pixel-sparse adversary may change a few pixels of an image to any value. Robustness to such attacks is currently measured with an ensemble, sparse-AutoAttack (sAA), because its members fail in different places: sparse projected gradient descent (sPGD) trusts a first-order model that a full pixel change breaks, and sparse random search (Sparse-RS) ignores the gradient even where it is informative. We show that both attacks are local searches, each a proposal distribution plus an acceptance rule, and ask what such a search can learn from the gradient. A Taylor bound says what to measure, and measurements at the states the search visits give five rules. The sign of the gradient is its most reliable use at a single pixel and sets a new pixel's value. Its ranking of candidate pixels should be followed loosely, and its ranking of the pixels to remove, which is often more reliable, can be followed more closely. A pixel should not be proposed twice before a move is accepted, and acceptance should be decided by the loss alone. These rules define Gradient-guided Random Search (GRS), which runs once and costs one forward and one backward pass per step. On 13 CIFAR-10 configurations and 5 ImageNet models, GRS matches or beats the best single member of sAA and is within one point of sAA itself or stronger on 17 of 18 settings, and it is significantly stronger than sAA on 8. It uses 3 instead of up to 7 forward-pass units, and on CIFAR-10 it runs 3.7 to 5.0 times faster than the members of sAA run in full.

AI.tldr: 提出GRS（梯度引导随机搜索），统一地将稀疏攻击视为"提议分布+接受规则"的局部搜索，用五条基于泰勒界的规则融合梯度信息，单次运行即可匹配或超越sAA集成，并快3.7–5.0倍。
AI.motivation: 像素稀疏攻击的鲁棒性目前用sAA集成衡量，因为其成员弱点互补：sPGD依赖易被全像素改动破坏的一阶模型，Sparse-RS则完全忽略梯度。作者希望弄清局部搜索究竟能从梯度中学到什么，从而设计单一高效的攻击。
AI.method: 将sPGD与Sparse-RS统一为"提议分布+接受规则"的局部搜索框架；借助泰勒界确定应测的量，并在搜索访问状态处测量，导出五条规则：单像素上用梯度符号设定新值；候选像素排序松散遵循；待移除像素排序更可靠、可更紧密遵循；移动被接受前不重复提议同一像素；接受与否仅由损失决定。由此构成GRS，每步仅需一次前向和一次反向。
AI.result: 在13种CIFAR-10配置和5个ImageNet模型上，GRS匹配或超越sAA最强单一成员；18个设置中17个与sAA差距在1分以内或更强，其中8个显著强于sAA。计算成本为3个前向单元（sAA最多7个），CIFAR-10上比sAA成员完整运行快3.7–5.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 梯度在稀疏局部搜索中有明确且有限的最佳用法：符号最可靠、排序宜松紧有别、接受只看损失。GRS以更低成本达到或超过集成攻击的强度，可作为更高效的稀疏鲁棒性评估方法。

title: DDSL: Iterative Self-Labeling for Financial Market States
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Conference version published in ICAIF 2026. Code available at https://github.com/hogwild/DDSL
summary: Financial market states lack a unique ground truth and must therefore be constructed from price data. Conventional labeling methods typically define states independently of the downstream classifier, leaving unresolved whether the resulting labels can be recovered from information available at prediction time. We propose DDSL, an iterative self-labeling framework that couples a price- and grammar-guided Viterbi labeler with a Transformer classifier through model feedback. DDSL constructs a nine-state representation that jointly encodes current and future market trends while retaining structured price emissions and temporal constraints throughout refinement. Experiments on SSE50, CSI300, CSI500, and NASDAQ100 show that DDSL increases held-out joint-state macro F1 by 78%-96% over single-pass dynamic-programming labeling. An independent GRU classifier that never participates in the labeling loop reproduces the same trend, while label entropy and class coverage remain stable, indicating that the gain transfers across architectures and is not caused by label collapse. We further show that learnability is controlled by both iteration and the model-feedback weight $β_{\mathrm{model}}$. Iterative gains diminish as successive label systems converge, whereas stronger feedback increasingly widens the performance gap between the feedback Transformer and the independent GRU. Increased learnability is accompanied by declining segment-level price-feature separation after an initial improvement. Finally, a non-anticipative event study provides partial external validation: refinement strengthens a conditional BEAR$\rightarrow$BULL reversal signal on the three A-share datasets, while the corresponding effect has the opposite sign on NASDAQ100. These results position DDSL as a structured framework for constructing market-state labels whose learnability can be explicitly controlled and evaluated.

AI.tldr: DDSL是一个迭代自标注框架，通过模型反馈把价格与语法引导的Viterbi标注器与Transformer分类器耦合，构造可学习的九状态市场状态标签，并显式控制与评估其可学习性。
AI.motivation: 金融市场状态没有唯一真值，只能由价格数据构造；传统标注方法与下游分类器独立定义，无法确定标签能否由预测时可得的信息恢复。
AI.method: DDSL以价格与语法引导的Viterbi标注器生成九状态表示（联合编码当前与未来趋势，保留结构化价格发射与时间约束），再通过模型反馈与Transformer分类器迭代自标注耦合。
AI.result: 在SSE50、CSI300、CSI500、NASDAQ100上，留出联合状态宏F1较单次动态规划标注提升78%-96%；不参与标注回路的独立GRU复现同样趋势，标签熵与类别覆盖稳定，排除标签塌缩；可学习性受迭代次数与反馈权重β_model控制，迭代增益随标签系统收敛而递减，反馈越强两类模型差距越大；可学习性提升伴随分段价格特征区分度先升后降；事件研究显示A股三数据集的BEAR→BULL反转条件信号增强，而NASDAQ100符号相反。
AI.conclusion: DDSL提供了可显式控制与评估可学习性的结构化市场状态标签构造框架。

title: Verifying Agents in Rubric-Graded Environments
summary: As AI agents take on increasingly open-ended and complex tasks, verifying their outputs has proven to be difficult. Rubric-graded agent environments, where a verifier judges multiple natural-language criteria against the deliverables and environment state changes produced by the agent, have emerged as a popular paradigm. We conduct the first systematic study of verifiers for rubric-graded agent environments. First, we create BankerVerifierBench (BVB), a meta-evaluation dataset of 2,464 human-judged rubric criteria across 24 investment-banking tasks.
