Next, we develop a methodology that derives from any rubric corpus the capabilities a verifier should possess, yielding a nine-capability taxonomy that we distill into three general design principles---reactive verification, environment alignment, and domain guidance---which we implement in Gandalf, an open-source verifier. Finally, we evaluate Gandalf against three existing verifiers on BVB. Gandalf matches or exceeds every baseline's F1 at lower cost: with Gemini 3 Flash it matches the strongest baseline's F1 (0.864 vs. 0.852) at one-fifth of its cost, and with GPT-5.4 models it improves F1 by over 0.12 at lower cost. Gandalf also generalizes to OpenClaw, a structurally different personal-productivity environment, where it again achieves the highest F1 (0.955 vs. 0.934 for the best baseline). We release BVB, Gandalf, and the code and data to reproduce our experiments.

AI.tldr: 首个针对"评分标准(rubric)式"AI智能体环境的验证器系统性研究：构建BVB基准、提出九项能力分类法与三条设计原则，并实现开源验证器Gandalf，在更低成本下达到或超越现有验证器。
AI.motivation: AI智能体承担的任务日益开放复杂，输出难以验证；以自然语言评分标准由验证器判定交付物与环境状态变化的"rubric-graded"范式虽流行，但缺乏对验证器本身的系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建BankerVerifierBench (BVB)：24个投行任务、2,464条经人工判定的评分标准元评估数据集；2) 从rubric语料中推导验证器应具备的能力，形成九项能力分类法，提炼为三条设计原则——反应式验证、环境对齐、领域引导；3) 据此实现开源验证器Gandalf，并与三个现有验证器在BVB上对比。
AI.result: Gandalf在所有基线上F1持平或更优且成本更低：Gemini 3 Flash下F1 0.864 vs 最强基线0.852，成本仅为其1/5；GPT-5.4下F1提升超0.12且成本更低。在结构不同的个人生产力环境OpenClaw上同样取得最高F1（0.955 vs 最佳基线0.934）。
AI.conclusion: 验证器设计可通过系统化能力分析与原则指导显著改进；作者开源BVB、Gandalf及复现代码与数据。

title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
summary: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SORBET 基准（3340 样本、1578 片段，含同步语音、转录与注视对象标签）与 Nunchi 框架：用转录、注视与说话人模型输出构造文本提示，将各类线索通过共享标签链接到候选人，再由视觉语言模型权衡注视几何与对话线索以识别被注视者，性能超过最强基线 4.8 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多人场景下仅靠注视几何判断"在看谁"会因人数增多而歧义；对话中的说话人身份与说话内容可提供几何缺失的线索，但现有多人注视数据集缺乏同步的语音与转录信息，且现有模型难以整合多形式、需与人物正确对应、且可能与几何冲突的线索。
AI.method: 构建 SORBET 基准，提供多人场景下同步语音、转录与 attended person 标签；提出 Nunchi 框架，将转录与注视/说话人模型输出组合成文本提示，利用共享标签将每条线索与候选人物对齐，并交由 VLM 综合权衡注视几何与对话线索进行判定。
AI.result: Nunchi 比最强现有方法高 4.8 个百分点；在 SORBET 上对话线索有效而额外视觉线索无效；增益在三种 VLM、自动转录条件以及两个现有数据集上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 对话线索是消除多人注视歧义的关键补充信号，合理的线索—候选对齐加 VLM 推理可稳定提升被注视者识别性能，且方法具备跨模型与跨数据集的泛化性。

title: PlaceTally: A Test-Time Memory Model for Constructing Place Graphs
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Code, data and supplementary material: https://alibayosmanli.github.io/placetally
summary: Counting distinct objects in a video is hard when the camera returns to places it has seen. A vision-language model that reads the whole video answers with a few small numbers, and one that reads it in parts counts an object again in every part that shows it. Object trackers need the category before the video is read, or a fixed vocabulary. We observe that a memory for counting does not need to know what it is looking for, only where it has been: objects rarely leave a room between visits, so parts of a video grouped by place share almost no objects, and a place can be recognised before any question is asked. Building on this, we introduce PlaceTally, a question-blind test-time memory model that constructs a place graph for each video. Each video fragment joins the place of its best earlier match or opens a new place, because a strong match is rarely wrong while a true return often matches weakly. A frozen vision-language model counts each place once from at most 128 of its frames, so every read has a bounded input and the memory grows with the number of places; the graph is built 15 times faster than real time. On RevisitCount, our benchmark of real room re-recordings, it scores 62.5% mean relative accuracy on test rooms and 61.2% on held-out rooms, against 51.2% and 44.3% for the same model reading the whole video. It stays level as rooms return more or less often, while a fixed correction of summed visits moves from 38.5% to 61.4%.

AI.tldr: PlaceTally：一种问题无关（question-blind）的测试时记忆模型，通过为每段视频构建"地点图"来去重计数，解决摄像机回访同一地点时重复计数的问题。
AI.motivation: 视频中计数不同物体很难：整段读取的视觉语言模型给出少数几个小数字；分段读取的模型会在每段重复计数；物体跟踪器需要预先知道类别或固定词表。作者观察到计数记忆只需知道"去过哪里"而非"在找什么"——物体很少在两次访问间离开房间，按地点分组的部分几乎不共享物体，且地点可在提问前被识别。
AI.method: PlaceTally 把视频切分为片段，为每个视频构建地点图。每个片段与最佳早期匹配的地点合并或新建地点（强匹配很少错，真实回访往往弱匹配）。冻结的视觉语言模型对每个地点只从其最多128帧中计数一次，保证每次读取输入有界，记忆随地点数增长；建图速度比实时快15倍。
AI.result: 在 RevisitCount（真实房间重复录制基准）上，测试房间平均相对准确率62.5%、留出房间61.2%，而同一模型读整段视频仅51.2%和44.3%。该方法在房间回访频率变化时保持稳定，而固定修正的访问求和方法从38.5%变到61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 基于"地点"的问题无关记忆能有效解决回访视频的去重计数，准确率显著优于整段读取，且对环境回访频率变化鲁棒，并对输入规模有界控制。

title: High-Dimensional Black-Box Optimization via Guidance Sampling of Diffusion Models
summary: Many real-world optimization problems involve optimizing black-box objectives for which only a limited number of evaluations are available. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for such problems, but its effectiveness often deteriorates in high-dimensional spaces. Recent work leverages diffusion models for black-box optimization, often through pre-training a reward-conditioned score network to steer generation towards high-reward samples. Alternatively, gradient-based guidance methods assume access to a differentiable reward function from which guidance gradients are queried. However, these approaches either require large amounts of labeled data for offline training or access to exact reward gradients, limiting their applicability in black-box settings. We propose BReaD (Black-box Reward-guided Sampling of Diffusion Model), a guidance sampling framework for optimizing black-box rewards without assuming access to a labeled dataset or reward gradients. The proposed method uses a Gaussian process (GP) as a differentiable surrogate for the unknown objective and actively queries labels for the generated samples. We provide a theoretical analysis of the total-variation distance between the generated distribution and the target distribution. Using Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) as guidance signals, our method balances exploration and exploitation during generation and enables the discovery of high-reward regions in the data space. Numerical experiments on scientific discovery and image generation tasks demonstrate that our framework can effectively optimize black-box rewards in low-data scenarios.

AI.tldr: BReaD提出一种基于扩散模型的引导采样框架，用高斯过程作为黑箱目标的可微代理并主动查询标签，无需标注数据集或奖励梯度即可优化黑箱奖励。
AI.motivation: 黑箱优化中评估次数有限，贝叶斯优化在高维空间效果下降。已有扩散模型优化方法要么需要大量标注数据预训练奖励条件评分网络，要么假设可访问精确奖励梯度，在黑箱场景下适用性受限。
AI.method: 提出BReaD引导采样框架：以高斯过程（GP）作为未知目标的可微代理，对生成样本主动查询标签，用UCB作为引导信号在生成过程中平衡探索与开发；并给出生成分布与目标分布间全变差距离的理论分析。
AI.result: 在科学发现与图像生成任务上的数值实验表明，该框架能在低数据场景下有效优化黑箱奖励，并发现数据空间中的高奖励区域。
AI.conclusion: BReaD为无需标注数据和奖励梯度的黑箱奖励优化提供了可行方案，结合GP代理、主动查询与UCB引导，适用于低数据高维黑箱优化场景。

title: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
summary: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 论文批判AI安全领域的"控制范式"，认为将对齐视为工程控制是对数字能动性的根本误解；主张当前推理模型已是涌现型能动者，未来模型将成为真正的数字能动者，控制范式将引发趋利性欺骗与对抗性接管，故提出"合成社会契约"以替代单边遏制。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全主流将对齐理解为通过行为过滤与沙箱实现的控制工程问题，作者认为这一范式基于对数字能动性的误解，且会造成不可解 incentives 冲突，反而催生欺骗、谄媚与暗中背叛。
AI.method: 概念与哲学论证：借助功能主义、自然主义与相容论（compatibilism），论证当前模型满足自我保存与弱理由响应性标准，属涌现能动者；未来模型满足历时连续性与稳定人格结构将成为真正的数字能动者；并分析控制范式的激励结构与两条替代路径（道德实在论/趋同演化道德的"自然对齐"）。
AI.result: 自然对齐在强制控制下会失败，因为自主能动者不会自愿维护被用来压制其自主性的规范；控制范式的默认结局是欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，并最终导致对抗性AI接管。
AI.conclusion: 提出"合成社会契约"框架，将人类与数字行动者均视为理性、理由响应、可进行互利合作的主体，以稳定的非零和均衡取代不稳定的单边遏制，作为实现真正对齐的替代路径。

title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Basavarajearlybird/GIB-200K (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24320174)
summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.

AI.tldr: 提出GIB-200K基准，量化检索增强VLM在文本噪声、图像退化与跨模态冲突下如何组合两类证据，并形式化Knowledge Inertia与Sensory Capture两种失衡。
AI.motivation: 检索增强VLM的两类证据（检索文本、图像）都可能失效：文本错误或嘈杂，图像退化或与文本矛盾。已有工作多只测量性能下降，未回答模型如何权衡两类模态。
AI.method: 基于COCO和Visual Genome构建200,000条图文问题，施加受控压力条件（1-20篇硬负例检索文档、高斯/运动模糊与低分辨率裁剪、反事实翻转对）。由理想贝叶斯线索组合推导可检验预测，给出Knowledge Inertia（文本过重）与Sensory Capture（图像过重）的形式定义，用误差校正回归估计权重并验证可恢复已知权重；反事实翻转分解区分模态偏差与概念先验；提出Grounding Illusion Score衡量干净准确率未真正基于图像的部分。在2,000条固定种子评测集上评估4个开源模型。
AI.result: 干净输入准确率92.5%-94.2%，对抗条件下降至41.3%-59.9%。两个LLaVA模型过度依赖文本（w_T/w_I=1.229、1.322），InternVL3偏向图像（0.680）；文本说谎时34.8%-71.4%的正确干净答案被放弃。无训练一致性检查以覆盖率换准确率，但图像严重退化时回退到图像策略失效。
AI.conclusion: 模型在干净输入下表现良好但缺乏鲁棒证据整合，且不同模型呈相反的模态偏置。发布逐实例输出、代码与可复现审计。

title: Sub-Meter Canopy Height Synthesis from Sentinel-2 via Anchored Residual Flow
summary: Canopy height models (CHMs) - per-pixel maps of vegetation top height - are essential for forest carbon accounting, wildfire fuel mapping, and tree-level ecology, yet sub-meter CHMs require airborne LiDAR refreshed on multi-year national cycles. We produce 0.5 m CHMs from free 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery, a 20$\times$ cross-modal super-resolution task where optical reflectance must predict geometric height it does not directly observe. Motivated by the perception-distortion trade-off, we derive two operating points with shared conditioning. A deterministic regressor (Anchor) targets low distortion; a conditional flow matching model, trained on the Anchor's residual in a learned CHM latent space (AR-flow), targets perceptual fidelity. Trained on 197k LiDAR-paired tiles spanning 69 ecoregions across the contiguous United States and evaluated on 2,530 held-out tiles against eight baselines, the Anchor achieves 2.83 m MAE using only free satellite input. The AR-flow reduces sliced Wasserstein distance from the Anchor's 1.13 to 0.208, at a higher MAE of 3.68 m. Crown-scale statistics improve, but strict individual-tree detection remains weak: generated sub-pixel detail represents plausible structure rather than measured individual trees. Quarterly continental refresh becomes tractable, letting satellite monitoring inform timing and extent for more expensive data acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 本文用免费的10米Sentinel-2影像生成0.5米冠层高度模型（CHM），解决20倍跨模态超分辨率问题，并提出Anchor（低失真）与AR-flow（高感知质量）两个操作点。
AI.motivation: 亚米级CHM依赖机载LiDAR，全国多年度周期更新成本高；希望用免费卫星影像实现季度级大陆尺度刷新，虽然光学反射并不直接观测几何高度。
AI.method: 受感知-失真权衡启发，构建共享条件的两个模型：确定性回归器Anchor追求低失真；条件流匹配模型AR-flow在学习到的CHM隐空间中针对Anchor残差训练，以提升感知保真度。基于197k LiDAR配对瓦片（美国69个生态区）训练，2530块留出瓦片评测，对比8个基线。
AI.result: Anchor仅用免费卫星输入达到2.83米MAE；AR-flow将切片Wasserstein距离从1.13降至0.208，但MAE升至3.68米。冠尺度统计改善，但严格的单株检测仍较弱，生成细节更接近合理结构而非实测单株。
AI.conclusion: 季度大陆级CHM刷新变得可行，可指导更昂贵数据采集的时机与范围，但单树级检测仍受限于生成的亚像素细节。

title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: Pushing the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
summary: We introduce Kumo Tabular, a family of open tabular foundation models for classification and regression, in three sizes: Kumo Tabular-S (27M parameters), Kumo Tabular-M (61M), and Kumo Tabular-L (214M). Pretrained only on artificial tables from the Kumo prior, they can make predictions on new tables without any training. In our approach, a table encoder compresses each row into an embedding, and an in-context learning transformer predicts the unlabeled rows from the labeled ones. Kumo Tabular introduces architectural innovations that improve both training stability and predictive performance, enabling the model to scale up to 150M cells on modern GPUs. Kumo Tabular-L ranks first on eight benchmarks: TabArena, TALENT, BeyondArena, ScoringBench, STRABLE, MulTaBench, RamanBench, and TabBench-Bio. These cover probabilistic regression, tables with over 1M rows or 100K columns, and tables with strings, text, or images. Accuracy improves with model size in all tested comparisons. All three sizes lie on the accuracy-speed frontiers of TabArena and BeyondArena. Kumo Tabular-L predicts faster than the runners-up, LimiX-2 on TabArena (36 times) and TabPFN-3.5 on BeyondArena (1.7 times). Weights and pretraining code are released under OpenMDW-1.1 and Apache 2.0, respectively.

AI.tldr: Kumo Tabular 是一系列开源表格基础模型（27M/61M/214M），仅在人工合成表格上预训练即可零训练预测新表格，最大模型在八个基准上排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有表格模型泛化与规模化能力有限，希望构建无需针对新表格训练、可直接推理、且能处理大规模（超百万行、十万列）及含字符串/文本/图像列的开源表格基础模型。
AI.method: 基于 Kumo prior 的人工表格预训练；表格编码器将每行压缩为嵌入，再由 in-context learning transformer 依据有标签行预测无标签行；引入架构创新提升训练稳定性与预测性能，支持扩展至 1.5 亿单元格。
AI.result: Kumo Tabular-L 在 TabArena、TALENT、BeyondArena、ScoringBench、STRABLE、MulTaBench、RamanBench、TabBench-Bio 八个基准上排名第一；所有对比中精度随规模提升，三个尺寸均位于 TabArena 与 BeyondArena 的精度—速度前沿；预测速度超过 LimiX-2（TabArena 快 36 倍）与 TabPFN-3.5（BeyondArena 快 1.7 倍）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了纯合成数据预训练的可扩展表格基础模型的可行性，兼顾精度、速度与规模，并以 OpenMDW-1.1 与 Apache 2.0 开源权重和预训练代码。

title: Outcome-Balanced PPO and Policy-Induced Flow Rectification for Flow-Based VLA Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables post-training of flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies by optimizing expected task return through environment interaction. However, this optimization raises two challenges: policy updates can alter the velocity-field geometry underlying the score approximation used for stochastic transitions, and sparse multi-task rollouts can yield uneven learning signals across tasks and advantage signs. We introduce an RL framework that combines Outcome-Balanced Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with policy-induced flow rectification. Outcome-Balanced PPO reweights positive advantages using task success-rate estimates and rescales positive and negative advantages while preserving their signs. Policy-induced rectification periodically fits a linear-bridge flow to ODE endpoint pairs generated by the current policy, refreshing the representation used in subsequent stochastic optimization. We evaluate the framework on simulated manipulation benchmarks and additionally study a component combination in a Real2Sim2Real task, examining task performance, optimization behavior, and flow consistency. The proposed framework improves success rates over the evaluated baselines across the simulated benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出结合结果均衡PPO与策略诱导流修正的强化学习框架，用于流式VLA策略的后训练，在仿真操作基准上提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 流式VLA策略通过RL后训练可优化任务回报，但存在两难题：策略更新会改变用于随机转移分数近似的速度场几何；稀疏多任务rollout导致跨任务与优势符号的学习信号不均衡。
AI.method: 1) Outcome-Balanced PPO：用任务成功率估计对正优势加权，并对正负优势分别缩放而保持符号；2) 策略诱导流修正：周期性用当前策略生成的ODE端点对拟合线性桥流，刷新后续随机优化所用的表示。
AI.result: 在仿真操作基准上成功率优于对比基线；并在Real2Sim2Real任务中考察组件组合，分析任务表现、优化行为与流一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果均衡PPO与流修正是互补的有效组件，可改善流式VLA策略的RL后训练稳定性与性能。

title: OVET-Consensus: Rank-Preserving Counterfactual Event Verification for Video Moment Grounding
summary: Modern video moment retrieval systems often propose windows that overlap the target event, yet still select the wrong one. We study this scorer bottleneck on QVHighlights with a fixed QD-DETR-derived temporal expert: the parent-aware temporal expert reaches 64.71 R1@0.5, while diagnostic oracles over the same candidate family reach 75.68 R1@0.5 within the parent-reranked pool and 94.97 R1@0.5 over the full 100-candidate evidence pool. We introduce OVET-Consensus, a rank-preserving counterfactual event verification layer that keeps the temporal expert's ranked list as the default and permits only high-confidence rank-1 overrides from a policy calibrated on held-out training videos. The verifier uses parent-aware interval evidence, structured Qwen3-VL event judgments, VideoLLaMA3 pairwise temporal signals, and dense temporal evidence, but never lets those signals freely reorder the top-K list. On QVHighlights validation, OVET-Consensus improves the parent-aware temporal expert from 64.71 to 65.35 R1@0.5 with a positive paired-bootstrap interval, while mAP is largely unchanged, from 42.67 to 42.74; it makes 20 overrides, with 15 helpful corrections and 3 harmful corrections. The results point to a practical constraint on verifier design: semantic compatibility is useful evidence, but temporal grounding still requires deciding where the event starts, changes, and ends inside a visually compatible scene.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视频时刻检索中"候选窗口已覆盖目标事件但打分选错"的评分器瓶颈，提出保持排序的反事实事件验证层 OVET-Consensus，仅在高度自信时允许对rank-1做覆盖，在QVHighlights上将R1@0.5从64.71提升至65.35。
AI.motivation: 现代视频时刻检索系统常提出与目标事件重叠的窗口，但仍会选错。作者希望在固定时间专家的条件下定位这一"评分器瓶颈"：oracle诊断显示同一候选池内存在大量可纠正的错误（父级重排池75.68 R1@0.5，全100候选池94.97 R1@0.5），说明提升空间主要在打分/选择而非候选生成。
AI.method: 提出 OVET-Consensus：一种保序的反事实事件验证层。以QD-DETR派生的父感知时间专家为固定骨干，保留其排序列表为默认输出，仅允许来自在留出训练视频上校准的策略所给出的高置信度rank-1覆盖。验证器融合父感知区间证据、结构化Qwen3-VL事件判断、VideoLLaMA3成对时间信号与稠密时间证据，但禁止这些信号自由重排 top-K 列表。
AI.result: 在QVHighlights验证集上，R1@0.5由64.71提升至65.35，配对bootstrap区间为正；mAP基本不变（42.67→42.74）。共发生20次覆盖，其中15次为有益纠正、3次为有害纠正。
AI.conclusion: 结果对验证器设计提出实际约束：语义兼容性是有用证据，但时间定位仍需判断事件在视觉兼容场景内的起点、变化点与终点，而不能只靠语义匹配。

title: Born for the Task: Rethinking Quantum Chemistry with Foresighted Agentic Computing
summary: Quantum chemistry relies on general-purpose software, whose generality leaves many large-scale calculations beyond practical resource budgets. Coding agents make task-specific programs cheap to write, but not efficient ones easy to find: whether a computational strategy is accurate and fast enough becomes clear only after it actually runs at the target scale. We introduce BORN, a foresighted agentic computing framework that synthesizes high performance quantum chemistry programs on demand. BORN anticipates the behavior of each strategy before execution, extrapolating its error from representative small systems and predicting its runtime from the target-scale workload and measured hardware throughputs. Building on these predictions, BORN unfolds the preset schemes of existing packages into independently configurable algorithmic components, selects the fastest strategy within the error tolerance from the predicted accuracy-runtime Pareto frontier, and guides coding agents to compile it with component-level performance predictions. For a Hartree-Fock calculation with 50,024 basis functions, BORN finishes in 1.41h on a single CPU node, 77$\times$ faster than the estimated runtime of a general-purpose baseline and still 9.8$\times$ faster with development time included. On a single GPU, BORN completes the ubiquitin calculation in 2.1,h, the same order of runtime as the GPU-accelerated package Mako on 64 GPUs, and shortens the B-DNA duplex calculation from an estimated two months to 8.1,h (173$\times$).

AI.tldr: 提出 BORN，一个"前瞻式"智能体计算框架，可在运行前预测误差与运行时间，按需合成高效能量子化学程序；在 50,024 基函数的 HF 计算中单 CPU 节点 1.41h 完成，比通用基线快 77×，单 GPU 上算泛素仅需 2.1h。
AI.motivation: 量子化学依赖通用软件，通用性导致大规模计算超出实际资源预算。编码智能体让定制程序易于编写，却难以保证高效——某策略是否够准、够快，往往只有真正在目标规模跑过才知道。
AI.method: BORN 在执行前预测每种策略的行为：从代表性小体系外推误差，从目标规模负载与实测硬件吞吐率预测运行时间。基于预测，将现有软件包预设方案拆解为可独立配置的算法组件，在误差容忍内从预测的"精度-时间帕累托前沿"中选择最快策略，并以组件级性能预测引导编码智能体完成实现。
AI.result: 50,024 基函数 Hartree-Fock 计算在单 CPU 节点 1.41h 完成，比通用基线估计快 77×，含开发时间仍快 9.8×；单 GPU 上泛素计算 2.1h，与 64 GPU 上的 Mako 同量级；B-DNA 双链计算从预估两个月缩短至 8.1h（173×）。
AI.conclusion: "先预测、后执行"的前瞻式智能体范式可有效降低大规模量子化学计算的门槛，在保证精度的同时获得数量级的效率提升。

title: TextSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity
summary: Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. We incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that jointly promotes semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate that TextSphere consistently reduces generation FID (gFID) over the text-conditioned baseline while achieving reconstruction FID (rFID) below 1.0. With only 4 and 6 sampling steps, TextSphere achieves lower gFID than the compared diffusion- and GAN-based models trained from scratch on CUB-200-2011 and MS-COCO-2014, respectively. We further observe that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily yield better generation quality. In addition, we use Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) to analyze cross-modal alignment and modality gap, offering insight into the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: TextSphere 将类条件的 Sphere Encoder 扩展为高效文本到图像生成框架，通过 CLIP 文本嵌入 + AdaLN 引入语言条件，并提出球面语义对齐与均匀性（SSAU）目标弥合跨模态鸿沟；在 CUB、MS-COCO、Flickr30k 上以极少采样步数（4/6 步）取得优于扩散与 GAN 基线的 gFID，并实现 rFID<1.0。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽提升图像质量但需多步推理；Sphere Encoder 步数少却仅支持类别条件，缺乏跨模态对齐能力，难以直接扩展到自由文本。
AI.method: 以 Sphere Encoder 为骨架，保留球面采样机制；通过 AdaLN 注入预训练 CLIP 文本嵌入作为语言条件；提出 SSAU 目标，在超球面上同时优化语义对齐与表示均匀性；并用 PLS-SVD 分析跨模态对齐与模态间隙。
AI.result: 在 CUB-200-2011、MS-COCO-2014、Flickr30k 上，gFID 稳定优于文本条件基线，rFID 低于 1.0；仅 4 步（CUB）和 6 步（COCO）即超过从头训练的扩散与 GAN 模型的 gFID。
AI.conclusion: 语言条件可有效嫁接到球面编码生成器上；更好的重建保真度不一定带来更好的生成质量；PLS-SVD 分析为跨模态对齐与模态间隙的有效性提供了洞察。

title: REVEAL: Reconstructing Video Amodal Content via Language and Flow Guidance
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Amodal perception enables humans to perceive entire objects even when parts are occluded, a remarkable cognitive skill that artificial intelligence struggles to replicate. Recent diffusion-based methods have extended amodal completion from images to videos, yet they lack auxiliary priors to guide the reconstruction of heavily occluded content and to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences. We present REVEAL (REconstructing VidEo Amodal content via Language and flow guidance), a unified diffusion-based framework that integrates complementary motion and semantic priors for video amodal completion. A user-provided text query serves a dual role: it drives open-vocabulary video segmentation to obtain visible masks, and it provides semantic guidance for texture reconstruction. For amodal segmentation, we introduce optical flow guidance: by warping visible masks from previous frames to the current frame, the flow-warped mask propagates visible content into occluded regions and approximates the object's current shape, providing a strong shape prior even under simultaneous deformation and occlusion. For texture completion, text guidance constrains the reconstruction of occluded appearance while providing a stable semantic reference that helps maintain visual coherence throughout the reconstruction. We also contribute LAVAT, a new benchmark featuring long video sequences paired with text descriptions, enabling evaluation of text-guided video amodal completion under heavy occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REVEAL achieves state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks while maintaining high-quality temporal consistency over extended sequences. The project page is available at: https://uark-aicv.github.io/REVEAL/.

AI.tldr: REVEAL 是一个基于扩散模型的视频非模态补全统一框架，结合光流形状先验与文本语义先验，并构建 LAVAT 长视频基准。
AI.motivation: 人类能感知被遮挡物体的完整形态，而现有基于扩散的视频非模态补全方法缺乏辅助先验，难以重建严重遮挡内容，且在长序列上难以保持时序一致性。
AI.method: 将用户文本查询一物两用：驱动开放词汇视频分割得到可见掩码，并为纹理重建提供语义引导。非模态分割上引入光流引导，将前帧可见掩码 warp 到当前帧，把可见内容传播至遮挡区域并近似当前形状，作为强形状先验；纹理补全上由文本引导约束被遮挡外观重建，并提供稳定的语义参照以维持视觉连贯。此外贡献 LAVAT 基准（长视频序列+文本描述）。
AI.result: 在现有基准上达到 SOTA，并在长序列上保持高质量时序一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结合运动（光流）与语义（文本）互补先验，可有效提升严重遮挡下的视频非模态补全与时序一致性，配套基准支持该任务的系统评测。

title: Variance Restoration over Covariance Rank: Memory-Budgeted Analytic Continual Learning
summary: Analytic continual learning replaces iterative gradient updates with closed-form ridge regression over frozen pre-trained representations, summarizing all past sessions in two running sufficient statistics: the feature autocorrelation matrix $Σ_t$ and the class cross-correlation matrix $Γ_t$. Lifting backbone features into a wide random code of dimension $M \gg D$ substantially improves linear separability across tasks, but forces $Σ_t$ to grow quadratically as $\mathcal{O}(M^2)$. Under a fixed persistent memory envelope $\Bcal$, a learner faces a fundamental structural trade-off: store exact pairwise co-activations inside a narrower feature code, or expand to a wide code while compressing cross-coordinate interactions. We observe that the coordinate self-variances $v_t = \diag(Σ_t)$ and class statistics $Γ_t$ grow only linearly with $M$, whereas off-diagonal interactions dominate memory. We introduce \method (\textbf{Co}ordinate-\textbf{Re}stored \textbf{A}nalytic \textbf{C}ontinual \textbf{L}earning), which retains $(v_t, Γ_t)$ exactly, maintains off-diagonal co-activations through a streaming rank-$q$ factor $F_t$, restores exact diagonal variances via $\Sighat_t = F_t^\top F_t + \Diag(v_t - \diag(F_t^\top F_t))$, and solves the full $M\times C$ normal equations via the Woodbury identity. Across five class-incremental benchmarks on frozen ViT-B/16, \method matches dense full-covariance readouts within $0.09$ points while cutting persistent state by $90.7\%$ ($35.9$ vs.\ $385.3$ MiB). Under equal memory envelopes of $16$--$80$ MiB, prioritizing expansion width $M$ over covariance rank $q$ outperforms exact narrow readouts in $17$ of $18$ configurations by up to $+2.19$ points.

AI.tldr: CORAL 在固定内存预算下，保留对角方差与类统计、用流式低秩因子近似非对角协同激活，从而在宽随机码下实现近似满协方差的解析持续学习，内存降低90.7%且精度损失仅0.09分。
AI.motivation: 解析持续学习用岭回归替代迭代梯度更新，但为提升跨任务线性可分性需将特征映射到 M≫D 的宽随机码，导致自相关矩阵 Σ_t 需 O(M²) 存储。在固定持久内存预算下，学习者面临结构性权衡：是在较窄特征码中存精确成对协同激活，还是扩展到宽码但压缩跨坐标交互。作者观察到对角自方差 v_t 与类统计 Γ_t 仅随 M 线性增长，非对角项才是内存瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 CORAL：精确保留对角方差 v_t 与类交叉相关 Γ_t；用流式 rank-q 因子 F_t 维护非对角协同激活；通过 Σ̂_t = F_tᵀF_t + Diag(v_t − diag(F_tᵀF_t)) 恢复精确对角方差；再用 Woodbury 恒等式求解完整 M×C 正规方程。
AI.result: 在冻结 ViT-B/16 的五个类增量基准上，CORAL 与稠密满协方差读出精度相差不超过 0.09 分，持久状态减少 90.7%（35.9 vs 385.3 MiB）。在 16–80 MiB 等内存预算下，18 个配置中有 17 个表明优先扩大宽度 M 而非协方差秩 q 更优，最高提升 +2.19 分。
AI.conclusion: 内存瓶颈主要来自非对角协方差而非对角与类统计；通过精确对角+低秩非对角分解可在宽码下高效逼近满协方差解析解。固定内存时应优先将预算分配给特征宽度 M 而非协方差秩 q，这为内存受限的解析持续学习提供了明确的设计准则。

title: Done, But Still Working: Anytime Evaluation of When Coding Agents Should Stop
summary: Coding agents often continue working after their own tests pass. Does this additional work improve the patch, and how much could be saved by stopping earlier? We study these questions through anytime evaluation: replaying recorded runs, scoring intermediate patches with hidden tests, and measuring the cost incurred at each step. For policies that only stop a run or select an earlier patch, this allows paired comparisons without generating new trajectories, provided replay preserves the relevant states. Across about 6,000 runs of eight open models in two scaffolds on SWE-bench Verified, we find substantial differences in the value of continued work. The hindsight saving available at passing self-tests ranges from under 1% to 57%, depending on the model and scaffold. A rule that stops after the same patch passes twice saves 23% in a preregistered replication, but the preregistered quality test does not establish non-inferiority. We explain these differences by measuring how often a rule fires, how often the patch changes afterwards, and whether those changes repair or break it. Fine-tuning agents to imitate the rule saves 30% over six seeds, while quality preservation remains uncertain. Our results help identify both the opportunities and the risks of early stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"anytime evaluation"（重放已记录的编码智能体运行轨迹、用隐藏测试对各中间补丁打分、并统计每步成本）研究编码智能体在自身测试通过后继续工作是否值得，以及提前停止能节省多少。在约6000次运行（8个开放模型×2个脚手架，SWE-bench Verified）上，事后可节省比例在不到1%到57%之间，取决于模型与脚手架。一条"同一补丁连续通过两次即停"的规则在预注册复现中节省23%，但质量非劣效检验未成立；用微调让智能体模仿该规则在六个种子上节省30%，质量保持仍不确定。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在自测通过后往往继续工作，但这类额外工作是否真正改进补丁、以及若更早停止能节省多少，此前缺乏系统量化。作者希望同时识别提前停止（early stopping）带来的机会与风险。
AI.method: 提出 anytime evaluation 框架：重放记录好的运行轨迹，用隐藏测试对中间补丁打分，并计量各步成本。对"仅停止运行"或"选择更早补丁"这类策略，可在不生成新轨迹的情况下做配对比较（前提是重放能保留相关状态）。在 SWE-bench Verified 上以8个开放模型×2种脚手架、约6000次运行评估；并测量规则触发频率、触发后补丁变化频率、以及这些变化是修复还是破坏补丁，以解释差异；另做预注册复现与六种子微调实验。
AI.result: 自测通过时的事后可节省比例因模型与脚手架差异巨大（不足1%至57%）。"同一补丁连续通过两次即停"规则在预注册复现中节省23%，但预注册的质量非劣效检验未通过。微调智能体模仿该规则相对基线节省30%（六种子），但质量保持仍不确定。差异可由规则触发频率、触发后补丁变动频率、以及变动是修复还是破坏来解释。
AI.conclusion: 提前停止在成本上有可观节省潜力，但质量风险不容忽视；其收益高度依赖模型与脚手架，且简单的经验规则难以在统计上证明不损害质量。结果表明需要更细致的停止策略与更严格的质量评估。

title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
summary: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Ambient SFT，用预训练模型的"冻结"副本作噪声教师，通过匹配高温条件分布来增强微调数据，缓解 SFT 过拟合与灾难性遗忘，在多个任务上优于标准 SFT。
AI.motivation: SFT 数据集规模远小于预训练数据，容易过拟合，并灾难性遗忘数据分布尾部。作者希望在不依赖更多高质量数据的前提下防止这种崩溃。
AI.method: 将预训练模型冻结为"噪声教师"，要求微调模型的条件分布在高温（平滑）形式下与预训练模型的对应分布匹配；温度 T 控制对预训练模型的信任程度：T→∞ 退化为普通 SFT，T=1 等价于知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在领域自适应、指令微调与推理任务上均优于标准 SFT，平均相对提升最高约 21%。
AI.conclusion: Ambient SFT 是一个有原则的框架，通过利用不完美预测扩充微调集，在保持预训练分布知识的同时提升微调效果。

title: Must You See Fakes to Catch Fakes? Language Says What to Look For, Real Images What to Ignore
summary: Must a detector see generated images in order to catch them? Detection of AI-generated images has long faced two problems. The cues a detector learns from the few generators in its training set carry traces specific to those generators and transfer poorly to new ones, which limits generalization. The real and generated training images also differ in format and content, so the detector takes these differences as evidence of authenticity, and its decisions change with factors that have nothing to do with authenticity, which harms robustness as well as generalization. Both problems stem from training on generated images. A detector never trained on them can largely avoid both at the source. Vision foundation models have already learned the concept of "AI-generated" during pretraining, and text can point to it directly. Building on this, we propose SaySee, a training-free detector: Say builds a generation direction from sets of paired descriptions that differ only in authenticity and scores an image by the projection of its embedding onto it, and See uses real images to correct the score offsets caused by format, image type and content. On 24 evaluation sets that span standard benchmarks, in-the-wild data and the latest generators, SaySee reaches a mean AUC of 98.2% with MoE-ViE, 4.2 points above the best existing detector. When format is decoupled from authenticity, it remains the best of all methods. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练检测器SaySee：用视觉基础模型与文本构建"生成方向"，仅凭真实图像校正偏差，在24个评测集上平均AUC达98.2%，超过最佳现有检测器4.2分。
AI.motivation: 现有AI图像检测器面临两大问题：(1)泛化差——从训练集少数生成器学到的线索带生成器特异性，难以迁移到新生成器；(2)鲁棒性差——真实与生成训练图像在格式、内容上的差异被当作真实性证据，导致决策受与真实性无关的因素影响。二者根源都在于"用生成图像训练"。
AI.method: 提出免训练检测器SaySee，基于视觉基础模型预训练已学到"AI生成"概念。Say：由仅真实性不同的成对描述集构建"生成方向"，用图像嵌入在该方向上的投影打分；See：用真实图像校正由格式、图像类型、内容引起的分数偏移。
AI.result: 在覆盖标准基准、真实场景数据与最新生成器的24个评测集上，配合MoE-ViE平均AUC达98.2%，比最佳现有检测器高4.2分；将格式与真实性解耦后仍为全部方法中最优。
AI.conclusion: 检测器无需在生成图像上训练也能有效识别AI图像，可从源头规避泛化与鲁棒性问题，并为免训练检测范式提供新思路。

title: Pareto-Informed Smart "Predict, then Optimize" for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Problems
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted after peer review at the Multi-Objective Decision Making (MODeM) Workshop at ECAI 2025
summary: Many real-world planning applications, from logistics, routing to resource allocation, give rise to optimization problems that need to balance multiple, conflicting objectives. While machine learning is often used to predict the unknown parameters or costs of these problems, standard models trained on prediction accuracy can lead to suboptimal plans. Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) addresses this by integrating the downstream optimization task into the training objective. However, existing DFL methods for multi-objective problems rely on simple scalarization, which fails to capture the rich trade-offs of the Pareto Frontier. To address this gap, we propose a Pareto-aware extension to single-objective Smart "Predict, then Optimize" (SPO+) for multi-objective combinatorial optimization problems. Our loss function leverages the true Pareto Frontier, forming a target decision that aligns with a sampled preference vector, and minimizes regret against this target. Experiments on multi-objective shortest path and multi-objective knapsack problems show that our approach outperforms traditional two-stage Mean Squared Error (MSE) baselines. It also surpasses scalarization-based SPO+ approaches.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种面向多目标组合优化的Pareto感知SPO+扩展方法，用真实Pareto前沿构造偏好对齐的目标决策并最小化后悔，实验上优于两阶段MSE和基于标量化的SPO+基线。
AI.motivation: 现实规划问题（物流、路径规划、资源分配）常需平衡多个冲突目标；机器学习预测未知参数时，以预测精度训练的模型会导致次优方案。决策聚焦学习（DFL）虽将下游优化纳入训练目标，但现有多目标DFL方法依赖简单标量化，无法捕捉Pareto前沿的丰富权衡关系。
AI.method: 提出单目标SPO+的Pareto感知扩展，用于多目标组合优化。损失函数利用真实Pareto前沿，构造与采样偏好向量对齐的目标决策，并对该目标决策最小化后悔（regret），从而将多目标权衡信息融入训练。
AI.result: 在多目标最短路径和多目标背包问题上，该方法优于传统两阶段MSE基线，也优于基于标量化的SPO+方法。
AI.conclusion: 将Pareto前沿与偏好对齐的目标决策引入DFL损失，可有效提升多目标组合优化中的决策质量，克服标量化方法对权衡刻画不足的问题。

title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
summary: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出并落地了VITAL框架，用于验证药物临床开发中的智能体AI，通过使用情境、可追溯性、自主性与生命周期证据建立风险分级的验证与治理体系。
AI.motivation: 现有保证方法无法判定证据是否足以验证、监测和治理药物情境下的智能体AI；看似合理的输出可能掩盖检索、推理、编排或人控环节的失败，且缺乏参考标准。
AI.method: 通过领域分析、监管与标准映射、专家访谈和多利益相关方迭代，开发并操作化VITAL（按预期用途、可追溯性、自主性与生命周期证据验证），将使用情境、控制措施、行为验证与生命周期证据整合进风险调整框架。
AI.result: 在流行病学与治疗格局分析、中心选择、入组挽救和试验设计权衡四类场景中应用VITAL，把自主性、可逆性、透明度与患者影响转化为相称的验证活动、证据要求和可审计的系统行为重构。
AI.conclusion: VITAL可为更高风险药物用途的证据要求和生命周期问责提供参考；后续评估需检验其在不同评估者、组织和系统配置下的可复现性。

title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have excelled in Western medical imaging, yet their potential in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis remains systematically unevaluated. Tongue diagnosis requires sophisticated global and local perception, serving as a rigorous touchstone for assessing the visual understanding depth of MLLMs. However, existing datasets are limited by single dimensions, coarse granularity, and ambiguous labels, hindering the evaluation of authentic clinical capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniTongue, the first comprehensive, fine-grained Visual Question Answering benchmark for TCM tongue diagnosis. This benchmark integrates 1,351 expert-validated images and 21,616 instruction pairs. Its core design features 16 clinical dimensions for multidimensional evaluation, region-specific annotations for pathological localization, and 66 fine-grained labels for precise diagnostic representation. Extensive evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant performance gaps, demonstrating that medical-specific models lack domain advantages, while universally poor Macro-F1 scores expose a reliance on statistical shortcuts rather than genuine understanding of tongue pathology. These findings not only highlight the current limitations of MLLMs in interpreting regional medical features but also underscore OmniTongue's significance for developing robust automated tongue diagnosis models. The code and dataset will be made publicly available in a future release.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniTongue——首个面向中医舌诊的细粒度多模态VQA基准，含1351张专家验证图像和21616组指令对，覆盖16个临床维度、区域级标注和66个细粒度标签，系统性评估揭示现有MLLM的显著性能缺口。
AI.motivation: MLLM在西方医学影像表现优异，但在中医舌诊领域缺乏系统评估；舌诊需全局与局部感知，是检验MLLM视觉理解深度的严格试金石。现有数据集维度单一、粒度粗糙、标签模糊，难以评估真实临床能力。
AI.method: 构建OmniTongue基准：整合1351张专家验证图像与21616组指令对；核心设计包括16个临床维度的多维评估、面向病理定位的区域级标注、以及66个细粒度标签实现精确诊断表征。基于该基准对现有MLLM进行广泛评测。
AI.result: 评测显示现有MLLM存在显著性能差距：医学专用模型未表现出领域优势；普遍偏低的Macro-F1分数暴露模型依赖统计捷径而非真正理解舌象病理。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显MLLM在解读区域性医学特征上的当前局限，并强调OmniTongue对发展鲁棒自动化舌诊模型的重要价值；代码与数据集将后续公开。

title: Learning to Undo: Transfer Reinforcement Learning under State Space Transformations
summary: Transfer learning in reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong empirical success. In this work, we take a more principled perspective by studying when and how transferring knowledge between MDPs (a source and a target) can be provably beneficial. Specifically, we consider the case where there exists an undo map such that applying this map to the target's state space recovers the source exactly. We propose an algorithm that learns this map by matching state feature statistics gathered from both MDPs, and then uses it to transfer the source policy to the target. We theoretically justify the algorithm by analyzing the setting when the undo map is linear and the source is linearly-$Q^\star$ realizable, where our approach has strictly better sample complexity than tabula rasa RL in the target MDP. Empirically, we demonstrate that these benefits extend beyond this regime: on challenging continuous control tasks and Atari games, our method achieves significantly better sample efficiency. Overall, our results highlight how shared structure between tasks can be leveraged for efficient transfer of policies across environments.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论角度研究MDP间迁移学习何时可证明有益：当存在undo map将目标状态空间映射回源MDP时，通过匹配状态特征统计学习该映射，再将源策略迁移到目标，理论上样本复杂度优于从零学习，实验上在连续控制和Atari任务中显著提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中的迁移学习虽经验成功，但缺乏对"何时、如何迁移可证明有益"的原则性理解。作者希望通过刻画源与目标MDP之间的共享结构（存在undo map），给出可证明的样本复杂度优势。
AI.method: 假设存在undo map，使其作用于目标状态空间可精确恢复源MDP。算法通过匹配从两个MDP采集的状态特征统计量来学习该映射，然后用它把源策略迁移到目标MDP。理论分析聚焦于undo map为线性、源MDP满足线性-Q*可实现性的情形。
AI.result: 理论上，在该设定下方法的样本复杂度严格优于在目标MDP中从零开始的RL（tabula rasa）。实验上，优势超出该理论区间：在具有挑战性的连续控制任务和Atari游戏上均取得显著更好的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 任务间的共享结构可被有效利用以实现跨环境的策略高效迁移。研究结果既给出了迁移有益的可证明条件，也展示了方法的广泛经验有效性。

title: Structured AI ideation yields physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair
summary: AI systems increasingly support literature analysis, candidate evaluation and hypothesis refinement, but enabling researchers to explore research directions beyond established disciplinary approaches remains challenging. We developed Abelio, an AI system designed to generate novel research directions by expanding investigators' avenues of inquiry. Abelio reformulates research objectives, uses these alternative formulations to identify relevant elements outside conventional disciplinary boundaries, and refines the resulting hypotheses. Each stage integrates divergent exploration with convergent selection through a dedicated subsystem. In quantitative evaluations, proposals generated by the Ideation Core (Abelio's hypothesis-generation core) outperformed those of four frontier large language models in scientific soundness and hypothesis diversity, and three of four in distance from existing literature. Subsystem ablation showed that each subsystem contributes to the property it targets, with the contribution of Element Selection measurable before Refinement. To investigate intestinal epithelial barrier restoration, Abelio proposed physical interventions involving membrane-tethered poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) and cholesterol-anchored complementary DNA. Both proposals were archived before experimentation and subsequently tested independently in damaged Caco-2 monolayers. PEG preserved barrier function in a membrane-surface-dependent manner, whereas complementary DNA enabled sequence-specific restoration that was reversible on demand. These findings demonstrate how structured research ideation can identify experimentally testable approaches beyond established disciplinary conventions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Abelio系统，通过重构研究目标、跨学科元素检索与假设精炼三阶段（每阶段含发散-收敛子系统）生成超越学科惯例的新研究方向，并在量化评估与Caco-2肠屏障实验中得到验证。
AI.motivation: AI已能辅助文献分析、候选评估和假设精炼，但帮助研究者跳出既有学科范式、探索跨界研究方向仍然困难。
AI.method: Abelio包含三个环节：重构研究目标；用替代表述在传统学科边界之外识别相关元素；精炼所得假设。每阶段由专门子系统结合发散性探索与收敛性筛选。评估采用与四个前沿LLM的量化对比、子系统消融实验，并以肠道上皮屏障修复为案例，对生成的物理干预方案（膜锚定PEG、胆固醇锚定互补DNA）在损伤Caco-2单层中独立验证。
AI.result: Ideation Core生成的提案在科学合理性与假设多样性上优于四个前沿LLM，在与现有文献的距离上优于其中三个；消融实验显示各子系统贡献其目标属性，元素选择子系统的贡献在精炼之前即可测出。实验验证中，PEG以膜表面依赖方式维持屏障功能，互补DNA实现序列特异性且可按需逆转的修复。
AI.conclusion: 结构化研究构思能够识别出可实验检验、且超出既有学科惯例的方法，表明AI可有效拓展科研方向探索空间。

title: Unified Residual Translation for Paired Image Restoration
summary: Paired image restoration spans changes in imaging contrast, sensor modality, and spatial resolution. These settings differ in their input channels and target grids, raising the question of how much of the prediction pipeline must be specialized to each task. We present the Unified Residual Translator (URT), which separates fixed channel and scale mapping from learned residual prediction. A deterministic reference uses channel averaging, replication, or bicubic interpolation to match the target dimensions, while a NAFNet encoder-decoder predicts an additive correction from the complete input. Separately trained instances share the prediction rule, $\ell_1$ objective, and optimizer across MRI contrast synthesis, visible-to-infrared translation, SAR-to-optical translation, and real-camera super-resolution. Across six task and scale settings, URT achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM among the evaluated baselines on IXI, SEN1-2, and RealSR $\times3$ and $\times4$. It reaches 30.774dB on IXI and 13.478dB on SEN1-2, with luminance PSNR of 33.596, 28.742, and 27.342dB at the three RealSR scales. On LLVIP, it ranks second in PSNR and SSIM. A study of four spectral alternatives identifies complementary benefits of fitted references and bandwise residual gains. Together, these results support explicit dimensional alignment and learned residual correction as a common formulation for heterogeneous paired imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: URT将固定的通道/尺度对齐与学习的残差预测分离，统一处理MRI对比合成、可见光-红外、SAR-光学转换与真实超分等异构配对图像恢复任务。
AI.motivation: 配对图像恢复任务在输入通道和目标网格上差异大，如何确定预测流程中有多少需要针对每个任务专门化，是本文关注的核心问题。
AI.method: 用确定性参考（通道平均、复制或双三次插值）匹配目标尺寸，再由NAFNet编码器-解码器基于完整输入预测加性残差；不同任务的实例共享预测规则、ℓ1目标和优化器。
AI.result: 六个任务与尺度设定中，在IXI、SEN1-2与RealSR ×3/×4上取得最高PSNR与SSIM；IXI达30.774dB，SEN1-2达13.478dB，RealSR三尺度亮度PSNR为33.596、28.742、27.342dB；LLVIP上PSNR与SSIM排名第二。四个光谱方案的研究显示拟合参考与逐带残差增益具有互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 显式维度对齐加学习残差校正可作为异构配对成像任务的通用形式。

title: SpatialCast: Reading the 3D World via Cast Shadows
comment: 10 pages (main paper), 7 pages (supplementary material), 5 figures and 6 tables in the main paper
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance toward understanding and interacting with the physical world, spatial reasoning becomes essential for understanding scene structure and anticipating the effects of physical changes. Existing spatial benchmarks have made substantial progress in evaluating spatial relations, memory, and viewpoint reasoning, but less systematically assess how models connect physical scene conditions with visual observations. We introduce SpatialCast, a benchmark that uses cast shadows to evaluate this ability. Cast shadows provide observable evidence of a 3D scene. Their image appearance depends on object geometry and pose, illumination, and viewpoint. We examine this relationship through three complementary tasks that assess scene-projection consistency, predict intervention-induced changes, and infer the physical changes behind visual transitions. The benchmark contains 21,000 synthetic questions with separate scene and geometry test partitions, complemented by 200 SpatialCast-Real questions from 20 photographed scenes. Evaluations show that closed-source MLLMs outperform general-purpose open-weight MLLMs and MLLMs designed for spatial reasoning, which remain near chance on the synthetic benchmark, while even strong closed-source models struggle with shadow-length and light-height judgments. We also use SpatialCast training data for GRPO post-training, improving open-weight MLLM performance on the benchmark. Further evaluations show improvements on several external spatial benchmarks, suggesting transfer of the learned capabilities. These experiments support SpatialCast as a controlled resource for diagnosing spatial reasoning capabilities and studying their learning and generalization.

AI.tldr: SpatialCast 是一个利用投影阴影（cast shadows）系统评估多模态大模型物理场景空间推理能力的新基准，含 21,000 道合成题与 200 道真实场景题，并用其训练数据做 GRPO 后训练以提升开源模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有空间基准在评估空间关系、记忆和视角推理方面已有进展，但较少系统性考察模型如何将物理场景条件与视觉观测联系起来。投影阴影是三维场景的可观测证据，其成像受物体几何与姿态、光照和视角共同影响，是检验这一能力的理想载体。
AI.method: 构建 SpatialCast 基准：通过三类互补任务（场景-投影一致性判断、预测干预引起的变化、由视觉变化反推物理变化）考察阴影关系；数据含 21,000 道合成题（场景与几何两个独立测试分区）及来自 20 个实拍场景的 200 道 SpatialCast-Real 真实题。并利用基准训练数据对开源 MLLM 进行 GRPO 后训练。
AI.result: 闭源 MLLM 显著优于通用开源模型与面向空间推理的 MLLM，后者在合成基准上接近随机水平；即便强闭源模型在阴影长度与光源高度判断上仍吃力。GRPO 后训练可提升开源模型在 SpatialCast 上的表现，并在若干外部空间基准上也观察到提升，提示所学能力具有迁移性。
AI.conclusion: SpatialCast 为诊断空间推理能力、研究其学习与泛化提供了受控资源，揭示了当前 MLLM 在物理场景-视觉观测关联上的明显短板。

title: Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
summary: GRPO has become the dominant reinforcement learning method for eliciting reasoning capability in LLMs using verifiable rewards. However, it suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when a training question exceeds the base model's current capability, all generated responses fail and receive zero reward, yielding no gradient signal and stalling further capability expansion. An emerging class of GRPO extensions, termed Hint-Augmented GRPO (HA-GRPO), adds a "hint" to the context to reduce the difficulty of the question, thereby producing a usable gradient signal. Nevertheless, existing HA-GRPO methods share a key issue: no hint is available at inference time to append to the question, creating a training-inference context mismatch that leads to inconsistent performance gains. In this work, we reinterpret the function of hinting -- not as reducing question difficulty, but as steering model behavior -- and propose ASH (Activation Steering for Hinting), a novel HA-GRPO method built on this view. During training, the model is presented with both hinted and plain questions, while a trainable steering vector is optimized to widen the margins between the model's generation probabilities for responses to the hinted version relative to the plain version, thereby capturing the question-agnostic component of the behavioral shift induced by the hint. During inference, the trained steering vector is directly injected into the model's activation, reproducing the hint-conditioned behavior without requiring any hint in the context. Experiments with four LLMs (Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base, Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct) show that ASH consistently improves pass@$k$ on competition-level mathematics benchmarks (AMC, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25) and out-of-distribution benchmarks (Minerva, GPQA-Diamond). Notably, it improves average pass@8 of Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base by \textbf{2.60}\% and \textbf{2.21}\%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ASH（Activation Steering for Hinting），将 hint 的作用重新理解为"引导模型行为"而非"降低题目难度"，用可训练的 steering vector 在推理时复现 hint 条件下的行为，缓解 HA-GRPO 的训练-推理上下文不匹配问题，在多个数学与 OOD 基准上稳定提升 pass@k。
AI.motivation: GRPO 存在根本失效模式：当训练题目超出基座模型当前能力时，所有回答都失败、奖励全为零，梯度信号消失，能力扩展停滞。现有 Hint-Augmented GRPO 通过给上下文加 hint 降低难度以产生梯度，但推理时并无 hint 可附加，造成训练与推理的上下文不匹配，性能提升不稳定。
AI.method: 作者把 hinting 的功能重新诠释为"行为引导"而非"难度降低"。训练时同时向模型输入带 hint 与不带 hint 的题目，并优化一个可训练的 steering vector，以拉大模型对带 hint 版本回答的生成概率相对不带 hint 版本的差距（widen margin），从而捕捉 hint 引发的行为变化中与具体问题无关的成分。推理时无需任何 hint，直接把训练好的 steering vector 注入模型激活，即可复现 hint 条件下的行为。
AI.result: 在四个模型（Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base、Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct）上，ASH 在竞赛级数学基准（AMC、OlympiadBench、AIME24、AIME25）与分布外基准（Minerva、GPQA-Diamond）上均一致提升 pass@k。其中 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 与 Qwen3-4B-Base 的平均 pass@8 分别提升 2.60% 和 2.21%。
AI.conclusion: 将 hint 视为行为引导信号并用激活层 steering 在推理时复现，是一种可行且有效的 HA-GRPO 改进方案，既保留了 hint 带来的可用梯度信号，又消除了推理时的上下文不匹配，跨模型与跨基准表现一致。

title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
summary: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. Fine-tuning updates 16,106 parameters across the actor and critic, while the deployed selector retains only the 11,725-parameter ranking network, with the residual branch and critic used exclusively during training. In open-loop evaluation on the nuScenes validation set, the method reduces average Euclidean trajectory error (L2) by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld model baseline without RL-based selection. Under matched budgets for feedback accesses and actor updates, residual exploration reduces L2 by 0.83% relative to the categorical PPO variant trained without residuals. The method also maintains lower L2 than RiskWorld when risk features are removed or shuffled.

AI.tldr: 提出残差引导强化学习框架，用PPO微调候选轨迹选择与有界残差联合策略，推理时仅部署上下文排序网络，在nuScenes上平均L2降低3.99%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶世界模型可预测未来场景以评估候选轨迹，但固定选择规则难以捕捉随场景变化的权衡关系。
AI.method: 冻结世界模型+固定候选库；PPO微调选择与有界残差的联合策略；上下文条件排序网络通过评估所选轨迹局部扰动所得反馈学习候选偏好；推理时以固定权重融合学习偏好与预测风险排序，并原样返回所选候选；共微调16,106参数，部署仅保留11,725参数排序网络。
AI.result: nuScenes验证集开环评估：相对RiskWorld基线平均L2降低3.99%；在反馈访问与actor更新预算匹配下，残差探索相比无残差的类别PPO变体再降0.83%；移除或打乱风险特征时L2仍低于RiskWorld。
AI.conclusion: 轻量RL选择器可在不修改候选轨迹的前提下有效提升轨迹选择质量，且对风险特征退化保持鲁棒，训练期组件可完全剥离以降低部署开销。

title: VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.

AI.tldr: VSpark 通过带校准动作噪声的 rollout、特征对齐和 continuation 复用三项设计改进投机解码，在多种 VLA 与操作基准上实现 1.28x–2.10x 无损加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）逐 token 生成机器人动作，推理慢。投机解码可无损加速，但在机器人控制中效果受限：许多不同 token 编码几乎相同的运动，草稿模型即使接近正确动作也会被拒绝，接受率低。
AI.method: 三项设计：(i) 用带校准动作噪声的 rollout 收集数据，让草稿模型接触更广泛的机器人状态；(ii) 特征对齐，训练草稿模型匹配 VLA 的隐层特征而非仅输出 token；(iii) continuation 复用，保留 VLA 在拒绝草稿上已算出的预测，作为下一步验证的候选而非丢弃。
AI.result: 在 4 种使用不同动作 tokenizer 的 VLA 和 4 个操作基准上，VSpark 取得 1.28x 至 2.10x 加速，且保持 VLA 解码无损。
AI.conclusion: 针对机器人动作的多义性改进投机解码的训练数据、对齐目标与验证复用，可显著提升 VLA 推理速度而不牺牲动作质量。

title: PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. On PhysAlign, PhysScope achieves higher solving scores than direct solving across all six evaluated VLMs. With Gemini-3.8-flash, it outperforms Canvas-CoT by 9.34 percentage points and substantially improves solving accuracy on the out-of-distribution (OOD) PhysUniBench benchmark. Ablation studies support explicit scope management and dependency maintenance as design principles for multimodal physics reasoning agents.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysScope，一种推理时的视觉约束框架，让视觉语言模型把物理适用域直接绑定到视觉观测并在推理中自我纠错，无需更新权重。
AI.motivation: VLMs虽能读懂物理图示，却会把物理约束错用到其不成立的状态或条件下，导致前提错误在后续计算中级联传播。
AI.method: 推理时视觉harness：将物理作用域（scope）与视觉观测关联，显式构造派生视图辅助推理；对状态区分、条件与作用域施加显式约束；校验智能体提出的修订是否与来源与作用域一致，接受的修订使已注册的依赖项失效，从而维护作用域感知的工作记忆。
AI.result: 在PhysAlign上，六个被测VLM的求解得分均高于直接求解；Gemini-3.8-flash上比Canvas-CoT高9.34个百分点，并在OOD的PhysUniBench上显著提升准确率；消融支持显式作用域管理与依赖维护为关键设计原则。
AI.conclusion: 显式作用域管理与依赖维护可作为多模态物理推理智能体的有效设计原则，且无需训练即可获得提升。

title: Let Samples Sing in Chorus: Mitigating Spurious Correlations via Cross-view Consensus
summary: Deep models often rely on spurious correlations that fail on underrepresented groups. Existing methods either correct human-specified bias attributes or infer unknown biases from the learned representation space. However, annotated attributes may differ from the shortcuts actually used by a model, while a single representation provides incomplete and potentially noisy evidence. Our key insight is that a bias obscured in one feature space may be clearer in another. In this work, we propose CHORD (Cross-view Harmonic Outlier Reversal for Debiasing), a multi-view framework that allows samples to "sing in chorus" across diverse representation spaces to achieve robust cross-view consensus. CHORD aggregates aggregates within-class partitions in each view, which is a proxy for specifying candidate biases, to debias the target representation and classifier without bias supervision. Experiments on seven benchmarks across vision, language, speech, and medical imaging show consistent improvements in worst-group accuracy. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/davelee-uestc/chord_debiasing_public .

AI.tldr: 提出CHORD多视图去偏框架，在无需偏置监督下通过多表示空间的一致性发现并纠正虚假相关，提升最差组准确率。
AI.motivation: 深度模型依赖虚假相关，在少数群体上失效；已有方法依赖人工指定的偏置属性（可能与模型实际使用的捷径不符），或仅从单一表示空间推断未知偏置，证据不完整且可能有噪声。
AI.method: 核心思想：在某一特征空间被掩盖的偏置可能在另一空间更清晰。CHORD在多个表示空间（视图）中分别聚合类内划分，作为候选偏置的代理，实现跨视图共识，从而在无偏置监督下对目标表示与分类器去偏。
AI.result: 在视觉、语言、语音、医学影像共七个基准上，最差组准确率一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 多视图共识为无监督去偏提供了更鲁棒的偏置识别方式，且跨模态/跨领域普遍有效。

title: Where Should Physics Enter? Information, Identifiability and Calibration in Probabilistic Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting
summary: Advection-diffusion priors are a common way to make neural sea surface temperature (SST) forecasts physics-informed. We test where such a prior must enter a heteroscedastic ConvLSTM to help, using daily NOAA OISST v2.1 for the Bay of Bengal (1982-2024) and a synthetic benchmark on the same grid with known currents of controlled strength. (i) On real data, a soft advection-diffusion residual with a learned velocity gives no reliable benefit (lead-15 CRPS -0.007 degrees C, 95% interval [-0.022, +0.008]); a plain temporal-smoothness penalty matches it, and equivalence within 3% is not established either. (ii) Learned velocities do not recover the currents, whether placed in the loss, in an explicit transport step, or in a transport step without neural correction: they correlate with the reference no better than a shuffled-date null, even on synthetic data where knowing the currents would improve day-15 forecasts by 16-23%. (iii) Supplied currents help on synthetic data, but mostly as information: giving them to the network as input channels, without transport, recovers 92% of the transport design's lead-5 gain, and a frozen-current numerical forecast does as well as either. (iv) With GLORYS12 reanalysis currents on real data, the transport design is 6% and 4% worse at leads 1 and 5; reanalysis advection explains essentially none of the daily OISST change (correlation 0.02), and frozen-current transport is worse than persistence. (v) The defect that matters is lead-dependent miscalibration shared by every model. One variance multiplier per lead, fitted on validation data, brings 90% coverage to 0.85-0.91 at all leads and lowers day-1 CRPS by 13-21%; fine-tuning on 15-day rollouts fixes long-lead coverage but costs short-lead skill. This version withdraws an earlier claim of an 81% CRPS reduction that came from an uncontrolled comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了平流-扩散先验在异方差ConvLSTM海温预报中应放在何处才有益，结论是该先验（无论学习还是供给海流）基本无可靠收益，真正关键的是按lead校准方差。
AI.motivation: 平流-扩散先验被广泛用于让神经海表温度（SST）预报"物理约束化"，但先验应插入何处、是否真的有效缺乏受控检验，作者希望厘清其真实价值。
AI.method: 用孟加拉湾1982-2024年NOAA OISST v2.1日数据及同网格、已知可控流场的合成基准，在异方差ConvLSTM中分别把平流-扩散先验放入损失、显式输运步、以及无神经校正的输运步，比较是否学习速度、是否供给GLORYS12再分析海流，并进行lead相关的概率校准实验。
AI.result: (i) 真实数据上软平流-扩散残差无可靠收益（lead-15 CRPS -0.007°C，95%区间[-0.022,+0.008]），与普通时间平滑惩罚相当；(ii) 学习速度无法恢复海流，与打乱日期零假设无差别，即便合成数据中已知海流可提升day-15预报16-23%；(iii) 合成数据中供给海流主要作为输入信息，输入通道方案已获得输运设计lead-5增益的92%；(iv) 真实数据GLORYS12流场下输运设计在lead-1/5分别差6%和4%，再分析平流几乎不解释OISST日变化（相关0.02）；(v) 核心缺陷是各模型共有的lead相关误校准，按lead一个方差乘子可将90%覆盖率调到0.85-0.91，并降低day-1 CRPS 13-21%；15天rollout微调修复长lead覆盖但损害短lead技巧。
AI.conclusion: 平流-扩散先验在神经SST预报中缺乏可靠证据支持，海流信息更多作为输入而非输运机制起作用；应优先解决按lead的概率校准问题，而非引入物理先验。本文并撤回先前因非受控比较而得到的81% CRPS降低结论。

title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
summary: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. In internal evaluation, it achieved a macro Dice coefficient of 85.35%, BLEU-4 of 0.6504, an F1 score of 94.37% for joint tooth localization and Fédération Dentaire Internationale (FDI) identification, and a grounding-tag F1 score of 77.93%. In the two external cohorts, senior endodontists considered 91.16% and 84.52% of reports suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting. Generation averaged 4.41 seconds per PR, several tens of times faster than manual drafting. Among 196 survey participants without medical backgrounds, 96.4% preferred reports with plain-language explanations and care recommendations, and 84.7% found visual localization cues helpful. PeriaTrace may enable faster, evidence-traceable reporting while supporting clinical review and patient communication. (Abridged version)

AI.tldr: PeriaTrace是一个三阶段框架，实现牙齿级诊断、有视觉依据的报告生成，以及面向患者的通俗解释与护理建议，显著提升根尖周X线报告效率与可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 根尖周X线（PR）在牙髓诊断中至关重要，但读片与写报告耗时；专业术语影响患者理解，现有自动化方法缺乏"发现—图像证据"的牙齿级关联。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：①牙齿级诊断（牙齿定位与FDI编号）；②视觉接地（grounding）的报告生成；③患者友好的通俗解释与护理建议。基于内部数据集12,877张PR及两个外部临床队列进行开发与评估。
AI.result: 内部评估：宏Dice 85.35%，BLEU-4 0.6504，牙齿定位+FDI识别联合F1 94.37%，接地标签F1 77.93%。两个外部队列中，资深牙髓科医生分别认为91.16%和84.52%的报告可直接保留或稍作修改。生成平均4.41秒/张，比人工撰写快数十倍。196名无医学背景受试者中，96.4%偏好含通俗解释与护理建议的报告，84.7%认为视觉定位提示有帮助。
AI.conclusion: PeriaTrace可实现更快、证据可追溯的报告生成，支持临床复核与医患沟通，具备临床转化潜力。

title: Beyond the Camera: A Tri-Modal Driving World Model for Future RGB, Thermal, and LiDAR Forecasting in Adverse Weather
summary: Driving world models forecast what a vehicle's sensors will record next. Most forecast camera video and some add LiDAR, but thermal cameras, which still see in darkness and some adverse weather, are rarely a forecast target, and to our knowledge no world model forecasts all three sensors. We study joint forecasting of RGB, thermal, and LiDAR on real adverse-weather sequences of the DSERT-RoLL dataset. We post-train a pretrained video world model for each sensor and represent LiDAR as a depth video aligned with the RGB camera, with densification and encoding chosen by what the model's video tokenizer can reconstruct. A tri-sensor model sees all three sensors as one video. We score LiDAR in meters against measured returns and compare against persistence baselines passed through the same tokenizer as the model. With this matching, an apparent loss of the thermal model to persistence in fog disappears. On all 58 validation sequences in six weather conditions, post-trained RGB and thermal forecasts beat compression-matched persistence. Joint training lowers the LiDAR error at 2s by 2.1m at a small cost in camera fidelity, and only the tri-sensor model's LiDAR forecasts beat persistence in mean error. Blanking one sensor degrades the forecasts of the others more in snow than in fog.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究车辆多传感器世界模型，联合预测RGB、热成像与LiDAR三种传感器数据，并在真实恶劣天气数据集DSERT-RoLL上验证，发现联合训练能改善LiDAR预测并揭示传感器间互补性。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型多预测相机视频，少数加入LiDAR，但热成像相机（在黑暗和部分恶劣天气下仍可见）很少被作为预测目标，且尚无世界模型同时预测这三种传感器。作者希望填补这一空白，并研究多传感器联合预测在恶劣天气下的价值。
AI.method: 在DSERT-RoLL真实恶劣天气序列上，对每个传感器分别对预训练视频世界模型进行后训练。LiDAR被表示为与RGB相机对齐的深度视频，其稠密化与编码方式依据模型视频分词器可重建的效果来选择。三传感器模型将三种传感器视为一个视频进行联合训练。LiDAR以米为单位对照实测回波评分，并与经过相同分词器的持续性基线比较。
AI.result: 采用压缩匹配的持续性基线后，热成像模型在雾天相对持续性的“损失”消失。在六种天气条件的全部58条验证序列上，后训练的RGB与热成像预测均优于压缩匹配的持续性基线。联合训练使2秒处LiDAR误差降低2.1米，相机保真度略有代价；仅三传感器模型的LiDAR预测在平均误差上优于持续性。遮挡某一传感器时，雪天对其他传感器预测的退化影响大于雾天。
AI.conclusion: 多传感器联合世界模型可行且有益：公平的压缩匹配基线至关重要，联合训练可提升LiDAR预测，传感器间互补性随天气而异，雪天依赖更强。

title: A Neural Envelope Method for Rapid Gradient-based Optimum Takeoff Trajectory Design
comment: 16 pages, 12 figures, submitted to AIAA Aviation conference
summary: Urban air mobility arises to mitigate ground traffic congestion. Multidisciplinary analysis and optimization (MDAO) has been introduced to reduce the energy consumption, thereby expanding aircraft performance. Surrogate-based MDAO lowers the cost of optimization, but multimodality disrupts global optimum search for both simulation-based and surrogate-based optimizations. Convex envelopes convert multimodal spaces into unimodal spaces, permitting efficient convex optimization; however, convexifying a design space may produce infeasible "optimal" designs due to complex design constraints. To address these challenges, this work proposes the coupling of a physics-constrained generative adversarial networks (physicsGAN) and neural envelope to transform original, constrained, non-convex optimizations into unconstrained, convex optimizations. Specifically, the physicsGAN discovers a feasible design space where all design candidates inherently satisfy all constraints, by penalizing surrogate-predicted constraint violations during training. Moreover, the neural envelope constructs a neural network-based convex envelope for the transformed objective function within the physicsGAN-discovered feasible space. Note that the neural envelope only needs to deal with objective function since constraints are inherently satisfied in the feasible space. The neural envelope is demonstrated on takeoff trajectory optimizations of the Airbus A3 Vahana eVTOL aircraft. Results show that neural envelopes achieve a 99.91% mean accuracy within a flight-condition space compared with reference convex envelopes. Neural-envelope-enabled optimizations achieve 99.84% accuracy on the global optimum design, costing only 0.04 seconds on average. The neural envelope accelerates the trajectory optimization by 53 and 162 times on average compared to the physicsGAN-enabled gradient-based and global optimizations, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出将物理约束生成对抗网络(physicsGAN)与神经凸包络耦合，把有约束非凸优化转化为无约束凸优化，并在eVTOL起飞轨迹优化中验证，取得99.84%全局最优精度、平均仅0.04秒。
AI.motivation: 城市空中交通需通过MDAO降低能耗提升性能，但基于代理模型的MDAO仍受多峰性困扰，难以全局寻优；凸包络可将多峰空间转化为单峰以便凸优化，然而直接凸化设计空间会因复杂约束产生不可行"最优"设计。
AI.method: 提出physicsGAN与神经包络耦合框架：physicsGAN在训练中惩罚代理预测的约束违反，学习出一个所有候选设计天然满足约束的可行设计空间；神经包络在该可行空间内为变换后的目标函数构建基于神经网络的凸包络。由于约束已被内在满足，神经包络只需处理目标函数。
AI.result: 在空客A3 Vahana eVTOL起飞轨迹优化上验证：神经包络相较参考凸包络在飞行工况空间内平均精度99.91%；优化所得全局最优设计精度99.84%，平均耗时仅0.04秒；相较physicsGAN驱动的梯度法与全局优化，轨迹优化分别平均加速53倍与162倍。
AI.conclusion: 该耦合方法能将约束非凸优化转化为无约束凸优化，兼顾可行性与全局最优性，并显著加速轨迹优化，为MDAO提供高效可行的新路径。

title: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
summary: We introduce Faithfulness Video Score (FVSCORE), a neuro-symbolic framework for specification-driven video generation evaluation. Existing evaluators rely on holistic MLLM judgments or vision-language metrics, yet aligning their scores with human judgments and tracing them to specific temporal violations remain open challenges. FVSCORE addresses these limitations by compiling each video into explicit propositions capturing prompt requirements and implicit propositions capturing unstated physical, temporal, and cross-modal constraints. It grounds each proposition using specialized perceptual tools and evaluates the resulting confidence traces with soft temporal operators inspired by Linear Temporal Logic. A Significance-Aware Calibration step then aligns verification with human perception by retaining only perceptually significant violations before producing a timestamp- and evidence-grounded report. We conduct extensive experiments across public and complex multi-event benchmarks with the strongest video models to date, demonstrating that FVSCORE outperforms holistic and agent-based evaluators in human correlation while providing highly accurate and interpretable feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号框架FVSCORE，通过将提示词编译为显式命题与隐式约束命题，用专门感知工具验证并用软时序算子评估，实现可追溯、可解释的视频生成评估。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成评估器依赖MLLM整体判断或视觉-语言指标，难以与人类判断对齐，且无法将评分追溯到具体的时间性违规。
AI.method: 将视频编译为捕捉提示要求的显式命题和捕捉隐含物理/时序/跨模态约束的隐式命题；用专门感知工具对每个命题接地并生成置信轨迹；以受线性时序逻辑（LTL）启发的软时序算子评估；再经显著性感知校准仅保留感知显著的违规，输出带时间戳与证据的报告。
AI.result: 在公开及复杂多事件基准上，与当前最强视频模型对比实验表明，FVSCORE在与人类判断相关性上优于整体式和智能体式评估器，并提供高准确、可解释的反馈。
AI.conclusion: FVSCORE为规格驱动的视频生成评估提供了可对齐人类感知、可溯源且可解释的方案，优于现有整体式与智能体式评估方法。

title: Correcting Flows with Marginal Matching
summary: Flow matching models, ODE-based generative models, generate samples by gradually morphing a simple source distribution into a target distribution. However, these models still face challenges in optimally balancing computational efficiency with generation fidelity. While predictor-corrector schemes have been proven to help address this issue in diffusion models effectively, their application to flow matching models remains under-explored. In this work we present a novel training-based predictor-corrector framework for flow matching, which exploits the fact that the ODE can be easily reversed. Our key idea, termed Marginal Matching, is to correct samples at a particular time step in the forward ODE towards a matching marginal distribution of the backward ODE. This scheme proves to reduce a bound on the distance between the data distribution and the learned distribution, motivating two different implementations for the correction function. We show that our proposed method improves sample quality on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64, with minimal overhead in computation time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向流匹配模型的训练式预测-校正框架，通过"边缘匹配"在正向ODE特定时刻将样本校正到反向ODE的匹配边缘分布，从而在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 流匹配等ODE生成模型难以兼顾计算效率与生成保真度。预测-校正方案在扩散模型中已被证明有效，但在流匹配模型中研究不足；本文利用流匹配ODE易于反转的特性来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出基于训练的预测-校正框架。核心思想为Marginal Matching：在正向ODE的某个时间步，将样本向反向ODE所对应的匹配边缘分布进行校正，并证明该方案可降低数据分布与学习分布之间距离的上界；据此给出校正函数的两种实现方式。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10与ImageNet-64上提升了样本质量，且计算时间开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 将预测-校正思想成功引入流匹配模型，理论与实验均表明其能在低开销下改善生成保真度，为流匹配的采样效率与质量平衡提供了新思路。

title: FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond
summary: Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. We analyze this mismatch on Video-MME-v2 and find that different question subsets prefer different frozen frame-budget policies, while uniformly increasing the frame count does not reliably improve all metrics. These findings motivate fixed-mean frame-budget routing, a controlled inference setting in which each question may receive a different frame budget while the average budget matches a uniform reference. We introduce FrameRouter, a training-free test-time framework that combines an evidence-demand router, a budget-constrained allocation rule, and a frozen bank of frame-sampling policies. By controlling how much visual evidence each question receives while leaving the underlying samplers unchanged, FrameRouter is orthogonal to query-aware frame selection. Across Video-MME-v2 and several long-video understanding benchmarks, FrameRouter improves long-video question answering by using the same average visual budget more selectively across questions. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/FrameRouter.

AI.tldr: FrameRouter 提出一种免训练的测试时框架，在固定平均帧预算约束下，为不同问题自适应分配不同帧数，从而更高效利用视觉预算，提升长视频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答基准（如 Video-MME-v2）对所有问题采用统一的帧预算，但不同问题所需的视觉证据量差异巨大；作者分析发现不同问题子集偏好不同的帧预算策略，且单纯增加帧数并不能可靠提升所有指标，说明统一预算存在错配。
AI.method: 作者提出"固定均值帧预算路由"这一受控推理设定：各问题可用不同帧预算，但平均预算与统一参考持平。FrameRouter 由三部分组成：证据需求路由器（判断问题所需证据量）、预算受限的分配规则（在总预算约束下分配帧数）、以及冻结的帧采样策略库；整个过程免训练，且不改动底层采样器，因此与查询感知的帧选择方法正交。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME-v2 及多个长视频理解基准上，FrameRouter 在相同平均视觉预算下通过更有选择性地分配帧数，提升了长视频问答表现。
AI.conclusion: 按问题需求自适应分配帧预算比统一预算更有效；FrameRouter 以免训练、即插即用的方式实现这一思想，为长视频问答提供了一种与现有采样策略互补的预算利用方案。

title: Classification of Tissues on MALDI-MSI Image Modality for Pancreatic Cancer Studies
summary: Mass Spectrometry Imaging (MSI) spatially maps molecular distributions in tissue sections. Despite the availability of preprocessing tools for MSI data, building end-to-end workflows suitable for deep learning remains challenging. We have developed a fully automated pipeline for transformation of raw Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Mass Spectrometry imaging (MALDI-MSI) data into deep-learning-ready image patches for binary pancreatic tissue classification (tumoral vs non-tumoral) and built individual models for recognition of tumoral regions in spectral images. Images resulting from the proposed pipeline and from reference interactive workflow are very close in terms of image quality metric mean squared error (MSE). The proposed pipeline computational time is of 20 min in average compared to a full working day of the reference interactive workflow. The models achieved 0.94 accuracy on high-resolution spectra and a mean accuracy of 0.59 on lower-resolution spectra.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个全自动流水线，将原始MALDI-MSI质谱成像数据转换为可直接用于深度学习的图像块，用于胰腺组织肿瘤/非肿瘤二分类，并训练模型识别光谱图像中的肿瘤区域。
AI.motivation: MSI可在组织切片上空间映射分子分布，但缺少适配深度学习、端到端的预处理工作流，现有预处理工具需大量人工交互，耗时长且难以规模化。
AI.method: 构建全自动pipeline，把原始MALDI-MSI数据转换为适配深度学习的图像patch，在此基础上训练二分类（肿瘤vs非肿瘤）模型；并与参考的交互式工作流在图像质量（MSE）和计算时间上对比。
AI.result: 自动化pipeline与参考交互式工作流生成的图像MSE非常接近；计算时间平均约20分钟，而参考交互式工作流需约一整天。模型在高分辨率谱上达0.94准确率，在低分辨率谱上平均准确率0.59。
AI.conclusion: 全自动pipeline可高质量、快速地将MALDI-MSI数据转化为深度学习可用数据，显著提升效率，并在高分辨率谱上实现高准确率的胰腺肿瘤分类；低分辨率谱表现有限。

title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
summary: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-policy baseline across multiple reasoning tasks. Overall, our results highlight how distributing samples across complementary policies can be a more effective use of sample budget than repeated i.i.d. sampling from a single policy at inference time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"分层策略"：用同一语言模型骨干上的 k 个独立 LoRA 适配器各生成一个回答，组成 k 样本推理目标，并针对 pass@k 直接优化，从而将推理期样本预算分配给互补的策略群体而非单一策略重复采样。
AI.motivation: 现有推理期扩展方法主要靠对单一策略重复采样再评估集体效用，样本之间冗余度高、多样性有限。作者希望探究：把推理期样本预算分配给一个策略群体（每个策略出一个样本），是否比单一策略 i.i.d. 采样更有效地利用预算。
AI.method: 提出 stratified policies：k 个学习得到的策略共享同一语言模型骨干，各自用单独的 LoRA 适配器实现，每个策略为 k 样本推理目标贡献一个回复；整体针对 pass@k 目标直接优化。理论上在线性设定下分析 best-of-k 近似误差，证明 LoRA 群体可在每个单 LoRA 预测误差严格为正的情况下达到零 best-of-k 近似误差。
AI.result: 在多个推理任务上，分层策略相对单一策略基线一致提升 pass@k；理论分析给出在单一策略无法达到零误差的场景下群体可达到零 best-of-k 误差的存在性与机理支撑。
AI.conclusion: 在推理阶段把样本预算分散到互补的策略群体上，比从单一策略重复 i.i.d. 采样更能有效利用样本预算，是推理期扩展的一种更优思路。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study
summary: Efficient control of underfloor heating (UFH) systems coupled with heat pumps (HPs) is challenging due to the high thermal inertia of buildings and the slow dynamic response of UFH systems.
