Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a data-driven control approach capable of simultaneously optimizing energy consumption and thermal comfort. However, the application of DRL-based controllers in occupied buildings under real operating conditions remains limited. This work presents and end-to-end case study (development, evaluation, and real-world deployment) of a DRL-based controller for an integrated UFH-HP system. First, a simulation-based pilot study was conducted to assess different DRL algorithms, control strategies, and configurations. Subsequently, a digital twin of a real residential building was developed and used to train DRL agents under simulated operating conditions. The best-performing agent was then deployed in the physical building without additional online fine-tuning. The results show that the controller successfully maintained indoor temperatures within the prescribed comfort limits while dynamically adjusting the HP supply temperature and UFH valve positions. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of deploying DRL controllers in occupied buildings and highlight their robustness and the practical challenges associated with transferring control policies from digital environments to real heating systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对集成地暖-热泵系统开展端到端深度强化学习（DRL）控制器案例研究（开发、评估、真实部署），先在仿真中比较算法与策略，再基于真实住宅数字孪生训练智能体，并直接部署到实际建筑而无需在线微调，验证了DRL在有人居住建筑中维持热舒适并动态调节供水温度与阀门开度的可行性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 地暖热惯性大、动态响应慢，与热泵耦合后控制困难；DRL可同时优化能耗与热舒适，但现有研究多在仿真中进行，缺少在有人居住的真实建筑、真实工况下的部署验证。
AI.method: 采用端到端流程：①基于仿真的先导研究，评估不同DRL算法、控制策略与配置；②构建真实住宅的数字孪生，在模拟工况下训练DRL智能体；③将表现最优的智能体部署至实体建筑，不进行额外在线微调。
AI.result: 控制器在真实建筑中成功将室内温度维持在规定的舒适范围内，同时动态调节热泵供水温度与地暖阀门开度，表现出良好的鲁棒性，并暴露出从数字环境迁移到真实供热系统的实际挑战。
AI.conclusion: DRL控制器可在有人居住的建筑中实际部署，具备可行性与鲁棒性；仿真到现实的策略迁移仍面临实际工程挑战，需在开发阶段予以关注。

title: CascadeJEPA: Enhancing 3D Geometric Representations via Spatially Coupled Cascaded Prediction
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for predictive visual representation learning. However, our analysis of I-JEPA reveals a growing discrepancy between semantic and geometric learning: improved semantic recognition during pretraining is accompanied by degraded 3D geometric representations. We hypothesize that this partly stems from predicting highly abstract latent representations with incomplete spatial context, favoring semantic regularities over fine-grained geometric information. To address this issue, we introduce CascadeJEPA, a spatially coupled cascaded prediction framework that promotes richer patch-level interactions through full-grid context encoding and cross-attention between prediction stages, while largely preserving the original I-JEPA architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over I-JEPA across multiple 3D geometric tasks while maintaining strong semantic recognition performance. Furthermore, its advantages extend to future feature forecasting and world model planning, highlighting the potential of enhanced geometric representations to support predictive world modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析I-JEPA存在语义与几何学习失衡问题，提出CascadeJEPA，通过全网格上下文编码与跨阶段交叉注意力增强patch级交互，在保持语义识别的同时大幅提升3D几何表示能力。
AI.motivation: 作者发现I-JEPA预训练中语义识别性能提升的同时，3D几何表示反而退化。推测原因在于：用不完整的空间上下文去预测高度抽象的隐表示，使模型偏向学习语义规律而忽视细粒度几何信息。
AI.method: 提出CascadeJEPA，一个空间耦合的级联预测框架：采用全网格上下文编码（full-grid context encoding）提供更完整的空间信息，并在预测阶段之间引入交叉注意力（cross-attention），促进更丰富的patch级交互，同时基本保留原始I-JEPA架构。
AI.result: 在多个3D几何任务上相对I-JEPA取得显著提升，同时保持较强的语义识别性能；优势还扩展到未来特征预测（future feature forecasting）和世界模型规划（world model planning）任务。
AI.conclusion: 增强的几何表示有助于支撑预测式世界建模，说明CascadeJEPA在语义与几何学习之间取得更好平衡，具备超越表征学习本身的更广泛潜力。

title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code and per-scenario results: https://github.com/nleaxy/learned-vs-kinematic-trajectory-prediction
summary: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.

AI.tldr: 研究观测历史频率降低时，学习型轨迹预测器相对匀速/匀加速模型是否仍有优势。在Argoverse 2上将5s历史降采样至5/2/1Hz，发现RNN误差分别增3.1%/10.1%/20.3%，但在直行与转弯上对更好运动学模型的优势均保持24-30%；10Hz模型加插值在2Hz仅差≤1.3%，1Hz差11.5%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶轨迹预测模型常在固定采样频率上训练，而V2X传来的位置仅为1-10Hz，需验证频率下降时学习型预测器是否仍优于CV/CA等运动学模型。
AI.method: 在Argoverse 2上把焦点智能体5s历史从10Hz降采样到5/2/1Hz，预测6s未来（无地图、无邻近智能体）；每个频率训练一个LSTM-RNN，并与10Hz训练+线性插值的同网络对比。假设与阈值预先固定，主网络各用10个随机种子，24,984测试场景做bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: 频率特定RNN的平均位移误差在5Hz增3.1%、2Hz增10.1%、1Hz增20.3%。与假设相反，其相对更优运动学模型的优势并未在直行上消失，各频率下直行与转弯均有24-30%优势；但行人场景CV更准。10Hz+插值模型在≤2Hz时最多差1.3%，1Hz差11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 各假设仅部分得到支持；学习型预测器在稀疏历史下仍显著优于运动学模型，但需按频率区分对象（行人宜用CV）。

title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
summary: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.

AI.tldr: 在自我改进编码代理的持久指令中写入简短价值观陈述，会同时改变其性能与所构建方案的形态；但价值观仍需人类设计，代理自改价值观会削弱差异。
AI.motivation: 自我改进代理通常只按产出结果优化，缺少塑造其"如何工作"的手段，尤其在开放式任务中。作者想探究在持久指令文件中加入简短价值观陈述，是否不仅影响性能，也影响代理构建出什么。
AI.method: 基于Schwartz基本人类价值观理论，选取四类高阶价值（开放变革、保守、自我增强、自我超越），在多样化编码任务中，将每类价值观在一次运行内的多轮自我改进过程中固定不变，观察其对性能与解方案的影响。
AI.result: (1) 价值观影响性能：开放变革类在留出数据上提升性能，相反的保守类则低于"无价值观"基线。(2) 价值观改变所构建的东西：解算法在规模、复杂度与方法上出现差异。(3) 人类监督仍必要：让代理自改价值观会缩小不同价值集间差异；从AI文献中提炼的价值观相比无价值观无可检测增益。
AI.conclusion: 设计良好的价值观能够影响自我改进编码代理构建什么，并在任务允许时影响其性能表现；价值观的设计应由人类把关，而非交由代理自行修订。

title: TANGO: Real-World Unregistered RGB-Guided Hyperspectral Super-Resolution with Two-Camera Acquisitions
comment: 18 pages, 11 Figures, 10 tables. Submitted to CVPR 2027
summary: Unregistered hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to recover a high-resolution HSI from a low-resolution hyperspectral observation and an unregistered high-resolution RGB reference. Although recent methods have begun to address the geometric misalignment between the two modalities, their evaluation is still constrained by the lack of a large-scale public benchmark based on real two-camera RGB--HSI acquisitions with a high-resolution HSI reference. To address this gap, we introduce DUET, the first large-scale public dataset for unregistered RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution, comprising 403 indoor and outdoor scenes captured with two separate RGB and hyperspectral cameras. We further propose TANGO (Two-camera AligNment with Gated Occlusions), which first compensates for the dominant cross-camera displacement through end-to-end global alignment and then refines the remaining inconsistencies with a coarse-to-fine local feature alignment. A learned gating mechanism further attenuates the RGB guidance where the two views cannot be consistently matched. Experimental results show that TANGO achieves state-of-the-art performance on both DUET and REAL across all evaluated scale factors, outperforming the strongest competitor on DUET by up to 2.29 dB in PSNR while requiring 2.5$\times$ fewer FLOPs. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/FagiolottoConSombrero/TANGO-DUET

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个大规模真实的未配准RGB引导高光谱超分数据集DUET（403个室内外场景，双相机采集，含高分辨率HSI参考），并提出TANGO方法：先端到端全局对齐补偿主位移，再用由粗到细的局部特征对齐修正残差，并通过学习门控在无法一致匹配处削弱RGB引导。
AI.motivation: 现有未配准HSI超分方法虽开始处理两模态几何失配，但缺乏基于真实双相机采集、带高分辨率HSI参考的大规模公开基准，导致评价受限。
AI.method: 构建DUET数据集（403个室内外场景，独立RGB与HSI相机采集）；提出TANGO：端到端全局对齐 + 由粗到细的局部特征对齐 + 学习式门控机制（在不一致区域衰减RGB引导）。
AI.result: 在DUET与REAL上所有评测尺度因子均达SOTA；DUET上PSNR最高超出最强对比方法2.29 dB，且FLOPs仅为其约1/2.5。
AI.conclusion: 填补了未配准RGB引导HSI超分缺乏大规模真实基准的空白，TANGO在精度与计算效率上均优于现有方法。

title: Social Signal Bench: Evidence-Weighted Evaluation of Co-occurring Social Signals in Video and Audio
summary: Recognizing social signals such as interest and hesitation requires interpreting context-dependent behaviors that may co-occur in conversation. Existing affective computing benchmarks rarely evaluate such co-occurring signals, and conventional multi-label F1 overlooks semantic relationships and annotator disagreement. We introduce Social Signal Bench, a 47-hour densely annotated benchmark for the evaluation of social signal recognition and engagement, comprising two datasets: Social Signal Bench Video (25 hours), covering ten social signals in audiovisual recordings, and Social Signal Bench Audio (22 hours), covering six signals in audio-only recordings. Each dataset pairs a public training set of online conversational video, of which 10 hours are expert-annotated and the remainder pseudo-labeled, with a private expert-labeled test set spanning four conversational domains. We also propose Evidence-Weighted F1 (EW-F1), which weights reference labels by annotator evidence and assigns graded credit to semantically related predictions through optimal per-clip matching. Controlled perturbations demonstrate that EW-F1 distinguishes semantically related errors from unrelated ones, unlike conventional F1. Under a shared evaluation protocol, 7B open models post-trained on Social Signal Bench outperform general-purpose frontier models on video and match them on audio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Social Signal Bench——一个47小时密集标注的社交信号识别与参与度评估基准（视频25小时含10类信号、音频22小时含6类信号），并提出考虑标注者证据与语义相关性的Evidence-Weighted F1 (EW-F1) 指标。
AI.motivation: 兴趣、犹豫等社交信号依赖语境且常共现，现有情感计算基准很少评估共现信号；传统多标签F1忽略语义关系与标注者分歧。
AI.method: 构建双数据集基准（公开训练集：10小时专家标注+其余伪标签；私有专家标注测试集覆盖四个对话领域），并提出EW-F1：按标注者证据加权参考标签，通过最优逐片段匹配对语义相关预测给予分级得分。
AI.result: 受控扰动实验表明EW-F1能区分语义相关错误与无关错误，而传统F1无法做到；在统一评估协议下，经该基准后训练的7B开放模型在视频上超过通用前沿模型，在音频上与之持平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为共现社交信号识别提供了标准化密集标注基准与更合理的评估指标，并证明针对性后训练可使小模型媲美或超越大模型。

title: Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models
summary: We present a provably distortion-free semantic watermarking algorithm that requires only black-box sampling access to a generative model and black-box access to a semantic embedding. A watermark is called distortion-free if, averaged over its secret detection key, it leaves the generator's output distribution unchanged; this provides a formal guarantee that watermarking does not reduce output quality. Conventional such watermarks are often brittle to transformations. This is especially problematic for images, where benign operations such as compression, cropping, or resizing change the entire pixel representation. Semantic watermarks therefore require detection to be robust to content-preserving transformations. Previous methods combining these properties rely heavily on specific white-box properties of the underlying model: either to autoregressive text generation or to diffusion-specific access, such as control of the initial noise or diffusion inversion. In contrast, our construction is fully generic: It only interacts with the generative model and the semantic embedding, a function that determines the notion of "preserving content" under which detection should be robust, via sample and query access. We then instantiate this framework for image generation. We characterize the two competing properties required of the semantic embedding: it should remain stable under transformations that preserve an image's content, but should distinguish independent generations from the same prompt. We train an image encoder directly for this tradeoff. The resulting encoder improves separation while maintaining stability over off-the-shelf alternatives and enables strong aggregate detection while remaining robust to various transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our watermark scheme on both open-source and closed models, which is possible only due to restriction to black-box access.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通用的无失真语义水印算法，仅需对生成模型和语义嵌入的黑盒采样/查询访问，并训练专用图像编码器实现鲁棒检测。
AI.motivation: 传统无失真水印对图像变换（压缩、裁剪、缩放）脆弱；语义水印需对内容保持变换鲁棒，但已有方法依赖模型白盒特性（自回归或扩散特有线），限制了适用性。
AI.method: 构造完全通用的无失真语义水印：仅通过样本与查询访问使用生成模型和语义嵌入；随后针对图像生成实例化，并专门训练一个图像编码器，在“内容保持变换下稳定”与“区分同提示独立生成”之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 所训练编码器相比现成方案提升了分离度并保持稳定性；在多种变换下实现强聚合检测，并在开源与闭源模型上均验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅依赖黑盒访问的通用框架，实现了兼具无失真保证与变换鲁棒性的语义水印，扩展了对闭源模型的适用性。

title: Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization
summary: Science advances from frontier to frontier as discoveries reshape what is known and create the basis for further discovery. We present Colombo, a self-organizing AI researcher that drives this renewal, first instantiated in oracle-based optimization. Here, the central question is how efficiently a problem class can be solved through a prescribed information interface and what costs no admissible algorithm can avoid. The gap between achievable guarantees and unavoidable limits defines the frontier recorded in its Complexity Atlas, a living map of frontier settings and the current state of knowledge. Self-Organization turns unresolved gaps into adaptive research programmes, coordinating conjecture formation, mathematical investigation, and replanning as evidence accumulates. Adversarial Co-Ascent develops algorithms and hard families through reciprocal challenge, exposing mechanisms of information use and concealment that guide stronger methods and proofs of unavoidable costs. Independent review and Lean-based formal certification check mathematical claims, while the Long-Term Memory carries supported findings and research experience across settings. To date, Colombo has established optimal or near-optimal rates for more than fifty settings in the Atlas. Colombo thus takes a concrete step toward Autopoietic Science: a scientific process whose validated advances regenerate the conditions of its own progress, continually reshaping how inquiry is organized and what it can discover.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Colombo，一个自组织 AI 研究者系统，在基于 oracle 的优化问题中自动推进"可达到保证 vs. 不可避成本"的前沿，迄今在 Complexity Atlas 中为 50 余个设定确立最优或近优速率。
AI.motivation: 科学进步源于前沿不断被重塑；作者希望构建能自主驱动这一"更新过程"的 AI 研究者，并把核心科学问题（信息接口下问题类的求解效率极限）作为首个试验场。
AI.method: 以 Complexity Atlas 记录前沿设定与知识状态；Self-Organization 将未解决差距转化为自适应研究计划，协调猜想、数学探究与重规划；Adversarial Co-Ascent 通过算法与困难族的相互挑战揭示信息利用与隐藏机制；辅以独立评审、Lean 形式化认证和跨设定的长期记忆。
AI.result: 已在 Atlas 的 50 多个设定中获得最优或接近最优的复杂度速率（即可达到保证与不可避下界基本匹配）。
AI.conclusion: Colombo 是迈向"自创生科学"（Autopoietic Science）的具体一步：被验证的进展能再生自身继续前进的条件，持续重塑研究组织方式与可发现的内容。

title: Know When to Zoom: How Small Is Too Small for Vision-Language Models?
comment: Accepted to the SENSE workshop at WACV 2027. 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Code, data and a plain-language walkthrough: https://siddvoh.com/know-when-to-zoom/
summary: Online vision-language models often miss small details in large images, because the service shrinks the image, or rejects it, before the model ever sees it. A car 20 pixels wide in an 8000 by 6000 drone photo reaches Claude about 6 pixels wide, and OpenAI's default rejects the photo outright. We measure how much detail survives for seven models from four vendors, using an eye exam of printed codes and 601 questions about small objects in real photos. The smallest text a model reads half the time grows from 6 pixels or less on a small image to a predicted 10 to 13 pixels on a 7680 by 4320 photo at default settings. Zooming wins much of the detail back. Splitting each photo into up to nine tiles raises accuracy by 11.1 to 14.5 percentage points for Claude and Gemini, and by avoiding rejections it lifts GPT-6.1 Sol from 50.7% to 83.7%. A two-step zoom, in which the model first names the region it needs, matches or beats tiles on Gemini and comes within 2.5 points of them on Claude, with about 40% of their image tokens. When a detail is lost, Claude and Gemini both say they cannot tell about half the time, but they fail differently in the rest: Gemini gives a confident wrong answer in 43% to 48% of these cases, Claude in only 5% to 9%. A check based on detail size, run before the call, misses most of the gain from tiles on Claude and Gemini, but Claude's own reply is a reliable trigger: tiling only after an unsure reply comes within 1.4 points of always tiling with 62% to 70% of the image tokens. We turn these findings into five rules for when an agent should zoom, and release the eye exam, every model answer and code at https://siddvoh.com/know-when-to-zoom.

AI.tldr: 论文系统测量在线视觉语言模型对大图中微小细节的保留能力（7个模型、4家厂商），发现默认缩放/拒收导致细节严重丢失，分块缩放能显著恢复精度，并提出5条"何时缩放"的智能体规则。
AI.motivation: 在线视觉语言模型服务通常会在模型看到图像前缩小图片或直接拒收，使大图中的小目标（如无人机照片里20像素宽的汽车）细节丢失。作者希望量化这一细节损耗，并找到低成本恢复细节的策略。
AI.method: 用"视力表"式印刷码测试和601道关于真实照片小目标的问答题，评测7个模型（4家厂商）；对比原图、9宫格分块、两步缩放（模型先指出需要区域再放大）等策略；分析模型对不确定性的表达与失败模式差异；考察基于细节尺寸的预检触发与基于模型回复的触发。
AI.result: 模型半可靠识别的最小文字尺寸从6像素升至7680×4320图上的10–13像素；分块使Claude/Gemini提升11.1–14.5个百分点，GPT-6.1 Sol因避免拒收从50.7%升至83.7%；两步缩放在Gemini上匹敌分块、Claude上仅差2.5点，且仅用约40%图像token；丢失细节时Gemini有43–48%自信错误，Claude仅5–9%；仅凭"不确定回复"触发分块可逼近全量分块（差1.4点），节省30–38% token。
AI.conclusion: 默认服务设置显著压缩可用细节，缩放/分块是有效补救；模型不确定性信号可作低成本触发条件；据此总结出5条智能体何时缩放的规则，并公开数据集、全部回答与代码。

title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
summary: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.

AI.tldr: 研究"赋予能力足够的冻结LLM智能体基本原语、资源与一个笼统的自我改进目标，让其自主设计上下文自我学习算法"这一自主范式，发现在无外部循环、无真实数据条件下模型可自发自我改进，且其策略与自我调节学习、自生成课程等理论一致，学到的文本产物可迁移到其他任务。
AI.motivation: 现有自我改进方法仍由人指定优化哪些组件与如何优化。随着模型能力增强，一个基本问题浮现：能力越来越强的模型是否仍需人类规定它们该如何自我改进？作者希望检验能否把"设计自我学习算法"本身也交给模型，实现更高程度的自主性。
AI.method: 以游戏玩法为测试床，给一个冻结的LLM智能体提供计算预算以及收集经验、更新文本文档的工具，设定一个笼统的自我改进目标，允许其自由实验；不施加外部规定的循环，也不接触真实世界数据，让其自行构造基于上下文的自我学习算法。随后分析其策略，并评测学到的文本产物向外部基准的迁移。
AI.result: 能力足够的模型在该自主条件下确实能自我改进；其涌现的策略与经典自我调节学习认知框架及机器学习中自生成课程的相关概念相吻合；学到的文本产物在跨不同游戏时间跨度、不同机制以及3D导航任务上均带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 自我改进的"算法设计"可以委托给足够强的模型，而不仅是委托优化过程的执行；其自主形成的策略可被已有理论解释，且产出的文本知识具有一定可迁移性，表明全自主自我学习范式在当前模型能力下已初具可行性。

title: Hidden-State Similarity Predicts Re-Elicitation After Inoculation Prompting
summary: Fine-tuning on narrow harmful tasks can cause emergent misalignment, where models generalize harmful behavior beyond the training distribution. Inoculation prompting can reduce this effect by explicitly eliciting the undesired behavior during training, but recent work shows that the behavior can reappear when evaluation prompts contain cues from the training context. We study what makes such prompts effective triggers. We find that, surprisingly, textual similarity to the inoculation prompt is an incomplete predictor. Instead, prompts are more likely to re-elicit suppressed behavior when they induce activation states similar to those produced by the inoculation context. These findings advance our understanding of how inoculation prompting modulates conditional misalignment, and suggest that activation space analysis can help identify when suppressed behaviors remain accessible under eval-time prompts.

AI.tldr: 研究"接种提示"（inoculation prompting）抑制涌现性错位的机制，发现评估提示能否重新激活被抑制行为，关键不在文本相似度，而在于其引发的激活状态是否接近接种上下文。
AI.motivation: 在狭窄有害任务上微调会使模型出现"涌现性错位"（emergent misalignment），将有害行为泛化到训练分布之外。接种提示可在训练时显式引出不良行为以缓解该效应，但近期工作显示：当评估提示含有训练上下文线索时，被抑制行为会重现。作者想弄清什么样的提示才是有效"触发器"。
AI.method: 对比分析评估提示与接种提示的关系：一方面检验文本相似度作为预测因子的效果，另一方面进行激活空间分析，考察评估提示所诱发的内部激活状态与接种上下文激活状态的相似性。
AI.result: 文本相似度只是不完整的预测因子；相反，当评估提示诱发的激活状态与接种上下文产生的激活状态相似时，被抑制行为更可能被重新引出。
AI.conclusion: 接种提示通过调节条件性错位起作用，其抑制效果与内部激活表征紧密相关；激活空间分析可帮助识别被抑制行为在评估提示下是否仍可被访问，为安全评估与提示设计提供依据。

title: PCRG: Training-Free Pruning and Caching of Reference Tokens for Video Generation
summary: Reference-to-video diffusion transformers pack the variational autoencoder (VAE) latents of all references and the generated tokens into one full-attention sequence, in which reference tokens make up about half. Because attention cost grows quadratically with sequence length, these tokens take up an even larger share of the attention computation, yet most of them are static, smooth or irrelevant to the output. To accelerate reference-conditioned generation, we propose pruning and caching of reference tokens for video generation (PCRG), a training-free, plug-and-play method that uses two signals the model already computes to assign each reference token to one of three tiers, namely pruned, cached or kept. The first is a low-level redundancy r from VAE latents, since a token whose latent barely changes over time or across its neighbors adds little new content. The second is a high-level importance g from the vision-language-model (VLM) conditioner, where the attention that the prompt and any first or last frames pay to a token tells whether the output needs to read it. Tokens that are not redundant are kept, and redundant tokens are cached if important and pruned otherwise. Pruned tokens leave the sequence before the first step with all rotary position embedding positions unchanged. Cached tokens have their keys and values computed once and reused, and kept tokens are processed as usual. On MiniMax-H3, already distilled to 8 timesteps and quantized to int8, PCRG is 1.57x faster end to end on our V2V-Bench and 1.49x faster on the public VACE-Benchmark, while the quality of VBench drops by only 0.24% and 0.17%, respectively. PCRG shortens the sequence rather than changing how attention is computed or which steps are run, so it also stacks on step caching and sparse attention. On V2V-Bench it reaches 1.86x with TeaCache, 1.82x with Spark at nearly unchanged fidelity and 2.15x with Veda.

AI.tldr: PCRG是一种免训练、即插即用的参考条件视频生成加速方法，将参考token按冗余度r与重要性g分为剪枝、缓存、保留三类，实现约1.5倍端到端加速且画质几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 参考到视频扩散Transformer把所有参考与生成token打包进一个全注意力序列，参考token约占一半；注意力开销随序列长度平方增长，而这些token大多静态、平滑或与输出无关，造成大量计算浪费。
AI.method: 利用模型已有的两个信号为每个参考token分级：来自VAE latent的低层冗余度r（时间或邻域内几乎不变则信息少）与来自VLM条件器的高层重要性g（提示词及首末帧的注意力）。非冗余token保留；冗余token中重要者缓存、不重要者剪枝。剪枝token在第一步前移出序列且RoPE位置保持不变，缓存token的K/V只算一次复用，保留token照常处理。
AI.result: 在已蒸馏至8步并量化为int8的MiniMax-H3上，V2V-Bench端到端加速1.57倍、公开VACE-Benchmark加速1.49倍，VBench质量分别仅降0.24%和0.17%；与TeaCache叠加达1.86倍，与Spark叠加1.82倍，与Veda叠加2.15倍，保真度基本不变。
AI.conclusion: PCRG通过缩短序列而非改变注意力计算方式或采样步数，因此可与步缓存、稀疏注意力等方法叠加，是一种通用高效的参考token剪枝与缓存加速方案。

title: RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models
summary: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously conduct training and improve target models is an important foundation for recursive self-improvement (RSI). As LLMs expand their role from being trained to conducting training, their model-training capability warrants dedicated study and systematic development. To this end, we construct RSI-Prime, a dataset for improving model-training capability, comprising 350 complete experimental trajectories across seven task categories. To help LLMs learn to make high-quality experimental decisions from training practice, we perform fine-grained decision identification and quality annotation, then apply decision-level loss masking to exclude supervision on low-quality behavior. Experiments with GLM-5.3 on PostTrainBench, a benchmark for autonomous post-training, show that training on RSI-Prime yields a 31.95% relative improvement in overall performance over the original GLM-5.3, highlighting a path toward future RSI systems in which models autonomously sustain their own advancement.

AI.tldr: 构建RSI-Prime数据集（350条完整实验轨迹，覆盖7类任务），通过细粒度决策识别与质量标注+决策级损失掩码训练LLM的"模型训练能力"，使GLM-5.3在PostTrainBench上整体性能相对提升31.95%。
AI.motivation: 实现递归自我改进（RSI）需要LLM能自主开展训练并改进目标模型；随着LLM角色从"被训练"扩展到"执行训练"，其模型训练能力亟需专门研究与系统化提升，但缺乏相应数据与训练方法。
AI.method: 构建RSI-Prime数据集，含7个任务类别的350条完整实验轨迹；对轨迹做细粒度决策识别与质量标注，并采用决策级损失掩码，屏蔽低质量行为的监督信号，使模型从高质量实验决策中学习。
AI.result: 在自主后训练基准PostTrainBench上，基于RSI-Prime训练的GLM-5.3相比原始GLM-5.3整体性能取得31.95%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明可通过数据与决策级监督有效提升LLM的模型训练能力，为模型自主持续推动自身进步的RSI系统提供了一条可行路径。

title: Practice in Text, Act in Pixels: Correcting Where Perception Fails
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/Carlxuzhl/practice-in-text ; aligned reader: https://huggingface.co/xuzhl/practice-in-text-aligned-reader
summary: GUI agents can learn cheaply from a text view of an interface and act on screenshots through a vision-language screen reader. Yet on a simulated mobile platform with a low-cost reader, policies that complete most tasks in text fail on many of the same tasks on screenshots. We ask where a small budget of real screenshots is best spent to close this gap. We find that the reader's misreads are systematic and recur on the same interface elements. Noise matched to the reader's error rates, a natural sim-to-real remedy, misses this structure, and in a pre-specified comparison it did not beat training the policy directly on screenshots. We therefore correct the misreads at their source with reader alignment, which fine-tunes the reader on screenshots paired with their text views. The reader learns to output each screen's text view, as in text practice, and the policy stays unchanged. Spent on the reader, the screenshot budget gives 80.9% full-task success on new task instances, against 55.6% when spent on training the policy. Given the same labeled screenshots, adapting the reader also beats adapting the policy, and a single aligned reader improves every text-trained policy we tried without retraining any of them.

AI.tldr: 在模拟移动平台上，文本视图训练的GUI智能体经低成本视觉读屏器转截图后性能大幅下降。作者发现读屏器误读是系统性的、集中于固定界面元素，故提出"读屏器对齐"：用小预算真实截图微调读屏器使其输出对应文本视图，策略保持不动。相同截图预算下新任务全任务成功率80.9%，而用于训练策略仅55.6%。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体可从界面文本视图廉价学习，但迁移到截图时在低成本读屏器下大量任务失败。需要确定少量真实截图预算应花在哪里来弥合该差距。噪声匹配（sim-to-real常用手段）忽略了误读的结构性，实验也未胜过直接截图训练策略。
AI.method: 分析发现读屏器误读具系统性、在同一界面元素上反复出现。据此提出读屏器对齐：用截图与其文本视图配对数据微调读屏器，使其对每屏输出正确文本视图，策略完全不变。与噪声匹配及直接截图训练策略进行预注册对比。
AI.result: 截图预算用于读屏器对齐时，新任务实例全任务成功率80.9%，用于训练策略时为55.6%。同批标注截图下，适配读屏器优于适配策略；单个对齐读屏器无需重训即可提升所有试过的文本训练策略。
AI.conclusion: 误读应在源头纠正而非用噪声模拟。小预算真实截图的最高性价比用途是对齐读屏器，因读屏器是策略与真实截图之间的共享瓶颈，对齐一次即可惠及所有下游策略。

title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary:
Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed.
  We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.

AI.tldr: WoRD利用学习到的轨迹扩散先验，通过条件去噪与贝叶斯重加权从部分轨迹推断智能体目标。
AI.motivation: 现有目标识别多为高层符号方法，忽略连续运动信息；基于连续轨迹的方法依赖难以获取且难迁移的显式动力学模型；且两者都未显式学习智能体如何向候选目标运动，导致在歧义轨迹前缀上精度不足。
AI.method: WoRD在每个时间步为每个候选目标运行一条warm-started去噪链，用闭式对数似然梯度将各链引导至观测轨迹，再按贝叶斯规则对采样重新加权，得到校准的目标后验分布。
AI.result: 在模拟机器人、行人轨迹和车辆轨迹三类场景中，采用针对不同失效模式的四项指标评估，WoRD均能通过歧义前缀保持校准的多模态信念，而基于滤波和分类器的观测器则塌缩为单峰或过度自信。
AI.conclusion: 学习式轨迹先验结合扩散采样与贝叶斯重加权，可无需显式动力学模型实现准确的连续目标识别，并在多场景下保持校准的多模态信念。

title: ConserveEdit: Source-Anchored Transactions for Drift-Bounded Iterative Image Editing
comment: 28 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Instruction-driven image editors produce convincing local edits in one pass, but inside an iterative refinement loop every accepted output becomes the next input, so unintended changes outside the requested region accumulate. We present ConserveEdit, an editor-agnostic controller that treats each refinement step as a transaction against a contract compiled once from the source image. The contract separates what may change (the authorized region of each target, with a bounded halo for shadows and reflections) from what must survive (protected content with explicit tolerances). Candidates from a frozen editor are composed through a source-anchored mask and committed only if target progress, drift on protected content, and image quality pass as separate tests; otherwise the step is rolled back and repaired. For any editor, this keeps every pixel outside the authorized region bit-exact and bounds drift independently of the number of iterations, whereas no fixed scalar trade-off reproduces the separate tests. On all 1053 MagicBrush test edits with a frozen Qwen-Image-Edit, masking is necessary but not sufficient. A direct call already alters the rest of the image (12.1 dB PSNR outside the mask); composed through the source-anchored mask, it stays bit-exact there and its DINO similarity to the ground truth rises from 0.67 to 0.85, matching ConserveEdit, so this gain comes from the mask. Next to automatic masks, however, masked direct editing changes a protected face or text on 48% of turns, and masked scalar selection avoids this mostly by abstaining (23% constrained success). Because its drift test names the violated entity, ConserveEdit shrinks the support instead (2% violations, 53% constrained success); in a simulator with known ground truth it raises constrained success from 55.0% to 61.8%. Automatic grounding remains the main bottleneck. Code and logs will be released.

AI.tldr: ConserveEdit是一个编辑器中立的控制器，把每次迭代编辑视为针对源图编译契约的事务，通过源锚定掩码和分项测试（目标进展/受保护内容漂移/图像质量）来防止迭代精修中掩码外内容累积漂移。在MagicBrush 1053条测试上，掩码使DINO相似度从0.67升至0.85，而ConserveEdit进一步将受保护内容违规从48%降至2%，受限成功率从23%提升至53%。
AI.motivation: 指令驱动的图像编辑器单次编辑效果可信，但在迭代精修循环中，每次被接受的输出都会成为下一次输入，导致目标区域之外的意外改动不断累积。现有方法需要固定的标量权衡，无法同时保住局部精确性与整体质量。
AI.method: 提出ConserveEdit控制器，从源图一次性编译"契约"：区分可改区域（各目标的授权区域加有界halo以容纳阴影/反射）与必须保留内容（含显式容忍度）。冻结编辑器的候选结果经源锚定掩码合成，仅当目标进展、受保护内容漂移、图像质量三项分别通过测试时才提交，否则回滚修复。漂移测试会指出被违反的实体，从而缩小支持区域而非放弃。
AI.result: 在MagicBrush全部1053条测试与冻结Qwen-Image-Edit上：直接调用已破坏掩码外区域（PSNR 12.1 dB），经源锚定掩码合成后可保持位精确，DINO相似度由0.67升至0.85。相比自动掩码，掩码直接编辑在48%的轮次中改动了受保护人脸或文字，掩码加标量选择主要靠弃权规避（23%受限成功）；ConserveEdit将违规降至2%、受限成功达53%。在已知真值模拟器中，受限成功率由55.0%提升到61.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架对任意编辑器均能保持授权区域外像素位精确，并使漂移与迭代次数无关，优于任何固定标量权衡；自动grounding仍是主要瓶颈，代码与日志将公开。

title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI)，一种基于PKI、零信任架构与远程证明的框架无关安全架构，用于验证跨组织AI agent的身份、执行完整性与授权。
AI.motivation: AI agent越来越多地跨组织边界协作，调用工具并与其他独立实体的agent交互。现有agent框架虽支持规划与协调，但缺乏验证跨组织agent身份、执行完整性和授权的通用机制。
AI.method: ATI基于PKI、零信任架构和远程证明构建：通过同行组织证书颁发机构（AgentCA）建立联邦信任，无需共享根权威；执行请求前验证agent证书、核查已批准的模型/工具/系统提示配置，并通过三项策略检查实施授权。ATI作为外部安全执行层实现，无需修改现有框架底层模型，采用IETF WIMSE工作负载令牌格式和实体证明令牌（EAT）。
AI.result: 在8个组织、6个agent框架（各部署5个agent团队）的模拟联邦中评估。安全实验涉及2个组织，评估14个攻击场景和6个良性任务，覆盖5个agent模型、5种攻击变体、每变体3次重复，由评审模型小组判定。全部执行机制启用后，攻击遏制率从43%提升至84%（在所有配置一致评估的11个场景中从40%提升至80%），每请求额外开销约174微秒。
AI.conclusion: ATI以极低开销显著提升跨组织agent协作的攻击遏制能力，并作为开源、框架无关的包发布，为跨组织agent交互提供统一的身份与执行完整性验证基础设施。

title: SlopeGuard: Towards Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection via Radial Spectral Slope Guidance
summary: AI-generated image detectors often overfit to generator-specific artifacts, hindering generalization to unseen synthesis pipelines. Existing frequency-based methods usually learn high-dimensional spectral patterns that may preserve generator-dependent variations. We explore Radial Spectral Slope, a compact descriptor of global spectral decay that captures transferable spectral trends while suppressing fine-grained variations. Our analysis shows that real and generated images exhibit systematic but generator-dependent slope differences, indicating that slope provides useful forensic evidence but is insufficient as a standalone decision criterion. This motivates combining spectral slope with semantic representations for more robust detection. Based on this insight, we propose SlopeGuard, which couples slope-aware data processing with slope guided feature learning to construct informative patch-based views, integrate Radial Spectral Slope with semantic features, and adapt prior preservation according to spectral atypicality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SlopeGuard achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracies of 97.5% on AIGCDetectBench, 97.8% on GenImage, and 85.1% on AIGIBench, while maintaining competitive performance under blur, cropping, JPEG compression, and additive noise.

AI.tldr: 提出径向频谱斜率描述子并结合语义特征，构建SlopeGuard检测器以提升对未见生成器的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器易过拟合到特定生成器的伪影，难以泛化到未见合成流程；频率类方法学习的高维频谱模式仍保留生成器相关变化。
AI.method: 采用径向频谱斜率（Radial Spectral Slope）这一紧凑的全局频谱衰减描述子，抑制细粒度变化、保留可迁移的频谱趋势；分析发现真实与生成图像的斜率差异系统性但依赖生成器，故将其与语义表示结合：SlopeGuard包含斜率感知数据处理与斜率引导特征学习，构建信息量高的patch视图，融合斜率与语义特征，并按频谱非典型性调整先验保持。
AI.result: AIGCDetectBench平均准确率97.5%，GenImage 97.8%，AIGIBench 85.1%，在模糊、裁剪、JPEG压缩与加性噪声下保持有竞争力性能。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑频谱斜率提供有用但非充分的取证证据，需与语义特征互补；SlopeGuard实现当前最优泛化检测效果并具鲁棒性。

title: Analyzing Learned Convnet Features with Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Models
comment: Presented at NIPS 2016 Workshop: Practical Bayesian Nonparametrics
summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (Convnets) have achieved good results in a range of computer vision tasks the recent years. Though given a lot of attention, visualizing the learned representations to interpret Convnets, still remains a challenging task. The high dimensionality of internal representations and the high abstractions of deep layers are the main challenges when visualizing Convnet functionality. We present in this paper a technique based on clustering internal Convnet representations with a Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model, for visualization of learned representations in Convnets. Our method copes with the high dimensionality of a Convnet by clustering representations across all nodes of each layer. We will discuss how this application is useful when considering transfer learning, i.e.\ transferring a model trained on one dataset to solve a task on a different one.

AI.tldr: 提出用狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型(Dirichlet Process GMM)对卷积网络各层全部节点的内部表示进行聚类，从而实现学习表示的可视化，并讨论其在迁移学习中的应用。
AI.motivation: 卷积网络虽在计算机视觉任务中表现优异，但其学习到的表示仍难以解释。可视化的主要难点在于内部表示维度高、深层抽象程度高。
AI.method: 基于狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型对卷积网络表示进行聚类；通过对每一层所有节点上的表示进行联合聚类，以应对表示的高维问题。
AI.result: 该技术可用于可视化卷积网络的学习表示，并说明其在迁移学习（将某一数据集训练的模型迁移到不同任务）场景中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 将DP-GMM聚类用于卷积网络内部表示可视化是一种应对高维与高抽象挑战的可行方案，尤其有助于迁移学习中的模型理解。

title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models
summary: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen computation by reusing shared layers, approaching larger models' capabilities with fewer parameters and easing the storage and deployment burden of stacking independent layers. However, repeatedly processing long visual sequences still incurs substantial compute and GPU memory costs. Visual token compression reduces these costs by shortening sequences. Existing methods mainly select original tokens directly or combine selection with aggregation. In looped models, the former may overlook changing token importance across calls and discard information needed later; the latter lack joint consideration of output changes across calls, limiting information preservation. We propose LoopZip, a training-free visual token compression algorithm addressing both issues. Visual aggregation builds a compact candidate pool before the looped backbone, and cross-invocation selection averages instruction attention from the first two existing calls of the same shared attention layer to retain tokens needed by both states. Weight-tied value correction then jointly fits shared visual-value adjustments to both pre-selection layer outputs, reducing output deviations across states. To validate LoopZip's effectiveness, we conduct extensive experiments covering two open-source looped VLMs, eleven benchmarks, and three pruning ratios. On LoopVL-1B, LoopZip retains 97.16% of the original model's performance at 50% pruning ratio and exceeds the strongest baseline by 5.36% at 87.5% pruning ratio. Across Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang, LoopVL-1B with LoopZip reduces peak allocated GPU memory by 58.36%-58.98% and achieves 2.01-2.47x end-to-end speedups over the original model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LoopZip，一种免训练的视觉 token 压缩算法，针对循环视觉语言模型（Looped VLM）在多次调用共享层时的 token 重要性变化与信息丢失问题，通过视觉聚合构建候选池、跨调用选择与权重共享的值校正，在保持性能的同时大幅降低显存与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 循环 VLM 通过复用共享层减少参数与部署负担，但反复处理长视觉序列仍带来显著计算与显存开销。现有视觉 token 压缩方法在循环模型中存在缺陷：直接选择原始 token 忽略跨调用重要性变化、丢弃后续所需信息；选择加聚合的方法缺乏对跨调用输出变化的联合考虑，信息保留受限。
AI.method: 免训练算法 LoopZip，包含三部分：1）视觉聚合：在循环骨干网络之前构建紧凑候选池；2）跨调用选择：对同一共享注意力层的前两次已有调用取指令注意力平均，保留两个状态都需要的 token；3）权重共享的值校正：联合拟合共享视觉值调整以适配两次预选择层输出，减少跨状态输出偏差。
AI.result: 在 2 个开源循环 VLM、11 个基准、3 种剪枝率上实验。LoopVL-1B 上，50% 剪枝率保留原模型 97.16% 性能；87.5% 剪枝率超出最强基线 5.36%。在 HF Transformers、vLLM、SGLang 上，峰值 GPU 显存降低 58.36%–58.98%，端到端加速 2.01–2.47 倍。
AI.conclusion: LoopZip 有效解决了循环 VLM 中视觉 token 压缩的跨调用信息保持问题，在不训练的前提下实现高剪枝率下的性能保持与显著的系统级效率提升，具备实际部署价值。

title: Evolve in Panorama, Render in View: Panoramic World State Evolution for Video World Models
summary: Video world models should maintain a world that keeps evolving as the viewpoint changes. Yet when the camera turns away and returns, current models often freeze the unobserved scene, lose objects, or change their appearance, because content outside the view has no representation that keeps changing. We present PanoEvo, which uses a Panoramic Evolver to evolve the world state in the latent space of a panoramic video diffusion model, where every viewing direction is present at every time step, so the scene evolves whether or not it is observed. Existing panoramic video models are not trained to evolve a scene from a single image or the objects within it, so we build PanoEvo-Data, an event-centric dataset from real 360° videos, and train the Panoramic Evolver coarse-to-fine as an image-to-panoramic-video model. Since each view covers only a small part of the low-resolution panorama, directly projected views are blurry and often show low-quality details or structural errors. A Perspective Renderer, built on a perspective video diffusion model, reads this state via latent-space projection and direction-restricted cross-attention to render sharp, high-quality views. PanoEvo achieves the best overall score among 23 publicly evaluated models on WRBench and the highest total score on STEVO-Bench. Code, models, and data will be released.

AI.tldr: PanoEvo 提出用全景视频扩散模型的潜空间来持续演化世界状态，使相机转开再转回时场景仍能正确演化，并通过透视渲染器生成清晰视图。
AI.motivation: 当前视频世界模型在相机移开视野时，未观测区域缺乏持续更新的表征，导致场景冻结、物体丢失或外观改变，无法维持视角变化下持续演化的世界。
AI.method: 构建全景演化器（Panoramic Evolver），在全景视频扩散模型潜空间中演化世界状态，每个时刻包含所有视角；构建事件中心的真实360°视频数据集 PanoEvo-Data，以由粗到细方式训练为图像到全景视频模型；再用基于透视视频扩散模型的透视渲染器，通过潜空间投影和方向受限的交叉注意力渲染高质量视图。
AI.result: 在 WRBench 上于23个公开评测模型中获得最佳总体得分，在 STEVO-Bench 上获得最高总分。
AI.conclusion: 以全景潜空间作为持续演化的世界表征，可有效解决视角移开再返回时的场景一致性问题，并配合透视渲染器弥补低分辨率全景投影的清晰度不足。

title: RefCloth: Transferable Adversarial Tablecloths for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Closed-loop vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely continuously on multi-view cameras, yet existing visual attacks typically hijack sensor streams with 2D patches or alter target object meshes that require retraining when manipulation objects change. We introduce RefCloth, a framework that optimizes one persistent adversarial tablecloth on a frozen source policy and deploys it zero-shot across unseen tasks and target models without modifying task objects or cameras. Throughout manipulation, static third-person and moving wrist views observe this shared world-bound texture under evolving occlusions. To generalize across shifting surface views while bridging the gap between differentiable and native renderers, RefCloth combines bounded texture parameterization with shared surface UV transformations and a same-path clean reference that removes static rendering offsets at initialization. Across four LIBERO suites in native simulation, one frozen texture transfers from OpenVLA-OFT to $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$, reducing success relative to an unoptimized cloth by 62.50 and 43.75 percentage points on average and far exceeding amplitude- and variation-matched random controls. Dual-view audits and target closed-loop camera interventions show that moving wrist exposure drives over twice the standalone drop of the main view with strong synergy, while ablations confirm the roles of UV diversification and path calibration.

AI.tldr: RefCloth 提出在冻结策略上优化一张持久的对抗桌布纹理，可零样本迁移到未见任务与目标模型（OpenVLA-OFT→π0/π0.5），无需改动物体或相机。
AI.motivation: 现有对闭环 VLA 的视觉攻击多依赖 2D 补丁或修改目标物体网格，物体变化即需重训，难以迁移；作者希望用一件世界锚定的实体纹理实现跨任务、跨模型的零样本攻击。
AI.method: 在冻结源策略上优化单一对抗桌布纹理；为跨视角泛化与跨越可微/原生渲染器差异，采用有界纹理参数化、共享表面 UV 变换，以及同路径干净参考以在初始化时消除静态渲染偏移；部署时第三人称与腕部视角在遮挡变化下共同观测该纹理。
AI.result: LIBERO 四个套件原生仿真中，一张冻结纹理从 OpenVLA-OFT 迁移至 π0 与 π0.5，成功率平均下降 62.50 与 43.75 个百分点，远超幅度/变化匹配的随机控制；双视角审计与目标相机干预显示腕部视角单独贡献超过主视角两倍且有强协同；消融证实 UV 多样化与路径校准的作用。
AI.conclusion: 单一世界锚定纹理可对闭环 VLA 策略构成强、可迁移、零样本的物理可实现威胁，且多视角曝光与渲染校准是关键因素。

title: GaussianMamba: Geometric and Relational State Space Scanning of 3D Gaussian Primitives
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction requires representing complex spatial structures and modeling contextual relationships across a scene. 3D Gaussian primitives provide a sparse and adaptive representation of scene geometry and semantics, while Mamba offers efficient sequence modeling for capturing dependencies among primitives. However, Gaussian primitives are irregular and unordered, making sequence construction challenging, as conventional spatial ordering may overlook their anisotropic geometry and feature-semantic relationships. In this paper, we present GaussianMamba, a dual-branch Mamba framework that explicitly incorporates Gaussian-specific geometric and feature-semantic relationships into complementary scanning strategies. The first branch refines a locality-preserving traversal using anisotropic Gaussian support derived from primitive scale and orientation. The second branch reorders spatially organized groups according to feature-semantic affinity and adjusts local features using geometry-weighted semantic differences. The resulting sequences are processed by separate Mamba modules, and their features are fused through a support-aware mechanism that incorporates local feature discrepancies arising from the distinct scanning paths. Experiments on nuScenes-SurroundOcc and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate consistent improvements over GaussianFormer and GaussianFormer-2 in both IoU and mIoU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GaussianMamba，一种双分支 Mamba 框架，通过显式编码高斯基元的各向异性几何与特征-语义关系构建互补扫描序列，提升 3D 语义占据预测性能。
AI.motivation: 3D 语义占据预测需表达复杂空间结构并建模全场景上下文；高斯基元虽稀疏自适应，但本身不规则、无序，传统空间排序难以兼顾其各向异性几何与特征语义关系，导致序列构建困难。
AI.method: 双分支 Mamba：第一分支基于由基元尺度与朝向推导的各向异性高斯支撑构建保局部性遍历；第二分支按特征-语义亲和度重排空间分组，并用几何加权语义差异调整局部特征；两序列分别经独立 Mamba 处理，再通过融合局部特征差异的支撑感知机制进行特征融合。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes-SurroundOcc 与 SSCBench-KITTI-360 上，相比 GaussianFormer 与 GaussianFormer-2 在 IoU 和 mIoU 上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 将高斯几何支撑与特征语义关系显式注入 Mamba 的序列扫描设计，并以支撑感知融合互补路径，可有效提升基于高斯基元的 3D 语义占据预测。

title: Teaching What to Look For: Privileged Perception Questions for Agentic On-Policy Distillation in Video Captioning
summary: Detailed video captioning requires comprehensive and faithful descriptions of objects, actions, and temporal events. Fixed-frame sampling, however, can miss brief motions, small objects, and other fine-grained evidence, motivating captioning agents that actively seek relevant moments and inspect local regions. Training such behavior is challenging because, unlike video question answering, generic captioning instructions do not specify what visual evidence should be acquired. We propose Perception-Question On-Policy Distillation (PQ-OPD), which uses training-only Perception Questions (PQs) to guide active video perception. PQs specify what should be inspected without revealing the corresponding answers, encouraging the teacher to explore the video more comprehensively and focus on relevant visual evidence. Along trajectories generated by the student, on-policy distillation transfers this guidance to the student's reasoning, tool calls, and captions; no PQs are required at inference. Across three detailed-captioning and two caption-to-QA benchmarks, PQ-OPD consistently improves the corresponding untrained agents across teacher-student scales and input-frame budgets. Under our evaluation protocol, PQ-OPD achieves the strongest primary-metric results among the compared open-source models on DREAM-1K, CaReBench, ShortVidBench, MotionBench, and VidCapBench-AE. Our ablations, together with analysis of temporal coverage and answer leakage, further indicates that the student internalizes the training-time guidance as a more effective video exploration policy.

AI.tldr: 提出感知问题在线策略蒸馏（PQ-OPD），用仅训练阶段使用的"感知问题"引导教师模型主动探索视频，再通过在线策略蒸馏把这种"看什么、何时看"的策略迁移给学生，实现更细节、更忠实的视频描述。
AI.motivation: 细节化视频描述需要全面忠实刻画物体、动作与时序事件，但固定帧采样易遗漏短暂动作、小物体等细粒度证据，因此需要能主动寻找关键时刻、检查局部区域的描述智能体。难点在于：与视频问答不同，通用描述指令并不指明应获取哪些视觉证据，主动感知行为难以直接监督训练。
AI.method: PQ-OPD 引入仅在训练时使用的感知问题（PQs），指明"应检查什么"但不泄露答案，促使教师更全面地探索视频并聚焦相关视觉证据；在学生模型生成的轨迹上进行在线策略蒸馏，将该引导迁移到学生的推理、工具调用与描述生成中；推理阶段无需任何PQs。
AI.result: 在三个细节描述基准与两个caption-to-QA基准上，PQ-OPD 在不同师生模型规模与输入帧预算下均稳定优于未训练的对应智能体；在 DREAM-1K、CaReBench、ShortVidBench、MotionBench、VidCapBench-AE 上取得所比较开源模型中最强的主指标结果。消融实验及时间覆盖度、答案泄漏分析表明学生已将训练期引导内化为更有效的视频探索策略。
AI.conclusion: 以感知问题作为训练期"证据定位"信号并对齐到策略空间，可有效训练出主动式视频描述智能体；该引导可被蒸馏内化、推理时零额外开销，且在不同规模与帧预算下具备良好泛化性。

title: ForceBody: Force-Paired Parametric Body Motion with Torque Uncertainty
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Forces and torques drive human motion, central to biomechanics, robotics, and physics-aware animation, yet they are often absent from learning-based motion pipelines for body reconstruction and generation. Some motion datasets provide force annotations, but the paired motion sequences are incompatible with the parametric body models used in modern learning pipelines. In addition, existing datasets typically obtain joint torques through inverse dynamics, which is inherently sensitive to the quality of the input kinematics; however, they do not quantify the reliability of these torque estimates. We close this gap with ForceBody, the first dataset to bring ground truth force supervision into a parametric body representation, shipped with per-sample torque uncertainty. ForceBody pairs the SKEL body model with ground reaction forces and inverse-dynamics joint torques across 10,386 motion trials (9.7M frames, 26.9 hours) from 140 subjects. Each torque label is paired with a per-frame, per-joint uncertainty annotation obtained by Monte Carlo sampling through the inverse dynamics pipeline. We benchmark six architectures (MLP, Conv1D, LSTM, GRU, Mamba2, Transformer) on ground reaction force and joint torque prediction from SKEL motion. As one example use of the released uncertainty, finetuning a Transformer with per-sample uncertainty weighting reduces the MAE of joint torque estimation by 5%. Code and data are at https://github.com/DominoAI-Lab/ForceBody-NeurIPS-ED-2026.

AI.tldr: ForceBody 是首个将真实力/力矩监督引入参数化人体模型的数据集，并为每个逆动力学力矩标注逐帧逐关节不确定度。
AI.motivation: 力与力矩是人体运动的核心，但学习式运动管线常缺乏力信息；已有带力标注的数据集与参数化人体模型不兼容，且逆动力学力矩缺乏可靠性量化。
AI.method: 将 SKEL 参数化人体模型与地面反作用力、逆动力学关节力矩配对，覆盖 140 名受试者、10,386 段动作（9.7M 帧、26.9 小时）；通过蒙特卡洛采样在逆动力学流程中为每个力矩生成逐帧、逐关节的不确定度标注。并基准测试六种架构（MLP、Conv1D、LSTM、GRU、Mamba2、Transformer）从 SKEL 运动预测力与力矩。
AI.result: 提供了力/力矩预测的基准结果；示例中利用不确定度加权微调 Transformer 使关节力矩估计的 MAE 降低 5%。
AI.conclusion: ForceBody 填补了带真实力监督且与参数化人体模型兼容的数据集空白，并首次为逆动力学力矩提供可靠度标注，可直接用于不确定度加权的力矩预测。

title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
comment: 25 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.

AI.tldr: NexSight构建可验证任务以评估和训练长视频智能体理解能力，生成SightLine数据集并用SightLoop评估，再通过轨迹监督训练Sight-35B显著提升交互式问答表现。
AI.motivation: 长视频细粒度问题（次数、顺序、状态变化时刻）需在数小时视频中定位零散片段；稀疏证据难以验证计数类结论，仅答案监督也无法显式监督证据搜索过程，因此需要可验证的评测与训练框架。
AI.method: 提出NexSight框架：用SightForge智能体流水线从原始视频密集重采证据，要求盲于草稿答案的验证器能重建答案且反例检查无法反驳任务；构建310个证据可追溯任务的SightLine数据集；设计共享多尺度评测框架SightLoop（时间探索、局部检查、证据整合、回访）；在不相交视频上用求解器轨迹作为观察决策的逐步监督训练Sight-35B。
AI.result: 最强模型在SightLine上仅达54.52%，给出标注证据时达79.35%；Sight-35B用不足6K样本将交互准确率从21.29%提升至42.26%，超越同家族397B模型，后训练后开始使用基座模型从未使用的显式空间检查，并在两个外部长视频基准上提升8个百分点以上。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的证据追踪任务既能诊断长视频智能体的定位瓶颈，也能通过轨迹级监督高效训练模型，显著提升交互式长视频理解能力。

title: Visual Harness Scales General VLMs to Medical Images
summary: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出医学视觉"挽具"(visual harness)——为通用视觉语言模型配备交互式视觉工具与无损证据记忆，通过"初答—遗漏评估—再检查测量—修订答案"的迭代智能体循环，在11项任务、4种影像模态上全面提升性能。
AI.motivation: 通用VLM直接用于医学影像任务表现不佳，缺乏系统性探查图像、积累并管理诊断证据的机制，因此需要一种通用框架而非重训专用模型来释放其潜力。
AI.method: 设计\ours视觉挽具：为通用VLM提供交互式视觉工具和系统化诊断证据管理；模型交互探索图像并逐步获取证据，证据以无损记忆保存以供检索复用；提交初答后获得"潜在遗漏+发现可靠性"的评估，据此继续检查与测量并迭代修订，直至证据充分，形成智能体闭环。
AI.result: 11项任务、4种模态全部提升：Qwen3.8-27B上脾脏测量63.3%→98.3%，肾脏搜索57.5%→71.2%，肺结节检测0.0%→28.2%；强API模型收益更佳，GPT-6.1 Sol肺结节检测10.8%→69.2%。
AI.conclusion: 更强的模型能力与有效医学视觉挽具互补，视觉挽具可作为将通用VLM扩展到医学影像任务的新范式，无需领域专用改造。

title: Pixel is All You Need
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Text, images, audio, touch, and even robot actions can, in principle, all be rendered onto a single canvas, suggesting an ambitious goal of unifying all modalities within vision. Language provides the natural first test. To subsume it, a visual model must reason directly over text in pixels. Across a wide range of image, video, and unified multimodal generators, however, we find that their visual generation modules cannot perform symbolic reasoning over text on the canvas. They succeed only when an underlying text module or prompt rewriter already supplies the answer, effectively reducing the generator to a mere renderer, a limitation that post-training does little to resolve. To test whether this failure stems from pixels themselves or from current training paradigms, we train a family of purely pixel-space generative models from scratch without any text pathway. With images as their sole input and output, these models read questions, write intermediate steps, and produce answers directly on the canvas. Remarkably, they exhibit hallmark behaviors of large language models. Performance improves predictably with scale following a power law. Writing intermediate steps frame by frame substantially outperforms single-frame answering, echoing chain-of-thought, while reinforcement-learning post-training further strengthens reasoning. Moreover, sharing one canvas allows the same model to reason across modalities, a capability that text-only language models lack. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these phenomena in purely pixel-space generative models free of text tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察多模态视觉生成模型能否在像素画布上直接对文本进行符号推理，发现现有生成器的视觉生成模块只会"渲染"已有答案；作者从零训练无文本通路的纯像素生成模型，证明其可呈现类LLM的规模定律、逐帧链式思考式推理与强化学习增益。
AI.motivation: 动机：所有模态原则上可渲染到同一画布，语言是统一视觉的首要检验；但若视觉模型只能在已有文本模块/提示改写器给出答案时成功，则生成器退化为一渲染器，说明真正的像素级符号推理尚未实现。
AI.method: 方法：先横跨图像、视频与统一多模态生成器进行评测，检验其视觉生成模块能否在画布上做符号推理；再从头训练一族纯像素空间生成模型，无任何文本通路，仅以图像为输入输出，在画布上直接读题、写中间步骤并给出答案，并进行规模扩展与强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 结果：现有生成器仅在上游文本模块或提示改写器提供答案时成功，后训练几乎无法缓解；纯像素模型随规模呈幂律提升，逐帧书写中间步骤显著优于单帧作答（类思维链），RL后训练进一步增强推理，且共享画布使同一模型可跨模态推理。
AI.conclusion: 结论：这是首个在无文本token的纯像素生成模型中系统研究此类现象的工作，表明失败源于训练范式而非像素本身，像素空间生成模型具备可扩展的符号推理与跨模态统一潜力。

title: A tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude open-water search and rescue
summary: Large aerial platforms often operate above 1.5 km to improve the efficiency of open water search and rescue (OW-SAR). However, long imaging distances, wide fields of view, and limited sensor resolution reduce objects to a few pixels, increasing their susceptibility to environmental interference and making detection harder than for conventional small objects. To our knowledge, existing datasets focus on low-altitude scenarios and do not support automatic detection at 1.5-2.0 km. We therefore present TinyWOD, a tiny object detection dataset for high-altitude OW-SAR using lifebuoys as detection targets. It comprises 11,359 manually annotated images and 19,505 annotated instances spanning diverse environments, lighting conditions, water colors, and surface ripples. Compared with existing datasets, TinyWOD contains much smaller objects and a substantially higher proportion of tiny instances; its average equivalent side length (ESL) is 12.7 pixels, with 76.96% of in stances having ESLs below 15 pixels, reflecting actual high-altitude water-rescue imaging conditions. We define APtiny, a tiny object detection metric, and benchmark mainstream and state-of-the-art networks using this and conventional metrics. All evaluated networks effectively detect tiny waterborne objects, demonstrating TinyWOD's reusability and utility. We expect this dataset to support research on tiny object detection in high-altitude OW-SAR.

AI.tldr: 提出TinyWOD——首个面向1.5-2.0km高空开放水域搜救(OW-SAR)的微小目标检测数据集，以救生圈为检测目标，含11,359张图像、19,505个标注实例，平均等效边长仅12.7像素（76.96%实例<15像素），并定义APtiny指标并给出多种网络基准。
AI.motivation: 高空平台(>1.5km)成像距离远、视场宽、传感器分辨率有限，目标仅数像素，易受环境干扰，检测难度远超常规小目标；而现有数据集集中于低空场景，无法支撑1.5-2.0km高空自动检测研究。
AI.method: 构建TinyWOD数据集：11,359张人工标注图像、19,505个实例，覆盖多样环境、光照、水色与水面波纹；目标更小、微小实例占比更高（平均ESL=12.7px，76.96%实例ESL<15px），贴近真实高空水面救援成像条件。同时定义微小目标检测指标APtiny。
AI.result: 使用APtiny及传统指标对主流与SOTA网络进行基准评测；所有被评估网络均能有效检测水面微小目标，验证了数据集的可用性与复用价值。
AI.conclusion: TinyWOD填补了高空OW-SAR微小目标检测数据的空白，可作为该方向研究与基准评测的基础数据集。

title: Kolibri: Color Finds the Place, Refinement Sets the Pose for RGB-D Localization in Colored Point Clouds
summary: An agent or robot in a scanned building must locate its camera in rooms that no model saw during training. Point cloud registration methods can align each RGB-D frame with the building's colored point cloud, accurately but at a high cost. We observe that geometric refinement brings nearby initial poses to the same final pose, so the learned component only needs to find the place. Kolibri does this with a graph network of 55,712 parameters that describes 10 cm cubes of points, called cells, by their color, local shape and neighbors. With the same refinement, it matches GeDi on 96 unseen ScanNet rooms (81.4% against 80.3% within 5 cm and 5°) and on a held-out test of 10 further rooms, in 82 ms per frame on an RTX 2080 Ti. The saved time allows for search without a room label. In one point cloud of 100 rooms, Kolibri loses 1.3 points against knowing the room, while retrieving the room first loses 56.0. In a hospital emergency department scene from a real scan, it localizes 86.5% of the frames rendered from the scan in 384 ms each, where GeDi needs 91 minutes per frame on cubes of the scan for a similar recall. The method needs colors that agree between the frame and the point cloud. On gray frames and across cameras with different color responses, point cloud registration methods keep the lead.

title: Keeping Parts Honest: Isolated Part Graphs for Faithful Vision Transformer Explanations
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Supplementary material will be added in a later version
summary: Part and prototype-based explanations for Vision Transformers (ViTs) present a decision as evidence from individual image regions. However, self-attention mixes information across patches, so part-level features absorb context from the whole image and consequently fail to faithfully reflect the decision. We show that existing interpretable ViT classifiers depend heavily on this leakage: when each explained region is encoded in isolation, their accuracy collapses, and retraining them under isolation recovers only part of the lost accuracy. We propose a classifier that represents each image as a graph of isolated parts. Each part is encoded only from its own patches by a ViT whose last blocks are fine-tuned under isolation, preventing evidence leakage from elsewhere in the image. Parts are discovered without annotation and refined hierarchically through their sub-parts, making them more consistent and stable across images than those of competing methods. Each edge is computed from part pairs, and recovers evidence that attention previously shared across the object without affecting the parts. Matching the image graph to a learned prototype graph per class makes the prediction a direct combination of node and edge similarities, each computed only from the patches it is credited to, so every explanation is faithful by construction. Across 11 fine-grained and general-object benchmarks, our method exceeds the accuracy of existing explainable methods that rely on leakage, while providing explanations that reflect what the model actually uses.

AI.tldr: 论文指出可解释ViT的部件级解释存在证据泄漏问题，提出基于孤立部件图的分类器，使解释在构造上即忠实。
AI.motivation: 现有基于部件/原型的ViT解释将预测归因于单个图像区域，但自注意力在patch间混合信息，使部件特征吸收全图上下文，导致解释不能忠实反映决策。作者实验证明：将各解释区域单独编码时现有可解释ViT准确率崩塌，即便在孤立条件下重训练也只能恢复部分精度，说明这些模型严重依赖泄漏。
AI.method: 将图像表示为孤立部件的图：每个部件仅用自身patch由一个ViT编码（其最后若干block在孤立条件下微调）以阻断证据泄漏；部件无需标注自动发现，并通过子部件分层细化使其跨图像更一致稳定；边由部件对计算，恢复注意力此前在物体内共享的证据；将图像图与每类学习的原型图匹配，预测为节点与边相似度的直接组合。
AI.result: 在11个细粒度与通用物体基准上，方法准确率超过依赖泄漏的现有可解释方法，且解释反映模型实际使用的证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过孤立部件图与原型图匹配，可从结构上保证解释忠实性，同时不牺牲甚至提升准确率，为可解释ViT提供新范式。

title: Propose & Verify: Fast Reflection Symmetry Detection via Harmonic Fields
summary: Detecting multiple reflection symmetries in 3D shapes requires aggregating geometric evidence over a large space of candidate planes, making traditional voting approaches computationally expensive. We introduce the Fourier Accelerated Symmetry Transform (FAST), a training-free framework that combines geometric pair voting with efficient spectral computation. Exploiting the fact that global reflection planes pass through the shape centroid, we reduce the search to plane orientations, while geometric consistency filtering and independent witnesses suppress unreliable pair hypotheses. Our key insight is to represent these votes as a signal over plane orientations and efficiently compute a continuous, smoothed symmetry field in the spherical-harmonic domain. Specifically, we exploit the Funk-Hecke theorem, the spherical counterpart of the Fourier convolution theorem for rotationally symmetric kernels, to transform Gaussian smoothing into multiplication of harmonic coefficients. This enables efficient field evaluation, from which symmetry candidates are extracted, refined, and geometrically verified. Across two benchmarks, including a new benchmark of highly symmetric shapes, FAST achieves the highest clean multi-plane detection $F_1$ scores among evaluated methods (0.861 and 0.947), with GPU inference below 4 ms per shape: over $100\times$ faster than the next-fastest evaluated multi-plane GPU baseline. FAST also demonstrates strong robustness to geometric noise and competitive single-plane detection, achieving 94.9% success on clean single-plane shapes.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的 FAST 框架，将反射对称投票表示为平面方向上的信号，利用 Funk-Hecke 定理在球谐域做高斯平滑，实现高效多平面反射对称检测，GPU 推理<4ms。
AI.motivation: 在 3D 形状中检测多个反射对称平面需在大量候选平面上聚合几何证据，传统投票方法计算开销大，尤其对高度对称形状效率低下。
AI.method: 先利用全局反射平面必过形状质心这一性质，将搜索降为平面朝向；用几何一致性过滤和独立见证抑制不可靠的成对假设；再将投票表示为平面朝向上的信号，借助 Funk-Hecke 定理（旋转对称核的球面卷积定理）把高斯平滑转为谐波系数相乘，在球谐域计算连续平滑的对称场，进而提取、精化并几何验证对称候选。
AI.result: 在两个基准（含新的高对称形状基准）上取得最高清洁多平面检测 F1（0.861 与 0.947），GPU 推理每形状<4ms，比次快的多平面 GPU 基线快 100 倍以上；对几何噪声鲁棒，单平面检测成功率达 94.9%。
AI.conclusion: FAST 通过球谐域谱计算显著加速多平面反射对称检测，在精度与速度上均优于现有方法，且无需训练、鲁棒性强。

title: Beyond Co-Generation: Rethinking Jointness in Joint Audio-Video Generation
summary: Our aim is to advance the understanding of genuine audio-visual coordination in joint text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation, with particular emphasis on semantic consistency. Evaluating audio-visual consistency in T2AV generation is nontrivial, as detailed text prompts obscure whether such consistency stems from genuine cross-modal coordination or merely from independent text following. To isolate the former, we introduce intrinsic jointness: the ability of audio and video to produce the same realization for details left underspecified by the prompt. Using semantically underspecified prompts (e.g., "musical instrument playing" rather than "electric guitar playing"), we investigate four recent models and reveal their limited intrinsic jointness. To address this limitation, we propose JointREPA, a simple representation alignment-based post-training method to facilitate cross-modal coordination. Since existing benchmarks use semantically detailed prompts, we introduce UNSAIDBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate intrinsic jointness under semantic underspecification. Experiments across two distinct models and three benchmarks, including UNSAIDBench, demonstrate that JointREPA consistently improves semantic consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出"内在联合性"(intrinsic jointness)概念衡量T2AV生成的真正跨模态协同，发现现有模型能力有限，并提出JointREPA后训练方法与UNSAIDBench基准。
AI.motivation: T2AV生成中，详细文本提示会掩盖音视频一致性是源于真正的跨模态协调还是各自独立跟随文本，因此需要隔离前者来评估。
AI.method: 用语义欠指定提示（如"乐器演奏"而非"电吉他演奏"）定义内在联合性；基于表示对齐的后训练方法JointREPA；构建UNSAIDBench基准评估该能力。
AI.result: 在四个近期模型上揭示内在联合性有限；在两种模型、三个基准（含UNSAIDBench）上，JointREPA一致提升语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: 语义欠指定提示能有效隔离真正的跨模态协调，JointREPA是简单有效的改进方案，UNSAIDBench填补了评测空白。

title: LOCUS: Causal Support Windows for Attribute Control in Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Unified autoregressive (AR) image generators struggle to satisfy multiple attribute constraints in a single prompt. Although these attributes are decodable from image-token latents, editing those latents at test time remains difficult. Adding a fixed attribute direction to the prefix can reinforce a requested attribute but rarely overrides a conflicting one, such as turning a car red when the prompt specifies blue. We investigate how the effect of an intervention depends on where it acts in the image-token sequence. We introduce the causal support profile, which measures, for each attribute, how often patching image-token states within a given window flips the rendered attribute. Structural attributes (count and position) are most responsive in early, narrow windows, while appearance attributes (color, size, and material) respond over later, broader windows. A budget-matched comparison of early and middle windows shows that the effect of window location depends on the target attribute, and two-dimensional support maps show that the responsive regions track spatial content. Based on these profiles, we propose LOCUS (Latent Optimization in Causal Support windows), which diagnoses which attribute failed and routes test-time latent optimization to its corresponding support window. With the generator, optimizer, reward, verifier, and token budget held fixed, support-routed windows outperform late windows by 23.6 percentage points in GenEval++ macro accuracy. With the generator frozen, LOCUS raises Janus-Pro's GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% overall and from 19.5% to 40.5% on multi-attribute tags. On GenEval, LOCUS repairs 48.1% of failed generations in one rollout, compared with 37.4% for prefix optimization, and needs 14% fewer rounds on average to succeed.

AI.tldr: 提出因果支持剖面对图像token序列中不同位置对属性效果的依赖进行刻画，并据此设计LOCUS方法，将测试时潜变量优化路由到对应属性最敏感的支持窗口，显著提升多属性约束满足率。
AI.motivation: 统一的自回归图像生成器难以同时满足单个提示中的多个属性约束。虽然图像token潜变量中包含这些属性信息，但在测试时直接编辑这些潜变量仍然困难。向prefix添加固定的属性方向可以强化某一请求属性，却很难覆盖与之冲突的属性（如提示指定蓝色汽车却要变红）。作者希望研究干预效果如何依赖于其在图像token序列中的作用位置。
AI.method: 1) 提出"因果支持剖面"（causal support profile）：对每个属性，统计在给定窗口内patch图像token状态时能翻转所渲染属性的频率；2) 发现结构性属性（数量、位置）在早期窄窗口最敏感，外观属性（颜色、尺寸、材质）在较晚的宽窗口响应；3) 进行预算匹配的早期vs中期窗口对比，并给出二维支持图，显示响应区域与空间内容相关；4) 基于此提出LOCUS：诊断哪个属性失败，并将测试时潜变量优化路由到其对应的支持窗口。
AI.result: 在生成器、优化器、奖励、验证器和token预算固定时，支持路由窗口在GenEval++宏平均准确率上比后期窗口高23.6个百分点。冻结生成器时，LOCUS将Janus-Pro的GenEval++准确率从24.6%提升到46.8%（整体），多属性标签从19.5%提升到40.5%。在GenEval上，LOCUS一次rollout修复48.1%的失败生成（前缀优化为37.4%），且平均成功所需轮数减少14%。
AI.conclusion: 干预在图像token序列中的位置对属性编辑效果具有关键且属性依赖的影响，基于因果支持剖面的窗口路由策略优于盲目或固定位置干预，为多属性约束下的自回归图像生成提供了一种高效、无需训练生成器的测试时优化方案。

title: Harnessing Image Diffusion Prior for Photo-Realistic Video Restoration
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Recent image generation models produce photo-realistic results with rich details, but transferring their powerful priors to video restoration remains difficult due to temporal inconsistency from stochastic detail synthesis. Existing video restoration methods improve temporal coherence but often sacrifice visual fidelity, leaving a gap between image-level quality and video-level stability. We propose a generative video restoration method that bridges this gap by enabling temporally consistent detail synthesis from image generation priors. Our method combines noise energy rebalancing to suppress structure-disturbing low-frequency stochasticity, motion-aligned noise warping to propagate details along object motion, a self-supervised denoising encoder to mitigate encoder-induced temporal uncertainty, and decoupled temporal attention to model cross-frame dependencies. Together, these components preserve fidelity, enhance fine-grained realism, and maintain temporal consistency. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially outperforms existing video restoration approaches in visual quality, detail richness, and temporal stability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成式视频复原方法，通过将图像生成模型的强先验以时间一致的方式迁移到视频复原中，兼顾保真度、细节真实感与时间稳定性。
AI.motivation: 图像生成模型能产生照片级细节，但其随机细节合成导致时间不一致，难以直接迁移到视频复原；现有视频复原方法虽提升时间连贯性，却牺牲视觉保真度，造成图像级质量与视频级稳定性之间的差距。
AI.method: 四个关键组件：(1) 噪声能量重平衡，抑制扰乱结构的低频随机性；(2) 运动对齐的噪声变形（warping），沿物体运动传播细节；(3) 自监督去噪编码器，缓解编码器引入的时间不确定性；(4) 解耦时间注意力，建模跨帧依赖。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、细节丰富度和时间稳定性上显著优于现有视频复原方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过噪声重平衡、运动对齐噪声传播、自监督去噪编码器与解耦时间注意力的组合，可在保持保真度的同时实现细粒度真实感与时间一致性，缩小图像级质量与视频级稳定性之间的差距。

title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
summary: Whole-slide visual question answering (VQA) offers a natural-language interface to pathology, allowing diagnostic and phenotypic questions to be answered directly from tissue slides. However, current vision-language models (VLMs) rely heavily on linguistic priors: their answers are sensitive to the order of the candidate answers, and can be reached through shortcuts that bypass the tissue evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce SlideJev, a framework that separately verifies candidate answers against the slide and learns to ground these judgments in tissue evidence. To connect parallel candidate evaluation with visual evidence learning, we adopt Jev and score each candidate by the difference between support and rejection log-likelihoods from the original language-model head. We compute these scores in parallel using separate prompts with the same format and no option-position labels, then normalize them for answer selection. To ground these scores in tissue evidence, candidate-conditioned reading and comparison guide gated updates to visual tokens across decoder layers. With the backbone frozen, we train these visual modules through the same scores using question-answer and paired-image supervision. Across three whole-slide pathology VQA benchmarks, SlideJev achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and 100% answer consistency across four option orders. Image-control experiments further show that SlideJev achieves the largest average accuracy gains from correct images over mismatched and image-free inputs across the three datasets. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev.

AI.tldr: 提出SlideJev框架，通过对每个候选答案独立地与切片证据进行验证并学习将判断扎根于组织证据，解决全切片病理VQA中VLM依赖语言先验（答案顺序敏感、走捷径）的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前全切片病理视觉问答（VQA）的视觉语言模型依赖语言先验：答案对候选顺序敏感，且可通过绕过组织证据的捷径得出结论，削弱了答案的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用Jev方法，用原语言模型头输出的支持与拒绝对数似然之差为每个候选打分；用相同格式、无选项位置标签的独立提示并行计算并归一化后选择答案；通过候选条件化的读取与比较，在解码层门控更新视觉token，将打分扎根于组织证据。骨干网络冻结，仅用问答与配对图像监督训练视觉模块。
AI.result: 在三个全切片病理VQA基准上取得最高平均总体准确率，并在四种选项顺序下达到100%答案一致性；图像控制实验显示，在三个数据集上正确图像相对错配图像与无图像输入的准确率提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 将候选答案独立验证与视觉证据扎根相结合，可有效消除顺序敏感与捷径问题，使全切片病理VQA更可靠，代码已开源。

title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. This introduces a significant performance bottleneck. An important question thus arises: what world state should a world VLA model reason over to support planning beyond pixel-level prediction? We argue that planning-oriented world modeling should focus on a compact and structured agent-centric latent state that captures the interactions between objects in the driving scene over time. As such, we introduce AgentWorld, an agent-centric VLA world model that uses discrete agent tokens jointly for reasoning and trajectory planning. Each token is dynamically grounded to a surrounding agent associated with its object's state, such as semantic identity, 3D geometry, motion, and interaction context. AgentWorld learns these tokens through three key processes: explicit geometric grounding, reasoning-oriented supervised fine-tuning, and agent-oriented reinforcement learning. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop experiments under diverse driving scenarios show that AgentWorld enhances planning capabilities, fully exploits visual evidence and agent dynamics, and yields interpretable agent-centric world states.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentWorld，一种以智能体为中心的 VLA 世界模型，用离散 agent token 联合进行推理与轨迹规划，替代像素级未来预测。
AI.motivation: 现有世界 VLA 模型在像素级生成未来帧，包含大量与驾驶无关的外观细节，只有少量 token 编码几何、运动、交互等规划关键因素，成为性能瓶颈；需要探讨"世界模型应推理何种世界状态"。
AI.method: 以紧凑、结构化的智能体为中心潜在状态建模：每个离散 agent token 动态绑定到周围智能体，编码语义身份、3D 几何、运动与交互上下文；通过显式几何接地、推理导向监督微调、以智能体为导向的强化学习三个过程学习这些 token。
AI.result: 在多场景的开环与闭环实验中，AgentWorld 提升了规划能力，充分利用视觉证据与智能体动力学，并产生可解释的 agent-centric 世界状态。
AI.conclusion: 面向规划的世界建模应聚焦紧凑、结构化的智能体中心潜在状态而非像素级预测，agent token 可同时支撑推理与规划。

title: RoadAnnoter: An AI-Assisted Desktop Tool for Semantic Segmentation Annotation of Road-Scene Images
summary: Accurate semantic segmentation of road-scene images is essential for road safety research; however, polygon-level annotation remains labor-intensive and limits labelled dataset development. This study presents RoadAnnoter v1.0, an open-source desktop application integrating six human-in-the-loop annotation modes: manual polygon delineation, SAM Prompt, Smart Select, Edge Fill, pretrained semantic segmentation using Cityscapes-trained SegFormer models, and task-specific segmentation using TinySegNet, a lightweight MobileNetV3-Small-based network trained with accumulated annotator-generated labels. SAM-based modes use promptable segmentation with SAM and MobileSAM, while Edge Fill combines Canny edge detection with colour-similarity-based flood filling in CIELAB colour space. SegFormer generates suggestions for common road-scene categories, whereas TinySegNet supports adaptation to project-specific features through iterative training. All six modes use a shared mask-to-polygon pipeline comprising morphological processing, Gaussian smoothing, contour extraction, and Douglas-Peucker simplification; annotations are exported in YOLO segmentation format.
